itinerary.title: Arrive in Dubai
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at Dubai International Airport, our tour manager will meet you and escort you to the hotel. Complete the check-in formalities and take some time to relax. Later in the evening, you will visit the Dubai Marina for a dhow cruise. The experience involves food, live entertainment, and sightseeing from the cruise.

itinerary.title: Dubai City Tour - Burj Khalifa - Dubai Fountain - Dubai Mall
itinerary.description: Today, you will explore Dubai City and experience top attractions like the Dubai Frame, the Dubai Mall, the Dubai Miracle Garden, the Dubai Aquarium, and the Burj Khalifa. The latter is the world’s tallest building, offering a 360-degree view of Dubai city from the 124th floor. The Jumeirah Mosque is famous for its medieval architecture, incorporating the Fatimid and Mamluk styles. In the evening, you will head to Dubai Fountain, the world’s largest performing fountain, famous for its light and music show.

itinerary.title: Desert Safari
itinerary.description: Today, in the afternoon, you will head out for a desert safari experience, where you will enjoy a camel ride, a quad bike adventure, a hot air balloon ride, and sand boarding. You can enjoy an overnight stay in the desert with fellow Bedouins and spend the night stargazing or return to the hotel.

itinerary.title: Abu Dhabi - Grand Mosque - Ferrari World
itinerary.description: Today, you will visit Abu Dhabi to explore the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, UAE’s largest mosque and Ferrari World, the world’s only car-themed amusement park.

itinerary.title: Depart Dubai
itinerary.description: Today, after breakfast, check out of the hotel and head to Dubai for some last-minute shopping, and later head to the Dubai International Airport to return home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Dubai
itinerary.description: Our tour manager will meet you upon arrival at Dubai International Airport and guide you to your hotel. Check into the hotel and spend the rest of the day at leisure. Later in the evening, head to the Dubai Marina for a dhow cruise. Enjoy live music, fine dining, and a panoramic view of the city’s skyline. Return to the hotel.

itinerary.title: Burj Khalifa - Dubai Fountain
itinerary.description: After a hearty breakfast, head to Burj Khalifa, the world’s tallest skyscraper. You will join the group for an At the Top tour for a 360 degree view of the city from the observation deck on the 124th floor. Enjoy lunch at the Burj Khalifa. Later, proceed to the Dubai Fountain for a light and music show at the world’s tallest performing fountain. End the day with a sumptuous dinner at an Indian restaurant.

itinerary.title: Desert Safari
itinerary.description: Start your day with a breakfast buffet and explore the hotel’s multiple amenities. You will head out to the desert in the afternoon for an exhilarating safari experience. An experienced driver will drive you through the dunes for exciting dune bashing. You can add activities such as sandboarding, sand skiing, and a hot-air balloon ride to your package. End the day by staying at the desert camp to enjoy a BBQ dinner with the local Bedouins, gaze at the Milky Way, or return to the hotel.

itinerary.title: Dubai Miracle Garden - Dubai Frame
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head to the Dubai Miracle Garden, the world’s largest natural flower garden. This beautiful garden has over 50 million flowers and over 250 million plants. Later, visit the Butterfly Garden adjacent to the Miracle Garden to marvel at over 15,000 butterflies in different sizes and colours. Later, head to Dubai Frame, the world’s largest picture frame. You can visit the observation deck of the Frame for a panoramic view of the city’s landscape. Return to the hotel in the evening.

itinerary.title: Dubai Dolphinarium
itinerary.description: Start your day with a leisurely breakfast before proceeding to the Dubai Dolphinarium, an air conditioned aquarium for dolphins and seals. You can interact with the marine animals, feed them, and even join the seals for a live show as they juggle, sing, and jump through hoops.

itinerary.title: Depart Dubai
itinerary.description: On the morning of your departure, head to Dubai Mall for some retail therapy. You can shop at Dubai’s largest gold souk, dine at one of the many restaurants, or have fun at the Middle East's largest ice rink. Head to the airport to catch your flight home.

itinerary.title: Arrive In Dubai
itinerary.description: You will fly to Dubai International Airport, where our tour manager will meet you and escort you to the hotel. Spend the rest of the afternoon relaxing and enjoying the hotel's amenities. Check into the hotel and spend the rest of the afternoon relaxing and enjoying the hotel's amenities. In the evening, you will head to the Dubai Marina for an unforgettable dhow cruise experience. Enjoy the multiple entertainment options, including music and dance shows, dinner, and a panoramic view of the city’s skyline.

itinerary.title: Dubai City Tour
itinerary.description: After a hearty breakfast, you will head out to explore the city and its multiple modern architectural marvels. Some landmarks you will visit include the Dubai Museum, Burj Khalifa, Jumeirah Mosque, Dubai Frame, and Dubai Fountain. Don’t miss taking in a 360 degree view of the city from the observation deck on the 124th floor. You will also enjoy a wonderful light and music show at the Dubai Fountain and learn about the crescent-shaped Palm Island. Return to the hotel for a relaxing dinner at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Desert Safari
itinerary.description: Start your morning with a breakfast buffet and enjoy the hotel’s multiple amenities until lunch. In the afternoon, our guide will pick you up for a desert safari. You will be driven by an experienced driver on a 4x4, where you’ll enjoy some dune bashing. Some other activities you can choose from include sandboarding, sand skiing, and a hot air balloon ride. You could spend the night in the desert camp enjoying live entertainment and dinner with the local Bedouins while watching the stars or return to the hotel.

itinerary.title: Dubai City Tour
itinerary.description: Today, you will enjoy a city tour that covers attractions missed on Day 2. These include the Dubai Miracle Garden, Dubai Aquarium and Underwater Zoo, Ski Dubai, Wild Wadi Waterpark, and the Al Fahidi Historical Neighbourhood.

itinerary.title: Aqua Venture and Lost Chambers
itinerary.description: After a hearty breakfast, you will head to the Atlantis Aquaventure theme park. This is the world’s largest theme park, with over 105 rides, attractions, and experiences. Don’t miss the fun aqua show at Splashers Island, where you can watch dolphins, sea lions, and other marine animals. Later, you will head to the Lost Chambers Aquarium at Aquaventure. This aquarium is home to over 65000 animals and offers plenty of activities, including diving with sharks, snorkelling, and scuba diving. Return to the hotel.

itinerary.title: Depart Dubai
itinerary.description: Today, you will check out of the hotel and shop to your heart’s content at the Dubai Mall. Later, head to Sharjah to catch your flight back home.

Some of the activities included in the cruise experience include food, live music, and enjoying a panoramic view of the city’s skyline. Return to your hotel after a hectic day.

itinerary.title: Burj Khalifa and Dubai Fountain
itinerary.description: After a hearty breakfast buffet, you will head out for a city tour. Some of the attractions you will cover today include Burj Khalifa and Dubai Fountain. The wall’s tallest building looks and feels magnificent. You will be taken for an At the Top 360-degree experience from the 124th floor to enjoy a panoramic view of the desert and ocean. Later in the evening, you will enjoy the Dubai Fountain's music and light show.

itinerary.title: Desert Safari

itinerary.title: Dubai City Tour

itinerary.title: Abu Dhabi - Grand Mosque - Ferrari World
itinerary.description: After your breakfast, you will head to Abu Dhabi. The first stop of your Abu Dhabi tour is the Sheik Zayed Grand Mosque, one of the world’s largest mosques. It is also home to the world’s largest woven carpet and giant chandeliers. You will later visit the Ferrari World for an out-of-this-world entertainment experience, including the world’s fastest roller coaster. This is the only Ferrari-themed park in the world. Return to Dubai in the evening.

itinerary.title: Depart Dubai
itinerary.description: This is the final day. After breakfast, you’ll check out of the hotel. Then, head to the Dubai Mall and the multiple souks for some retail therapy.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Dubai

itinerary.title: Desert Safari

itinerary.title: Dubai Full Day Tour

Later in the evening, enjoy a light and music show at the Dubai Fountain. End the day with a visit to the Lost Chambers Aquarium. This exotic aquarium is home to over 65,000 marine animals and is the perfect place to enjoy scuba diving, snorkelling, and diving with sharks.

itinerary.title: Meena Bazaar
itinerary.description: Today, you will visit the historic Al Fahidi District to explore Dubai’s Arab past. The highlight of the tour is a visit to Meena Bazaar. The market is famous for textiles, spices, raw silk, cashmere, and jewellery. The gold souk is a great place to buy authentic gold jewellery for cheap.

itinerary.title: Depart Dubai
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel and head to the Dubai Mall. There are numerous restaurants, retail stores, and entertainment options. Later, head to the airport to catch your return flight home.

packages.name: Greenland Holiday Package
packages.destination: Nuuk - Boat Tour To Kangeq - Ilulissat - Eqip Sermia

itinerary.title: Arrive in Nuuk
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at the Nuuk airport, our tour manager will guide you to the hotel and help you complete the check-in formalities. Spend the rest of the day exploring places around the hotel. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Nuuk.

itinerary.title: Nuuk – Half-Day City Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast, you'll take a half-day tour of Nuuk. You’ll explore the picturesque neighbourhoods of this historic city, which has been inhabited since 1728. Some places you will see include the Colonial Harbour, the Greenland National Museum, the Nuuk Art Museum, and the Katuaq Cultural Centre. An experienced guide will inform you about the city's fascinating geography and history. You’ll learn how people survive and manage their lives in this numbing temperature. You’ll enjoy a panoramic view of the fjords, visit the main harbour, and visit the University of Greenland's new and old campuses. Return to your hotel and spend the rest of the day lazing around in the hotel.

itinerary.title: Nuuk – Boat Tour to Kangeq
itinerary.description: After breakfast, you will enjoy a boat tour to Kangeq. This was once a traditional fishing village in Southwestern Greenland, abandoned in the 1980s. It takes around an hour to reach Kangeq, with the journey equally memorable as your boat will pass through beautiful mountains and even catch a glimpse of the arctic wildlife, including seals and whales. You’ll pass through abandoned homes that are nothing short of a museum tour. The guide will explain the consequences of politics during the 1950s and 1960s when people were forced to abandon these villages to move to the big cities. You’ll also learn about Aron of Kangeq, an Inuit hunter and painter who chronicled the myths and stories of Greenland. Return to your hotel to spend the night at Nuuk.

itinerary.title: Nuuk to Ilulissat
itinerary.description: Depart from Nuuk airport to reach Ilulissat, the third-biggest town in Greenland with over 5,000 residents. Check into the hotel and spend the rest of the day exploring the different places.

itinerary.title: Ilulissat – Eqip Sermia – Ilulissat
itinerary.description: Today, you’ll start by visiting Ilulissat Harbour for a full-day tour of the Eqip Sermia glacier, one of the largest calving glaciers in Greenland. The glacier is over 4 kilometres wide and 200 metres above water. Depending on the package chosen, you can stay near the glacier or hike to the moraine at Eqi Glacier. You can also admire the glacier from the boat as we stop for an hour to serve lunch and coffee. Return to Ilulissat and spend the night at a hotel.

itinerary.title: Guided Walking Tour of Ilulissat
itinerary.description: After breakfast, start the day with a 2-hour guided tour of Ilulissat with a local guide to learn more about the town’s history and culture. You’ll visit the old town, the fishing harbour, the old church, and the museum. Ilulissat was founded in 1741 and was named after Jakob Severin, a Danish merchant. Through the tour, you’ll learn about Greenlandic culture while visiting the buildings of the first Danish settlement. You can explore the island on your own in the afternoon before embarking on an evening cruise sailing among the icebergs. Sailing during the evening/night is a once-in-a-lifetime experience where the fading sun shines on the pristine ice sheets, displaying a unique play of colours. The icebergs are beautiful in every kind of weather – during the summer when the sunshine contrasts are very clear or when it is cloudy and the midnight sun casts a unique glow on the glacier. Return to your hotel room at night.

itinerary.title: Depart Ilulissat
itinerary.description: Spend the day at leisure until it is time to depart to the Ilulissat Airport to catch your flight home or move on to the next leg of your journey.

itinerary.title: Arrive In Rome
itinerary.description: Welcome to Rome, one of the oldest cities on the continent. Our tour manager will welcome you and help you complete the transfer formalities upon arrival. Check in to your hotel and spend the rest of the day visiting local flea markets and attractions in and around the hotel.

itinerary.title: Rome Day Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head to the Hop On Hop Off bus for a complete tour of the city’s attractions. Some of the places you will visit include the Colosseum, the Trevi Fountain, Tiber Island, and Piazza Venezia. The best thing about this bus is that you can hop in and get off anytime. Piazza Venezia is famous for its many historic buildings, including the National Museum of Palazzo Venezia—the National Institute of Archaeology, and the monument of Victorio Emanuele II, Italy’s first king. Head to the train station in the afternoon to catch your train to Florence. Check into your Florence hotel and relax well to prepare for a busy day tomorrow.

itinerary.title: Florence And Pisa
itinerary.description: Complete your breakfast and head to a Hop On Hop Off bus for a full-day tour of Florence. Today, you will explore the scenic Tuscan region and its crown jewel, Florence. Did you know this city was the birthplace of the Renaissance? The city attracts millions of tourists for its museums, art galleries, and historical buildings. Some attractions you must not miss include the statue of the David of Michelangelo, the Venus of Botticelli, and the stunning Duomo with its marble facade. After lunch, you will explore the Tuscan countryside to visit the historic University of Pisa. This is another important city famous for its Leaning Tower and the Piazza dei Miracoli. An audio commentary explains the distinctive features of the Piscan Romanesque architecture and the round-shaped Pisa Baptistery. Head to Florence in the evening to start with the next leg of your journey.

itinerary.title: Florence And Venice
itinerary.description: Complete your breakfast at the hotel and spend the rest of the morning exploring Florence's many markets and quaint streets. Around midday, you’ll take a train to Venice. Check in to your hotel and spend the rest of the evening at leisure. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Venice

itinerary.title: Venice City Tour
itinerary.description: You will explore this romantic city on foot. Much of Venice’s history is centred around St. Mark’s Square. Some monuments covered in the guided tour include the Ducal Palace, the famous Venice Jail, and the Bridge of Sighs. End the day with a visit to the Island of Murano, renowned for its centuries-old glass factory. You can explore the rest of the city and its markets in the evening. Spend the night in Venice.

itinerary.title: Venice And Innsbruck
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel to catch your train to Innsbruck. The journey takes around 6 hours and is scenic, especially in its final leg. Upon arrival, check into your hotel and spend the rest of the day exploring this breathtaking town in the Alps. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Innsbruck.

itinerary.title: Innsbruck And Zurich
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel to catch your train to Zurich. The journey takes around 3.5 hours and offers a panoramic view of the Swiss countryside. Upon arrival at the Zurich station, head to the hotel. Complete the check-in formalities to spend the rest of the evening at leisure. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Zurich.

itinerary.title: Zurich – Mt Titlis – Lucerne – Zurich
itinerary.description: Today, after breakfast, you will proceed for a full-day tour of Lucerne and Mt. Titlis, the highest vantage point in Central Switzerland. You’ll travel to Engelberg by motor coach and then take the 8-person Titlis Xpress from Engelberg to Stand station. From there, you’ll take the Titlis Rotair revolving cable car to reach Titlis. The 30-minute cable car ride is the world’s first and, without a doubt, the highlight of your Swiss trip. You’ll enjoy a 360° panoramic view of the Alps. Some of the attractions atop Mount Titlis include a visit to the Ice Grotto and Ice Flyer. The latter is a chair lift ride over the glacier with a breathtakingly beautiful view of the crevasses and ice falls. Don’t miss the snow slide on Fun Lift. The entire Titlis experience lasts for around 2 hours; then, you will descend to Engelberg to board our coach for a drive to Lucerne. You will explore Lucerne to do some sightseeing and go shopping. Some places you will visit today include the 14th-century Kapellbrucke wooden footbridge, the painted buildings of Altstadt, Chateau Gutsch, and the Picasso Museum. Return to Zurich to spend the night in the city.

itinerary.title: Zurich – Frankfurt
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head out to Frankfurt. Check into the Frankfurt hotel and head to the Hop On Hop Off bus to begin your Frankfurt city tour. This Roman-era city is famous for trade and commerce, and its most famous export - high-quality sausages called frankfurters. Some places you will visit in Frankfurt include Goethe House, Kleinmarkthalle, Frankfurt Cathedral, the Stadel Museum, and Palmengarten. Return to your hotel to spend the night at a luxury hotel in Frankfurt.

itinerary.title: Frankfurt – Amsterdam
itinerary.description: After a hearty breakfast of the famous German sausages, check out of your hotel and head to the Frankfurt Train Station to board your train to Amsterdam. The journey takes around 4 hours and is famous for its scenic views as the train travels along the River Rhine. Check into the hotel and get ready for the Hop On Hop Off bus tour. Some of the places you will cover include the renowned Van Gogh Museum, Anne Frank’s House, the famous Historisch Museum, Rembrandt House Museum, Madame Tussauds, the Diamond Museum, and the Jewish Historical Museum. Don’t miss the canal cruise on Amsterdam’s historic canals. Spend the night in Amsterdam.

itinerary.title: Amsterdam – Brussels
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel to catch the train to Brussels. After check-in, make your way for a full-day tour of this Belgian capital. Some of the sights you will cover today include the European Parliament Building, the Mannekan Pis statue, the Cinquantenaire Arch, Victor Horta, the Grand Palace, and the Atomium. Spend the night in Brussels.

itinerary.title: Brussels – Paris
itinerary.description: After breakfast, prepare for a Hop On Hop Tour of Brussels to explore sights you may have missed yesterday. You will transfer to the Brussels Train Station in the afternoon to take your connecting train to Paris. Upon arrival, transfer to the hotel and complete check-in formalities. Spend the evening exploring different places in and around your hotel. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Paris.

itinerary.title: Paris Full Day Tour
itinerary.description: Today, you will explore Paris on a Hop On Hop Off bus. As the name suggests, you can hop off and hop on at any time. The ticket is valid for 48 hours, allowing you to explore the city at your own pace. Some places you will see on the open-top double-decker bus include the Eiffel Tower, Arc de Triomphe, Champs-Elysees, Ecole Militaire, and more. Today’s tour highlights the Louvre Museum, where you can admire some of the world’s most famous artworks, including the Mona Lisa, Venus de Milo, and the Winged Bulls of Khorsbad. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Paris.

itinerary.title: Depart Paris
itinerary.description: Check out after breakfast to catch your flight to continue with the next leg of your Europe tour package or your return flight home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Madrid
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at Madrid Barajas Airport, our tour manager will meet you and assist with your transfer to the hotel. Complete check-in formalities and freshen up before your Spanish tour begins. Some of the places you will visit during the tour include the Sabatini Gardens, neoclassical gardens within the Royal Palace, and the Prado Museum.

itinerary.title: Madrid - Hop On Hop Off Tour
itinerary.description: The second day is a hop-on and hop-off tour of all major tourist attractions within the city. The city is famous for its historic buildings, museums, and plazas like the Almudena Cathedral, Prado Museum, Gran Vía, and the Plaza Mayor. But it’s equally famous for its modern buildings like Caxia Forum, Edificio Mirador, Paseo de la Castellana, and the legendary Bernabeu Stadium, home to Real Madrid FC.

itinerary.title: Madrid – Seville
itinerary.description: Wake up to have a leisurely breakfast at your hotel in Madrid before boarding a high-speed AVE train to Seville. After reaching Seville, you will have plenty of time to spend the day at your own pace.

itinerary.title: Seville – Granada - Granada Cathedral - Royal Chapel
itinerary.description: Have breakfast at the hotel before you leave for Granada, located in the Andalusia region of Spain. Witness the historical magnificence and wealth of the Spanish people through the Granada Cathedral, shining with its gold and white interiors and standing as a spellbindingly beautiful proof of Spanish Renaissance-style architecture. The Royal Chapel in Granada is where you will find the tombs of Queen Isabella I and King Ferdinand II, the monarchs who once ruled the city.

itinerary.title: Seville – Cordoba – Mosque–Cathedral of Cordoba - Palacio de Viana
itinerary.description: On your fifth day, you will be exploring the city of Cordoba. Let the gorgeousness of the Mosque-Cathedral of Cordoba leave you mesmerized. It’s an ancient structure that was constructed back when Cordoba was the capital of Al-Andalus. Post this, you can proceed to explore the Palacio de Viana with its stunning courtyards and collection of antiques and art.

itinerary.title: Seville – Plaza de Toros de la Maestranza - Torre del Oro – Madrid
itinerary.description: You can spend half your sixth day exploring Seville, learning more about the city’s beautiful architecture. Visit Plaza de Espana, the Cathedral, the Plaza de Toros de la Maestranza, an important bullfighting spot in Spain, the Orange Tree Courtyard Cathedral, the Giralda Tower, the Golden Tower, Barrio de Santa Cruz, and other major attractions within Seville. Then, it will be time to head to the Torre del Oro, also known as the Tower of Gold, built in the 12th century. Board a high-speed AVE train to Madrid and spend the night at your hotel in Madrid.

itinerary.title: Depart from Madrid
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrive at Madrid – Toledo
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at the Madrid Airport, we’ll drive you to Toledo in a private car. Toledo is renowned for its magnificent cathedrals and monasteries and is even nicknamed The Glass City thanks to its long history of glassmaking. You’ll stay at one of the best paradores in Toledo and explore the places close to your hotel.

itinerary.title: Catedral de Toledo
itinerary.description: Day 2 is dedicated to exploring Toledo, including its medieval castles and fortresses. Some famous places include the Jewish Quarter of Toledo, the stunning Catedral Primada de Toledo, Alcazar de Toledo, and the Monasterio de San Juan de los Reyes. The synagogues in Toledo include El Transito and Santa Maria la Blanca.

itinerary.title: Toledo - Granada
itinerary.description: Depart for Granada on the third day and stop at Jaen for a bit, which is famous for its historical heritage. Jaen is also called the World Capital of Olive Oil and its Renaissance architecture. You’ll stay at one of Granada’s famous paradores.

itinerary.title: Generalife – Alhambra
itinerary.description: On day 4, we’ll be exploring Granada and its multiple attractions. Some places we’ll cover in this city include - Generalife, the summer palace of the Nasrid rulers, and Alhambra, a UNESCO World Heritage Site famous for its Islam-inspired Moorish architecture.

itinerary.title: Granada – Ronda
itinerary.description: Before you go from Granada to Ronda, you will explore the city of Antequera with its many historically rich buildings and monuments. Spend the night at a Ronda Parador.

itinerary.title: Ronda – Carmona
itinerary.description: Explore the white village of Ronda, which has been declared a national historic site and visit the Bullring of the Royal Cavalry, a famous bullring in Ronda. Drive to Carmona in the evening and spend your evening at one of the paradores in the city.

itinerary.title: Carmona – Merida
itinerary.description: Drive to Merida with a stop at Zafra, a beautiful town possessing great historical significance thanks to the Via de la Plata, an ancient commercial and pilgrimage path. Some places you’ll cover in Zafra include the 15th-century Alcazar, Plaza Grande, and Museo de la Medicina. After you reach Merida, you will explore the Roman Theatre and the Temple of Diana. Spend the night at a Merida Parador.

itinerary.title: Depart from Madrid
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrive at Madrid - Sabatini Gardens - Royal Palace of Madrid
itinerary.description: After you land in Madrid, our tour representatives will greet you at the airport and take you to your hotel. We’ll help you check in and brief you about the tour and the itineraries we’ll cover during the trip. Madrid is a beautiful city renowned for its architecture, museums, and plazas. Some places we’ll cover in Madrid include the Sabatini Gardens, an 18th-century garden designed by Francesco Sabatini, with neoclassical influences, and the Royal Palace, the official residence of the Spanish Royal Family. You can also visit the Prado Museum, Puerta de Alcázar, Plaza Mayor, the Temple of Debod, and El Retiro Park.

itinerary.title: Madrid - Seville - Plaza de Toros de la Maestranza - Torre del Oro - La Giralda
itinerary.description: Take a high-speed train from Madrid to Seville on your second day. Seville is a medieval town loved for its cathedrals, cultural festivals, and food. We’ll cover all the important attractions in Seville, including the Plaza de Toros de la Maestranza, the world’s biggest bullfighting festival venue. We’ll cover Torre del Oro, also known as the Tower of Gold, built in the 12th century. Before returning to your hotel, we’ll cover the city’s famous bell tower, the La Giralda, a Renaissance-era monument.

itinerary.title: Seville – Cordoba - Mosque–Cathedral of Cordoba - Palacio de Viana
itinerary.description: Some other places in Seville included in the itinerary – the Santa Cruz quarter, the Royal Alcazar of Seville, General Archive of the Indies, and a boat ride on the Guadalquivir River. Take a train from Seville to Cordoba on the third day of your trip. Witness the magnificence of the beauty of the Mosque–Cathedral of Cordoba, an ancient monument constructed when Cordoba was the capital of Al-Andalus. You can then breathe in the courtyards and the collection of antiques and art at the Palacio de Viana.

itinerary.title: Cordoba – Madrid
itinerary.description: Today, you will cover places missed on Day 3. This includes the Cordoba Synagogue and the Templo Romano. Board your train from Cordoba to Madrid.

itinerary.title: Depart from Madrid
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

packages.name: Saint James Way
packages.destination: Rioja - Burgos - Fromista - Leon - Santiago De Compostela

itinerary.title: Arrive in Madrid – La Rioja - Santo Domingo De La Calzada
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Adolfo Suárez Madrid–Barajas Airport, you will be greeted by our tour representatives. From the airport, they will drive you to Logrono, a city located in La Rioja. The places you will be visiting here include the Church of Santa Maria de Palacio and the Municipal Pilgrim’s Hostel. Spend the night at the Parador Santo Domingo De La Calzada, a hotel which was once a 12th-century hospital. It was built by St. Dominic, who treated the pilgrims travelling on the Way of St. James.

itinerary.title: Logrono - Vivanco Museum of Wine Culture
itinerary.description: Today, you will learn about wineries and wine making. La Rioja is one of the world’s best wine-growing regions in the country. You will also visit Briones to the Vivanco Cultura de Vino (Vivanco Museum of Wine Culture) to learn about the history and production of wine. Later, visit the UNESCO World Heritage Sites of San Millán Yuso and Suso Monasteries, before returning to your hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: Logrono - Burgos - Burgos Cathedral
itinerary.description: Today, make your way from Logrono to the city of Burgos. Visit the Burgos Cathedral, a Catholic church that is dedicated to the Virgin Mary situated in Burgos’ historical centre.

itinerary.title: Burgos - Fromista – Leon
itinerary.description: On the fourth day of your trip, depart Burgos and head towards Carrion de Los Condes to visit the Monastery of San Zoilo. After this, leave for Fromista where you can take in the architectural beauty of the church named San Martin de Fromista. Your next stop will be the city of Leon, where you will be visiting the Monastery of San Pedro de Eslonza, the Church of Santa Ana, and the Church of El Mercado. Spend the night at the Hostal de San Marcos, a historic hostel whose construction started in the 16th century.

itinerary.title: León – Astorga – Ponferrada – Santiago de Compostela
itinerary.description: In the morning, drive to the city of Santiago De Compostela and visit its popular tourist attractions. On this day, You will explore the numerous beautiful sites in Leon, including the Palace of Gaudí Astorga, the Cathedral of Santa Maria de Astorga, Ponferrada Castle, and Santo Tomás de las Ollas.

itinerary.title: Cathedral of Santiago de Compostela
itinerary.description: After relishing a scrumptious breakfast, leave to visit the Cathedral of Santiago de Compostela. This church is the burial site of Saint James the Great, who was one of the apostles of Jesus Christ. Boasting a Romanesque design, the structure also has Baroque and Gothic elements.

itinerary.title: Depart Cathedral of Santiago de Compostela
itinerary.description: Once you’re done with breakfast in the morning, check out of your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

packages.name: Spain, Wine and Castles
packages.destination: Siguenza - La Rioja - Olite - Hondarribia - San Sebastian - Bilbao

itinerary.title: Arrive in Madrid – Siguenza
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Adolfo Suárez Madrid–Barajas Airport, you will be greeted by our tour representatives, who will take you to your hotel. Complete the check-in process, after which you will be driven to Siguenza. Begin your day of sightseeing with a visit to Siguenza Cathedral Basilica, a 12th-century Roman Catholic cathedral that’s often called the Fortress Cathedral. You will also visit the Siguenza Plaza Mayor and Casa del Dancel before getting to your hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: Aranda de Duero - La Rioja
itinerary.description: On this day, you will be travelling to the city of Aranda de Duero, from where you can explore Ribera Del Duero, which is one of the biggest wine-producing regions in the country. You will be taken to a winery where you can learn about the process of making wine and try out some delicious wines and appetisers. Pay a visit to La Rioja, which is another popular wine-growing region in the country.

itinerary.title: La Rioja - Vivanco Museum of Wine Culture
itinerary.description: Today, you will be heading to La Rioja, which is home to over 600 vineyards. You will also get to explore the San Millan Yuso and Suso Monasteries, both of which are UNESCO World Heritage Sites. The highlight of this day will be exploring the Vivanco Museum of Wine Culture. Covering an area of 4000 square metres, it was given a Special Achievement Award by the Great Wine Capitals Global Network in 2024. Relish a gourmet lunch where you can consume multiple glasses of delicious wine.

itinerary.title: La Rioja – Olite
itinerary.description: Make your way from La Rioja to the town of Olite, known for being the wine capital of Navarra. While you’re in Olite, you will be visiting the Royal Palace of Olite and the Church of Santa María la Real.

itinerary.title: Castillo de Javier – Hondarribia
itinerary.description: After having breakfast, make your journey to Hondarribia, a coastal town known for its beaches, restaurants, and aristocratic buildings. Visit the Castillo de Javier, a castle which is perched atop a hill. Wrap up your day by going to a tapas bar to enjoy some delicious food and drinks.

itinerary.title: Hondarribia - San Sebastian - Parte Vieja - San Telmo Museum - Basilica de Santa Maria del Coro
itinerary.description: Depart from Hondarribia to head towards the coastal town of San Sebastian. Walk around the San Telmo Museum which has displays of old as well as contemporary Basque history, arts, and culture. Witness the beauty of the Basilica de Nuestra Senora del Coro, a Roman Catholic parish church whose construction was completed in 1774.

itinerary.title: San Sebastian – Bilbao - Guggenheim Museum
itinerary.description: On this day, you will be heading to Bilbao, which is one of the largest cities in Spain. Famed for its mouthwatering cuisine, art, architecture, and natural landscapes, the first place you will be visiting is the Guggenheim Museum. Featuring art created by Spanish as well as international artists, it is one of the many museums affiliated with the Solomon R. Guggenheim Foundation. Explore the Museum of Fine Arts of Bilbao before returning to your hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: Depart Madrid
itinerary.description: In the morning, check out of your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

packages.name: North of Spain
packages.destination: Madrid - La Rioja - San Sebastian - Bilbao - Picos Europa - Fuente De - Oviedo - Santiago Compostela - Santiago - Salamanca - Madrid

itinerary.title: Arrive in Madrid - La Rioja - Vivanco Museum of Wine Culture
itinerary.description: After you land in Madrid, our tour representatives will arrange a private car to drive to La Rioja. Here, you will explore the Vivanco Museum of Wine Culture and enjoy a gourmet lunch, soaking in the ambiance and the mesmerizing vineyards. Take in the historic buildings in La Rioja before returning to your hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: La Rioja – San Sebastian
itinerary.description: On your second day, you will visit a traditional winery in La Rioja that has been around for 125 years and is run by the members of its founding family. After a round of wine tasting, you will visit San Sebastian to spend the night.

itinerary.title: San Sebastian
itinerary.description: Today, you will explore San Sebastian, including the city’s many pintxos bars (Tapas bars are called that in the Basque region). Key attractions in San Sebastian include Old Town, the Monte Igueldo and Monte Urgull viewpoints, and beaches such as La Concha and Zurriola.

itinerary.title: Explore Bilbao
itinerary.description: Bilbao is one of Europe’s iconic cities, famous for its avant-garde architecture, renowned gastronomy, and rich history. Some popular attractions include the Guggenheim Museum, the Zubizuri Bridge, and the Azkuna Zentroa centre. Don’t forget to explore the city’s tapas bars, called Pintxos in the Basque region. Spend the night in San Sebastian.

itinerary.title: Oviedo – Picos de Europa – Covadonga – Fuente de
itinerary.description: Today, you will drive to Oviedo, visiting Covadonga, Picos de Europa, and Fuente De on the way. Covadonga is famous for its lakes and beautiful landscapes. The Picos de Europa National Park is home to the world’s deepest caves, including the Torca del Cerro and Sima de la Cornisa. You will also take a cable car ride in Fuente de to admire the spectacular setting of valleys and rocky crests. Finally, check into your hotel in Oviedo.

itinerary.title: University of Oviedo - Oviedo Cathedral - Santiago de Compostela
itinerary.description: Before leaving Oviedo, visit the University of Oviedo and the Oviedo Cathedral, a Roman Catholic church in the center of Oviedo. Explore the Palacio del Marques de San Feliz before driving towards Santiago de Compostela.

itinerary.title: Cathedral of Santiago de Compostela
itinerary.description: Walk around the Cathedral of Santiago de Compostela, which is the burial place of Saint James the Great. This is where you can also spot the Botafumeiro, one of the largest censers in the world, weighing 80 kg and measuring 1.60m in height. The highlight of the Cathedral is the huge incense burner that’s swung vigorously across the Cathedral, leaving the entire place smelling of incense. You can spend the rest of the day at your own pace.

itinerary.title: Santiago de Compostela – Salamanca
itinerary.description: On the eighth day of your trip, you will visit Salamanca, a four-hour drive from Santiago de Compostela. Although Salamanca is in western-central Spain, this historic and charming city is worth visiting. Check into your hotel and spend the rest of the evening exploring the neighbourhood. Spend the night in Salamanca.

itinerary.title: Depart from Madrid
itinerary.description: Explore the Old City of Salamanca, a UNESCO World Heritage Site famous for its Roman, Romanesque, Gothic, Moorish, and Renaissance monuments and the 18th-century Plaza Mayor, before heading to Madrid. Catch your return flight from Madrid or continue with the next leg of your Europe tour package journey.

packages.name: Western Explorer Tour Package: Unveiling the Wonders of San Francisco, Las Vegas and More
packages.destination: San Francisco - Las Vegas - Grand Canyon - Los Angeles - San Diego

images.alt_text: Western Explorer Tour Package: Unveiling the Wonders of San Francisco, Las Vegas and More
Western Explorer Tour Package: Unveiling the Wonders of San Francisco, Las Vegas and More

itinerary.title: Arrival in San Francisco
itinerary.description: Begin your journey as you fly to San Francisco, a city that holds a legendary status akin to the likes of Paris or London in North America. The city's renowned hills give you breathtaking views of the Pacific Ocean and San Francisco Bay. It's a place where you can explore a diverse array of shops, indulge in exquisite dining experiences, and revel in cosmopolitan nightlife. San Francisco is not just about its diversity and charm; it also serves as the gateway to Silicon Valley, the epicenter of American high technology. Upon your arrival, settle into your hotel and enjoy a comfortable overnight stay in San Francisco.

itinerary.title: San Francisco City Tour
itinerary.description: Today, embark on a captivating sightseeing tour of San Francisco. Your journey will take you to the iconic Golden Gate Bridge, a towering structure that was once the longest and tallest suspension bridge in the world. Continue your exploration with visits to Twin Peaks, Lombard Street, the famous Cable Car, Pier 39, Nob Hill, Civic Center, Union Square, Fisherman’s Wharf, and the exquisite Palace of Fine Arts, along with other remarkable highlights. After a day of exploration, return to your hotel for a peaceful overnight stay in San Francisco.

itinerary.title: San Francisco to Yosemite Park Day Trip
itinerary.description: Today, you will embark on a journey to Yosemite National Park, a place of unparalleled natural beauty. Here, you'll discover the breathtaking wonders shaped by glaciers, featuring magnificent waterfalls and awe-inspiring gorges. Yosemite is a paradise adorned with stunning lakes, colossal granite domes, towering pinnacles, cascading waterfalls, and lush forests. During your visit, you will have the chance to marvel at iconic landmarks like El Capitan and Half Dome. As the day draws to a close, you will make your way back to San Francisco. Rest for the night at our San Francisco hotel.

itinerary.title: San Francisco to Las Vegas
itinerary.description: Your day begins with a morning flight to Las Vegas. Upon landing, we'll transfer you to your hotel. In the evening, you will set out on a captivating city tour of Las Vegas, where you will witness the mesmerising Colourful Dancing Fountain water display at the Bellagio. You will get a chance to ascend the Stratosphere Tower, explore Downtown Vegas, and be entranced by the vibrant Fremont Street. This lively area dazzles with over 12 million lights, accompanied by pulsating music, creating a free and unforgettable show. You will retire for the night at our Las Vegas hotel.

itinerary.title: Las Vegas - Grand Canyon (Optional)
itinerary.description: You have the freedom to spend the day at your leisure or opt for the Grand Canyon Tour by either bus or air. Don't miss the chance to explore the New Wonder of the West, the Skywalk. In the evening, you can choose to take the Las Vegas Night Flight, a thrilling helicopter ride over the dazzling nighttime skyline of Vegas. Alternatively, you can attend fabulous shows the Wizard of Oz and Cirque du Soleil. You'll be spending the night at the hotel in Las Vegas. (B)

itinerary.title: Las Vegas - Los Angeles
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a delightful breakfast at the hotel before setting off for Los Angeles. Later, immerse yourself in the charm of Los Angeles with a city tour. We'll take you through the "Entertainment capital of the world," exploring iconic landmarks like Hollywood, the Hollywood Walk of Fame, Beverly Hills, the Grauman's Chinese Theater, the Sunset Strip, Rodeo Drive for some of the world's most luxurious shopping, and China Town for excellent bargains. Your overnight stay will be at a hotel in Los Angeles.

itinerary.title: Los Angeles - Universal Studio
itinerary.description: Join us today for a captivating tour of Universal Studios, renowned for its innovative rides and attractions. It is expertly crafted to offer visitors a unique cinematic experience like no other. A visit to Universal is akin to a journey into the heart of Hollywood. With ongoing film and TV production, you never know who you might chance upon strolling along the park's charming sidewalks. Spend the night at your hotel in Los Angeles.

itinerary.title: Los Angeles - Sea World - San Diego - Los Angeles
itinerary.description: Start the day with a hearty breakfast. Today, you will venture to Sea World, an enthralling marine life park that promises a plethora of exciting attractions. Prepare to be amazed as you embark on a one-of-a-kind water coaster thrill ride through the enigmatic lost city of Atlantis. At Sea World, you can interact with, feed, or even come face to face with an array of incredible wild animals. After a thrilling day, return to your Los Angeles hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: Disney Land
itinerary.description: Head to Anaheim to explore Disneyland. As soon as you set foot on Main Street USA, you'll find yourself transported to a realm where the worries of the outside world seem to effortlessly vanish. Your overnight stay will be at a Los Angeles hotel.

itinerary.title: Leaving Los Angeles
itinerary.description: Enjoy a leisurely morning after breakfast. Later, head to the airport for your flight to your next destination.

packages.name: Orlando Tour Packages: A Magical Journey through Disney and Sea World

images.alt_text: Orlando Tour Packages: A Magical Journey through Disney and Sea World
Orlando Tour Packages: A Magical Journey through Disney and Sea World

itinerary.title: Arrive in Orlando
itinerary.description: Welcome to the vibrant city of Orlando. Orlando, the sixth largest city in Florida, holds the distinction of being the largest inland city in the state. With the enchanting Disney World theme park gracing its landscape, Orlando has established itself as a renowned vacation destination. This city extends its warm hospitality to over 52 million tourists annually. Upon your arrival, we will arrange your transfer to the hotel, where you will spend the night in Orlando.

itinerary.title: Orlando – Walt Disney Magic Kingdom
itinerary.description: On this day, you'll have the enchanting opportunity to visit Magic Kingdom, a sprawling 107-acre wonderland that first opened its gates on October 1, 1971. It's often lovingly referred to as "The Most Magical Place on Earth!" and for a good reason. Magic Kingdom is a realm that comprises seven themed lands, offering an array of attractions that cater to visitors of all ages. As you step foot into this captivating realm, you'll find yourself on Main Street USA, and instantly, the hustle and bustle of the outside world seems to effortlessly fade away. Here, storybook fantasies become everyday realities, and beloved Disney classics come to life. It's a place where dreams are woven into the very fabric of your visit, and every corner holds the promise of a magical encounter. After a day of such enchantment, you'll retire to your hotel in Orlando for the night.

itinerary.title: Orlando - Epcot Center
itinerary.description: Commence your day with a visit to the Epcot Center, an enchanting place where you can experience the wonders of the future and embark on a global journey filled with a dazzling array of attractions and captivating live performances. Spanning over 260 acres, Epcot is dedicated to both past achievements and the boundless possibilities of technology. The World Showcase within Epcot presents a unique and enduring World Fair, featuring pavilions representing eleven different countries. Each pavilion offers a glimpse into the rich culture, cuisine, and heritage of these nations. After a day of exploration and cultural immersion, you'll spend the night at your hotel in Orlando.

itinerary.title: Orlando - Sea World
itinerary.description: Today, you will have an exciting day planned as you'll be visiting the world's largest Marine Park, Sea World. This incredible park is home to a plethora of fascinating attractions. Here, we challenge you to embark on a one-of-a-kind water coaster thrill ride that will take you on an adventure through the mysterious lost city of Atlantis. At Sea World, you can engage with awe-inspiring wild animals in various ways, from touching and feeding them to getting up close for unforgettable encounters. Immerse yourself in all the captivating action that makes Sea World a place you'll want to return to time and again. After this exciting day, you will rest for the night at your hotel in Orlando.

itinerary.title: Depart Orlando
itinerary.description: This morning, it's time to bid farewell to Orlando as you make your way to the airport to catch your flight to your next destination.

itinerary.title: Arrive at Dubai – Miracle Garden - Dhow Cruise
itinerary.description: Upon arrival in Dubai, our tour representatives will assist with your transfer to the hotel. Begin your trip by visiting the enchanting Miracle Garden, inaugurated on Valentine's Day in 2013. Spread over 72,000 square meters, the garden is home to over 150 million flowers. You will surely enjoy walking around the world's largest natural flower garden. In the evening, get ready to ride the Dhow Cruise. You mustn't miss the dhow cruise if you appreciate adventure and nature. The cruise is perfect if you're looking forward to spending a romantic evening with your spouse or a fun night with your family. You can customize it to your needs while enjoying the fabulous views and some mesmerizing belly dancing moves choreographed by talented artists. Return to your hotel after the cruise and enjoy a blissful night's sleep.

itinerary.title: Burj Khalifa – Dubai Creek – Dubai Mall - Jumeirah Beach
itinerary.description: For the second day, treat yourself to the majestic sight of the Burj Khalifa, the tallest building in the world. Go to the observation decks on the 124th, 125th, and 148th floors to view the entire city and get your pictures clicked against this mesmerizing background. After this, head on to the commercial hub of Dubai Creek, where you can enjoy a traditional boat ride. Spend some time browsing through the many luxury brands at Dubai Mall, and then experience the serenity of the waves at Jumeriah Beach.

itinerary.title: Desert Safari
itinerary.description: A trip to Dubai is incomplete without witnessing the magical golden sands of the Middle East. You may choose a desert safari in the morning, afternoon, or evening, or stay overnight and head back to the hotel the next day. You may choose a desert safari in the morning, afternoon, or evening or stay overnight and head back to your hotel the next day. You can also choose activities such as dune bashing, sand skiing, or riding on a camel's back. Sip on traditional Arabic coffee while watching the most spellbinding sunset, fire show, or dance performance. Relish the delicious local cuisine at the buffet dinner and BBQ. You will have mattresses, pillows, and blankets for a comfortable night's sleep under the twinkling stars.

itinerary.title: Abu Dhabi - Yas Island - Warner Bros World
itinerary.description: Travel from Dubai to Abu Dhabi and check into your hotel. Start your day by visiting the very famous Yas Island. It's a tourist destination where you can explore several entertainment options and thrilling rides. Hop on to the Warner Bros World, the largest indoor theme park in the world.

itinerary.title: Louvre Abu Dhabi - Ferrari World
itinerary.description: Are you a lover of art and history? If so, you'll cherish your trip to the Louvre in Abu Dhabi, an art museum containing theme-based displays of different ages and civilizations. End your adventurous day at Ferrari World, the first Ferrari-branded theme park.

itinerary.title: Depart from Abu Dhabi
itinerary.description: Leave for the airport to board your flight as you carry home many memories in your heart.

itinerary.title: Arrive at Dubai – Miracle Garden - Dhow Cruise
itinerary.description: After you land in Dubai, our tour representatives will meet you at the airport and take you to your hotel. Once you’ve freshened up, you will begin your Dubai trip by visiting the splendid Miracle Garden. Opened back in 2013 on the occasion of Valentine's Day, this garden covers an area of 72,000 square metres and has over 150 million flowers. You are sure to enjoy your time walking around the largest natural flower garden in the world. Get set to ride the Dhow Cruise in the evening. Regardless of whether you’re travelling with your partner or your family, the Dhow Cruise is perfect for it all. Personalise it as per your needs while you enjoy the gorgeous views around as well as some mesmerising belly dancing moves. Get back to your hotel after the cruise and enjoy a peaceful night of sleep.

itinerary.title: Burj Khalifa – Dubai Creek – Dubai Mall - Jumeirah Beach
itinerary.description: The second day is all about exploring the most famous tourist spots in Dubai. We begin with the crowning jewel of Dubai, the Burj Khalifa, which is the tallest building in the world. Go up to the observation decks on the 124th, 125th, and 148th floors to get a view of the entire city. The next stop for the day is the commercial hub of Dubai Creek where you can enjoy a traditional boat ride. If you’re hoping to indulge in some shopping from luxury brands, the Dubai Mall has plenty for you to choose from. End the day by experiencing the serenity of the waves at Jumeirah Beach.

itinerary.title: Desert Safari
itinerary.description: How can a trip to Dubai be complete without the inclusion of the magical, golden sands of the Middle East, right? You must experience our desert safari to satiate your love for the Arabian Nights. You can also choose to stay overnight and camp in the desert before heading back to your hotel the next morning. Ride on a camel’s back or go dune bashing or sand skiing as per your preference. Watch a fire show or dance show and relish the delicious local cuisine at the buffet dinner and BBQ. You will be provided with mattresses, pillows, and blankets to get a comfortable night’s sleep under the twinkling stars.

itinerary.title: Sharjah - Al Corniche Beach - Sharjah Natural History Museum and Desert Park
itinerary.description: Drive to Sharjah and check into your hotel. Enjoy the beautiful and serene turquoise-hued water at Sharjah’s Al Corniche Beach. Explore all about the Arabian desert’s flora and fauna at the Sharjah Natural History Museum and Desert Park that also has farm animals whom you can pet.

itinerary.title: Mleiha Archaeological Centre - Sharjah Aquarium - Al Noor Island
itinerary.description: Your second day in Sharjah will begin with a visit to the Mleiha Archaeological Centre which provides the perfect amalgamation of history, culture, and nature. If you’re interested in the wonders of marine life, then the Sharjah Aquarium is a spot you will love to spend hours at. Containing more than 250 species of aquatic life, you can also see mangroves, coral reefs, and lagoons here. The climax to this thrilling day will take place at Al Noor Island, which houses a Butterfly House, a playground, a café, and displays of modern art.

itinerary.title: Depart from Sharjah
itinerary.description: Leave for the airport to board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrive at Sharjah - Sharjah Museum of Islamic Civilization - Al Majaz Waterfront
itinerary.description: once you land in Sharjah, you will be greeted by our tour representative, who will take you to your hotel. The first stop for the day is the Sharjah Museum of Islamic Civilization. Exploring the origin of Islamic culture, the museum houses over 5,000 artifacts from the Islamic world. After this, you can enjoy the mix of entertainment and scenic beauty at the Al Majaz Waterfront Park, where you can see a mini golf course, musical fountain, Art Park, and a creative center.

itinerary.title: Al Corniche Beach - Sharjah Natural History Museum and Desert Park
itinerary.description: The second day of your commences with a walk along the shore of Sharjah’s Al Corniche Beach, where you can breathe in the exquisite sight of the serene turquoise-hued waters. After this, explore the Arabian desert’s flora and fauna at the Sharjah Natural History Museum and Desert Park. Are you in the mood to pet some furry and adorable animals? The park allows you to do that as well.

itinerary.title: Mleiha Archaeological Centre - Sharjah Aquarium - Al Noor Island
itinerary.description: The third day of your tour begins by visiting the Mleiha Archaeological Centre, which provides tourists with the ideal blend of history, culture, and nature. After spending time at this archaeological spot, it’s time to be spellbound by the endless beauty of the underwater world at the Sharjah Aquarium, which contains over 250 species of aquatic life and mangroves, coral reefs, and lagoons. The final destination of your trip is the famous Al Noor Island. This favorite tourist spot contains a Butterfly House, a playground, a café, and modern art displays.

itinerary.title: Depart from Sharjah
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and leave for the airport to board your flight back home, carrying many memories in your heart.

packages.name: Explore Dubai
packages.destination: Dubai - Dhow Cruise - Dubai City Tour - Burj Khalifa - Desert Safari - Bollywood Park - Ski Dubai - Miracle Garden

itinerary.title: Arrive at Dubai – Dhow Cruise
itinerary.description: After you land in Dubai, you will be greeted by our tour representatives, who will take you to your hotel. Once you check in and freshen up, you can have lunch at the hotel's dining area and get some much-needed rest. In the evening, get dolled up for the Dhow Cruise, the perfect amalgamation of enchanting views and natural landscapes. Imagine a sparkling night that you can spend with your buddies or a romantic one with your significant other, looking at Dubai's many spectacles. Return to your hotel after the cruise and get a good night's sleep.

itinerary.title: Burj Khalifa – Jumeirah Beach – Dubai Mall
itinerary.description: Visit the tallest building in the world, Burj Khalifa, on the second day of your holiday. The 124th, 125th, and 148th floors serve as observation decks from where you can get a majestic view of the entire city. After this, it will be time to breathe in the peaceful ambience of Jumeirah Beach. Finish the day by hopping to Dubai Mall, with many luxury brands available for you to shop from.

itinerary.title: Miracle Garden – Global Village
itinerary.description: Today, you will visit the Miracle Garden, the world’s largest natural flower garden, featuring more than 150 million flowering plants arranged artistically and iconic structures such as an Airbus and heart-shaped arches. Next, you will head to Global Village, a huge outdoor multicultural attraction that operates during the cooler months from October to April. You will find themed pavilions featuring restaurants, cafes, kiosks, and other shops representing different countries. You can also enjoy at the entertainment area with plenty of rides, skill games, and more. Remove Abu Dhabi from the destination

itinerary.title: Dubai Frame - Desert Safari
itinerary.description: Begin Day 4 with your trip by visiting Dubai Frame, a museum and observatory serving as a point of connection between the past and present of Dubai. How can your Dubai trip be complete without witnessing the endless magic of the desert? This is where the desert safari comes in, which you will explore during the evening. Go dune-bashing or sand skiing, as you prefer, and ride on a camel's back. View the gorgeous sunset and relish the delicious local cuisine at the buffet dinner and BBQ. Get a comfortable night's sleep under the twinkling stars.

itinerary.title: Ski Dubai - Museum of the Future
itinerary.description: How about some skiing to initiate your day? Experience the indoor ski resort of Ski Dubai, located within the Mall of the Emirates. Later on, head to the Museum of the Future, a futuristic monument that provides a glimpse into the marvellous possibilities of the future.

itinerary.title: Depart from Dubai
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight as you carry unforgettable memories.

itinerary.title: Arrive In Helsinki
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at the Helsinki International Airport, our tour manager will welcome you and help you transfer to the hotel. Complete the check-in formalities and spend the rest of the day leisurely exploring neighbouring places and markets. Helsinki is famous for its unique architecture, world-class cuisine, unique sauna, picturesque villages and towns, and vibrant culture. It is also renowned for its cathedrals and museums. A must-visit place is the charming Suomenlinna Fortress, a UNESCO World Heritage sea fortress built in the 18th century. Spend the night in Helsinki.

itinerary.title: Uspenski Cathedral
itinerary.description: After a breakfast buffet, spend the day exploring the local attractions, including the Helsinki Cathedral, Uspenksi Cathedral, the Tempeliaukion Church, and Suomenlinna. Head to the pier in the afternoon to board your overnight cruise to Stockholm. The overnight cruise guarantees great fun with restaurants, on-board entertainment, and an overnight party. Spend the night on the cruise.

itinerary.title: Stockholm
itinerary.description: Eat to your heart’s content with a breakfast buffet and wait until the ferry arrives in Stockholm. We’ll help you transfer to the hotel and check in. Stockholm is a beautiful Scandinavian city with green parks, buildings, and museums. Did you know the city is built over 14 islands and is connected through 57 bridges? Some of the places you will visit in Stockholm include the Vasa Museum, The Royal Palace, the ABBA Museum, Gamla Stan, Grona Lund, and the Skansen Open Air Museum. Spend the night in Stockholm.

itinerary.title: Stockholm – Copenhagen
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out from your Stockholm hotel to reach the Stockholm Central Station to catch the train to Copenhagen, the capital of Denmark. The journey takes around 5 – 6 hours and is marked by its scenic journey. The city is famous for its museums, Viking heritage, gardens, and delicious food. It is the world’s most environmentally friendly city and the most cycle-friendly place. Some of the local attractions you must not miss include Tivoli Garden, Gefion Fountain, Christianborg Palace, Amalienborg Palace, and the Carlsberg Museum. Being a musically inclined city, there are plenty of musical festivals every day of the year. If you’re lucky, you could enjoy the Copenhagen Jazz Festival. If not, there’ll always be some festival all year round. Spend the night in Copenhagen.

itinerary.title: Copenhagen Overnight Cruise
itinerary.description: After breakfast, spend the day at leisure. We’ve left an open schedule for you to enjoy some shopping and sightseeing. You’ll head to the DFDS Seaways Terminal in the afternoon for an overnight ferry to Oslo. There’s plenty of entertainment for everyone, including entertainment shows, restaurants, and parties. You could soak in all the fun or sit out on the deck watching the sunset. Don’t miss the dinner buffet with a huge Scandinavian spread. Spend the night on the cruise.

itinerary.title: Oslo Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head to Oslo, the Norwegian capital, where we have arranged sightseeing activities for you. Oslo is famous for its unique architecture, natural scenery, and various museums. Oslo is a centuries-old city founded in 1050 at the end of the Viking age by King Harald Hardraade. Some of the attractions we’ll cover include the Akershus Fortress, The Fram Museum, the Holmenkollen Ski Museum, and the Royal Palace. Spend the night at a hotel in Oslo.

itinerary.title: Depart Oslo
itinerary.description: Bid adieu to Oslo as you check out of your hotel and head to the Oslo International Airport. You could catch your flight back home or proceed to the next leg of the journey.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Istanbul
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at Istanbul International Airport, our tour manager will assist you with your transfer to the hotel and complete check-in. Rest and relax for some time. Later, continue exploring the markets and other attractions near your hotel. Spend the night at a luxury hotel.

itinerary.title: Istanbul City Tour
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast at the hotel. Start your day with a tour of Old Istanbul City. Some places you’ll cover include The Blue Mosque (Sultan Ahmed Mosque), Hagia Sophia, and the Topkapi Palace. You’ll also visit the Grand Bazaar, one of the world’s oldest and largest covered markets. Besides admiring its unique architecture, you’ll also get a unique local perspective by exploring its many tourist-free nooks and crannies. After a lunch break, we’ll cover the remaining attractions, including the Basilica Cistern, the Hippodrome of Constantinople, the Obelisk of Theodosius, the Serpentine Column, the Column of Constantinople, and the Spice Bazaar (Egyptian Bazaar) Return to your hotel in the evening.

itinerary.title: Continue Tour Of Istanbul
itinerary.description: Today, you will continue with your tour of this historic city. Some of the attractions you will visit include Rumeli Fortress, Dolmabahce Palace, Camlica Hills, and the Bosphorus Bridge. The tour also includes an optional Bosporus Cruise to explore the scenic waterway that separates Europe from Asia.

itinerary.title: Istanbul To Cappadocia
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel in Istanbul and take a domestic flight to Cappadocia, the city of caves and fresco paintings. After checking in to your hotel, you’ll spend the day exploring Cappadocia. You can spend the night enjoying the night at a local restaurant, or with local folk dancers and belly dancers. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Cappadocia.

itinerary.title: Cappadocia Full Day Tour
itinerary.description: Depending on the time available, you will cover attractions in and around Cappadocia, including the Devrent Valley, Pasabag Valley, Avanos, the Göreme Open-Air Museum, and the fairy chimneys. Derinkuyu and Ihlara Valley.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Enjoy your last breakfast in Cappadocia Check out from the hotel. If time permits, you can do some last-minute shopping or visit any remaining sights. Transfer to Kayseri or Nevsehir to reach Istanbul International and catch your flight back home.

Delightful Zagreb Tour Package – 4 Days Itinerary

itinerary.title: Arrival in Zagreb
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at the Zagreb International Airport, our tour manager will welcome you and help you transfer to the hotel. Zagreb sits at the crossroads of East and West, showcasing both the continental and Mediterranean aspects of the country. Spend the night at the hotel in Zagreb.

itinerary.title: Explore Zagreb
itinerary.description: After enjoying breakfast at the hotel, embark on a city tour to discover Zagreb's rich history. Visit key landmarks like Lotrščak Tower, Stone Gate, St Catherine’s Baroque Church, Croatian Parliament, theatres, museums, and more in both Upper and Lower town. The afternoon is yours to explore the city at your own pace. Spend another night at the hotel in Zagreb.

itinerary.title: Free Time in Zagreb
itinerary.description: Enjoy a leisurely morning with breakfast at the hotel. The day is free for you to explore Zagreb on your own or take part in optional excursions. Spend the night at the hotel in Zagreb.

itinerary.title: Departure from Zagreb
itinerary.description: After a delightful breakfast, in the morning, we will arrange your transfer to the airport for your journey back home or to your next destination.

packages.name: 4 Nights and 5 Days Reunion Island Delights Itinerary

images.alt_text: 4 Nights and 5 Days Reunion Island Delights Itinerary
4 Nights and 5 Days Reunion Island Delights Itinerary

itinerary.title: Welcome to Sainte Marie - Arrival at Roland Garros Airport
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Roland Garros Airport, you will receive a warm welcome from our friendly representative. They will provide you with all the necessary documents for your stay, including vouchers, maps, and a helpful travel guide. Afterward, you'll be whisked away in a comfortable air-conditioned vehicle to your chosen accommodation. The remainder of the day is yours to enjoy at your leisure, allowing you the opportunity to relax and unwind. You will spend the night in the comfort of your hotel in Sainte Marie.

itinerary.title: Sainte Marie - Salazie - Sainte Marie
itinerary.description: Kickstart your day with a hearty breakfast. This morning, you will go on a journey that promises a vibrant and sensory-rich experience. Your first stop will introduce you to the captivating and colourful Indian temples, each boasting distinctive, phallic architecture that immediately catches the eye. As you explore these temples, your senses will be thoroughly delighted and tested. Your adventure continues with a visit to Mr. Rouloff's vanilla plantations, where you'll discover the fascinating process of cultivating vanilla pods. The journey will unveil the epic tales of Mr. Rouloff's efforts, from tending to his plantations to the meticulous preparation of this exotic spice. The intoxicating aromas and delightful balms will envelop your senses, creating a truly enchanting experience. As you proceed further, the landscapes and the lush greenery are all-encompassing, with a myriad of plant species, countless waterfalls, and an array of vibrant flowers adorning the paths that lead you to your destination. Your final stop for the day will take you to a unique village that pays homage to the governor of Hell. Here, you'll be immersed in a living museum of Creole architecture, characterised by its distinctive acute ridgepoles and a fascinating history. As the day draws to a close, you will return to your hotel, where you can relax and unwind. You'll spend the night in the comfort of the hotel in Sainte Marie, enjoying a delicious dinner.

itinerary.title: Exploring Sainte Marie and the Enchanting Cilaos Cirque
itinerary.description: Today, you will go on a journey to the southern part of the island. The story of this adventure dates to 1845 when a challenging path was first opened for intrepid pedestrians. Fast forward to 1896, and thermal baths were established here. Before a proper road for vehicles was built, the only way to reach Cilaos was on a "sedan chair." Quite a feat, considering Cilaos is perched at an elevation of 1200 metres (about the height of the Burj Khalifa, the tallest building in the world)! The ascent along the "400 bends road" is not just a road; it's a scenic masterpiece. Along the way, you'll encounter exceptional vantage points that offer breathtaking views of numerous charming hamlets. As you approach the village, surrounded by towering peaks, you'll be transported to what feels like a village from another era. Old houses are nestled amidst flower-filled courtyards and gardens, reminiscent of a vibrant artist's palette in the summertime. You'll find jacarandas casting purple hues, dahlias, azaleas, roses, hydrangeas, and mimosas, all adding to the picturesque charm. Cilaos isn't just about its natural beauty; it's also famous for its hydropathy establishment, exquisite embroidery, unique wine production (the only one in Reunion), and its renowned lentils. Numerous walking trails beckon you to explore this paradise, with "La Roche Merveilleuse" offering the best viewpoint of the cirque, accessible via a forest path, car, or bus. From this vantage point, you'll have an unparalleled panoramic view of the entire cirque, the village, winding paths, and lush forests. Don't forget to visit the thermal baths, including the historic remnants from the 19th century, accessible via a picturesque road, as well as the modern spa and health facilities. You'll have the option to enjoy lunch on your own during the day. Later in the afternoon, we'll visit the "Embroidery House" and delve into the intricate world of "les Jours de Cilaos" (highly recommended). As the sun begins to set, you will make a stop at "the whirlpool" in L’Etang-Salé, before returning to your hotel around 5.30pm. You'll spend the night at the hotel in Cilaos Cirque, where dinner will be provided.

itinerary.title: Exploring Cilaos Cirque
itinerary.description: Today is your day to relax and enjoy yourself. You have the option to indulge in various leisure activities, which can be arranged upon your arrival. These include thrilling experiences like helicopter rides, diving adventures, transparent kayaking, and leisurely paddling. After a day of leisure, you'll spend the night at your hotel in the beautiful Cilaos Cirque. (Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner included)

itinerary.title: Saying Farewell to Cilaos Cirque
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delightful breakfast. On this day, it's time to bid adieu to Cilaos Cirque as you're transferred to the airport for your flight back home or onward journey.

packages.name: Discover Amazing Puerto Rico Along with San Juan and Vieques Island

images.alt_text: Discover Amazing Puerto Rico Along with San Juan and Vieques Island
Discover Amazing Puerto Rico Along with San Juan and Vieques Island

itinerary.title: Welcome to San Juan
itinerary.description: Puerto Rico, officially known as the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico, is an unincorporated territory of the United States. It is situated in the northeastern Caribbean Sea, to the east of the Dominican Republic and to the west of both the United States Virgin Islands and the British Virgin Islands. Upon arrival, our team will assist with your transfer to your hotel. After checking, you will have the rest of the day to relax or visit the neighbourhood. Spend the night in San Juan.

itinerary.title: San Juan - City Tour
itinerary.description: On this day, you'll have the pleasure of embarking on a guided tour of the Bacardi distillery, the world's largest producer of rum. Here, you can have a taste of their fine products or even purchase some liquid souvenirs to take home. Following this delightful visit, you'll head to Old San Juan, one of the most remarkably well-preserved Spanish colonial cities globally. The entire city has been recognised as a National Historic Preservation site, making it an absolute must-visit destination during your time in Puerto Rico. For the night, you'll be accommodated at your hotel in San Juan.

itinerary.title: San Juan – Free Day
itinerary.description: This day offers you the opportunity to enjoy your own time either at the beach or in a leisurely manner. You will spend the night at the hotel in San Juan. (Breakfast included)

itinerary.title: San Juan – Vieques Island
itinerary.description: After your morning meal, it's time to check out of your hotel and make your way to Fajardo for the ferry ride to Vieques Island. Please note that you will need to purchase your own ferry ticket, as it cannot be bought in advance by a third party. Once you arrive at Vieques Island, we'll ensure you reach your hotel. You can check in at the hotel and have the rest of the day to unwind at your own pace. You'll spend the night at the hotel on Vieques Island.

itinerary.title: Vieques Island – Leisure Day
itinerary.description: Have your breakfast and start the day. Take pleasure in a day of relaxation and personal enjoyment. Spend the day as you desire. In the evening, retreat to your hotel on Vieques Island for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Depart from Vieques Island to San Juan
itinerary.description: Today marks the end of your stay on Vieques Island. Start off the day with a hearty breakfast. It's time to check out of your hotel and make your way to the airport. You can catch a flight back home or continue your journey to your next destination.

itinerary.title: Arrival at Bangkok – Pattaya – Experience the Alcazar Show
itinerary.description: As you land at Bangkok International Airport, our team will warmly greet you and escort you to your hotel in the charming city of Pattaya. Check in at the hotel and take a moment to settle in. Later in the day, get ready for a captivating experience at the Alcazar Cabaret Show. The Alcazar Show has gained international acclaim as Thailand's premier transvestite cabaret. Renowned for its spectacular performances, the show seamlessly blends traditional and modern stage artistry, creating a beautiful experience for our guests. Enjoy the enchanting display of talent and creativity. After the show, retreat to the comfort of your hotel in Pattaya for a restful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Pattaya – Coral Island
itinerary.description: Start the day with a thrilling adventure as you cruise to the picturesque Coral Island, the largest gem in Pattaya's archipelago. Dive into the mesmerising world beneath the waves with a ride on a classic glass-bottomed boat, revealing the beauty of sea treasures and vibrant coral formations. Feel the rush of the wind as you take on Para Sailing, try your hand at water skiing, and indulge in various water sports at your leisure. After a day of excitement, unwind and relax at your hotel in Pattaya.

itinerary.title: Pattaya – Safari World & Marine Park - Nong Nooch Village
itinerary.description: Today, kick-start your day with a delicious breakfast before heading to the captivating Safari World and Marine Park. Dive into the wonders of Bangkok Safari World, where you'll be enchanted by two main attractions: the Safari Park and the Marine Park. At Safari World, prepare for an up-close encounter with rare and endangered species from the animal kingdom. Witness the awe-inspiring feeding show featuring lions and tigers, a spectacle unlike any other in the world. The excitement continues at Marine Park, where a diverse array of marine animals, including dolphins and seals, awaits your admiration. Be captivated by the incredible shows featuring trained birds, dolphins, seals, and apes. As the day unfolds, venture to Nong Nooch Village in the evening. This sprawling area feels like a charming theme park, offering daily cultural performances, tempting restaurants, comfortable accommodation, and vast expanses of individually themed gardens. Don't miss the daily shows at the Thai Cultural Hall within Nong Nooch Garden. Conclude your day with a restful night at your hotel in Pattaya.

itinerary.title: Farewell to Pattaya!
itinerary.description: As the sun rises on your final morning in Pattaya, after a delicious breakfast, we'll whisk you away to Bangkok International Airport, where you'll catch your flight homeward or to your next exciting destination.

packages.name: Discovering Jordan for 6 Days | Itinerary
packages.destination: Amman - Jerash - Dead Sea - Madaba - Mt. Nebo - Shobak - Petra - Wadi Rum

itinerary.title: Welcome to Amman - Your Jordanian Adventure Begins
itinerary.description: Welcome to the enchanting land of Jordan! Upon your arrival at Amman Airport, our friendly representative will be there to extend a warm greeting and provide all the assistance you need with visa formalities. From there, we'll whisk you away to your comfortable hotel. Check in, get settled, and take the evening to relax at your leisure. Your overnight stay awaits in the heart of Amman.

itinerary.title: Amman, Jerash, and the Dead Sea
itinerary.description: After a satisfying breakfast at the hotel, your day kicks off with a journey to Jerash, Jordan's grand Roman treasure. This remarkable site is just an hour's drive from Amman, promising an unforgettable experience. Next, we'll take you to the renowned Dead Sea, where you'll have 2-3 hours of free time to bask in the unique sensation of floating effortlessly in the world's saltiest body of water. It's a moment of pure relaxation and indulgence. As the day winds down, you will return to the comforts of Amman, where you'll spend another restful night at your hotel.
