itinerary.title: Amman to Petra - Exploring Ancient Treasures
itinerary.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast and get ready for an exciting journey to the south. Along the way, you will make stops at some remarkable sites, including Mount Nebo, Madaba, and Shobak Castle. First up is Mount Nebo, a significant historical site (please note that the church is currently closed for renovation). From there, you will head to Madaba, where you can explore the fascinating Saint George Church. The next destination is Shobak Castle, a magnificent medieval fortress that will transport you back in time. After this day of exploration, you will continue your journey southward to reach Petra, where you'll spend the night at a comfortable hotel.

itinerary.title: Petra - A Day in the Ancient City
itinerary.description: Today, after a delicious breakfast, you will have the option to start off on a Petra city tour. This ancient, rock-cut city is a UNESCO World Heritage site and a true wonder to explore at your own pace. After your Petra adventure, we'll pick you up from the site and head back to Amman via the Desert Highway, where you'll spend the night at a hotel in Petra.

itinerary.title: Exploring Petra, Wadi Rum, and Heading to Amman
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a hearty breakfast at the hotel as you will embark on a captivating journey to Amman. Along the way, we'll make a stop at the enchanting Wadi Rum site. You'll have the freedom to explore this extraordinary desert landscape at your own pace. Feel the wonder of Wadi Rum as you opt for a thrilling 4x4 adventure through its stunning terrain or perhaps even spend the night in a Bedouin camp for a truly authentic experience. Wadi Rum is a place of unparalleled beauty, and its rugged charm will leave you in awe. As you soak in the unique landscapes and immerse yourself in the desert's rich history, you'll be creating memories to treasure. In the evening, you will continue your journey towards Amman, where you will find your overnight accommodation at a comfortable hotel.

itinerary.title: Farewell to Amman
itinerary.description: After a delicious breakfast at the hotel, it's time to bid farewell to this remarkable adventure. Check out of the hotel and make your way to Amman airport, where you'll catch your flight back home.

packages.name: Highlights of Finland by Self Drive | 5 Days Itinerary
packages.destination: Helsinki - Porvoo - Turku - Naantali - Tuusula - Vantaa

images.alt_text: Highlights of Finland by Self Drive | 5 Days Itinerary
Highlights of Finland by Self Drive | 5 Days Itinerary

itinerary.title: Welcome to Helsinki!
itinerary.description: When you arrive at Helsinki-Vantaa airport, pick up your rental car. Drive into Helsinki and take some time to explore the city. We suggest checking out important places like the Senate Square, the Uspenskij Cathedral, Parliament House, Finlandia Hall, the Sibelius Park & Monument, and the Temppeliaukio Church. After your day of exploration, spend the night at your hotel in Helsinki.

itinerary.title: Helsinki to Porvoo
itinerary.description: Start your day with breakfast at the hotel. In the morning, you have some free time to discover more of Helsinki. We suggest checking out the Suomenlinna Sea Fortress, which is a UNESCO World Heritage site. It was built in 1748 and is just a 15-minute ferry ride from Helsinki's Market Square. After exploring Helsinki, it's time to head to Porvoo, the second oldest town in Finland. We'll take The King's Road, a historic route that dates back to the 1300s and has been used by kings, couriers, bishops, artists, and more. Along the way, you can stop at Haikko Manor, once the home of the famous painter Albert Edelfelt, and the old 15th-century church of Sipoo. Once you arrive in Porvoo, take a stroll through the charming Old Town. Admire the well-preserved wooden houses, visit the medieval church, and explore the Town Hall Square. Your night will be spent at a small, elegant boutique hotel in the heart of Porvoo's picturesque Old Town. Enjoy your overnight stay at the hotel in Porvoo.

itinerary.title: Porvoo to Turku
itinerary.description: Start your day with breakfast at the hotel. Leave Porvoo and head to Turku, which is not only the oldest town in Finland but also a former capital. Turku sits by the Aura River in the southwest, where Finland's recorded history began, and the oldest traces of people living in the area were found. As you drive to Turku, you'll follow The King's Road. If you're up for it, you can take a little detour to Hanko to see Finland's southernmost point—it's worth the extra kilometres! When you reach Turku, get ready to explore a city known for its lively cultural scene and maritime atmosphere. We suggest checking out the 13th-century Turku Castle, the open-air and crafts museum at Luostarinmäki, and the Aboa Vetus & Ars Nova Museum complex. You might also enjoy a visit to Ruissalo Island and the Botanical Gardens of the University of Turku. Tonight, you'll stay at a hotel in Turku.

itinerary.title: Turku – Naantali – Tuusula
itinerary.description: Start your day with a short drive to Naantali, often called Finland's official summer holiday city. It's home to the Kultaranta Estate, where the President of Finland spends summers. Kids and families love the Moomin World theme park here. Take a stroll in the Old Town, check out the medieval church, and explore the beautiful gardens with 3,500 roses at the Kultaranta Estate. In the late afternoon, head to Tuusula, conveniently close to Helsinki-Vantaa airport for your departure the next day. Arrive at the Krapi Estate in Tuusula, surrounded by a rich cultural environment. It offers a hotel, restaurants, a sauna without a chimney, and a large park with various activities. Krapi is at the beginning of the first Finnish Museum Road (Tuusula Rantatie), showcasing homes of famous artists from the turn of the century who played a key role in shaping Finnish identity. Spend the night at the hotel in Tuusula.

itinerary.title: Depart Tuusula – Helsinki – Vantaa Airport
itinerary.description: Enjoy the peaceful surroundings of Krapi. If time allows before your flight, explore cultural sights and museums along Tuusulan Rantatie. Drive to Helsinki – Vantaa airport and after returning the car, you will catch your flight.

itinerary.title: Welcome to Zagreb!
itinerary.description: Today is all about starting your adventure in Zagreb, the capital of Croatia. Zagreb is not just the biggest city, but it is also the centre for culture, economy, movies, sports, and government in the country. After arriving, check in at your hotel. Later, join other visitors for the Zagreb Evening Tour. The meeting point is at the Tourist Information Centre on Ban Josip Jelačić Square 11. The tour lasts around 2.5 to 3 hours. During the tour, explore Zagreb with an English-speaking guide. Discover its famous historical sights and monuments. Listen to interesting stories about how two medieval cities came together to form the Zagreb we know today, the capital of Croatia. After an exciting day of exploration, spend the night at your hotel in Zagreb.

itinerary.title: Explore Plitvice Lakes National Park
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delicious breakfast before checking out. Head to the Zagreb bus terminal, where you will catch a coach to Plitvice, one of Croatia's stunning national parks. Plitvice Lakes is like a precious gem in Croatia's natural beauty collection, boasting sixteen interconnected lakes and 92 breathtaking waterfalls. Take some free time to immerse yourself in the park's wonders, featuring diverse plant and animal life. The main attractions include the Upper Lakes, a group of 12 lakes separated by travertine barriers. Kozjak Lake, the largest and deepest lake in the park, is must-see. It is unique because nature fused two smaller lakes into one, creating the only navigable lake in Plitvice. Do not miss Stephanie's Island on Kozjak Lake, named after an Austrian princess who visited in 1888. Explore the Lower Lakes, known for idyllic scenes of small waterfalls, turquoise water, and lush greenery. Nearby, you will find the Šupljara underground cave. The highlight of the Lower Lakes is the Great Waterfall, standing at an impressive 78 metres, making it the tallest waterfall in Croatia. After an exciting day of exploration, check into your hotel in Plitvice for a well-deserved overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Explore Zadar with a Guided Evening Tour
itinerary.description: Start your day with breakfast and hop on a coach from Plitvice to Zadar in the morning. After checking out, head to the bus terminal for your journey to Zadar. Upon arrival, your driver will be waiting to take you to your hotel. Welcome to Zadar, a city with a fascinating history and a vibrant cultural heritage, known for its tourism. Check in to your hotel and later in the evening, join a guided city tour of Zadar. The meeting point is Narodni trg (People's Square) under the Lamp Post, so be there 10 minutes early. The tour starts at 18:00 and lasts for about 1 hour. After exploring the city, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Travelling from Zadar to Dubrovnik
itinerary.description: Start your day with breakfast and then hop on a coach to head to Dubrovnik in the morning. Brace yourself for a bit of a journey, as it's about 350 kilometres away. When you arrive, your driver will be waiting for you at the bus terminal to take you to your hotel. Dubrovnik is a beautiful city in southern Croatia by the Adriatic Sea. It's famous for its charming Old Town, surrounded by strong stone walls built in the 16th century. The city boasts well-preserved buildings like the baroque St. Blaise Church, the Renaissance Sponza Palace, and the Gothic Rector’s Palace (now a history museum). The Stradun, a pedestrianised street paved with limestone, is lined with shops and restaurants. After a day of exploring, settle in at your hotel in Dubrovnik for the night. Enjoy your stay!

itinerary.title: Explore Dubrovnik on a City Tour
itinerary.description: Start your day with breakfast and then head out for a city tour of Dubrovnik. The tour lasts about an hour and is a great way to get to know this beautiful city. You will be entertained and learn a lot about Dubrovnik's interesting history. After the tour, spend the night at the hotel in Dubrovnik.

itinerary.title: Exploring Dubrovnik and Split with an Evening City Tour
itinerary.description: Start your day with a tasty breakfast at the hotel. Get ready for an exciting journey as you head to Split by coach in the morning. Upon reaching Split, embark on a 75-minute walking tour of the city with a local guide. This is a fantastic way to explore the largest coastal town in Croatia on foot. You will visit key landmarks such as the Golden Gate, Diocletian Palace, statue of Gregory of Nin, and more. Join the Split city tour at the Golden Gate, where you will depart at either 3:00 PM or 5:00 PM. During this tour, you will step back in time and discover the historical treasures of Split. Your guide will lead you through the Diocletian Palace, showcasing the remains of an ancient Roman Empire palace, including the impressive open colonnades of the Peristyle. After the city tour, return to the hotel and enjoy an overnight stay in Split.

itinerary.title: Explore the Beautiful Blue & Green Caves
itinerary.description: After having breakfast today, get ready for an amazing day exploring the Blue and Green Caves from Split. This special day on the sea includes visits to the majestic Green and Blue caves, as well as the islands of Vis and Pakleni. You will start by sailing between Hvar and the small islands of Ravnik and Biševo. Your first stop is the Green Cave, where you can swim inside and enjoy the beautiful emerald light. Next, you will head to a hidden spot called Stiniva for a refreshing swim or some relaxation in the sun. After Stiniva, you will visit the famous Blue Cave. The magical silvery blue colour inside the cave is created by the sunlight entering through an opening in the roof and reflecting off the sandy surface below. Considered one of the world's most beautiful natural wonders, the Blue Cave is must-see. Your journey continues to the legendary island of Vis. You will have an hour of free time to explore this charming seaside village before you set off for the Paklinski Islands. You will stop at Vinogradišce, one of the archipelago's popular bays at Palmižana, where you can enjoy a seaside lunch at some of the best restaurants in the Adriatic! After lunch, feel free to swim, relax, or even dance at the famous Laganini lounge club beach bar – a spot where even Bono enjoyed a 10-course lunch! You will end the day by returning to the hotel in Split for the night.

itinerary.title: Split to Zagreb
itinerary.description: Start your day with breakfast, then check out of the hotel. Head to the Split bus terminal to catch a coach to Zagreb, the final stop on your tour. Once you arrive in Zagreb, you'll be transferred to your hotel. The evening is yours to explore the city at your own pace. Spend the night at the hotel in Zagreb.

itinerary.title: Leaving Zagreb
itinerary.description: After breakfast, it is time to head to the airport. Catch your flight back home or to your next exciting destination.

packages.name: Exciting Croatia and Montenegro Itinerary
packages.destination: Zagreb - Zadar - Split - Hvar - Dubrovnik - Montenegro

itinerary.title: Arrival in Zagreb
itinerary.description: Welcome to Zagreb! You will arrive in Zagreb around noon. Your driver or guide will be waiting for you at your hotel. Zagreb, the capital of Croatia, is a city that sits at the crossroads between East and West, showing both the continental and Mediterranean influences of the country. It's a place where you can experience the cultural, scientific, economic, political, and administrative heart of Croatia. In Zagreb, you might meet interesting people, make new friends, and have some special moments. After checking into your hotel, the rest of the day is free for you to relax and do as you please. Enjoy your overnight stay at the hotel in Zagreb.

itinerary.title: Zagreb to Zadar (Zagreb and Zadar City Tours)
itinerary.description: After having breakfast, you will explore Zagreb on a city tour. Zagreb is a city where Eastern and Western cultures meet, creating a rich cultural and artistic blend. Our guide will take you to the Upper Town of Gornji Grad, the historic heart of Zagreb. The best way to explore this area is on foot. As you stroll through the Upper Town, you will come across the impressive St. Stephen’s Cathedral, a standout landmark in the city. The tour concludes in the central Jelacic square, where colourful cafes and terraces offer a perfect spot to take a break, enjoy Croatian cuisine, and refresh yourselves. After lunch, you will head to Zadar by bus on a Seat In Coach Basis. Upon arrival in Zadar, you will set off on a city tour. The evening begins with a walk around Zadar's historic centre. You might start by the sea organ on the promenade, an art installation with pipes that make music as waves hit them. Sitting on the steps, you can enjoy the natural symphony created by the waves. End the day with a romantic evening at a beachside restaurant, watching the famous sunsets of Zadar, with the sound of waves and a gentle breeze. You will spend the night at a hotel in Zadar.

itinerary.title: Zadar - Plitvice Lakes National Park Tour
itinerary.description: In the morning, after you have had your breakfast, the driver will take you to Plitvice Lakes National Park. It will take about 1.5 hours to get there. Plitvice Lakes is a special place with 16 big lakes and a few smaller ones. They are arranged in a row, separated by natural barriers. Picture cascading waterfalls, clear aquamarine lakes, and thick forests around. Plitvice Lakes are a natural wonder, incredibly beautiful and unique. It is so amazing that UNESCO, a global organisation, has recognized it as one of the world's natural treasures. Enjoy the breathtaking scenery! After a day of exploring, you will stay overnight at the hotel in Zadar.

itinerary.title: Zadar to Split - Evening City Tour
itinerary.description: After having breakfast today, you will head to Split. You will travel by bus, and once we arrive, you can check in at your hotel. Our knowledgeable and friendly guides will then take you on a tour of the city. They are experts in the history and culture of Split, and they will show you all the ancient treasures, from Diocletian's Palace to the charming Austro-Hungarian architecture. During the tour, you will get to explore the natural beauty of Marjan Hill, which is a great spot for taking romantic photos. Your guide will share interesting stories about Split's rich history, covering everything from its early days before the Romans to the medieval period and up to the more recent times. After the tour, you will spend the night at the hotel in Split.

itinerary.title: Split to Hvar by Ferry
itinerary.description: Today, after having breakfast, you will check out from the hotel and take a ferry to Hvar. The ferry ride from Split to Hvar takes about two hours and is the main way to travel between the two places. During the summer, it can get busy, so it is a good idea to arrive at least an hour before to get a good seat. Do not worry about boarding; it is usually not a problem. Hvar, a Croatian island, is an ideal spot for tourists who want to enjoy the beauty of Mediterranean beaches without dealing with the crowds found in more popular places. There are lovely pathways surrounded by lavender vines leading to quiet coves, small fishing villages, and local vineyards. You can also explore the nearby islands by taking ferries and catamarans across the calm, blue waters. Tonight, you will stay at a hotel in Hvar.

itinerary.title: Hvar to Dubrovnik - City Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast, your driver will take you to Split, and then you will head to Dubrovnik. Check into the hotel in Dubrovnik. Dubrovnik is a special place in Croatia, known for its beauty. It is a town by the sea and the heart of the Dubrovnik-Neretva County. Today, Dubrovnik is a top tourist spot in Croatia, and it's considered one of the prettiest towns in the Mediterranean. The view of the sunlit Old Town in Dubrovnik is perfect for a memorable photo in your album! Take a stroll along its stone streets with a guide who knows all about Dubrovnik's past and present. Touch the ancient walls and feel the history of the people who lived there centuries ago. This tour will amaze you with its old buildings, art, and rich culture – making it one of your favorite holiday experiences. Remember to wear comfortable shoes, bring a hat, and use sunscreen. Tonight, stay at the hotel in Dubrovnik.

itinerary.title: Dubrovnik to Montenegro
itinerary.description: In the morning, after having breakfast, we will take you to Montenegro. As you cross the border, the road will wind and twist around the large Bay of Kotor, passing through charming villages along the way. Once you arrive, you will check in to the hotel, and the rest of the day is free for you to explore on your own. You can enjoy your time and discover the place. You will spend the night at the hotel in Montenegro (Kotor).

itinerary.title: Montenegro - Kotor Day Trip
itinerary.description: After breakfast, you will explore the Old Town of Kotor on a walking tour. Your guide will share interesting stories about the history, architecture, culture, and food of this walled city. You will visit key landmarks like St. Tryphon Cathedral, the Square of Arms, the Clock Tower, Pima Palace, Buca Palace, the Northern Gate, and more. It's a chance to learn and soak in the charm of the area. You will stay overnight at the hotel in Montenegro.

itinerary.title: Departure - Montenegro
itinerary.description: After breakfast, it is time to head to the airport for your flight back home or to your next destination.

packages.name: Exploring Bible Land Tour | Itinerary
packages.destination: Jerusalem - Beit Shean - Nazareth - Golan Heights - Sea of Galilee -Acre - Haifa - Caesarea - Tel Aviv - Ben Gurion Airport

itinerary.title: Arrival in Jerusalem
itinerary.description: Your journey begins as you arrive at the airport, where you will be warmly greeted by our representative. From there, we'll transfer you to your elegant hotel in Jerusalem. Rest up for the exciting adventures to come as you settle in for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Exploring Jerusalem's New City
itinerary.description: Today, we kick off our exploration of Jerusalem's vibrant new city with a breathtaking view from the summit of the Mount of Olives. As you take in this panoramic vista, you'll witness the city's beauty from a unique perspective. Our next stop is the serene Garden of Gethsemane and the Church of the Agony, where you can soak in the tranquil atmosphere and the profound historical significance of the site. We'll then make our way to the Israel Museum, home to the renowned Shrine of the Book, housing the famous Dead Sea Scrolls. Additionally, you'll have the opportunity to explore a meticulously crafted model of the Herodian city of Jerusalem, which takes you back to the time of the Second Temple. Our journey continues with a visit to Yad Vashem, a poignant memorial dedicated to the six million Jews who tragically lost their lives during the Holocaust. The significance of this place is deeply moving and a stark reminder of history's darkest chapter. In the afternoon, we'll head to the charming village of Ein Karem, known as the traditional birthplace of John the Baptist. Its picturesque surroundings and historical charm make it a must-visit destination. At the end of this enriching day, return to your hotel for a delightful dinner and well-deserved rest.

itinerary.title: Exploring Jerusalem (Old City) and Bethlehem
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a hearty breakfast, and then step through one of the historic gates into the ancient walls of the Old City. First, you'll explore the restored Jewish Quarter, where the rich tapestry of Jerusalem's heritage comes to life. Take in the solemn beauty of the Western Wall, and wander through the hallowed Temple area. Don't miss the vibrant bazaars, where you can immerse yourself in the local culture and shop for unique treasures. As you continue your adventure, follow the path of the Via Dolorosa, tracing the Stations of the Cross, until you reach the venerable Church of the Holy Sepulcher. This sacred site holds deep significance for many, and its history is both compelling and inspiring. Next, ascend to the tranquil heights of Mt. Zion. Here, you'll have the opportunity to pay your respects at the tomb of King David, visit the Room of the Last Supper, and explore the Dormitory Abbey, each a testament to the spiritual history of the area. In the afternoon, your journey takes you to Bethlehem, where you'll discover the iconic Church of the Nativity, a place of immense religious importance. Take in the beauty of the Shepherd's Fields from a distance, appreciating the serene landscapes. After a day filled with cultural and historical immersion, return to your Jerusalem hotel for the night, where a delicious dinner awaits.

itinerary.title: Beit Shean, Nazareth, and Galilee Adventure
itinerary.description: As we bid farewell to Jerusalem today, we'll embark on a journey to the north, passing by Jericho, known as the oldest city in the world. Our route will take us through the stunning Jordan Valley until we reach Beit Shean. At Beit Shean, we'll delve into the beautiful excavations of this wonderfully preserved Roman City. Next, we'll continue our voyage to Nazareth, where we'll visit the Church of the Annunciation and the carpentry workshop of Joseph. Our adventure then takes us to Safed, often referred to as the city of Kabala. Here, you can wander through enchanting, mystic alleys and explore a synagogue that holds stories of centuries past. Don't miss the opportunity to visit the artists' colony, where creativity flourishes. At the end of the day, we'll find our restful sanctuary in a Galilee hotel. You'll enjoy a well-deserved dinner before settling in for the night.

itinerary.title: Exploring Golan Heights and the Tranquil Sea of Galilee
itinerary.description: This morning, we will go on a scenic drive to the Golan Heights, passing through the picturesque Druze villages. Our journey takes us to a former Syrian fortification perched high on the heights. As we continue, we transition into a delightful Israeli wine country experience. Here, you'll find vineyards surrounded by breathtaking vistas. Get ready to acquaint yourself with a diverse collection of fine and rare wines through an engaging tour. You'll also have the opportunity to taste these exquisite wines while gaining insights into the intricate wine production process. Our next stop is Banias, the source of the Jordan River, where we'll visit the serene Mount of Beatitudes. Here, you can explore the ruins of an ancient synagogue and Peter's house at Capernaum. We then make our way to Tabgha, the site where the miracle of the fish and bread took place. It's a place imbued with a profound sense of history and spirituality. Continuing our journey, we reach Tiberias, where you have the option to take a brief tour of the old centre of Jewish learning. If you're feeling adventurous, you can also choose to sail across the Sea of Galilee in a boat, experiencing the same tranquillity and scenery that has remained virtually unchanged for the past 2000 years. Please note that this is subject to weather conditions and an additional fee. You will settle in for the night at your hotel in the serene surroundings of Galilee. Enjoy a well-deserved dinner before resting up for more adventures to come.

itinerary.title: A Journey through History and Beauty
itinerary.description: After a hearty breakfast, your day begins with a westward drive to the captivating city of Acre. Here, you will step back in time to explore the renowned Crusader stronghold and its medieval fortifications, a true gem of history. Your adventure continues to the enchanting city of Haifa, where you will treat your senses to a panoramic tour of this coastal jewel. Highlights include a visit to the Baha'i Shrine, the Persian Garden, and a stunning vantage point atop Mount Carmel, where you can take in the breathtaking views of Haifa Bay. Your next stop leads southward to Caesarea, where you will explore the ancient port, complete with its well-preserved Roman Theater and Hippodrome. These historical wonders will transport you to a bygone era. As the day winds down, you will make your way to the vibrant city of Tel Aviv-Jaffa for a short city tour, offering a taste of the urban charm this city exudes. You will then check in to our comfortable hotel for a restful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Explore at Your Own Pace
itinerary.description: Today is a day to follow your own desires. You have the freedom to explore Tel Aviv and its surroundings at your own leisure, taking in the local culture, cuisine, and attractions. If you're up for an extraordinary adventure, there's also the option to embark on a tour to the unique Dead Sea, where the buoyant waters and therapeutic mud offer a truly exceptional experience. Rest easy and recharge at your hotel in Tel Aviv.

itinerary.title: Farewell to Tel Aviv
itinerary.description: As your journey comes to an end, savour your breakfast at the hotel. It's time to bid farewell to the remarkable city of Tel Aviv and make our way to Ben Gurion Airport for your departure.

packages.name: Witness the Highlights of Israel | Itinerary
packages.destination: Tel Aviv - Beer Sheba - Masada - Dead Sea Jerusalem (New City) - Beit Shean - Nazareth - Safed Golan Heights - Sea of Galilee Acre - Haifa - Caesarea

images.alt_text: Witness the Highlights of Israel | Itinerary
Witness the Highlights of Israel | Itinerary

itinerary.title: Welcome to Tel Aviv
itinerary.description: Your journey begins with your arrival at Tel Aviv Airport, where our friendly representative will be eagerly waiting for you. Look out for a sign with your name, and they will be there to assist you right after you clear passport control. They'll help you retrieve your luggage and guide you through the customs process. Once that's done, you'll be introduced to your driver, who will be your escort to the hotel. With the formalities taken care of, you'll have the evening to yourself to explore the vibrant city of Tel Aviv or simply unwind at your hotel. Enjoy a restful night in Tel Aviv.

itinerary.title: Tel Aviv to the Dead Sea via Beer Sheba and Masada
itinerary.description: Today, you will set off from Tel Aviv on an exciting journey. As you head south, you will pass by the cities of Ashdod and Ashkelon before reaching Beersheba, the capital of the Negev Desert. Here, you'll have a brief opportunity to explore this historic city. The adventure continues as you travel through Arad and reach Masada, a remarkable archaeological park that offers a fascinating window into the rituals, politics, and culture of the people who once inhabited this desert fortress. This ancient site was the last stronghold of the Jewish Zealots during their struggle against the Romans. You'll have the chance to explore the excavations, including Herod's palaces, a synagogue, a bathhouse, and cisterns. And don't forget to take in the breathtaking view of the Roman camps and the Dead Sea from atop Masada. The next destination is the Dead Sea, the lowest point on Earth. Here, you can experience the unique sensation of floating effortlessly in the buoyant, salty waters. You can also indulge in the mineral-rich black mud that's renowned for its skin benefits. As we move on, we'll pass by the picturesque oasis of Ein Gedi before journeying through the rugged beauty of the Judean Desert to reach our final destination for the day, Jerusalem. Tonight, you'll rest at your hotel in Jerusalem, filled with memories of an unforgettable day.

itinerary.title: Exploring Jerusalem (New City)
itinerary.description: Let's kick off our day with a spectacular view of Jerusalem from the Shrine of the Book at the Israel Museum. This unique museum is famous for hosting the renowned Dead Sea Scrolls, offering a glimpse into ancient history. Next on our itinerary is a visit to the beautifully restored model of the Herodian city of Jerusalem, which dates back to the time of the Second Temple. It's a fascinating journey back in time. We'll then head to Ein Karem, a charming village situated in the southwest of Jerusalem. This picturesque place holds great significance in Christian traditions, as it is believed to be the birthplace of John the Baptist. The history and beauty of this village will surely captivate you. Our next stop is Yad Vashem, the official memorial dedicated to the memory of the Jewish victims of the Holocaust. Established in 1953, it is located at the base of Mt. Hertzl. Visiting this solemn place is a poignant reminder of the past. In the afternoon, you will venture to Bethlehem, the birthplace of Jesus. Here, you can explore the historic Church of the Nativity and Manger Square, where the story of Christmas began. As the day comes to a close, you will come back to your comfortable hotel in Jerusalem for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Exploring the Timeless Beauty of Jerusalem (Old City)
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delicious breakfast and embark on an unforgettable journey into the heart of the Old City of Jerusalem. Begin by visiting the Western Wall, a site of profound significance, and stand in awe of the very location where the Second Temple once stood, the Temple Mount. Your steps will then lead you along the Way of the Cross, known as the Via Dolorosa, a path of reflection that takes you to Calvary and the Church of the Holy Sepulchre. This sacred place houses not only the traditional site of the Crucifixion but also the Tomb of the Resurrection, making it a deeply spiritual and moving experience. Beyond the ancient city walls, to the southwest, you'll find Mount Zion, home to the traditional tomb of King David and the Room of the Last Supper. Don't forget to take a moment to relish the breathtaking panoramic view of Jerusalem, a city revered by three of the world's major religions: Christianity, Judaism, and Islam. This unparalleled vista can be found at the peak of the Mount of Olives, an ideal spot to absorb the city's rich heritage. Continuing your journey, visit the Garden of Gethsemane, a place where the poignant betrayal of Jesus by Judas unfolded. As the day comes to a close, you'll return to your comfortable hotel in Jerusalem.

itinerary.title: Beit Shean, Nazareth, and Safed Exploration
itinerary.description: After a satisfying breakfast, we'll continue our journey north, taking in the fascinating sights of this ancient land. Our adventure begins as we pass by Jericho, an ancient city with a history as old as time itself, often referred to as the world's oldest city. We'll then follow the picturesque Jordan Valley, with its new settlements, on our way to Beit Shean. At Beit Shean, you'll have the chance to explore the beautifully preserved Roman City and its intriguing excavations. The remnants of this once-thriving Roman settlement offer a unique glimpse into the past. Our next destination is Nazareth, where we'll visit the Church of the Annunciation and other significant Christian holy sites. Continuing our adventure, we'll make our way to Safed, often called the city of Kabbalah and a hub of Jewish mysticism. Here, you can wander through the charming streets of the artists' colony, taking in the creativity and inspiration that infuses the air. As the day comes to a close, we'll find our accommodation in Galilee, where you can relax and recharge for the adventures yet to come.

itinerary.title: Golan Heights and the Beautiful Sea of Galilee
itinerary.description: After a satisfying breakfast, we will set off on a captivating journey to the Golan Heights, passing by the Banias, the source of the Jordan River, along with the remnants of former Syrian fortifications and the charming Druze villages. As we ascend, prepare to be amazed by the stunning Israeli wine country, where lush vineyards are surrounded by breathtaking vistas. Immerse yourself in an Israeli wine country experience like no other. You'll have the opportunity to explore the art of winemaking, surrounded by the serenity of the vineyards. As we make our way down to the shores of the mesmerising Sea of Galilee, our next destination is Capernaum. Here, we'll explore the captivating ruins of an ancient synagogue. Our journey continues to the Mount of Beatitudes, a place steeped in tradition and believed to be the location of the renowned 'Sermon on the Mount.' You'll also have the chance to visit Tabgha, the traditional site associated with the 'miracle of the loaves and the fish.' Our travels lead us onward to Tiberias, an ancient centre of Jewish learning and a place rich in history. As the day draws to a close, we'll settle into our comfortable hotel in Galilee for a restful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: A Journey Through History - Acre, Haifa, Caesarea, and Tel Aviv
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a hearty breakfast. We'll start by heading westwards through the scenic Galilee hills to the captivating city of Acre, also known as Akko. Here, you'll have the opportunity to explore the ancient and renowned Crusader stronghold, along with its well-preserved medieval fortifications. A journey back in time awaits. Our next destination is the vibrant city of Haifa. As we ascend Mount Carmel, be prepared to be awed by the panoramic views of the city, including the Baha'i Shrine, the exquisite Persian Garden, and the picturesque Haifa Bay. Continuing along the stunning Mediterranean coast, we'll make our way to Caesarea. Here, you'll have the chance to visit the Roman Theater and the imposing Crusader fortress, often referred to as the "masterpiece of Herod the Great." To wrap up this incredible day of exploration, we'll enjoy a brief city tour of Tel Aviv, a modern contrast to the historical gems you've encountered. Don't miss the chance to explore the ancient port of Jaffa. Finally, you can look forward to a comfortable overnight stay at our hotel in Tel Aviv.

itinerary.title: Saying Goodbye to Tel Aviv
itinerary.description: After a satisfying breakfast, make sure to complete your check-out at the hotel. Following that, we'll arrange a comfortable transfer to the airport for your departure.

packages.name: Lakeland Tour in Finland | 6 Days Itinerary
packages.destination: Helsinki - Porvoo - Savonlinna - Nurmes - Kuopio - Tampere - Vantaa

images.alt_text: Lakeland Tour in Finland | 6 Days Itinerary
Lakeland Tour in Finland | 6 Days Itinerary

itinerary.title: Arrival in Helsinki - Explore Porvoo
itinerary.description: When you land at Helsinki-Vantaa airport, grab your rental car. If you have some time, consider taking a drive to Helsinki and checking out the city. We suggest visiting the Suomenlinna Sea Fortress, a UNESCO World Heritage site since 1991. It was built in 1748 and is just a 15-minute ferry ride from Helsinki’s Market Square. Afterwards, head to the road to Porvoo, the second oldest town in Finland. Follow The King’s Road, an important travel route dating back to the 1300s. Kings, couriers, bishops, artists, and armies have used it throughout history. The road is dotted with mansions, farms, taverns, alehouses, and inns that have accommodated travellers for centuries. You can stop by Haikko Manor, once home to the famous painter Albert Edelfelt, and visit the old church of Sipoo, built in the 15th century. Once in Porvoo, explore the Old Town on foot. Wander around the well-preserved wooden houses, visit the medieval church, and check out Town Hall Square. End your day by staying overnight at a charming boutique hotel in the heart of Porvoo's picturesque Old Town.

itinerary.title: Porvoo to Savonlinna
itinerary.description: Start your day with breakfast. Head towards the beautiful Finnish Lakeland, passing through places like Kouvola and Lappeenranta. Your destination is Punkaharju, where you can take a scenic drive along the Punkaharju Ridge. If you are interested, you can visit the Retretti Art Centre, a significant art hub in Finland. In this area, there are also important nature reserves and a fascinating museum called Lusto Forest Museum, which we highly recommend. Afterwards, take a short drive to Savonlinna, a lively small-town famous for its annual Opera Festival. Don't miss the chance to visit Olavinlinna Castle. Spend the night at a hotel in Savonlinna.

itinerary.title: Savonlinna to Nurmes
itinerary.description: Today, you will leave Savonlinna and drive through Heinävesi to reach the peaceful and beautiful New Valamo Monastery. After that, you will head to Joensuu, the main city in the North Karelia region. Next up is a tour around Lake Pielinen, one of Finland's largest lakes, followed by a visit to Koli National Park. Take a leisurely walk in the park, enjoying the panoramic views. You might want to check out the Ukko Nature Center and the 'Pirun Kirkko' (‘the Devil’s Church’), a 34-metre-long cave that you can reach by following a marked trail on a short hike. Later, you will drive to Nurmes, a small town on the northern shore of Lake Pielinen. While in Nurmes, you can choose to participate in optional activities, like lake fishing. Tonight, you will stay at a hotel in Nurmes.

itinerary.title: Nurmes to Kuopio
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delicious breakfast. Head towards Lieksa, where you can explore the open-air museum called Pielisen Museo. Afterwards, take a drive from Lieksa to Ruunaa Nature Reserve, where you can enjoy a beautiful view of the lake with rapids. It is also a great spot for fishing. Next, make your way to Vuonislahti. Here, you will have the opportunity to visit the studio of the famous Finnish sculptor Eva Ryynänen and see a unique wooden church. Continue your journey to Kuopio, which is the capital of the Savo region. We suggest visiting the Puijo Tower for a panoramic view of the surroundings. If you are interested, you can also book a lake cruise on Lake Kallavesi. Finally, spend the night at a hotel in Kuopio.

itinerary.title: Kuopio to Tampere
itinerary.description: Start your day with breakfast, and then head towards Tampere in central Finland. On the way, consider making a stop at Jyväskylä, known for its architecture by Alvar Aalto. Continue your journey and reach Tampere, where you will check in to your hotel. Spend the night there.

itinerary.title: Tampere to Helsinki / Vantaa Airport, Departure
itinerary.description: Begin your day with breakfast. We suggest spending the morning in lively Tampere. You can visit the Näsinneula Tower for a great view or explore one of Finland's popular amusement parks, Särkänniemi. Art enthusiasts might want to check out the Sara Hildén Art Museum. Later, head to Hämeenlinna, where you can visit Hämeenlinna Castle or the birthplace of Finland's most famous composer, Jean Sibelius. In the late afternoon, drive to Tuusula, conveniently located near Helsinki-Vantaa. This marks the end of your trip, and you can depart from Helsinki/Vantaa Airport.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Zagreb
itinerary.description: Welcome to Zagreb, the biggest city and the main hub of Croatia. It is not just the capital; it is also where the action happens – culturally, economically, in movies, sports, and government. Once you arrive, check in at the hotel. Later in the evening, join the Zagreb City Tour to explore the city. Meet up with fellow visitors at the Tourist Information Centre on Ban Josip Jelačić Square 11. The tour lasts for 2.5 to 3 hours, guided by someone who speaks English. Discover Zagreb's historical sights and monuments and hear stories about how two medieval cities came together to become the capital of Croatia. Visit the unique Museum of Broken Relationships and, after the tour, enjoy a drink at one of the many cafes in the city centre. Some of the places you will see include Ban J. Jelačić square, Kaptol, Tkalčićeva street, Stone gate, St. Mark’s church, and Lotrščak tower. Have a good night's sleep at the hotel in Zagreb.

itinerary.title: Zagreb to Zadar (Walking Tour)
itinerary.description: In the morning, after having breakfast, you will head to Zadar. Welcome to Zadar City! Here, you can explore quiet marble streets, relax on pine-scented beaches, and sail to remote islands with small restaurants mostly for fishermen. Once you check in at the hotel, the afternoon is free for you to do as you please. Later in the evening, you will go on a walking tour of Zadar. Meeting Point: "Narodni trg" (People's Square) Departure Time: 18:00 hrs Your tour guide will take you on a journey through Zadar's ancient history. As you walk through the streets, the guide will show you various monuments and share stories and legends, allowing you to feel the town's pulse from the past to today. During the walk, you will see the Old City, stop by the Church of St. Donat on the ancient Roman forum (built from the 1st century BC to the 3rd century AD), visit the Cathedral of St. Anastasia, pass through the Sea Gate and Land Gate, explore the City Walls, and visit the Square of Five Wells. At the end of the tour, you can take some time to listen to the unique sound of the Sea organ or enjoy the view of a beautiful sunset. The tour guide will provide suggestions for restaurants and shops to make your trip memorable! You can then enjoy a romantic evening watching Zadar's famous sunsets at a beachside restaurant, with the sound of waves and a gentle breeze. Zadar is known for its world-famous ice cream, and you will take you to the oldest and best ice cream shop in the city. Finally, you will return to the hotel for an overnight stay in Zadar.

itinerary.title: Zadar - Plitvice Lake Tour
itinerary.description: After having breakfast this morning, you will head to Plitvice Lakes for a tour. Plitvice Lakes has some awesome places to see: Upper Lakes: There are 16 lakes in Plitvice, and 12 of them are part of the Upper Lakes. They are separated by these cool barriers made of travertine. Kozjak Lake: This is the biggest and deepest lake in Plitvice Lakes National Park, and it is part of the Upper Lakes. It is special because two smaller lakes joined together to form it. On the lake, there is an island named Stephanie's, after an Austrian princess who visited in 1888. Lower Lakes: These lakes are all about picturesque scenes with small waterfalls, turquoise water, and lots of greenery. There is also an underground cave called Šupljara nearby. Great Waterfall: In the Lower Lakes group, there is a massive waterfall called the Great Waterfall. It is the tallest waterfall in Croatia, standing at 78 metres. Tonight, you will stay at a hotel in Zadar.

itinerary.title: Zadar to Dubrovnik - Guided City Tour with Cable Car
itinerary.description: After having breakfast in the morning, check out of the hotel and head to Dubrovnik. Welcome to Dubrovnik! It is a beautiful city by the Adriatic Sea in Croatia. Check in at the hotel and later join the Dubrovnik walking tour. Departure Time: 17:00, Duration: 1 hour, Meeting Point: Onofrio's Fountain Your guide will drive you to Dubrovnik for a guided city tour by cable car. When you arrive, get on the cable car for a ride up Mt Srđ. Enjoy breathtaking views of the city and the Dalmatian Coast as you go up the mountain. Once at the top, step out of the cable car and take in the amazing views from the panoramic terraces — they say on a clear day, you can see sights up to 37 miles (67 km) away. After exploring the summit, hop back on the cable car for the trip down Mt Srđ. Once back on the ground, follow your guide to Dubrovnik Old Town. As you stroll through the cobblestone streets and narrow pathways, learn about the rich cultural and historical significance of the area. See Onofrio's Fountain and pass by Sponza Palace. Walk through the main square to admire the Baroque Cathedral of the Assumption, which was rebuilt in the 18th century after an earthquake. Other highlights include Rector’s Palace and the Church of St Blaise. Tonight, you will stay overnight at the hotel in Dubrovnik.

itinerary.title: Dubrovnik
itinerary.description: Start your day with breakfast at the hotel. The rest of the day is free for you to explore Dubrovnik on your own. You can enjoy your leisure time. Tonight, stay at the hotel in Dubrovnik.

itinerary.title: Depart from Dubrovnik
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head to the airport to catch your flight back home or to your next destination.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Nadi
itinerary.description: Your journey begins as you arrive at Nadi International Airport. Once you've completed the immigration and customs procedures, head towards the exit of the Customs Hall. You can easily find our Tour Shop, which is located at number 21 or booth 6. Additionally, you can seek assistance from our Tour Managers at the Information Desk. Look out for our friendly representative dressed in our company uniform. They will warmly greet you with a "Bula," offer you beautiful shell leis, refreshing minted towels, and bottled water. After this warm welcome, they will guide you to our office, where you can exchange your vouchers and receive important information. Once your vouchers are sorted, our Portage service will take care of your luggage. You'll also meet your driver, who will transfer you in our comfortable, air-conditioned vehicle to your hotel. The rest of the day is yours to relax and enjoy at your leisure. You'll spend the night at a hotel in Nadi.

itinerary.title: Nadi
itinerary.description: On this day, you have several choices for how to spend your time. You can make the most of the activities offered at your hotel or resort. Alternatively, you can opt for an optional excursion during the day. If you're looking for a more relaxed day, you can unwind at the resort and consider taking part in the Sunset Dinner Cruise, which has scheduled departures. This cruise allows you to enjoy a breathtaking tropical sunset. After your day's activities, you'll spend the night at your Nadi hotel.

itinerary.title: Nadi - Mana Island Day Trip Option
itinerary.description: Today, you have the option to go on a full-day cruise to Mana Island. This exciting trip includes lunch and round-trip transfers to and from your hotel. Mana Island is a spacious resort with three distinct beach areas. You'll find crystal-clear warm waters, poolside bars, and comfortable lounges to relax in. On the lagoon side, you can enjoy snorkeling and a variety of water activities. If you're looking for a quieter experience, North Beach is perfect for those who want to read or simply laze around. Lunch on the island includes a delicious BBQ with a side of salad. After your fun-filled day, you'll return to your Nadi hotel for a restful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Nadi
itinerary.description: Today, you have several exciting options to choose from. You can go skydiving, take a river safari, explore caves, or simply indulge in a relaxing day at a spa. In the evening, you can have a great time at local pubs like PURPLE HAZE and ICE BAR, making it a fantastic way to spend your last night in Nadi. You'll stay overnight at your Nadi hotel.

itinerary.title: Leaving - Nadi
itinerary.description: It's time for an early check-out as you prepare for your departing flight.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Madrid
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Adolfo Suárez Madrid–Barajas Airport, our tour representatives will greet you and help you get to your hotel. Once you complete the check-in formalities, you can spend the rest of the day relaxing or exploring the city on your own.

itinerary.title: Madrid - Hop On Hop Off
itinerary.description: On this day, you will be visiting some of the most popular spots in Madrid, which is the capital of Spain and also its most populous city. Get aboard a Hop On Hop Off bus to visit places such as the Plaza Mayor, an integral public space situated in the heart of Madrid. The next stops will be Puerta del Sol, the Royal Palace of Madrid, Museo Nacional del Prado, and Buen Retiro Park. Make sure to stop by one of the tapas bars to relish some delicious snacks and beverages.

itinerary.title: Toledo - Catedral Primada de Toledo
itinerary.description: Today, you will be driven down to the city of Toledo. In 1986, it was declared a World Heritage Site by UNESCO owing to its cultural and monumental heritage. Known as the ‘City of the Three Cultures’, the city has experienced Christian, Muslim, and Jewish influences throughout its history. Drive back to your hotel in Madrid for the night.

itinerary.title: Madrid – Barcelona
itinerary.description: On the fourth day of your trip, you will be making your way from Madrid to Barcelona, the capital of Catalonia. Reputed for being one of the core European cities for its history, art, culture, and architecture, lay your eyes on the vibrant sites of the city on your way to the hotel. After completing the check-in procedure, you can spend the rest of the day at your own pace.

itinerary.title: Barcelona – Hop On Hop Off Tour
itinerary.description: Dedicate this day to exploring the architectural marvels of Barcelona through a Hop On Hop Off tour. The first place you will be visiting is the Basilica de la Sagrada Familia, the world’s largest unfinished Catholic church. Designed by the renowned Catalan architect Antoni Gaudi, the edifice is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Travel to the picturesque neighbourhood of the Gothic Quarter before checking out the Picasso Museum. During the day, stop for meals where you can enjoy rounds of scrumptious seafood and sangria.

itinerary.title: Barcelona – Paris – Champs-Elysees - Louvre Museum - Galeries Lafayette Haussmann – Lido
itinerary.description: Leave for Paris from Barcelona by boarding a train. Our tour representatives will greet you at the station and help you get to your hotel. After checking-in and freshening up, you will be taken on a guided tour to visit some of the popular sites in Paris. This tour will include Champs-Elysees, Louvre Museum, Galeries Lafayette Haussmann, and Arc de Triomphe. In the evening, catch a fascinating cabaret show at Lido.

itinerary.title: Paris - Hop On Hop Off Tour
itinerary.description: Get a Hop On Hop Off bus to encounter the famous attractions in the city. Experience the beauty of places like Place de la Concorde, the Tuileries Garden, the Eiffel Tower, and Les Invalides. Visit the Latin Quarter in the evening and enjoy a delicious dinner at one of its many bistros.

itinerary.title: Disneyland
itinerary.description: Get ready to enjoy a day of endless fun and adrenaline rush at Disneyland, which is known to be the happiest place on earth. Interact with your favorite Disney characters, get on rides, and relish delectable snacks throughout the day.

itinerary.title: Depart Paris
itinerary.description: In the morning, check out of your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Singapore – Night Safari
itinerary.description: After you land in Singapore, our tour representatives will greet you at the airport and take you to your hotel. After completing check-in formalities, we’ll begin with the first day of your vacation experience with a visit to the Mandai Wildlife Reserve for a Night Safari. This is the world’s only nocturnal open-air zoo and home to thousands of animals.

itinerary.title: Singapore Half-Day City Tour
itinerary.description: On the second day, we’ll cover all the top tourist destinations in the city. This includes Gardens by The Bay, a nature park sprawling over 101 hectares, and the National Gallery Singapore, which has a collection of work from the community of Southeast Asian artists. The Singapore Zoo, with more than 4200 animals and the Singapore Botanic Gardens are also included in the itinerary. The Merlion Park is famous for the Merlion statue, a half-lion and half-fish statue signifying how Singapore started as a fishing village. The tour also includes Chinatown, a neighbourhood favorite for its century-old Chinese temples, food stalls, street shops selling souvenirs, spices, clothes, purses, accessories, etc.

itinerary.title: Sentosa Island - Universal Studios - Trick Eye Museum
itinerary.description: If you are fond of rides and movies that remind you of a nostalgic childhood, you must visit Universal Studios. This theme park has dozens of rides, games, and shows based on classic Hollywood movies like Madagascar and Jurrasic Park. For the second and last stop of the day, head over to the Trick Eye Museum to be mesmerized by its fascinating 3D art display.

itinerary.title: Sentosa Island Tour
itinerary.description: On Day 4, we cover Sentosa Island, Singapore’s most popular tourist spot. You can choose from fine dining restaurants, luxury resorts, theme parks, museums, and other attractions to keep you engaged throughout the day. Relax on Palawan Beach or walk across the famous suspension bridge on Palawan Beach while the kids interact with the dolphins on Dolphin Island. And if you are looking for adventure, don’t miss the thrilling cable car ride at the Skyline Luge and Skyride.

itinerary.title: S.E.A. Aquarium – Maritime Experiential Museum
itinerary.description: If you would love to explore marine life, you must visit the S.E.A. Aquarium, where you can observe over 100,000 marine animals, some of which are rare and endangered. You can pay for a guided aquarium tour or sign up for an open-water dive. Similarly, the Maritime Experiential Museum is the only museum devoted to Asia’s maritime history. The museum’s multimedia cinema, the Typhoon Theatre, provides a 360-degree view of maritime adventures.

itinerary.title: Singapore Botanic Gardens - Sunset Dinner Cruise
itinerary.description: On your sixth day, you will be taken to the Singapore Botanic Gardens, a UNESCO World Heritage site. The National Orchid Garden within the Botanic Gardens is home to over 1,000 orchid species. In the evening, you can head out for a calming and peaceful Sunset Sail & City Lights Dinner Cruise, where you can enjoy a 7-course meal followed by a wine-tasting session and admire the city’s beautiful coastline.

itinerary.title: Depart from Singapore
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

packages.name: Sri Lanka Delight
packages.destination: Sri Lanka - Dambulla - Kandy - Nuwara Eliya - Colombo

itinerary.title: Arrive in Colombo
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at the Colombo International Airport, our tour manager will greet you and help you transfer to the hotel. You will travel by car to the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage in Kegalle. The journey takes around 3 hours and is the perfect way to experience rural Sri Lanka. The Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage was established in 1975 by the Sri Lanka Wildlife Department to protect and care for orphaned elephants. The orphanage hosts over 93 elephants, including baby elephants. Tourists can feed and bathe the animals and take pictures with them. Spend the night at a Dambulla luxury resort.

itinerary.title: Dambulla – Sigiriya Rock Fortress – Dambulla
itinerary.description: After breakfast, you will head out to visit the Dambulla cave temples. The Golden Rock Temple in Dambulla is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of the largest, well-preserved cave temples in Sri Lanka. You will then visit Sigiriya Rock Fortress, another UNESCO World Heritage Site. The place is famous for its palace ruins, built on a 200-metre rock. An extensive network of gardens, water reservoirs, and other attractions surrounds the fortress. Besides exploring the fortress, you will visit the Sigiriya Museum and the Pidurangala Rock, famous for its reclining Buddha statue. Don’t miss the Minneriya National Park, renowned for the herds of elephants that visit the park for food and water. Spend the night at Dambulla.

itinerary.title: Dambulla – Kandy
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel and head to Kandy, Sri Lanka’s last royal capital. Kandy is famous for the Temple of the Tooth, which gets its name from the canine tooth believed to be of Gautama Buddha, which is enshrined here. The temple hosts the annual Esala Perahara, a procession to honour the sacred tooth and pay homage to the old gods of Sri Lanka. In addition to the Sri Dalada Maligawa Temple, you will visit Kandy Lake, the Ceylon Tea Museum, Sri Lankathilake Rajamaha Viharaya, and the Udawatta Kele Sanctuary. In the evening, you will be treated to a colourful show, during which you can witness a mind-blowing Sri Lankan cultural extravaganza, including drumbeats and acrobatics. Spend the night in Kandy.

itinerary.title: Kandy – Nuwara Eliya
itinerary.description: Today, you will explore places around Kandy, beginning with Nuwara Eliya. This is the highest town in Sri Lanka and is called Little England. It was the favorite retreat of the British officers who loved the cool and clean air. The place is now famous for its colonial buildings, tea plantations, and the spectacular Horton Plains National Park. You will also visit the Royal Botanical Gardens in Peradeniya. The garden is famous for its tropical trees and plants, including the cannonball fruit tree, the 40 m-high Burma bamboo, and the Javan fig tree. The garden is also known for its extensive collection of orchids. Other attractions in Nuwara Eliya include the Seetha Amman temple, Horton Plains National Park, and the Nuwara Eliya Central Market. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Nuwara Eliya.

itinerary.title: Nuwara Eliya – Colombo
itinerary.description: Today, check out of your hotel and proceed to Colombo. The journey takes around 5 hours and gives you a glimpse of the beautiful landscape. On the way, you can even stop by to check out other popular attractions like St Mary’s Church and the Dutch Canal. Check into your Colombo hotel and spend some time relaxing. Later, head out for a tour of the city. You will visit some of the city’s commercial areas and tree-lined residential streets like Cinnamon Gardens. Some other tourist attractions include Fort Area, Sea Street in Pettah, the Bazaar Area, and the Dutch Church of Wolfendhal. Don’t miss the replica of the Avukana Buddha Statue kept at the Bandaranaike Memorial International Conference Hall and the Independence Square. If you plan to shop, you must visit ODEL, House of Fashion, Arcade Independence Square, Race Course, and Beverly Street. The Pettah Market is a great place to bargain. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Colombo.

itinerary.title: Depart Colombo
itinerary.description: Check out of the hotel and head to the airport, as your Sri Lanka trip package ends.

packages.name: A Vivifying Vacation to Ooty and Wayanad

images.alt_text: A Vivifying Vacation to Ooty and Wayanad
A Vivifying Vacation to Ooty and Wayanad
A Vivifying Vacation to Ooty and Wayanad
A Vivifying Vacation to Ooty and Wayanad
A Vivifying Vacation to Ooty and Wayanad
A Vivifying Vacation to Ooty and Wayanad

itinerary.title: Arrive in Ooty
itinerary.description: Upon arrival in Ooty, our tour manager will welcome and guide you to your hotel. Complete check-in formalities and relax for some time before heading out to enjoy the scenic locations. Some places you will cover include Boat House, Rose Garden, Botanical Garden, CSI St. Stephen’s Church, Doddabetta Peak, and the Tea Factory. Spend the night in Ooty.

itinerary.title: Ooty Day Tour
itinerary.description: Today, you will visit the Mudumalai Wildlife Sanctuary. The nature park is home to an amazing array of wildlife, including elephants, tigers, gaur, leopards, and over 50 fish species. You will also visit the Pykara Waterfalls on the Ooty-Mysore Road. Later, head to Wayanad to spend the night.

itinerary.title: Wayanad Tour
itinerary.description: After a sumptuous breakfast, head to explore Wayanad. Today, you will explore Neelimala View Point, Banasura Sagar Dam, Meenmutty Falls, and Pookot Lake. Later, return to your hometown with pleasant memories of your Ooty and Wayanad tour.

packages.name: Sizzling Singapore Tour with Bintan
packages.destination: Singapore - Bintan - City Tour - Universal Studio

itinerary.title: Singapore - Bintan
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at the Changi International Airport, our tour manager will welcome you to Bintan. The ferry ride takes around 2.5 hours. Upon arrival, check into the resort and spend some time appreciating its beautiful surroundings. Enjoy a candlelight dinner in the evening and a relaxed stay at the luxury resort.

itinerary.title: Bintan Tour
itinerary.description: Bintan Island offers plenty of exciting activities that you must experience. These include enjoying the seafood, visiting the ancient temples, exploring Trikora Beach, enjoying a pampering spa session, and even signing up for an archery session. Spend the night in Bintan.

itinerary.title: Bintan - Singapore
itinerary.description: After a sumptuous breakfast, check out your hotel and head to Singapore. You will start with the Singapore Experiential Tour, which includes attractions like S.E.A Aquarium, Universal Studios, Adventure Cove, and other attractions at Resorts World Sentosa. Revel in the adrenaline surge experienced through extreme adventure rides on these theme parks before calling it a day and returning to your hotel. Don’t miss the Songs of the Sea, a multimedia show at Sentosa Island featuring fireworks, water jets, and a musical fountain.

itinerary.title: Singapore Half-Day City Tour
itinerary.description: After a delicious breakfast, you will head for a tour of Singapore City, covering major attractions like Gardens by the Bay, Marina Bay, the Merlion Statue, China Town, the Singapore Zoo, the Buddha Tooth Relic Temple, and the National Museum of Singapore. Don’t miss shopping at the little street shops in Little India and Chinatown. You can shop for little trinkets, souvenirs, and keepsakes on one of these streets. End the day with a visit to Mt Faber on a cable car. Spend the night at a hotel in Singapore.

itinerary.title: Singapore – Universal Studio
itinerary.description: After a healthy breakfast, head to Universal Studios to enjoy the cutting-edge rides and attractions focused around your favorite movies and TV shows, including Madagascar, Shrek, and the Mummy series. Return to your hotel to end the day.

itinerary.title: Depart Singapore
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel and catch your flight home to India.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Sharjah
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival in Sharjah, our tour representative will welcome you and guide you to Dubai. Complete check-in formalities and enjoy the rest of the day at leisure. Later, in the evening, proceed to the Dubai Marina to enjoy a dhow cruise and a panoramic view of the city at night. Spend the night in Dubai.

itinerary.title: Burj Khalifa - Global Village
itinerary.description: Today, you will explore the world’s tallest building, the Burj Khalifa. Enjoy a At The Top experience from the observation deck on the 124th building. Don’t miss taking in the 360 degree panoramic view of the city. On a clear day, you can view as far as the coast of Iran across the Persian Gulf. Later, enjoy the music and light spectacle at the Dubai Fountain, the world’s largest performing fountain. The next stop on the tour is Global Village, a shopping and entertainment zone with attractions from over 90 countries. Each country is represented by a pavilion that showcases its culture, cuisine, handicraft, and shopping stalls. There are plenty of rides as well to enjoy. End the day with a dinner at an Indian restaurant before heading out to your hotel.

itinerary.title: Ski Dubai - Desert Safari
itinerary.description: Today, after a sumptuous breakfast buffet, head out to Ski Dubai, the world’s third largest indoor ski slope and the first in the Middle East. You can enjoy various activities, including skiing, snowboarding, ziplining, and chairlift ride. After lunch, you will head to the desert for an exhilarating safari. You’ll enjoy a thrilling ride as the driver rides through the dunes. Other activities include camel ride, sandboarding, sand-skiing, and hot air balloon ride. You can also opt to stay overnight in the desert camp to enjoy a fascinating view of the Milky Way Galaxy. End the night with a BBQ dinner and cultural shows by the local Bedouins before heading out to the hotel.

itinerary.title: Aqua Venture - The Lost Chambers
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a hearty breakfast. Later head to the Aqua Venture Waterpark, the world’s largest water park with over 105 slides, multiple attractions, and 30+ rides. Enjoy a show at Splashers Island to enjoy an aqua show with sea lions, dolphins, sharks, and other marine animals. Later, head to The Lost Chambers Aquarium, the largest aquarium in the Middle East and Africa. The aquarium is themed on the lost city of Atlantis and is home to over 65,000 marine animals.

itinerary.title: Dubai Mall - Miracle Garden - Butterfly Garden
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head to Dubai Mall, the world’s largest mall with over one thousand shops to choose, including designated stores for gold, restaurants, and designer stores. It is also home to an indoor theme park and the largest ice rink in the Middle East. After lunch, head to the Dubai Miracle Garden. This is the world’s largest natural flower garden with over 150 million flowers gather from across the globe. Adjacent to the Miracle Garden is the Butterfly Garden, a climate-controlled dome that’s home to a huge variety of butterflies. Stay overnight in Dubai.

itinerary.title: Abu Dhabi - Warner Bros World
itinerary.description: Today, you will head out to explore Abu Dhabi to visit the Warner Bros theme park, the UAE’s largest indoor theme park. It is spread over 1.65 million sqkm with high-end and sophisticated rides using the latest technology. You will be transported to the land of your favorite characters and enjoy over 29 rides. There are plenty of family activities as well, including live entertainment, inverted roller coasters and rope bridges.

itinerary.title: Dubai Safari Park
itinerary.description: Spend a relaxed morning before heading to the Dubai Safari Park which houses over 3000 animals, divided into different regions to which the animals belong.

itinerary.title: Abu Dhabi Ferrari World
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head out to Abu Dhabi to visit the Ferrari World, the world’s first Ferrari-branded theme park. You can enjoy the park’s 40 rides, including Formula Rossa, the world’s fastest roller coaster. Enjoy exclusive access to the world’s best Italian supercars along with a go-kart experience with friends and family.

itinerary.title: Ain Dubai
itinerary.description: In the morning, you will visit Ain Dubai, the world’s largest observation wheel for an unparalleled 360-degree view of the city. Head back to the hotel to complete checkout formalities and head to Sharjah to catch your return flight home.

packages.destination: Singapore - Sentosa Sunset Tour - Singapore City Tour - Universal Studios

itinerary.title: Night Safari
itinerary.description: As you land at Changi Airport, our tour representatives will greet and take you to the hotel. Once you have checked in and freshened up, you can eat a delicious lunch at the hotel's dining area and get some much-needed rest. Later in the evening, get ready for a Night Safari at the world’s first nocturnal zoo. It is a part of the Mandai Wildlife Reserve and home to hundreds of animals, including Asian Elephants, the Malayan tiger, Tasmanian devils, and fishing cats.

itinerary.title: Sentosa Island Tour
itinerary.description: The second day is for Sentosa Island. Interact with the dolphins at Dolphin Island, visit Palawan Beach to see the famous suspension bridge, and enjoy a thrilling cable car ride at the Skyline Luge and Skyride.

itinerary.title: Universal Studios
itinerary.description: If you have grown up watching Hollywood movies, Universal Studios is a great place to relive your favorite movies like Transformers, The Mummy, Jurassic Park, etc., and enjoy exhilarating rides like Battlestar Galactica. Trust us when we say your kids will be absolutely thrilled on the visit!

itinerary.title: Gardens by the Bay - National Gallery Singapore - Singapore Zoo – Chinatown
itinerary.description: Enjoy the beautiful Singapore architecture on the fourth day, beginning with Gardens By The Bay, a nature park spread over 101 hectares. Post this, head over to the National Gallery Museum, which displays the art and culture of the Southeast Asian community. Animal lovers will thoroughly enjoy visiting the Singapore Zoo, home to more than 4200 animals. Finish your day with a trip to Chinatown to satiate your craving for oriental cuisine.

itinerary.title: Depart from Singapore
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Zurich - Lindt Home of Chocolate
itinerary.description: After you land in Zurich, board a train from Zurich Airport to Zurich HB and check in to your hotel. Prepare yourself to begin your trip with the delicious goodness of all things chocolaty through the Lindt Home of Chocolate. Learn more about making chocolate and how cocoa emerged as an essential ingredient in Europe. Enjoy the rest of the day at leisure.

itinerary.title: Zurich – Interlaken - Lake Brienz or Lake Thun Cruise
itinerary.description: Board a train from Zurich to Interlaken. Check into a luxury hotel and explore Interlaken after completing check-in formalities. Your next activity will be a cruise on Lake Brienz or Thun for half a day. Enjoy the scenic view of the historic castles, sparkling streams, and waterfalls as the ship sails along the river. Don’t miss to take in the view of the unique Eiger, Monch, and Jungfrau mountain ranges. Spend the night at your hotel in Interlaken.

itinerary.title: Interlaken – Jungfraujoch
itinerary.description: For the third day of your trip, take a train from Interlaken Ost to Grindelwald, from where you can get on a cogwheel train to the top of Jungfraujoch, a viewing point in the Bernese Alps that sits at an altitude of 3,454 metres. View the Aletsch Glacier, the biggest glacier in the Alps, and visit the Ice Palace. You are free to spend the evening at your own pace.

itinerary.title: Interlaken – Lucerne - Lake Lucerne Cruise
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and board the Golden Pass train to Lucerne. The train passes through scenic landscapes, including 8 lakes, 6 cantons, 3 mountain passes, and 2 language regions. Don’t miss the gorgeous Lake Thun, Lake Brienz, Lake Geneva, and the beautiful vineyards on the shores of Lake Geneva. Once you reach Lucerne, check in to your hotel, and head out to explore the city with a Swiss Pass and board the Lake Lucerne cruise or explore Bern city using the Swiss Pass. Stay overnight at a luxury hotel in Lucerne.

itinerary.title: Lucerne- Mt. Titlis
itinerary.description: This day will be about an excursion to Mt. Titlis. Get on Rotair, the world’s first revolving cable car from Engelberg to Mt. Titlis, for a panoramic view of the glaciers. Witness the magnificence of the glaciers, lakes, and snow-covered valleys around you. Spend the night at your hotel in Lucerne.

itinerary.title: Lucerne – Zurich – Depart from Zurich
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to Zurich to board your flight back home.

packages.destination: Nairobi - Masai Mara - Lake Nakuru - Aberdares - Mount Kenya
