itinerary.title: Arrival in Nairobi
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at the airport, our friendly representatives will assist you in completing all necessary government procedures. Afterward, you'll be transferred to your hotel, where you can enjoy a relaxing day at your own pace.

itinerary.title: Nairobi to Masai Mara (5 hours and 30 minutes)
itinerary.description: After enjoying your breakfast at the hotel, we'll set out for the remarkable Masai Mara National Reserve, passing through Narak Town. Upon arrival, we'll check into the hotel for a delicious lunch. Following a brief rest, we'll embark on an exciting game drive in this renowned reserve, an extension of Tanzania's Serengeti National Park. As the day comes to a close, we'll head back to the hotel for a delightful dinner, and you'll spend the night there.

itinerary.title: Masai Mara
itinerary.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast, and then gather with our tour guide for an exciting morning game drive. Afterward, head back to the camp for a relaxing lunch break. In the evening, return to your hotel for a delicious dinner and a comfortable overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Masai Mara to Lake Nakuru (5 Hours and 30 Minutes)
itinerary.description: After enjoying your breakfast at the hotel, we'll set off for the picturesque Lake Nakuru National Park, where breathtaking scenery awaits. You'll have your lunch at the hotel and then head to the national park for a brief visit to experience its natural beauty. Later in the day, return to the hotel for a delicious dinner.

itinerary.title: Lake Nakuru to Aberdares (4 Hours)
itinerary.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast, and then it's off to Aberdares to explore some of the area's top tourist attractions. After your visit, return to the hotel to check out, and enjoy a leisurely lunch. Following that, embark on more sightseeing adventures before transferring to the lodge using the lodge's transportation. In the evening, savour a delicious dinner at the lodge and settle in for a peaceful overnight stay. Keep an eye out for the various animals that frequent the waterhole and its surroundings.

itinerary.title: Aberdares to Mount Kenya (1 Hour 30 Minutes)
itinerary.description: Start your day with a quick breakfast at the hotel, and then meet with your tour guide to discuss the day's plan. We'll make our way to the picturesque White Highlands and the stunning Mount Kenya Region. Upon arrival, check-in at the club. The rest of the day is yours to enjoy at your leisure. Take in the breathtaking surroundings and relish the tranquility. As evening approaches, it's time for a delicious dinner where you can indulge in your favorite dishes at the club.

itinerary.title: Depart from Mount Kenya to Nairobi
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delicious breakfast, and then make your way to Nairobi. Treat yourself to lunch at the renowned "Carnivore" restaurant or "Haandi/Haveli" if you prefer vegetarian options. After your meal, head to the airport for your flight departure.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Zurich
itinerary.description: After you land in Zurich, our tour representatives will greet you at the airport and take you to your hotel. Once the check-in formalities are complete, you can have lunch in the hotel’s dining area. Spend the rest of the day at leisure.

itinerary.title: Zurich - Swiss National Museum - Bahnhofstrasse – Limmatquai - St. Peter's Church - Zurich Opera House - Swiss Federal Institute of Technology
itinerary.description: The second day is dedicated to exploring some of the best spots in Zurich. This beautiful city has consistently ranked among the top 3 for quality of life. Start with the Swiss National Museum, which portrays Switzerland’s cultural history, and then head to Bahnhofstrasse, a downtown street among the world’s most exclusive and expensive shopping avenues. You can then view Limmatquai, a street that leads through the middle of Zurich's old town, and find numerous restaurants, quaint stores, and churches along the way. Pay your respects at St. Peter's Church, catch a show at the Zurich Opera House, and then go to the Swiss Federal Institute of Technology, where Albert Einstein studied and taught. We’ll also ride the Dolderbahn Cogwheel Train to the Zurichberg district and the Grand Hotel Dolder. End the day by going to Fraumunster Church to admire the world-famous Chagall-Windows.

itinerary.title: Zurich – Lucerne
itinerary.description: Board a train from Zurich to Lucerne. Once you’re done checking in to your hotel in Lucerne, you can spend the rest of the day at your own pace.

itinerary.title: Mt. Titlis
itinerary.description: Situated on the Uri Alps, Mt. Titlis is Central Switzerland’s tallest mountain. Take the bus from Lucerne to Engelberg and ride the Rotair, the world’s first revolving cable car that will take you to Mt. Titlis. At 10,000 ft above sea level, Mount Titlis offers a magnificent view of the Alps. Some other attractions on Mt Titlis include – The Glacier Cave, Ice Flyer, Glacier Park, Titlis Adventure Park, Chocolate Shop, Titlis Souvenir Shop, and the Photo Studio. And the many restaurants from where you can enjoy the views of the surrounding lakes, valleys, and glaciers.

itinerary.title: Lucerne – Paris - Champs-Elysees – Louvre - Galeries Lafayette – Lido
itinerary.description: Get on the train from Lucerne to Paris. Reach your hotel and complete the check-in process and then head out for some sightseeing. Visit the famous Louvre and be mesmerised by the stunning display of art, including the painting of the Mona Lisa. Stroll along the Seine River, walk around the Champs-Elysees, shop at Galeries Lafayette, and end the day by catching a cabaret show at the Lido.

itinerary.title: Paris City Tour - Arc de Triomphe - Place de la Concorde - Les Invalides - Tuileries Gardens - Eiffel Tower - Latin Quarter
itinerary.description: Today, we will take you on a delightful tour of Paris. Ride up to the 2nd floor of the Eiffel Tower, and visit some of the most famous landmarks, such as the Arc de Triomphe, Les Invalides, Place de la Concorde, and Tuileries Gardens. In the evening, you can head to Latin Quarter, which has cafes, bookshops, and much more.

itinerary.title: Disneyland Paris
itinerary.description: Who doesn’t want to explore Disneyland? We have kept an entire day aside for you to enjoy the magical experience. Interact with your favorite Disney characters, get access to the Walt Disney Studios Park, and learn about the behind-the-scenes info of your beloved Disney movies and TV shows.

itinerary.title: Depart from Paris
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrival in New York
itinerary.description: Welcome to the vibrant metropolis known as the "Big Apple" and "The City That Never Sleeps." New York is a city of remarkable achievements, being America's largest, most thrilling, and the epicenter of both business and culture. It has long held the status of a global hub for commerce and finance. Upon your arrival at the airport, you will be comfortably transported to your hotel. Enjoy an overnight stay at the hotel in New York.

itinerary.title: New York City Tour
itinerary.description: Following a delightful breakfast, you will embark on a comprehensive city tour of New York. Your journey begins with a visit to the iconic "Statue of Liberty," one of the USA's most renowned landmarks. To reach Liberty Island, you will board a ferry, offering a breathtaking perspective of the New York City skyline. You will then proceed to the One World Observatory, located in the World Trade Center, for an unforgettable view of the city. As the day unfolds, the tour takes you through significant sites, including Rockefeller Center, Wall Street, Ground Zero, Central Park, Times Square, the United Nations, and Trump properties. After a day filled with exploration, you will return to your New York hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: New York to Washington
itinerary.description: Start the day with a hearty breakfast. Today, you will travel to Washington, D.C., the capital of the United States of America, renowned for its historic neighbourhoods and monuments. Besides serving as the seat of the federal government, tourism plays a vital role in D.C.'s economy, drawing nearly twenty million visitors annually. Upon arrival and hotel check-in, you'll have some free time to relax. Spend the night at your Washington hotel.

itinerary.title: Washington City Exploration
itinerary.description: Following breakfast, you'll have the opportunity to explore the capital city of the United States. Your itinerary includes visits to prominent landmarks such as the White House, Lincoln Memorial, Supreme Court, the Capitol Building, the Smithsonian Air and Space Museum, Union Station, World War II Memorial Building, the Pentagon, and the Washington Monument. Enjoy another night at your Washington hotel.

itinerary.title: Washington - Buffalo - USA Side Niagara Falls - Niagara
itinerary.description: Today, you'll fly to Buffalo and then transfer to the charming town of Niagara, home to the world-famous falls, one of the natural wonders of the world. Upon your arrival, check into your hotel, take a moment to freshen up, and explore the local shops where you can purchase souvenirs. In the evening, return to the hotel for a delightful dinner. If you wish, you can also explore the nearby casinos on your own tonight. Enjoy your overnight stay at the hotel in Niagara.

itinerary.title: Niagara - Visit the Famous USA Side of Niagara Falls
itinerary.description: On this day, you will embark on the renowned "Maid of the Mist" boat, which will take you up close to the thundering falls and provide stunning views of both the American and Horseshoe Falls (it is seasonal). After this exhilarating experience, return to the hotel to freshen up. In the evening, you have the option to visit the falls on your own to witness their beautiful illumination. Enjoy another night at the hotel in Niagara.

itinerary.title: Depart from Niagara
itinerary.description: Commence your day with a hearty breakfast. Today marks the conclusion of your journey as you prepare to return home or continue to your next destination.

itinerary.title: Niagara to Orlando
itinerary.description: On this day, you will depart for Orlando via a flight. Orlando is Florida's sixth largest city and is famous for being its largest inland city. Notably, the presence of Disney World theme park has transformed Orlando into a renowned vacation destination, attracting over 52 million tourists annually. Upon your arrival, you will be transferred to your hotel, where you will spend the night in Orlando.

itinerary.title: Orlando - Walt Disney Magic Kingdom
itinerary.description: On this seventh day, your destination is the enchanting Walt Disney Magic Kingdom, spanning a vast 107 acres and having opened its gates on October 1, 1971. Often hailed as "The Most Magical Place on Earth," it boasts seven captivating, themed lands and a plethora of attractions that cater to all age groups. The moment you set foot on Main Street USA, you'll find yourself whisked away to a realm where the worries of the outside world miraculously dissolve, and where Disney's timeless tales come to life. You'll spend the night at your Orlando hotel. (B)

itinerary.title: Orlando - Epcot Center
itinerary.description: Commence your day with a visit to the captivating Epcot Center, where you can explore the future and embark on a global journey through a captivating array of attractions and live performances. This expansive 260-acre domain is dedicated to both past accomplishments and the frontiers of technology. The World Showcase beckons with a perpetual World Fair atmosphere, featuring pavilions that pay homage to eleven different countries. You'll once again stay overnight at your Orlando hotel. (B)

itinerary.title: Orlando - Sea World
itinerary.description: Today, you'll set your sights on the world's largest Marine Park, Sea World, where a host of exciting attractions awaits. Are you daring enough to experience a one-of-a-kind water coaster adventure through the enigmatic lost city of Atlantis? You can also take to the skies on a thrilling jet copter ride to the Wild Arctic. At Sea World, you'll have the chance to interact with and marvel at incredible, awe-inspiring wildlife, and immerse yourself in the excitement that keeps drawing visitors back time and time again. You'll spend the night at your Orlando hotel.

itinerary.title: Orlando to San Francisco
itinerary.description: Today, you will embark on a journey to San Francisco, a city that has earned its legendary status, akin to the likes of Paris and London. San Francisco's iconic hills offer breathtaking vistas of the Pacific Ocean and San Francisco Bay. The city is adorned with a diverse range of shops, restaurants, and a vibrant cosmopolitan nightlife. Moreover, San Francisco serves as the gateway to Silicon Valley, the heart of American high technology. Upon your arrival, we will assist you in checking into your hotel, where you'll be spending the night.

itinerary.title: San Francisco City Tour
itinerary.description: Today, you set out to explore the enchanting city of San Francisco. Your tour will encompass a visit to the world-renowned Golden Gate Bridge, boasting the world's highest bridge towers. Continuing on, you'll experience Twin Peaks, the winding charm of Lombard Street, the iconic Cable Car, Pier 39, the elegance of Nob Hill, the Civic Center, Union Square, the bustling Fisherman's Wharf, and the magnificent Palace of Fine Arts, along with other noteworthy highlights. You'll return to your hotel in San Francisco for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: San Francisco to Las Vegas
itinerary.description: In the morning, you will depart for your flight to the dazzling city of Las Vegas. Upon arrival, we will ensure you a smooth transfer to your hotel. In the evening, you will embark on a city tour of Las Vegas, where you'll witness the mesmerising Colourful Dancing Fountains at the Bellagio, the swashbuckling Pirate Ships at Treasure Island, the towering Stratosphere Tower, the vibrant Downtown Vegas, and the iconic Fremont Street, illuminated by over 12 million lights, offering a captivating free show accompanied by pulsating music. Your night will be spent at the hotel in Las Vegas.

itinerary.title: Las Vegas - Grand Canyon (Optional)
itinerary.description: You have the option to spend the day at your leisure or embark on an exciting journey to the Grand Canyon. Don't forget to explore the remarkable Skywalk, a new wonder of the West. In the evening, you can choose to take the Las Vegas Night Flight, a breathtaking helicopter ride over the dazzling nighttime Vegas skyline. Alternatively, you can enjoy a fabulous show or attend one of the free performances, such as the Sirens of Treasure Island, and much more. Spend the night at your hotel in Las Vegas.

itinerary.title: Las Vegas - Los Angeles
itinerary.description: This morning, you will depart for Los Angeles. Later in the day, you can enjoy a captivating city tour of Los Angeles. Our tour will take you through the "Entertainment capital of the world," including Hollywood, the Hollywood Walk of Fame, Beverly Hills, Grauman's Chinese Theater, the Sunset Strip, Rodeo Drive for some of the world's most exclusive shopping, and China Town for excellent bargains. Spend the night at your hotel in Los Angeles.

itinerary.title: Los Angeles - Universal Studios
itinerary.description: Join us today for a tour of Universal Studios, a place renowned for its innovative rides and attractions that provide visitors with an unparalleled movie experience. A visit to Universal Studios is like stepping into the heart of Hollywood, where you might even spot famous actors or TV personalities strolling the park's sidewalks. Spend the night at your hotel in Los Angeles

itinerary.title: Departing from Los Angeles
itinerary.description: Begin your morning with some leisurely moments before making your way to the airport, where you'll board your flight to your next exciting destination

Don't miss the opportunity to experience the New Wonder of the West, SKYWALK. In the evening, you have the option to take the Las Vegas Night Flight, a mesmerising helicopter ride over the glittering Las Vegas skyline. You can also indulge in a fabulous show or catch one of the free performances, such as the Sirens of Treasure Island, and much more. Your night's accommodation awaits at the hotel in Las Vegas.

itinerary.title: Las Vegas - Los Angeles
itinerary.description: Today, you'll travel to Los Angeles either by air or road. In Los Angeles, you'll enjoy a city tour that will take you through the entertainment capital of the world. Explore iconic locations like the Hollywood Walk of Fame, Beverly Hills, Grauman's Chinese Theatre, Sunset Strip, Rodeo Drive for a taste of the world's most exclusive shopping, and China Town for some great bargains. Your overnight stay is arranged at a hotel in Los Angeles.

itinerary.title: Los Angeles - Universal Studios
itinerary.description: Join us today for an exciting visit to Universal Studios, renowned for its cutting-edge rides and attractions, offering visitors a unique opportunity to immerse themselves in the world of movies like never before. A day at Universal feels like a journey into the heart of Hollywood, where the magic of film and TV production is always in progress. You might even spot some familiar faces strolling along the park's sidewalks. You will spend the night at your hotel in Los Angeles.

itinerary.title: Los Angeles - Disneyland
itinerary.description: Today, we'll take you to Disneyland, where the enchanting world of storybook fantasies becomes a part of your everyday reality. As soon as you step onto Main Street USA, you'll be transported to a place where the worries of the outside world seem to effortlessly fade away. It's a land where Disney classics come to life, promising a day filled with wonder and joy. You will spend the night at your hotel in Los Angeles.

itinerary.title: Los Angeles to San Francisco
itinerary.description: Today, you'll board a flight to San Francisco, a city that has achieved legendary status akin to iconic places like Paris and London. Your journey in San Francisco includes visits to renowned landmarks such as the Golden Gate Bridge, which boasts the world's tallest bridge towers. You'll also explore Twin Peaks, Lombard Street, the famous Cable Car, Pier 39, Nob Hill, Civic Center, Union Square, Fisherman’s Wharf, and the Palace of Fine Arts, among other highlights. Your night's stay will be at a hotel in San Francisco.

itinerary.title: Depart San Francisco
itinerary.description: This morning, you can take some time to relax and enjoy leisure moments. Later, make your way to the airport for your flight to your next destination.

packages.name: Indulge in Holy Land Tour | 8 Days Itinerary
packages.destination: Tel Aviv - Sea of Galilee Acre - Nazareth - Jordan Valley - Beit Shean - Jerusalem - Masada - Dead Sea

images.alt_text: Indulge in Holy Land Tour | 8 Days Itinerary
Indulge in Holy Land Tour | 8 Days Itinerary

itinerary.title: Arrival in Tel Aviv
itinerary.description: As you get off your flight at Tel Aviv Airport, our friendly representative will be there to greet you. They'll assist you in collecting your luggage and smoothly guide you through Customs. After this, you'll be introduced to your driver, who will take you to your hotel. The evening is yours to relax and explore Tel Aviv at your leisure. Enjoy a comfortable overnight stay in your hotel.

itinerary.title: From Tel Aviv to the Shores of the Sea of Galilee
itinerary.description: Following a hearty breakfast, our journey begins with a short visit to the historic city of Jaffa, also known as Joppa. Here, you'll embark on a brief walking tour through the charming old town's winding streets. You'll pass by the house of Simon the Tanner and take in breathtaking views from the hilltop. The route then takes northward along the picturesque coast to the captivating archaeological ruins of Caesarea, originally constructed by Herod the Great in honour of Augustus Caesar. From there, we head to Megiddo, a place mentioned in the Book of Revelations as the site of a great battle known as "Armageddon." This ancient city has been continuously inhabited for over five millennia, dating back to 6000-500 B.C. After exploring the fascinating ancient ruins, set the course towards the serene shores of the Sea of Galilee, where you will spend the night at a comfortable hotel in Tiberias.

itinerary.title: Exploring the Wonders of the Sea of Galilee
itinerary.description: After a satisfying breakfast, our day begins in the historically rich city of Tiberias. This city holds a special place in history, as it was where Jesus once lived, wandered, and delivered his sermons on the tranquil shores of the Sea of Galilee. Our first stop takes us to Capernaum, which was the epicenter of Jesus' ministry. Here, you'll step into the footsteps of history and gain insight into the significance of this sacred place. Continuing our journey, we will head to Tabgha, located just north of Tiberias. It's here that the miracle of feeding the 5,000 took place. The Church of Multiplication, adorned with a mosaic floor depicting a basket filled with loaves and two fishes, serves as a poignant reminder of this extraordinary event. Next, our path leads us to the Mount of Beatitudes, perched on a hillside with a breathtaking view of the Sea of Galilee. This is where Jesus delivered his famous "Sermon on the Mount" and where tradition holds that he selected his twelve apostles. The adventure then takes you to the heights of Golan Heights, where you will be treated to a panoramic view of Mt. Hermon's peaks, the rugged plateau of Golan Heights, and the lush green Hula Valley beneath it. Before the day concludes, you will visit the Yardenit Baptismal Site, a serene spot along the Jordan River located to the south of the Sea of Galilee. After our day of exploration, you will return to our comfortable hotel in Tiberias for a peaceful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Nazareth, Jordan Valley, Beit Shean, and Jerusalem Exploration
itinerary.description: Today, you will kick off the day with a satisfying breakfast before embarking on a journey that promises to immerse you in history and spirituality. Your first stop takes you to Cana, where you will visit the Wedding Church, a place of great significance where Jesus performed his inaugural miracle, transforming water into wine. Continuing your spiritual pilgrimage, you will lead to Nazareth, the town where Jesus spent his formative years. Here, you'll have the opportunity to visit the Church of Annunciation, a magnificent structure constructed on the very spot where archaeologists believe the Archangel Gabriel appeared to the Virgin Mary. As you explore further, you will encounter Mary's Well and Joseph's Church, each steeped in history and meaning. Leaving Nazareth, we traverse the Jordan Valley, heading towards Beit Shean. This ancient city, boasting a recently excavated amphitheatre, is a testament to its Roman past. The city's beauty remains astonishingly preserved; despite the devastation it endured in an earthquake. As the day draws to a close, you will settle into your accommodation in Jerusalem for a well-deserved night's rest.

itinerary.title: Masada and the Enchanting Dead Sea
itinerary.description: Following a hearty breakfast, we embark on a captivating journey to explore the awe-inspiring landscapes of the Dead Sea. Our next destination is Masada, a mountaintop fortress perched on an isolated cliff in the Judean Desert. This remarkable site has earned its place as a UNESCO World Heritage Site since 2001. To reach the fortress, we'll ascend by cable car. Once at the top, you'll delve into the history of Masada, which served as the final stronghold for Jewish Zealots during their fierce battle against the Romans. Your visit will include exploring King Herod's palace, the synagogue, the bathhouse, and much more. From this vantage point, you'll be treated to a breathtaking panorama of the Roman camps and the mesmerising Dead Sea. On our journey to the Dead Sea, we'll make a stop at the Qumran Caves, the very place where the Dead Sea Scrolls were discovered. Situated nearly 1,300 feet below sea level, the Dead Sea is Earth's lowest point. If the weather permits, you can even experience the unique sensation of effortlessly floating on its salty, mineral-rich waters. After a day of exploration and relaxation, you will return to your comfortable hotel in Jerusalem for a peaceful night's sleep.

itinerary.title: Exploring Jerusalem's Modern Side
itinerary.description: Kickstart your day with a hearty breakfast and get ready for a fascinating journey through Jerusalem's modern city. Your first stop is at the Israel Museum, where you will delve into the past with a visit to the renowned Shrine of the Book, home to the famous Dead Sea Scrolls. Next, you will step back in time as you visit the meticulously restored model of the Herodian city of Jerusalem, dating back to the era of the Second Temple. It's a unique opportunity to visualise what the city looked like in days gone by. Your adventure continues with a visit to Ein Karem, a charming village nestled in the southwest of Jerusalem. This village holds a special place in Christian traditions as the traditional birthplace of John the Baptist. The serene surroundings and historical significance make it a memorable stop on our journey. You will then visit Yad Vashem, the official memorial dedicated to the Jewish victims of the Holocaust. Established in 1953, it's situated at the base of Mt. Hertzl, and it serves as a poignant reminder of the atrocities of the past. In the afternoon, you will venture to Bethlehem, the revered birthplace of Jesus. You will visit the Church of the Nativity and the iconic Manger Square, where the story of Christmas comes to life. As the day draws to a close, you will return to your hotel in Jerusalem, where you can relax and unwind.

itinerary.title: Exploring the Historic Heart of Jerusalem
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a hearty breakfast before starting on a journey through the ancient streets of Jerusalem's Old City. Your first stop will be the Western Wall, a place of deep spiritual importance, and the very spot where the Second Temple once stood - known as the Temple Mount. As you wander through the city, follow the path of the Via Dolorosa, the Way of the Cross, which leads to Calvary and the Church of the Holy Sepulchre. This remarkable church houses both the traditional Crucifixion site and the Tomb of the Resurrection. Venturing just beyond the Old City's southwestern edge, you'll find Mount Zion, home to the traditional tomb of King David and the Room of the Last Supper. From here, take in the breathtaking panoramic view of Jerusalem, a city revered by three major world religions: Christianity, Judaism, and Islam. The view from the Mount of Olives is nothing short of spectacular. Conclude your day with a visit to the Garden of Gethsemane, the historic location, where Judas betrayed Jesus. Your overnight stay awaits you at the hotel in Jerusalem.

itinerary.title: Farewell to Jerusalem
itinerary.description: As you rise on this new day, relish a final breakfast at your hotel before it's time to bid farewell to the enchanting city of Jerusalem. Check out of your accommodation and make your way to the airport for your departure.

itinerary.title: Arrive In Rome
itinerary.description: Welcome to Rome, the City of Seven Hills! The city is considered the cradle of Western Civilization and the epicenter of the Catholic Church. Upon arrival at the Rome International Airport, our tour manager will gladly help you transfer to the hotel and complete check-in formalities. Spend the rest of the day exploring the different markets and avenues around your hotel. Stay at a luxury hotel in Rome.

itinerary.title: Rome – Hop On Hop Off Tour
itinerary.description: After a quick break, you’ll start with the Discover Rome tour on the Hop On Hop Off bus. The tickets for this bus are valid for 48 hours, allowing you to leave or join any time. Some of the tourist attractions you’ll cover on this tour include the Vatican City, the Colosseum, Trevi Fountain, Tiber Island, and more. This open double-decker bus offers a 360-degree view of the different attractions. Listen to an audio commentary about these places in multiple international languages. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Rome.

itinerary.title: Rome – Florence – Pisa – Florence
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a sumptuous breakfast buffet at the hotel. Later, catch your train to Florence. The journey takes around 1.5 hours and is scenic for most parts. Check into your hotel before starting a half-day excursion to the Tuscan countryside. Some of the sites you’ll cover include the fertile Tuscan countryside, the historic Leaning Tower of Pisa, Piazza de Miracoli, Duomo, Camposanto, Battistero di San Giovanni, Camposanto, and Piazza dei Cavalieri. An audio commentary in multiple international languages will guide you. Remember to marvel at the beautiful Piscan architecture at the Church of San Sisto, one of the oldest churches in Pisa, and Piazza dei Cavalieri, or Knight’s Square, an important landmark in Pisa. Return to Florence in the evening to spend the night at a luxury hotel in the city.

itinerary.title: Florence – Venice
itinerary.description: After a hearty breakfast, start your day with a tour of Florence on the Hop On Hop Off bus. You will explore the vast greenery, vineyards, and olive groves at the foot of the Appenine Mountains chains, along with the many museums, art galleries, and other attractions of Florence. Millions of tourists visit daily to admire the statues of David of Michelangelo, 2.5 hMaria dei Fiore. After lunch, you will be driven to the Florence Railway Station for your train to Venice. As you arrive in Venice, we’ll help you transfer to the hotel. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Venice.

itinerary.title: Venice
itinerary.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast. Later, make your way to the Tourist Office at Plaza San Marcos for a guided walking tour of Venice. You’ll start your day with a tour of St. Mark’s Square and its main monuments, understanding its history and architecture. Today, you’ll cover St. Mark’s Basilica and the Ducale Palace. Next, you’ll cross the Bridge of Sighs to visit the famous Venice Jail. The tour ends with a visit to the glass factory on the island of Murano. You are free to spend the rest of the afternoon exploring the many markets of Venice famous for local crafts, glassware, delicate lace, and papier-mâché art. Spend the night in Venice.

itinerary.title: Venice – Milan
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel to take your train to Milan. The journey takes around 2.5 hours and is scenic as the train travels through Italy’s Adriatic Coast. Check into your hotel and spend the rest of the day exploring the many markets famous for fashion and handicrafts. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Milan.

itinerary.title: Milan – Hop On Hop Off Tour
itinerary.description: Today, you will explore Milan on a Hop On Hop Off bus. This is an open-top double-decker bus offering a panoramic view of the city’s top attractions. Some places you will cover include the Duomo, Sforzesco Castle, Santa Maria delle Grazie, Piazza del Duomo, and the Leonardo da Vinci Museum of Science. Other attractions in Milan include Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II and Triennale di Milano. Spend the night in Milan.

itinerary.title: Depart Milan
itinerary.description: Check out of your hotel to head to the airport to continue with the next leg of your Europe tour package or catch your return flight home.

packages.name: Eastern Explorer – A Journey through Iconic Cities and Attractions
packages.destination: New York - Washington - Buffalo - USA Side Niagara Falls - Niagara - Orlando - Epcot Center - Sea World

images.alt_text: Eastern Explorer – A Journey through Iconic Cities and Attractions
Eastern Explorer – A Journey through Iconic Cities and Attractions

itinerary.title: Arrival in New York
itinerary.description: Welcome to the iconic "Big Apple," a city that never rests, New York. This vibrant metropolis holds numerous distinctions, being America's largest city, its most thrilling, a hub of business and culture, and a trendsetter in the nation. For over a century, it has stood as a global epicenter for trade and finance. Upon your arrival at the airport, our team will ensure your smooth transfer to the hotel. You'll spend the night at your accommodation in New York.

itinerary.title: New York City Tour
itinerary.description: Following a delicious breakfast, you will set off on a comprehensive city tour of New York. Your sightseeing adventure includes a visit to one of the most iconic landmarks in the USA, the "Statue of Liberty." To get up close and personal with Lady Liberty, you will take a ferry ride to Liberty Island, providing us with a breathtaking view of the New York City skyline. Next, you will have the opportunity to witness a truly unforgettable vista from the One World Observatory, located within the World Trade Center. This experience promises a panoramic view of the city that will stay with you for a lifetime. As the day progresses, your journey takes us through some of New York's most famous locations, such as Rockefeller Center, Wall Street, Ground Zero, and Central Park. You will also pass by Times Square, the United Nations headquarters, and buildings associated with Donald Trump. After a day of exploration and discovery, you will return to your hotel in New York for a restful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: New York to Washington
itinerary.description: Today, you will make your way to the vibrant city of Washington, D.C. Upon your arrival, we'll assist you with the check-in process at your hotel. Washington, D.C. stands as the capital of the United States, and its name pays homage to George Washington, the country's inaugural President. The district's title, "Columbia," holds historical significance as an early poetic reference to the United States, and it also harkens back to Christopher Columbus, the renowned Italian explorer of the Americas. After checking in, you'll have the evening to unwind and prepare for the adventures that await in the heart of the nation's capital. Your overnight stay will be at the hotel in Washington.

itinerary.title: Washington City Tour
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a satisfying breakfast, and then embark on a fascinating journey through the capital city of the United States. Your tour will take you to some of the most iconic landmarks in Washington, D.C., including the White House, the Lincoln Memorial, the Supreme Court, the Capitol Building, the Smithsonian Air and Space Museum, Union Station, the World War II Memorial Building, the Pentagon building, and the Washington Monument. After a day filled with exploration, return to your hotel in Washington for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Washington - Buffalo – USA Side Niagara Falls - Niagara
itinerary.description: Today, you will take a flight to Buffalo to witness the awe-inspiring wonder of the world, Niagara Falls. These majestic falls, a natural marvel, are a sight to behold. Your journey includes a remarkable boat ride aboard the renowned "Maid of the Mist," which will bring you up close to the roaring cascades, allowing you to embrace the misty embrace of the American and Horseshoe Falls (which is available only during certain seasons). After the exhilarating boat trip, you will return to our hotel for a refreshing break. You'll have the evening to relax and unwind at our hotel in Niagara.

itinerary.title: Niagara - Orlando
itinerary.description: Today, you will bid farewell to Niagara and take off on a flight to Orlando. Orlando, the sixth-largest city in Florida, is a remarkable destination known for its distinction as the largest inland city in the state. What truly sets Orlando apart is the enchanting Disney World theme park, which has firmly established this city as a renowned vacation getaway. Every year, Orlando extends a warm welcome to over 52 million visitors. Upon your arrival, you will be transferred to your hotel, where you will spend the night in Orlando.

itinerary.title: Orlando – Walt Disney Magic Kingdom
itinerary.description: On this seventh day, you'll have the pleasure of visiting The Magic Kingdom, an enchanting place spanning 107 acres. This magical destination first welcomed visitors on October 1, 1971, and has since earned the nickname "The Most Magical Place on Earth!" The park boasts seven themed lands, along with a multitude of attractions that captivate visitors of all ages. As soon as you set foot on Main Street USA, you'll find yourself transported to a realm where the worries of the outside world seem to effortlessly fade away. It's a place where storybook fantasies come to life, and Disney classics unfold before your eyes. Following your visit, you'll return to your hotel in Orlando for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Orlando - Epcot Center
itinerary.description: Wake up and have a delicious breakfast. Commence your day with a visit to the Epcot Center, a place where you can experience the future and explore the world through a captivating array of attractions and live performances. Epcot covers 260 acres, dedicated to celebrating past accomplishments and the marvels of future technology. The World Showcase is a permanent exhibition that resembles a world fair, featuring pavilions representing eleven different countries. You'll return to your hotel in Orlando for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Orlando – Sea World
itinerary.description: On this day, you will have the chance to visit Sea World, which is the largest marine park in the world. Sea World offers a plethora of captivating attractions that are bound to leave you amazed. One of the thrilling experiences includes embarking on a unique water coaster ride that will take you on a heart-pounding journey through the enigmatic lost city of Atlantis. For those seeking an adrenaline rush, you can take to the skies on a jet copter ride to the Wild Arctic, where you'll soar through a world of adventure and danger. At Sea World, you'll also have the opportunity to engage with and observe incredible wild animals up close. Whether it's touching them, feeding them, or coming face to face with these magnificent creatures, Sea World promises an experience that will beckon you to return time and time again. After a day filled with such extraordinary encounters, you'll return to your hotel in Orlando for a relaxing overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Leaving Orlando
itinerary.description: Start the day with morning breakfast. I's time to head to the airport for your flight to your next destination.

packages.name: Muscat Travel Package Itinerary: Grand Mosque, Dolphin-Watching, and Jebel Akhdar
packages.destination: Muscat - Dolphin Watching - Wahiba - Nizwa - Jabal Akhdar

images.alt_text: Muscat Travel Package Itinerary: Grand Mosque, Dolphin-Watching, and Jebel Akhdar
Muscat Travel Package Itinerary: Grand Mosque, Dolphin-Watching, and Jebel Akhdar

itinerary.title: Arrival in Muscat
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Muscat International Airport, kindly proceed through immigration clearance and collect your baggage. Once you have completed customs formalities, make your way to the arrival hall, where your chauffeur will be waiting to escort you to your hotel. Enjoy a restful overnight stay at your accommodation in the enchanting city of Muscat.

itinerary.title: A Half-Day Exploration of Muscat's Splendours
itinerary.description: Commence the day with a hotel pickup and embark on a journey to witness the Grand Mosque, the crown jewel of Muscat's cityscape. Noteworthy is the fact that visits are not feasible on Fridays or other public holidays. Completed in 2001, the Grand Mosque stands as a magnificent testament to contemporary craftsmanship seamlessly interwoven with traditional aesthetics. Its modern exterior belies the preservation of age-old artisanal skills, creating a truly wondrous and evocative atmosphere. The mosque's interior is nothing short of captivating, with its intricately woven handmade carpets, resplendent chandeliers, and the awe-inspiring ceiling of the main prayer room, all of which are absolute must-see treasures. It is imperative to take note that, for the visit, ladies are kindly requested to be fully covered and carry a headscarf, while gentlemen should be attired in trousers. Embark on a scenic drive along the waterfront Corniche, allowing for a visit to the vibrant Muttrah Souq. Subsequently, you will proceed to Al Alam Palace, a resplendent edifice that serves as the official residence of His Majesty Sultan Qaboos, elegantly flanked by the Portuguese forts of Mirani and Jalali, dating back to the 16th century. Your journey continues with a visit to the Bait Al Zubair Museum, offering a captivating glimpse into the tapestry of Oman's rich history. Concluding your exploratory sojourn, you will return to the sanctuary of your hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Dolphin-Watching Delight.
itinerary.description: Transfer from your Muscat abode to the Marina, where an enchanting maritime adventure awaits. You will set sail on a boat, embarking on an exhilarating quest to encounter the mesmerising world of dolphins and whales. Witnessing these wild dolphins in their natural habitat is an exhilarating way to commence your day, and for the fortunate few, a sighting of the diverse whale species that frequent the waters just a stone's throw from Muscat's rugged coastline is a possibility. While no guarantees can be made regarding sightings, the journey at sea promises an enriching experience, enhancing your knowledge of these captivating marine mammals. After the maritime excursion, you will return to the Marina and then make your way back to the hotel. The remainder of the day is yours to savour at your leisure, allowing you the opportunity to explore the city's charms or indulge in the amenities offered by your hotel. As the day draws to a close, retire for a peaceful overnight stay at your Muscat haven.

itinerary.title: Muscat – Nizwa – Jabal Akhdar
itinerary.description: We set forth to Nizwa, the interior's capital and the very cradle of Islam within the Sultanate of Oman. Nizwa takes pride in its illustrious Round Tower Fort, an architectural gem from the 17th century, which you will pause to admire through a photographic lens. The Souq in Nizwa is renowned not only for its bustling Friday cattle auction but also for the exquisitely hand carved "Khanjars" (traditional Omani daggers) and ornamental silver jewellery on display. Your journey continues to Wadi Al Madeen, where you will encounter a checkpoint. From this point, a winding 36-kilometre stretch of road beckons, leading us to the verdant sanctuary of Jebel Akhdar, standing 2000 metres above sea level. This emerald jewel amidst the Al Hajjar mountain ranges is an absolute rarity within the Arabian Peninsula, offering a refreshing mountain climate that invites you to savour its natural beauty. Our evening unfolds at the Sama Jabal Akhdar Hotel for a serene overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Depart Jabal Akhdar – Muscat
itinerary.description: Al Jebel Al Akhdar is celebrated for its fruit orchards, meticulously terraced along the mountain slopes and nourished by natural springs and aflaj. As you traverse the landscape, you will encounter the picturesque villages of Saiq, Wadi Bani Habib (the village of old houses), and village roose & Al Ain. These settlements offer breathtaking vistas of dramatic peaks, gorges, and wadis. The fragrance of the Jabal Al Akhdar roses fills the air when they are in full bloom, typically in March or April. Within the homes of these villagers, rose water is lovingly distilled, adding to the region's allure. To make the most of this excursion, it is advisable to don light, comfortable clothing and sturdy walking shoes. Your journey concludes with a drop-off at Muscat International Airport.

itinerary.title: Welcome to Muscat
itinerary.description: Your journey begins as you touch down at Muscat International Airport. After smoothly clearing immigration, collecting your baggage, and going through customs, make your way to the arrival hall. There, you'll be warmly welcomed by your chauffeur who will accompany you to your chosen hotel. Settle in and enjoy a restful overnight stay in Muscat.

itinerary.title: Exploring Muscat's Treasures
itinerary.description: Today, you will go on a captivating half-day tour of Muscat, the heart of Oman. We'll start the day with a visit to the breathtaking Grand Mosque, a true highlight of the city. Please note that the Grand Mosque visit is not possible on Fridays and certain public holidays. This modern architectural masterpiece, completed in 2001, seamlessly combines modern design with traditional craftsmanship. As you explore, be sure to capture the mosque's beauty, from the intricate handmade carpets to the grand chandeliers and the stunning ceiling of the main prayer room. To enter, ladies should ensure they are fully covered and have a headscarf, while men should wear trousers. The journey continues along the picturesque waterfront Corniche, where we'll make a stop at the vibrant Muttrah Souq, a bustling and colourful marketplace filled with local treasures and handicrafts. Don't forget to haggle for some souvenirs. We'll then proceed for a photo stop at the magnificent Al Alam Palace, the official residence of His Majesty Sultan Qaboos. It is flanked by the historic 16th-century Portuguese forts, Mirani and Jalali, adding to the grandeur of the scene. The next stop takes us to the Bait Al Zubair Museum, where you can catch a glimpse of Oman's rich history and cultural heritage. As the day comes to a close, we'll return to the hotel for a well-deserved rest. Enjoy your overnight stay in Muscat, reflecting on the wonderful experiences of the day.

itinerary.title: Dolphin Watching - A Maritime Adventure
itinerary.description: Today, we'll take you from your Muscat hotel to the Marina for an exciting escapade. Our destination? The open sea, where we'll set off on a boat in search of Dolphins and Whales. Watching these incredible marine creatures in their natural habitat is a truly exhilarating way to kickstart your day. If you're lucky, you might even have the chance to spot one of the many whale species that call the waters just a short distance from Muscat's rugged coastline their home. While we can't promise dolphin or whale sightings on every trip, the journey itself is a memorable experience. You'll gain a deeper understanding of these captivating marine mammals and the ocean they call home. As we return to the Marina, you'll have the rest of the day to yourself, either to explore the city or take advantage of the hotel's facilities. Your night's rest will be at the hotel in Muscat.

itinerary.title: Farewell to Muscat
itinerary.description: Enjoy your morning breakfast and it will be time to bid adieu to Muscat. After checking out from your hotel, we'll arrange for your transfer to Muscat International Airport, where you'll catch your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Coimbatore – Delhi - India Gate - Karol Bagh
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at Delhi Airport, you will be greeted by our tour representatives, who will help you get to your hotel. After completing the check-in process, you can relax around your hotel for a while. Later in the day, proceed to visit India Gate and get some shopping done at Karol Bagh. Get back to your hotel to spend the night.

itinerary.title: Delhi - Birla Mandir - Lotus Temple - Raj Ghat - Indira Gandhi Memorial - Amritsar
itinerary.description: On this day, you will be going around the city of Delhi and taking in most its touristy sights. The first stop will be Birla Mandir, which also goes by the name of Shri Laxmi Narayan Temple, and was the first Hindu temple to be built in Delhi. Next up is the Lotus Temple, which derives its name from the lotus-like shape of the temple. Go to Raj Ghat, a memorial complex where Mahatma Gandhi was cremated after his assassination in 1948. Finish your exploration of Delhi by visiting the Indira Gandhi Memorial, which was once the place of residence of Indira Gandhi. Later in the day, board a train to move to Amritsar.

itinerary.title: Amritsar - Golden Temple - Jallianwala Bagh - Wagah Border
itinerary.description: Once you reach Amritsar, check-in to your hotel and head out to offer your prayers at the revered Golden Temple. Also known as Harmandir Sahib, it is a primary religious spot for the Sikhs and served as a site for the Singh Sabha Movement between 1883 and the 1920s. It was also a centre of the Punjabi Suba movement between 1947 and 1966. There is a manmade pool located at the site of the temple, which was completed in 1577 by Guru Ram Das, the fourth Sikh Guru. After having lunch, proceed to visit the Jallianwala Bagh, a memorial park built to honour the memory of those who died in the Jallianwala Bagh massacre in 1919. You will also be visiting Wagah Border, the international border that separates India and Pakistan. Return to your hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: Amritsar – Shimla - Mall Road
itinerary.description: In the morning, depart Amritsar and drive to Shimla. Upon reaching your hotel in Shimla, check-in to your hotel and relax for a bit. In the evening, enjoy a round of shopping at Mall Road. Spend the night at your hotel in Shimla.

itinerary.title: Himalayan Nature Park Kufri
itinerary.description: In the morning, have your breakfast at your hotel and leave to visit the Himalayan Nature Park in Kufri. Situated at a height of 2,600 metres, it is located close to 18 km from Shimla and is sprawled over an area of 90 hectares. The park was once a musk deer farm before it was recognised by the Central Zoo Authority of India as a full-fledged nature park, after which it was given its name in 1996. Some of the plant species present at this park are potentillas, geraniums, ground orchids, and primulas. The animals you can spot at the Himalayan Nature Park include the Himalayan blue sheep, Himalayan wolf, musk deer, sambar deer, leopard cat, barking deer, and cheer pheasant.

itinerary.title: Shimla - Kullu - Manali
itinerary.description: After enjoying a healthy breakfast, leave Shimla and head for Manali. On the way, lay your eyes on the Beas River, Sutlej River, and Kullu Valley. Stop by a shawl factory at Kullu, after which you can continue your journey to Manali post your lunch. You will be reaching Manali in the evening and you can relax around your hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: Rohtang Pass
itinerary.description: Today, you will be driven to Rohtang Pass, which is an iconic high mountain pass that stands at a height of 3,980 metres. It is a connecting point between the Lahaul and Spiti Valleys and the Kullu Valley. Rohtang Pass stays open from May to November. While you’re at this mountain pass, you can engage in thrilling activities such as paragliding, mountain biking, snow scootering, and skiing. In the evening, drive back to Manali.

itinerary.title: Manali - Shri Vashishtha Temple - Hadimba Devi Temple - Chandigarh
itinerary.description: On this day, you will be visiting two temples in Manali. The first one you will be going to is the Shri Vashishtha Temple, which is situated in a village named Vashishtha, about 3 km from Manali’s city centre. The temple is dedicated to Vashishtha, who is among the oldest and most revered Vedic sages. Decorated with intricate and exquisite wooden carvings, the temple is said to be over 4,000 years old. The interior of the temple contains traditional murals, figurines, and paintings. There is a black statue of Sage Vashishtha placed within the temple, which was built using granite and wrapped in a white dhoti. The second temple you will be visiting today is Hadimba Devi Temple, dedicated to Hidimbi Devi, who was the wife of Bhima. The temple dates back to the 16th century and was built by Maharaja Bahadur Singh. Standing 24 metres tall, a cedar forest surrounds the temple at the foot of the Himalayas. The temple is said to be constructed around a cave where Hidimbi Devi used to meditate. The Goddess Hidimbi Devi is a highly revered deity in Manali. Later in the day, leave for Chandigarh. In the afternoon, have your lunch and enjoy a boat ride on Sukhna Lake. Spend the night at your hotel in Chandigarh.

itinerary.title: Rock Garden of Chandigarh - Pinjore Gardens - Rose Garden - Delhi
itinerary.description: This day will be dedicated to visiting some of the most famous tourist sites in Chandigarh. The first place will be the Rock Garden of Chandigarh, a sculpture garden that also goes by the name of Nek Chand Saini's Rock Garden of Nathupur because the garden's founder was named Nek Chand Saini. Visit Pinjore Gardens and Rose Garden before leaving for Delhi after having your lunch. Check-in to your hotel in Delhi and enjoy a relaxing night.

itinerary.title: Depart Delhi - Coimbatore
itinerary.description: In the morning, have your breakfast and engage in some retail therapy before leaving for Delhi Airport to board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Delhi
itinerary.description: After you arrive in Delhi, our tour representatives will greet you and help you get to your hotel. Once you complete the check-in formalities, you can go around Delhi and enjoy some retail therapy. Get back to your hotel to spend the night.

itinerary.title: Delhi - Manali
itinerary.description: Relish a delicious breakfast and then head out to explore some of the most famous sightseeing spots in Delhi. Visit the Lotus Temple, Birla Mandir, Raj Ghat, Indira Gandhi Memorial Museum, and India Gate. Later in the day, go shopping at Karol Bagh. In the evening, leave for Manali.

itinerary.title: Manali - Shri Vashishtha Temple - Hadimba Devi Temple
itinerary.description: Upon reaching Manali, check-in to your hotel and relax for a while. Head over to the Vashisht Temple, which is known for its sulphurous hot water springs. Wrap up the day by visiting the Hadimba Devi Temple, a Hindu temple dedicated to Hidimbi Devi. Return to your hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: Rohtang Pass
itinerary.description: Today, you will be driven to Rohtang Pass, which is an iconic high mountain pass that stands at an altitude of 3,980 metres. It serves as a connecting point between the Lahaul and Spiti Valleys and the Kullu Valley. In the evening, drive back to Manali.

itinerary.title: Manali - Kullu - Delhi
itinerary.description: In the morning, make your way from Manali to Delhi. On the way, lay your eyes on the Beas River, Sutlej River, and Kullu Valley. Stop by a shawl factory at Kullu, after which you can continue your journey to Delhi post your lunch.

itinerary.title: Depart Delhi
itinerary.description: After reaching Delhi, you can relax for a while and then pay your respects at the Akshardham Temple. Enjoy a round of shopping before leaving for the Delhi Railway Station to return to your hometown.

itinerary.title: Arriving At Delhi
itinerary.description: When you arrive at the Delhi Indira Gandhi International Airport, our tour manager will greet you and help you check into your hotel. After a quick break, you will head out for a brief sightseeing tour, including attractions like the India Gate and Parliament House. Enjoy the rest of the day in Karol Bagh shopping for footwear, accessories, and home décor items, and end the day with sumptuous street food.

itinerary.title: Delhi – Amritsar
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head out to continue with your sightseeing. You will visit iconic attractions like the Indira Gandhi Memorial, Birla Mandir, Lotus Temple, and Raj Ghat. Later in the evening, proceed to Amritsar for an overnight journey.

itinerary.title: Amritsar
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at Amritsar, check in to your hotel and get some much-needed rest. After a short break, get ready for a city tour. We will cover top attractions, including the Golden Temple and Jallianwala Bagh. You will also visit the Indo-Pak border in Wagah. Spend the night at a comfortable hotel in Amritsar.

itinerary.title: Amritsar – Kulu Manali
itinerary.description: After a delicious breakfast, check out of the hotel and head to Manali. On the way, you will pass through the Beas and Sutlej rivers. Don’t miss the views on Kulu Valley and the shawl factory in Kulu. Reach Manali in the evening. Spend the night at a comfortable hotel in Manali.

itinerary.title: Manali – Rohtang Pass – Manali
itinerary.description: After a sumptuous breakfast, head out to Rohtang Pass. The 2-hour drive is famous for its beautiful landscapes, including lush green hills and beautiful glaciers. Drive back to Manali in the evening. Spend the night at a hotel in Manali.

itinerary.title: Manali – Chandigarh
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel and head out for a sightseeing tour of Manali. You will visit the Vashishta Temple, Hidimba Temple, and Bhrigu Lake. Then, head to Chandigarh to continue with the next leg of your journey. Enjoy a boat ride in Sukhna Lake and some retail therapy at Palika Bazaar and Patel Market, shopping for accessories, apparel, and handicrafts. Spend the night in Chandigarh.

itinerary.title: Chandigarh – Delhi
itinerary.description: Start your day with a morning breakfast and continue with your sightseeing. You will visit the Rock Garden, Pinjore Garden, and Rose Garden. After lunch, head out to Delhi and spend the night at a comfortable hotel in the city.

itinerary.title: Delhi
itinerary.description: After a morning breakfast, head out to catch your return train to Chennai.

itinerary.title: Delhi – Chennai
itinerary.description: Continue with your train journey, enjoying the company of friends.

itinerary.title: Chennai
itinerary.description: Arrive in Chennai with unforgettable memories of your tour.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Agra - Taj Mahal
itinerary.description: After you arrive in Agra, our tour representatives will greet you and help you get to your hotel. Once you complete the check-in formalities, relax for a while before heading out. Witness the magic of the Taj Mahal, one of the Seven Wonders of the World. Return to your hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: Agra – Jaipur - Albert Hall Museum - Hawa Mahal - Jantar Mantar - City Palace - Water Palace
itinerary.description: Enjoy a delicious breakfast in the morning and then leave for Jaipur. Once you reach the Pink City, you will get to visit its major sightseeing spots. Start with the Albert Hall Museum, which is the oldest museum in the state of Rajasthan. Move to Hawa Mahal, a gorgeous palace built using red and pink sandstone, and then to Jantar Mantar, a UNESCO World Heritage Site which has the largest stone sundial in the world. Wrap up the day by visiting the City Palace and Water Palace. Spend the night at your hotel in Jaipur.

itinerary.title: Jaipur - Delhi
itinerary.description: In the morning, have your breakfast and leave for Delhi. On the way, stop to visit the Amer Palace Fort, which was constructed with red sandstone and marble. Relax at your hotel in Delhi and get a good night’s sleep.

itinerary.title: Delhi - Birla Mandir - Lotus Temple - Raj Ghat - Indira Gandhi Memorial
itinerary.description: On this day, you will be going around the city of Delhi and taking in all the touristy sights it has to offer. The first stop will be Birla Mandir, which also goes by the name of Shri Laxmi Narayan Temple, and was the first Hindu temple to be built in Delhi. Next up is the Lotus Temple, which derives its name from the lotus-like shape of the temple. Go to Raj Ghat, a memorial complex where Mahatma Gandhi was cremated after his assassination in 1948. Finish the day by visiting the Indira Gandhi Memorial, which was once the place of residence of Indira Gandhi.

itinerary.title: Delhi - Akshardham Temple - India Gate
itinerary.description: Once you get done with your breakfast, proceed to offer your prayers at the Akshardham Temple, a Hindu temple situated in a complex filled with lush green gardens, lawns, and exquisite bronze statues. End the day by going to India Gate, a war memorial that was built to honour the brave soldiers who sacrificed their lives for the country.

itinerary.title: Depart Delhi
itinerary.description: After relishing a scrumptious breakfast at your hotel, you can go shopping at Karol Bagh. A bit later in the day, get to the Delhi Railway Station to return to your hometown.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Cairo
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Cairo International Airport, our tour representatives will greet you and help you get to your hotel. Once the check-in formalities are done, you can rest and relax. Catch the sound and light show in the evening and spend the night at your hotel.

itinerary.title: Cairo City Tour
itinerary.description: After having breakfast, you will be taken to witness the Pyramids of Giza, which are the only one of the seven wonders of the ancient world that have stood the test of time. Post having your lunch, experience Saqqara which is home to the oldest pyramid in the nation, the Step Pyramid of Djoser. You will also be taken to the ancient city of Memphis. The rest of your day will be occupied with going to the Papyrus Institute, shopping at bazaars, and enjoying camel and horse rides. Get back to your hotel to spend the night.

itinerary.title: Egyptian Museum - Khan el-Khalili - St. Mark's Coptic Orthodox Church
itinerary.description: Start the day by visiting the Egyptian Museum, which is reputed to be the oldest archaeological museum in the Middle East. Home to more than 170,000 artefacts, it has the most extensive collection of Pharaonic antiquities. You will then be taken to the Citadel of Cairo, which served as the Egyptian government’s seat and the residence of the country’s rulers for almost 700 years. Take a stroll around the iconic market known as Khan el-Khalili to shop for handicrafts, spices, and souvenirs. Enjoy the peaceful ambience at the St. Mark's Coptic Orthodox Church before heading back to your hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: Cairo - Alexandria - Cairo
itinerary.description: Once you’re done with breakfast, you will be leaving for the city of Alexandria, which is Egypt’s second-largest city. Witness Pompey's Pillar, which is a single column present on a rocky hilltop and was built to honour the Roman emperor, Diocletian. Go back in time at the catacombs of Kom El Shoqafa, which are Egypt’s largest-known Roman burial site. After going to the Citadel of Qaitbay, it will be time to witness one of the most vital libraries of the ancient world, the Great Library of Alexandria. Get back to Cairo and spend the night at your hotel.

itinerary.title: Depart Cairo
itinerary.description: Leave for the airport after eating your breakfast to board your flight back home.
