Witness Awesomeness of Down Under Duo in 7 Days | Itinerary

itinerary.title: Arrival in Melbourne
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Melbourne Tullamarine Airport, proceed to your hotel for check-in. Please note that there may be an additional private surcharge for late-night arrivals. Early check-in is not guaranteed. The remainder of the day is at your leisure, allowing you to unwind and explore the city. Spend the night at your Melbourne hotel.

itinerary.title: Melbourne – Half-Day City Exploration
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a delicious breakfast. In the morning, embark on a half-day Melbourne City Tour with scheduled hotel pickups between 7:00 AM and 7:50 AM. Please note that this tour is both complementary and non-refundable. Your tour will conclude at Federation Square around 11:45 AM. Afterward, make your way to MG Gate #3, located between light towers 1 and 2, to participate in a guided one-hour tour of the iconic Melbourne Cricket Ground (MG). These tours are available between 10:00 AM and 3:00 PM on non-event dates. Alternatively, you can choose to explore the Southgate Art & Leisure Precinct and join a one-hour Melbourne Yarra River Cruise, with the last departure around 3:00 pm to 3:30 pm. Once you've completed your chosen activity, return to your hotel at your own pace. Another comfortable night awaits you at your Melbourne accommodation.

itinerary.title: Melbourne – Your Choice of a Full Day Adventure
itinerary.description: Today, you have the delightful privilege of selecting one full-day Small Group (SIC) tour from a tantalising array of options. These splendid journeys promise unforgettable experiences, leaving you with cherished memories of Melbourne. Option 1: Morning Full Day Great Ocean Road Tour Departure at 8 am for a day of awe and wonder along the Great Ocean Road. Immerse yourself in the breathtaking beauty of nature as you explore this coastal marvel. Your return is expected after 8 pm. Please note that this tour is compulsory and non-refundable. Option 2: Afternoon Full Day Phillip Island Expedition Commencing from Federation Square at 1 pm, the Phillip Island tour offers encounters with penguins, kangaroos, and koalas. An enchanting experience awaits, and you'll return after 9.30 pm. Do remember that this tour is compulsory and non-refundable. Option 3: Morning Full Day Sovereign Hill Gold Rush Journey (Mon, Tue, Thu & Sat) Embark on a journey back in time to the gold rush era. Departure is at 8 am, available on select days only. Your return is scheduled by 5.30 pm. Please be aware that this tour is compulsory and non-refundable. Option 4: Morning Full Day Puffing Billy Steam Train and Yarra Valley Wineries (Mon, Wed, Fri & Sun) At 8 am, step aboard the iconic Puffing Billy Steam Train and explore the renowned Yarra Valley wineries, including Dominique Potter and Rockford. This tour is available on specific days only and is compulsory and non-refundable. Option 5: Morning Full Day Puffing Billy Steam Train, Dandenong Ranges & Asheville Wildlife Tour (Mon, Wed, Fri & Sun) Start your trip on a delightful adventure departing at 8 am to explore the Puffing Billy Steam Train, Dandenong Ranges, and the fascinating Asheville Wildlife. Please note that this tour is available on specific days only and is compulsory and non-refundable. After your chosen adventure, retire to your comfortable hotel room in Melbourne for a relaxing evening. Overnight stay at the hotel in Melbourne.

itinerary.title: Melbourne to Sydney
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a delicious breakfast. In the morning, complete your check-out from the hotel and make your way to Melbourne Tullamarine Airport using a SIC Transfer for flights scheduled before 9pm. Upon arrival at Sydney Airport, transfer to your hotel for the check-in process. Your overnight stay will be at the hotel in Sydney.

itinerary.title: Sydney Half-Day City Tour
itinerary.description: Embark on a captivating morning Half-Day SIC Sydney City Tour that provides stunning views of the Opera House and Harbour Bridge. This tour also includes a visit to Manly Beach, among other attractions. It's important to note that this tour is complementary and non-refundable, with limited hotel pickup and no hotel drop-off. The tour concludes around 11.45 am near Darling Harbour or Circular Quay. Upon concluding the tour, make your way to the nearest point to King Street Wharf, Darling Harbour. Later in the day, head to Sea Life Aquarium at Darling Harbour to redeem your Combo 2 Pass voucher for admissions to Sea Life Aquarium and Sydney Tower Eye with a 4D Experience (please note that transfers to the aquarium and tower are not included). In the evening, you can independently journey to King Street Wharf #5, Darling Harbour, between 6.50pm - 7pm, to join the Sydney ShowBoat cruise. This cruise includes an Indian vegetarian dinner and standard seating, but please be aware that transfers are not provided. Enjoy your overnight stay at the hotel in Sydney.

itinerary.title: Sydney - A Day of Full Tour Splendour
itinerary.description: We commence the day with a delightful breakfast. The pinnacle of the day awaits as you select one Full Day SIC Tour from the exquisite options listed below. Note that there are only nine designated pickup points, so be punctual and attentive to your hotel's location. Option 1: Full Day SIC Blue Mountains Tour, accompanied by a Wildlife Park visit and the thrill of Scenic Rides at Scenic World. The adventure begins at 8 am daily, returning by 6 pm. Please be aware that hotel pickup is limited and compulsory, with no refund available. Option 2: Alternatively, you can opt for the Full Day SIC Blue Mountains Tour, which includes not only the Wildlife Park experience but also a delightful lunch and the exhilarating Scenic Rides. The tour embarks at 8 am hours daily, concluding by 6pm. Like the first option, this choice has limited hotel pickup and is also compulsory and non-refundable. You'll spend the night at your Sydney hotel, savouring the memories of the day's adventures.

itinerary.title: Farewell to Sydney
itinerary.description: The morning begins with a scrumptious breakfast. It's time to bid adieu to your comfortable abode. Check out of your hotel and journey to Sydney Airport, where you'll catch your next flight or return to your hometown. The treasure trove of unforgettable memories from your time in Sydney will undoubtedly last a lifetime. Please note that this transfer service is valid for domestic flights departing after 7 am and international flights departing after 8:30 am. For earlier departures, a supplementary charge for private transfers will apply. Safe travels!

packages.name: Exotic Thailand Itinerary for 9 Days
packages.destination: Krabi - Phuket - Phi Phi Island - Bangkok - Pattaya - Coral Island

itinerary.title: Welcome to Krabi
itinerary.description: As you land at Krabi International Airport, our friendly team will be there to greet you and whisk you away to your hotel in Krabi. Take a moment to settle in as you check into the hotel. Get ready to immerse yourself in the stunning beauty of Thailand's coastline – a true tropical paradise. Bask in the warmth of the sun, embrace the soothing sea breeze, and break free from your everyday routine. Krabi's coastline is adorned with unique limestone formations that create breathtaking silhouettes, stretching far into the Andaman Sea. The remainder of the day is yours to enjoy at your leisure. Relax and unwind at the hotel in Krabi, as you prepare for the adventures that await you in the coming days.

itinerary.title: Krabi – Four Island Adventure
itinerary.description: Embark on an exhilarating island-hopping escapade today as we explore the enchanting Four Islands by speedboat. Glide through the turquoise waters of the Krabi Sea, discovering tropical havens that promise an unforgettable experience. Our journey unfolds with visits to Tub Island, Chicken Island, Poda Island, and the captivating Pranang Cave. Dive into the vibrant activities of swimming, snorkelling, sunbathing, exploration, and photography, immersing yourself in the beauty of these paradisiacal locations. Bask in the abundant sunshine, witness a diverse array of coral and marine life, and feel the velvety touch of white powdery sands beneath swaying coconut palms. As the day unfolds, capture moments that will linger in your memory. Return to the hotel as the sun sets, carrying the day's cherished memories with you. Nestle into the comforts of your Krabi accommodation for a peaceful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Krabi to Phuket (Approximately 158 Kms / 2 hrs 30 mins)
itinerary.description: Embark on a scenic drive to the enchanting island of Phuket. Upon reaching Phuket, settle into your hotel and immerse yourself in the allure of this Andaman Sea gem, a sought-after tropical beach haven. The remainder of the day is yours to enjoy at your own pace. Relax and unwind in the picturesque surroundings of Phuket. Spend the night in comfort at your Phuket hotel. Optional Excursion: Phuket FantaSea Show – No Dinner (Additional Cost Applies) For those seeking an extra touch of magic, consider the Phuket FantaSea Show, an exquisite Thai cultural spectacle reminiscent of Las Vegas extravagance. This captivating show encapsulates the essence of Thai spirit, portraying elements such as love for freedom, courage, and compassion in each mesmerizing scene. Hosted in the grand Palace of the Elephants Theater, this family-friendly performance weaves together traditional Thai dance, music, and costumes with vivid special effects, enchanting illusions, pyrotechnics, and even dancing elephants. Hundreds of talented cast members come together to bring this mythical story, titled "Fantasy of a Kingdom," to life. (Note: Additional cost for the show applies.)

itinerary.title: Explore Phi Phi Island from Phuket
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a delightful breakfast. Today, you will set off on a ferry for an enchanting Phi Phi Island tour. Immerse yourself in the allure of pristine white beaches, framed by majestic limestone cliffs and bathed in the radiant glow of crystal-clear waters. As the afternoon unfolds, make your way back to Phuket. Spend the night at your hotel in Phuket, relishing the memories of a day well-spent in this tropical paradise.

itinerary.title: Phuket - Bangkok – Pattaya (Approximately 149 kilometres / 2 hours 30 minutes)
itinerary.description: Begin your day by heading to Phuket International Airport to catch a flight to Bangkok. Upon your arrival at Bangkok International Airport, you'll be warmly welcomed and transported to your hotel in Pattaya. Check-in and take some time to relax. The remainder of the day is yours to enjoy at your leisure. Spend a comfortable night at the hotel in Pattaya.

itinerary.title: Pattaya – Coral Island
itinerary.description: Today you will go on an exciting adventure as you travel by speedboat to the picturesque Coral Island, the largest in Pattaya's archipelago. Marvel at the stunning array of sea treasures and coral formations from the comfort of a traditional glass-bottomed boat. For those seeking a thrill, there's the option to indulge in activities such as parasailing, water skiing, and other water sports. The rest of the evening is free for you to unwind. Retreat to your hotel in Pattaya for a relaxing overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Pattaya to Bangkok (Approx. 149 Km / 2 hrs 30 mins)
itinerary.description: On this day, you will set off on a scenic drive to Bangkok, covering approximately 149 kilometres in about 2 hours and 30 minutes. Upon reaching Bangkok, check in to your hotel and unwind. The remainder of the day is yours to enjoy at your leisure. Spend a relaxing night at the hotel. Optional Activity: Chao Phraya River Cruise Dinner (Additional Cost) In the evening, consider treating yourself to an enchanting Chao Phraya River Cruise with Dinner, featuring dance performances and live music (available at an additional cost). Delight in a buffet-style dinner while taking in the picturesque riverside views. Admire historic temples and landmarks on both sides of the river as a live band and talented singers provide entertainment throughout the cruise, making it an unforgettable experience.

itinerary.title: Exploring the Heart of Bangkok
itinerary.description: Start on an interesting temple and city tour, immersing yourself in the rich cultural tapestry of Bangkok. The focal point of this expedition is the awe-inspiring Golden Buddha temple, housing an ancient golden Buddha. This seated masterpiece, standing at an impressive 3 metres and weighing a staggering five and a half tons, traces its origins back to the Sukhothai Period. As you wander through the vibrant streets, make your way to Chinatown, where a colossal gold-plated Reclining Buddha awaits. Stretching an impressive 46 metres in length and soaring 15 metres in height, this iconic idol features exquisite inlaid mother of pearl soles, adding a touch of artistic brilliance. The remainder of the evening is yours to unwind or indulge in some delightful shopping experiences. Retreat to the comfort of your hotel for a restful night. Optional Excursion: Dive into the Depths of Sea Life Bangkok Ocean World & Encounter Celebrities at Madame Tussauds For those seeking extra adventures, consider an optional tour to Sea Life Bangkok Ocean World, formerly known as Siam Ocean World. Uncover the wonders of one of Southeast Asia's largest aquariums, featuring themed areas. Take a stroll along the innovative Shark Walk, providing a unique perspective as you traverse above a tank inhabited by five different shark species. Alternatively, immerse yourself in the world of celebrities at Madame Tussauds Bangkok, a renowned wax museum. Rub shoulders with global icons, heads of state, activists, sports legends, artists, and even royalty. This optional excursion promises entertainment and a chance to mingle with the stars, all available at an additional cost.

itinerary.title: Farewell to Bangkok
itinerary.description: As the sun rises on your final day in Bangkok, prepare to bid the vibrant city farewell. After a morning of unforgettable experiences, you will be chauffeured to Bangkok International Airport for your journey home or onwards to your next destination.

packages.name: Spectacular Thailand: Phuket, Phi Phi Island, Bangkok | Itinerary

images.alt_text: Spectacular Thailand: Phuket, Phi Phi Island, Bangkok | Itinerary
Spectacular Thailand: Phuket, Phi Phi Island, Bangkok | Itinerary

itinerary.title: Welcome to Phuket
itinerary.description: As you land at the vibrant Phuket International Airport, a warm greeting awaits you. Your journey begins with a seamless transfer to your chosen hotel in the heart of Phuket. Immerse yourself in the check-in process, settling into a haven that rests along the stunning Andaman Sea-a true gem and a beloved tropical beach resort. The remainder of the day is yours to embrace at your own pace. Feel the inviting embrace of the sun-soaked beaches or explore the local charm that Phuket has to offer. Your overnight stay at the hotel promises comfort and tranquillity. For those seeking a touch of spectacle, an optional adventure awaits. Consider the mesmerising Phuket FantaSea Show-an enchanting display of Thai culture with a Las Vegas flair. Hosted in the grand Palace of the Elephants Theater, this family-friendly performance weaves together traditional Thai dance, captivating music, and vibrant costumes. Brace yourself for a mythical journey enriched with special effects, magical illusions, pyrotechnics, and the graceful presence of dancing elephants. (Optional Tour: Phuket FantaSea Show – No Dinner, available at an additional cost). Set off on this delightful journey into the heart of Phuket, where each moment unfolds like a beautifully crafted story.

itinerary.title: Phuket - Phi Phi Island Excursion
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delightful breakfast, followed by an exciting adventure to Phi Phi Island. Board a ferry and embark on a journey to this stunning destination, where classic white beaches meet impressive limestone cliffs, and crystal-clear waters sparkle in the sunlight. Spend the day basking in the beauty of your surroundings. In the late afternoon, return to Phuket and unwind at your hotel. Enjoy a comfortable overnight stay in Phuket.

itinerary.title: Phuket - Bangkok
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head to Phuket International Airport to catch your flight to Bangkok. Upon arrival at Bangkok International Airport, you will be warmly welcomed and transferred to your hotel in the city. Check in and spend the rest of the day at your leisure. Overnight stay at the hotel. (Optional: Chao Phraya River Cruise Dinner at an additional cost) In the evening, consider treating yourself to a magical experience with the Chao Phraya River Cruise Dinner. Glide along the Chao Phraya River, indulging in a sumptuous buffet dinner while enjoying live music and dance performances. Marvel at the historic temples and landmarks lining the riverbanks as you create lasting memories on this beautiful cruise.

itinerary.title: Exploring Bangkok – City Tour
itinerary.description: Kickstart the day with a splendid breakfast. Today you will delve into the heart of Bangkok for a captivating temple and city tour. The crowning jewel of our expedition is the visit to the Golden Buddha temple, housing an ancient gold Buddha. This seated masterpiece, standing at an impressive 3 metres tall and weighing a remarkable five and a half tons, dates back to the Sukhothai Period. Our exploration continues to the Marble Temple (Wat Benchamabophit), an epitome of contemporary Thai religious architecture. Renowned for its main chapel constructed from exquisite white Carara Italian marble, this temple proudly displays a replica of Thailand's most beautiful Buddha image. The overnight stay at the hotel in Bangkok promises a tranquil end to an enriching day. Optional: Immerse in Aquatic Wonders & Celebrity Encounters (Additional Cost) For those seeking extra thrills, consider a visit to Sea Life Bangkok Ocean World, formerly known as Siam Ocean World, Southeast Asia's biggest aquarium. Highlights include the innovative Shark Walk, where visitors stroll above a tank inhabited by five species of sharks, providing a unique perspective. Alternatively, delve into the enchanting world of Madame Tussauds Bangkok, a wax museum that promises entertainment and encounters with lifelike figures of world celebrities, heads of state, activists, sports icons, legendary artists, and even royalty.

itinerary.title: Departing Bangkok
itinerary.description: As the sun rises on a new day, relish a leisurely breakfast before bidding adieu to the vibrant city of Bangkok. A transfer awaits to escort you to Bangkok International Airport, where you will board your flight back home or to your next exciting destination.

packages.destination: Krabi - Phuket - Phi Phi Island - Bangkok

itinerary.title: Welcome to Krabi!
itinerary.description: As you get off the plane at Krabi International Airport, our friendly team will be there to greet you and take you to your hotel in Krabi. Check-in and settle into your comfortable accommodation. Immerse yourself in the stunning beauty of Thailand's coastline, known for its exceptional charm. Take in the sunshine, feel the sea breeze, and break away from your daily routine. Krabi's coastline boasts unique limestone formations that create breathtaking silhouettes, extending into the captivating Andaman Sea. The rest of the day is yours to enjoy at your own pace. Relax and unwind in the enchanting atmosphere of Krabi. Spend a peaceful night at the hotel, embracing the tranquillity of this coastal paradise.

itinerary.title: Krabi – Four Island Adventure
itinerary.description: Kick off the day with a delightful breakfast. Today promises an exhilarating island-hopping escapade to the Four Islands via a speedy boat. Get ready for a thrilling journey to the tropical gems nestled in the Krabi Sea. Explore Tub Island, Chicken Island, Poda Island, and the enchanting Pranang Cave. Dive into a day filled with activities like swimming, snorkelling, sunbathing, exploration, and capturing breathtaking moments through photography. Anticipate abundant sunshine, a diverse array of coral and fish, pristine crystalline waters, and sandy beaches adorned with picturesque coconut palms. As the day unfolds, return to your hotel to unwind. Enjoy a restful overnight stay in Krabi.

itinerary.title: Krabi to Phuket (Approximately 158 Kms / 2 hrs 30 mins)
itinerary.description: Start the day with a scenic drive to the enchanting destination of Phuket. Upon arrival, settle into your hotel in this gem of the Andaman Sea, renowned for its pristine beaches and tropical allure. The remainder of the day is yours to enjoy at your leisure. Overnight stay at the delightful Phuket hotel. Optional Activity: Phuket FantaSea Show – No Dinner (Additional Cost Applies) Consider adding a touch of magic to your evening with the Phuket FantaSea Show, a captivating display reminiscent of Las Vegas-style entertainment infused with Thai cultural richness. Held at the majestic Palace of the Elephants Theater, this family-friendly performance weaves a mythical tale through traditional Thai dance, music, and costumes. Be spellbound by the vibrant special effects, magical illusions, pyrotechnics, and even dancing elephants, all portraying the essence of Thai life, from freedom and fun to courage and compassion. An extraordinary showcase featuring hundreds of talented cast members awaits.

itinerary.title: Explore the Wonders of Phi Phi Island from Phuket
itinerary.description: Start the day with a thrilling adventure as you set off for a day tour to Phi Phi Island by ferry. Immerse yourself in the charm of classic white beaches, embraced by stunning limestone cliffs and bathed in the glow of clear waters. Let the day unfold with the beauty of nature surrounding you. In the afternoon, return to Phuket and unwind at your hotel for a peaceful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Phuket to Bangkok - Gateway to Urban Excitement
itinerary.description: Say goodbye to the serene vibes of Phuket as you head to Phuket International Airport for your flight to Bangkok. Upon landing at Bangkok International Airport, you'll be greeted and smoothly transferred to your hotel in the heart of Bangkok. Check in, and the remainder of the day is yours to enjoy at your own pace. Relax and soak in the vibrant atmosphere of the city. Spend a comfortable night at your Bangkok hotel. Optional Evening Excursion: Chao Phraya River Cruise Dinner (Additional Cost) For an enchanting evening experience, consider the optional Chao Phraya River Cruise Dinner. Cruise along the majestic Chao Phraya River, indulging in a delightful dinner buffet. As you dine, enjoy the unfolding scenery of historic temples and landmarks on both sides of the river. Let a live band and talented singers entertain you with a captivating performance, making this dinner cruise a truly memorable experience. (Additional cost applies.)

itinerary.title: Explore Bangkok's Rich Heritage
itinerary.description: Get ready for a captivating city tour today, delving into the cultural wonders of Bangkok. The highlight of your day will be a visit to the Golden Buddha temple, where an ancient gold Buddha resides. This seated marvel, standing at an impressive 3 metres tall and weighing five and a half tons, dates back to the Sukhothai Period. Continue your exploration with a visit to the colossal gold-plated Reclining Buddha in Chinatown. Stretching 46 metres in length and towering 15 metres high, this awe-inspiring idol features exquisite inlaid mother of pearl soles. As the day unfolds, the evening is yours to unwind or indulge in some delightful shopping experiences. Your overnight stay at the hotel in Bangkok promises a serene end to a day filled with cultural treasures. Optional Tour: Dive into the Wonders of Sea Life Bangkok Ocean World & Madame Tussauds (Additional Cost) For those seeking extra excitement, consider an optional tour to Sea Life Bangkok Ocean World, Southeast Asia's premier aquarium. Immerse yourself in various themed areas, including the unique Shark Walk, where you walk above a tank filled with five species of majestic sharks. Alternatively, visit Madame Tussauds Bangkok, a renowned wax museum that offers an entertaining experience. Rub shoulders with wax replicas of world celebrities, heads of state, activists, sports heroes, legendary artists, and even royalty.

itinerary.title: Farewell Bangkok
itinerary.description: After a delightful breakfast, it's time to bid farewell to the vibrant city of Bangkok. You will be smoothly transferred to Bangkok International Airport for your journey back home or to your next exciting destination.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Pattaya – Alcazar Cabaret Show
itinerary.description: Welcome to Bangkok International Airport! Upon your arrival, our friendly team will greet you and escort you to your hotel in the vibrant city of Pattaya. After checking in, get ready for a dazzling evening at the renowned Alcazar Cabaret Show. Widely celebrated as Thailand's premier transvestite cabaret, Alcazar has earned global acclaim for its spectacular performances. The show has continually evolved, incorporating innovative stage technology to delight our cherished guests. Enjoy a mesmerising night and rest comfortably at your Pattaya hotel.

itinerary.title: Pattaya – Coral Island
itinerary.description: Embark on a delightful adventure today as you cruise to the picturesque Coral Island, the grandest among Pattaya's collection of islands. Glide through the azure waters in a speedy boat, marvelling at the breathtaking underwater world through the transparent floor of a classic glass-bottomed boat. Witness an enchanting showcase of sea treasures and vibrant coral formations. Feel the thrill as you take on water activities like Para Sailing, water skiing, and other exciting water sports at your leisure. As the day unfolds, immerse yourself in the beauty of the island before heading back to the cosy comforts of your Pattaya hotel. Overnight stay awaits with memories of an exhilarating day.

itinerary.title: Pattaya - Nong Nooch Village
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a delightful breakfast before starting on a journey to Nong Nooch Village. This enchanting destination resembles more of a theme park, boasting daily cultural spectacles, charming restaurants, comfortable accommodations, and vast expanses adorned with uniquely themed gardens. The focal point of Nong Nooch Garden is its botanical park, complemented by captivating daily shows at the Thai Cultural Hall. Immerse yourself in the beauty and diversity of this place. Retreat to your hotel in Pattaya for a restful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Pattaya – Bangkok – City Exploration
itinerary.description: Bid farewell to your Pattaya abode as you set forth on a scenic drive to Bangkok. Dive into a mesmerising city and temple tour, highlighted by a visit to the Golden Buddha temple. Marvel at the ancient golden Buddha, a seated figure standing at an impressive 3 metres and weighing five and a half tons, dating back to the Sukhothai Period. Next on your itinerary is the Marble Temple (Wat Benchamabophit), a contemporary masterpiece of Thai religious architecture. Renowned for its main chapel constructed from exquisite Carara Italian marble, the temple houses a replica of Thailand's most exquisite Buddha image. Check into your hotel in Bangkok for a restful overnight stay. Optional Tour: Chao Phraya River Cruise Dinner (Additional Cost) In the evening, consider enhancing your experience with the optional Chao Phraya River Cruise Dinner. Glide along the Chao Phraya River, taking in the breathtaking riverside panorama. As you savour a buffet-style dinner, historical temples and landmarks unfold on either side. Delight in live music and dance performances by a professional ensemble, making this dinner cruise a truly memorable experience. (Additional cost applies)

itinerary.title: Exploring Bangkok's Wildlife Wonders
itinerary.description: Kick off the day with a delightful breakfast and get ready for an exciting adventure at Safari World and Marine Park. Dive into the enchanting world of Bangkok Safari, where you'll encounter rare and endangered species up close. The park is divided into two main attractions: Safari Park and Marine Park. Safari Park: Immerse yourself in the closest encounters with the majestic inhabitants of the animal kingdom. Don't miss the awe-inspiring feeding show featuring lions and tigers, a spectacle that stands out as a one-of-a-kind experience worldwide. Marine Park: Enter a realm filled with aquatic wonders, including dolphins, seals, and more. Be captivated by shows featuring talented birds, dolphins, seals, and apes, showcasing their intelligence and skills. As the day winds down, you'll have the evening free to unwind at your leisure. Spend a relaxing night at your hotel in Bangkok.

itinerary.title: Farewell to Bangkok
itinerary.description: After a satisfying breakfast, it's time to bid adieu to the vibrant city of Bangkok. You will be transferred to Bangkok International Airport for your journey back home or to your next exciting destination.

packages.name: Glimpse of Thailand for 5 Days | Itinerary

images.alt_text: Glimpse of Thailand for 5 Days | Itinerary
Glimpse of Thailand for 5 Days | Itinerary

itinerary.title: Welcome to Krabi
itinerary.description: Upon landing at Bangkok International Airport, catch a flight to Krabi International Airport. Check in to your hotel and immerse yourself in the allure of Thailand's stunning coastline. Take in the sunshine, the sea, and a refreshing break from your daily grind. The coastline is adorned with unique limestone formations, creating captivating silhouettes that stretch out into the Andaman Sea. The remainder of the day is yours to enjoy at your own pace. Spend the night at your hotel in Krabi.

itinerary.title: Krabi – Four Island Adventure
itinerary.description: Embark on a thrilling island-hopping escapade to the fabulous four islands with a speedy boat ride today. Traverse the enchanting hotspots nestled in the vibrant Krabi Sea, featuring Tub Island, Chicken Island, Poda Island, and the mesmerising Pranang Cave. Engage in a day filled with swimming, snorkelling, sunbathing, exploration, and capturing picturesque moments through your lens. Immerse yourself in the warm glow of the sun, surrounded by a diverse array of coral and vibrant marine life in the crystal-clear waters. The soft, powdery white sand beaches adorned with exotic coconut palms complete this tropical paradise. As the day winds down, return to the comfort of your hotel in Krabi for a well-deserved rest. Overnight in Krabi, anticipating more delightful adventures to come.

itinerary.title: Krabi to Bangkok
itinerary.description: This morning, after a delicious breakfast, you'll be whisked away to Krabi International Airport to catch your flight to Bangkok. Upon landing at Bangkok International Airport, a warm welcome awaits you, and you'll be smoothly transported to your hotel in the heart of Bangkok. Check in and settle into your accommodation. The remainder of the day is yours to enjoy at your own pace. Overnight at your Bangkok hotel. Optional Activity: Chao Phraya River Cruise Dinner (Additional Cost) In the evening, consider treating yourself to a delightful Chao Phraya River Cruise Dinner. This optional experience comes with a captivating mix of dinner, dance, and live music. As you cruise along the Chao Phraya River, soak in the enchanting views of historic temples and landmarks unfolding on both sides. Indulge in a buffet-style dinner, complemented by the melodies of a live band and talented singers, making it a night to remember. (Additional cost applies)

itinerary.title: Bangkok City Tour
itinerary.description: Today you will go on an enriching temple and city tour today. The highlight of this excursion is a visit to the Golden Buddha temple, housing an ancient golden Buddha. The seated statue, standing at an impressive 3 metres and weighing five and a half tons, dates back to the Sukhothai Period. Another captivating stop is at the colossal gold-plated Reclining Buddha in Chinatown. This remarkable idol stretches 46 metres in length and reaches a height of 15 metres, adorned with exquisite inlaid mother-of-pearl soles. The remainder of the evening is yours to unwind or indulge in some delightful shopping. Spend the night at the hotel in Bangkok. Optional Tour: Sea Life Bangkok Ocean World & Madame Tussauds (Additional Cost) For an extra adventure, consider a visit to Sea Life Bangkok Ocean World, formerly known as Siam Ocean World. It stands as one of South-east Asia’s largest aquariums, featuring diverse themed areas. Don't miss the innovative Shark Walk, offering a unique perspective as visitors stroll above a tank where five species of sharks gracefully swim. Madame Tussauds Bangkok, a renowned wax museum, awaits those seeking entertainment and a chance to mingle with wax figures of world celebrities, heads of state, activists, sports icons, legendary artists, and even royalty.

itinerary.title: Departure from Bangkok
itinerary.description: This morning, you will be transferred to Bangkok International Airport for your flight back home or to your next exciting destination.

packages.name: Indulge in the Treasures of Jordan | Itinerary
packages.destination: Amman - City Tour - Dead Sea - Petra - Amman

images.alt_text: Indulge in the Treasures of Jordan | Itinerary
Indulge in the Treasures of Jordan | Itinerary

itinerary.title: Welcome to Jordan - Arrival in Amman
itinerary.description: Welcome to the enchanting land of Jordan! You'll be warmly greeted by our representative at the airport. They will guide you through the visa formalities, making your arrival smooth and hassle-free. From there, you'll be taken to your hotel, where you can check in and settle in comfortably. The evening is yours to enjoy at your leisure. Rest peacefully overnight at your Amman hotel.

itinerary.title: Discovering Amman and the Dead Sea
itinerary.description: After a hearty breakfast, your day will kick off with a visit to the Citadel, Museum, Amphitheatre, and Folklore Museum. Take your time to soak in the rich history and culture at your own pace. Later, we'll go for a journey to the remarkable Dead Sea. Here, you'll have some free time to indulge in the therapeutic wonders of the world's lowest point on land. Whether it's floating effortlessly in the mineral-rich waters or covering yourself in the famous Dead Sea mud, you'll have the opportunity to experience this unique natural wonder. After your day of exploration, we'll return to your Amman hotel, where you can relax and take rest.

itinerary.title: Amman to Petra and Back
itinerary.description: After a hearty breakfast, you will go for an exciting journey from Amman to Petra, following a picturesque route through the desert. The destination is the remarkable rock-cut city of Petra, a UNESCO World Heritage site that is truly a testament to history's enduring beauty. Here, you'll have the opportunity to explore the wonders of Petra at your own pace. Take in the awe-inspiring sights and immerse yourself in the ancient charm of this remarkable place. Once your Petra adventure is complete, we'll pick you up from the Petra site and make your way back to Amman via the Desert Highway. You'll spend the night at a comfortable hotel in Amman.

itinerary.title: Farewell to Amman
itinerary.description: As a new day begins, savour a delicious breakfast before checking out of your hotel. We'll then proceed to Amman Airport, where it's time to bid farewell to this captivating destination. Take your cherished memories along with you as you go on your flight back home.

packages.name: Explore Jordan in Depth | Itinerary
packages.destination: Amman - Jerash - Madaba - Mt. Nebo - Shobak - Petra - Wadi Rum - Dead Sea

itinerary.title: Arrival in Amman, Jordan
itinerary.description: Welcome to Jordan! Your journey begins as you arrive at Amman Airport, where you'll be warmly greeted by our representative. They will be there to assist you with any visa formalities and guide you through the arrival process. From the airport, we'll take you to your hotel. After checking in, the rest of the evening is yours to enjoy at your own leisure. You'll spend the night at your comfortable Amman hotel.

itinerary.title: Exploring Amman and Jerash
itinerary.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast, and then get ready for a captivating exploration of the City Tour. You'll visit some of the city's highlights, including the Citadel, Museum, Amphitheatre, and Folklore Museum. Take your time to explore these sites at your own pace. Later in the day, you will go to Jerash, Jordan's largest Roman archaeological site, located just an hour's drive from Amman. Here, you'll have the freedom to enjoy the site at your own leisure. After a day of exploration, return to Amman, where you'll spend another comfortable night at your hotel.

itinerary.title: From Amman to Petra - A Journey Through History
itinerary.description: After a hearty breakfast, our adventure continues as we make our way south towards Petra. Along the way, we'll stop at some remarkable sites that hold a special place in Jordan's history. Our first destination is the Mount Nebo site, where you can enjoy stunning views (please note that the church is currently closed for renovation). Next, we'll visit Madaba and explore the Saint George Church, known for its intricate mosaics that depict the region's rich history. Our journey then takes us to the impressive Shobak Castle, a fortress that has witnessed centuries of stories and struggles. Then you will head further south to reach your destination - Petra. You'll be spending the night in a comfortable hotel in Petra.

itinerary.title: The Wonders of Petra
itinerary.description: Petra is an ancient Nabatean city and a UNESCO World Heritage Site famous for its rock-cut architecture. The city was considered lost (though the local Bedouin had long known about it) until Swiss explorer Johann Ludwig Burckhardt discovered it in 1812. Some of the attractions in Petra include Al-Siq, the famous entrance gate, and Al-Khazneh, a treasury believed to be the mausoleum of Nabatean King Aretas. Spend the night in Petra.

itinerary.title: Petra, Wadi Rum, and Amman
itinerary.description: After enjoying a hearty breakfast at the hotel, you will set off for an incredible journey to Amman. Along the way, you will visit Wadi Rum, a UNESCO World Heritage Site that covers diverse landscapes, including narrow gorges, natural arches, cliffs, and caverns. Wadi Rum boasts an awe-inspiring landscape. You’ll have the opportunity to experience it firsthand with an optional 4x4 tour through the breathtaking desert scenery. For those seeking an even more immersive experience, spending the night in a Bedouin camp is an option. Later in the day, you will make your way to the vibrant city of Amman, where you will spend the night in the comfort of a hotel.

itinerary.title: Amman and the Dead Sea
itinerary.description: Following a delicious breakfast at the hotel, you will set off on an excursion to the legendary Dead Sea. Here, you'll have ample free time to enjoy the remarkable and therapeutic waters of this unique Salt Lake. Nestled between Jordan on the east and Israel and the West Bank on the west, the Dead Sea is a geological wonder. Its surface and shores sit at an astonishing 430.5 metres below sea level, making it the lowest elevation on Earth's land. After a day of relaxation and rejuvenation at the Dead Sea, you will return to the hotel in Amman, where you can spend the rest of the day at your leisure.

itinerary.title: Farewell to Amman
itinerary.description: On the final day of your journey, you will savour a delectable breakfast at the hotel and bid farewell to Amman. With cherished memories in your hearts, check out of the hotel and make your way to Amman airport for the flight back home. World Heritage site, and it's a true testament to the ingenuity and craftsmanship of ancient civilizations. You can explore this archaeological wonder at your own pace. After your Petra adventure, we'll pick you up from the site, and then make the way back to Amman via the Desert Highway. You'll spend the night at a comfortable hotel in Petra.

packages.name: Singapore with Bali
packages.destination: Singapore - Sentosa Island - Bali - Kintamani - Tanjung Benoa

itinerary.title: Arrive at Singapore - Gardens by the Bay - Marina Bay Sands
itinerary.description: The flora and fauna here are as breathtaking as the futuristic architecture.

itinerary.title: Singapore Botanic Gardens - Singapore Zoo
itinerary.description: Immerse yourself in the beauty of nature at the Singapore Botanical Gardens, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Enjoy a guided tour of the lush green surroundings, and remember to pose for pictures. Take your children to see wildlife at the Singapore Zoo, which houses more than 4,200 animals, including African lions, white rhinos, cheetahs, giraffes, and zebras.

itinerary.title: Universal Studios
itinerary.description: Get ready for a thrilling experience at the only Universal Studios in Southeast Asia. All attractions at this theme park are based on movies and TV shows. The theme park is also filled with exciting rides and entertaining shows. If that doesn’t sound exciting, we don’t know what does.

itinerary.title: Arrive at Bali - Celuk Village - Mas Village
itinerary.description: Board your flight from Singapore to Bali. Your tour of the island includes a visit to Celuk, the Balinese village famous for its gold and silver craftsmanship. Later, you will head to Mas, a village known for its wood carving. You can shop for intricate statues, furniture, and traditional masks.

itinerary.title: Batubulan Village- Kintamani Volcano Safari – Ubud Central Market
itinerary.description: Your second day in Bali will begin by visiting the Batubulan Village, famous for its art exhibits. You can also witness a Barong and Kecak Dance performance at Batubulan. The next adventure is the Kintamani Volcano Safari, where you can come face-to-face with the breathtaking view of the hot black lava of Mount Batur and also see the rice terraces, coffee plantations, and ancient temples. End your day at the central market in Ubud to purchase souvenirs and knickknacks.

itinerary.title: Tanjung Benoa Beach
itinerary.description: How can you leave Bali without enjoying the calm and serene blue waters at its beaches? Head to Tanjung Benoa Beach to leisurely stroll and immerse yourself in sunbathing and beachy activities. To indulge in water sports, pick from the available options - parasailing, banana boat, and jet skiing. Pamper yourself in the afternoon with two hours of a rejuvenating spa treatment. Spend the night at your hotel.

itinerary.title: Depart from Bali
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight home.

packages.name: Amazing South Africa with Kenya: Your Ultimate Tour Package Adventure
packages.destination: Cape Town - Half Day City Tour - Full Day Cape Peninsular Tour - Johannesburg - Sun City - Day At Leisure - Victoria Falls, Zambia - Nairobi - Masai Mara

images.alt_text: Amazing South Africa with Kenya: Your Ultimate Tour Package Adventure
Amazing South Africa with Kenya: Your Ultimate Tour Package Adventure

itinerary.title: Arrival in Cape Town
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at Cape Town International Airport, our tour manager will greet you and assist with your transfer to the hotel. Complete check-in formalities and spend the rest of the day exploring the neighbourhood. Spend the night in Cape Town.

itinerary.title: Cape Town City Tour
itinerary.description: Today, we are on a half-day tour of Cape Town. The first stop on your itinerary is Table Mountain, where you will take the cable car to the summit for panoramic views of the city and the Atlantic Ocean. You will drive past the Castle of Good Hope, the Company Gardens, the Parliament Building, the City Hall, and the Slave Lodge. You will also visit the vibrant Malay Quarter and stop at a diamond-cutting factory. Your tour concludes at the Victoria & Alfred Waterfront, where you can enjoy some shopping before returning to your hotel. Spend the night in Cape Town.

itinerary.title: Cape Town Tour
itinerary.description: Today, your tour will cover attractions that you missed yesterday. Start the day with a stop at Hout Bay Harbour for a Seal Island cruise. If Chapmans Peak Drive is open, we’ll take you on a scenic drive along this stunning route. After lunch, visit the beautiful Cape Point National Park for a ride on the Flying Dutchman Funicular. Later, head to Simons Town and the charming Boulders Beach Penguin Colony. End the day with a visit to the Kirstenbosch Botanical Gardens. Spend the night in Cape Town.

itinerary.title: Cape Town to Sun City
itinerary.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast and head to Cape Town International Airport for a flight to Johannesburg. Our tour manager will meet you and assist with your transfer to the hotel. Spend the rest of the day exploring activities at the resort.

itinerary.title: Sun City Tour
itinerary.description: Sun City is a vibrant resort famous for its world-class amenities, safari adventures, and water parks. You can visit the resort’s luxurious casinos – Sun City Casino and the Palace of the Lost City. If you’re tired of the adventures or running around kids, book an appointment for a relaxing spa or visit the gym to work up a sweat. Spend the night in Sun City.

itinerary.title: Sun City to Johannesburg
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a breakfast buffet and complete check-out formalities. Later, head to Johannesburg and check into your hotel. You can either spend the day relaxing at the hotel or exploring the neighbourhood. Some places you can visit include the Johannesburg Zoo, the Wilds Nature Reserve, the Apartheid Museum, Gold Reef City Theme Park, and Nelson Mandela Square.

itinerary.title: Johannesburg To Victoria Falls, Zambia
itinerary.description: Leave your hotel and head to O. R. Tambo International for your flight to Zambia. Check into your hotel and spend the rest of the day exploring the resort. You can also choose from optional tours for an extra cost. Spend the night at a hotel in Victoria Falls.

itinerary.title: Victoria Falls
itinerary.description: Today, you will join a guided tour to explore Victoria Falls. There are many packages to choose from, depending on your interests. For instance, if you love enjoying a bird’s eye view of the spectacular falls, sign up for a helicopter ride. You can also take a river cruise on the Zambezi. There are many activities that offer an adrenaline rush, including bungee jumping, bridge swinging, and white-water rafting. Or, choose a full-day guided tour of the Chobe National Park in Botswana. Spend the night in Victoria Falls.

itinerary.title: Victoria Falls to Nairobi, Kenya
itinerary.description: Head to the Livingstone Airport to catch your flight to Nairobi, the capital city of Kenya. After completing check-in formalities, spend the day exploring the city or relaxing at the hotel. Some tourist attractions in Nairobi include the Nairobi National Park, the Giraffe Centre, and the National Museum of Kenya. Spend the night in Nairobi.

itinerary.title: Nairobi to Masai Mara
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head out to explore the nearby markets. Later in the afternoon, head out to Jomo Kenyatta to catch your flight to the Masai Mara. Check in to your resort and spend the rest of the day exploring the resort and enjoying its activities. Spend the night in the Masai Mara.

itinerary.title: Explore the Masai Mara
itinerary.description: The Masai Mara National Reserve is renowned for the Great Migration and is one of the world’s leading wildlife conservation and wilderness projects. Your tour will include a drive in a 4x4 Land Cruiser or van (depending on your package) to see its wildlife, including the Big Five, cheetahs, giraffes, and hippos. The tour also includes cultural visits to the Masai villages. Spend the night in the Masai Mara.

itinerary.title: Masai Mara to Nairobi
itinerary.description: Today, you will return to Nairobi and arrive at the hotel in the afternoon. Spend the rest of the day relaxing or exploring the city and its vibrant nightlife. Spend the night in Nairobi.

itinerary.title: Explore Nairobi
itinerary.description: Today, you will explore tourist attractions that you missed on Day 9.

itinerary.title: Leaving for Johannesburg
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of your hotel to head to Jomo Kenyatta International Airport to catch your flight to Johannesburg. You can then continue your trip in Africa or catch your return flight home.

packages.name: Unveiling Kenya’s Natural Beauty: An Adventure Safari Tour Package from Nairobi
packages.destination: Nairobi - Tree Hotel - Nakuru/Naivasha - Masai Mara

images.alt_text: Unveiling Kenya’s Natural Beauty: An Adventure Safari Tour Package from Nairobi
Unveiling Kenya’s Natural Beauty: An Adventure Safari Tour Package from Nairobi

itinerary.title: Nairobi
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport in Nairobi, a dedicated tour manager will meet you and assist with your transfer and check-in. You will spend the night at a luxury hotel in Nairobi.

itinerary.title: Nairobi to Tree Hotel
itinerary.description: After a delightful breakfast, we will depart from Nairobi in the morning, heading to Nyeri. Nyeri is a charming town nestled in the heart of Kenya's coffee-growing and dairy farming region, formerly known as the White Highlands. Following a scrumptious lunch at the base hotel, our adventure takes us to a tree hotel. Here, you'll witness a fascinating spectacle in the evening as a parade of animals emerges from the forest and gathers at the floodlit water hole and salt lick. They engage in playful scuffles and jostles for prime viewing spots. If you decide to stay up, you might witness the impressive displays of strength by elephants, although even they are cautious about challenging the rhinos, keeping a respectful distance. At Mountain Lodge, we head directly to the lodge for lunch. You'll enjoy your meals and spend the night at the Tree Hotel. Don't forget to pack an overnight bag for your transfer to the Ark later in the night.

itinerary.title: Tree Hotel to Nakuru or Naivasha
itinerary.description: Today, we set off for Nyahururu, where Thompson's Falls await at an impressive altitude of 7,738 feet. These falls were named after the Scottish explorer Joseph Thompson, who made the first European discovery in 1884. We then make our way down into the stunning Rift Valley, arriving at Lake Nakuru National Park in time for lunch at one of the local hotels. After lunch, an exciting afternoon game drive is on the agenda. The park is teeming with wildlife, and the birdwatching here is truly exceptional. You might even find yourself becoming a bird enthusiast, thanks to the breathtaking variety of bird species. Lake Nakuru is famous for its magnificent flocks of lesser and greater flamingos, which turn the lake's shores into a spectacular stretch of pink. This park is renowned for its birdlife, with over 400 species, including white pelicans, plovers, egrets, and marabou storks. It's also one of the rare places in Africa where you can spot the white rhino and the elusive Rothschild giraffe. Tonight, we'll enjoy our meals and spend the night at a comfortable lodge or camp in Nakuru or Naivasha.

itinerary.title: Nakuru/Naivasha to Masai Mara
itinerary.description: In the morning, embark on a scenic drive through the stunning Great Rift Valley to reach the renowned Masai Mara National Reserve. This vast reserve is a part of the Serengeti plains, famous for the incredible wildebeest migration and home to the Big Five: Lions, Elephants, Leopards, Buffaloes, and Rhinos. After arriving at your lodge or camp, enjoy a relaxing lunch before setting out for an exciting afternoon game drive. The Masai Mara Game Reserve is a true wilderness wonderland, where you can easily spot a diverse array of large mammals. Some of the park's permanent residents include Maasai Giraffes, Buffaloes, Elands, and numerous plains game like Impalas, Zebras, Topis, as well as both Thomson's and Grant's Gazelles. You'll wrap up the day with a delightful meal and spend the night at your lodge or camp in the heart of the Mara. This includes Breakfast, Lunch, and Dinner.

itinerary.title: Masai Mara
itinerary.description: Start your day with a morning safari to spot the diverse wildlife that calls this reserve home. With a bit of luck, you might witness a live hunt unfold before your very eyes. After a delicious lunch at your lodge, embark on another thrilling game drive, where you have the chance to encounter the renowned 'Big 5' animals. You'll enjoy your meals and spend the night at a lodge or camp in the Mara. This includes Breakfast, Lunch, and Dinner.

itinerary.title: Masai Mara to Nairobi
itinerary.description: Enjoy your morning meal and complete the check-out process. We'll then embark on a pleasant drive back to Nairobi, ensuring we arrive in time for lunch. You can choose your preferred lunch spot. Afterwards, we'll transfer you to Jomo Kenyatta International Airport for your onward flight.

itinerary.title: Masai Mara to Nairobi
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast, check out, and begin your journey back to Nairobi, where you'll arrive in time for lunch. You can choose your own lunch option. Afterwards, we'll arrange your transfer to Jomo Kenyatta International Airport for your next flight.

packages.name: Dazzling Philippines: Manila & Bohol | 5 Days Itinerary

images.alt_text: Dazzling Philippines: Manila & Bohol | 5 Days Itinerary
Dazzling Philippines: Manila & Bohol | 5 Days Itinerary

itinerary.title: Arrival in Manila
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival in Manila, our representative will extend a warm welcome and assist you in transferring to the hotel. Enjoy a delightful overnight stay at the hotel in Manila.

itinerary.title: Manila
itinerary.description: Begin the day with a delightful breakfast. Embark on a tour starting from the financial district of Makati, including Fort Bonifacio and the American Cemetery. Progress to Manila, the capital of the country. You will then head to Rizal Park, a tribute to the national hero, Dr. Jose Rizal. Take a moment for a photo stop before heading to the historic Walled City of Intramuros. Wander through the cobblestone streets and explore San Agustin Church, the oldest stone church in the country. Marvel at its extensive collection of ecclesiastical icons, vestments, and other religious artefacts. Just across lies Casa Manila, a reproduction of a 19th-century house adorned with Oriental and European decor, along with antique Philippine furniture. You will continue the journey to Fort Santiago, Manila's primary defence against maritime invaders. This stone fortress has witnessed many pivotal moments in Philippine history and guards the city's entrance from Manila Bay. Following the fort visit, drive to Quiapo, the central district often called the heart of Manila. Experience its vibrant market, the pilgrimage church of the Black Nazarene, jeepney terminals, and bazaars. Conclude the day with a visit to the Chinese Cemetery, where mausoleums rival houses in size and grandeur. Witness the unique blend of Buddhist and Christian influences evident in the architecture. Take some time for shopping before returning to the hotel. Overnight at the hotel in Manila.

itinerary.title: Manila to Bohol
itinerary.description: Enjoy a hearty breakfast meal in the morning. Today you will be transferred from your hotel to the Domestic Airport for your flight to Bohol. Upon reaching Bohol, enjoy a shared transfer to the beach resort. The remainder of the day is yours to relax and unwind. Spend the night at the hotel in Bohol.

itinerary.title: Bohol
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a delightful breakfast. Today, you will set off on a captivating day trip to explore the enchanting wonders of Bohol. Your first destination is the Philippine Tarsier Foundation in the town of Corella. This sanctuary provides a haven for the world's smallest primate, the tarsier. Witness these rare nocturnal creatures in their natural habitat, marvelling at their agility as they gracefully leap between trees and rotate their heads almost 360 degrees. Next, venture to Baclayon and take a brief pause at the historic Blood Compact site. Here, the friendship between Spain's Miguel Lopez de Legazpi and Datu Sikatuna, a native chieftain, was sealed with a symbolic drink. Despite recent damage to its bell tower and portico from a powerful earthquake, the church still hosts a museum with an extensive collection of religious art, ecclesiastical vestments, and church music librettos inscribed in Latin on animal skins. Continue the tour, passing through the Bilar man-made forest—a dense grove of majestic mahogany trees lining the highway toward the Chocolate Hills, one of the country's geological marvels. Pause at the designated viewing area to admire the hills, which change hues with the seasons. In the summer, the hill grasses take on a deep brown, resembling drops of chocolate candy, hence the name 'Chocolate Hills.' Return to the hotel by late afternoon and spend the night in Bohol.

itinerary.title: Depart from Bohol – Manila
itinerary.description: Commence your morning with a delicious breakfast before checking out of the hotel. Transfer to the Manila airport and board your flight back home, carrying with you cherished memories that will last a lifetime.

packages.name: Unveiling New Zealand’s Natural Marvels: Northern Splendour Tour from Auckland to Wellington

images.alt_text: Unveiling New Zealand’s Natural Marvels: Northern Splendour Tour from Auckland to Wellington
Unveiling New Zealand’s Natural Marvels: Northern Splendour Tour from Auckland to Wellington

itinerary.title: Arrival in Auckland
itinerary.description: As you touch down in Auckland, also known as 'The City of Sails,' those of you traveling by group coach will be greeted by our friendly local representative. They will ensure your smooth transfer to your hotel. If you're driving yourself, pick up your rental car at the airport and make your way to your hotel. Enjoy a comfortable overnight stay in Auckland.

itinerary.title: Auckland to Rotorua via Waitomo
itinerary.description: Enjoy your breakfast, then head south to visit the renowned Waitomo Glowworm Caves with a knowledgeable guide. Afterward, drive over the beautiful Mamaku Ranges, arriving in the geothermal wonderland of Rotorua. Spend the night at your Rotorua hotel.

itinerary.title: Rotorua
itinerary.description: After a delightful breakfast, we're off to explore some of New Zealand's incredible natural wonders. First stop is Te Puia Thermal Reserve, where you can witness bubbling mud pools and powerful geysers. Next, we head to Rainbow Springs to observe New Zealand's trout, birds, and wildlife. Our adventure continues at the Agrodome, where you'll be treated to a fantastic New Zealand farm show. Get ready for sheepdog demonstrations, cow milking, and an introduction to the stars of our sheep industry. The afternoon is yours to relax and enjoy yourself. In the evening, prepare for a genuine Maori Hangi feast and Concert, a cultural experience you won't forget. Your dinner is on us! You'll spend the night at a comfortable hotel in Rotorua.

itinerary.title: Rotorua to Napier (Approx. 219km, about 2 hours and 45 minutes)
itinerary.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast. Then, journey through the lush forests from Rotorua to reach the beautiful Lake Taupo. This lake is about the same size as Singapore and a beloved vacation destination for Kiwis. Drive through scenic mountain ranges and well-tended farmlands until you reach the East Coast and the charming 'Art Deco' city of Napier. Spend the night at your Napier hotel for a well-deserved rest.

itinerary.title: Napier
itinerary.description: Today is your free day to relax and enjoy Napier. You can choose to explore this charming city with optional activities like an Art Deco walking tour or a vintage car sightseeing tour (please note that optional tours are not included in the tour price). Later in the afternoon, relish a delightful wine tour that includes tastings at three local wineries. You'll spend the night at your Napier hotel.

itinerary.title: Napier to Wellington (Approx. 322km, around 4 hours and 15 minutes)
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delicious breakfast. Today, we will go through the scenic Manawatu Gorge, making our way to Palmerston North. From there, we'll follow the beautiful Kapiti Coast to reach New Zealand's vibrant 'Capital City,' Wellington. You'll spend the night at a comfortable hotel in Wellington.

itinerary.title: Leaving Wellington
itinerary.description: Enjoy your morning meal. Now, it's time to check out from your hotel and head to Wellington Airport. You'll either catch your flight back home or return your rental car.

itinerary.title: Welcome to Maldives
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at the Male International Airport, our tour manager will welcome you and help you transfer to the Arena Beach Hotel by speedboat. Complete check-in formalities and spend the rest of the day enjoying the amenities offered at the resort. Spend the evening at the swimming pool before ending the day with a private candlelight dinner by the beach. Retire for the day at a Standard Superior Room.

itinerary.title: Activities and Excursions
itinerary.description: Today, after a leisurely breakfast, you’ll head out to enjoy some of the activities offered by the resort. This includes a half-day or full-day adventure around the corals where you’ll swim with marine animals, explore the Vaavu Atoll, go on a sand bank tour and enjoy a live BBQ, go island hopping, or go on a dolphin cruise. End the day with a sunset fishing expedition where you can enjoy a BBQ made fresh with your catch.

itinerary.title: Activities and Excursions
itinerary.description: Start your day with a sumptuous breakfast before heading out to begin your water sports. You can enjoy snorkelling at Shark Bay, go on a whale shark expedition, or snorkelling in the resort’s fish tank. Other watersports available at the resort include parasailing, stand-up paddleboarding, fun tubing, jet skiing, and kayaking. End the day with a romantic dinner at one of the many restaurants in the resort.

itinerary.title: Depart Male
itinerary.description: Today, you will check out of the hotel after breakfast to head to Male. You will visit some of the top attractions in Male and even visit some of the local markets to shop for memorabilia for friends and family. Later, catch your flight to return home to India.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Singapore – Night Safari
itinerary.description: Our tour representative will greet you at Changi Airport to welcome you and transfer you to the hotel. We’ll leave you to freshen up and prepare for the day ahead. In the evening, we’ll visit the Mandai Wildlife Reserve to experience Night Safari, the world’s first nocturnal zoo to watch the animals from close quarters.

itinerary.title: Singapore City Tour - Gardens by the Bay - National Gallery Singapore - Singapore Zoo
itinerary.description: Let’s get extra touristy on the second day by visiting some of Singapore’s iconic attractions, namely – Gardens by The Bay, a nature park spanning over 101 hectares and home to millions of plants from across the continents, the National Gallery, a national museum home to exquisite art from Southeast Asia, and the Singapore Zoo.

itinerary.title: Sentosa - Universal Studios – Chinatown
itinerary.description: Let the alluring beauty of Sentosa Island engulf you and engage you with its multiple activities. Get a cable car ride at the Skyline Luge and Skyride, stroll around its many beaches and interact with cute dolphins at Dolphin Island. Universal Studios is a Hollywood-based theme park with amazing rides, games, and shows based on old Hollywood classics like Jurrasic Park, Madagascar, Shrek, and Transformers. You can end the day with a visit to Chinatown to sample some local street food, including Hainanese chicken rice, char kway teow, and roti prata. It’s also the best place for some bargain shopping.

itinerary.title: Singapore – Bintan - Banyan Tree Temple
itinerary.description: Ride a ferry from Singapore to Bintan, Indonesia’s famous holiday destination. We’ll meet you at the Tanah Merah Ferry Terminal and help you transfer by coach to an exclusive hotel in Bintan. Get a good night’s sleep at your hotel in Bintan. One of the top destinations in Bintan includes the Banyan Tree Temple – a Chinese shrine worshipped for over 200 years.

itinerary.title: Bintan Full-Day Tour
itinerary.description: Bintan is famous for its world-class resorts, beautiful beaches, Chinese temples, seafood restaurants, and local delicacies. You can enjoy snorkelling, jet-skiing, windsurfing, and other water sports in Bintan.

itinerary.title: Bintan – Singapore - Depart from Singapore
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

packages.name: Best Of Turkey Package
packages.destination: Istanbul - Istanbul Bosphorus Cruise And Shopping Tour - Istanbul Princes’ Island Tour - Cappadocia

itinerary.title: Arrival in Istanbul
itinerary.description: Arrive at the Ataturk International Airport and transfer to your hotel. Check-in and spend the day at your leisure, exploring the vibrant city on your own.

itinerary.title: Istanbul Sightseeing and Bosporus Cruise
itinerary.description: Begin the day with a relaxing Bosporus Cruise, where you can take in stunning views of the city's skyline and iconic landmarks from the water. Later, embark on a guided sightseeing tour of Istanbul. Visit popular attractions such as the Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, Topkapi Palace, and the Grand Bazaar. We’ll also cover the scenic Ciragan Palace, the Yildiz Palace, and the Dolmabahce Palace. Return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Princes' Island Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast, take a ferry to Princes' Island, a charming cluster of nine small islands in the Sea of Marmara. View historical monuments like the Topkapi Palace, Uskudar, and Leander’s Tower from the sea. Stop at Buyukada Island, one of the islands in Princes’ Island and famous for its summer resorts and water sports. Explore the island on a horse-drawn carriage or rent a bicycle to enjoy the scenic surroundings. Visit historic sites, relax on the beaches, and savor delicious seafood. Return to Istanbul in the evening and overnight at your hotel.

itinerary.title: Istanbul to Cappadocia
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out from your Istanbul hotel and transfer to the airport for a flight to Kayseri. Take a car from Kayseri to Cappadocia. Upon arrival in Cappadocia, transfer to your hotel and enjoy the rest of the day at leisure to relax or explore the local area. Overnight stay in Cappadocia.

itinerary.title: Cappadocia Exploration
itinerary.description: Start the day early with an unforgettable hot air balloon ride over the unique landscapes of Cappadocia (optional and weather-dependent). After breakfast, embark on a full-day guided tour of Cappadocia's highlights. Visit the Goreme Open-Air Museum to admire ancient rock-cut churches and stunning frescoes. Explore the fairy-tale-like valleys of Devrent and Pasabag, known for their unique rock formations. Discover the fascinating underground city of Kaymakli or Derinkuyu, carved deep into the Cappadocian hills. Enjoy a panoramic view of Cappadocia from the Uchisar Castle. Other attractions we’ll cover include the monastery of Cappadocia, the Fairy Chimneys of Avanos, the Red Valley, Cavusin Village, and the Pigeons Valley. Return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Cappadocia - Istanbul Departure
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out from your hotel and transfer to the airport for your flight back to Istanbul. Upon arrival in Istanbul, you can spend the remaining time exploring the city or shopping for souvenirs. Transfer to Istanbul Airport for your departure flight or extend your stay in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Male
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at the Male International Airport, our tour manager will help you transfer to Hotel Riu Atoll. Complete check-in formalities and spend the rest of the day exploring the hotel's beautiful surroundings and amenities. End the evening with a quaint candlelight dinner by the beach.

itinerary.title: Water Sports
itinerary.description: Today, you will enjoy the many water sports offered by the hotel. Some are complimentary, while others are paid for. Some activities include jet skiing, banana boat riding, snorkelling, kayaking, scuba diving, and paddle surfing. Later in the evening, enjoy live music and a dance show at the resort.

itinerary.title: Exploring Maldives’ Marine Life
itinerary.description: Today, you will enjoy beach activities with friends and family. You could join the group for an underwater walk to explore the corals, relax on the beach, or enjoy a boat ride to watch the dolphins.

itinerary.title: Spa Facilities And Relaxation
itinerary.description: Start your day with a wonderful breakfast with the impressive Indian Ocean for company. Later, head to the beach, sipping an aperitif under the umbrella. The hotel also offers spa facilities, helping you relax and make the most of your vacation.

itinerary.title: Depart Hotel Riu Atoll
itinerary.description: After breakfast today, you will leave the hotel and head to Male Airport. Board your flight to return home after a memorable vacation.

itinerary.title: Colombo - Kandy
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at the airport, our tour manager will welcome you and guide you to Kandy, the second-largest city in Sri Lanka. This city is famous for its monasteries, temples, Buddhist viharas, spice gardens, and museums. Check into a luxury hotel and spend the night in Kandy.

itinerary.title: Kandy - Nuwara Eliya
itinerary.description: After a sumptuous breakfast, head to explore some of Kandy’s popular tourist attractions, including The Kandy Lake, the Royal Botanical Gardens, The Temple of the Tooth, and the Ceylon Tea Museum. Later, head to Nuwara Eliya, a quaint town famous for its colonial buildings and bungalows. The city is also called Little England, thanks to its laidback atmosphere and tea plantations. Explore the city with our guide. Return to the hotel to spend the night in Nuwara Eliya.

itinerary.title: Nuwara Eliya - Bentota
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head out to explore local attractions in Nuwara Eliya, including Seetha Amman Temple, Victoria Park, Lover’s Leap Waterfall, and the UNESCO-listed Horton Plains National Park. Don’t miss a boat ride on Lake Gregory. Later in the day, check out of the hotel and head to Bentota. The journey takes over 4 to 5 hours and is absolutely beautiful. Check in to your hotel in Bentota and spend the rest of the day enjoying places in the neighbourhood.

itinerary.title: Bentota
itinerary.description: The resort town of Bentota is a tropical paradise offering a perfect blend of sun and sand, and sumptuous food. Later, head to visit some of Bentota’s local attractions, including, the Kande Vihara Temple, Turtle Farm, and the Galle Dutch Fort. Don’t miss the fun water sports in the beach, including jet skiing, parasailing, and scuba diving. Spend the night in Bentota.

itinerary.title: Bentota - Colombo
itinerary.description: After a hearty breakfast, check out of the hotel and head to Colombo. Check into your hotel and head out to explore Sri Lanka’s capital city. Some of the places you will visit include the Gangaramaya Temple, Galle Face Green, Viharamahadevi Park, and the Kelaniya Raja Maha Viharaya. Return to your hotel after an evening of shopping and sightseeing.

itinerary.title: Depart Colombo
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head out to Colombo for shopping. Later, head to the airport to catch your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Male
itinerary.description: After arriving at the Male International Airport, our tour manager will welcome you and help you transfer to North Male Atoll. Check in at the Villa Nautica Paradise Island Resort and spend the rest of the day exploring and enjoying the amenities. Spend the night at a beach villa.

itinerary.title: Activities and Excursions
itinerary.description: After a hearty breakfast, head out to explore the resort's amenities. This includes enjoying a picnic at one of the nearby seawalls, dining at the Crow’s Nest, exercising at the open-air gym, signing up for a relaxing spa session, signing up for diving lessons, or taking your kids to the kids’ club within the resort. You can also explore the neighbouring islands, visiting local markets to buy souvenirs for friends and family.

itinerary.title: Activities and Excursions
itinerary.description: Today, after breakfast, you will head out to enjoy some of the water sports, including stand-up paddleboarding, parasailing, surfing, snorkelling, canoeing, windsurfing, kitesurfing, jet-surfing, jet skiing, and sailing. End the day with a private dinner on the beach under the gaze of a thousand stars.

itinerary.title: Activities and Excursions
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a hearty breakfast buffet. Later, you can continue enjoying the amenities offered at the resort. You can opt for a sunset cruise to watch dolphins, go night fishing, or enjoy a picnic at one of the neighbouring sandbanks.

itinerary.title: Depart Male
itinerary.description: Today, after breakfast, you will check out of the hotel and head to Male by ferry. You will be taken to the Male International Airport to catch your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Gardens By The Bay - National Gallery Singapore - Singapore Zoo
itinerary.description: Once you land in Singapore, our tour representatives will greet you at the airport and take you to your hotel. After completing check-in and freshening up, you can head out to begin your fantastic holiday. The first day involves hopping from one famous sightseeing spot to another. The first one is Gardens by the Bay, Singapore’s most famous nature garden, which sprawls over 101 hectares, including three waterfront gardens. Next is the National Gallery Museum, Singapore, with art pieces from the Southeast Asian community on display. The last place on your itinerary is Singapore Zoo, the best place for families with kids.

itinerary.title: Sentosa Island Tour
itinerary.description: The beauty and glamour of Sentosa Island await you on your second day. The island has numerous beaches for you to relax and enjoy. There are plenty of other activities you can indulge in, such as interacting with dolphins at Dolphin Island and taking a cable car ride at the Skyline Luge and Skyride.

itinerary.title: Universal Studios – Chinatown
itinerary.description: Get ready to be engulfed by a world of fun rides and entertainment at Universal Studios in Singapore, the first of its kind in Southeast Asia. Make sure to ride the Battlestar Galactica while you’re there. Later in the evening, grab some scrumptious oriental cuisine in Chinatown.

itinerary.title: Reach Langkawi - Langkawi Cable Car - Langkawi Wildlife Park
itinerary.description: Take your flight from Singapore to Langkawi, where you will be greeted by our tour representatives, who will help you shift to your hotel. Head on to one of Malaysia's most famous attractions, the Langkawi Cable Car, where you can ride a gondola-style cable car and ride 650 metres high in the air. Finish the day by exploring the Langkawi Wildlife Park and interacting with the 150 species of animals.

itinerary.title: Pantai Cenang Beach - Paradise 3D Museum - Telaga Tujuh Waterfalls
itinerary.description: Visit Pantai Cenang Beach to relax and enjoy swimming, sunbathing, and other water sports. After this, visit the Paradise 3D Museum, the world’s largest 3D. Lastly, lay your eyes on the mesmerizing view of the Telaga Tujuh Waterfalls.

itinerary.title: Depart from Langkawi
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

packages.name: Russia Moscow Special Saver Package
packages.destination: Moscow - Moscow City Tour - St.Petersburg - St.Petersburg City Tour - Hermitage State Museum

itinerary.title: Arrive in Moscow
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival in Moscow, you will be greeted by our tour representative, who will help you get to your hotel. After you complete the check-in formalities, you can freshen up and leave to explore the delightful parks in Moscow. Home to over 50 parks and forests, there are more than 700 boulevards and public gardens in the capital of Russia.

itinerary.title: Moscow City Tour
itinerary.description: After consuming a delicious breakfast, you will be heading to witness a bunch of the most popular attractions in Moscow. The places our tour representatives will take you to include the Red Square, the State Historical Museum, St. Basil’s Cathedral, and Lenin Mausoleum. You will also get to witness the Cathedral of Christ the Saviour, New Maiden’s Convent, and Moscow State University. Journey along the Moskvoretskaya Embankment to enjoy the views of Kremlin, which is situated right in the heart of the city. Move along to Sparrow Hills, an observation platform from where you can get a panoramic view of the entire city. Dedicate the rest of the day to exploring the other famous sightseeing spots in Moscow, such as Victory Park, Triumphal Arch, Poklonnaya Hill, Boulevard Ring, Tverskaya Street, Pushkin Square, Kutuzovsky Avenue, Manezhnaya Square, and New Arbat Avenue. Finish off the day by visiting Tsar Cannon, Tsar Bell, and Senate Square.

itinerary.title: Moscow Metro Tour - St. Petersburg
itinerary.description: Have a scrumptious breakfast, and then head out for the Moscow metro tour. You will be visiting Komsomolskaya, Mayakovskaya, Novokuznetskaya, Ploshchad Revolyutsii, Kropotkinskaya, and Novoslobodskaya. Make sure to visit the Belorusskaya, Arbatskaya, and Park Kultury stations. In the afternoon, board a train to St. Petersburg, which is a port city. Our tour representatives will help you get to your hotel. You can enjoy a relaxing evening after completing the check-in formalities.

itinerary.title: St. Petersburg City Tour
itinerary.description: Spend this day exploring the city of St. Petersburg. The places you will be exploring are Saint Isaac's Cathedral, Alexander Nevsky Lavra, Peter and Paul Fortress, Peterhof, Pavlovsk Palace, Yusupov Palace, and Catherine Palace. Spend the night at your hotel.

itinerary.title: Hermitage State Museum
itinerary.description: Today, you will be visiting the Hermitage State Museum. Founded in 1764, it’s one of the largest museums in the world, containing more than three million items. The museum saw 2,812,913 visitors in 2022 and was ranked 10th by the Art Newspaper in their most visited art museums list. Visit a flea market after your lunch and go back to your hotel at night.

itinerary.title: Depart St. Petersburg
