itinerary.description: After getting done with your breakfast, check out of your hotel and head to Pulkovo Airport to board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrive In Moscow
itinerary.description: As you arrive in Moscow, our tour manager will await to help you transfer to the hotel. Check into the hotel and spend the rest of the day exploring the city at leisure. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Moscow.

itinerary.title: Moscow City Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head to the city centre for a full-day tour. You will explore some of Moscow’s historic cathedrals and palaces, including Poklonnaya Hill, New Maiden Convent, Vorobievy Hills, Manezhnaya Square, and Lubianka Square. Don’t miss Bolshoi Theatre, Ohotny Riad, Tverskaya Street, the Cathedral of Christ the Saviour, and the Kropotkinskaya Embankment. Later, you will proceed to Red Square and tour the Kremlin to check out the famous cathedrals. Spend the night in Moscow.

itinerary.title: Moscow - St Petersburg
itinerary.description: Check out of the hotel and move to the train station to catch your Sapsan train to St Petersburg. You will be served a complimentary lunch. At the station, our tour manager will guide you and help you transfer to the world. Spend the evening leisurely to explore the city and neighbourhoods around the hotel. Overnight in St Petersburg.

itinerary.title: St Petersburg City Tour
itinerary.description: St Petersburg is Russia’s second-largest city, founded in 1703 by Peter the Great. The city is famous for its White Nights, a phenomenon from May to July when the sun does not drop below 6 degrees, giving a beautiful white glow all night. Some of the iconic attractions in St Petersburg include the Spit of the Basil Island, St Isaac Cathedral, the Church of the Saviour on the Spilled Blood, the Cruiser Aurora Museum, the Nevsky Prospect, the Neva Embankments, and the Peter and Paul fortresses, where Tsars from Russian royalty lie buried. Spend the night in St Petersburg.

itinerary.title: St. Petersburg – Hermitage Museum
itinerary.description: Today, you will head to the Catherine Palace, named after Catherine I, the wife of Peter the Great. The Palace is famous for its architecture and décor, with blue and white facades. It has been converted into the Hermitage Museum, which houses over 3 million artefacts, including paintings, sculptures, crockery, fine clothes, and weaponry dating back to the Middle Ages. Spend the night in St Petersburg.

itinerary.title: Depart Russia
itinerary.description: Check out of the hotel to catch your flight to return home.

packages.name: Explore Beautiful Philippines: Manila & Boracay | Itinerary

images.alt_text: Explore Beautiful Philippines: Manila & Boracay | Itinerary
Explore Beautiful Philippines: Manila & Boracay | Itinerary

itinerary.title: Arrival in Manila
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival in Manila, our representative will warmly welcome you and transfer you to the hotel. Enjoy a comfortable overnight stay at the hotel in Manila.

itinerary.title: Explore Manila's Rich Heritage
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a wonderful breakfast and go for a tour of the vibrant financial district of Makati, which includes Fort Bonifacio and the American Cemetery. Continue your exploration in the heart of Manila, the capital city. Your first stop is Rizal Park, a tribute to the national hero, Dr. Jose Rizal. Take a moment for a photo stop before moving on to the historic Walled City of Intramuros. Wander through the charming, cobbled streets of San Agustin Church, the oldest stone church in the country, housing a remarkable collection of ecclesiastical icons and religious artefacts. Just across is Casa Manila, a replica of a 19th-century house adorned with Oriental and European decor, as well as authentic Philippine antique furniture. Next, visit Fort Santiago, a stone fortress that served as Manila's primary defence against sea invaders and witnessed significant moments in Philippine history. Following the fort exploration, head to Quiapo, the central district known as the heart of Manila. Immerse yourself in its lively market, visit the pilgrimage church of the Black Nazarene, explore jeepney terminals, and browse through vibrant bazaars. Conclude the day with a visit to the Chinese Cemetery, where grand mausoleums rival houses in size and intricacy. The cemetery reflects a unique blend of Buddhist and Christian influences. Take some time for shopping before returning to the hotel for a relaxing overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Exploring Boracay
itinerary.description: Kick off the day with a delightful breakfast before making your way to the Domestic Airport for a flight to Boracay. Upon arriving at the Caticlan Airport, you’ll be seamlessly transferred via ferry (50-minute ride) to your Boracay hotel. The rest of the day is yours to enjoy at your own pace. Take in the beauty of Boracay and unwind at your leisure. Spend the night at your Boracay accommodation.

itinerary.title: Island Hopping Adventure
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a delicious breakfast, gearing up for an exciting Boracay Island hopping tour. No visit to Boracay is complete without this adventure! Explore over a dozen pristine, undeveloped beaches, marvel at turquoise waters, and discover vibrant coral reefs. Feast your eyes on breathtaking scenery, snorkel, and witness the vibrant marine life. The boat trip will include stopovers at some of the most stunning spots in Boracay, offering opportunities for snorkelling and swimming. Spend the night at your Boracay hotel.

itinerary.title: Farewell to Boracay
itinerary.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast. Check out from your hotel in the morning and head to Manila airport for your journey back home.

packages.name: New Zealand Road Trip Itinerary: Auckland to Wellington
packages.destination: Auckland - Bay of Islands - Rotorua - Wellington

images.alt_text: New Zealand Road Trip Itinerary: Auckland to Wellington
New Zealand Road Trip Itinerary: Auckland to Wellington

itinerary.title: Arrival in Auckland
itinerary.description: Welcome to 'The City of Sails,' Auckland. As you touch down, collect your rental car and head to your relaxing hotel. Rest up for the exciting journey ahead.

itinerary.title: Auckland - Bay of Islands
itinerary.description: Today, we set off north, crossing Auckland's iconic Harbour Bridge and tracing the scenic Hibiscus Coast. Our adventure leads us through Whangarei, Northland's major city, culminating in the breathtaking Bay of Islands, where we'll settle into our hotel.

itinerary.title: Bay of Islands
itinerary.description: A day to savour the Bay of Islands' charm at your leisure. You can opt for a Cape Reinga & 90 Mile Beach day tour or explore Kerikeri. The choice is yours as you soak in the beauty of this serene region.

itinerary.title: Bay of Islands - Auckland
itinerary.description: Another day to explore the Bay of Islands at your own pace. Alternatively, venture out to discover more of this captivating area. Return to Auckland for a relaxing evening.

itinerary.title: Auckland - Rotorua
itinerary.description: Heading south, we journey to Pukekohe, known for its vibrant market gardens. Continuing through Hamilton and the lush Waikato region, we arrive at Rotorua, the 'Thermal City.' Check into your hotel for a well-deserved rest.

itinerary.title: Rotorua - Tongariro National Park
itinerary.description: Our route takes us to Taupo, home to New Zealand's largest lake and the majestic Huka Falls. After exploring Taupo, we wind around the edges of Lake Taupo, entering the Tongariro National Park. An overnight stay amidst this natural wonder awaits.

itinerary.title: Tongariro National Park
itinerary.description: Today is all about leisure. You can explore the Tongariro National Park, home to world-famous walking tracks, including the renowned Tongariro Crossing. Take your time to absorb the beauty of the surroundings.

itinerary.title: Tongariro National Park - Wellington
itinerary.description: This morning, we are going to make our way to the capital city, Wellington. The rest of the day is yours to enjoy at your own pace. Relax and soak in the city's vibrant atmosphere.

itinerary.title: Wellington
itinerary.description: Today, it's time to bid farewell. Enjoy your delicious breakfast, then head to Wellington Airport for your flight to your next destination or your cherished hometown, carrying with you memories of this incredible journey.

itinerary.title: Arrive at Langkawi - Langkawi Cable Car - Langkawi Wildlife Park
itinerary.description: Once you land in Langkawi, our tour representatives will greet you at the airport and take you to your hotel. After completing check-in and freshening up, you can head out to begin your vacation. Head on to one of Malaysia's most famous attractions, the Langkawi Cable Car, where a gondola-style cable car takes you 650 metres high in the air for a bird’s eye view of the Finish the day by exploring the Langkawi Wildlife Park and interact with over 150 species of animals.

itinerary.title: Pantai Cenang Beach - Paradise 3D Museum - Telaga Tujuh Waterfalls
itinerary.description: Relax at the Pantai Cenang Beach and sample delicious food at one of its numerous cafes. After this, visit the second-largest 3D museum in the world, Paradise 3D Museum. For the last stop of your day, lay your eyes on the mesmerizing view of the Telaga Tujuh Waterfalls.

itinerary.title: Reach Kuala Lumpur - Malacca - Petronas Twin Towers
itinerary.description: Board your flight from Langkawi to Kuala Lumpur. Check into your hotel and head out for a city tour. You will visit the Petronas Twin Towers and, if time permits, visit Malacca, a UNESCO World Heritage Site known for its distinctive colonial architecture and night markets.

itinerary.title: KL Bird Park - Batu Caves - National Mosque of Malaysia
itinerary.description: You will be breathing in the serenity of Batu Caves during the fourth day of your trip. Get mesmerized by the National Mosque of Malaysia before getting back to your hotel. Visit the Kuala Lumpur Bird Park, which covers an area of 20.9 acres and has over 3,000 local and foreign birds of about 200 different species.

itinerary.title: Depart from Kuala Lumpur
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Reach Kuala Lumpur – Petronas Twin Towers - KL Bird Park
itinerary.description: Once you land in Kuala Lumpur, our tour representatives will greet you at the airport and take you to your hotel. We’ll leave you to freshen up and prepare for your Malaysian vacation's first day. Your next destination is the Petronas Twin Towers, one of the most popular tourist spots in Kuala Lumpur. Next, head to the Kuala Lumpur Bird Park, which covers an area of 20.9 acres and has over 3,000 local and foreign birds of about 200 different species.

itinerary.title: Taman Negara - Night Jungle Walk
itinerary.description: On your second day, we’ll take you to Kuala Tahan by coach or van, after which you will hop on a boat to reach Taman Negara. From there, you will proceed to the Department of Wildlife to register and obtain the required permits and licenses, post which you will watch a video presentation of the lush national park. Later in the night, a tour guide will take you for a fun jungle walk.

itinerary.title: Canopy Walkway - Teresek Hill - Lata Berkoh
itinerary.description: Today, you will head on to Sungai Sedim Recreational Park to walk on the world’s longest canopy walk. The Tamara Negara Rainforest walkway is 925 metres long and the best way to enjoy the stunning forest scenery. You can then trek up Teresek Hill and enjoy a boat ride to Lata Berkoh, where you can also go swimming.

itinerary.title: Taman Negara to Kuala Terengganu
itinerary.description: Today, you will travel to Kuala Terengganu to explore its cultural and historical attractions, including Chinatown and a village inhabited by the indigenous Orang Asli tribe.

itinerary.title: Back to Kuala Lumpur
itinerary.description: Check out of your hotel in Kuala Terengganu and head to Kuala Lumpur. Spend the rest of the day relaxing in the hotel and exploring the neighbourhood.

itinerary.title: Depart from Kuala Lumpur
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

packages.name: Matamanoa Island Vacation Packages: A Blissful Escape with GT Holidays

images.alt_text: Matamanoa Island Vacation Packages: A Blissful Escape with GT Holidays
Matamanoa Island Vacation Packages: A Blissful Escape with GT Holidays

itinerary.title: Arrival at Matamanoa Island
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Nadi Airport, you'll be whisked away to the tranquil Matamanoa Island Resort. Here, you have the choice to unwind completely or indulge in a variety of leisure activities and cultural adventures. Take a refreshing dip in the freshwater pool or the stunning Pacific Ocean, enjoy a game of tennis, or relax with a cocktail at the bar while witnessing the mesmerising sunset. Embrace the opportunity to explore the enchanting beauty of this island at your own pace. You'll spend the night at the Matamanoa Island Resort, where the magic of the island awaits you.

itinerary.title: Matamanoa Island Resort
itinerary.description: Today, you have the entire day to leisurely explore the resort at your own pace. Enjoy the tranquility of Matamanoa Island Resort. Prepare to spend the night in this serene paradise.

itinerary.title: Matamanoa Island Resort
itinerary.description: After a sumptuous breakfast, spend the day enjoying activities at the resort. This includes snorkelling, kayaking, scuba diving, and boat excursions to nearby spots.

itinerary.title: Matamanoa Island Resort to Mercure Nadi
itinerary.description: Today, you'll be whisked away to Mercure Nadi. The rest of the day is yours to enjoy at your leisure. Spend the night at the welcoming Mercure Nadi.

itinerary.title: Departure from Mercure Nadi
itinerary.description: This morning, complete your check-out from the hotel and proceed to the airport for your flight back home.

packages.name: Bali with Yogyakarta
packages.destination: Bali - Uluwatu Kecak - Kintamani - Ubud - Yogyakarta

itinerary.title: Arrive at Bali - Bounty Sunset Cruise
itinerary.description: Once you arrive in Bali, our local representative will greet you at the airport and take you to the hotel. After enjoying a delicious lunch, you can relax and walk around the resort. In the evening, proceed to board the Bounty Sunset Cruise. Course through the coastal area of Benoa to relish some delicious food as you watch entertaining dance performances and enjoy traditional music. Get back to your hotel after a fulfilling dinner on the cruise.

itinerary.title: Celuk Village - Mas Village - Elephant Cave - Kintamani - Ubud Village Tour
itinerary.description: The second day of your trip begins with Celuk, a Balinese village famous for its gold and silver jewelry. Proceed to the quaint Mas Village, where you can find several intricately carved wooden sculptures. Next is the revered Hindu archaeological site, Elephant Cave or Goa Gajah. After this, move on to Kintamani Volcano and end the day by going to the central market in Ubud to buy traditional souvenirs for yourself and your loved ones.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Yogyakarta - Sultan Palace - Taman Sari Water Castle
itinerary.description: You will be boarding your flight from Bali to Yogyakarta on the third day. Be prepared to explore the city of Yogyakarta. Explore the Sultan Palace, the place of residence of the king of Yogyakarta. After this, witness another famous spot known as the Taman Sari Water Castle. Combining traditional and western forms of architecture, this was known as a place of escape for the royal family.

itinerary.title: Borobudur Temple
itinerary.description: Pay your respects at the Borobudur Temple, revered as the world's biggest Buddhist monument. Perched atop a hill surrounded by lush greenery, this monument is a must-visit on your itinerary. Get back to your hotel in the evening and enjoy a calming night.

itinerary.title: Depart from Yogyakarta
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: India – London
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Heathrow International Airport, our tour manager will welcome you and help you transfer to the hotel. After checking in, spend the rest of the day exploring places in and around the hotel. Spend the night at a comfortable hotel in London.

itinerary.title: London City Tour
itinerary.description: After a delicious English breakfast, head to explore some of London’s most famous attractions. This includes the London Tower, the London Eye, Buckingham Palace, The British Museum, the Natural History Museum, and Tower Bridge. Spend the evening enjoying the busy markets and streets in London.

itinerary.title: London City Tour Day 2
itinerary.description: Today, you will explore Madame Tussauds Max Museum. This museum houses wax statues of world-famous figures, including Indian celebrities like Amitabh Bachchan and Shahrukh Khan.

itinerary.title: London to Paris
itinerary.description: After a sumptuous breakfast, head to St Pancras Station to board the Eurostar. The journey takes up to 2.5 hours. Upon arriving in Paris, you will visit an Indian restaurant for lunch. Later, head to the Eiffel Tower, followed by a guided tour of neighbouring places. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Paris.

itinerary.title: Paris Day Tour
itinerary.description: After a quick breakfast, head to the Bois de Boulogne for a cruise on the River Seine. Return to your hotel to enjoy some shopping at one of the local Paris markets. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Paris.

itinerary.title: Paris – Lucerne
itinerary.description: Check out of your hotel and head to Lucerne, the most populous city in Central Switzerland. The city is famous for its beautiful Lake Lucerne, its well-preserved architecture, and the iconic 14th-century wooden bridge. Other attractions include the Picasso Gallery, the Jesuit Church, Mill Bridge, and the Zytturm Clock Tower. End the day with a delicious dinner at an Indian restaurant. Spend the night in Lucerne.

itinerary.title: Zurich – Rhine Falls
itinerary.description: After a hearty breakfast buffet, check out of the hotel and head to Zurich, Switzerland’s largest city. It is famous for its historic buildings, picturesque alleyways, and the iconic Grossmunster Church. Some attractions you will cover during this tour include Fraumuenster Church, the Hoehenstrasse, and the Rapperswil Castle. Spend the night in Zurich.

itinerary.title: Depart Zurich
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head to the Zurich International Airport to catch your return flight home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in New York
itinerary.description: Welcome to New York, the city that never sleeps! Once you arrive at the John F. Kennedy International Airport, our tour manager will greet you and take you to your hotel. After completing the check-in formalities, you will be given an overview of your itinerary. Spend the rest of the day relaxing and exploring the hotel.

itinerary.title: New York City Tour
itinerary.description: After having your breakfast, you will be heading to explore the city of New York, with the first stop being the internationally acclaimed Statue of Liberty. You will then board a ship to Liberty Island to take in the view of the gorgeous New York City skyline. Get ready to witness some of the major attractions of New York, such as Times Square, Wall Street, Ground Zero, Rockefeller Center, Central Park, and the United Nations Headquarters. End the day by going up to the observation deck located on the 86th floor of the Empire State Building.

itinerary.title: New York to Washington
itinerary.description: Get done with your delicious breakfast and then move to Washington, D.C., the capital city of the United States of America. Pulling in over 25 million visitors each year, tourism and hospitality is one of the biggest sectors in D.C. Check in to your hotel and enjoy a relaxing evening.

itinerary.title: Washington City Tour
itinerary.description: After consuming a scrumptious breakfast, visit some of the most popular spots in the city, including the Pentagon, United States Capitol, White House, Supreme Court, Lincoln Memorial, Smithsonian National Air and Space Museum, World War II Memorial, and Washington Monument.

itinerary.title: Washington to Niagara Falls
itinerary.description: Depart from Washington to drive to Niagara Falls, travelling through Pennsylvania, stopping at the scenic Watkins Glen State Park (if time permits). Upon your arrival at the Niagara Falls, check into the hotel to enjoy a night view of the illuminated falls.

itinerary.title: Explore Niagara Falls
itinerary.description: Enjoy panoramic views of the Niagara Falls from the US side. The Maid of the Mist boat will take you around this group of waterfalls, where you can lay your eyes on the American Falls and Horseshoe Falls. You can also choose to visit the falls in the evening to see them lit up in all their glory.

itinerary.title: Buffalo to Orlando
itinerary.description: Board your flight from Buffalo to Orlando, the fourth-largest city in Florida. The city is often called the Theme Park Capital of the World, attracting millions of tourists from the US and across the world. It is home to world-class theme parks like the Walt Disney World Resort, Universal, and SeaWorld. Check into your hotel and spend the rest of the day relaxing.

itinerary.title: Magic Kingdom Park
itinerary.description: Lovers of Disney and theme parks are in for a treat as you visit Orlando’s beloved Magic Kingdom Park. Inaugurated in October 1971, the park welcomes millions of visitors each year and features rides, parades, nostalgic attractions, and fireworks displays. As you roam around this park, known as ‘The Most Magical Place on Earth’, you will find yourself revisiting your childhood days.

itinerary.title: Epcot
itinerary.description: Time to experience yet another adventurous theme park in Orlando. You will be taken to Epcot, a theme park within the Walt Disney World resort. Built to celebrate the beauty of humanity’s achievements, the park features several displays showcasing the brilliance of science and technology.

itinerary.title: SeaWorld
itinerary.description: On this day, you will be visiting SeaWorld, an attractive marine park offering rollercoasters, water slides, and close-up encounters with underwater animals. Have dinner with orcas, enjoy a playful time with bottlenose dolphins, and cherish the sight of flamingos as you roam around this theme park.

itinerary.title: Depart Orlando
itinerary.description: Head to Orlando International Airport to board your flight to India via New York, carrying fond memories of your tour of the United States.

packages.name: Samui Phuket Holiday Delight
packages.destination: Arrive Koh Samui - Bangkok - Phuket (Fanta - Sea Show)- Phuket - Phi Phi Island - Bangkok Departure

itinerary.title: Arrive in Koh Samui
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at Koh Samui Island, our tour manager will welcome you and help you to transfer to the hotel. Complete check-in and spend the rest of the day exploring places in and around your resort. You could visit the neighbouring towns of Mae Nam and Choeng Mon to enjoy the pristine beaches or shop at one of the local markets. In the evening, head to the adjacent island of Koh Phangan to explore the natural corals on the island. Ko Phangan is famous for its Full Moon Party, an all-night party held on full moon nights every month. Return to the resort in the evening to spend your night in Koh Samui.

itinerary.title: Koh Samui Full Day Tour
itinerary.description: Today, after breakfast, you will explore the island of Koh Samui. This island is famous for its pristine beaches, lush tropical rainforests, and world-class spas. You will cover Koh Samui’s attractions, including Wat Phra Yai, Ladd Koh, and Wat Kunaram. Don’t miss the Hin Ta and Hin Yai or, Grandfather and Grandmother Rocks, and the Tarnim Magic Garden. Spend the night in Koh Samui.

itinerary.title: Koh Samui – Phuket
itinerary.description: After breakfast, you will check out of the hotel to catch your flight to Phuket. Upon arrival, check into the hotel and enjoy the island and its views. Thailand’s largest island, Phuket, is known for its vibrant nightlife and white sandy beaches. You will explore some of Phuket’s tourist attractions. Some of the places you will enjoy today (or tomorrow, depending on time) are FantaSea, the Big Buddha, and Green Elephant Sanctuary Park. Spend the night in Phuket.

itinerary.title: Phuket to Phi Phi Island
itinerary.description: Some of the top attractions you will cover today include Old Phuket Town, Freedom Beach, Monkey Hill, Kata Beach, Kamala Beach, Wat Chalong, Nai Harn Beach, and Karon Viewpoint. Later, head to Phi Phi Island to visit Maya Bay, Monkey Beach, Bamboo Island, and Viking Caves. Return to your hotel in Phuket for the night.

itinerary.title: Phuket - Bangkok
itinerary.description: Check out of your hotel to catch your return flight to Bangkok. Later in the night, you will catch your return flight to India.

packages.name: Egypt Long Nile Cruises for 9 Days| Itinerary
packages.destination: Amman - Nazareth - Bethlehem - Taba (Israel) - Sinai (Egypt) - Cairo

images.alt_text: Egypt Long Nile Cruises for 9 Days| Itinerary
Egypt Long Nile Cruises for 9 Days| Itinerary
Egypt Long Nile Cruises for 9 Days| Itinerary
Egypt Long Nile Cruises for 9 Days| Itinerary
Egypt Long Nile Cruises for 9 Days| Itinerary
Egypt Long Nile Cruises for 9 Days| Itinerary

itinerary.title: Amman
itinerary.description: Upon arrival in Amman, our tour manager will greet you and assist with check-in. Following a quick break, get ready for a journey to Mount Nebo, via the historic King’s Highway. Some of the places you will visit here include the Jordan Valley and the Dead Sea. Return to your hotel in Amman for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Amman - Nazareth
itinerary.description: Commence the day with a hearty breakfast at your hotel. Your itinerary then calls for a visit to the Sheik Hussain Bridge, where you will safely cross the border. Here, it is necessary to complete customs and emigration formalities to gain entry into Israel. After the requisite procedures, enjoy a satisfying lunch at a nearby restaurant. Subsequently, journey to the town of Nazareth, where Archangel Gabriel made a divine appearance before Mary, foretelling the birth of her son. If time allows, explore Joseph's workshop before retiring to your Nazareth hotel. Enjoy a delightful dinner and a peaceful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Sea of Galilee - Capernaum - Jordan River - Nazareth - Bethlehem
itinerary.description: Begin the day with a morning repast, and then rendezvous with your tour guide. Your day's exploration will commence with visits to Mount Tabor, Capernaum, the Church of the Beatitudes, and Tabgha. As an exhilarating addition to your journey, partake in a voyage aboard an authentic Galilean fishing boat. Following this, make a brief visit to St. Peter's Church, Mensa Christi, and the Church of the Primacy of Peter. Break for a leisurely lunch at a local restaurant. Be sure to visit the traditional Baptismal site, known as "Yardenit," situated on the Jordan River, before concluding your day's adventures.

itinerary.title: Haifa - Mt. Carmel - Joppa (Tel Aviv) - Jericho - Bethlehem
itinerary.description: Commence your day with a hearty breakfast and embark on a journey to the coastal city of Caesarea en route to Haifa, a city reputedly perched upon the slopes of the venerable Mount Carmel. Following this, proceed to the enchanting Persian Hanging Gardens and Muhraqa. Pause to savour a delightful repast at a local restaurant. Subsequently, your itinerary calls for a visit to St. Peter's Church, the Mediterranean Sea, the iconic Sycamore Tree, and the sacred Mount of Temptation.

itinerary.title: Old City of Jerusalem - Golgotha - Wailing Wall - Ein Karem - Bethlehem
itinerary.description: With the break of day, indulge in a sumptuous breakfast and commence your exploration at the Pools of Beit Hasda, followed by a contemplative stroll along the path of Dolorosa. Along this sacred route, you shall traverse the 14 Stations of the Cross, culminating at Golgotha. Your journey unfolds with visits to Pilate's Judgment Hall, the Chapel of the Flagellation, the Ecce Homo Arch, The Tomb, and the Convent of the Sisters of Zion. A respite for lunch ensues. Thereafter, continue your odyssey to En Karem, where you shall visit the Church of Visitation and the mythical Dead Sea. Should the clock permit, consider an excursion to Lazarus's Tomb. Return to your hotel to conclude the day with a delectable dinner.

itinerary.title: Mount of Olives - Gethsemane - Bethlehem
itinerary.description: Following your morning repast, embark on a swift sojourn to the eminent Mount of Olives, where panoramic vistas of Jerusalem unfurl before your eyes. Subsequently, pay homage at the Garden of Gethsemani, the Basilica of Agony, the Tomb of St. Mary, the Church of St. Peter of Gallicantu, and Caiaphas. Transitioning from this spiritual pilgrimage, journey onwards to Bethlehem and partake in the pastoral splendour of the Shepherd's Field. A luncheon interlude awaits at a local restaurant. The subsequent highlights on your itinerary encompass the venerable Church of the Nativity, Manger Square, the Milk Grotto, the Crusaders' Cloister, and the evocative Milk Grotto. Conclude your day by returning to your hotel for an evening repast.

itinerary.title: Taba (Israel) - Sinai (Egypt)
itinerary.description: Commence your day with a delightful breakfast before venturing forth to Taba. Take time to explore the local attractions and pause for a leisurely luncheon at noon. Subsequently, fulfil all requisite formalities and proceed into the captivating realm of Egypt. There, set your sights on the majestic Sinai Mountains in the Sinai region. Upon your return to the hotel, relish a delightful dinner and retire for the night.

itinerary.title: Sinai - St. Catherine Monastery – Cairo
itinerary.description: Following a morning repast, set off on an enlightening visit to the venerable St. Catherine Monastery, renowned for housing a repository of ancient manuscripts spanning over fifteen centuries. Afterward, partake in a well-deserved respite and savour your midday meal at a local restaurant. Continue your journey to Cairo, where you shall embark on a memorable cruise along the storied waters of the River Nile. An onboard dinner awaits, and you shall then be transferred to your accommodation for a restful night's sleep.

itinerary.title: Sinai - St. Catherine Monastery – Cairo
itinerary.description: Begin the day by enjoying a nourishing breakfast and performing the necessary check-out procedures at the hotel. Prepare your belongings for departure and set out to explore the iconic Pyramids, age-old churches, and the renowned Egyptian Museum. Conclude your adventure by making your way to the airport for your departure.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Madurai
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Madurai Railway Station or Airport, our tour representatives will greet you and help you get to your hotel. After completing the check-in formalities, freshen up and relax in your room for a while. Later in the day, head out to explore the city of Madurai. Start off with Meenakshi Amman Temple which was built to celebrate the union of Lord Shiva and Goddess Parvati. Proceed to visit the Thiruparankundram Murugan Temple, which was built during the Pandya empire in the 8th century. Next, you will be taken to the Thirumalai Nayakkar Palace, which was built by King Tirumala Nayaka in 1636. Finish off the day by visiting the Gandhi Memorial Museum and Alagar Kovil.

itinerary.title: Madurai - Rameshwaram
itinerary.description: In the morning, check out of your hotel in Madurai and journey towards Rameshwaram. After you get done with the check-in process at your hotel, freshen up and head out to experience the many holy places in Rameshwaram. The first place you will be taken to is the Sri Ramanathaswamy Temple. Made up of towers, corridors, and intricate details, this temple is one among the 12 Jyotirlingas in India. Head over to Agnitheertham, which is situated on the eastern beach corner of Sri Ramanathaswamy Temple. The other places you will be exploring are Dhanushkodi, Ramar Padam, and Adam's Bridge.

itinerary.title: Rameshwaram - Kanyakumari
itinerary.description: Check out from your lodging after having your breakfast, from where you will be driven to Kanyakumari. Situated in the southernmost tip of India, Kanyakumari is a major pilgrimage centre. Upon reaching the coastal town, you can check-in to your hotel and then freshen up to explore the popular tourist spots in Kanyakumari. Experience the Vivekananda Rock Memorial which was built in honour of Swami Vivekananda. Offer your prayers at the Kumari Amman Temple, one of the 108 Shakti Peethas which is home to a statue of Goddess Devi Kanya Kumari. The other spots you will be taken to in Kanyakumari are Suchindram Temple, Gandhi Mandapam, and Triveni Sangamam.

itinerary.title: Kanyakumari – Trivandrum - Depart Trivandrum
itinerary.description: Enjoy a delicious breakfast in the morning and then leave Kanyakumari to move to Trivandrum. Upon reaching the capital city of Kerala, explore its many tourist attractions. These will include Sree Padmanabhaswamy Temple, Padmanabhapuram Palace, the Government Secretariat, and the Museum of History and Heritage. Later in the day, leave for the airport or railway station to go back to your hometown.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Madurai
itinerary.description: Upon arriving in Madurai, our tour representatives will greet you and help you get to your hotel. Once the check-in formalities are complete, head out to explore the city of Madurai. Start off with the Arulmigu Meenakshi Sundareswarar Temple. Also known as Arulmigu Meenakshi Amman Thirukkovil, the temple is dedicated to the goddess Meenakshi Amman Nayak. Visit Teppakulam and enjoy a light and sound show at Thirumalai Nayak Palace before going back to your hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: Madurai - Kodaikanal
itinerary.description: Leave for the hill station of Kodaikanal on this day. After checking-in to your hotel, head out to Bryant Park, which is home to a wide variety of plants and shrubs. Return to your hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: Kodaikanal
itinerary.description: Dedicate this day to exploring all the popular sightseeing spots in Kodaikanal. You will be taken to places such as Green Valley View Point, Coaker's Walk, Pillar Rocks, Shenbaganur Museum, Chettiar Park, and the many waterfalls that Kodaikanal is home to.

itinerary.title: Kodaikanal - Madurai
itinerary.description: Make your way back to Madurai from Kodaikanal. Experience the beauty of Alagar Kovil and peruse through the Gandhi Memorial Museum before getting back to your hotel in Madurai.

itinerary.title: Madurai – Rameshwaram
itinerary.description: Today, you will be moving to Rameshwaram, which is revered to be one of the holiest destinations in India. After reaching your hotel and freshening up, leave at noon to uncover the famous attractions of Rameshwaram. Visit the Ramjharoka Temple, Sri Arulmigu Ramanathaswamy Temple, Agnitheertham, Dhanushkodi, and Adam's Bridge. Spend the night at your hotel in Rameshwaram.

itinerary.title: Rameshwaram - Kanyakumari
itinerary.description: Make your way from Rameshwaram to Kanyakumari in the morning. Situated in the southernmost region of India, Kanyakumari is home to a range of culturally and historically important spots. Our tour representatives will take you to the Kumari Amman Temple, Suchindram Theroor Bird Sanctuary, Vivekananda Rock Memorial, Triveni Sangamam, and Gandhi Memorial. Breathe in the view of a gorgeous sunset at Kanyakumari Beach before heading back to your hotel.

itinerary.title: Kanyakumari – Trivandrum – Depart Trivandrum
itinerary.description: On the last day of your trip, you will be driven to Trivandrum. Stop by the Padmanabhapuram Palace on your way. The capital of Kerala has much to offer in terms of sightseeing. Make sure to visit the Sree Padmanabhaswamy Temple and the Government Secretariat. Later on, leave for the airport or railway station to board your flight or train back home.

packages.name: Spiritual South India Tour
packages.destination: Tirupati - Bangalore - Mysore - Ooty - Madurai - Rameswaram - Kanyakumari

itinerary.title: Tirupathi
itinerary.description: You will arrive in Tirupathi by train/air to begin your pilgrimage tour. Our tour manager will guide you to the hotel and complete check-in formalities. Spend some time relaxing in the hotel. In the evening, get ready for an optional sightseeing tour of Tirupathi. Spend the night at a hotel in Tirupathi.

itinerary.title: Tirupathi – Bangalore
itinerary.description: After breakfast, prepare for a darshan of the Sri Venkateshwara Swami Temple and the Padmavati Ammavari Temple in Tiruchanur. While the temple of Lord Srinivasa is atop the seven hills at Tirumala, the temple dedicated to Goddess Padmavathi is at Tirupati. It is believed that devotees must first visit Tirupati before seeking blessings from her consort, Lord Balaji. After darshan and lunch, head to Bangalore to continue with your South India spiritual tour package. The journey takes around 6 hours by train and around 4.5 hours by road. Check into the hotel and spend the rest of the day exploring places around it. Spend the night in Bangalore.

itinerary.title: Bangalore – Mysore
itinerary.description: After a hearty South Indian breakfast, head out for a city tour. Bangalore, or Bengaluru, is the capital of Karnataka. It was founded around 500 years ago by Kempe Gowda I, a Governor under the Vijayanagara Empire. While the old areas of the city included the neighbourhoods of Ulsoor, Malleshwaram, Basavanagudi, and Shivajinagar, Bangalore grew around these places over time. You will visit Cubbon Park, Tippu Sultan’s Summer Palace, The Mayo Hall, Attara Katcheri, Bangalore Palace, and the famous Bull Temple in Basavanagudi. Later, check out of your hotel and head to Mysore for an overnight stay. The journey takes around 2.5 hours by road. Check into the hotel to spend the night in Sandalwood City.

itinerary.title: Mysore – Ooty
itinerary.description: Mysore is Bangalore’s second-most populous city. It was founded in 1399 by two brothers, Yaduraya and Krishnaraya. The town gets its name from the demon Mahishashura, who is believed to have ruled the area and was killed by the Goddess Chamundeshwari. After breakfast, head out for a tour of Mysore City. You will visit Mysore Palace, Chamundeshwari Temple, Somnathapura Temple, Jagmohan Palace and Art Gallery, Lalitha Mahal, Sri Chamarajendra Zoological Gardens, and Brindavan Gardens. Later, check out of the hotel and head to Ooty. The journey takes around 3.5 hours by road. Check into the hotel and spend the night at a luxury hotel in Ooty.

itinerary.title: Ooty
itinerary.description: Ooty, or Uthagamandalam, is part of the Western Ghats and is often described as the Queen of Hills. The town is famous for its toy trains, scenic views of the surrounding mountains, lakes, gardens, and wildlife. After breakfast, you will explore some of Ooty’s top attractions, including the Botanical Gardens, Rose Garden, Doddabetta, Mudumalai Tiger Reserve, Pykara Falls, Avalance Lake, and Tea Factory. Spend the night in Ooty.

itinerary.title: Ooty to Madurai
itinerary.description: After a hearty breakfast, head to Madurai for your temple tour. The journey takes around 7 hours on the way, you will visit Dolphin’s Nose in Coonoor. Check into a hotel and freshen up. Later in the evening, visit the Madurai Meenakshi Amman Temple. After Darshan, go shopping at the stalls around the temple before heading to the temple. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Madurai.

itinerary.title: Madurai
itinerary.description: After a breakfast buffet, head out for a sightseeing tour of Temple City. You will visit the Gandhi Museum, Tirumalai Nayakar Palace, Vandiyur Mariamman Teppakulam, Rajaji Park, and Alagarkoil. After shopping and sampling some of Madurai’s famous street foods, spend the night at a luxury hotel in Madurai.

itinerary.title: Rameswaram
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head to Rameswaram for a pilgrimage to the Ramanathaswamy Temple. Check into the hotel and spend some time relaxing. Later, you can go on a sightseeing tour of Rameswaram. You will visit the Pamban Bridge, the many Agraharams around the temple, Dhanushkodi, and the Dr A. P. J Abdul Kalam Memorial. Spend the night in Rameswaram.

itinerary.title: Rameswaram – Kanyakumari
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head to Kanyakumari for the final leg of your South India spiritual tour package. The journey takes 5.5 hours. Check into a hotel and spend the rest of the day enjoying places around it. You will visit the Gandhi Memorial, the Thiruvalluvar Statue, and the sunset. Spend the night in Kanyakumari.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Today, you will experience the mesmerising sunrise and darshan of the Bhagavathiamman Temple. You will also visit Suchindrum Temple, Thiruvattar Adi Kesava Perumal Temple, and the Padmanabhapuram Palace. Check out of the hotel and head to Coimbatore as your South India spiritual tour package ends.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Madurai
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival in Madurai, our tour representatives will greet you and help you transfer to your hotel. After completing the check-in formalities, freshen up and relax for a while before leaving for a delightful day of sightseeing. Some of the spots you will be visiting are Meenakshi Amman Temple, Thiruparankundram Murugan Temple, Pazhamudhir Solai, and Teppakulam. Later in the day, enjoy a light and sound show at Thirumalai Nayak Palace. Stay overnight at your hotel in Madurai.

itinerary.title: Madurai - Kodaikanal
itinerary.description: In the morning, have your breakfast and check out from your hotel in Madurai to leave for Kodaikanal. After getting to Kodaikanal, check-in to your hotel and get some rest. Once you feel well-rested, venture out to head to Bryant Park, where you can partake in thrilling activities such as boating, horse riding, and cycling. Return to your hotel to get a good night’s sleep.

itinerary.title: Kodaikanal
itinerary.description: Popular for being ‘the princess of hill stations’, today you will be exploring the beauty of Kodaikanal. After having a delicious breakfast, you will be taken to the most beloved spots in this delightful hill station. The first spot will be Coaker's Walk, a manmade bridge that offers you a fabulous panoramic view of Kodaikanal. You will then be visiting Pillar Rocks, Chettiar Park, Green Valley View Point, and the many waterfalls that Kodaikanal is home to.

itinerary.title: Depart Madurai
itinerary.description: Have a filling breakfast and leave Kodaikanal to head to Madurai. You will then be leaving for the airport or railway station in Madurai to get back to your hometown.

itinerary.title: Arrival In Chiang Mai
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at Chiang Mai Airport, our representative will greet you and help you transfer to the hotel. We’ll leave you to refresh, briefly explaining the itinerary and the dos and don’ts of visiting the many temples. Chiang Mai is a beautiful city famous for its unique temples, chedis (stupas), boutique hotels, and night markets. It is also the best place for adventure activities like trekking, river rafting, and visiting the many hill tribes. You are free to explore the city at your leisure before returning to the hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Chiang Mai Temple Tour
itinerary.description: Your day begins early with a complimentary breakfast buffet at the hotel. Our tour guide will explain in detail the different temple styles and the differences between Thai, Burmese, Lanna, Sri Lankan, and Mon styles. Begin the tour with Wat Phra Singh, one of Chiang Mai’s most revered and oldest temples. You will admire the chedi’s striking Lanna architecture and the Phra Buddha Sihing statue here. Your next stop is Wat Chedi Luang, a 14th-century temple famous for its enormous stupa, which is around 282 feet high and 144 feet wide. The temple, which once held the holy emerald Buddha, one of the most sacred objects in Thailand, was destroyed in an earthquake. You can interact with the monks in the temple and ask questions about Buddha and Buddhism. But do not take their pictures without their permission. The next stop is Wat Suan Dok, a 14th-century temple blending Lanna and Burmese styles. The temple, today, houses relics of Chiang Mai’s royal family. Take a lunch break before moving on to the Chiang Mai Market, the largest and most famous market in Chiang Mai, selling a range of products like shoes, bags, handicrafts, and electronic items.

itinerary.title: Chiang Mai
itinerary.description: Begin the day with a scrumptious breakfast buffet at the hotel before proceeding to the Mae Tang Elephant Camp. Some attractions here include elephant shows, elephant rides, ox-cart rides, etc. You will drive through scenic roads and mountains leading up to the camp. Your next stop is the Sankampaeng Area, famous for Thai handicrafts like lacquerware, silverware, and famous Thai umbrellas. Return to the hotel in the evening for an overnight stay at your Chiang Mai hotel.

itinerary.title: Chiang Mai to Bangkok
itinerary.description: As usual, begin your day with a breakfast buffet at the hotel. Our tour representatives will transfer you to the Chiang Mai airport to board your flight to Bangkok, Thailand’s capital. Upon arrival, we’ll take you on a half-day city tour to explore the different temple monasteries like Wat Pho, Wat Trimit, and Wat Benchamabophit. The tour will also explore the famous gems and jewellery stores in and around Bangkok. Here, you can buy semi-precious stones like jade. Enjoy the rest of the day at your leisure. Stay overnight at a hotel in Bangkok. Wat Pho is famous for its giant Reclining Buddha statue and the city's largest temples. Wat Traimit is famous for its giant golden statue of Buddha, considered one of the biggest in the world. Wat Benchamabophit, also known as The Marble Temple, was constructed during the 1800s with marble imported all the way from Italy.

itinerary.title: Depart Bangkok
itinerary.description: After a scrumptious breakfast, move on to Indra Market to end your tour with some souvenir shopping. Leave Bangkok with beautiful memories of the city and its temples.

packages.name: Phuket Getaway – Bangkok Tour | Itinerary
packages.destination: Bangkok - Phuket - FantaSea Show - Phi-Phi Island Tour - Bangkok - Pattaya

itinerary.title: Arrive in Phuket – Phuket FantaSea Show
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at the Phuket International Airport, our tour representative will welcome you and assist with your transfer to the hotel. Phuket is a stunning island with breathtaking scenery. It is Thailand’s largest island and is named after the Malay word "Bukit." Phuket offers plenty of tourist attractions, including Chinese-Portuguese architecture, stunning beaches, street food options, diverse cuisine, and diverse activities. In the evening, enjoy cultural performances and Las Vegas-style shows at the Phuket FantaSea. Spend the night at the Phuket beach resort.

itinerary.title: Phuket-Phi Phi Island Tour
itinerary.description: Start your day with breakfast at the hotel. Board the Express Boat to Phi Phi Island. Explore the beautiful sights of Maya Bay and have a great time. If you're into snorkelling or the underwater world, the tour representative can take you to Coral Bay for swimming and spotting Nemo at Snorkeling Point. Have lunch and return to Phuket for an overnight stay at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Phuket to Bangkok to Pattaya
itinerary.description: Start your day with a quick breakfast and head to Phuket Airport. Catch a flight to Bangkok. Once you land at Bangkok International Airport, our tour representatives will be there to assist you. You'll then be transferred to Pattaya by coach. This charming city is situated on the east coast of the Gulf of Thailand, boasting beautiful sandy beaches, great shopping, and captivating tourist attractions. Originally a fishing town, Pattaya has transformed into one of Thailand's top tourist destinations. Upon reaching Pattaya, relax at the hotel for a bit. In the evening, attend the Alcazar show, also known as the Tiffany Show. This show is a delightful combination of art, costumes, and stage design. Enjoy the musical performance and return to the hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Pattaya
itinerary.description: Have your breakfast at the hotel. Prepare to explore the coral island with our tour representatives. Experience the vibrant coral and underwater world through a glass-bottom boat. Later, engage in watersports like sunbathing, water scooting, parasailing, snorkelling, and more. Enjoy your time here and return to the city for some shopping. In the evening, head back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Pattaya to Bangkok - Departure
itinerary.description: After a quick breakfast, visit Indhira Market for shopping. In the evening, our tour guide will take you to Bangkok International Airport for your departure.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Phuket – Phuket FantaSea Show
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at Phuket Airport, our tour representative will meet you and assist with your transfer to the hotel. Complete the check-in formalities, then rest until you are briefed on the next steps. Phuket is derived from the Malay word Bukit, meaning hill. It is Thailand's largest island, nestled in the Andaman Sea. In the evening, you will head to Kamala Beach to visit Phuket FantaSea, a 60-acre theme park with Las Vegas-style shows, shopping avenues, and cultural performances. Return to your hotel in Phuket.

itinerary.title: Phuket - Phi-Phi Island Tour
itinerary.description: Start your day with breakfast at the hotel. Head over to Phi-Phi Island via Express Boat. Once on the island, indulge in sightseeing at Maya Bay and have a fantastic time exploring. If you're keen on snorkelling or discovering the underwater world, the tour representative will take you to Coral Bay for swimming and snorkelling to find Nemo at the Snorkeling Point. Later, make sure to soak up the sun and have fun on the Sun Deck. You'll end the day with wonderful memories. Return to the hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Phuket - James Bond Island Tour
itinerary.description: Start your day with a quick breakfast before heading out for the James Bond Island Tour. James Bond Island is a well-known landmark in Phang Nga Bay, famous for its appearance in the James Bond movie 'The Man with the Golden Gun.' The bay is characterised by impressive limestone cliffs that rise vertically from the emerald-green water, attracting millions of tourists from around the world. After an exciting day, return to the hotel for a comfortable overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Phuket Departure
itinerary.description: Have your breakfast at the hotel, and then enjoy the entire day at your own pace. If you feel like exploring, feel free to venture out. In the evening, you will be transferred to Phuket International Airport for your departure flight.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Tokyo
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Narita, our tour representatives will greet you and accompany you to the hotel by bus. Enjoy your overnight stay in Tokyo.

itinerary.title: Tokyo City Tour
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delicious breakfast. Prepare for a guided sightseeing tour of Tokyo, where you'll explore Tokyo Tower, Akasaka Guest House, Meiji Shrine, National Diet Building, and more. Continue your journey to the Imperial Palace East Garden, Imperial Palace Plaza, Tasaki Pearl Gallery, Ginza Shopping District, Asakusa Kannon Temple, Sumida River Cruise, and Nakamise Shopping Street. Make sure to visit the Kappabashi, Ueno, and Akihabara areas. Return to the hotel from Harajuku Station for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Hakone
itinerary.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast before embarking on a tour to Mt. Fuji and Hakone. Head to the Tomei Expressway-Fuji, skyline-5th Station, and relish the breathtaking views. Enjoy a delightful lunch at Hakone Lake Hotel. Explore Hakone Sky Gondola and Owakudani Boiling Valley. Take in the serene surroundings with a boat cruise on Lake Ashi. Return to Tokyo by motor coach, arriving at your hotel for a wonderful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Kyoto
itinerary.description: Indulge in a tasty breakfast at the hotel before our tour representatives guide you to Tokyo Station. Board the express train to Kyoto and transfer to your hotel upon arrival. Take some time to unwind. In the afternoon, join a seat-in-coach tour to witness the beauty of Helan Shrine, Kiyomizu Temple, and Sanju-Sangendo Hall. Journey to Osaka via JR Rapid Train with our tour representative, arriving at Osaka Station. Settle in for a comfortable overnight stay in Osaka.

itinerary.title: Osaka
itinerary.description: Osaka is one of Japan’s most vibrant cities, famous for its cuisine, cherry blossoms, and nightlife. Begin your day in the city with a light and filling breakfast before heading out for sightseeing. Some of the top attractions you will explore include Osaka Castle, Universal Studios, Tennoji Zoo, and the Kyoto National Museum. Return to your hotel in Osaka for the night.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Start the day with a delightful breakfast and transfer to Kansai International Airport for your journey back home.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Hong Kong - Macau
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Hong Kong International Airport, our tour representatives will assist you in transferring to Macau via ferry. Once you arrive in Macau, you'll be taken to your hotel to unwind and relax. Enjoy your overnight stay in Macau.

itinerary.title: Macau Full Day Tour – Day 1
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delightful breakfast at the hotel. Explore the Ruins of St. Paul's Church and the charming Senado Square, which is the heart of Macau's urban life. Don't forget to visit the Portuguese Cathedral for a moment of reflection and blessings. Continue your journey to Na Tcha Temple, an integral part of the old city walls. Our tour representative will also guide you to the A-Ma Temple, a significant cultural site. As the day draws to a close, relish a delicious dinner at an Indian restaurant. Conclude your day by heading to the Venetian Hotel for a comfortable and enjoyable overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Macau Full Day Tour – Day 2
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delightful breakfast, then enjoy the freedom to explore at your own pace. Next, visit the renowned "House of Dancing Water," a creation by Franco Dragone, celebrated as one of the world's most spectacular show creators. With a staggering USD 250 million investment, the House of Dancing Water has become the latest global extravaganza. Return to your hotel for a restful overnight stay or spend the rest of the day exploring nearby places. Spend the night in Macau.

itinerary.title: Macau to Hong Kong (Disneyland)
itinerary.description: Following your morning breakfast, transfer to the ferry terminal and embark on a journey to Hong Kong. Upon your arrival in Hong Kong, immerse yourself in the enchanting world of Disneyland. Hong Kong Disneyland is a captivating destination filled with walking cartoon characters, delectable cuisine, and thrilling rides. Conclude your day with a satisfying meal at a local Indian restaurant before returning to your hotel for a peaceful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Hong Kong City Tour
itinerary.description: Following your morning meal, our tour representative will guide you on an exciting half-day exploration of Hong Kong Island. This journey will encompass visits to the renowned Victoria Peak and the Man Mo Temple, a cherished attraction drawing over 7 million visitors each year. Continue on to the Aberdeen Fishing Village, which offers a captivating panorama of trawlers, fishing boats, and yachts. Explore the beloved Repulse Bay and delve into its rich history. Your next stop will be the Hong Kong Jewelry Factory. To round off the day, experience the remarkable Madame Tussauds Hong Kong, a vast museum showcasing lifelike wax figures of celebrated personalities. Return to the hotel for a comfortable overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Departure from Hong Kong
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a hearty breakfast at the hotel, and then dedicate the entire day to shopping to your heart's content. In the evening, we'll arrange your transfer to the airport for your departure.
