itinerary.title: Arrival in Hong Kong
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival, you'll be warmly welcomed by our tour representatives, who will assist in your transfer to the hotel. Once settled into your accommodation, take a moment to unwind and relax. In the afternoon, prepare for an exciting half-day city tour of Hong Kong Island, which includes visits to the iconic Victoria Peak and the serene Man Mo Temple. This renowned tourist destination captivates over 7 million visitors annually. Following this, we'll journey to the Aberdeen Fishing Village, offering a picturesque panorama of trawlers, fishing boats, and elegant yachts. A visit to the popular Repulse Bay will provide you with insights into its rich historical significance. We'll also take you to the Hong Kong Jewelry Factory, where you can explore exquisite craftsmanship. Our next stop is the illustrious Madame Tussauds Hong Kong, a grand museum showcasing lifelike wax figures of famous celebrities. To conclude this vibrant day, we'll return to the hotel for your overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Exploring Hong Kong's Ocean Park
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a delicious breakfast at the hotel. Your dedicated tour guide will accompany you on a captivating Ocean Park Tour, where you'll have the opportunity to immerse yourself in the mesmerising world of marine life and partake in exhilarating rides on the cable car. This remarkable theme park boasts one of the world's largest aquariums, offering a breathtaking aquatic spectacle. The park also plays host to a variety of other enchanting attractions, including red pandas, giant pandas, charming sea lions, vibrant avian species, and playful dolphins. For the adventurous at heart, a thrilling array of rides awaits your exploration. After an action-packed day, return to the comfort of your hotel for a peaceful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Hong Kong Disneyland
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a delightful breakfast, and then embark on an enchanting journey to Hong Kong Disneyland. This wondrous destination is home to charming walking cartoon characters, delectable cuisine, and thrilling rides. For dinner, savour the flavours of a local Indian restaurant before returning to your hotel for a restful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Departure from Hong Kong
itinerary.description: Indulge in a scrumptious breakfast at your hotel and dedicate your entire day to a shopping adventure. In the evening, you'll be smoothly transferred to the airport in preparation for your departure.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Kochi
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at the Kochi International Airport/Kochi Railway Station, our tour manager will welcome and guide you to the hotel. Complete check-in formalities and spend some time relaxing at the hotel. Later, you will head out for a city tour. Some of the places you will visit include the Dutch Palace, Jewish Synagogue, and Santa Cruz Basilica. Don’t miss Vasco da Gama Square to see the Chinese fishing nets, aka Cheena Vala, introduced by Chinese explorers in the 14th century. Jew Town is also a great place to shop for crockery, antiques, and bronze and brass sculptures. Spend the night in Kochi.

itinerary.title: Kochi – Munnar
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel and head to Munnar. The journey takes around 4 hours and is often considered the Kashmir of South India. The hill station is famous for its sprawling tea estates, spice plantations, waterfalls, and beautiful valleys. Check into your hotel and spend the rest of the exploring places around the hotel and enjoying places around it.

itinerary.title: Munnar
itinerary.description: Enjoy a sumptuous breakfast before driving out to explore the tea estates and other places of attractions, including the Pothamedu View Point, Mattupetty Dam, Tea Museum, Kolukkumalai Tea Estate, Kundala Dam, Echo Point, Anamudi, and the Eravikulam National Park. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Munnar.

itinerary.title: Munnar – Kumarakom
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel and head to Kumarakom. The journey takes around 4 hours and is exceedingly beautiful. Complete the check in formalities at a resort on the banks of the Vembanad Lake. Later, join the tour manager for a relaxing backwater cruise. Spend the night in Kumarakom.

itinerary.title: Kumarakom – Alleppey
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head out to Alleppey for a houseboat experience. Check into the houseboat to spend the night enjoying the views of the tranquil backwaters. This is a luxury accommodation with a living area, air-conditioned bedrooms, and viewing decks. The experience also includes sampling freshly made vegetarian and non-vegetarian food made by chefs inside the houseboat. Spend the night in the houseboat.

itinerary.title: Alleppey – Kochi
itinerary.description: On the last day of your Kerala travel package, head out to Kochi. The journey takes around 1.5 hours. Bid adieu to the city as you board your plane/train to return home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Chennai
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival in Chennai, you will be greeted by our tour representatives, who will help you transfer to your hotel. Once the check-in formalities have been completed, you can freshen up and then leave at noon for a tour of the city of Chennai. Some of the spots you will be exploring are Parthasarathy Temple, Santhome Cathedral Basilica, Kapaleeshwarar Temple, National Art Gallery, and Marina Beach. Get back to your hotel to enjoy a good night’s sleep.

itinerary.title: Chennai - Tirupati
itinerary.description: After having your breakfast, leave for Tirupati by road. Upon reaching the holy city, you will be taken to witness some of the most popular sites Tirupati has to offer. Visit the Sri Venkateswara Swami Temple, Kailasakona Waterfalls, Kalyani Dam, Agastheswara Swamy Temple, and Chandragiri. Spend the night at your hotel in Tirupati.

itinerary.title: Tirupati - Chennai - Depart Chennai
itinerary.description: In the morning, have your breakfast and leave for Chennai. Head to the airport or railway station to leave for your hometown.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Kochi
itinerary.description: Welcome to the Queen of the Arabian Sea, Kochi. Upon your arrival, our tour manager will help you transfer to the hotel. Complete check-in formalities and head to visit the city’s top tourist attractions. Spend the night in Kochi.

itinerary.title: Munnar Tour
itinerary.description: Check out of the hotel and head to Munnar. Popular for its verdant tea plantations and wildlife, Munnar is a sight for sore eyes. You will visit Munnar’s famous attractions like the Mattupetty Dam, Eravikulam National Park, Anamudi Peak, Echo Point, Attukal Waterfalls, and tea plantations. Spend the night in Munnar.

itinerary.title: Munnar
itinerary.description: Spend the morning exploring tourist attractions in Munnar that you may have missed the previous day. Spend the night in Munnar.

itinerary.title: Munnar to Kumarakom
itinerary.description: Check out of your hotel in Munnar and head to Kumarakom. Some of the places you will visit in and around the village include the Vembanad Lake, Kumarakom Bird Sanctuary, Kumarakom Beach, and the Aruvikuzhy Waterfalls. Spend the night in Kumarakom.

itinerary.title: Kumarakom to Alleppey
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a hearty Kerala breakfast and head to Alleppey, the Venice of the East. The city is famous for its temples, backwaters, houseboats, and the coir industry. Check into your houseboat and enjoy a tour of the backwaters. Spend the night on the houseboat.

itinerary.title: Depart Kochi
itinerary.description: Check out of your houseboat to reach Kochi, from where you can board your flight or train back to your hometown.

itinerary.title: Kochi
itinerary.description: As you arrive at Kochi, our tour manager will welcome you and help you transfer to the hotel. Complete check-in formalities, and spend the rest of the day enjoying sights in Kochi. This includes visiting Jew Town, Mattancherry Palace, the Hill Palace Museum, the Chinese Fishing Nets, and Marine Drive. Enjoy the evening shopping for spices, coffee, handicrafts, banana chips, traditional sarees, cashews, and Ayurveda products. Spend the night in Kochi.

itinerary.title: Wonderla
itinerary.description: On the second day of your Kochi visit, check out of your hotel and head to Wonderla, Asia’s largest theme park with over 56 rides. In the evening, head to Munnar by road. Check in to your hotel and spend the night in Kochi.

itinerary.title: Munnar Day Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast, you will head out for a tour of Munnar. Some places you will cover include Echo Point, Power House Waterfalls, Malankara Reservoir, Rajamala, Kundala Lake, and other attractions. Return to your hotel to spend the night in Munnar.

itinerary.title: Thekkady
itinerary.description: In the morning, check out of your hotel and head to Periyar National Park. Other attractions include the Malampuzha Rock Garden and the Spice Plantation Garden. In the evening, head to Kochi as you bid adieu to Thekkady.

itinerary.title: Arrive In Shirdi
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at Shirdi Airport, our tour managers will welcome you and take you to the Sai Baba Temple, dedicated to the 19th-century saint who attained Samadhi in the city. You will then proceed to Nashik, home to the Trimbakeshwar Temple, one of the 12 Jyotirlingas. On the way, you will stop at Panchvati and visit some of its top attractions like the Kalaram Temple, Sita Gufa, and Ram Kund. Spend the night at Nashik.

itinerary.title: Nashik to Aurangabad
itinerary.description: Today, you will check out of the hotel and visit Shani Shingnapur, a temple dedicated to Lord Shani. The deity here is believed to be self-manifested and is worshipped in an open-air shrine without a roof. Spend the night in Aurangabad.

itinerary.title: Ajanta Caves
itinerary.description: Today, you will explore the Ajanta Caves, a UNESCO World Heritage Site comprising a collection of rock-cut Buddhist monasteries and prayer halls featuring exquisite murals, intricate sculptures, and other artworks. Spend the night in Aurangabad.

itinerary.title: Ellora Caves
itinerary.description: Today, you will explore Ellora Caves, a series of rock-cut cave temples and monasteries, most famous for the monolithic Kailasa Temple, built between the 6th and 10th centuries CE. You will also visit the Grishneshwar Temple and other tourist attractions in Aurangabad, including the Bibi Ka Maqbara and the Daulatabad Fort. Spend the night in Aurangabad.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Today, you will check out of the hotel and head home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Pune
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at the Pune Junction Railway Station/Pune International Airport, our tour manager will welcome you and help you transfer to Mahabaleshwar. Check into the hotel and relax for some time. You can spend the rest of the evening exploring nearby attractions or markets. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Mahabaleshwar.

itinerary.title: Mahabaleshwar Day Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast, you will check out and head to Mahabaleshwar. The journey takes around 4 hours, allowing you to enjoy the stunning views of the Sahyadri Mountains. Check into your hotel and spend some time relaxing. Later, you can go to Venna Lake, an artificial lake built by Shahaji Bhonsale, the ruler of Satara. Some things you can do around the lake include boating, horseback riding, and shopping. Spend the night in Mahabaleshwar.

itinerary.title: Mahabaleshwar Day 2
itinerary.description: Today, you will leave the hotel to drive to Pratapgadh to view the 17th-century fort constructed by Moropant Trimbak Pingle, Shivaji Maharaj’s Prime Minister. The famous battle between Shivaji and Afzal Khan occurred at the Pratapgadh Fort. Other attractions in Mahabaleshwar include Mapro Garden, Mahabaleshwar Temple, Krishnabai Temple, and the Panchganga Temple.

itinerary.title: Depart to Pune
itinerary.description: After checking out of the hotel, head to Pune. On the way, you will reach Panchgani, a beautiful hill station famous for its lush green hills and spectacular viewpoints.

itinerary.title: Arrive In Gangtok
itinerary.description: As you arrive at Bagdogra Airport, our tour manager will welcome you and help you transfer to Gangtok. The scenic journey takes 4 to 5 hours. Check into your hotel and spend the rest of the day enjoying the area around it.

itinerary.title: Gangtok Full Day Tour
itinerary.description: Today, after breakfast, you will explore places around the hotel. Some iconic attractions you will cover include Hanuman Tok, Ban Jhakri Falls, Sikkim Himalayan Zoological Park, Ganesh Tok, Enchey Monastery, Do Drul Chorten, and the Bakthang Waterfall. Don’t miss the ropeway ride to enjoy a panoramic view of Gangtok City.

itinerary.title: Gangtok - Darjeeling
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel and head to Darjeeling. On the way, you will cover the places you missed yesterday. Check into the hotel and head out to cover tourist attractions in Darjeeling. You will visit Tiger Hills, Tenzing Rock, Peace Pagoda, Padmaja Naidu Himalayan Zoological Park, Tibetan Refugee Self-Help Centre, and Batasia Loop. Spend the night in Darjeeling.

itinerary.title: Depart Darjeeling
itinerary.description: Today, you will check out of the hotel and head to the Bagdogra Airport to catch your flight home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Thiruvananthapuram
itinerary.description: Upon arriving in Thiruvananthapuram, our tour manager will help you check into the hotel. You will freshen up and head out to explore some of the city’s famous attractions, including the Padmanabhaswamy Temple, Thiruvananthapuram Zoo, Napier Museum, and Kovalam Beach. Spend the night in Thiruvananthapuram.

itinerary.title: Thiruvananthapuram - Kanyakumari
itinerary.description: You will head to Kanyakumari to visit some local attractions, including Padmanabhapuram Palace, Tiruparappu Falls, Adi Keshava Perumal Temple, Suchindrum, and the Nagaraja Temple. You will be on time at Kanyakumari to witness the mesmerising sunset. Spend the night in Kanyakumari.

itinerary.title: Kanyakumari
itinerary.description: Wake up to witness the magical sunrise at Kanyakumari. Later, head to the Vivekananda Rock, Thiruvalluvar Statue, and the Bhagavathi Amman Temple. You can also shop at the local Kanyakumari Market and Nagercoil, buying plantain chips, macaroons, and other snacks. Later in the evening, head to your home with beautiful memories of your holiday.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Delhi
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at the Delhi airport, our tour manager will welcome you and help you transfer to Agra. On the way, you will visit Mathura, the birthplace of Lord Krishna. Check into the hotel in Agra and spend the night in this beautiful city.

itinerary.title: Agra - Jaipur via Fatehpur Sikri
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel and head to view the Taj Mahal and Agra Fort. Later, you will drive to Jaipur, where you will visit Fatehpur Sikri. Some places you will visit in Fatehpur Sikri include Buland Darwaza, Panch Mahal, Diwan-i-Khas, Birbal Mahal, and Jodhabai’s Palace. Check into the hotel in Jaipur and spend the rest of the evening exploring the local markets.

itinerary.title: Jaipur Day Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head out for a full-day tour of Pink City. Some of the places you will cover today include Hawa Mahal, Nahargarh Fort, Jantar Mantar, The City Palace, Amber Palace, Jal Mahal, Jaigarh Fort, Rambaugh Palace, and Ramniwas Bagh. In the evening, visit Bapu Bazaar to buy local handicrafts. Spend the night in Jaipur.

itinerary.title: Jaipur - Delhi
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head to Delhi. Check into the hotel and relax before exploring some of Delhi’s famous attractions, including Qutub Minar, Jama Masjid, Old Delhi, Agra Fort, India Gate, Rashtrapati Bhavan, and Parliament Building. Spend the night in Delhi.

itinerary.title: Depart Delhi
itinerary.description: Today, you will visit Raj Ghat, Shanti Van, and Agrasen ki Baoli before shopping at Sarojini Market. Bid farewell to Delhi as you head to your hometown.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Srinagar
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Srinagar Airport, our tour representatives will greet you and help you get to your inn or houseboat. Freshen up and enjoy a shikhara ride on Dal Lake, which is the second-largest lake in Jammu and Kashmir. Proceed to explore Char Chinar Island and Nehru Park before getting back to your inn.

itinerary.title: Srinagar – Gulmarg - Srinagar
itinerary.description: After having breakfast, make your way from Srinagar to the town of Gulmarg. The name of the town literally means ‘meadow of flowers’. On your way, make a stop at the Apple Garden. Reach the hotel, get done with the check-in process, and then leave to explore Gulmarg. You will be taken to the Gulmarg Golf Course, after which you will be riding the Gulmarg Gondola, which is famous for being the largest and highest cable car project in Asia. Later in the day, drive back to Srinagar.

itinerary.title: Srinagar – Pahalgam - Srinagar
itinerary.description: Relish a delicious breakfast and then journey towards the town of Pahalgam. On your way, visit Awantipora and the saffron fields. After exploring Pahalgam, return to Srinagar.

itinerary.title: Srinagar
itinerary.description: Dedicate this day to exploring Srinagar. Witness the beauty of spots like Sri Shankaracharya Temple, Nishat Garden, Shalimar Bagh, and Cheshma Shahi Garden. Spend the evening at leisure.

itinerary.title: Depart Srinagar
itinerary.description: In the morning, depart for the airport to board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Jammu
itinerary.description: As you arrive in Jammu, our tour manager will welcome you and drive you to Katra. The journey takes around 1.5 hours and is absolutely stunning. Check into your hotel and spend the rest of the day exploring places in the neighbourhood. Spend the night in Katra.

itinerary.title: Katra - Vaishno Devi
itinerary.description: After breakfast, visit the Vaishno Devi Temple, a 700-year-old shrine dedicated to Maa Shakti. Return to the hotel in the evening to spend the night in Katra.

itinerary.title: Katra - Pahalgam
itinerary.description: After breakfast, drive to Pahalgam, a famous hill station famous for its lush green meadows and pristine waters. Check into the hotel and spend the rest of the day enjoying places around the neighbourhood. Spend the night in Pahalgam.

itinerary.title: Pahalgam - Gulmarg
itinerary.description: Today, you will explore places around Pahalgam, including Mamaleshwar Temple, Chandanwari, Deno Valley, Wadiy e Hajan, and the Shri Amarnath Cave Temple. Later in the day, you will visit Gulmarg. The journey takes around 3 hours. This beautiful destination is famous for its iconic attractions, such as the Gulmarg Gondola, a cable car ride, Strawberry Valley, Afarwat, and Drung Waterfall. Return to your hotel for an overnight stay in Gulmarg.

itinerary.title: Gulmarg - Srinagar
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head to Srinagar, Kashmir’s capital city, famous for its lakes, picturesque scenery, and gardens. Some places you will cover include Shalimar Bagh Mughal Gardens, Tulip Garden, Pari Mahal, Dal Lake, Hari Parbat, and the Nishat Garden. Enjoy a houseboat experience in Srinagar.

itinerary.title: Srinagar
itinerary.description: Today, you will cover the places that you missed yesterday. This includes the Floating Gardens, enjoying a boat ride in the Dal Lake, Lal Chowk, and Sinthan Top.

itinerary.title: Srinagar
itinerary.description: After breakfast, enjoy a beautiful shikara ride, visit the Sri Shankaracharya Temple, or go shopping. Or, you could do nothing and rest on the houseboat enjoying Kashmiri cuisine and some kahwa.

itinerary.title: Depart Srinagar
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel and return to the airport to catch your flight home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Srinagar
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at the Srinagar Airport, our tour manager will welcome you and transfer to the hotel. Check into the hotel and spend some time relaxing. Later, you will head out to visit the Mughal Gardens, viz., Nishant Bagh, Shalimar Bagh, Pari Mahal, and Chasm-e-Shahi. Return to the hotel to spend the night in Srinagar.

itinerary.title: Srinagar, Sonmarg, Srinagar
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head to Sonmarg to explore the Meadow of Gold, famous for its snow-peaked mountains and the meandering Sindh River. Some of the places you will explore include Thajiwas Glacier, Zoji La, Vishansar Lake, Gangabal, Gadsar Lake, and the Amarnath Cave Temple. Return to Srinagar to spend the night in the houseboat.

itinerary.title: Srinagar - Pahalgam
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel and head to Pahalgam. On the way, you will visit Mattan Lake and the Awantipora Ruins. The Mattan Temple was built in the 8th century and is one of the oldest shrines in Kashmir. Awantipora is famous for the historic temple built by King Awanti Warman. Check into the hotel in Pahalgam and spend the rest of the evening exploring places in the neighbourhood. Pahalgam is a quaint town popularly called Mini Switzerland and is associated with the famous Amarnath Yatra. Spend the night in Pahalgam.

itinerary.title: Pahalgam - Gulmarg
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel and head to Gulmarg. On the way, you will visit Chandanwari, Betaab Valley, and Aru Valley. The mountains are famous for their snow-covered peaks and dense Deodhar forests. Check into the hotel in Gulmarg and spend the rest of the day relaxing or enjoying neighbouring places. Gulmarg is called Meadow of Flowers, thanks to the thousands of daisies, bluebells, forget-me-nots, and buttercups that bloom in spring. Spend the night in Gulmarg.

itinerary.title: Gulmarg - Srinagar
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel and head to Srinagar. On the way, you will stop at Kungdoor for a gondola ride, where a cable car will take you to the Kongdari Station. Check into a houseboat in Srinagar and head out to spend the night in a shikhara.

itinerary.title: Depart Srinagar
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head to the airport as you bid adieu to Kashmir.

packages.name: Special Delhi Mathura Vrindavan Package
packages.destination: Delhi - Vrindavan - Mathura - Gokul - Mahavan - Govardhan - Nandgaon - Barsana

itinerary.title: Delhi - Vrindavan - Mathura
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at the Delhi Airport, our tour manager will welcome you and help you transfer to Vrindavan, believed to be the place where Lord Krishna spent his childhood. You will visit the Banke Bihari Temple, Prem Mandir, and the ISKCON Temple here. The Banke Bihari Temple is believed to have been established by Swami Haridas, the guru of Tansen. Later, proceed to Rangnath Ji Temple, which is dedicated to Lord Vishnu and Lakshmi Devi. Move to Mathura to enjoy a delectable vegetarian lunch. In the evening, you will visit the Dwarkadhish Temple, built by Seth Gokul Das Parikh and end the day with a Yamuna ji ki aarthi. End the day at a luxury hotel in Mathura.

itinerary.title: Mathura - Gokul - Mahavan - Govardhan - Mathura
itinerary.description: Today, after a hearty breakfast, you will head out to explore the different places associated with Braj Bhoomi. The first stop on the itinerary is Gokul, which is where you can visit the Gokulnath Temple. Lord Krishna is believed to have lived in Gokul before moving to Vrindavan, as Krishna had killed many demons, including Bakasura and Putana. The next stop on the tour is Govardhan, where Lord Krishna lifted the Govardhan Mountain. Some temples you will visit include Shri Giriraj Maharaj Danghati Mandir, Kusum Sarovar, and Shyam Kund. Continue your journey to Mahavan, where Lord Krishna played along the Yamuna River with his friends. Some places you will visit in Mahavan include Raman Reti and the Mathura Nathji Temple. Later, return to Mathura to spend the night.

itinerary.title: Mathura - Nandgaon - Barsana - Delhi
itinerary.description: Today, after breakfast, you will check out of the hotel to visit the Pavan Sarovar in Nandgaon. This is a sacred pond where the Gopikas and Gopas would bring the cows to drink fresh water. It is believed that taking a bath in Pavan Sarovar relieves a person from all sins. Move to Barsana, believed to be the birthplace of Radha. Don’t miss Prem Sarovar, a lake believed to have been formed by the tears of Radha and Krishna when they were separated. Later in the evening, head to Delhi to explore places in New Delhi before returning home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Geneva – Zermatt - St. Peter's Church
itinerary.description: After you land in Geneva, you will take a train to Zermatt. Once you reach Zermatt and complete the check-in process at your hotel, you will have the rest of the day to discover Zermatt. You can visit St. Peter's Church, also known as the English Church, a crucial part of the traditions and history of Zermatt. Spend the night at your hotel in Zermatt.

itinerary.title: Zermatt – Gornergrat – Matterhorn
itinerary.description: For the second day of your trip, take the Gornergrat Railway from Zermatt to Gornergrat, after which you can experience the mesmerising view of Switzerland’s most famous peak, the Matterhorn. Post this thrilling adventure, return to your hotel, and spend the rest of the day leisurely.

itinerary.title: Zermatt - St. Moritz
itinerary.description: Check out of your hotel in Zermatt and board the famous Glacier Express to make the journey from Zermatt to St. Moritz, a resort town in Switzerland’s Engadin Valley. You will stay at a luxurious ski resort in St. Moritz. Before reaching your hotel, you can visit Lake St. Moritz.

itinerary.title: St. Moritz – Zurich - Rhine Falls
itinerary.description: Head to Zurich from St. Moritz on the fourth day. After getting done with the check-in formalities, go out to explore the city of Zurich. From cobbled streets to museums and flea markets, there is much to see here in a day. Make sure to witness the biggest waterfall in Europe, known as Rhine Falls. Spend the night at your hotel in Zurich.

itinerary.title: Depart from Zurich
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrive In London
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Heathrow International Airport, our tour manager will welcome you and help you transfer to the hotel. Complete check-in formalities and spend the rest of the day in leisure, enjoying places around the hotel. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in London.

itinerary.title: London City Tour
itinerary.description: London is the capital of England and the United Kingdom and is renowned for its historic landmarks. The city has over four UNESCO World Heritage sites: the Tower of London, Maritime Greenwich, Westminster Palace, and the Royal Botanical Gardens. You will cover each of these sites on a guided tour. Besides the above places, you will also cover Buckingham Palace (covering the Changing of Guards ceremony), London Eye, London Bridge, The British Museum, St Paul’s Cathedral, Big Ben, Victoria and Albert Museum, Hyde Park, the Natural History Museum, Trafalgar Square, Kensington Palace, Borough Market, and the London Aquarium. Spend the night in London.

itinerary.title: London - Paris
itinerary.description: After a sumptuous English breakfast, head to St Pancras International to catch the Eurostar to Paris. The journey takes around 2.5 hours and, depending on the class of your travel includes snacks and drinks or a three-course meal. Upon arrival in Paris, our tour manager will guide you to the hotel and help with the check-in formalities. Spend the evening exploring the area around the hotel.

itinerary.title: Paris City Tour
itinerary.description: Paris, the capital of France, is located on the banks of the Seine River and is one of the world’s most beautiful cities. It has beautiful boulevards, haute couture, street-side cafes and bistros, and elaborate architecture. After breakfast, you will explore the city on an open-top bus, visiting some of Paris’ iconic attractions, including the Louvre Museum, Eiffel Tower, Notre Dame, Arc de Triomphe, Jardin du Luxembourg, Pantheon, and Palace of Versailles. The guided tour includes an audio guide in 8 languages and a complimentary lunch. Spend the night in Paris.

itinerary.title: Paris Disneyland Tour
itinerary.description: Disneyland is located about 32 kilometres from Paris and is Europe’s most visited theme park. It is home to some of the world’s best nature resorts, theme parks, and thrilling rides. Spend the day enjoying the rides and shopping for exclusive Disney merchandise. Return to your hotel to spend the night in Paris.

itinerary.title: Depart Paris
itinerary.description: Bid adieu to the world’s most romantic city as you check out of the hotel and head to the airport to catch your return flight home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Venice
itinerary.description: As you arrive at the Marco Polo International Airport, our tour manager will welcome and guide you to the hotel. After completing check-in formalities, spend the evening at leisure.

itinerary.title: Venice
itinerary.description: Venice is the capital of Italy’s Veneto Region and a group of 126 islands. It is famous for its centuries-old architecture, cobblestoned alleyways, and famous canals. After breakfast, you will explore the iconic attractions, beginning with the island of Murano, to learn how master craftsmen manufacture the famous handmade Murano glass. Later, you will head to the islands of Burano and Torcello. You will also explore Sant’Elena, an island on the eastern end of Venice. The city is also famous for its gardens, viz., Giardini Papadopoli, Giardini della Biennale, and Giardini Reali. The Lido Waterfront is a beautiful coastline that has been awarded the blue flag and has plenty of activities for tourists. Torcello is another island famous for its museum, the cathedral of Santa Maria Assunta and a 15th-century bridge located along Strada della Rosina.

itinerary.title: Venice - Florence
itinerary.description: After your breakfast, check out of the hotel and head to Florence. The journey takes around 3.5 hours and is a delightful experience. As you reach Florence City, our tour manager will guide you and help you transfer to the hotel. Some of the places you will cover in Florence include the Cathedral of Santa Maria del Fiore, Uffizi Galleries, Piazzale Michelangelo, and Piazza della Signoria. If time permits, you will also cover Pisa to explore the Leaning Tower of Pisa, Cattedrale di Pisa, and the Piazza del Duomo. Spend the night in Florence.

itinerary.title: Rome
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head to the train station to catch your train to Rome. The journey takes around 1.5 hours and is scenic as the train passes through agricultural fields. After checking in, you will head to explore Vatican City. This is a guided tour that will cover some of its iconic attractions, such as St Peter’s Basilica, the Sistine Chapel, the Gardens of the Vatican City, Saint Peter’s Square, and Castel Sant’Angelo. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Rome.

itinerary.title: Rome City Tour Day 2
itinerary.description: After a delicious Italian breakfast, you will head to explore the many Roman attractions. As one of the oldest cities in the world, Rome is rightfully called Eternal City. The city is considered to be the cradle of Western Civilisation, especially Western Christian culture. Some of the attractions you will cover here include the Colosseum, Trevi Fountain, Pantheon, Roman Forum, Piazza Navona, Spanish Steps, Villa Borghese, and the Arch of Constantine. Don’t miss the Jewish Quarter, where you can visit the Synagogue, the Tempio Maggiore di Roma, and the Jewish Museum. Spend the night in Rome.

itinerary.title: Depart Rome
itinerary.description: Bid adieu to Rome as you check out of the hotel and catch your flight to return home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Athens
itinerary.description: Welcome to Athens! Upon your arrival, our tour manager will welcome you and help you transfer to the hotel. Complete check-in formalities and enjoy the rest of the morning exploring neighbouring places. Later, you’ll visit Athens’ top tourist spots, such as the Acropolis Museum, the Temple of Olympian Zeus, the Parthenon, the Acropolis of Athens, the National Archaeological Museum, the Odeon of Herodes Atticus, the Temple of Hephaestus, Plaka, and the Roman Forum of Athens. In the evening, you’ll join the group for a dinner and music show, where you’ll savour delectable Greek food with live Bouzouki music. Spend the night in Athens.

itinerary.title: Mykonos
itinerary.description: Today, after breakfast, you’ll check out of the hotel and head to Mykonos by ferry. Our tour manager will welcome you to Mykonos and guide you to the hotel. Complete check-in formalities and head out to explore the island. Mykonos is a beautiful island famous for its nightlife, sunny weather, Cycladic architecture, and long sandy beaches. Spend the night in Mykonos.

itinerary.title: Mykonos Day Tour
itinerary.description: Today, you will explore places you missed yesterday, including the Aegean Maritime Museum, the Church of Panagia Paraportiani, the iconic windmills, Ornos Beach, Paradise Beach, Little Venice, and the Monastery of Tourliani. Spend the night in Mykonos.

itinerary.title: Santorini
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel and take the ferry to Santorini. The journey takes around 2 hours and offers a panoramic view of the landscape by the Aegean Sea. Check into the hotel and spend the rest of the day exploring the island. Santorini is one of the most visited islands on the Aegean Sea. It is famous for its whitewashed houses, old houses, churches, and fantastic shorelines. Enjoy your overnight stay in Santorini.

itinerary.title: Santorini Day Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast in the morning, explore Santorini with our tour guide. You will visit Akrotiri, Ancient Thera, Oia, Red Beach, Santorini Caldera, the Three Bells of Fira, and Pyrgos Kallistis. Spend the night in Santorini.

itinerary.title: Athens
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel and head to Athens. Check into the hotel and spend the rest of the day exploring the city's neighbouring markets. Spend the night in Athens.

itinerary.title: Depart Athens
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel and head to the airport to catch your flight to return home.

itinerary.title: Arrive In Athens
itinerary.description: Arrive at the Athens International Airport, where you’ll be greeted by our tour manager. We’ll help you check in to the hotel and explain the tour details. Spend the evening exploring places around the hotel. Spend the night at the Athens Hotel.

itinerary.title: Athens City Tour & Acropolis Museum
itinerary.description: Athens is renowned for its rich history, ancient ruins, and vibrant nightlife. It’s also the best place to sample scrumptious Greek cuisine. After a delectable breakfast spread, move on for a full day of the Athens City Tour. Some of the places we’ll cover during the day trip include the Panathenaic Stadium, the Prime Minister’s residence, the Temple of Olympian Zeus, the Hadrian’s Arch, the Parliament, the Memorial to the Unknown Soldier, the Temple of Athena Nike, and the National Library in Greece. We’ll break for lunch, where you can enjoy a scrumptious Greek lunch, which includes salads, grilled meat, sandwiches, and Ouzo. After lunch, we’ll cover the Acropolis Museum. This museum is consistently rated among the best in the world thanks to its iconic attractions, including the Parthenon Gallery and the famous Caryatids. The Hekatompedon is another popular attraction along with Propylaea. Spend the night in Athens.

itinerary.title: Athens To Mykonos
itinerary.description: After a hearty breakfast buffet, move on to Mykonos. The ferry ride takes around 3 hours, offering a scenic view of the Aegean Sea. Check into the hotel and spend the rest of the day exploring the neighbouring areas of your Mykonos hotel. Spend the night in Mykonos.

itinerary.title: Mykonos
itinerary.description: Mykonos is a world-famous beach destination visited by A-list celebrities from across the world. The town’s maze-like whitewashed streets and traditional houses make this place attractive. Some attractions you’ll cover include the Windmills, the Church of Panagia Paraportiani, and Paradise Beach. You can also explore the different street markets in Mykonos to buy cheap Greek souvenirs. Or, choose to visit Delos Island. Spend the night in Mykonos.

itinerary.title: Depart Mykonos
itinerary.description: Bid adieu to Mykonos and Greece as you head to the Mykonos International Airport to catch your flight back home or to the next leg of your Europe tour.

itinerary.title: Arrive In Athens
itinerary.description: Welcome to Athens! Upon your arrival at the Athens International Airport, our tour manager will greet you and help you transfer to the hotel. After you complete the check-in formalities, the tour guide will explain the itinerary in detail. Then, spend the rest of the evening exploring places in and around the hotel. Stay overnight at the Athens hotel.

itinerary.title: Athens City Tour
itinerary.description: After a scrumptious breakfast buffet, explore Athens. The city is over 3,400 years old, home to historic ruins, and generally considered the birthplace of Western Civilisation. Some places you will explore today include the Panathenaic Stadium, where the first Olympic Games were held in 1896. The next step in the tour is Maximos Mansion, the Prime Minister’s residence. Other attractions we’ll cover include the Temple of Olympian Zeus, the Hadrian’s Arch, the Greek Parliament, the Monument to the Unknown Soldier, the Constitution Square, the National Archaeological Museum, and Mount Lycabettus. In Athens, you cannot miss Athens’ most popular attractions, the Acropolis and the Parthenon. At the Acropolis Museum, you can enjoy the architectural masterpieces and the many statues.

itinerary.title: Athens To Paros
itinerary.description: After breakfast, catch your ferry to Paros. The journey takes around 3 hours and offers a scenic view of the Aegean Sea. Check in to the hotel and spend the rest of the day exploring nearby places.

itinerary.title: Paros
itinerary.description: After a breakfast buffet, head out to explore Paros, a beautiful city famous for its white marble quarries, golden beaches, hidden coves, and sun-drenched hilltop villas. It is also visited for its traditional villages and breathtaking landscapes. Besides exploring the beautiful scenery, you can visit Delos Island or the neighbouring Antiparos Island.

itinerary.title: Paros to Santorini
itinerary.description: After breakfast head to catch your ferry to Santorini. The journey takes around 2 hours and promises a beautiful view of the Aegean Sea and the surrounding islands. Check into the hotel and spend the rest of the day exploring places nearby.

itinerary.title: Santorini
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head out to explore Santorini, the famous island on the Aegean Sea. The island is home to the world’s most unique beaches, white-washed buildings, blue-domed churches, and dramatic cliffs. Santorini is a romantic getaway where couples take photos of the island’s famous Caldera and sunset. Spend the evening exploring this city and staying overnight at a luxury hotel. You can also opt to visit the city's volcanoes, hot springs, and multi-coloured beaches. Don’t miss the archaeological excavations at Akrotiri

itinerary.title: Depart Santorini
itinerary.description: Bid adieu to this beautiful city as you head to the Santorini International Airport to catch your flight back home or to continue with the next leg of your Europe tour package.

packages.name: Koh Samui Tour Package Itinerary
packages.destination: Bangkok - Koh Samui - Koh Samui Island Tour - Bangkok - Safari World

itinerary.title: Arrive In Koh Samui
itinerary.description: Arrive at the Koh Samui International Airport and move to your hotel with our tour guide to help you with the transfer process. The guide will also explain the itinerary and instructions about the dos and don'ts in a traditional Buddhist country like Thailand. Spend the day leisurely exploring the city or visiting the beaches. Spend the night at the Koh Samui hotel.

itinerary.title: Koh Samui Tour
itinerary.description: Koh Samui is a beautiful island with stunning beaches, waterfalls, temples, and spectacular viewpoints. We’ll help you explore the island and experience its nightlife throughout the tour. The tour will also include sessions at the many wellness spas in and around Koh Samui. Day 2 begins with a hearty breakfast buffet accompanied by exotic tropical fruits. Some of the places we’ll cover include: Grandpa and Grandma Rocks – The Grandfather and Grandmother Rocks are two of the most famous attractions in Koh Samui. These rocks get their name from their shape, which resembles male and female genitalia. Nathon Town – The place is famous for its old-wooden Chinese shops that sell various goods, including clothes, souvenirs, local bath products, coconut oil-based products, and home décor. Na Muang 2 Waterfalls – Na Muang 2 Waterfalls is a set of two waterfalls. While Na Muang 1 is more accessible and crowded, Na Muang 2 is about a 30-minute uphill walk from the first waterfall. Big Buddha Monument – The Big Buddha statue is within the Wat Phra Yai temple. The Buddha statue was built in 1972 and is especially beautiful during sunset. You can enjoy the rest of the day exploring the different local night markets like Bankrak and Chaweng Walking Market. Spend the night at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Koh Samui To Bangkok
itinerary.description: Board your flight to Bangkok, Thailand’s capital city. After you check into your hotel, our tour representative will take you for a half-day tour of the town. You will visit some of the city’s famous tourist spots, like the Wat Pho Temple, Wat Traimit Temple, and the Wat Benchamabophit Temple. Other places you must visit include The Grand Palace, Wat Arun, and Sea Life. In the evening, you can visit the many local markets like Chatuchak, Or Tor Kor, and Wang Lang to buy silk, jade, coconut oil-based products, trinkets, silver jewellery, and Thai snacks. Spend the night at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Safari World – Bangkok
itinerary.description: Safari World is Asia’s largest open-air zoo and home to hundreds of animals, including tigers, lions, elephants, and zebras. This drive-in park is split into two experiences. The first experience involves observing the animals in their natural habitat. The second section involves visiting the Marine Park or Water Park. Some of the attractions in the later section include marine life shows, aquarium visits, marine life exhibit visits, bird shows, jungle cruises, animal safaris, elephant shows, and adventure shows. Return to the hotel to prepare for the return journey the following day.

itinerary.title: Bangkok Departure:
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a breakfast buffet before visiting Indra Market to shop for souvenirs and traditional Thai handicrafts. Bid adieu to Thailand as you head to the Bangkok International Airport for your return journey.

packages.name: Scenic Thailand Tour: Koh Samui & Bangkok | Itinerary

images.alt_text: Scenic Thailand Tour: Koh Samui & Bangkok | Itinerary
Scenic Thailand Tour: Koh Samui & Bangkok | Itinerary

itinerary.title: Arrival at Koh Samui
itinerary.description: Your journey begins with your arrival at Koh Samui airport. A warm greeting awaits you, and you'll be smoothly transported to your hotel in Koh Samui. Take a moment to settle in and check into your accommodation. The evening is yours to enjoy at your leisure. Relax and unwind as you prepare for the exciting days ahead. Overnight stay at your chosen hotel in Koh Samui.

itinerary.title: Discover Koh Samui with a City Tour
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delicious breakfast, and then set off on a captivating Koh Samui City Tour. Immerse yourself in the island's rich culture as you visit its main attractions. This full-day exploration promises to unveil the beauty and charm of Koh Samui. After an exciting day of discovery, return to your hotel for a restful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Koh Samui - Ang Thong National Park
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delicious breakfast, and get ready to explore the enchanting Ang Thong, a marine national park nestled in the Gulf of Thailand within Surat Thani Province. This paradise comprises 42 stunning islands. After a day of discovery, retreat to your comfortable accommodation in Koh Samui for a restful night.

itinerary.title: Koh Samui - Bangkok
itinerary.description: After a splendid breakfast, bid farewell to your Koh Samui haven as you check out and head to Koh Samui Airport. Board your flight bound for Bangkok International Airport, where a warm welcome awaits. Transfer to your chosen hotel in the vibrant city of Bangkok, where you'll spend the night. Optional Tour: Chao Phraya Cruise – No Dinner (Additional Cost) For an extra touch of magic, consider the optional Chao Phraya Cruise with no dinner (available at an additional cost). Revel in the beauty of Thai cuisine, engaging entertainment, and breathtaking river panoramas. As you embark on this dinner cruise, let the historic temples and landmarks along the riverbanks captivate you. A buffet-style dinner, accompanied by a live band and talented singers, guarantees an unforgettable evening. Alternatively, you can upgrade to the Chao Phraya Cruise with dinner, adding a culinary dimension to your cruise experience. Immerse yourself in the splendour of the riverside scenery while indulging in a delectable feast.

itinerary.title: Exploring Bangkok's Rich Heritage
itinerary.description: Embark on a fascinating journey through the heart of Bangkok as you delve into the city's temples and cultural treasures. A major highlight awaits you at the Golden Buddha temple, where an ancient gold Buddha, standing at an impressive 3 metres tall and weighing five and a half tons, resides. This magnificent, seated image, dating back to the Sukhothai Period, is a true marvel. Next on the itinerary is a visit to the Marble Temple, or Wat Benchamabophit, a masterpiece of modern Thai religious architecture. The temple's main chapel, crafted from exquisite white Carrara Italian marble, houses a replica of Thailand's most beautiful Buddha image. Immerse yourself in the serenity and beauty of this iconic site. Overnight, find comfort at your hotel in Bangkok. Optional Excursion: For those seeking extra thrills, consider a visit to Sea Life Bangkok Ocean World (formerly Siam Ocean World), one of Southeast Asia's largest aquariums. Experience the innovative Shark Walk, where, instead of walking through an acrylic tunnel, you stroll above a tank teeming with five species of sharks. Alternatively, venture into the captivating world of Madame Tussauds Bangkok, a wax museum that brings you face-to-face with world celebrities, leaders, sports icons, artists, and even royalty. (Additional cost applies)

itinerary.title: Departing Bangkok
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a delicious breakfast, bidding farewell to the vibrant city of Bangkok. After checking out from your hotel, you will be seamlessly transferred to Bangkok International Airport for your flight home or to your next exciting destination.

packages.name: Sizzling Thailand – Phuket Tour | Itinerary
packages.destination: Bangkok - Krabi City Tour - Four Island Tour - Phi-Phi Island Tour - Phuket - FantaSea Show

itinerary.title: Bangkok to Krabi City Tour
itinerary.description: Upon arriving at Bangkok Airport, catch a flight to Krabi. Once you reach Krabi Airport, a transfer will take you to the hotel. Take some time to relax at the hotel. Enjoy your stay in Krabi with ample free time for personal activities. In the afternoon, embark on a city tour of Krabi to see some of the main tourist spots. Afterward, return to the hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Krabi - Four Island Tour
itinerary.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast at the hotel. Our tour representatives will guide you on a city tour to explore this beautiful island. If you love the sea and sun, then Krabi is the perfect destination for you. It's a captivating place squeezed into a small province. The main activities here include swimming, photography, sunbathing, snorkelling, and more. Have a fantastic time in the crystal-clear waters, under the sun, on the white powdery sand beaches surrounded by coconut palms. Return to the hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Krabi to Phi-Phi Island Tour to Phuket
itinerary.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast at the hotel. Travel to Phi-Phi Island via an Express Boat. Once on the island, relish sightseeing at Maya Bay and have a fantastic time exploring. If you fancy snorkeling or the underwater world, the tour representative will take you to Coral Bay for a swim and an opportunity to find Nemo at Snorkeling Point. Have your lunch and proceed to Phuket. Enjoy your overnight stay at the Phuket Hotel.

itinerary.title: Phuket - FantaSea Show
itinerary.description: After having your morning breakfast, get ready to explore Phuket city on your own. The name "Phuket" comes from the Malay word meaning "Hill." It's the largest island in Thailand, situated in the Andaman Sea. Upon arrival at Phuket Airport, our tour representatives will welcome you and transfer you to a beach resort for the rest of the day. In the evening, enjoy the FantaSea Show, then return to the hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Phuket Departure
itinerary.description: Start your day with breakfast at the hotel. Afterward, you have the entire day at your leisure or can venture out. In the evening, we will take you to Phuket International Airport for your flight departure.

packages.name: Mesmerizing Thailand: Phuket, Phi Phi Island & Bangkok Itinerary

images.alt_text: Mesmerizing Thailand: Phuket, Phi Phi Island & Bangkok Itinerary
Mesmerizing Thailand: Phuket, Phi Phi Island & Bangkok Itinerary

itinerary.title: Welcome to Phuket
itinerary.description: As you step off the plane at Phuket International Airport, our friendly team will be there to greet you and transfer you to your hotel in Phuket. Get settled into your accommodation, a true gem by the shores of the Andaman Sea and a sought-after tropical beach escape. The remainder of the day is yours to enjoy at your leisure. Your comfortable overnight stay awaits at the hotel in Phuket.

itinerary.title: Discover the Beauty of Phi Phi Island
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delightful breakfast before setting off on an exciting journey to Phi Phi Island by ferry. Immerse yourself in the timeless allure of its pristine white beaches, framed by majestic limestone cliffs and bathed in the shimmering glow of crystal-clear waters. Revel in the scenic beauty that surrounds you throughout the day. As the afternoon unfolds, you will return to the tranquillity of Phuket. Unwind and spend a peaceful night at your Phuket hotel.

itinerary.title: From Phuket to the Heart of Bangkok
itinerary.description: Enjoy a leisurely breakfast before making your way to Phuket International Airport to catch your flight to Bangkok. Upon landing at Bangkok International Airport, you will be warmly greeted and transported to your hotel in the heart of Bangkok. Check in and take a moment to settle in. The remainder of the day is yours to explore at your own pace. Relax and enjoy a comfortable overnight stay at your Bangkok hotel.

itinerary.title: Bangkok - City Exploration
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delightful breakfast before embarking on a fascinating temple and city tour. The highlight of today's exploration is the visit to the Golden Buddha temple, where you will encounter an ancient golden Buddha. This seated masterpiece, standing at an impressive 3 metres and weighing a staggering five and a half tons, dates back to the Sukhothai Period. Following that, you will have the opportunity to marvel at the Marble Temple, also known as Wat Benchamabophit. This temple stands as a modern gem in Thai religious architecture. Its main chapel, constructed in elegant white Carara Italian marble, is home to a replica of Thailand's most exquisite Buddha image. The Marble Temple is a must-visit for its serene beauty and cultural significance. After a day of exploration, unwind and spend the night at your hotel in Bangkok.

itinerary.title: Departing Bangkok
itinerary.description: Indulge in a delicious breakfast to kick-start your final day in Bangkok. Post-breakfast, you will be transferred to Bangkok International Airport, marking the end of your memorable journey. Safe travel!

packages.name: Discovering Tranquility in Thailand: Chiang Mai and Bangkok

images.alt_text: Discovering Tranquility in Thailand: Chiang Mai and Bangkok
Discovering Tranquility in Thailand: Chiang Mai and Bangkok

itinerary.title: Arrival at Chiang Mai
itinerary.description: As you land at Chiang Mai International Airport, our friendly team will be there to greet you and take you to your hotel in the heart of Chiang Mai. Once you've checked in, the day is yours to enjoy at your own pace. Relax and unwind as you settle into your accommodation for a restful night in Chiang Mai.

itinerary.title: Chiang Mai – City Tour
itinerary.description: Begin the day with a delightful breakfast before embarking on a half-day tour of Doi Suthep, a splendid temple. Explore Wat Suan Dok, a temple crafted by King Kuna, and Chiang Man Temple, the oldest in Chiang Mai, constructed by King Meng. Take a scenic drive around the historic city, admiring the City Moat and the Ruined City Gate. Next on the itinerary is a visit to Warorot Market, the largest central market, where you can immerse yourself in the vibrant local atmosphere. After a day filled with cultural and historical wonders, retreat to your hotel in Chiang Mai for a peaceful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Chiang Mai
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delightful breakfast. Today, the entire day is yours to enjoy at your leisure. Consider treating yourself to the Khantoke Dinner experience, which you can arrange independently. Spend the night at your hotel in Chiang Mai. Optional: Khantoke Dinner (Additional Cost) Indulge in the Khantoke Dinner, a unique cultural and culinary experience that showcases the charm of northern Thai traditions. This dinner and show combo let you savour authentic Thai cuisine served in a traditional manner – family-style on large platters at low tables. Relax on floor mats as you enjoy the feast. The entertainment includes captivating performances that display the diverse culture and traditions of Thailand, featuring dance and music from members of various hill tribes. It is an optional experience well worth considering for a memorable evening.

itinerary.title: Chiang Mai to Bangkok
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delightful breakfast before heading to Chiang Mai International Airport for your flight to Bangkok. Upon arrival at Bangkok International Airport, a warm welcome awaits you, and you'll be smoothly transferred to your hotel in the heart of Bangkok. Check-in and settle into the vibrant atmosphere of the city. Enjoy a relaxing overnight stay at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Bangkok - Discover the City
itinerary.description: Kick off the day with a scrumptious breakfast, followed by an exciting temple and city tour. The highlight of this exploration is a visit to the Golden Buddha temple, housing an ancient gold Buddha that stands 3 metres tall and weighs an impressive five and a half tons, dating back to the Sukhothai Period. Another fascinating stop on the tour is the colossal gold-plated Reclining Buddha in Chinatown, stretching an impressive 46 metres in length and 15 metres in height. Admire its beautiful inlaid mother-of-pearl soles, adding an extra touch of splendour. After the tour, the evening is yours to either relax or indulge in some fantastic shopping experiences. Retire for the night in the comfort of your hotel.

itinerary.title: Departing Bangkok
itinerary.description: Savour your last breakfast in Bangkok before bidding farewell to this dynamic city. You will be transferred to Bangkok International Airport for your journey back home or to your next exciting destination.

packages.name: Cameron Highlands and Pangkor Island
packages.destination: Kuala Lumpur - Cameron Highlands - Marina Island Jetty - Pangkor Laut Island

itinerary.title: Reach Kuala Lumpur - Petronas Twin Towers - KL Bird Park
itinerary.description: Once you land in Kuala Lumpur, our tour representatives will greet you at the airport and take you to your hotel. After you check in and freshen up, we’ll come to pick you up for the first day of your vacation. We’ll take you to some of the most popular tourist spots in Kuala Lumpur, including the Petronas Twin Towers, Batu Caves, the Petaling Street flea market, and the Kuala Lumpur Bird Park, a sanctuary covering over 20.9 acres and over 3,000 local and migratory birds.

itinerary.title: Cameron Highlands - Boh Tea Plantation - Cameron Lavender Garden
itinerary.description: Today, you will be transferred to Cameron Highlands, a popular getaway destination in Malaysia. After reaching Cameron Highlands, you will have ample time to freshen up before heading out. Visit the largest tea plantation in Southeast Asia, the Boh Tea Plantation. Founded in 1929, this plantation is the largest tea producer in Malaysia. You can also admire the vast expanses of lavender fields at the Cameron Lavender Garden. The garden also displays different types of lavender flowers and other tropical flowers.

itinerary.title: Cameron Highlands Butterfly Farm - Time Tunnel Museum
itinerary.description: The Cameron Highlands Butterfly Farm is home to numerous reptiles, butterflies, amphibians, and insects you can witness around this pretty farm. End the day by visiting the Time Tunnel Museum, which contains memorabilia and collectables that show what life was like in Malaysia during the pre-war era.

itinerary.title: Pangkor Laut Island – Jungle Trekking
itinerary.description: You will be transferred to Pangkor Laut Island on a speed boat on your fourth day. While there, you will stay at the gorgeous Pangkor Laut Resort. Enjoy a delicious lunch at the resort, after which you can head for some fun jungle trekking to explore the region's flora and fauna.

itinerary.title: Water sports – Sunset View Chalet - Fisherman's Cove
itinerary.description: Indulge in a water sport you choose, such as kayaking, paddle boarding, and wakeboarding. Go to the Sunset View Chalet in the evening if you would like to feed the hornbills. You can have dinner at one of the best seafood restaurants on the island, known as Fisherman's Cove.

itinerary.title: Coral Beach - Chinatown
itinerary.description: How about you relish relaxing by strolling around a beach and witnessing the stunning sky views? Coral Beach is the place to do so. Later in the evening, you can go to Chinatown and taste some scrumptious Chinese food.

itinerary.title: Depart from Kuala Lumpur
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

packages.name: Super Saver Package – Langkawi & Kuala Lumpur
packages.destination: Malaysia - Langkawi - City Tour - Day At Leisure

images.alt_text: Super Saver Package – Langkawi & Kuala Lumpur
Super Saver Package – Langkawi & Kuala Lumpur

itinerary.title: Arrive in Malaysia
itinerary.description: Welcome to Malaysia, a haven for tourists looking to enjoy a beautiful mixture of modernity and tradition. Upon your arrival at the Kuala Lumpur International Airport, our tour manager will welcome you and help you transfer to the hotel. After checking in, you are free to explore the area around the hotel. Later in the day, you can explore Kuala Lumpur. Some of the iconic attractions you will visit include the Petronas Twin Towers, Thean Hou Temple, Central Market, and Batu Caves. Don’t miss the Kuala Selangor Fireflies Tour, where you’ll find thousands of fireflies flashing lights while mating, thereby putting on a dazzling display. Spend the night in Kuala Lumpur.

itinerary.title: Kuala Lumpur - Langkawi
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head to the airport to catch your flight to Langkawi. This beautiful island is famous for its rainforests, wildlife, and pristine beaches. Upon checking into your hotel, spend the rest of the day enjoying sights and attractions around the hotel. Most hotels offer an array of water activities, including jet ski rides, kayaking, parasailing, and snorkelling. Spend the night in Langkawi.

itinerary.title: Langkawi Full Day Tour
itinerary.description: Today, you will head out to the city to enjoy a full-day tour of Langkawi. Some places you will cover today include the Langkawi Sky Bridge, Datarng Lang, Telaga Tujuh Waterfall, and the Langkawi Underwater World. Don’t miss Kuah Town and the Atma Alam Batik Art Village before returning to your hotel and spending the night in Langkawi.

itinerary.title: Langkawi Day 2
itinerary.description: Today, you will visit the mangroves of Langkawi and the geopark. The latter is marked as a UNESCO World Heritage site. Don’t forget to cruise through the Kilim River to learn about the delicate ecosystem while exploring sea eagles and caves full of bats. Later, you will learn more about the Cycad Langkawiensis, an antiquated palm variety that can survive over 1000 years. Don’t miss admiring the beautiful wildlife, including the Brahminy kites, peregrines, falcons, and white-bellied ocean birds. Spend the night in Langkawi.

itinerary.title: Depart Langkawi
itinerary.description: After breakfast, you will check out of the hotel and head to the Langkawi International Airport to catch your return flight home.

packages.name: Explore Amazing China with Beijing, Xian and Shanghai

images.alt_text: Explore Amazing China with Beijing, Xian and Shanghai
Explore Amazing China with Beijing, Xian and Shanghai

itinerary.title: Arrival in Beijing
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival in Beijing, you will receive a warm welcome and be transported to your hotel. The remainder of the day is yours to enjoy at your leisure. You will spend the night at your Beijing hotel.

itinerary.title: Beijing Exploration
itinerary.description: This morning, you will embark on an exciting journey to the awe-inspiring Great Wall of China at Juyong Pass. Here, you'll delve into the historical significance of this ancient structure, marvelling at its enduring presence as it meanders gracefully along the mountain ridges. Along the way, we will make a stop at the Jade Factory, return to the city to visit the Silk Factory, and have a photo opportunity at the Olympic Stadium. Your overnight stay will be at your Beijing hotel.

itinerary.title: Beijing
itinerary.description: Begin the day with your breakfast and hop on to a visit to Tiananmen Square and the Forbidden City, a remarkable collection of ancient structures, the largest and most comprehensive in all of China. This vast complex comprises an astounding 8,706 rooms, once home to an estimated 8,000 to 10,000 individuals, including 3,000 eunuchs, maids, and concubines, all situated within a sprawling 170-acre area. Later, explore the exquisite Summer Palace and enjoy some free time for shopping at Xiushui Market. Your overnight stay will be at a Beijing hotel.

itinerary.title: Beijing to Xi'an
itinerary.description: Start the day with a hearty breakfast. In the morning, we will assist you with your transfer to the airport or train station for your journey to Xi'an. Upon arriving in Xi'an, you will be greeted and transported to your accommodation. Later in the day, embark on a city tour that includes a photo stop at the City Wall. You'll spend the night at Xi'an hotel.

itinerary.title: Xian
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a delightful breakfast. Embark on a full-day excursion, starting with a visit to the Terra Cotta Warriors, followed by a tour of a pottery factory. Upon returning to the city, explore the Bell Tower Square, and set aside some time for leisurely shopping. You'll also be treated to a complimentary lunch. Spend the night at your Xian hotel.

itinerary.title: Xian - Shanghai
itinerary.description: Indulge in a scrumptious breakfast to kickstart your day. Later in the morning, make your way to the railway station or airport for a high-speed bullet train or flight to Shanghai. Upon arriving in Shanghai, you'll be greeted and transferred to your hotel. Enjoy a relaxing night at your Shanghai accommodation.

itinerary.title: Explore Shanghai
itinerary.description: After breakfast, you’ll head out to explore the city today. The itinerary includes a tour of the Jade Buddha Temple and the Tian Hou Silk Factory to learn more about their traditional silk-making process. The tour also includes a visit to Bund, a protected historical district famous for its classic colonial buildings from the 1930s. These buildings have been restored to their past glory and are now symbolic of China’s past and glorious present. The waterfront is spectacularly lit at night, displaying the city’s futuristic skyline. You’ll end the tour with a visit to the 88th floor of the Jin Mao Tower and some bargain shopping at Nanjing Road.

itinerary.title: Depart Shanghai
itinerary.description: Bid Zai Jian to Shanghai as you catch your train to the Pudong International Airport to catch your flight back home or continue with the next leg of your journey.

itinerary.title: Exploring Shanghai

itinerary.title: Departure from Shanghai

itinerary.title: Arrival in Beijing
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival in Beijing, you will be warmly greeted and then escorted to your hotel. The rest of the day is yours to enjoy at your leisure. Spend the night at your Beijing hotel.

itinerary.title: Exploring Beijing
itinerary.description: Today, you will start off on an exciting journey to the Great Wall of China at Juyong Pass. Delve into the rich history of this centuries-old structure, which winds its way majestically across the mountain ridges. Along the way, you will also visit the Jade Factory and then return to the city for a fascinating tour of the Silk Factory. En route, you will make a stop to capture photos of the Olympic Stadium. Tonight, you'll rest at your Beijing hotel.

itinerary.title: Beijing
itinerary.description: Begin your day by exploring Tiananmen Square and the Forbidden City, which is the largest and most well-preserved collection of ancient structures in China. The entire complex comprises a staggering 8,706 rooms, housing an estimated 8,000 to 10,000 people, including 3,000 eunuchs, maids, and concubines, all nestled within a vast 170-acre expanse. In the afternoon, you'll have the opportunity to visit the Summer Palace and enjoy some free time for shopping at Yaxiu market. Your overnight stay will be at a hotel in Beijing.

itinerary.title: Beijing - Xian
itinerary.description: This morning, we'll assist you in transferring to either the airport or the train station for your journey to Xi'an. Upon arrival in Xi'an, you'll receive a warm welcome and be transported to your hotel. Later in the day, embark on a city tour, with highlights including a visit to the City Wall (photo opportunity) and the vibrant Big Wild Goose Pagoda Square featuring a captivating fountain show. Your overnight accommodation will be at a hotel in Xian.

itinerary.title: Xian
itinerary.description: Start the day with morning breakfast. Today, you will embark on a tour to the renowned Terra-cotta Warriors, which marks one of the most remarkable archaeological discoveries of the 20th century. Here, you will encounter an army of thousands of life-sized warriors and their battle-ready horses, who have stood vigil for over two millennia, protecting the final resting place of Emperor Qin Shi-Huang. Following this captivating visit, you will explore the Arts and Crockery Factory, and you'll have the opportunity for some leisurely shopping at the vibrant Muslim Bazaar. You will spend the night at a hotel in Xian, with a delicious Chinese lunch included.

itinerary.title: Xian - Guilin
itinerary.description: Starting with breakfast, today, you will take a flight to Guilin, a city nestled amidst a picturesque landscape of mountains, lakes, and caves. Upon your arrival in Guilin, you'll be greeted and transferred to your hotel for a comfortable night's stay.

itinerary.title: Guilin
itinerary.description: Your day begins with a delightful morning breakfast and a visit to the Pearl Factory, where you can appreciate the beauty of these lustrous gems. Next, prepare for a mesmerising two-hour cruise down the Li River, where you'll be surrounded by the surreal beauty of limestone karst formations. Later in the day, we'll explore Yangshuo West Street, a charming market town, offering an opportunity for some delightful shopping. We'll spend the night at a hotel in Guilin.

itinerary.title: Guilin to Shanghai
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a delightful breakfast. In the morning, you will board a flight to Shanghai. Upon your arrival, our friendly English-speaking guide will be there to greet you and accompany you to your hotel. The remainder of the day is yours to explore the city at your leisure. You will spend the night at your hotel in Shanghai.

itinerary.title: Shanghai
itinerary.description: Kickstart your day with a scrumptious breakfast. Today, you will embark on a full-day tour that includes a visit to the Jade Buddha Temple and a Silk Factory. Next, you'll explore the Bund, a waterfront area adorned with beautifully restored colonial buildings dating back to the 1930s, which come alive with dazzling lights at night. After this, you'll ascend to the 88th floor of the Jin Mao Tower for breathtaking views and indulge in some shopping along Nanjing Road. You will spend the night at your hotel in Shanghai.

itinerary.title: Depart from Shanghai
itinerary.description: Savour a morning breakfast. Today's highlight is a journey on the magnetic train as you're transferred to Pudong International Airport for your homeward flight.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Hong Kong
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at the Hong Kong International Airport, you will be greeted by our tour representative who will help you get on a ferry that will take you to Macau. Check-in to your hotel and enjoy the rest of the day at your own pace.

itinerary.title: Macau
itinerary.description: After having your breakfast, head out to explore the city of Macau. Start off with St Paul’s Church which came into being during the 20th century and is designed in a gothic style. View the Senado Square, which forms a part of the UNESCO Historic Centre of Macau World Heritage Site. Pay your respects at the Na Tcha Temple and A-Ma Temple. Relish a delicious dinner at an Indian restaurant before heading back to your hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: Macau - Hong Kong - Disneyland
itinerary.description: Once you get done with breakfast, board a ferry back to Hong Kong. Freshen up at your hotel and then leave to make happy memories at Hong Kong Disneyland. Meet your favourite Disney characters, experience the thrill of various rides, and catch the attractive shows at this delightful theme park. Have your dinner at an Indian restaurant and go back to your hotel for a good night’s sleep.

itinerary.title: Hong Kong City Tour
itinerary.description: Today will be dedicated to exploring Hong Kong. Witness the beauty of Man Mo Temple and Victoria Peak. You will be taken to the Aberdeen Fishing Village, which was once the residence of thousands of fishing families who were given the title of ‘the floating people’. Experience the serenity of Repulse Bay, check out a jewellery factory, and end the day by visiting Madame Tussauds Hong Kong.

itinerary.title: Depart Hong Kong
itinerary.description: Spend the day at leisure after having your breakfast. Leave for the airport later in the day and board your flight back home.
