packages.name: Rocky Mountaineer – Breathtaking Mountains, Peaks and Glaciers
packages.destination: Vancouver - Kamloops - Jasper - Banff - Columbia Icefields - Calgary

images.alt_text: Rocky Mountaineer – Breathtaking Mountains, Peaks and Glaciers
Rocky Mountaineer – Breathtaking Mountains, Peaks and Glaciers

itinerary.title: Vancouver
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival, you'll be transferred from Vancouver International Airport to your hotel. Later in the day, you can enjoy an exciting 4D show called FlyOver Canada, which offers a gentle and immersive ride. This experience features chairlift-style seats that elevate you in front of a vast spherical screen, creating a captivating illusion of flying over breathtaking landscapes. You will spend the night at your hotel in Vancouver.

itinerary.title: Vancouver
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a delightful breakfast. Today, your adventure continues with a comprehensive Vancouver City Tour, followed by a visit to the Capilano Suspension Bridge. During the city tour, you'll have the opportunity to explore remarkable waterfront landmarks such as Canada Place, Robson Street for some shopping, English Bay, Stanley Park, Granville Island, Chinatown, and Gastown. Afterwards, you'll cross the Lions Gate Bridge, where you can catch a glimpse of the exclusive homes in British Property's area. Your journey then takes you to the Capilano Salmon Hatchery and, finally, to the Capilano Suspension Bridge, an impressive suspension bridge that spans the Capilano River. Capilano also offers other exciting attractions, including the thrilling Cliffwalk and Treetops Adventure. You will spend another night at your hotel in Vancouver.

itinerary.title: Vancouver to Kamloops
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a delightful breakfast. In the morning, it's time to check out from your accommodation and make your way to the train station. There, you will embark on an unforgettable journey aboard the Rocky Mountaineer Rail, indulging in top-notch hospitality as you travel from Vancouver to Kamloops. Along the way, you'll witness the breathtaking rushing waters of Hell's Gate in the Fraser Canyon, the awe-inspiring steep slopes, and the protective rock sheds lining the Thompson River. After an incredible day, you'll spend the night at a comfortable hotel in Kamloops.

itinerary.title: Kamloops to Jasper
itinerary.description: Enjoy a satisfying breakfast to kick-start your day. Today, the adventure on the Rocky Mountaineer Rail continues as you head towards the majestic Canadian Rockies and the province of Alberta. This leg of the journey will feature remarkable highlights such as Mount Robson, the towering peak within the Canadian Rockies, the picturesque Pyramid Falls, and the ascent over the Yellowhead Pass, leading you into Jasper National Park. Upon arrival in Jasper, you'll be transferred from the Jasper train station to your chosen hotel. Get ready for a good night's rest at the hotel in Jasper.

itinerary.title: Jasper
itinerary.description: Today, you will hop on the Explore Jasper Tour, where you will discover the stunning beauty and rich history of Jasper, nestled amidst the rugged peaks of the Rockies. The tour highlights include visits to Jasper town-site, Athabasca Viewpoint, Maligne Canyon, and Maligne Lake. At Maligne Canyon, you can take a leisurely stroll along its impressive 50-metre walls and learn about its unique underground water system. In the afternoon, you have free time to explore various optional activities such as White Water Rafting, the Jasper Skytram, a Cruise on Maligne Lake, Sky Gazing, and more. You'll spend the night at a hotel in Jasper.

itinerary.title: Jasper to Banff via Columbia Icefields
itinerary.description: This morning, after enjoying your breakfast, it's time to check-out and transfer to Banff via the breathtaking Icefields Parkway, renowned as Canada's most scenic mountain roadway. Along this route, you'll encounter glaciers, pristine lakes, and captivating waterfalls. Your journey leads you to the Columbia Icefields Discovery Center, where you'll embark on an exhilarating Ice Explorer Ride, taking you up the Athabasca Glacier. Afterwards, a coach will transport you to the Glacier Skywalk, an observation platform with a glass floor offering unobstructed views of the stunning Sunwapta Valley and the surrounding glaciers. Continuing along the Parkway, you'll have the opportunity to see the Crowfoot Glacier, Peyto Lake, and Bow Lake on your way to Banff. Your overnight stay will be at a Banff hotel.

itinerary.title: Depart Banff to Calgary
itinerary.description: Today, you will depart from Banff to Calgary. Begin your day with a delicious breakfast and complete the check-out process, leaving your luggage in the hotel's lobby. Your day will continue with an exciting exploration of Banff. This charming resort town is nestled amidst the majestic Rundle, Tunnel, Cascade, and Norquay mountains. You'll have the opportunity to visit several captivating highlights, including Bow Falls, Tunnel Mountain Drive, Surprise Corner, Hoodoos, Two Jack Viewpoint, and Lake Minnewanka. At Lake Minnewanka, you can choose to embark on an optional one-hour boat cruise, offering an excellent opportunity to observe the local wildlife and vegetation, including the intriguing Devil's Gap nestled at the foothills of the Rockies. For a more elevated perspective, you'll take a leisurely ride on the Banff Gondola, which will transport you to the summit of Sulphur Mountain. From there, you'll be treated to a breathtaking 360-degree panorama of the Bow Valley. Finally, your day will conclude with a transfer to Calgary Airport, where you will catch your connecting flight to your onward destination

packages.name: Armenia Getaway
packages.destination: Duration : 3 Nights / 4 Days Destinations : Yerevan City - Tsaghkadzor - Garni - Geghard - Vernissage

itinerary.title: Arrival at Yerevan City
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at the Zvartnots International Airport, our tour manager will greet you and help you transfer to the hotel. Check into the hotel and spend some time relaxing. Later, you will explore some of the popular tourist attractions in Yerevan City. Some local attractions you will visit include Republic Square, Northern Avenue, Opera House, Cascade Monument, and Swan Lake. Republic Square is the central town square built around 1977, while Swan Lake is a cherished landmark right at the heart of the city. To the uninitiated, Yerevan is an incredible city with plenty of parks, fountains, cafes, tree-lined boulevards, and a vibrant nightlife. It’s also called Pink City thanks to the many pink buildings made using naturally coloured volcanic rocks, After lunch, continue with your city tour by visiting the Genocide Memorial Park and the Mother Armenia Monument. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Yerevan.

itinerary.title: Yerevan – Tsaghkadzor – Lake Sevan – Yerevan
itinerary.description: After a breakfast buffet, head out for a day trip from Yerevan to the neighbouring Tsaghkadzor and Lake Sevan. Tsaghkadzor is a ski resort town attracting millions of people in winter and summer. Some of the places you will explore here include Kecharis Monastery. Lake Sevan is equally fascinating and popular as a blue-eyed lake. It is Armenia’s biggest water resource at 1990 metres above sea level. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Yerevan.

itinerary.title: Yerevan – Garni – Geghard – Vernissage
itinerary.description: After breakfast, continue your Yerevan day trip. You will visit Garni, famous for its Greco-Roman building, which was built in the first century by King Tiridates I. The temple was dedicated to Mithra, the Sun God. It is the only Hellenistic temple to survive in modern Armenia. You will then proceed to Geghard or the Monastery of the Spear. The town is located at the entrance to the Azat Valley. You will visit the Geghard Monastery and enjoy the views of the valley. This is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and a must-visit on your list. While returning to Yerevan, visit the Vernissage Market to shop for souvenirs such as silk scarves, handmade handbags, unique accessories, antiques, and carpets. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Yerevan.

itinerary.title: Depart Yerevan
itinerary.description: As your travel package to Yerevan ends, check out of the hotel and head to Yerevan International Airport to continue with the next leg of your journey or return home.

packages.name: Armenia Highlights
packages.destination: Yerevan City - Tsaghkadzor - Dilijan - Garni - Geghard - Vernissage

itinerary.title: Arrival in Yerevan
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at the Zvartnots International Airport, our tour manager will greet you and guide you to the hotel in Armenia’s capital city, Yerevan. Check into your hotel and spend the rest of the day exploring places around the area.

itinerary.title: Yerevan City Tour – Tsaghkadzor
itinerary.description: Yerevan, the capital city of Armenia, is also called Pink City because its buildings are made of naturally coloured volcanic rocks of pink, giving the entire town a vibrant hue. The city is also famous for its pubs, café, and restaurants that are open until early morning. You will visit Republican Square, Northern Avenue, the Opera House, Swan Lakes, and the Cascade Monument. The latter is an open-air museum. You can climb the museum's stairs to view the entire city. You will also walk through the Genocide Memorial Park and the Mother Armenia Monument. The latter is considered a female personification of Armenia – she seems to be watching over the entire city, guarding the country and symbolising peace and strength. After lunch, you will head to Tsaghkadzor Town. This popular tourist town is famous for its summer and winter tourism options. In winter, you can enjoy skiing and snowboarding; in summer, you can enjoy hiking, mountain biking, and picnicking. The place is also called the Gorge of Flowers owing to the colourful alpine meadows and the flowers that bloom in spring. The striking red-orange carpet of flora in autumn also makes it a great place to visit Tsaghkadzor Town. Don’t miss the ropeway in Tsaghkadzor, which will take you to the peak of Mount Teghenis for a breathtaking view of the alpine forests. Spend the night in Yerevan.

itinerary.title: Yerevan – Lake Sevan – Dilijan –Yerevan
itinerary.description: After a sumptuous breakfast, head out to Lake Sevan. This beautiful lake is in the heart of Armenia and is one of the highest-altitude lakes in the world, standing at over 1,900 metres above sea level. It is also one of the largest lakes in the Caucasus’. Some of the things you can do on Lake Sevan include taking a hiking trail, which begins at the Sevan Botanical Garden, to the mountain peak for an expansive view of the peninsula. The next stop on your tour is Dilijan. The place is famous for green blanket during spring and the forested slopes with orange, yellow, and red leaves. It’s also called the Switzerland of Armenia and the trail network leading up to the isolated monasteries on Parz Lake. Some of Dilijan’s famous spots include the Jukhtakvank and the Matosavanak monasteries. Don’t miss the fantastic food that’s usually locally sourced and organic. Some things you will enjoy in Dilijan include wild mushroom pizza and lamb served with plums and honey. Return to Yerevan to spend the night at the luxury hotel.

itinerary.title: Yerevan – Garni – Geghard – Vernissage
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a breakfast buffet before heading out for a day trip to Garni and Geghard. Garni is famous for the Garni Temple, a Greco-Roman building/mausoleum probably built by King Tiridates I and is dedicated to Mihr, the sun god. The next stop on your trip is Geghard, a town located at the entrance of the Azat Valley. The place is famous for the Geghard monastery, a medieval structure named after the spear that apparently wounded Christ on the Cross. The monastery and the surrounding viewpoints from the valley make the place worth visiting. Did you know the Geghard Monastery is listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List? As you return to the hotel, drive to the Vernissage Market to shop for souvenirs, including silken scarves, handmade bags, wooden chess or Backgammon board games, antiques, and carpets. You can also visit the Dalma Garden Mall to shop for trendy clothes, accessories, and shoes. Spend the night in Yerevan.

itinerary.title: Depart Yerevan
itinerary.description: As your Armenia holiday package ends, check out of the hotel and head to Yerevan International Airport.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Delhi
itinerary.description: After you arrive in Delhi, our tour manager will welcome you and drive you to Nainital. The scenic drive takes around 7 hours. Enjoy lunch at one of the many wonderful roadside restaurants on the way. Check into your hotel and spend the rest of the evening exploring places in the neighbourhood. You can also enjoy a boat ride on Lake Naini, which offers a panoramic view of the surrounding mountains.

itinerary.title: Nainital Full Day Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast, get ready for a full-day tour of Nainital. The town gets its name from the Naina Devi Temple, located on the edge of the Naini Lake. The hill station is famous for its serene lakes and lush green hills. You will visit Sat Tal, Bhim Tal, Naukuchia Tal, and the Naina Devi Temple. Enjoy a delicious Pahari lunch before riding a ropeway. In the evening, you can visit Mall Road to do some shopping. Spend the night in Nainital.

itinerary.title: Nainital - Corbett
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel and head to Corbett. You will stop at local attractions like the Woodland Waterfall and Lover’s Point on the way. Stop for lunch at one of the many roadside restaurants to enjoy some delicious Pahari food. The Jim Corbett National Park is part of the famous Corbett Tiger Reserve. It was established in 1936 to protect the endangered Bengal tiger. It is home to exotic animals, including the Asian elephant, sambar deer, chital, and the Asian black bear. Check into a hotel and spend the night in Corbett.

itinerary.title: Corbett - Haridwar
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head out to explore Corbett. You can join a jeep safari, go camping or trekking, and even enjoy rock climbing. Later, check out of the hotel and head to Haridwar. After your arrival, check into your hotel and relax. Later, you can join the Ganga ji ki aarthi at Har ki Pauri in the evening. Spend the night in Haridwar.

itinerary.title: Haridwar - Mussoorie via Rishikesh
itinerary.description: After an early breakfast, head to Mussoorie. On the way, visit Rishikesh to explore its attractions, including Laxman Jhula and Swarg Ashram. Check into a hotel and relax. Later in the evening, head to Mall Road. You can also take a ropeway ride on Gun Hill. Return to your hotel for dinner to spend the night in Mussoorie.

itinerary.title: Mussoorie
itinerary.description: After a sumptuous breakfast buffet, head out for a tour of Mussoorie. This beautiful hill station, also called the Queen of the Hills, offers a spectacular view of the Himalayas, including the Doon Valley and Siwalik ranges. Some places you will visit include Dhanulti, Mussoorie Lake, and Mall Road. Return to your hotel for dinner and spend the night in Mussoorie.

itinerary.title: Depart Mussoorie
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel and head to Delhi. On the way, you will stop in Dehradun, the capital of Uttarakhand. In Delhi, you can catch your train or board your plane to return home.

itinerary.title: Delhi - Haridwar
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Delhi, our tour manager will welcome you and drive you to Haridwar. The journey takes around 4.5 hours and is loved for its scenic views. Check into the hotel and spend some time relaxing. Haridwar translates to "The Gateway to Vishnu," as this is where pilgrims start their Char Dham yatra. Interestingly, Shaivites call this place Hardwar, as Har means Shiva, while Vaishnavites call it Haridwar, with Hari meaning Vishnu. The most auspicious place in Haridwar is the Har ki Pauri, which is believed to be the Ganges' exit point from the mountains. From here, the Ganges enters the plains. It is called the Brahma Kund, as legend has it that this is where a drop of amrit fell on earth when Garuda was carrying the Elixir of Eternal Life after Sagar Manthan, or the Churning of the Ocean. Spend the night in Haridwar.

itinerary.title: Haridwar - Rishikesh
itinerary.description: Today, you will visit some of the major tourist attractions in Haridwar, including the Daksha Mahadev Temple, Ma Anandmayi Ashram, Parad Shivling, Mansa Devi Temple, Chandi Devi Temple, Pawan Dham, Maya Devi Temple, Parmath Niketan Ashram, Bhuma Niketan, Shanti Kunj, Bharat Mata Mandir, and the Saptarishi Ashram. Later, you will proceed to Rishikesh. This holy city is situated at the confluence of the Ganga and the Chandrabhaga Rivers. Hindus believe that a dip in the Ganga river here washes all sins. Don’t miss the Triveni Ghat Aarthi, where the three holy rivers, i.e., the Ganga, Yamuna, and the mythical Saraswathi, converge. Spend the night in Rishikesh.

itinerary.title: Rishikesh - Delhi
itinerary.description: Today, you will explore major tourist attractions like Ram Jhula, the Beatles Ashram, Lakshman Jhula, and Gita Bhawan. Later, check out of the hotel and head to Delhi. Spend the night in Delhi.

itinerary.title: Depart Delhi
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head to Old Delhi to explore major tourist attractions like Red Fort, Jama Masjid, Raj Ghat, and Chandni Chowk. You can also explore attractions in New Delhi, including India Ghat, Akshardham, and Rashtrapati Bhavan. Later, you will head to the airport to catch your return flight.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Delhi
itinerary.description: Upon arriving in Delhi, our tour manager will welcome you and drive you to Nainital. The journey takes around 7 hours and is beautiful. Check into your hotel and relax for some time. Later, enjoy a boat ride on the Naini Lake to enjoy a view of the surrounding mountains. Spend the night at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Nainital Full Day Tour
itinerary.description: After a delicious Pahadi breakfast, you will explore the tour. Nainital is famous for its prestigious British-era educational institutions and gets its name from the revered Naina Devi Temple, which stands at the lake's edge. Return to the hotel for some hot dinner and spend the night in Nainital.

itinerary.title: Nainital - Kausani
itinerary.description: Today, you will head to Kausani via Almora. Kausani is a small village and a picturesque hill station with rich biodiversity. It is often referred to as the Switzerland of India, thanks to the panoramic view of the Himalayan Mountain peaks, including Nanda Devi, Nandakot, and Panchchuli. Some of the things you will do in Kausani include visiting the Gandhi Ashram, Bajinath Temple, Shawl Factory, and the Girihas Tea Factory, and enjoying various activities like rock climbing, rappelling, trekking, camping, and bird watching. Return to your hotel for dinner and enjoy your stay in Kausani.

itinerary.title: Kausani Full Day Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast, spend the day exploring places you missed on your tour yesterday, including visiting Bageshwar and the Rudradhari Falls.

itinerary.title: Kausani - Corbett National Park
itinerary.description: After breakfast, you will head to the Corbett National Park via Ranikhet. Other attractions you will visit along the way include Chaubatia, Hairakhan Temple, and Bhalu Dam. Ranikhet is another hill station with verdant landscapes and gorgeous views of the Himalayas. Chaubatia is famous for its terraced orchards, which grow apples, peaches, plums, and apricots. The Bhalu Dam is an artificial lake located about 3 km from Chaubatia. Check into your hotel and spend the night in Corbett.

itinerary.title: Corbett National Park
itinerary.description: The Jim Corbett National Park was established in 1936 and is part of the Corbett Tiger Reserve. It is home to a large number of tigers and over 50 other species of mammals. Start your tour with a jeep safari, gradually progressing to other activities like hiking, mountain biking, rock climbing, trekking, fishing, and bird watching. You can also visit the Garija Temple. Return you to your hotel to spend the night in Corbett.

itinerary.title: Corbett - Haridwar
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of your hotel in Corbett and head to Haridwar. This is one of the four holy cities that hosts the Kumbh Mela every 12 years. The city is located on the banks of the Ganga River and is famous for its temples, including the Mansa Devi Temple, Chandi Devi Maa Temple, and Har ki Pauri. Don’t miss the Ganga Aarthi or the Har ki Pauri.

itinerary.title: Haridwar - Mussoorie Via Rishikesh
itinerary.description: After a delicious local breakfast, head to Mussoorrie. On the way, you will pass through Laxman Jhula, Swargashram, and the Kunjapuri Camp. Check into your hotel and spend the rest of the day exploring the neighbourhood. Don’t miss shopping at The Mall and the ropeway. Return to your hotel to spend the night in Mussoorie.

itinerary.title: Mussoorie Full Day Tour
itinerary.description: Mussoorie is a beautiful hill station and is often called the Queen of the Hills, thanks to its splendid views of the Doon Valley and Shiwalik ranges. Mussoorie is also home to the famous Kempty Falls. Don’t miss a ropeway tour to Gun Hill, which is home to the second-highest peak of Mussoorie. Return to your hotel to spend the night in Mussoorie.

itinerary.title: Depart Mussoorie
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel and head to Delhi. On the way, you will visit Dehradun, the capital of Uttarakhand. After arrival in Delhi, you can catch your train or plane to return home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Vizag
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival in Vizag, our tour representatives will greet you and help you get to your hotel. After completing the check-in formalities, you can freshen up and venture out to explore Vizag. You will be taken to the Simhachalam Temple, Submarine Museum, Ramakrishna Beach, and Visakha Museum. Go back to your hotel or resort to enjoy a good night’s sleep.

itinerary.title: Vizag City Tour
itinerary.description: After relishing a scrumptious breakfast, head out to experience the city of Vizag. Our tour representative will enable you to experience Thotlakonda, Rama Naidu Studios, and Bheemili Beach. Breathe in the calmness of Rushikonda Beach before making your way to Kailasagiri, an enticing hill that offers a panoramic view of the city. Get back to your hotel to spend the night.

itinerary.title: Vizag – Araku Valley
itinerary.description: In the morning, check out of your hotel in Vizag and leave for Araku Valley. Visit the Borra Caves, which are famous for being India’s largest stalagmite and stalactite caves. Believed to be over 150 million years old, these caves came into being as a result of the Gosthani River. Wrap up your day by going to the Tribal Museum and Padmapuram Gardens.

itinerary.title: Depart Vizag
itinerary.description: Leave from Araku Valley and make your way to Vizag. View the Anantagiri Hills on your way before going back to your hometown.

packages.name: Jewels of Seychelles with Mahe
packages.destination: Mahe - Praslin - Vallée de Mai - Mahe Island

itinerary.title: Mahe - Praslin
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at the Mahe International Airport, our tour managers will welcome you and help you transfer to the ship terminal to board your ship to Praslin. Check into your hotel in Praslin and spend the rest of the day exploring places around your resort. Spend the night in Praslin.

itinerary.title: Praslin - Vallée de Mai
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head to the Vallée de Mai Nature Reserve. This is a UNESCO World Heritage Site famous for the coco de mer palm tree, the seeds of which are believed to be the largest in the world. The nature reserve is also home to unique wildlife species, including the Seychelles tree frog, the Seychelles chameleon, the Seychelles black parrot, and the bronze gecko. Return to your resort in the evening to enjoy a candlelight dinner beside the beach.

itinerary.title: Praslin - Mahe
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel and head to the Praslin Ship Terminal to board your ferry to Mahe. Check into your hotel and spend the evening at leisure. Spend the night in Mahe.

itinerary.title: Mahe Island Day Tour
itinerary.description: After a delicious breakfast, head out for a full-day tour of the island. Some iconic attractions include Anse Royale Beach, Anse Major, Victoria Botanical Gardens, Morne Blanc Trail, Takamaka Rum Distillery, and Beau Vallon Beach. Don’t miss the Jardin du Roi Spice Garden, where you can admire the different medicinal and herbal plants and fruits. Spend the night in Mahe.

itinerary.title: Depart Mahe
itinerary.description: After breakfast, bid adieu to Seychelles and catch your flight to return home.

packages.name: Santa Claus Adventure Rovaniemi | 4 Days Itinerary

images.alt_text: Santa Claus Adventure Rovaniemi | 4 Days Itinerary
Santa Claus Adventure Rovaniemi | 4 Days Itinerary

itinerary.title: Welcome to Rovaniemi!
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival in Rovaniemi by flight, a private car will take you from Rovaniemi Airport to your hotel. If you are interested, there is an optional tour (not included in the package) called Northern Lights Hunting by bus. It costs 99 EUR per person. During this 3-hour tour, you will be taken to the best spot to witness the Northern Lights, a spectacular natural event in the Arctic. Bring your camera and tripod to capture the beautiful colours. You will drive away from the city and its lights for about 30-45 minutes, depending on the weather. If you are lucky, you might even see the lights on the way. Remember, seeing the lights is not guaranteed, but they are often visible on clear evenings. Even if you do not see the lights, the Arctic starry sky is stunning. Seeing the lights is a bit like winning a small lottery – it is unpredictable but might happen during the trip! Be prepared for some pleasant surprises. The starting time of the tour might change. After the tour, you will spend the night at your hotel in Rovaniemi.

itinerary.title: Reindeer Farm & Santa Claus Village Adventure
itinerary.description: Start your day with a good breakfast. In the morning, we will pick you up and head to the beginning of your snowmobile safari. This safari is a chance for you to ride your own snowmobile through the forest trails around Santa Claus Village. Enjoy the beautiful winter scenery, and you will have a few stops to take in the snowy nature. After the snowmobiling fun, you will visit a local Reindeer Farm. Here, you will experience a short but exciting reindeer sleigh ride (about 700 metres). You will warm up in a comfortable Lappish tent called "kota," where you will be served hot Lappish berry juice and cookies. Participate in the mysterious Arctic Circle ceremony, where you will hear the Oldest Legend of Lapland. You will even receive the International Reindeer Driver’s License and the Arctic Circle Crossing Certificate. You will head back to the Arctic Circle for a buffet lunch at Santa Claus Village. After lunch, you will have free time to visit the Santa Claus Office and meet Santa on your own. Explore Santa Claus Village, send postcards from Santa’s Post Office, and check out the souvenir shops. The whole program lasts about 6 hours, with approximately 1 hour and 30-40 minutes of snowmobiling and 1 hour at the reindeer farm. For safety reasons, the average speed during the snowmobile ride is limited. Two adults will ride on one snowmobile, but if you prefer to ride alone, there is an extra charge. This tour is family-friendly, and children will travel in a sled pulled by the guide's snowmobile. After the adventure, spend the night at the hotel in Rovaniemi.

itinerary.title: Husky Safari
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delicious breakfast. Today, you will be picked up and taken to where your husky safari begins. Leave the city behind and immerse yourself in the enchanting forests of the Lappish wilderness! As you drive your own team of huskies, enjoy the breathtaking views of the Lappish forests and hills. The sound of the huskies panting and the snow under your sled create the perfect soundtrack for this adventure. Upon reaching the kennel, you will get safety and driving instructions. The trail's length depends on weather conditions and participants' skills, usually ranging from 14-20 km and taking about 1 hour and 30 minutes. Children ride in the same sled as their parents. After the ride, you will warm up with hot juice and cookies while hearing stories about the Husky farm. The entire program, including transfers, lasts approximately 4 hours. Spend the night at the hotel in Rovaniemi.

itinerary.title: Departure from Rovaniemi
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a tasty breakfast. Check out from the hotel in the morning. If you have time, you can explore the Arktikum Museum (optional tour, not included), located in the city centre. The museum's exhibitions take you on a journey through Finnish Lapland and the Arctic region, covering the history and culture of Lapland from prehistory to the 1970s. Learn about Arctic research today and in the future. Later, transfer from the hotel to Rovaniemi Airport.

itinerary.title: Arrive In London
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Heathrow International Airport, our tour manager will welcome you and help you transfer to the hotel. Complete the check-in formalities and spend the rest of the day exploring the city’s multiple attractions. Some places you will cover today include Madame Tussauds and a ride on the London Eye. After enjoying the breathtaking views of the city, head out to the luxury hotel for an overnight stay. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in London.

itinerary.title: London Full-Day Tour
itinerary.description: After a quick breakfast, head to the Hop On Hop Off Bus for a full-day tour of the city. This open-top double-decker bus offers a panoramic view of the city. You will cover the city’s main attractions in Central London, including the Tower of London, the Crown Jewels, The British Museums, The National Gallery, and Buckingham Palace. You can also walk along the River Thames or enjoy a scenic cruise on the river. Some major attractions you may visit include the Houses of Parliament, Westminster Abbey, Big Ben, Trafalgar Square, Piccadilly Circus, Downing Street, and St. Paul’s Cathedral. In the evening, check out the many iconic restaurants, cinemas, and pubs in Leicester Square, Spend the night in London.

itinerary.title: Around London
itinerary.description: Today, after breakfast, you will explore places around London. You will begin the tour by visiting Berkshire to explore Windsor Castle, move to Wiltshire to visit Stonehenge and finally visit the historic city of Bath in Somerset County. Some of the other attractions you’ll cover during these trips include St. George’s Chapel in Windsor, the Salisbury Cathedral and the many beautiful Cotswold villages in Wiltshire, and the Glastonbury Abbey and the stunning Pulteney Bridge of Somerset.

itinerary.title: Around London – Day 2
itinerary.description: Today, you will explore the historical attractions nearby London. You will begin the day with a tour of Oxford, a historical place famous for its architecture, culture, and history. Don’t miss the opportunity to visit Christ Church College in Oxford to see the fantastic locations of the Harry Potter movie. After lunch, you will move to Warwickshire to explore the many ancient inns in this county and visit Stratford-upon-Avon, Shakespeare’s birthplace. The Tudor-era homes in this town are noteworthy. Warwick Castle is equally magnificent, with gigantic towers, ramparts, and gruesome prison cells. Return to London to spend the night at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Depart London
itinerary.description: After a quick breakfast, check out of your hotel to proceed to the airport to catch your flight back home or continue with the next leg of your Europe tour package.

packages.name: Delights Of London & Paris
packages.destination: London - Madam Tussauds - Paris - Disneyland Paris

itinerary.title: Arrival in London
itinerary.description: Arrive in London and transfer to your hotel. Spend the rest of the day exploring the city at your own pace. Some of the shopping destinations in London include – Selfridges, Harrods, and Fortnum & Mason.

itinerary.title: London Full-Day Tour
itinerary.description: Explore London city with a Hop On Hop Off tour on a double-decker bus. Some attractions you’ll cover include Buckingham Palace, Trafalgar Square, Westminster Abbey, Big Ben, the Houses of Parliament, the Tower of London, Piccadilly Circus, etc. The Hop on Hop off tour involves 4D cinema and Leicester Square. Stroll along the River Thames and explore the vibrant Southbank area, home to the Tate Modern and Shakespeare's Globe Theatre. You can also cruise on River Thames or sign up for a show at the Kids Club. You may want to visit museums like the British Museum or the Natural History Museum or take a relaxing walk in one of London's beautiful parks, such as Hyde Park or Kensington Gardens. You may want to catch a show in London's famous West End theater district. In the evening, you can enjoy a final dinner at a traditional British pub or try cuisine from around the world in London's diverse restaurant scene.

itinerary.title: London Eye, Madame Tussauds, and Shopping
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a visit to the iconic London Eye, where you can enjoy panoramic views of the city. Visit Madame Tussauds to explore its lifelike wax figures of celebrities and historical figures. Afterward, explore the shopping districts of London, such as Oxford Street, Regent Street, or Covent Garden. In the evening, enjoy a leisurely dinner in one of London's trendy neighborhoods, such as Soho or Shoreditch.

itinerary.title: London to Paris
itinerary.description: Take an early morning Eurostar train from London to Paris (approximately 2 hours). Upon arrival, embark on a guided city tour of Paris. Check in to the hotel and spend the rest of the day strolling along the Seine and many Parisian cafes. When visiting the Louvre Museum, don’t miss the Mona Lisa. Paris is famed for its shopping galleries, including Galeries Lafayette on Boulevard Haussmann. Spend the evening at the Lido before retiring at a luxury hotel in Paris.

itinerary.title: Paris City Tour
itinerary.description: Today, we’ll cover the city’s famous landmarks, such as the Eiffel Tower, Notre-Dame Cathedral, Champs-Élysées, Arc de Triomphe, Place de la Concorde, and the Tuileries Gardens. Don’t miss a cruise on the river Seine and the Latin Quarter. Enjoy some free time to explore Montmartre and visit the Sacré-Cœur Basilica. You can indulge in French cuisine at a traditional Parisian restaurant in the evening.

itinerary.title: Disneyland Paris
itinerary.description: Enjoy a full day at Disneyland Paris, just outside the city. Experience the magic of Disneyland by exploring both Disneyland Park and Walt Disney Studios Park. Enjoy thrilling rides, meet your favorite Disney characters, and watch enchanting shows throughout the day. You can watch the spectacular Disney Illuminations nighttime show in the evening before returning to your hotel in Paris.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Check out of your hotel and transfer to the airport for your departure from Paris.

packages.name: London Paris Amsterdam
packages.destination: London - Madam Tussauds - Paris - Disneyland - Amsterdam

itinerary.title: Arrival in London
itinerary.description: Arrive in London and transfer to your hotel. Take some time to rest and recover from your journey. In the evening, explore the vibrant streets of London and indulge in some local cuisine. Don’t miss out on Oxford Street, famous for Selfridges, Primark, and John Lewis. Knightsbridge is equally famous for Harrods and Harvey Nichols.

itinerary.title: Full Day Tour Of London
itinerary.description: Discover London with a Hop On Hop Off tour, covering all the main attractions in the city. Begin your day with a visit to the iconic Tower of London and witness the Crown Jewels. Take a cruise along River Thames to see famous landmarks such as the Houses of Parliament, Big Ben, Westminster Abbey, Piccadilly Circus, Buckingham Palace, and the London Eye. Explore the Natural History Museum, British Museum, home to a vast collection of historical artifacts. In the evening, enjoy a West End theatre show or take a stroll in Covent Garden.

itinerary.title: London Eye And Madame Tussauds
itinerary.description: Today, you’ll be visiting the London Eye and Madame Tussauds. The London Eye is the world’s largest cantilevered observation wheel and a great way for a panoramic view of London. Madame Tussauds is another must-visit attraction with hundreds of lifelike wax figures of famous celebrities, including the Royal Family, Hollywood actors and directors, and politicians. Your ticket also includes a 4D cinema experience. In the evening, visit Leicester Square where there’s plenty of see and do, including restaurants, clubs, and cinemas.

itinerary.title: London to Paris
itinerary.description: Depart from London and travel to Paris via the Eurostar train. Arrive in Paris and transfer to your hotel. Spend the afternoon exploring the charming streets of Montmartre and visit the Sacré-Cœur Basilica for panoramic views of the city. In the evening, take a relaxing boat cruise along the Seine River to admire the illuminated landmarks. Don’t miss the many Parisian cafes on Boulevard Haussmann.

itinerary.title: Sightseeing in Paris
itinerary.description: Visit the iconic Eiffel Tower and enjoy breathtaking views from its observation decks. Explore the Louvre Museum, home to famous masterpieces like the Mona Lisa. Take a stroll along the Champs-Élysées and stop by the Arc de Triomphe. Don’t miss the Place de la Concorde, Les Invalides, the Tuileries Gardens, and the Latin Quarter. In the evening, savor delicious French cuisine at a local restaurant.

itinerary.title: Disneyland Paris
itinerary.description: Today is devoted to exploring Disneyland Paris. The journey from Paris to Chessy (Disneyland) takes around an hour. Don’t miss Disneyland Paris Park where you’ll meet all the famous Disney characters. The ticket also includes access to Walt Disney Studios Park for a behind the scene access to the studio’s movies, cartoon shows, and TV shows. Head back to Paris and spend the night at a luxury hotel in Paris.

itinerary.title: Paris to Amsterdam
itinerary.description: Travel from Paris to Amsterdam by train. Arrive in Amsterdam and transfer to your hotel. Visit the Anne Frank House to learn about the poignant history of World War II. Take a leisurely canal cruise to admire the beautiful architecture and charming canals of the city.

itinerary.title: Sightseeing in Amsterdam
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a Hop On Hop Off tour of the City of Canals. You will explore the famous Van Gogh Museum, housing an extensive collection of the artist's works. Visit the Rijksmuseum to see masterpieces by Dutch painters such as Rembrandt and Vermeer. Wander through the vibrant neighbourhood of Jordaan and visit the Anne Frank statue. Your ticket also includes a canal cruise where you’ll be sailing through wonderful old buildings, canal houses, and bridges. In the evening, experience Amsterdam's lively nightlife or enjoy a traditional Dutch meal.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Enjoy some free time in Amsterdam for shopping or sightseeing. Transfer to the airport for your departure or continue your journey to other destinations.

itinerary.title: Arrival in London
itinerary.description: Arrive in London and transfer to your hotel. Spend the day exploring the city at your leisure. Visit popular attractions such as the Tower of London and Buckingham Palace, or stroll along the River Thames. You can also explore the city’s multiple shopping avenues, like Oxford Street, famous for Selfridges and Primark, and Knightsbridge, famous for Harrods and Harvey Nichols.

itinerary.title: London Full-Day Tour
itinerary.description: Your London tour involves a Hop On Hop Off tour where you’ll visit this historic city's iconic monuments. You’ll visit iconic landmarks like Big Ben, Westminster Abbey, and the British Museum. Enjoy a leisurely walk through Hyde Park or explore the trendy neighborhoods of Notting Hill or Camden Town. Some of the other attractions we’ll cover include Piccadilly Circus, the Houses of Parliament, the London Eye, Madame Tussauds, and St. Paul’s Cathedral.

itinerary.title: London to Paris
itinerary.description: Depart from London and travel to Paris via the Eurostar train. The journey takes around two hours and thirty minutes, and the best way to travel to Paris. Arrive in Paris and check into your hotel. Spend the evening exploring the city's charming streets and trying delicious French cuisine. You can stroll along the Seine or the Champs Elysees and stop for a break at one of Paris’ famous cafes. Don’t miss the Louvre and its famous attraction, the Mona Lisa. Paris is equally famous for Galeries Lafayette and other shopping destinations at Boulevard Haussman. Finish the day with a cabaret performance at the Lido and stay overnight at a luxury hotel.

itinerary.title: Paris Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Enjoy a full day of sightseeing in Paris. Visit the Eiffel Tower, Notre Dame Cathedral, Arc de Triomphe, Place de la Concorde, Les Invalides, Tuileries Gardens, and other places. Take a cruise along the Seine River to admire the city's beautiful architecture.

itinerary.title: Paris to Interlaken
itinerary.description: Travel from Paris to Interlaken by train. Arrive in Interlaken and check into your hotel. Spend the evening exploring the picturesque town and enjoying stunning views of the Swiss Alps.

itinerary.title: Interlaken and Jungfrau Region
itinerary.description: Take a day trip to the Jungfrau Region, known for its breathtaking mountain scenery. You’ll visit Grindelwald, the famous mountain resort, and take a cogwheel train for a ride via Kleine Scheidegg to Jungfraujoch. Visit the "Top of Europe" at Jungfraujoch, the highest railway station in Europe. Enjoy activities like hiking, skiing, or simply taking in the panoramic views of the Swiss Alps. Don’t miss the triple peaks of Eiger, Monch, and Jungfrau, the Sphinx Observation Terrace, and Europe’s longest glacier, the Aletsch Glacier and Ice Palace.

itinerary.title: Interlaken to Lucerne
itinerary.description: Travel from Interlaken to Lucerne by train. Upon arrival, check into your hotel and explore the city. Visit the famous Chapel Bridge, the Lion Monument, and explore the charming old town.

itinerary.title: Lucerne and Mount Titlis
itinerary.description: Take a day trip to Mount Titlis, one of Switzerland's most scenic mountains. Ride the cogwheel railway to the summit and enjoy stunning views of the surrounding lakes and mountains. Enjoy the cable car ride on Rotair, the world’s first revolving cable car, for a panoramic view of the glacier and ice boulders. Don’t miss the Ice Grotto and Ice Flyer. Return to Lucerne and spend the evening at your leisure.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Depart from Lucerne and transfer to the airport for your departure.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Delhi - Jim Corbett National Park
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at the airport or railway station in Delhi, our tour representatives will greet you at the airport and help you get to your resort at the Jim Corbett National Park. You can spend the rest of the day at your own pace.

itinerary.title: Jim Corbett National Park
itinerary.description: In the morning, get ready to experience the flora and fauna of Jim Corbett National Park. You will be taken on a jeep safari where you can lay your eyes on wildlife such as tigers, leopards, elephants, jackals, rabbits, langurs, and more. Spend the evening at leisure.

itinerary.title: Jim Corbett National Park - Nainital
itinerary.description: On this day, you will be making your way to Nainital. Known as the ‘The City of Lakes’, this quaint town is surrounded by seven hills. After reaching your hotel, complete the check-in process and relax for a while. In the afternoon, head out to Naina Peak, the highest peak in Nainital, which offers the most mesmerising view of the Himalayas. Later on, go to Naini Lake to enjoy a round of boating or a cable car ride.

itinerary.title: Nainital - Mussoorie
itinerary.description: Bid goodbye to Nainital to say hello to Mussoorie, which is lovingly called the ‘Queen of the Hills’. After freshening up at your hotel, visit some of the most popular tourist attractions in Mussoorie, such as Company Garden, Gun Hill, and Mall Road.

itinerary.title: Mussoorie – Delhi - Depart Delhi
itinerary.description: Enjoy a delicious breakfast in the morning, and then leave for Delhi to board your train or flight back to your hometown.

packages.name: Magical Andaman Islands

itinerary.title: Arrive in Port Blair
itinerary.description: Our tour manager will welcome and guide you to the hotel when you arrive at the Veer Savarkar International Airport in Port Blair. Complete the check-in formalities and get some rest before leaving for a full-day tour of Port Blair. Port Blair is the capital of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands and is famous for its historical buildings, panoramic scenery, and water-based activities. You will cover Cellular Jail, Corbyn’s Cove, the Naval Marine Museum, the Anthropological Museum, and the Chidiya Tapu Beach. In the evening, enjoy a light and sound show at Cellular Jail, which will bring to life the incidents surrounding the freedom struggle.

itinerary.title: Port Blair - Baratang Island
itinerary.description: Today, after breakfast, you will head to Baratang Island, around 3 hours from Port Blair, famous for its limestone caves and mangrove creeks. The Baludera Beach on Baratang is equally famous. Travel to Parrot Island if you’d like to admire the hundreds of parrots on Baratang.

itinerary.title: Port Blair - Havelock Island
itinerary.description: After breakfast, you will head to Havelock Island to visit the famous Radha Nagar Beach. Some other beaches on this island include Vijay Nagar, Govind Nagar, Elephant Beach, and Kala Pathar Beach. You can also sign up for water sports like scuba diving, snorkelling, and underwater walking. Return to Port Blair in the evening to spend the night at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Snorkelling At Elephant Beach
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head to Elephant Beach on a motor boat to join everyone for a snorkelling session. You can also enjoy dining at a beachfront restaurant in Elephant Beach.

itinerary.title: Port Blair
itinerary.description: Today, you will enjoy the scenery around your resort and sign up for water-based sports on the island.

itinerary.title: Depart Port Blair
itinerary.description: Bid adieu to Port Blair and the Andaman and Nicobar Islands as you head to the airport for your return flight home.

itinerary.title: Ross Island - North Bay - Viper Island

Later in the day, get set to be mesmerised by the views at Ross Island and Viper Island. Get back to your hotel at Port Blair and enjoy a good night’s sleep.

itinerary.title: Havelock Island – Port Blair
itinerary.description: On this day, you will be making your way to Havelock Island, an alluring natural paradise famous for its rich biodiversity. itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Veer Savarkar International Airport, you will be greeted by our tour representatives, who will help you get to your hotel. Indulge in a range of watersports at this beach, including parasailing, scuba diving, swimming, jet skiing, and speed boat rides. In the evening, head towards Cellular Jail, a vital landmark as it’s a British colonial prison that was once used by the colonial government of India to exile criminals and political prisoners. Witness a light and sound show at this location. Return to your hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: Ross Island - Viper Island
itinerary.description: After having your breakfast, depart for North Bay, a secluded island situated about 4 km from Port Blair. Engage in watersports and go on a glass boat ride to view the magical underwater world. You will then be heading towards Ross Island, which is famous for its cultural venues, natural landscapes, and historical significance. Visit the Chief Commissioner's Bungalow and the Government House. Later on, explore Viper Island where you can try parasailing and go on banana boat rides.

itinerary.title: Havelock Island - Radhanagar Beach - Port Blair
itinerary.description: In the morning, have your breakfast and get on a ship to leave for Havelock Island, which is situated 41 km northeast of Port Blair. Once you get done with the check-in process at your hotel, relish a scrumptious lunch and relax for a while. In the evening, go to Radhanagar Beach, which was given the honour of the ‘Best Beach in Asia’ by Time magazine in 2004. Witness a gorgeous sunset, and make sure to click a bunch of pictures to remember the moments. Spend the night at your hotel.

itinerary.title: Port Blair - Fisheries Museum - Zonal Anthropological Museum - Samudrika Naval Marine Museum
itinerary.description: On this day, you will be visiting some of the most beloved tourist destinations in Port Blair. The first place you will be visiting is Fisheries Museum, a museum that exhibits the specimens belonging to the underwater world. Home to fishes, corals, and shells, it provides an insight into the animals, plants, ecosystems, tribal communities, and marine life of the Andamans. Next, go to the Zonal Anthropological Museum which displays the history of the local tribes of the island. While you’re at this museum, you will get to learn more about the Shompens, the Andamanese, the Onges, the Nicobarese, and the Jarawas. Head over to the Samudrika Naval Marine Museum, which aims to raise awareness regarding the numerous aspects of the oceanic world. The location is maintained by the Indian Navy and is divided into five sections, namely marine life, archaeology, geographical information, the history of the islands, and the people of the Andamans. Indulge in some retail therapy in the evening.

itinerary.title: Depart Port Blair
itinerary.description: In the morning, have your breakfast and leave for the airport to board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Port Blair – Corbyn’s Cove Beach - Cellular Jail

After this, head to the iconic landmark of the Andamans, the Cellular Jail. This British colonial prison was once used by the colonial government of India to exile criminals and political prisoners. Several Indian freedom fighters were imprisoned at this very jail during India’s struggle for independence, including Vinayak Damodar Savarkar, Yogendra Shukla, and Sudhangshu Dasgupta. Catch the light and sound show in the evening before getting back to your hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: Havelock Island - Radhanagar Beach
itinerary.description: In the morning, enjoy a scrumptious breakfast and leave for Havelock Island, which is situated 41 km northeast of Port Blair. After checking in to your hotel, relax around your hotel for a while. In the evening, head for Radhanagar Beach, which was given the title of the Best Beach in Asia by Time magazine in 2004. itinerary.title: Havelock Island - Leisure

itinerary.title: Elephant Beach - Port Blair
itinerary.description: For the fourth day of your trip, spend your time at Elephant Beach, which is among the most unique beaches in the Andaman Islands. Enjoy the view of its clear waters and white sands and participate in activities like snorkelling, glass bottom boat rides, jet skiing, and parasailing. Later in the day, leave for Port Blair. Check-in to your hotel and enjoy a relaxing night.

itinerary.title: Depart Port Blair
itinerary.description: In the morning, have your breakfast and leave for the airport to board your flight back home.

packages.name: Romania Holiday Package
packages.destination: Bucharest - Sibiu - Hunedoara - Alba Iulia - Cluj Napoca - Baia Mare - Maramures County - Bucovina Area - Sighisoara - Brasov - Tulcea - Danube Delta

itinerary.title: Arrive In Bucharest
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at the Henri Coanda International Airport, our tour manager will welcome you and help you complete the transfer formalities. Complete check-in and spend the rest of the day exploring the many places in and around Bucharest. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Bucharest.

itinerary.title: Bucharest – Sibiu
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head out to explore the beautiful town of Sibiu. On the way, stop at Horezu to visit the Monastery of Horezu, which was set up in 1690 by Prince Constantine Brancovan and is famous for its architectural beauty. The monastery is also considered a masterpiece of the Brancovan style. Later, after lunch, continue your journey to Sibiu. On the way, you’ll make a short visit to the fortified monastery of Cozia. Check-in to a luxury hotel in Sibiu. Spend the night in Sibiu.

itinerary.title: Explore Sibiu
itinerary.description: Sibiu is one of Romania's most beautiful cities, famous for its medieval charm and colourful houses. It was founded in the 12th century to accommodate German settlers in Transylvania. Some places you will explore in this quaint town include the ASTRA National Museum Complex, apparently the largest open-air museum in Europe, the Stairs Passage, the many fortresses in Sibiu, and the winding streets along the town. Enjoy a Romanian lunch at a local restaurant and head to the Museum of Glass Painted Icons. Spend the rest of the evening exploring the beautiful city and seeing how the villagers enjoy life in this quiet town. Spend the night in Sibiu.

itinerary.title: Sibiu – Hunedoara – Sibiu
itinerary.description: Today, you will explore Sibiu. This often-overlooked town in Transylvania is full of natural wonders and gorgeous edifices. Some places you will cover today include Corvin’s Castle, also called Hundayi Castle. This unique castle is the largest medieval castle in Transylvania and was the perfect showpiece to depict the financial prowess of the Corvin Family. While the castle has changed over the centuries, visitors should not miss Neboisa, or the Last Defence Tower, which has remained unchanged since John Hunyadi built the castle in the 1440s. Later, you will explore the city of Deva, the capital of Hunedoara County. The Hungarian King Stefan built the 13th-century local fortress, later developed by John Hunyadi in 1444. Travel back to Sibiu to spend the night in the city.

itinerary.title: Sibiu – Alba Iulia – Cluj Napoca – Baia Mare
itinerary.description: Today, you will check out of your hotel in Sibiu and continue to the northern parts of Romania. These are some of the most traditional and wildest places in Transylvania. The distance from Sibiu to Alba Iulia takes around an hour and is extremely scenic. Alba Iulia is a beautiful city with a great history. The Romans called it Apullum and used it as a military and commercial settlement. You will visit the Alba-Carolina Citadel, Reunification Cathedral, Saint Michael Cathedral, and the caves in the Apunesi Mountains. Later, drive to Baia Mare, a beautiful town founded in the 12th century by Saxon immigrants. Check into your hotel and spend the night in luxury.

itinerary.title: Explore Maramures
itinerary.description: Today, you will tour Maramures, one of Romania’s most rural areas where people still follow centuries-old traditions and customs. The town is famous for its wooden churches, wood carvings, and carpets. Some of the places you will explore today include the Church of the Archangels Michael and Gabriel in Surdesti, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, the upper church of Leud, the Plopis Wooden Church, also a UNESCO World Heritage Site, and the Maramures Village Museum. Drive along the Iza Valley to admire the many beautiful villages along the Ukraine border. Don’t miss the Merry Cemetery, now an open-air museum listed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site. This is a unique place where people choose fun ways to be remembered through their epitaphs and memorial crosses. Interestingly, these crosses are painted in a distinctive blue, now called the Sapanta Blue. Return to Baia Mare in the evening to stay at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Baia Mare – Bucovina
itinerary.description: After breakfast, you’ll leave for Bucovina, stopping at the many wooden churches in Poienile Izei and Barsana. You’ll pass through Prislop Pass, Romania’s highest mountain road pass, to reach Gura Humorului, a beautiful town in the Bukovina region. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Gura Humorului.

itinerary.title: Explore Bucovina
itinerary.description: Bucovina has a rich history and plenty of architectural monuments, including medieval monasteries, churches, and natural wonders. Today, you will explore some of Bucovina’s UNESCO World Heritage Sites, including the monasteries of Sucevita and Voronet, later called the Sistine Chapel of the East. Don’t miss the Moldovita Monastery, famous for its depiction of the ancestors of Jesus Christ, and the many ceramic workshops in Marginea. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Gura Humorului.

itinerary.title: Bucovina – Sighisoara
itinerary.description: After the morning, proceed to Sighisoara through the Bicaz Gorge, a scenic canyon that is the passageway from Moldova to Transylvania. Sighisoara is the birthplace of Vlad the Impaler, the supposed inspiration behind the fictional character of Count Dracula. Sighisoara is a beautiful medieval town with cobblestone paved roads, colourful buildings, and long winding streets. Stay overnight at a luxury hotel in Sighisoara.

itinerary.title: Sighisoara – Brasov
itinerary.description: Today, after breakfast, check out of the hotel and head to Brasov. Stop at Prejmer, a fascinating Transylvanian village renowned for its UNESCO World Heritage Sites. The Peasant Fortified Citadel, built by the Teutonic Knights in the early 1200s, is a must-visit. After lunch, head to Brasov, a medieval town once Transylvania's capital. Brasov is one of the most beautiful places in Romania, famous for its Gothic, baroque, and Renaissance architecture. You will explore Council Square, the Black Church, etc. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Brasov.

itinerary.title: Explore Brasov
itinerary.description: After a hearty breakfast of traditional cold cuts, cheese, sausages, eggs, bread, and homemade jams, head out to the Prahova Valley. Visit the Bran Castle, a 14th-century fortress believed to have inspired the fictional Count Dracula’s home. Later, you will visit Peles Castle, the former summer residence of the erstwhile royal family of Romania. This unique castle was built in 1914 by King Carol I. Spend the night at Brasov.

itinerary.title: Brasov – Tulcea
itinerary.description: After breakfast, you will leave for Tulcea, a 7th-century town on the Danube Delta founded by the Dacians. You will first drive to Galati, a port town on the Danube River and then board a ferry to reach Tulcea. Check in to a hotel and spend the rest of the evening exploring places around your hotel. Spend the night at a hotel in Tulcea.

itinerary.title: Danube Delta
itinerary.description: You will start the day with an excursion to the Danube Delta. This is the second longest river, flowing through 10 countries and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Almost 82% of the Danube Delta is in Romania, while the rest is in Ukraine. The delta hosts over 300 species of birds, 45 varieties of freshwater fish, and the Letea forest.

itinerary.title: Danube Delta - Bucharest
itinerary.description: Leave for Bucharest through Constanta, the largest city on the Black Sea Coast. On the way, you will stop in Histria to explore the ancient Greek ruins. The town was founded by Milesian settlers in the 7th century BC and is probably the oldest city discovered in Romania. Some places you will explore here include the National History Museum and the Roman Mosaic from 100 BC. You will continue your journey to Bucharest to spend the night in the city.

itinerary.title: Explore Bucharest
itinerary.description: Enjoy a short tour of Bucharest exploring some of Bucharest’s famous tourist attractions, including Revolution Square, the People’s Salvation Cathedral, the Romanian Athenaeum, the Royal Palace of Bucharest, the Arch of Triumph, University Square, and the Open Air Village Museum. You can explore the flea markets in Bucharest to buy antique items, ceramicware, and other handicrafts. Spend the night in Bucharest.

itinerary.title: Depart Bucharest
itinerary.description: Check out of the hotel to reach the Bucharest International Airport to catch your return flight home or continue with the next leg of your Europe tour package journey.

itinerary.title: Arrive In Bucharest
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Bucharest Henri Coanda International Airport, our tour manager will help you transfer to the hotel and complete check-in formalities. Spend the rest of the day exploring the area around the hotel. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Bucharest.

itinerary.title: Bucharest – Sibiu
itinerary.description: Today, after breakfast, you will leave to explore Sibiu. The entire journey takes around 4.5 hours and covers around 300 km. On the way, you will enjoy plenty of top attractions like Saint Mary Evangelical Cathedral, The Bridge of Lies, the Astra National Museum, and the fortified monastery of Cozia. Enjoy lunch at a local restaurant along the way to sample some of the best Romanian food. Upon reaching Sibiu, you’ll enjoy a walking tour of the city, including the small and large squares, the Stairs Passage, and the Drumbrava Sibiului Natural Park. Sibiu feels like a medieval city with cobbled streets and picturesque row houses. Spend the night at a luxury resort in Sibiu.

itinerary.title: Sibiu – Alba Iulia – Cluj – Napoca
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of your hotel and leave for Alba Iulia. The journey takes around 2.5 hours and is beautiful. Alba Iulia is an ancient city inhabited since the 1st century AD. It is also the oldest settlement in Romania. The Romans called it Apulum, and they set up the largest military and economic centre in the city. Some places you will cover here include the Alba Iulia Vauban Fortress, Alba Iulia Princely Palace, the Batthyaneum Library, Apor Palace, and the Roman Catholic Cathedral. Enjoy a hearty Romanian lunch at a local restaurant before heading to Cluj Napoca, the largest city in the Transylvania region. The journey takes around 2.5 hours and is full of gorgeous landscapes and beautiful castles. Check in to a luxury hotel in Cluj Napoca to spend the night in the city.

itinerary.title: Cluj Napoca – Turda –Targu Mures
itinerary.description: Today, after breakfast, head to Romania’s most famous salt mines. This is one of the world’s most spectacular natural underground salt mines – large enough to cover the world’s salt requirement for another 60 years. To the uninitiated, Turda, along with Alba Iulia, Cluj Napoca, and Timisoara, is one of Romania's oldest and most important settlements. Enjoy lunch at a local restaurant before continuing to Targu Mures. The town is named after a market on the Mures River and was probably founded around the 14th century. Some places you can visit include Apollo Palace, The Old Prefecture, Palffy House, and the St. Michael Wooden Orthodox Church. Don’t miss the 15th-century Targu Mures Fortress built by Prince Stefan Bathory. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Targu Mures.

itinerary.title: Targu Mures – Brasov
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel and head to Sighisoara, one of the most important places in Transylvania that originated around the 12th century. The town is also believed to be the birthplace of Vlad the Impaler. Here, you will visit the Covered Stairway and Casa Vlad Dracul, supposedly the birthplace of Vlad the Impaler. Don’t miss the cobbled streets, the medieval buildings, ancient castles, and the local torture museum. Later, after lunch, head to Brasov, a popular Romanian ski resort. Check into a luxury hotel to spend the night in Brasov.

itinerary.title: Brasov – Prejmer – Bran
itinerary.description: Today, after a short tour around Brasov, you will head to visit the Prejmer Fortified Church, one of the largest fortified churches in Southeastern Europe, built by Teutonic Knights in the 13th century. Later, you will visit Bran to explore the Bran Castle. This imposing castle is famous for its distinctive red roofs, thick stone walls, and imposing round donjons. It is believed to be the place that inspired Bram Stoker to create his Count Dracula character. Later, return to Brasov to enjoy some of its attractions. You will visit the Council Square, the Black Church, the First Romanian School Museum, and the Aquatic Paradise. Spend the night in Brasov.

itinerary.title: Brasov – Sinaia – Bucharest
itinerary.description: Check out of your hotel in Brasov to return to Bucharest via Sinaia. This town is the perfect stop when travelling from Brasov to Bucharest, thanks to its stunning landscapes and mineral springs. Don’t miss the Peles Castle, a fairytale-like castle famous for its intricate décor, statues, gargoyles, and magnificent dining room. Stop for lunch at a local restaurant before reaching Bucharest. Spend the rest of the day exploring this panoramic city. Some places you will visit include Revolution Square, Triumph Arch, Patriarchy Church, and the Open Air Village Museum. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Bucharest.

itinerary.title: Depart Bucharest
itinerary.description: Bid goodbye to Bucharest as you head to catch your flight to return home or continue with the next leg of your Europe tour package journey.

packages.name: Dubai free and easy
packages.destination: Dubai - Dhow Cruise - Dubai Desert Safari

itinerary.title: Arrive at Dubai – Miracle Garden - Dhow Cruise
itinerary.description: Once you land in Dubai, you will be greeted by our tour representatives, who will take you to your hotel. Begin your trip with a visit to the fabulous Miracle Garden, launched on Valentine’s Day in 2013. Sprawling over 72,000 square meters, it contains more than 150 million flowers. You will surely enjoy walking around the world’s largest natural flower garden. In the evening, get ready for a dhow cruise. Whether you’re looking to spend a glittering night with your family or a romantic evening with your spouse, the cruise is perfect. Take in the gorgeous view around and the mesmerizing belly dance that’s part of the entertainment activities you can enjoy. You’ll surely love the dhow cruise if you appreciate nature and adventures. Get back to your hotel after the cruise for a peaceful night of sleep.

itinerary.title: Burj Khalifa – Dubai Creek – Dubai Mall - Jumeirah Beach
itinerary.description: The second day begins with a visit to the majestic Burj Khalifa, the tallest building in the world. Ride up to the observation decks on the 124th, 125th, and 148th floors to view the entire city and get your pictures taken against this mesmerizing background. After this, head on to the commercial hub of Dubai Creek, where you can enjoy a traditional boat ride. Spend some time browsing through the many luxury brands at Dubai Mall, and once your hands are filled with shopping bags, experience the serenity of the waves at Jumeirah Beach.

itinerary.title: Desert Safari
itinerary.description: Your trip to Dubai is incomplete if you don’t witness the magical golden sands of the Middle East. Our desert safari allows an entire day for you to indulge in your love for the Arabian Nights. You can take the safari in the morning and the evening or make an entire day out of it before heading back to your hotel the next morning. Go dune bashing or sand skiing, as per your preference, and ride on a camel’s back. View the gorgeous sunrise and sunset as you sip tea or hot Arabic coffee while watching a fire or dance show. Relish the delicious local cuisine at the buffet dinner and BBQ. You will be provided with mattresses, pillows, and blankets to get a comfortable night’s sleep under the twinkling stars.

itinerary.title: Depart from Dubai
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight as you carry unforgettable memories.

itinerary.title: Arrival at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport - Transfer to Nairobi Hotel
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport in Nairobi, you will be warmly greeted by our representatives. They will assist you in transferring to your Nairobi Hotel, where you will spend the night.

itinerary.title: Nairobi to Masai Mara Game Reserve
itinerary.description: After enjoying a hearty breakfast at your hotel, it's time to set out on an exciting adventure. Our first stop is the renowned Masai Mara Game Reserve, one of Nairobi's most famous attractions. Along the way, we'll pass through the breathtaking Great Rift Valley, providing ample opportunities for stunning photographs. As we continue our journey towards Masai Mara, we'll break for a delicious lunch. Once we arrive at the reserve, get ready for an incredible experience. Here, you'll have the chance to witness the most magnificent scenes in the animal kingdom – from the commanding roar of a lion to the incredible agility of a cheetah during a hunt. Keep your camera ready for moments like an elephant expressing its frustration. Prepare to be captivated by a multitude of fascinating events as you explore the Masai Mara Game Reserve.

itinerary.title: Masai Mara
itinerary.description: Prepare for another thrilling safari adventure as you embark on a journey to spot wild animals. The early morning and evening are prime times for observing these magnificent creatures in their natural habitat. During the midday, you can enjoy a game viewing drive in pursuit of the famous "big five" – the leopard, lion, rhino, and elephant.

itinerary.title: Lake Nakuru National Park
itinerary.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast and be sure to listen to the instructions provided by your safari driver to help you navigate into Lake Nakuru National Park. Once you're all set, head over to Lake Nakuru Lodge where you can enjoy a leisurely lunch. The real adventure begins in the afternoon as you embark on a thrilling game viewing drive within the boundaries of Lake Nakuru National Park.

itinerary.title: Lake Nakuru to Nairobi
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delicious breakfast. Then, it's time to check out from the hotel and make your way to Nairobi. Our friendly representatives will accompany you to Jomo Kenyatta International Airport for your departure. Safe travel!

itinerary.title: Arrival at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport
itinerary.description: Check into Your Nairobi Hotel Upon your arrival at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport, our friendly representatives will assist you in transferring to your Nairobi hotel, where you'll spend the night.

itinerary.title: Nairobi to Masai Mara Game
itinerary.description: Reserve Begin your day with a hearty breakfast at the hotel. Today, you'll embark on an exciting journey to the renowned Masai Mara Game Reserve, promising loads of fun and adventure. Along the way, we'll make a stop at the Eastern Great Rift Valley for some excellent photo opportunities to capture the stunning landscape. Upon arriving at the Masai Mara, we'll settle in for a delicious lunch at the hotel. After a rejuvenating break, your expert tour guide will lead you on an unforgettable safari experience. Get ready to witness some of the most incredible wildlife in their natural habitat. As you explore the reserve, keep an eye out for mesmerising moments, like the mighty lion's roar, the majestic wildebeest, or the elephants trumpeting in all their grandeur. The Masai Mara promises a wealth of exciting animal encounters and breathtaking scenes.

itinerary.title: Masai Mara
itinerary.description: On the following morning, our tour representatives will take you on an exciting safari adventure to seek out the majestic wildlife. Typically, the early mornings and evenings offer the prime opportunity to observe the hunting activities of the big cats, such as cheetahs, leopards, and lions. Moreover, you can revel in the breathtaking views of the sunrise and sunset in this incredible destination. Afterward, take a short break to recharge. To ensure an unforgettable wildlife experience, we will guide you on a quest to spot the "big five" animals, which include elephants, buffaloes, lions, rhinos, and leopards.

itinerary.title: Masai Mara to Lake Nakuru National Park
itinerary.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast at the hotel. Seek the guidance of our skilled safari driver as you journey to Lake Nakuru National Park. Here, you'll spend the morning exploring the park's unique wildlife. Upon arrival at Lake Nakuru Lodge, enjoy a delicious lunch to refuel for your adventure. Afterward, embark on an exciting game drive within Lake Nakuru National Park. Keep your eyes peeled for some of nature's rare gems, such as the white rhino, black rhino, elusive leopard, and other fascinating wildlife.

itinerary.title: Lake Nakuru to Lake Naivasha
itinerary.description: After enjoying breakfast at your hotel, we'll make our way to the enchanting Lake Naivasha. Our first stop is the Lake Naivasha Spa Lodge, nestled on the serene southern shores of Lake Naivasha. This charming lodge boasts 21 cozy cottages, each with four rooms, and 84 comfortable rooms that provide breathtaking panoramic views of the lake valley. Our adventure continues as we head to Crescent Island, a unique and picturesque destination. Here, you'll have the opportunity to observe a variety of wildlife, often found taking shelter in their caves. It's a truly captivating experience!

itinerary.title: Lake Naivasha to Nairobi – Time to Say Goodbye
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delicious breakfast, and then it's time to check out of the hotel. We'll arrange a comfortable transfer to Nairobi for you. Our friendly representatives will ensure you reach Jomo Kenyatta International Airport in time for your departure. Safe travel!
