itinerary.title: Arrive in Hong Kong
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at the Hong Kong International Airport, you will be greeted by our tour representative, who will help you get to your hotel. Once you complete the check-in formalities, you have the rest of the day to yourself.

itinerary.title: Hong Kong Disneyland
itinerary.description: Get ready to go back to your childhood days because today, you will be heading to Hong Kong Disneyland! Interact with your beloved Disney characters, catch a bunch of marvellous shows, and experience the thrill of numerous rides. After spending the entire day giving yourself plenty of adrenaline rush, relish a delicious dinner at an Indian restaurant before turning in for the night.

itinerary.title: Hong Kong City Tour - Shenzhen
itinerary.description: Today, you will be heading out to explore some of the most famous sightseeing spots in Hong Kong. Start off with the Man Mo Temple before heading to Victoria Peak. Experience the charm of the Aberdeen Fishing Village, which was once home to fishing families who were referred to as ‘the floating people’. The other stops to make today include the Repulse Bay, Madame Tussauds Hong Kong, and the jewellery plant in Hong Kong. Transfer to the city of Shenzhen by train and check in to your hotel.

itinerary.title: Shenzhen City Tour
itinerary.description: This day will be dedicated to exploring Shenzhen. The places you will be taken to are the Shenzhen Mineral Museum and Window of the World. The latter is a theme park sprawled over an area of 480,000 square meters, displaying replicas of world-famous monuments, such as the Taj Mahal and the Leaning Tower of Pisa. There will also be the opportunity to shop for bamboo products.

itinerary.title: Shenzhen - Macau
itinerary.description: Relish a delicious breakfast at your hotel before leaving to take a ferry to Macau. This is the city where Hong Kong’s mesmerising nightlife and stunning architecture come alive. You have the rest of the day to explore Macau on your own. Spend the night at your hotel in Macau.

itinerary.title: Depart Hong Kong
itinerary.description: Catch a ferry to Hong Kong from Macau. You can spend the morning indulging in some shopping before heading to the airport to board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Jaipur
itinerary.description: After you arrive in Jaipur, our tour manager will welcome you and guide you to the hotel. Check into the hotel and spend the rest of the day exploring neighbouring places. Spend the night in Jaipur.

itinerary.title: Jaipur Full Day Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head out to explore Pink City. Some of the places you will visit include the Amber Fort, Sheesh Mahal, Hawa Mahal, the City Palace, Nahargarh Fort, Jantar Mantar, Jal Mahal, Jaigarh Fort, and the Birla Mandir. Spend the night in Jaipur.

itinerary.title: Jaipur - Jodhpur
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel and head to Jodhpur. You will visit Pushkar on your way. Some places you will visit in Pushkar include the Lord Brahma Temple, the site of the famous Camel Fair, and even the Ajmer Khwaja Dargah. Check into the hotel in Jodhpur and spend the night in Blue City.

itinerary.title: Jodhpur
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head out to explore Jodhpur. Some of the places you will visit include the Mehrangarh Fort, Jaswant Thada, Ghanta Ghar, and the Umaid Bhawan Palace Museum. Later, visit Osian Village, a small town outside Jodhpur famous for its Jain and Hindu temples built between the 8th and the 12th centuries. You can also sign up for a desert camel safari. Later, head back to Jodhpur to spend the night at a luxury hotel.

itinerary.title: Jodhpur - Udaipur
itinerary.description: After breakfast, drive to Udaipur and visit the Ranakpur Temples. Check into the hotel in Jodhpur and spend the rest of the day enjoying the sights in the neighbourhood. Some of the places you will visit include City Palace, Jagdish Temple, Sajjangarh Monsoon Palace, Bagore ki Haveli, Lake Pichola, and Ambrai Ghat. Spend the night in Udaipur.

itinerary.title: Udaipur City Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast, visit the places you missed yesterday. These include Saheli ki Bari, Lok Kala Mandal, and Crystal Gallery. Spend the night in Udaipur.

itinerary.title: Depart Udaipur
itinerary.description: After breakfast, go shopping at the nearby markets. Later, go to the nearest railway station or airport.

packages.name: Golden Triangle Tour with Jodhpur
packages.destination: Jaipur - Pushkar (150 Kms, 2 Hrs) - Jodhpur (250 Kms, 4.5 Hrs)

itinerary.title: Arrive in Jaipur
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at the Jaipur Airport, our tour manager will welcome you and help you transfer to the hotel. Check into the hotel and spend the night in Pink City.

itinerary.title: Jaipur Day Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head out for a day tour of Pink City. You will visit Amber Fort, Hawa Mahal, Nahargarh Fort, Jantar Mantar, The City Palace, Jal Mahal, Jaigarh Fort, Rambaugh Palace, and Patrika Gate. Return to the hotel to spend the night at a luxury hotel in Jaipur.

itinerary.title: Jaipur - Pushkar
itinerary.description: After a hearty breakfast, head to Pushkar, an ancient town famous for the legendary Camel Fair and the Brahma Temple. Don’t miss the Ajmer Khwaja Nawaz Dargah Sharif. Head to the hotel to spend the night in Jaipur.

itinerary.title: Jaipur - Jodhpur
itinerary.description: After breakfast today, head to Jodhpur. The journey takes around 4.5 hours. Check into the hotel and spend some time relaxing.

itinerary.title: Jodhpur Day Tour
itinerary.description: After a relaxed breakfast, head out for the Jodhpur City Tour. You will explore Mehrangarh Fort, Moti Mahal, Umaid Bhavan, Phool Mahal, and Jaswant Thada. Return to your hotel to spend the night in Jodhpur.

itinerary.title: Depart Jodhpur
itinerary.description: After breakfast, leave the hotel and head to the airport to return home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Hilo
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Hilo International Airport, you will be greeted by our tour representatives, who will help you get to your hotel. Complete the check-in formalities and spend the rest of the day at leisure.

itinerary.title: Volcanoes National Park - Hilo - Wailuku River State Park
itinerary.description: On this day, you will be visiting the Hawaii Volcanoes National Park, which contains the active volcanoes of Kīlauea and Mauna Loa. Later in the day, you will be visiting the Akatsuka Orchid Gardens and Macadamia Nut Farm. Make your way to Richardson Ocean Park, which is great for swimming, picnics, and snorkelling. Experience the beauty of the Wailuku River State Park, King Kamehameha Statue, and Rainbow Falls before returning to your hotel.

itinerary.title: Leisure Day
itinerary.description: After having your breakfast, you can enjoy the rest of the day at leisure or spend it engaging in watersports.

itinerary.title: Akaka Falls State Park - Hilo - Lava Tree State Monument
itinerary.description: On this day, explore the Akaka Falls State Park, where you can view the Kahuna Falls and Akaka Falls. Experience the Nani Mau Gardens, a landscaped garden brimming with tropical plants and flowers. Go to the Lava Trees State Park, a public park situated in the Puna District of Hawaii. End the day by visiting the Kapoho Tide Pools and Kalapana Beach.

itinerary.title: Hilo - Maui - Honolulu
itinerary.description: Today, you will be travelling to the island of Maui, and you can spend the day exploring its beaches, parks, and hiking trails. Later in the day, you can make your way to the city of Honolulu.

itinerary.title: Pearl Harbor - Honolulu
itinerary.description: After having your breakfast, you will be leaving to explore the most visited site in all of the Hawaiian Islands, and that’s Pearl Harbor. A tragic piece of history that you will be visiting today is the USS Arizona Memorial, which serves as the resting place of 1,102 of the 1,177 sailors and marines who lost their lives during the attack on Pearl Harbor in December of 1941. Later in the day, get back to Honolulu and spend the night at your hotel.

itinerary.title: Honolulu
itinerary.description: Enjoy a scrumptious breakfast, and then head out to visit some of the most popular spots in Honolulu. These include the Iolani Palace, Kawaiahaʻo Church, Honolulu Hale, and the National Memorial Cemetery of the Pacific.

itinerary.title: Honolulu
itinerary.description: The second to last day of your trip can be spent relaxing or shopping around, based on your preferences.

itinerary.title: Depart Honolulu
itinerary.description: After getting done with your breakfast, check out of your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrive at Maldives – Island Hopping - Sunset Cruise
itinerary.description: Once you reach Maldives, you will be transferred to your hotel by our tour representative. After reaching the gorgeous Coco Bodu Hithi Resort, you will get ample time to freshen up before beginning the first round of sightseeing. Maldives is a stunning island offering a mesmerizing view to tourists from all over the world. You can buy souvenirs or jewelry at the resort's handicraft store. You can also meet the locals and interact with them to learn more about local life. In the evening, get ready to experience the beautiful golden hues on the sunset cruise. You can take in the island's serenity and enjoy a delicious dinner before returning to your hotel.

itinerary.title: Snorkelling - Vaadhoo Island
itinerary.description: What's a trip to the Maldives without indulging in thrilling water-based activities? Immerse yourself in the endless beauty of the underwater world through snorkeling. Post this exciting adventure, you can head to Vaadhoo Island, where the magic of the Glowing Beach is sure to win you over.

itinerary.title: Male - Dolphin Watching
itinerary.description: The third day of your Maldives trip begins by exploring Male, the capital of Maldives. Spend the morning and afternoon exploring famous sites such as the Male Fish Market, considered the heart of the city, and the oldest mosque in the Maldives, known as the Old Friday Mosque. If you want to learn more about the history of Maldives, pay a visit to the National Museum. Later in the day, you will be taken to Cinnamon Hakurra, where you can see some adorable dolphins being playful, before returning to your hotel.

itinerary.title: Depart from Maldives
itinerary.description: Get ready to check out from the hotel and head to the airport to catch your flight back home.

packages.name: Gems of Scandinavia
packages.destination: Stockholm - Copenhagen - Odense - Aarhus - Frederikshavn - Gothenburg - Oslo

itinerary.title: Arrive in Stockholm - Gamla Stan - Vasa Museum - ABBA The Museum
itinerary.description: After you land in Stockholm, our tour representatives will greet you at the airport and take you to your hotel. We’ll help you check in and leave you to freshen up. You can then venture out to begin exploring the beautiful capital of Sweden. Stockholm is a stunning city with beautiful buildings built on 14 islands connected by 57 bridges. The city is famed for its clean air and picturesque gardens. Start your tour with Gamla Stan or Old Town, lined with cafes, studios, galleries, restaurants, and stores. Afterward, head to Vasa Museum for a guided tour of the world’s only preserved 17th-century ship. Inaugurated in 1990, it is one of the most famous museums in Scandinavia. End your day at ABBA The Museum, an interactive museum perfect for ABBA fans. Other attractions in Stockholm include The Royal Palace, Skansen Open Air Museum, and the Stockholm City Hall.

itinerary.title: Stockholm – Copenhagen - Tivoli Gardens - Christiansborg Palace - National Museum of Denmark
itinerary.description: Take a train from Stockholm to Copenhagen. Upon reaching the capital of Denmark, check in to your hotel and begin sightseeing. Copenhagen is the seat of one of the oldest monarchies in the world. This beautiful city is famous for its cobblestone pavements, churches, colorful buildings, and fine-dining options. You’ll first visit the Tivoli Gardens, the world’s second-oldest amusement park. It was opened in 1843 and is Europe’s fifth most visited amusement park. After this, head over to the Christiansborg Palace, which is located in Slotsholmen. The palace serves as the Supreme Court of Denmark, the Danish Prime Minister's office, and the Danish Parliament's seat. For the day's last stop, explore the National Museum of Denmark, Denmark's biggest cultural history museum.

itinerary.title: Copenhagen – Odense – Hans Christian Andersen Museum
itinerary.description: Board a train from Copenhagen to Odense, Denmark’s third-largest city. Walk around the Hans Christian Andersen Museum for an insight into the life of the Danish author. Spend the night at your hotel in Odense.

itinerary.title: Odense – Aarhus - Moesgaard Museum - Marselisborg Castle - Street Food Hall
itinerary.description: Transfer from Odense to Aarhus on a train and visit famous landmarks like the Moesgaard Museum and Marselisborg Castle. Aarhus is the second-largest city in the country and is known as the City of the Smile. Start your tour with a visit to Old City or Den Gamle By in Central Aarhus. In the evening, walk around the Street Food Hall, where you can relish various types of Turkish, Italian, and Mediterranean food.

itinerary.title: Aarhus – Frederikshavn – Gothenburg
itinerary.description: Get on a train from Aarhus to Frederikshavn, and then get on a ferry to reach the city of Gothenburg. Being the second-largest city in Sweden, it has a lot of famous landmarks for you to visit, such as the Liseberg amusement park and Maritiman, the floating maritime museum to learn about U-boats, destroyers, fireboats, etc. Get on a boat cruise to the New Alvsborg Fortress. Spend the night at your hotel in Gothenburg.

itinerary.title: Gothenburg – Oslo - Vigeland Park - Royal Palace - City Hall
itinerary.description: Take a train from Gothenburg to Oslo, the capital of Norway. Once you reach Oslo, you will go sightseeing to spots such as Vigeland Park, Royal Palace, City Hall, Bygdoy Peninsula, Parliament Building, Aker Brygge, and the Akershus Fortress. Oslo is the capital city of Norway and home to beautiful fjords and rolling green hills. It has a rich history dating back to 1,000 AD.

itinerary.title: Depart from Oslo
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight home.

itinerary.title: Colombo - Kandy
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at the Colombo Bandaranaike International Airport, our tour manager will welcome you and help you transfer to Kandy, the second-largest city in Sri Lanka. Kandy is Sri Lanka’s second-largest city and the last headquarters of the ancient Sri Lankan kingdom. Some tourist attractions in Kandy include the Sri Dalada Maligawa, also called Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic, Royal Botanic Gardens, Udawatta Kele Sanctuary, and Kandy View Point. Check in at a luxury resort to spend the night in Kandy.

itinerary.title: Nuwara Eliya
itinerary.description: Today, you will begin your day with a hearty Sri Lankan breakfast before heading to Nuwara Eliya. Also called Little England because of its colonial bungalows, Nuwara Eliya is famous for its mountain valleys, tea plantations, and waterfalls. Some of the other attractions in Nuwara Eliya include Seetha Amman Temple, Victoria Park, and the Horton Plains National Park. End the day with a boat ride on Gregory Lake before returning to a hotel in Nuwara Eliya.

itinerary.title: Nuwara Eliya - Bentota
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel in Nuwara Eliya to head to Bentota. The journey takes around 5 hours and is absolutely scenic. Bentota is famous for its beaches, watersports, and Buddhist temples. Check into the Blue Beach Resort and spend the night at the luxury accommodation.

itinerary.title: Bentota - Colombo
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a leisurely breakfast. Later, head out to explore Bentota's top attractions. Some places you will visit include the Kande Viharaya Temple, Turtle Farm, Galle Dutch Fort, and Ventura Beach. Later in the day, you will head to Colombo to explore the city’s top attractions, including the Colombo Museum, the Natural History Museum, the 18th-century Dutch church of Wolfendhaal, and the ancient 6th-century BC Kelaniya Buddhist Temple. End the day by shopping at one of Colombo’s street markets.

itinerary.title: Depart from Colombo
itinerary.description: Check out of the hotel and bid adieu to the city as you head to the airport to catch your flight to return home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Leh
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Leh Airport, you will be greeted by our agent and taken to your hotel. Enjoy a welcome drink as you enter the hotel. After the check-in formalities are completed, you can spend the rest of the day at your own pace.

itinerary.title: Leh City Tour
itinerary.description: Relish a delicious breakfast, and then get ready to explore Leh to the fullest. You will be beginning with Shey Palace, a Stakna monastery that is perched at an altitude of 3,600 m. Shey was once the summer capital of Ladakh and contains Ladakh’s second-largest Buddha statue. From there, move on to Hemis, a village that is popular for being home to the Hemis Monastery, which was built way back in 1672 AD. Finish off the day by going to the Thiksey Monastery or Thiksey Gompa, a monastery located on a hillock that overlooks the Indus Valley.

itinerary.title: Leh – Ladakh - Leh
itinerary.description: Today will be dedicated to witnessing Pangong Lake, the highest saltwater lake in the world. While you get driven to the lake via Chang La Pass, halt to have your lunch in the village of Tagste. Proceed towards Pangong Lake, whose blue waters will leave you spellbound. Get back to Leh at night.

itinerary.title: Leh – Ladakh - Leh
itinerary.description: After having a filling breakfast, commence the day by visiting Khardung, a mountain pass that is known to be among the highest motorable roads in the world. Situated at a height of 5,359 m, it is located about 40 kms from Leh. Pay your respects at the Gurudwara Pathar Sahib which was built in honour of Guru Nanak. You will also get to witness the point where the Indus River meets the Zanskar River.

itinerary.title: Depart Leh
itinerary.description: In the morning, have your breakfast and then leave for the airport to board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrival in São Paulo
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at São Paulo Airport, you will be warmly greeted and then transferred to your hotel. The remainder of the day is yours to relax and unwind, with an overnight stay at the hotel in São Paulo.

itinerary.title: São Paulo - Rio De Janeiro City Tour
itinerary.description: Wake up for a wonderful morning breakfast. This morning, you will set out to explore São Paulo during a city tour. Your journey commences at the Centro Cultural. Throughout this excursion, you will meander through the historic precincts of São Paulo's Old Downtown, acquainting yourself with noteworthy landmarks such as the Cathedral Se, Patio do Colegio, Monastery of Sao Bento, the Banespa Building, Martinelli Building (South America's first skyscraper), Viaduto do Cha, the Municipal Theater, Concert hall Sala Sao Paulo, the Estaçao da Luz train station, and the Municipal Market. Following the tour, we will transfer you to the airport for your flight to Rio de Janeiro. Upon arrival at Rio de Janeiro Airport, you will be greeted and transferred to your hotel. You are then free to explore the city at your own leisure. You will spend the night at your hotel in Rio de Janeiro.

itinerary.title: Rio De Janeiro
itinerary.description: Today, after enjoying breakfast at your hotel, you will go on an excursion to Sugar Loaf. This tour begins with a panoramic view of the city's downtown, passing by the Maracana Stadium, the Sambodrome, the Metropolitan Cathedral, a striking pyramid-shaped structure with a diameter of 96 meters and a height of 80 meters. You will also discover the historic Cinelandia square, adorned with significant edifices, such as the Municipal Theater, the National Library, and the National Museum of Fine Arts. The tour culminates at Pao de Açúcar, an iconic symbol of Rio de Janeiro, which is reached via a two-stage journey on glass cable-cars. In the afternoon, you will visit Corcovado Mountain and explore the city's beautiful beaches. You will spend the night at your hotel in Rio De Janeiro.

itinerary.title: Rio De Janeiro
itinerary.description: After a delightful breakfast, your day begins with a journey to HD Guanabara Bay, which is gracefully framed by magnificent mountains and pristine beaches, steeped in historical significance. During your cruise along this enchanting bay, you'll pass by numerous captivating islands like Ilha de Villegaignon, Ilha Fiscal, Ilha das Cobras, and Ilha das Enxadas, among others. The cruise also affords you captivating vistas of the bustling Docks and the iconic Rio-Niteroi Bridge. On the opposite side of the bay, the Niteroi coastline beckons with a plethora of attractions, including Gragoata beach and Fort, the Museum of Contemporary Art, and an array of exquisite beaches such as Flechas, Icarai, Sao Francisco, Charitas, Jurujuba, and Adao e Eva. Additionally, you'll feast your eyes on Pedra Itapuca and Pedra do Índio, as well as the grand Santa Cruz Fortress. As you journey back, don't miss the chance to revel in the sights of the Laje and São Pedro Fort, and the inviting shores of Flamengo and Botafogo beaches. You'll spend the night at your comfortable hotel in Rio De Janeiro.

itinerary.title: Rio De Janeiro – Iguassu
itinerary.description: Your day commences with a transfer to Rio De Janeiro Airport in the morning. Upon your arrival in Iguassu, you'll be whisked away to your hotel in the area. Later, you'll embark on an excursion to the Brazilian Falls, a natural wonder of extraordinary beauty. The Brazilian Park, in particular, offers modern amenities that enhance your experience. Upon reaching the Visitors center, you'll board panoramic buses that kickstart your exploration of the park. After a brief bus ride, you'll descend to begin your journey along the park's winding pathways. From the initial balcony, you'll be greeted by a sweeping panoramic view of the Argentinean falls. A picturesque 950-meter path leads you to the falls on the Brazilian side, where you'll enjoy awe-inspiring vistas. Walking along the pathway that takes you right next to the Floriano fall, you’ll be treated to a refreshing encounter and breathtaking views of the lower Iguazu river and the attractive Devil’s Gorge Canyon. The adventure continues as you take the elevator or stairs to the shopping and restaurant area upstairs. You'll spend the night at your welcoming hotel in Iguazu.

itinerary.title: Iguassu
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a delightful breakfast, followed by an enchanting journey to explore the Argentinean side of the Falls. This tour has been extended due to the introduction of new facilities for the Upper, Lower, and Devil's Throat Circuits. Upon arrival, you'll first reach the New Visitors Center, which allows you to explore the Nature's Interpretation Center. From here, you can hop on a train that will whisk you to the Cataratas Station in just about 8 minutes or opt for a short stroll through the "Green Trail," leading to the starting point of the Upper and Lower trails. Upper Circuit: This segment spans 800 meters of raised walkways, gently removed from the jungle's floor to safeguard the local wildlife's natural pathways. Here, you'll enjoy a bird's-eye view of the falls, basking in their grandeur and taking in the panoramic spectacle. Lower Circuit: Covering a substantial 1,600 meters of walkways, this circuit also gently ascends from the jungle's surface, granting you a unique perspective from below and around the falls. It provides an unparalleled opportunity to become one with the natural surroundings, allowing you to witness and feel their immense beauty up close. Devil's Gorge: Commencing from the Cataratas Station, a train journey of approximately 18 minutes will take you to the Garganta Station. From there, an alluring walk along the catwalks, spanning about 1,200 meters over the islands, will lead you to the most breathtaking vantage point: the Devil's Throat. Conclude your day with an overnight stay at the hotel in Iguazu.

itinerary.title: Iguassu to Buenos Aires
itinerary.description: This morning, we will arrange for your transfer to Iguazu Airport, from where you'll catch a flight to Buenos Aires. Upon your arrival at Buenos Aires Airport, you will be smoothly transported to your hotel. Buenos Aires is a multifaceted, lively, and captivating port city, which extends from south to north along the shores of the Rio de la Plata, serving as Argentina's historical gateway. The people of Buenos Aires, known as Porteños, take immense pride in their intricate and culturally rich identity. They hold their European heritage in high regard, evident in their lifestyle and architectural influences, which distinctly resonate with European elements more than any other city in South America. In the evening, we invite you to indulge in the enchanting experience of a Tango Show and Dinner at the exquisite Tango Porteño. Rest and recharge for the night at your hotel in Buenos Aires.

itinerary.title: Buenos Aires
itinerary.description: Begin your day with an exploration of Buenos Aires on the City Tour. We cordially invite you to uncover the charms of Buenos Aires, often referred to as the "Reina del Plata" (Queen of the Silver). Commence the tour by navigating through the city center, where you'll encounter its most alluring landmarks, including the grand Av. 9 de Julio, the renowned Colón Theatre, and the iconic Obelisk, symbolising Buenos Aires. Your journey will then lead you to the historic Plaza de Mayo, before venturing southward through San Telmo with its enchanting tanguerías, the vibrant La Boca and its famous Caminito, and onwards to Puerto Madero, the revitalised port district known for its culinary delights. You might also explore Palermo, the largest green oasis in Buenos Aires, featuring picturesque parks and elegant architecture. The day culminates in Recoleta, a neighbourhood that harmoniously blends culture and sophistication. On Sundays, your tour concludes at the lively Flea Market of San Telmo. Enjoy a comfortable night's stay at the hotel in Buenos Aires. Note: If the City Tour takes place on a Sunday, the excursion wraps up at the vibrant Flea Market of San Telmo.

itinerary.title: Buenos Aires to Ushuaia
itinerary.description: Have a healthy and delightful breakfast in the morning and embark on a flight from El Calafate Airport to reach the captivating Ushuaia. Situated at the southernmost tip of the Republic of Argentina, on the Isla Grande de Tierra del Fuego, Ushuaia proudly holds the title of being the world's southernmost city. Nestled along the shores of the Beagle Channel, its name, derived from the yamana tongue, means "bay overlooking the West." Surrounded by the breathtaking embrace of the sea, dense forests, tranquil lakes, and towering mountains, Ushuaia presents itself as a picturesque city. It boasts a well-developed infrastructure to cater to tourists, an elegant commercial hub, and a burgeoning social and cultural scene. Your overnight stay awaits at a comfortable Ushuaia hotel.

itinerary.title: Ushuaia
itinerary.description: In the morning, join on a captivating Half Day Tour of Tierra del Fuego National Park, complete with a ride on the Train of the End of the World. This historic train journey offers a fascinating glimpse into Ushuaia's heritage, set against the backdrop of the Earth's southernmost point – a truly magnificent landscape. Located just 12 kilometers from Ushuaia, this park is unique as it is the only national park in the country that boasts an ocean coastline. Its vast 63,000 hectares are a sanctuary for a variety of flora, including nires, lengas, cherry trees, calafates, as well as delicate flowers such as violets and orchids. In the afternoon, embark on a Beagle Channel Navigation excursion, including a visit to Seals Island. You'll be transported to the port, where you'll board a catamaran to sail the waters of the Beagle Channel, a body of water that links the Atlantic and Pacific Oceans. This area serves as a haven for numerous sea mammals and birds, offering a unique opportunity to observe them in their natural habitat without disturbing their daily routines. After a day filled with exploration and natural wonders, retire to your Ushuaia hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: Ushuaia to El Calafate
itinerary.description: Start off the day with a healthy breakfast. On this day, you will bid farewell to your hotel and proceed to the airport for your flight to El Calafate. Upon arriving in El Calafate, you will be promptly transferred to your hotel for check-in. The remainder of the day is yours to enjoy at your leisure. You will spend the night at your hotel in El Calafate.

itinerary.title: El Calafate
itinerary.description: This morning, you will hop on for a full-day excursion to the awe-inspiring Perito Moreno Glacier. As you journey through the breathtaking landscape, you will witness the magnificence of nature at its finest. Continuing from El Calafate, along the southern shore of the Argentine Lake, you will reach the entrance to Los Glaciares National Park, which is situated 90 kilometers away. Here, you will follow the trails leading to the glacier. The Perito Moreno Glacier is a remarkable natural wonder, boasting an age of approximately 30,000 years. It covers an expansive surface area of 192 square kilometers, with a front wall extending for 5 kilometers and towering peaks that reach heights of up to 80 meters. Its deep blue base is nearly as dark as the surrounding waters. The tranquillity of the environment is occasionally broken by the resounding noise of massive chunks of ice breaking off from the glacier and plunging into the lake, where they float in the Icebergs Channel. For a more immersive experience, you will go on a Nautical Safari excursion, which allows you to truly appreciate the vastness of the Perito Moreno Glacier. The journey commences at Bajo de las Sombras Port, located 6 kilometers from the Glacier Vantage Point. Visitors board a boat and sail along Rico Lake. Upon reaching the southernmost part of the Icebergs Channel, the boat anchors at a safe distance from the towering wall of the Perito Moreno Glacier. Here, you will have the unique opportunity to observe the glacier's immense walls and the icebergs continually calving from the glacier into Rico Lake. After an eventful day, you will return to your hotel in El Calafate for the night.

itinerary.title: El Calafate to Bariloche
itinerary.description: On this day, you'll bid farewell to your hotel in El Calafate and head to the airport for a flight to Bariloche. Upon your arrival in Bariloche, you will be comfortably transferred to your new abode. After checking in at the hotel, the remainder of the day is yours to enjoy at your own pace. You'll be spending the night at the hotel in Bariloche.

itinerary.title: Bariloche Exploration
itinerary.description: Following a delicious breakfast, embark on a captivating journey through the picturesque city of Bariloche. Your adventure commences on Ezequiel Bustillo Avenue, a scenic route that meanders alongside the enchanting Nahuel Huapi lakeshore. Along the way, you'll feast your eyes on the natural beauty of Nahuel Huapi and Moreno lakes, El Trebol lagoon, San Pedro and Llao Llao peninsulas, Victoria Island, Otto, Lopez, Goye, and Catedral hills, as well as the charming town of San Carlos de Bariloche. Continuing your route, you'll pass by a serene golf course, cross the Angostura river bridge linking Nahuel Huapi Lake to Moreno Lake, and glide past López Bay, nestled at the foot of Lopez Hill. Your journey will culminate at the Panoramic Point, a scenic overlook boasting a splendid vista of Moreno Lake and Llao Llao peninsula. As the day unfolds, you'll return to your hotel in Bariloche for a restful night.

itinerary.title: Bariloche to Puerto Varas
itinerary.description: Today, you will go on a journey from the charming city of San Carlos de Bariloche in Argentina, venturing into Chile through the magnificent Andes Mountains. The day begins early as you set forth on your path towards the Cardenal Samore International Pass. As you traverse this mountainous terrain, you will be greeted by the sight of Osorno, Frutillar, Puerto Varas, and Puerto Montt, all nestled behind the peaks. This pass is the second most crucial international connection, providing direct access to Osorno and Puerto Montt via the Southern Road, as well as the rest of Chilean Patagonia. Your journey commences as you cross the Argentinean Customs Office and the National Gendarmerie. Along the route, you'll gradually notice signposts guiding the way to renowned Puyehue hot springs, the Antillanca Volcano with its ski resort, and the distance remaining to Osorno, your first official stop. After a brief pause, our bus resumes its course, leading you to Puerto Varas, just an hour away, where you will ultimately arrive. The evening will find you at a comfortable hotel in Puerto Varas, ready to rest and rejuvenate.

itinerary.title: Puerto Varas
itinerary.description: In the morning, hop on a Half Day Excursion to Frutillar. This delightful journey along the shores of Llanquihue Lake, the second-largest lake in Chile, will lead you to the quaint town of Frutillar. Along the way, you'll be treated to stunning vistas of the Osorno, Calbuco, Puntiagudo, and Tronador volcanoes. The town itself, with its charming 19th-century German architecture, offers a nostalgic trip back in time. Don't miss the chance to witness the breathtaking Osorno, Calbuco, Puntiagudo, and Tronador volcanoes, as well as the Teatro del Lago. Spend the night at your hotel in Puerto Varas.

itinerary.title: Puerto Varas - Santiago
itinerary.description: Today, bid farewell to your Puerto Varas hotel and transfer to Puerto Montt Airport for your flight to Santiago. Upon your arrival in Santiago, you will be transferred to your hotel. Santiago serves as the central hub for a region teeming with alluring destinations and activities. Just to the south of Santiago, you'll find the lush and picturesque vineyards of the Maipo Valley, one of the world's most renowned wine-producing regions. In the afternoon, indulge in a City tour of Santiago. This excursion will take you to the heart of the city, commencing at Bernardo O'Higgins Avenue, its main thoroughfare. You'll visit the presidential palace, La Moneda, and take a leisurely stroll through the pedestrian streets of Ahumada and Huerfanos, ending up at the historic Plaza de Armas, encircled by the cathedral and other venerable structures. The tour continues with a climb up San Cristobal Hill for a panoramic view of the city, and then proceeds to other intriguing areas, including Bellavista, a hub of cultural and artistic activity, and the modern residential districts of Las Condes and Providencia. Enjoy your overnight stay at your hotel in Santiago.

itinerary.title: Santiago
itinerary.description: Today, there will be a full-day excursion to Vina del Mar and Valparaiso. As the morning sun graces Santiago, you'll set off towards the coastline to explore the charming towns of Vina del Mar and Valparaiso. Your journey commences with a delightful stop in Pomaire, a quaint village renowned for its skilled artisans crafting an array of items from local clay, including dishes, pots, and intriguing sculptures, along with various other handicrafts. As you proceed towards the coast, take in the coastal beauty with visits to the sandy shores of Renaca and the enchanting town of Vina del Mar, often referred to as the Garden City due to its elegant parks and streets adorned with vibrant flowers. In the afternoon, continue your adventure to the picturesque port city of Valparaiso, established in the 16th century atop 43 hills. Navigating the city involves navigating narrow winding streets, staircases, and a network of lifts, also known as funiculars. This unique urban layout, boasting eclectic architecture and historical significance, has earned Valparaiso UNESCO's recognition as a World Heritage Site. Retreat to your hotel in Santiago for an overnight stay, enriched by the experiences of the day.

itinerary.title: Departing from Santiago
itinerary.description: After a satisfying breakfast, you will proceed to the airport to catch your flight, whether it be to your next destination or your cherished hometown. It's a day filled with memories that will last a lifetime.

itinerary.title: Arrival in São Paulo
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at São Paulo Airport, your local guide will warmly welcome you and accompany you to your hotel. You'll spend the night at the hotel in São Paulo.

itinerary.title: São Paulo to Rio de Janeiro
itinerary.description: After enjoying a delightful breakfast at the hotel, you'll embark on a City Tour to explore São Paulo. This tour offers an excellent opportunity to gain insight into the city's history, culture, and the lifestyle of the largest city in the Southern Hemisphere. It commences at Centro Cultural, guiding you through the historic heart of São Paulo. You'll have the chance to visit significant landmarks such as the Se Cathedral, Pátio do Colégio, Monastery of São Bento, the Banespa Building (resembling São Paulo's "Empire State Building"), Martinelli Building (South America's first skyscraper), Viaduto do Chá (Tea Bridge), the Municipal Theater, Sala São Paulo concert hall, Estação da Luz train station, and the Municipal Market. Later in the day, you'll be transferred to the airport for your flight to Rio de Janeiro. Upon arrival at Rio de Janeiro Airport, you'll be greeted and transferred to your hotel, where you'll spend the night in anticipation of the next day's adventures.

itinerary.title: Rio de Janeiro
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a delightful Full Day Sugar Loaf Excursion and City Tour of Rio de Janeiro. The adventure commences with a panoramic exploration of the city's downtown, taking you past iconic landmarks such as the Maracanã Stadium, the Sambodrome, the Metropolitan Cathedral (imposing with its pyramid shape, measuring 96 meters in diameter and soaring 80 meters high). As you stroll through the historic Cinelândia Square, you'll be captivated by the charm of its classical buildings, including the Municipal Theater, the National Library, and the National Museum of Fine Arts. Then, ascend from a small peninsula at the entrance of Guanabara Bay to Sugar Loaf, so named for its resemblance to a perfectly refined sugarloaf. This unique journey unfolds in two stages, carried by glass cable-cars. The initial cable-car ride whisks you to the summit of Urca Hill, rising 215 meters above sea level. The second cable-car ride elevates you to the apex of Sugar Loaf, an impressive 395 meters above sea level, offering a breathtaking 360-degree vista of the entire city, including the enchanting Botafogo and Copacabana Beaches, the iconic Corcovado, and the heart of downtown Rio de Janeiro. In the afternoon, your exploration continues as you visit the majestic Corcovado Mountain and the beautiful beaches. You'll spend the night at your hotel in Rio de Janeiro.

itinerary.title: Rio De Janeiro
itinerary.description: Today, you'll embark on a delightful Half Day Guanabara Bay Tour. This picturesque bay, surrounded by imposing mountains and serene beaches, brims with a rich historical tapestry. The cruise route meanders past numerous enchanting islands, such as Ilha de Villegaignon, Ilha Fiscal, Ilha das Cobras, and Ilha das Enxadas, to name a few. Along the way, you'll also catch sight of the bustling Docks and the majestic Rio-Niteroi Bridge. On the opposite shore of the bay, Niteroi's coastline beckons with a treasure trove of attractions. Gragoata beach and fort, charming islands like Ilha da Boa Viagem, adorned with the Church of Nossa Senhora da Boa Viagem, the Museum of Contemporary Art, and the stunning beaches of Flechas, Icarai, Sao Francisco, Charitas, Jurujuba, Adao e Eva await your exploration. Don't miss the awe-inspiring Pedra Itapuca and Pedra do Indio, along with the historic Santa Cruz Fortress. Your night will be spent at a comfortable hotel in the heart of Rio De Janeiro.

itinerary.title: Depart from Rio de Janeiro
itinerary.description: After enjoying a delightful breakfast, we will arrange your transfer to the airport. From there, you can catch your flight to your next destination or return to your hometown, carrying with you a treasure trove of lifelong memories.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Madrid – Segovia - Salamanca
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Adolfo Suárez Madrid–Barajas Airport, our tour representatives will greet you at the airport and help you get to your hotel. Complete the check-in process and venture out to explore Madrid. The spots you will be taken to include San Lorenzo de El Escorial, Alcala de Henares, Aranjuez, and El Retiro. From Madrid, you will be driven to the city of Segovia. Here, you will be visiting the two UNESCO World Heritage Sites namely the Old Town of Segovia and its Aqueduct and the Alcazar of Segovia. Explore Avila and the Old City of Salamanca before heading back to your hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: Salamanca - Plaza Mayor - House of Shells
itinerary.description: Dedicate the second day of your trip to exploring Salamanca. You will be taken to Plaza Mayor which was built in the traditional baroque style that is typical in Spanish architecture. Visit the House of Shells, which is a unique Gothic style building.

itinerary.title: Salamanca – Toledo
itinerary.description: On the third day of your trip, you will be transferred from Salamanca to Toledo. Check-in to your hotel in Toledo and spend the rest of the day at leisure.

itinerary.title: Toledo - Catedral de Toledo - Toledo Museum of Art
itinerary.description: In the morning, leave after breakfast to witness the tourist attractions in Toledo. Admire the beauty of Catedral de Toledo, a Roman Catholic church that has both French influences and a Gothic touch to its design. Walk around the Toledo Museum of Art, which is home to over 30,000 objects.

itinerary.title: Depart Madrid
itinerary.description: In the morning, check out of your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Nadi
itinerary.description: As you touch down at Nadi International Airport, our courteous tour representatives will be there to warmly welcome you. They will accompany you to your hotel for a seamless transfer. The rest of the day is yours to relish at your own pace. The resort offers a plethora of activities to keep you entertained throughout the day. Sink your toes into the soft, white sandy beaches or unwind by the tranquil pool. Your night's repose awaits at the resort.

itinerary.title: Nadi Exploration
itinerary.description: Kickstart your day with a delectable morning breakfast. Prepare for an enchanting half-day boat excursion along the scenic Navua River. As you journey through, you'll pass by traditional villages and uncover the pristine allure of cascading waterfalls. Don't miss out on the opportunity to partake in the customary 'Kava' ceremony, a revered national tradition in Fiji. Later, return to the resort for a peaceful night's rest.

itinerary.title: Nadi
itinerary.description: Following a delightful breakfast, venture to the southern reaches of Nadi town, where you'll find the exquisite Sri Siva Subramaniya Hindu Temple, a magnificent edifice celebrated as the Southern Hemisphere's largest. From there, your journey leads you to Denarau Island, a sanctuary for opulent resorts and thrilling adventure pursuits. Continue onwards to the enchanting Garden of the Sleeping Giant, a mere 10-minute drive from town, where an array of orchids graces the landscape. As the day draws to a close, embrace the cultural wonders of an evening Nadi cruise. Then, retreat to your plush resort for a restful night.

itinerary.title: Nadi
itinerary.description: This day is yours to savour at your leisure.

itinerary.title: Depart Nadi
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a delectable breakfast. Subsequently, make your way to the airport for your departing flight.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Nadi
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Nadi International Airport, you'll be warmly greeted by our tour representatives who will escort you to your hotel. After settling in, the day is yours to relish at your own pace. Whether you opt for thrilling activities, a stroll along the pristine white sandy beaches, or simply bask in the holiday ambiance, the choice is yours. Conclude the day back at the resort for a peaceful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Island Retreat
itinerary.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast, and then dive into the azure waters for snorkelling adventures amidst vibrant coral reefs. Explore the tranquil sea with a diving excursion or delve into the rich Fijian culture at the local village. To rejuvenate your body, mind, and soul, treat yourself to a spa session. In addition, engage in a range of non-motorized activities such as sailing, windsurfing, kayaking, tennis, hiking, and table tennis. As the day draws to a close, return to the hotel for a relaxing overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Island Resort
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a delightful morning breakfast, and then relish the day at your own pace. A plethora of activities awaits you, including a leisurely herbal medicine walk, captivating glass bottom boat excursions, engaging basket weaving classes, spirited beach volleyball matches, and the possibility of arranging a private boat charter, among other enticing options. If you desire, you can even arrange a charming picnic on a secluded island or embark on a boat trip to explore the nearby isles. As the day winds down, return to the hotel for a peaceful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Savusavu (Namale Island Resort)
itinerary.description: Following a swift and satisfying breakfast, embark on a catamaran ride that will transport you to Port Denarau. Upon arrival, you will be greeted by a dedicated driver who will escort you to Nadi Airport for your domestic flight to Savusavu. Upon landing in Savusavu, journey to the splendid Namale Island Resort, where lush rainforests meet the sparkling ocean. This sanctuary is renowned as a quintessential 5-star boutique resort. Your day here is filled with exciting water-based activities, such as invigorating waterfall hikes, scenic treks through the hills, a game of tennis, serene horseback riding, adventurous mountain biking, and the thrill of water skiing and kayaking, among other choices. Don't miss the chance to partake in a memorable dolphin watching cruise in the enchanting Natewa Bay, where you can witness skilled trainers' hand-feeding these majestic creatures. Your tour includes both lunch and dinner, and you'll spend the night in pure comfort at the resort.

itinerary.title: Savusavu (Namale Island Resort)
itinerary.description: Commence your day at the exquisite Namale Island Resort with a delightful breakfast. The hours ahead are yours to savour at your own pace, surrounded by the resort's enchanting ambiance. As the sun sets, return to the resort for a serene overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Savusavu - Nadi
itinerary.description: Following a satisfying morning meal, bid adieu to your Savusavu abode as you venture to the domestic departure terminal for your Pacific Sun flight to Nadi. Upon touching down in Nadi, our courteous tour representatives will be at your service, ensuring a seamless transfer to your chosen hotel. Take the day to explore an array of exhilarating activities, and as night falls, retreat to your resort for a restful night's sleep.

itinerary.title: Depart from Nadi
itinerary.description: Begin your final day in Fiji with a swift yet delightful breakfast, then head to Nadi Airport. Here, you'll patiently await your flight, cherishing the memories of your Fijian adventure.

packages.name: Bali with Komodo Island
packages.destination: Bali - Uluwatu Kecak - Labuan Bajo - Rinca Island - Kalong & Bidadari Islands - Labuan Bajo - FD Kintamani - Ubud

itinerary.title: Arrive at Bali - Celuk Village - Mas Village
itinerary.description: Once you reach Bali, you will be greeted by our tour representative at the airport, who will transfer you to the hotel. Begin your Balinese holiday by visiting the village of Celuk, well-known for its gold and silver jewelry. Follow it up by visiting Mas Village and admiring the finely carved wood sculptures.

itinerary.title: Labuan Bajo - Rinca Island
itinerary.description: Board your morning flight to Labuan Bajo, where our tour representative will guide you to the traditional wooden boat that sets for Komodo Island. Lunch will be served on the boat. As the name suggests, the island is famous for Komodos and is the only place where you’ll find an island full of these ancient reptiles. Go on a trek to Rinca Island, where the stunning landscapes will surely mesmerize you.

itinerary.title: Kalong and Bidadari Islands
itinerary.description: Head out early in the morning towards the Kalong and Bidadari Islands. This is where you can relax and enjoy as many water sports as you like, including snorkeling. Take a flight back to Bali the same day and get a good night’s rest at your hotel.

itinerary.title: Kintamani Volcano Safari – Ubud Central Market
itinerary.description: The first adventure of the day is the Kintamani Volcano Safari, where you can come face-to-face with the breathtaking view of the hot black lava of Mount Batur and also see the rice terraces, coffee plantations, and ancient temples. End your day by going to the central market in Ubud to purchase souvenirs.

itinerary.title: Depart from Bali
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Calicut
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival in Calicut, our tour representatives will greet you at the airport/railway station and help you get to your hotel. Once you complete the check-in formalities, you’re free to spend the rest of the day at your own pace.

itinerary.title: Wayanad
itinerary.description: After having a delicious breakfast, you will be taken to explore the mesmerising district of Wayanad. Dedicate this day to witnessing spellbindingly beautiful sites such as Pookode Lake, the rain forest of Lakkidi, Kuruva Island, and the Edakkal Caves. The rock engravings you see at Edakkal Caves are known to date back to the Neolithic Age. Your day will also include taking a tour of Panamaram, Mananthavady, and checking out the tributary known as Kabini.

itinerary.title: Wayanad - Calicut
itinerary.description: Enjoy a filling breakfast at your hotel in Wayanad and then leave for Calicut. Check-in to your hotel, rest for a while, and then get ready for some more adventures. Our tour representatives will take you to some of the most enthralling spots in Calicut, including Kozhikode Beach, Thali Temple, Pazhassi Raja Archaeological Museum, Kappad Beach, and Beypore Beach. Get back to your hotel in Calicut for a good night’s sleep.

itinerary.title: Depart Calicut
itinerary.description: In the morning, have your breakfast at the hotel and then leave for the airport or railway station to get back to your hometown.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Delhi - Shimla
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Delhi Airport, our tour representatives will greet you at the airport, from where you will be heading to Shimla. Check-in to your hotel and then proceed to spend the rest of the day relaxing.

itinerary.title: Shimla City Tour
itinerary.description: Start off the day by visiting the Christ Church, which is North India’s second oldest church. Explore the Tudor Library, which is now referred to as the State Library Shimla. Get back to your hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: Shimla - Kufri
itinerary.description: Once you have your breakfast, leave for the resort hill station of Kufri. Regarded as a place of wonders, you can explore some of the beloved sightseeing spots in Kufri on your own, such as the Himalayan Nature Park, Kufri Zoo, and Mahasu Peak. Get back to your hotel to enjoy a good night’s sleep.

itinerary.title: Shopping in Shimla
itinerary.description: Shimla is known for its shopping scene, allowing tourists to take home plenty of wonderful gifts and souvenirs for themselves and their loved ones. Head over to Mall Road, a major shopping centre in the city where you can shop for woollen clothes, wooden and metal goods, keychains, jewellery, handicrafts, and pottery items. You can then go to The Ridge, where you will find rugs, carpets, scarves, mufflers, jackets, and more.

itinerary.title: Depart Shimla
itinerary.description: Relish a delicious breakfast at your hotel and then leave for Delhi Airport, from where you will be boarding your flight back home.

packages.name: Amazing Thailand Tour Package Itinerary
packages.destination: Phuket - Phi Phi Island - Bangkok - Pattaya - Coral Island

itinerary.title: Arrival at Phuket
itinerary.description: When you arrive at Phuket International Airport, someone will be there to meet you and take you to your hotel in Phuket. Once you are at the hotel, you will check in. Phuket is a beautiful place by the Andaman Sea, and it is a popular tropical beach resort. After checking in, you have the rest of the day to relax and do whatever you like. You'll spend the night at the hotel in Phuket. Optional Activity: Phuket FantaSea Show – No Dinner (Extra Cost) The Phuket FantaSea Show, also known as FantaSea of a Kingdom, is like a show you might see in Las Vegas but with a Thai cultural twist. The show represents everything Thai, including love for freedom, fun, courage, and compassion. It takes place in the Palace of the Elephants Theater and tells a mythical story using traditional Thai dance, music, and costumes. There are also colourful special effects, magical illusions, pyrotechnics, and even dancing elephants. The show is suitable for families, and it's a unique and entertaining experience. If you're interested, you can choose to attend this show at an additional cost.

itinerary.title: Explore Phi Phi Islands from Phuket
itinerary.description: Begin your day with breakfast. Then, take a ferry to Phi Phi Islands for a tour. Relax on beautiful white beaches, surrounded by impressive cliffs and clear water. Lunch is included. Later in the afternoon, you will return to Phuket and stay overnight at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Travel from Phuket to Pattaya via Bangkok
itinerary.description: Start your day with a wonderful breakfast. Head to Phuket International airport and catch a flight to Bangkok. Upon arrival at Bangkok International airport, you'll be transferred to a hotel in Pattaya. Check in and have the rest of the day at leisure. Stay overnight at the hotel in Pattaya.

itinerary.title: Pattaya – Coral Island
itinerary.description: Today, after having breakfast, you'll hop on a speedy boat to reach Coral Island, the biggest among Pattaya's group of islands. Explore the underwater world and colourful coral formations through a special boat with a see-through bottom. You can also try out exciting water activities like Para Sailing and water skiing. Lunch will be provided, and the rest of the evening is free for you to relax at the hotel in Pattaya.

itinerary.title: Bangkok
itinerary.description: Today, you'll head to Bangkok and check into your hotel. The rest of the day is yours to spend as you like. You can also choose to take an optional Chao Phraya Cruise with dinner (additional cost). This cruise offers delightful Thai cuisine, entertaining performances, and breathtaking views of the river. As you enjoy a buffet-style dinner, you'll cruise along the river, passing by historic temples and landmarks. A live band and talented singers will keep you entertained throughout the evening.

itinerary.title: Bangkok City Tour
itinerary.description: Today, after having breakfast, you'll explore the city and visit some interesting places. The highlight of our tour is the Golden Buddha temple, where you can see a very old and huge gold Buddha statue. It's 3 metres tall and weighs a whopping five and a half tons. This statue comes from the Sukhothai Period. We'll also stop by the Marble Temple (Wat Benchamabophit), which is a modern and famous Thai temple. The main chapel is made of white Italian marble, and inside, you'll find a replica of the most beautiful Buddha image in Thailand. Tonight, you will stay at the hotel in Bangkok. Optional Activity (at an additional cost): Sea Life Bangkok Ocean World & Madame Tussauds If you're interested, you can visit Sea Life Bangkok Ocean World, one of the largest aquariums in Southeast Asia. There's a cool Shark Walk where you can see different shark species swimming below you. Madame Tussauds Bangkok is a wax museum where you can see lifelike statues of famous people from around the world, including celebrities, leaders, activists, sports heroes, and even royalty.

itinerary.title: Leaving Bangkok
itinerary.description: After a tasty breakfast this morning, you'll be taken to Bangkok International Airport. From there, you can catch your flight back home or to your next exciting destination. Safe travels!

packages.name: Bangkok Holiday Package
packages.destination: Bangkok - Phuket-FantaSea Show - Phuket-Phi-Phi Island Tour - Bangkok-Pattaya - Safari World

itinerary.title: Phuket – FantaSea Show
itinerary.description: As you arrive at the Phuket International Airport, our tour representative will receive you and help you transfer to the hotel. We’ll explain the itinerary and provide instructions about the dos and don’ts of exploring a traditional Buddhist country and rules regarding respecting the monarchy. Phuket is a beautiful island filled with lush greenery and stunning beaches. Not to mention the scrumptious food in the many street stalls. Some islands in and around Phuket include Koh Phi Phi, Koh Kai Noi, Koh Racha, and Koh Lon. You will explore FantaSea Show, a Thai cultural theme park that best represents Thai culture and tradition. Some of the things you can do at the theme park include souvenir shopping, dinner at the Golden Kinnaree Buffet Restaurant, jewellery shopping at the Iyara Grande, riding elephants on Palace Court, and shopping for tribal art at the Tribal Craft Bazaar. End the day by visiting the local markets. Spend the night at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Phi-Phi Island Tour
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a scrumptious breakfast with Thai, Indian, and Continental delicacies. For dessert, sample some of their exotic tropical fruits. You will depart Phuket to move on to Phi-Phi Island by ferry. Phi-Phi Island is famous for its beautiful corals and marine life, including leopard sharks and giant manta rays. Tourists also visit the surrounding islands, viz., Koh Mai Pai and Koh Yung. Some attractions in Phi-Phi Island include Maya Bay, Loh Samah Bay, Ko Yao Yai, and Laem Tong Beach. There are plenty of activities on Phi-Phi Island, including snorkelling, swimming with corals and the Finding Nemo snorkelling tour. Spend the night at the hotel, unwinding at one of the many wellness spas.

itinerary.title: Phuket Bangkok Pattaya
itinerary.description: After a scrumptious breakfast, head to Phuket Airport to board your flight to Bangkok, Thailand’s capital. At the airport, our tour representative will help you take your coach to Pattaya. Pattaya is famous for its beaches, including the beautiful Jomtien Beach and its crazy nightlife. It’s also renowned for its local markets, where you can shop for souvenirs and gawk at the street food stalls selling exotic meat, including grilled snake and crocodile. Don’t miss shopping at the local night markets to buy keychains, fridge magnets, and traditional Thai handicrafts. The Alcazar Show is another attraction and is famous for being the best transvestite cabaret show. Enjoy the show, admiring the art, costumes, and stage design. Spend the night at the hotel, unwinding after a day of fun and activity.

itinerary.title: Pattaya
itinerary.description: Today, you will explore Pattaya, experiencing its history, culture, beaches, and water parks. Some of the unique attractions in Pattaya include: The Sanctuary of Truth – This wooden building is a blend of castle and temple architecture based on Hindu and Buddhist beliefs. Wat Yansangwararam – This large Buddhist temple is a replica of the Mahabodhi Temple in Gaya, India. The temple is famous for its monuments, gardens, lakes, and Chinese pavilions. Some other attractions in Pattaya include swimming, banana riding, and jet ski riding on Coral Island, exploring the different native fishes in Underwater World Pattaya, and visiting the Nong Nooch Tropical Botanical Garden. End your day exploring the different local markets for some souvenir shopping. Spend the night at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Bangkok
itinerary.description: Today, you will explore Bangkok, Thailand’s capital city. Your tour representative will take you for a half-day city tour, visiting some of the city’s popular attractions. Some of the places covered in the itinerary include: Wat Pho – This is Bangkok's largest and oldest temple, famous for the Reclining Buddha. The temple is older than Bangkok and existed when Thailand was part of the historic city of Ayutthaya. Wat Traimit – The Temple of the Golden Buddha was built in the 18th century, famous for its enormous golden Buddha statue. During the 1950s, it was discovered that the statue was made using solid gold, weighing over 5.5 tons. It is likely 700 to 800 years old. Wat Benchamabophit – This marble temple is made using Italian Carrara marble. It was designed by Prince Narisara Nuvadtivongs using European and Chinese design influences. Other attractions in Bangkok include The Grand Palace, Chatuchak Weekend Market, and Wat Arun. End your day exploring the different local markets for some souvenir shopping. Spend the night at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Safari World – Bangkok
itinerary.description: Safari World is Asia’s largest open-air zoo and home to hundreds of animals, including tigers, lions, elephants, and zebras. This drive-in park is split into two experiences. The first experience involves observing the animals in their natural habitat. The second section involves visiting the Marine Park or Water Park. Some of the attractions in the later section include marine life shows, aquarium visits, marine life exhibit visits, bird shows, jungle cruises, animal safaris, elephant shows, and adventure shows.

itinerary.title: Depart Bangkok
itinerary.description: After a hearty breakfast, head to Indra Market for some last-minute souvenir shopping. Bid goodbye to Thailand and head on to the Bangkok International Market.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Bangkok - Phuket-FantaSea Show
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Phuket Airport, our tour representatives will welcome you and transfer you to the hotel. Phuket is a stunning island with beautiful landscapes and no land boundaries. The name "Phuket" comes from the Malay word meaning "Hill." It is the largest island in Thailand, situated in the Andaman Sea. Once you arrive at Phuket Airport, our tour representatives will greet you and take you to a beach resort, where you can relax for the remainder of the day. In the evening, enjoy the FantaSea Show before returning to the hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Phuket-Phi-Phi Island Tour
itinerary.description: Start your day with breakfast at the hotel. Head to Phi-Phi Island by Express Boat. While on the island, enjoy sightseeing at Maya Bay and have a great time exploring. If you're into snorkelling or the underwater world, the tour representative can drop you off at Coral Bay for swimming and snorkelling to find Nemo. Have lunch and then return to Phuket. Spend the night at your hotel in Phuket.

itinerary.title: Phuket-Bangkok
itinerary.description: After your morning breakfast, travel to Bangkok, the capital and largest city of Thailand. Our tour representatives will guide you on a half-day city tour of Bangkok. Visit some of the most famous temple monasteries, including Wat Po (The Temple of the Reclining Buddha), Wat Trimit (The Temple of the Solid Gold Buddha weighing 5 1⁄2 tons of gold), and Wat Benchamabophit (The Marble Temple). Proceed to the world-famous Gems and Jewelry Shop for some purchases of Jade stone. Enjoy the rest of the day at your leisure and later return to the hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Bangkok - Safari World
itinerary.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast at the hotel. Our tour representatives will guide you on a Safari World tour. The zoological park is split into two sections. The first part is an open zoo featuring various wild animals, and the second part is the Marine Park, home to marine animals, trained dolphins, seals, apes, and birds. Begin your exploration at Safari Park, where you can marvel at rare and endangered species of the animal kingdom. Take your time to discover the wonders of nature. Return to the private car or coach for a brief relaxation. Don't miss the chance to witness the impressive Tiger and Lion Feeding showroom. Next, enjoy entertaining shows like Bird Show, Spy War, Dolphin Show, Orang Utan Boxing Show, Cowboy Show, and Sea Lion Show. Head back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Bangkok Departure
itinerary.description: Enjoy a quick breakfast before heading to Indhira Market for some shopping. In the evening, our tour guide will transport you to Bangkok International Airport for your departure.

itinerary.title: Desert Safari
itinerary.description: Once you land in Dubai, you will be greeted by our tour representatives, who will take you to your hotel. After checking in, you can head to the hotel's dining area to enjoy your lunch and get some rest to prepare for the busy day ahead. We begin with the magic of the desert and the dunes through the desert safari. You can opt for camel rides and dune bashing or relax and sip on Arabic coffee while devouring the delicious local food before retiring for a night under the stars.

itinerary.title: Burj Khalifa - Dubai Mall - Dhow Cruise
itinerary.description: You’ll visit the Burj Khalifa, the world’s largest building, the following day. Ride to its observation decks for a mesmerizing view of this glittering city. Indulge in some retail therapy at Dubai Mall, home to all the luxury brands you can imagine. In the evening, ride the dhow cruise and experience a lavish display of spellbinding entertainment.

itinerary.title: Arrive at Abu Dhabi – Yas Waterworld - Warner Bros. World
itinerary.description: Take your flight from Dubai to Abu Dhabi, where our tour representatives will greet you and take you to your hotel. Once you freshen up, you can experience Abu Dhabi in all its glory, beginning with the water-based activities and fun at Yas Waterworld. Later, we’ll take you to Warner Bros. to enjoy a world filled with rides, character interactions, and thrilling shows.

itinerary.title: Louvre - Ferrari World
itinerary.description: If art fascinates you, you will surely love the exhibitions and galleries within the Louvre. Finish the day with a visit to Ferrari World, the world’s first Ferrari-themed park on Yas Island.

itinerary.title: Depart from Abu Dhabi
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Coimbatore - Chennai - Arrive in New Jalpaiguri
itinerary.description: Board the train from Coimbatore Junction Railway Station to reach New Jalpaiguri.

itinerary.title: New Jalpaiguri
itinerary.description: The second day of your trip will be reserved for your journey to New Jalpaiguri.

itinerary.title: New Jalpaiguri - Gangtok
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at New Jalpaiguri Railway Station, our tour representatives will greet you and help you get to your hotel. Once you complete the check-in formalities, you can spend the rest of the day at leisure. Spend the night at your hotel.

itinerary.title: Gangtok - Tsongmo Lake - Baba Mandir
itinerary.description: After having your breakfast, leave to visit Tsongmo Lake. Also known as Tsomgo Lake or Changu Lake, the lake changes colours as the seasons go along, and remains frozen during the winters. The local Sikkimese people hold great respect for Tsongmo Lake. Yet another popular tourist spot you will be visiting today is Baba Mandir, a temple that was built to honour the memory of Baba Harbhajan Singh. He was a soldier in the Indian army who died fighting for the country. Return to your hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: Gangtok - Darjeeling
itinerary.description: Half of this day will be dedicated to covering some of the most popular tourist destinations in Gangtok. Start off with Banjhakri Falls and Energy Park, a recreation centre with the park located next to an army camp in a thickly forested region of Swastik. Banjhakri Falls is a natural waterfall whose water comes from springs situated at a higher altitude. The concept of the theme park was suggested by Pawan Kumar Chamling, who was the Chief Minister of Sikkim. Head over to Do Drul Chorten, a giant stupa that was built in 1945 by the head of the Nyingma order of Tibetan Buddhism, Trulshik Rinpoche. The interior of the stupa contains a complete set of Dorje Phurba, holy books, and various kinds of religious items. Explore the Namgyal Institute of Tibetology, a prominent research centre dedicated to the art, history, culture, language, people, and religion of Tibet. Your tour of Gangtok will end after visiting the Directorate of Handicrafts & Handloom and Flower Exhibition Centre. By noon, you will be shifting from Gangtok to Darjeeling, and you can spend the night at your hotel.

itinerary.title: Darjeeling City Tour
itinerary.description: Early in the morning, before sunrise, you will be leaving to witness the spellbinding beauty of Tiger Hill, where the illuminated peaks of Kanchenjunga can be seen as sunlight falls on them. This spot offers the most gorgeous panoramic view of Mount Everest as well as Mount Kanchenjunga. On your way back, see the Batasia Loop, an engineering marvel from where you can lay eyes on Mount Kanchenjunga and Darjeeling’s snow-capped mountains. Stop by the Ghoom Monastery, which is reputed for its 15-foot-long statue of the Maitreya Buddha. After getting back to your hotel and enjoying a scrumptious breakfast, venture out for a half-day tour of Darjeeling. The first stop will be the Japanese Buddhist Temple, whose foundation stone was laid by Nichidatsu Fujii in November 1972. The temple was inaugurated two decades later in November 1992. Enjoy the view of the animals housed at Padmaja Naidu Himalayan Zoological Park which is dedicated to wildlife conservation. Inaugurated in 1958, this zoo is spread over an area of 67.56 acres. Hop on a cable car ride from the Darjeeling Ropeway to get a mesmerising view of Darjeeling’s forests, waterfalls, rivers, tea gardens, and valleys. You will also be visiting the Himalayan Mountaineering Institute, Tenzing and Gombu Rock, and the Tibetan Refugee Self-Help Centre on this day.

itinerary.title: Darjeeling - New Jalpaiguri - Chennai
itinerary.description: Have your breakfast in the morning and leave for the airport or railway station to begin your journey towards Chennai.

itinerary.title: Depart Chennai
itinerary.description: If you’re travelling by train, you will be reaching Chennai Central Railway Station on the last day of your trip.
