itinerary.title: Arrival in Bangkok - Pattaya
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Bangkok International Airport, meet our tour representatives and be transported to Pattaya by coach. This charming city is situated on the east coast of the Gulf of Thailand. Pattaya boasts numerous captivating sandy beaches, fantastic shopping, and amazing tourist attractions. Originally a fishing town, it has evolved into one of Thailand's top tourist destinations. Once you arrive in Pattaya, transfer to the hotel and take some time to relax. In the evening, attend the Alcazar show, also known as the Tiffany Show. This show is a beautiful combination of art, costumes, and stage design. Enjoy the musical performance and return to the hotel for your overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Pattaya
itinerary.description: Have breakfast at the hotel, then get set to discover the coral island with our tour representatives. Experience the rich coral and underwater world through a glass bottom boat. After that, have some fun with water activities like sunbathing, riding water scooters, parasailing, snorkelling, and more. Take your time to enjoy the place and return to the city for some shopping. In the evening, head back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Pattaya to Bangkok
itinerary.description: After having your morning breakfast, head to Bangkok, the capital and largest city of Thailand. Our tour representatives will guide you on a half-day city tour of Bangkok. Explore some of the most renowned temple monasteries in the city, including Wat Po (The Temple of the Reclining Buddha), Wat Trimit (The Temple of the Solid Gold Buddha weighing 5 ½ tons of gold), and Wat Benchamabophit (The Marble Temple). Visit the world-famous Gems and Jewelry Shop for the opportunity to purchase Jade stone. The rest of the day is yours to enjoy at your own pace. Later, return to the hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Bangkok - Safari World
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delicious breakfast at the hotel. Our tour representatives will guide you through an exciting day at Safari World. This zoological park is split into two parts. The first part is an open zoo housing a variety of wild animals. The second part is the Marine Park, where you can encounter marine animals, trained dolphins, seals, apes, and birds. Begin your exploration at Safari Park, where you can observe rare and endangered species at your own pace. Afterward, return to the private car or coach to relax for a while. Don't miss the thrilling Tiger and Lion Feeding showroom. Next, enjoy entertaining shows such as the Bird Show, Spy War, Dolphin Show, Orangutan Boxing Show, Cowboy Show, and Sea Lion Show. Finally, head back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Bangkok Departure
itinerary.description: Have a quick breakfast before heading to Indhira Market for some shopping. In the evening, our tour guide will escort you to Bangkok International Airport for your departure.

packages.name: Shoppers Delight- Sentosa Sunset Tour
packages.destination: Singapore - Night Safari - Singapore City Tour - Sentosa Sunset Tour - Universal Studios - Genting Highlands - Kuala Lumpur - Kuala Lumpur City Tour

itinerary.title: Night Safari
itinerary.description: Once you land in Singapore, our tour representatives will greet you at the airport and take you to the hotel. After you check in and freshen up, you can have lunch at the hotel's dining area and rest. In the evening, leave for the Night Safari, the world’s first nocturnal zoo, where you can see animals such as Asian Elephants, the Malayan tiger, and fishing cats.

itinerary.title: Singapore City Tour - Sentosa Island Tour
itinerary.description: The second day of your Singapore trip starts with a half-day tour of the city where we will cover Chinatown’s Thian Hock Keng temple and other attractions. We’ll then proceed to Sentosa Island and experience the eclectic activities offered. Tourists can choose to go on cable car rides, interact with adorable dolphins, or stroll through the island's many beaches. The package also includes Underwater World and Song of the Sea light show. Get back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Universal Studios
itinerary.description: Universal Studios is the best place if you’ve always wanted to relive your childhood and enjoy your favorite movies. It is Southeast Asia’s first and only Universal Studio theme park. Enjoy your adrenaline pumping rides and movie-based rides.

itinerary.title: Genting Highlands
itinerary.description: The cruise will reach Genting Highlands, one of Malaysia's most popular destinations. Pay your respects at the Chin Swee Caves Temple and browse through the Genting Strawberry Leisure Farm. Board the Star Virgo Cruise at night and enjoy the Captain’s Cocktail dinner. Remember to bring some formal attire for dinner and to enjoy some of the entertainment activities on the cruise ship. Spend your night on the Star Virgo.

itinerary.title: Genting Highlands – Kuala Lumpur
itinerary.description: Start your day with the complimentary breakfast buffet before moving on to visit the Genting SkyWorlds Theme Park, an outdoor theme park for a magical adventure with your family. Move on to Kuala Lumpur to explore Malaysia’s capital city and admire the city’s numerous attractions. Spend your night in Kuala Lumpur and get some much-needed rest for the busy day tomorrow.

itinerary.title: Kuala Lumpur City Tour
itinerary.description: Once you reach Kuala Lumpur, you will have an entire day to explore Malaysia's capital city, including the Petronas Towers, Batu Caves, and the National Museum.

itinerary.title: Depart from Kuala Lumpur
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Sydney
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival in Sydney, our tour representatives will greet you and help you get to the hotel. After completing the check-in formalities, you can enjoy the day at leisure. At night, you could have your dinner at the 360 Bar and Dining in the Sydney Tower, a rotating restaurant that offers you a view of the entire city.

itinerary.title: Sydney
itinerary.description: After having a delicious breakfast, you will be given a Sydney Explorer Pass to experience all the popular attractions of Sydney. The places you will be visiting include Botanic Gardens, Sydney Cove, Australian Museum, The Rocks, Kings Cross, Mrs Macquarie's Chair, Queen Victoria Building, Art Gallery of New South Wales, Sydney Opera House, and Australian National Maritime Museum. Some of the other gems you will be visiting today are the Wild Life Sydney Zoo, Hyde Park, Sydney Cricket Ground, Double Bay, Gap Park, Bondi Beach, and Oxford Street. Spend the night at your hotel.

itinerary.title: Sydney
itinerary.description: Once you get done with breakfast, you can spend the rest of your day the way you like. Making a day trip to the Blue Mountains is one of the options. You can also visit the Featherdale Sydney Wildlife Park, where you can spot kangaroos, koalas, wombats, and Tasmanian devils.

itinerary.title: Sydney - Brisbane - Gold Coast
itinerary.description: In the morning, board a flight to Brisbane. On reaching the city of Brisbane, you will be transferred to Gold Coast, known for its surfing spots and beaches. Check-in to your hotel and relax for the rest of the day. We recommend visiting the Australian Outback Spectacular in the evening, where you can enjoy a 3-hour long dinner show featuring animals and an immersive technological experience you will never forget.

itinerary.title: Gold Coast
itinerary.description: Get ready to spend a day filled with adventures and adrenaline rush, as today you will be taken to Dreamworld, which is renowned for being the biggest theme park in Australia. Home to over 40 rides and enchanting wildlife, make sure to get on the Giant Drop, Mick Doohan's Motocoaster, and Tail Spin.

itinerary.title: Gold Coast
itinerary.description: Another day of outdoor adventures and fun awaits you at the Warner Bros. Movie World, which is the only film-related theme park in Australia. From rides and shows to food and shopping, you will never run out of things to do at this delightful destination. Later in the day, you can visit the theme park known as Sea World, which is a famous marine animal park. Boasting rides, presentations, and unforgettable shows, you will get to come across beautiful marine life at this park, such as penguins, dolphins, and polar bears.

itinerary.title: Gold Coast – Cairns
itinerary.description: In the morning, board a flight to journey from Gold Coast to the city of Cairns. Upon reaching your hotel, you can complete the check-in process and enjoy the day at your own pace. We recommend visiting Kuranda Village, which is a charming mountain retreat. Get on the Kuranda Scenic Railway to make your way from Cairns to Kuranda, with the journey giving you views of waterfalls, bridges, tunnels, and ravines.

itinerary.title: Cairns
itinerary.description: Today, you will be getting aboard a Big Cat Green Island Reef Cruise to journey up to Green Island. From crocodiles and coral reefs to white beaches and rainforests, the views are endlessly beautiful on this island. Witness the magic of a semi-submarine tour as you witness the endless marine life upfront.

itinerary.title: Depart Cairns
itinerary.description: Enjoy a filling breakfast and leave for the airport to board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Bangkok - Transfer to Pattaya
itinerary.description: Upon arriving at Bangkok International Airport, meet our tour representatives and be transported to Pattaya by coach. This beautiful Thai city is situated on the east coast of the Gulf of Thailand, boasting captivating sandy beaches, excellent shopping, and incredible tourist attractions. Once a fishing town, Pattaya has evolved into one of Thailand's premier tourist destinations. Upon reaching Pattaya, transfer to the hotel and take some time to relax. Explore the Alcazar show, also known as the Tiffany Show, a captivating blend of art, costumes, and stage design. Enjoy the musical performance and return to the hotel for your overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Pattaya
itinerary.description: Start your day with breakfast at the hotel. Get ready to explore the coral island with our tour representatives. Experience the vibrant coral and underwater world through a glass-bottom boat. Afterwards, engage in watersports like sunbathing, water scooter, parasailing, snorkelling, and more. Enjoy some quality time in the area and then return to the city for shopping. In the evening, head back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Pattaya - Bangkok
itinerary.description: After breakfast, travel to Bangkok, the capital and largest city of Thailand. Our tour representatives will guide you on a half-day city tour, visiting some of Bangkok's most famous temple monasteries. Explore Wat Po (The Temple of the Reclining Buddha), Wat Trimit (The Temple of the Solid Gold Buddha weighing 5 1⁄2 tons of gold), and Wat Benchamabophit (The Marble Temple). Continue to the world-famous Gems and Jewelry Shop for some Jade stone shopping. Enjoy the rest of the day at your leisure before returning to the hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Bangkok Departure
itinerary.description: Have a quick breakfast and head to Indhira Market for shopping. In the evening, our tour guide will transfer you to Bangkok International Airport for your departure.

packages.name: Thailand Tour Packages
packages.destination: Bangkok - Chiangmai - Chiangmai Temple Tour - Safari World

itinerary.title: Arrival In Chiang Mai
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at the Chiang Mai International Airport, our tour representative will welcome you and help you transfer to the hotel. We’ll brief you about the tour and explain the etiquette to be followed in the religious places. Chiang Mai is a beautiful city famous for its handicrafts, including silverware, lacquerware, woodwork, and umbrellas. But what makes it even more special is the city’s ancient and unique temples. When in Chiang Mai, don’t miss the beautiful temples, chedis, boutique hotels, and local night markets. It is also an excellent place for adventure lovers with a range of activities, including ziplining, river rafting, camping, trekking, and ATV riding. Spend the day enjoying the city at your leisure and stay overnight at a Chiang Mai hotel.

itinerary.title: Chiang Mai Temple Tour
itinerary.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast at the buffet. Your first stop for the day is Wat Chedi Luang, a 14th-century temple famous for its enormous Buddhist chedi, built in the Lanna architecture. Some of the other temples included in the Chiang Mai Temple Tour include: Wat Phra Singh – This 14th-century temple has a distinct Lanna architecture but is also influenced by neighbouring Burmese and Sri Lankan architecture. The temple is also famous for its intricate art, including sculptures, doors, windows, and panels. Wat Suan Dok – Also called Wat Buppharam, this 14th-century temple features Lanna-style architecture and houses a 500-year-old bronze statue of Buddha. And if you’re at the right time, don’t miss the annual temple fair held in June every year. After the Chiang Mai Temple Tour, we’ll conclude the day with a visit to the Chiang Mai market, which is famous for Thai handicrafts, including clothes, souvenirs, and jewellery.

itinerary.title: Chiang Mai To Bangkok
itinerary.description: Today, you’ll catch your flight to Bangkok, but not before sampling a scrumptious breakfast buffet featuring Indian, Thai, and Continental delicacies. And, of course, a huge range of exotic tropical fruits. As soon as you land in Bangkok, our tour representatives will help you check in to the hotel. Later, we’ll take you on a half-day tour of the city, covering a range of attractions, viz., the Wat Pho Temple, Wat Traimit Temple, and Wat Benchamabophit. You’ll end the day with some jade and souvenir shopping at Bangkok's many gem and jewellery shops. Spend the night at a Bangkok luxury hotel.

itinerary.title: Safari World – Bangkok
itinerary.description: Today, you will explore Safari World, a 200-acre open-air zoo. This is Asia’s largest open-air zoo, home to various animals and birds, including tigers, lions, and zebras. You mustn’t miss the zoo’s marine park, famous for its life shows, aquarium, and adventure zone. Some of the activities in Safari World include under-the-sea experiences, jungle cruise river tours, jungle walks, and orang-utan shows, sea lion shows, and dolphin shows. Spend the night at your hotel.

itinerary.title: Bangkok Departure
itinerary.description: On the last day of your tour, we’ll take you to Indra Market to complete your shopping. Later, end the day with a return flight to India from the Bangkok International Airport.

In the evening, attend the Alcazar show, also known as Tiffany Show. This show is a captivating mix of art, costumes, and stage design. Enjoy the musical performance and return to the hotel for your overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Pattaya

Afterwards, participate in water sports like sunbathing, riding water scooters, parasailing, snorkeling, and more. Enjoy some quality time on the island before heading back to the city for shopping. In the evening, return to the hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Pattaya - Nong Nooch Village
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delicious breakfast, and then head to Nong Nooch Village for a day of exploration. The Tropical Garden is home to a variety of orchid species, vibrant flowers, a palm garden, and colorful plants from around the world. Prepare for a delightful time at the Elephant Show, where these gentle giants showcase their skills in football, bike riding, and more. Take a leisurely stroll through the beautifully landscaped gardens, immersing yourself in the pleasant fragrance of millions of flowers. Don't miss the chance to observe trained chimpanzees and elephants in their natural surroundings. Return to the hotel for your overnight stay after a day filled with wonderful experiences.

itinerary.title: Pattaya to Bangkok
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delicious breakfast before heading to Bangkok, Thailand's capital and largest city. Our tour representatives will guide you on a half-day city tour of Bangkok. Explore some of the most renowned temple monasteries in the city, including Wat Po (The Temple of the Reclining Buddha), Wat Trimit (The Temple of the Solid Gold Buddha weighing 5 ½ tons of gold), and Wat Benchamabophit (The Marble Temple). Make a visit to the world-famous Gems and Jewelry Shop to purchase Jade stone. The remainder of the day is yours to enjoy at your leisure. Later, return to the hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Departure from Bangkok
itinerary.description: Start your day with a quick breakfast, and then head to Indhira Market for some shopping. In the evening, our tour guide will transfer you to Bangkok International Airport for your departure.

itinerary.title: Arrive at Bali - Bounty Sunset Cruise
itinerary.description: After you reach Bali, our local representative will greet you at the airport and take you to the hotel. Once you’re done having breakfast at the hotel, proceed to the Benoa Port to board the Bounty Sunset Cruise. You can cruise through the coastal area of Benoa to relish delicious food with your family while enjoying entertaining dance and music performances. Get back to your hotel after a fulfilling dinner on the cruise.

itinerary.title: Safari Marine Park
itinerary.description: Get ready to enjoy an exhilarating safari experience at Bali’s Safari Marine Park. Tourists can witness animals such as tigers, elephants, lions, hippos, rhinos, and more. The Jungle Hopper safari allows you to admire endangered species such as the Komodo Dragon and Bali Starling.

itinerary.title: Kintamani - Ubud Village Tour
itinerary.description: The Kintamani Volcano is a part of the day three itinerary. You can head to the central market in Ubud, where you can grab traditional souvenirs for yourself and your loved ones.

itinerary.title: Lembongan Island Day Cruise
itinerary.description: The fourth day of your trip includes cruising around to breathe in the endless beauty of Lembongan Island. You can partake in activities such as snorkeling and water slides as you journey.

itinerary.title: White Water Rafting
itinerary.description: This day is about doing something thrilling while allowing you plenty of time to relax later in the day. Visit the largest river in Bali, the Ayung River, to engage in an afternoon of white water rafting, after which you can return to your hotel and enjoy a relaxing evening.

itinerary.title: Depart from Bali
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Bangkok and Transfer to Hua Hin
itinerary.description: Upon arriving at Bangkok Airport, meet our tour representatives who will escort you to your hotel in Hua Hin. Check in and take some time to relax. In the afternoon, visit Phetchaburi Palace using a Cable Car and take a leisurely stroll through the Night Market. Spend the night at your hotel in Hua Hin.

itinerary.title: Hua Hin City Tour
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delicious breakfast at the hotel. Our tour representatives will guide you on a tour of Hua Hin City. Begin by heading to the island and visiting the Queen’s Project, an animal sanctuary where various animals are rehabilitated for eventual release. Next, continue your journey to the Maruka Thai Yawan Palace, also known as the Palace of Love & Hope, built in 1924. Take a leisurely stroll around the beautiful Teakwood Palace to learn more about its history. Continue your exploration of Hua-Hin by visiting Khao Takiab, also known as Monkey Mountain, which serves as both a monastery and a sanctuary for Thai people. Be cautious of the wild monkeys as you enjoy the breathtaking ocean views. Return to Hua Hin for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Hua Hin - Bangkok City Tour
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delicious breakfast before heading to Bangkok, Thailand's capital, and largest city. Our tour representatives will guide you on a half-day city tour of Bangkok, where you will visit some of its most famous temple monasteries. Explore Wat Po (The Temple of the Reclining Buddha), Wat Traimit (The Temple of the Solid Gold Buddha, weighing 5 1⁄2 tons of gold), and Wat Benchamabophit (The Marble Temple). Continue to the world-renowned Gems and Jewelry Shop for some Jade stone shopping. The remainder of the day is yours to enjoy at your leisure. Later, return to the hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Bangkok Departure
itinerary.description: After a quick breakfast, you will head to Indhira Market for some shopping. In the evening, our tour guide will escort you to Bangkok International Airport for your departure.

packages.name: Bali Bliss
packages.destination: Bali - Kintamani - Ubud - Tanjung Benoa - Uluwatu

itinerary.title: Arrive at Bali - Tanjung Benoa Beach
itinerary.description: Once you arrive in Bali, our local representative will greet you at the airport and take you to your hotel. After enjoying a delicious breakfast, prepare for a day of beachy fun and water-based activities at Tanjung Benoa Beach. Witness the gorgeous blues of the serene waters as you sunbathe or enjoy a book under the sun. You can also choose to parasail, ride a banana boat, or jet ski. Pamper yourself in the afternoon with two hours of a rejuvenating spa treatment. Spend the night at your hotel.

itinerary.title: Celuk Village - Mas Village - Elephant Cave - Kintamani - Ubud Village Tour
itinerary.description: The second day is all about exploring the rich culture of Bali. We begin with the Balinese village of Celuk, known worldwide for its gold and silver jewelry, after which you will proceed to the quaint Mas Village, where you can find several carved wood sculptures. Next is the revered Hindu archaeological site, Elephant Cave or Goa Gajah. Pay your respects at Bali’s sacred water temple, Tirta Empul, and enjoy the blissful ambiance. Then move to the Volcano Village of Kintamani and end the day by going to the central market in Ubud, where you can grab traditional souvenirs and other handicrafts.

itinerary.title: Bali Swing - Batubulan Village
itinerary.description: How about engaging in a thrilling adventure? Sign up for the Bali Swing, a giant swing that offers a 360-degree view of the surrounding rainforest while flying from 33 feet or above. After this wild experience, head to the Batubulan Village to watch Barong and Kecak dance performances at this art and creativity center.

itinerary.title: Depart from Bali
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and leave for the airport to board the flight back home as you take along a million memories with yourself.

itinerary.title: Bounty Sunset Cruise
itinerary.description: Once you arrive in Bali, our local representative will greet you at the airport and take you to your hotel. After having breakfast, proceed to the Benoa Port to board the Bounty Sunset Cruise to enjoy the beautiful turquoise waters and relish some delicious food with your family or partner while watching the beautiful Balinese artists entertain you with dance and music. Get back to the hotel after a fulfilling dinner on the cruise.

itinerary.title: Celuk Village - Mas Village - Elephant Cave - Kintamani - Ubud Village Tour
itinerary.description: Visit the Mas Village to watch the local woodcarvers create world-famous wooden sculptures, followed by Celuk, a Balinese village reputed for its gold and silver jewelry. The famous Elephant Cave, or Goa Gajah, is the next stop, a revered Hindu archaeological site. Experience the holy surroundings of Bali’s sacred water temple, Tirta Empul, before proceeding to the Volcano Village of Kintamani. Pay a visit to the central market of Ubud to buy handwoven baskets, silk scarves, and other handcrafted goods before returning to the hotel.

itinerary.title: Tanjung Benoa Beach
itinerary.description: How can your trip to Bali be complete without witnessing the serene and stunning beaches? Head to Tanjung Benoa Beach, where you can stroll at a leisurely pace, immersing yourself in sunbathing and beachy activities. You may also indulge in water sports and choose from some of the activities included in our package: parasailing, banana boat, and jet skiing. Pamper yourself in the afternoon with two hours of a rejuvenating spa treatment. Spend the night at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Depart from Bali
itinerary.description: Check out from the hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.
