After this, move on to the Volcano Village of Kintamani and end the day by going to the central market in Ubud, where you can grab traditional souvenirs.

itinerary.title: Jakarta - National Monument - Cafe Batavia
itinerary.description: On the third day, you will catch a flight to Jakarta, where our tour representative will meet you at the airport and drop you at the hotel. After lunch, head out for sightseeing, starting with the National Monument, which is historically significant and tied to Indonesian independence. Finish your day at Cafe Batavia to taste some scrumptious Indonesian cuisine.

itinerary.title: Miniature Park
itinerary.description: This day is especially thrilling for little kids and everyone who enjoys adorable sights. The Miniature Park is a living museum showcasing Indonesian diversity and how cultures coexist harmoniously in this country.

itinerary.title: Depart from Jakarta
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

packages.name: Bali with Gili Trawangan
packages.destination: Bali - Uluwatu Kecak - Kintamani - Gili Trawangan

itinerary.title: Arrive at Bali – Tanjung Benoa Beach
itinerary.description: Once you arrive in Bali, our local representative will greet you at the airport and take you to your hotel. After having breakfast at the hotel, get ready for Tanjung Benoa Beach to embrace you. After all, a trip to Bali is incomplete without witnessing the serene and stunning blues of its beaches. Stroll around at a leisurely pace, immersing yourself in sunbathing and beachy activities. If your package includes water sports activities, choose from different options available, including parasailing, banana boat riding, and jet skiing. Pamper yourself in the afternoon with two hours of a rejuvenating spa treatment. Spend the night at your hotel.

itinerary.title: Celuk Village - Mas Village - Elephant Cave - Kintamani - Ubud Village Tour
itinerary.description: Initiate the second day of your trip by visiting the Balinese village of Celuk, known worldwide for its gold and silver jewelry. Afterward, you will proceed to the quaint Mas Village, where you can find several delicate carvings of wood sculptures. Next is the revered Hindu archaeological site called Elephant Cave or Goa Gajah. After this, move along and see the Volcano Village of Kintamani. End the day by going to the central market in Ubud, where you can grab traditional souvenirs and knickknacks.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Gili Trawangan
itinerary.description: On the third day, visit Gili Trawangan island on a speed boat. You will then have the rest of the day to relax and walk around the island. Enjoy a good night’s sleep at your hotel.

itinerary.title: Snorkelling – Island Hopping
itinerary.description: Immerse yourself in the endless beauty of the underwater world. Gili Trawangan offers some spectacular water-based activities, including snorkeling. You can also bike around the island and hop on to the numerous beaches.

itinerary.title: Depart from Bali
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Bangalore
itinerary.description: After arriving in Bangalore, our tour representative will welcome you and help you transfer to the hotel. After check-in, spend some time relaxing before heading out for a tour of Bengaluru City. You will visit Lal Bagh, Cubbon Park, Vidhana Soudha, and Tipu Sultan’s castle. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Bangalore.

itinerary.title: Bangalore to Coorg
itinerary.description: After a breakfast buffet, check out of the hotel and head to Coorg. The journey takes around 6 hours and looks mesmerising. Check in to the hotel and spend the rest of the evening relaxing and exploring the area. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Coorg.

itinerary.title: Coorg
itinerary.description: After breakfast in the morning, head out for a tour of Coorg. This beautiful hill station is famous for its coffee and tea plantations and lush greenery. You will visit the Nagarhole National Park, Madikeri Fortress, Iruppu Falls in Brahmagiri, Raja’s Seat Garden, Nunnery Falls, and the Omkareshwara Sanctuary. Return to the hotel to spend the night in Coorg.

itinerary.title: Coorg – Bangalore
itinerary.description: As your Coorg trip package ends, check out of your hotel to head to Bangalore.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Bangalore
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival in Bangalore, our tour manager will welcome you and help you transfer to the hotel. Check into your hotel and spend some time relaxing. Later, you will explore some of Bengaluru’s top attractions, including Lal Bagh, Cubbon Park, Visvesvaraiyya Museum, Vidhana Soudha, and the Bengaluru College. Later in the evening, you will head to MG Road to shop and catch a glimpse of this vibrant shopping street.

itinerary.title: Bangalore Day 2
itinerary.description: Later, you will visit the ISKCON temple and continue to Bannerghatta National Park to spot the elusive white tiger and other animals. Later, you will also head to Wonderla, Asia’s largest theme park. By evening, bid goodbye to Bangalore as you return home.

packages.name: Discover the Wonders of New Zealand: A 15-Day Itinerary
packages.destination: Auckland - Waitomo - Rotorua - Wellington - Picton - Kaikoura - Christchurch - Mount Cook - Queenstown - Milford Sound - Glacier Region - Greymouth

images.alt_text: Discover the Wonders of New Zealand: A 15-Day Itinerary
Discover the Wonders of New Zealand: A 15-Day Itinerary

itinerary.title: Auckland Arrival
itinerary.description: As you touch down in Auckland, famously known as 'The City of Sails,' our friendly local representative will warmly greet our guests taking the seat-in-coach option. They'll then be whisked away for a private transfer to their hotel. For those who prefer to go at their own pace, our self-drive guests can conveniently collect their rental car at the airport and drive to their chosen hotel. Rest easy with an overnight stay in Auckland.

itinerary.title: Exploring Auckland City
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a delightful Auckland city sightseeing tour (exclusive for guests traveling by coach). Immerse yourself in the enchanting world of Kelly Tarlton's Sealife Aquarium and the Antarctic Encounter (available to both coach and self-drive guests). The remainder of the day is yours to enjoy at your leisure. Spend a restful night at your Auckland hotel.

itinerary.title: Auckland - Waitomo - Rotorua
itinerary.description: Journey from Auckland to Rotorua via Waitomo Head south through the lush Waikato region until you reach Waitomo. There, relish a guided exploration of the mesmerising Waitomo Glowworm Caves. Afterward, continue your voyage across the scenic Mamaku Ranges, ultimately arriving in the enchanting 'Thermal City' of Rotorua. Enjoy your overnight stay in Rotorua.

itinerary.title: Rotorua
itinerary.description: After having a delicious breakfast, we are going to explore the fascinating Te Puia Thermal Reserve, where you can witness bubbling mud pools and thundering geysers. Afterward, we head to the Agrodome for an entertaining farm show and Rainbow Springs, where you can marvel at trout, birds, and wildlife. The afternoon is yours to enjoy at your own pace. In the evening, savour an authentic Maori Hangi feast and experience a captivating concert. Enjoy the dinner and rest for the night at your Rotorua hotel.

itinerary.title: Rotorua to Wellington
itinerary.description: Head south to the charming lakeside retreat of Taupo, tracing the scenic edges of Lake Taupo to Turangi. Continue your journey on the Desert Road, framed by the majestic trio of Ruapehu, Ngauruhoe, and Tongariro. As you venture through the fertile countryside, you'll eventually arrive in the splendid 'Capital City' of Wellington. Enjoy your overnight stay at the Wellington hotel.

itinerary.title: Wellington
itinerary.description: This morning, relish a splendid Wellington city sightseeing tour, followed by a brief guided excursion at Te Papa, also known as the 'Museum of New Zealand.' Afterward, the afternoon is yours to explore the charming capital city of New Zealand at your leisure. If you wish to indulge in extra activities (for an additional fee), you might consider the Zealandia by Night Tour. This exceptional experience offers the exclusive opportunity to encounter the KIWI bird in its natural habitat. Embrace the mystical ambiance of the sanctuary valley as you immerse yourself in the nocturnal sights, sounds, and scents of Zealandia. A night tour of Zealandia is an unforgettable and distinctive adventure that you won't soon forget. Your day concludes with an overnight stay at your Wellington hotel.

itinerary.title: Wellington to Kaikoura via Picton
itinerary.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast. Embark on a scenic journey across the Cook Strait, the magnificent waterway that separates New Zealand's North and South Islands. As you sail into the Marlborough Sounds, you'll be mesmerised by the pristine waters and lush forests that surround you. Your journey continues as you travel southward, passing through the charming town of Blenheim before arriving in the picturesque coastal town of Kaikoura. Tonight, rest and rejuvenate at your Kaikoura hotel.

itinerary.title: Kaikoura to Christchurch
itinerary.description: Begin the day with a yummy breakfast. We continue our journey towards Christchurch, passing through the picturesque North Canterbury region. Our destination is the charming 'Garden City' of Christchurch, where we will spend the night.

itinerary.title: Christchurch - Mount Cook - Queenstown
itinerary.description: Enjoy a hearty breakfast to kick-start your day. As the morning sun graces the horizon, embark on a picturesque journey across the lush Canterbury Plains. Your first stop is at Lake Tekapo, where you can marvel at the iconic 'Church of the Good Shepherd.' From there, your adventure takes you to the towering peak of New Zealand, Mount Cook. After soaking in the awe-inspiring scenery, bid farewell to this majestic mountain and follow the tranquil shores of Lake Pukaki to the historical Central Otago region. Your day's journey ends in Queenstown, the charming 'Alpine Resort.' Rest for the night in the comfort of your hotel.

itinerary.title: Queenstown - Milford Sound - Queenstown
itinerary.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast. Today, you will travel along the southern edge of Lake Wakatipu, passing through Lumsden and continuing to the serene Lake Te Anau. Next, venture into the breathtaking Eglinton Valley and travel through the enchanting Homer Tunnel, which leads you to the mesmerising Milford Sound. Take pleasure in a cruise on this internationally renowned fjord, where the imposing Mitre Peak and the picturesque Bowen Falls will captivate your senses. After this extraordinary experience, return to Queenstown for a comfortable overnight stay at your hotel.

itinerary.title: Queenstown
itinerary.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast. Today, you have the freedom to delve into a plethora of enticing optional activities. Queenstown extends a warm invitation to indulge in the delights of bungee jumping, exhilarating jet boating, leisurely gondola rides, and so much more. Please note that these optional activities are not covered within the tour package cost. Enjoy your day!

itinerary.title: Queenstown to the Glacier Region
itinerary.description: Leave Queenstown and journey through Lake Wanaka, passing through the historic Haast Pass, the entrance to the revered World Heritage Westland National Park. Continue your drive up the stunning West Coast, where you'll be treated to breathtaking mountain vistas, lush native forests, and serene lakes on your way to the glacier region. Spend the night at a cozy hotel in the Glacier Region.

itinerary.title: Glacier Region
itinerary.description: Today, you have the freedom to wander through the stunning glacier region at your own pace. You can choose from optional activities like a picturesque flight or a guided stroll on one of the glaciers. These extras are not part of the tour package. You'll spend the night at the Glacier Region hotel.

itinerary.title: Glacier Region - Greymouth - Christchurch
itinerary.description: Glacier Region to Christchurch Today, we head north towards Greymouth and embark on the renowned Tranz Alpine train, exclusively available for our seated coach passengers. As the train ascends through the verdant beech forests, you'll journey past the picturesque alpine village of Arthur's Pass and traverse the awe-inspiring Southern Alps. The final leg of our voyage leads us across the serene Canterbury Plains before we reach our overnight destination in Christchurch. Your accommodation for the night will be at a comfortable hotel in the heart of Christchurch.

itinerary.title: Christchurch - Return Home
itinerary.description: This morning, make your way to the airport to catch your flight to your next destination or your hometown, carrying with you cherished memories that will last a lifetime. The tour has come to an end, but the memories will stay with you forever. Safe travel!

itinerary.title: Arrive in Bangalore
itinerary.description: Upon arriving in Bengaluru, our tour manager will welcome you and help you transfer to the hotel. Complete check-in formalities and spend some time relaxing. Later, you will cover Bangalore’s major attractions, including Lal Bagh Botanical Garden or Red Garden, an old garden established by Hyder Ali over 200 years ago, Vidhana Soudha, Cubbon Park, Visvesvaraiya Museum, ISKON Temple, and Bengaluru Palace. Later in the evening, spend some time shopping at MG Road. Spend the night in Bangalore.

itinerary.title: Bangalore - Mysore
itinerary.description: After a hearty South Indian breakfast, head to Wonderla, Asia’s largest water theme park. Later, you will head to Mysore to continue with Day 3 of your tour.

itinerary.title: Mysore Day Tour
itinerary.description: On the last day of your tour, you will explore Mysore.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Bangalore
itinerary.description: Upon arriving in Bangalore, check into your hotel and spend some time relaxing. Later, you will visit some of Bangalore’s iconic attractions, including the Lal Bagh Gardens, the Visweswarayya Industrial and Technology Museum, the Iskcon Temple, and Cubbon Park. Spend the night in Bangalore.

itinerary.title: Bangalore - Wonderla
itinerary.description: You will head to Wonderla, Bangalore, after breakfast. It is India’s largest water theme park, with over 61 rides. Later in the evening, you will head to Coorg by road. Check into the hotel and spend the night in Coorg.

itinerary.title: Coorg Full Day Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head out to explore Coorg. Some places you will cover include the Raja’s Seat Garden, Abbey Waterfall, Iruppu Waterfalls, Namdroling Monastery, and the Nagarahole Tiger Reserve. Don’t miss the Dubare Elephant Camp at Rangasamudra. The camp is famous for rafting, elephant rides, and boating. End the night with a campfire dinner in Coorg.

itinerary.title: Mysore
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of your hotel and head to Mysore. Sandal City is famous for its iconic attractions, such as the Chamundi Hills, Mysore Palace, Mysore Zoo, and Brindavan Gardens. In the evening, enjoy the sound and light show at Brindavan Gardens. Bid goodbye to Karnataka as you head to catch your train or flight to return home.

itinerary.title: Chennai to Delhi
itinerary.description: Board your train to Delhi from the Chennai Egmore Railway Station. Our tour manager will accompany you on your tour to ensure it progresses seamlessly.

itinerary.title: Delhi to Nainital
itinerary.description: Today, you will continue with your journey to Delhi. Spend the day relaxing and spending time with friends.

itinerary.title: Arriving In Delhi – Nainital
itinerary.description: When you arrive at the Delhi railway station, our tour manager will help you catch your train to Nainital. The journey takes around 8 hours and is full of picturesque views of the Himalayan mountains. On reaching Nainital, check-in and stay at a comfortable hotel.

itinerary.title: Full-Day Tour Nainital
itinerary.description: Nainital gets its name from the Naina Devi Temple, located on the north end of the Nainital Lake. After a sumptuous breakfast, explore the dense pine and deciduous forests. Some places you will cover today include Nainital Lake, Naina Devi Temple, Tiffin Top, and the G B Pant High Altitude Zoo. You will also cover the Naina Peak and enjoy a bird’s eye view of Nainital on the aerial ropeway. Spend the night at a comfortable hotel in Nainital.

itinerary.title: Nainital – Corbett
itinerary.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast and checkout at the hotel to leave for the Jim Corbett National Park. The national park is famous for its tiger population and jeep safari. Join your friends for a 2-hour safari ride before continuing to check other attractions. Other attractions include the Garjiya Devi Temple on the outskirts of the Corbett National Park. Don’t miss the Corbett Waterfalls as well. Check-in at the hotel for a night’s stay at the Jim Corbett National Park.

itinerary.title: Corbett – Mussoorie – Delhi
itinerary.description: Check out of the hotel in Corbett and leave for Mussoorie. This 4.5-hour drive is picturesque and offers a fantastic view of the Himalayan mountains. Enjoy sightseeing and a sumptuous lunch in Mussoorie. Some places you will cover include Mussoorie Lake, Jwalaji Temple, Lal Tibba, and the Nag Devta Temple. You are free to enjoy the rest of the evening at leisure. You can go shopping at Mall Road or one of the stalls at the Tibetan Market. Spend the night at a comfortable market in Mussoorie.

itinerary.title: Mussoorie – Delhi
itinerary.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast in Mussoorie before checking out of the hotel and catching your return train to Delhi. On reaching the capital city, you will check in to your hotel and spend the rest of the night shopping at Karol Bagh. Spend the night at a comfortable hotel in Delhi.

itinerary.title: Delhi Full Day Tour
itinerary.description: After a sumptuous breakfast, get ready for a full-day tour of India’s capital city. Some of the iconic attractions you will visit include Birla Temple, Qutub Minar, India Gate, President’s House, Lotus Temple, Parliament House, Red Fort, and Jantar Mantar. Spend the evening shopping at Sarojini Market before returning to your hotel.

itinerary.title: Delhi – Chennai
itinerary.description: Check out of the hotel to catch your train back to Chennai.

itinerary.title: Chennai
itinerary.description: You will reach Chennai the following day with sweet memories of Delhi, Mussoorie, and Nainital.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Antananarivo
itinerary.description: Arrive at Ivato International Airport in Antananarivo, the capital of Madagascar. Meet your guide and transfer to your hotel. Take the rest of the day to relax and acclimatize to the surroundings.

itinerary.title: Antananarivo – Manambato – Ankanin’ny Nofy
itinerary.description: After breakfast, depart from Antananarivo and head east to Manambato on a private vehicle. Along the way, enjoy the scenic drive through the countryside, passing rice fields, pine woods, eucalyptus forests, lush landscapes, and the typical population along the villages of Merina and Bezanozano. Lunch at a restaurant and later continue to Manambato Village along the Pangalanes Canal, an artificial channel that forms an inland waterway. From here, take a boat ride on the Pangalanes Canal to reach La Palmarium, the exclusive resort in Ankanin'ny Nofy. Check into your hotel room and stay overnight at the luxury hotel.

itinerary.title: Ankanin'ny Nofy
itinerary.description: Ankanin'ny Nofy means Nest of Dreams. True to its name, this is a beautiful private reserve enriched with unique flora and fauna. After breakfast, get ready for a morning walk around the beautiful private park to admire the palm trees, orchids, and even carnivorous plants growing in the gardens. Don't miss the lemurs that roam around freely in La Palmarium. Enjoy a scrumptious lunch at the hotel, followed by a visit to Andranokoditra to discover the Betsimisaraka village and the traditional essential oil factory. Head back by boat to your hotel. Later in the evening, visit the nearby forests of Madagascar to observe the endemic nocturnal aye-aye lemur, an endangered species typical with its furry hair and long nails. Stay overnight at the La Palmarium Hotel.

itinerary.title: Ankanin'ny Nofy – Manambato - Andasibe
itinerary.description: After breakfast, depart from Ankanin'ny Nofy and head back to Manambato by boat. Continue the journey to Andasibe, known for its lush rainforests and abundant wildlife. Arrive in Andasibe and check into your hotel. Enjoy a scrumptious lunch at a restaurant before traveling to the Vakona Private Park to observe the local animals, including lemurs, Ibis, wild ducks, fossa, and crocodiles. In the evening, embark on a night walk to spot nocturnal lemurs and other fascinating creatures. Stay overnight at a luxury hotel in Andasibe.

itinerary.title: Andasibe National Park – Antananarivo
itinerary.description: After an early breakfast, venture into Andasibe National Park, home to the indri, the largest lemur species. Enjoy a guided trek through the park, exploring its rich biodiversity, including various lemur species, chameleons, and endemic flora. Post lunch, visit Lemur Island, where you can observe lemurs in their natural habitat. Drive to Antananarivo, stopping at the Marozevo Exotic Park to learn how the farm breeds local animals like chameleons, geckos, reptiles, crocodiles, and beautifully colored butterflies. Stay overnight at a luxury hotel in Antananarivo.

itinerary.title: Antananarivo
itinerary.description: On the final leg of your journey, visit the Pereyras Reptile Reserve to see a variety of reptiles, including chameleons and snakes. Transfer to the airport for your departure.

packages.name: Picturesque Mauritius Tour Package
packages.destination: Mauritius - North Island - Ile Aux Cerfs - South Island

itinerary.title: Arrive Mauritius
itinerary.description: Welcome to the Beautiful Island Country of Mauritius. Our tour representatives will meet and welcome you at the airport. Later, you will be moved to the hotel. Register with the inn at Mauritius. Whatever is left of the day is free for you to unwind and spoil yourself by the ocean and benefit as much as possible from the sunny climate. Later at night, you can go (on own) to the Grand Baie or the Waterfront region which is dabbed by Haute Cafes and Abundant diversion. Return back to the hotel for overnight stay.

itinerary.title: North Island Tour
itinerary.description: Take your morning breakfast at the hotel. After breakfast, revel in a Panoramic City Tour of Port Louis the Capital of Mauritius, beside the Caudan Waterfront, Marie Reine De La Paix and La Citadel. Hang out for shopping at Pamplemousses Garden or Jumbo Hypermarket which you may decide to visit, Apravasi Ghat, China Town, Local Market & Musuem. Later at night, return once more to the lodging. Enjoy your overnight stay at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Day at Leisure
itinerary.description: After morning breakfast, you can enjoy the day at your leisure. You could use the day strolling – Walking on the Sea Bed !!!! Attempt the Undersea Walk. This is really a lifetime experience!! On the off chance that you might want to respect the Marine Life without getting into the water you could attempt the Le Nesse which is a semi submersible and you could sit and see the Marine Life from the security of the glass around you. Later at night, move back to the hotel for overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Ile Aux Cerfs Tour
itinerary.description: Have your morning breakfast at the hotel. After breakfast, you will be taken for a Full Day Tour to the Ile Aux Cerfs by Speed cruiser. The Ile Aux Cerfs is an Island at the East Coast of Mauritius, where you can appreciate time all alone, delight in the Sun at one of the numerous shorelines and enjoy various Water games, Parasailing and so on (all alone). Late at night, return once more to the lodging. Enjoy your overnight stay at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Day at Leisure
itinerary.description: After morning breakfast at the hotel, one more day in this Paradise Country and what would you be able to do today? Parts!! You could get into a Cruise around the Island or simply sit and unwind by the Sea or the Pool and spoil yourself with the conveniences your lodging brings to the table you. Later at night, return once again to the hotel for night stay.

itinerary.title: South Island Tour
itinerary.description: After your morning breakfast, set out on a Tour of Chamarel Village which houses two Natural Wonders. Visit the Cascading Chamarel Falls and the Seven-Colored Earths of Chamarel. Later continue to Floreal Shop Factories, Dead Volcano of Trou Aux Cerfs, Mare Aux Vacoas new water store, The Sacred Lake of Grand Basin and Black River Gorges. In the night, return back to the hotel for night stay.

itinerary.title: Depart Mauritius
itinerary.description: After morning breakfast, sign out from the inn. Later, you will be escorted to the Airport to catch your flight to fly back home. Return with brilliant memories of your shoreline Vacation!!

packages.name: Rigi Extravaganza
packages.destination: Switzerland - Basel - lucerne - Mt. Rigi - Zurich

itinerary.title: Arrive in Zurich – Basel - Kunstmuseum Basel - Theater Basel - Freie Strasse
itinerary.description: After you land in Zurich, get on a train to Basel. Once you check in to your hotel and freshen up, you can venture out for the first round of sightseeing. Go to the Kunstmuseum Basel, home to the world's oldest public art collection. Experience the magic of theatre at Theater Basel. For the day's last stop, head over to Freie Strasse, the main shopping street in Basel. Don’t forget to dine at one of the many Gault Millau evaluated restaurants.

itinerary.title: Basel – Lucerne - Lake Lucerne Cruise
itinerary.description: Once you leave your hotel in Basel, get on a train to Lucerne. After checking in to your hotel in Lucerne, you will board the Lake Lucerne cruise. While on the cruise, you can listen to the audio commentary detailing various places of interest, historical monuments, and the four surrounding cantons. Spend the night at your hotel in Lucerne. You can also use the Swiss Pass for an hour’s ride to explore Bern.

itinerary.title: Lucerne - Mt. Rigi
itinerary.description: On the third day of your trip, take a ferry to Vitznau and reach Mt. Rigi on Europe’s first-ever mountain railway. You can choose to get back either by train or by boat. Spend the night at your hotel in Lucerne.

itinerary.title: Lucerne – Zurich – Rhine Falls
itinerary.description: Check out of your hotel in Lucerne and reach the station to get on a train to the city of Zurich. After the check-in formalities, you can head out to witness Europe’s biggest waterfall, Rhine Falls. You can then spend the rest of the day walking around, visiting Zurich's shops, museums, and flea markets.

itinerary.title: Depart from Zurich
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Reach Kuching - Kuching Waterfront - Sarawak Cultural Village
itinerary.description: Once you land in Kuching, our tour representatives will greet you at the airport and take you to your hotel. After you’ve checked in and freshened up, prepare for the first day of vacation. You will first be taken to the Kuching Waterfront, a riverside walkway filled with street food stalls, colonial edifices, and several restaurants. After this, head to the Sarawak Cultural Village for a glimpse into the lifestyle and culture of the many indigenous groups living in Malaysia.

itinerary.title: Gunung Gading National Park - Cat Museum
itinerary.description: The Gunung Gading National Park is one of the main attractions in Malaysia and one of the few places in the world where you can observe the rafflesia bloom in its natural habitat. If you’re a cat lover, you’re in for an absolute treat at the Kuching Cat Museum. We’ll take you through the cultural and historical importance of these adorable animals through more than 2,000 cat-related exhibits.

itinerary.title: Bidayuh Annah Rais Longhouse - Tua Pek Kong Temple – Main Bazaar
itinerary.description: The Bidayuh Annah Rais Longhouse, also known as the Annah Rais Longhouse Homestay, is a traditional Bidayuh longhouse home to about 500 people. Take a tour of this longhouse at the Borneo Highlands base. Pay your respects at the Tua Pek Kong Temple, atop a foothill and opposite the Chinese History Museum. End the day by hopping on to Kuching’s Main Bazaar, where you can shop for handicrafts, souvenirs, and antiques.

itinerary.title: Depart from Kuching
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Zurich - Lucerne
itinerary.description: After you land in Zurich, you will take a train to Lucerne. Once you reach Lucerne, check in to your hotel. You can then spend the rest of the day at your own pace and explore this beautiful city.

itinerary.title: Lucerne - Mt. Titlis
itinerary.description: Situated on the Uri Alps, Mt. Titlis is a must-visit spot in Switzerland, and that’s exactly where you will be heading on the second day of your trip. Take a train to Engelberg, and ride the cable car to Mt. Titlis. The Titlis Rotair is the world’s first revolving cable car, offering a 360-degree view of the surrounding lakes, valleys, glaciers, and mountains of the Black Forest region. Spend the night at your hotel in Lucerne.

itinerary.title: Lucerne – Interlaken
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and get on a train to Interlaken. Interlaken is a beautiful city nestled between the Brienz and Thun lakes offering a gorgeous view of the Jungfrau. The famous Golden Pass train offers a breathtaking view of the Swiss Alps. Once you check in to your hotel, you can spend the remaining day at leisure.

itinerary.title: Interlaken – Jungfraujoch
itinerary.description: Board a train from Interlaken Ost to Grindelwald on your fourth day, after which you will get on a cogwheel train to the top of Jungfraujoch, a viewing point in the Bernese Alps. At 3,454 metres above sea level, Jungfrau is the world’s highest railway station. Take the breathtaking view of the Aletsch Glacier, the biggest glacier in the Alps, and visit the Ice Palace. Spend the night at your hotel in Interlaken.

itinerary.title: Zurich – Rhine Falls
itinerary.description: On the fifth day, board a train from Interlaken to Zurich. After reaching Zurich and completing the check-in formalities at the hotel, head out to witness the Rhine Falls, the biggest waterfall in Europe. After this thrilling experience, walk around Zurich's cobbled streets, shop in flea markets, or visit its many museums.

itinerary.title: Depart from Zurich
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Geneva – Montreux
itinerary.description: After you land in Geneva, board a train to Montreux, and complete the check-in formalities at your hotel. You will also receive a Swiss Pass to explore Montreux on your own. This beautiful city is well known for its Belle Epoque buildings, the Chillon Castle, and other attractions.

itinerary.title: Gruyeres - La Maison du Gruyere - Gruyeres Castle - Maison Cailler
itinerary.description: Venture out on the second day to explore the quaint town of Gruyeres. Here, you will explore La Maison du Gruyere, a prominent cheese factory that offers tours and audio guides, and the Gruyeres Castle, a 13th-century castle offering an amazing view of the surrounding countryside. Switzerland is famous for its chocolates, watches, and railroads. With our package, we cover all of these and more. Get back on the train to go to Broc, where you will visit Maison Cailler. This famous chocolate factory offers its tourists an interactive experience and insight into chocolate making.

itinerary.title: Montreux - Geneva - St. Pierre Cathedral - Mini Train Tour
itinerary.description: Check out of your hotel in Montreux and board a train to the city of Geneva. After completing check-in at your hotel in Geneva, head out for some sightseeing. Visit the St. Pierre Cathedral, a former Roman Catholic cathedral which got converted into a Reformed Protestant Church of Geneva during the Reformation. Enjoy the mini-train tour that takes the visitors to Geneva's Old Town.

itinerary.title: Lake Geneva - Museum of Art and History
itinerary.description: On the fourth day of your trip, proceed to view the largest water body in Switzerland, Lake Geneva. As one of the largest lakes in Western Europe, 60% of the lake belongs to Switzerland, while 40% is to France. Proceed to the Museum of Art and History, home to over a million exposition pieces, and present tourists with an insight into the history of Western culture.

itinerary.title: Depart from Geneva
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

packages.name: South African Adventure: Cape Town to Knysna with GT Holidays
packages.destination: Cape Town - Oudtshoorn - Knysna - John Benn Cruise

images.alt_text: South African Adventure: Cape Town to Knysna with GT Holidays
South African Adventure: Cape Town to Knysna with GT Holidays

itinerary.title: Arrival in Cape Town - Oudtshoorn
itinerary.description: Your journey commences as you arrive in Cape Town and embark on a scenic drive through the Winelands, passing Paarl and Worcester along the way. As you meander through the picturesque Breede River Valley, characterised by its lush vineyards and bountiful fruit orchards, you'll soon find yourself in the enchanting region known as 'The Little Karoo.' Your route leads you to the coastal town of Mossel Bay, nestled along the Garden Route in South Africa's Western Cape Province. Mossel Bay is renowned for its expansive Santos Beach and the iconic 19th-century Cape St. Blaize Lighthouse, offering breathtaking bay views. While here, make sure to explore the Bartolomeu Dias Museum Complex, which houses the Maritime Museum, the Shell Museum, and delightful botanical gardens. Don't miss the Post Office Tree, a majestic milkwood tree within the complex that has served as a mail collection point since the 1500s. Your first day's journey concludes with an overnight stay at a hotel in Oudtshoorn.

itinerary.title: Oudtshoorn to Knysna
itinerary.description: Today, we explore the captivating Cango Caves, renowned for their stunning stalactite and stalagmite formations. Afterwards, we head to the Cango Wildlife Ranch, offering an optional opportunity to get up close with the world's fastest animal, the cheetah (additional cost applies). In the afternoon, we delve into the fascinating world of ostrich farming, discovering how these magnificent birds are raised. You may even have the chance to take a ride on one of these remarkable creatures. Our journey then takes us over the picturesque Outeniqua Mountains to George, known as 'the Gateway to the Garden Route,' and the scenic lakes of Wilderness, en route to the beautiful destination of Knysna. You'll spend the night at Knysna hotel.

itinerary.title: Knysna - John Benn Cruise
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a delightful morning cruise aboard the John Benn, sailing on the scenic Knysna Lagoon. The remainder of the day is yours to enjoy at your leisure. You'll spend the night at your Knysna hotel.

itinerary.title: Leaving Knysna
itinerary.description: Start the day with a healthy breakfast. Today, we'll pick you up from your hotel and take you to George Airport for your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Kuala Lumpur
itinerary.description: Welcome to Kuala Lumpur, the capital of Malaysia and the largest city in the country. Upon your arrival at the Kuala Lumpur International Airport, our tour representative will greet you and take you to your hotel. Get done with the check-in formalities and spend the rest of the day relaxing.

itinerary.title: Kuala Lumpur City Tour
itinerary.description: Today will be all about exploring the city of Kuala Lumpur. Commence your day with the Perdana Botanical Garden, the first large-scale recreational park to exist in Kuala Lumpur. Witness the iconic Petronas Towers, which are the tallest twin skyscrapers in the world. Some of the other popular tourist spots you will be exploring on this day include Jamek Mosque, Central Market, the National Library of Malaysia, Merdeka Square, National Planetarium, National Mosque of Malaysia, Chinatown, and Parliament House. Witness the beauty of the Thean Hou Temple, which is a six-tiered temple dedicated to the Chinese sea goddess Mazu.

itinerary.title: Kuala Lumpur - Genting Highlands
itinerary.description: After having your breakfast, drive to Genting Highlands, located about 35 km away from Kuala Lumpur. Check-in to your hotel, after which you will receive passes to go to the Genting SkyWorlds Theme Park. Located at Resorts World Genting, this theme park is packed with rides and various other attractions. Visit Casino De Genting, the largest casino in Genting Highlands. Get back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Depart Kuala Lumpur
itinerary.description: Drive to Kuala Lumpur in the morning following your breakfast. Head to the airport to board your flight back home.

packages.name: Go Crazy in China Holiday Package
packages.destination: India/Beijing - By Int’l Flight - Beijing/Shanghai-By Morning Domestic Flight

images.alt_text: Go Crazy in China Holiday Package
Go Crazy in China Holiday Package
Go Crazy in China Holiday Package
Go Crazy in China Holiday Package
Go Crazy in China Holiday Package
Go Crazy in China Holiday Package
Go Crazy in China Holiday Package

itinerary.title: Arrive in Beijing
itinerary.description: After arriving at the Beijing Capital International Airport, you will be greeted by our tour representative and taken to your hotel. Once the check-in formalities have been completed, you can either relax at your hotel or head out for a bit to enjoy an acrobatic show at the Chaoyang Theatre.

itinerary.title: Forbidden City - Tiananmen Square - Houhai
itinerary.description: Eat a delicious breakfast and leave for a full day of sightseeing in Beijing. Start off with the Summer Palace, which consists of a hefty combination of palaces, gardens, and lakes. This is where you can witness the Marble Boat and the Long Corridor. Head to Tiananmen Square, where a series of protests had taken place in 1989 against inflation and corruption. Next up is the Forbidden City, which is reputed to be among the world’s most well-preserved wooden structures. Witness the beauty of Houhai Lake and explore the nearby courtyards, lanes, and bars.

itinerary.title: Great Wall of China - Juyong Pass - Bird's Nest
itinerary.description: Start off the day by visiting the famed UNESCO World Heritage Site known as the Great Wall of China. This is where you will also come across Juyong Pass, from where you can go to the Longdi Jade Factory and get some precious souvenirs for yourself. Finish the day by laying your eyes on the Beijing National Stadium, which also goes by the name of Bird's Nest. It served as the venue for the 2008 Summer Olympics and Paralympics as well as the 2022 Winter Olympics and Paralympics.

itinerary.title: Beijing - Shanghai
itinerary.description: Leave Beijing in the morning to board a flight to Shanghai. Once our tour representatives help you get to your hotel and finish the check-in formalities, you can then head out to explore the city of Shanghai. Let your first stop be the Jade Buddha Temple, which was founded in 1882 and houses two jade Buddha statues. Indulge in some shopping at People's Square. You can also choose to go to Madame Tussauds Shanghai before heading back to your hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: Shanghai Museum - Yuyuan Garden - Yuyuan Market
itinerary.description: The first spot you will be visiting today is the Shanghai Museum which contains displays of paintings, ceramics, sculptures, and calligraphy. Let the lush greenery and floral beauty of the Yuyuan Garden engulf you before you move to the Yuyuan Market to shop for handicrafts and antiques. Visit the Oriental Pearl Tower, and there is also the option of going to the Shanghai Ocean Aquarium. Have dinner at an Indian restaurant and get a good night’s sleep at your hotel.

itinerary.title: Xitang – Xintiandi
itinerary.description: Today, you will be taken to Xitang, which is a water town whose history dates back to 1000 years. Filled with rowing boats, old buildings, cobbled streets, and bridges, the quaintness of the town is something to relish. Later in the day, you can head to Xintiandi, a rich car-free shopping, entertainment, and eating district located in Shanghai. Peruse through its restaurants, cafes, and malls before going back to your hotel.

itinerary.title: Depart Shanghai
itinerary.description: Consume a heart breakfast at your hotel and check out to head to the airport and board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in London
itinerary.description: Welcome to London! After arriving at the airport, our tour manager will greet you and take you to your hotel. Once you complete the check-in formalities, you will be given an overview of your itinerary. You have the rest of the day to laze around the hotel or explore London on your own.

itinerary.title: London City Tour
itinerary.description: Once you get done with breakfast, you will be going on a tour of the city. The first stop is the Tower of London, which is a castle situated on the north bank of the River Thames. Founded in 1066, the castle is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and a complex made up of numerous buildings. The tower has been a significant part of British history and controlling it has been synonymous with having a control over the country. The next stop you will be taken to is the London Eye. It is among the most popular tourist attractions in London while also being the tallest cantilevered observation wheel in Europe. Standing at a height of 443 feet, it was opened to the public in 2000. Head over to an Indian restaurant for lunch, and then you will have the rest of the day to spend as you want to. Stay overnight at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Madame Tussauds
itinerary.description: After having a delicious breakfast at your hotel, you can explore London as per your time. Later in the day, you will be heading to Madame Tussauds, the well-renowned wax museum which was founded in 1835. Some of the prominent personalities whose statues can be found at the museum are Anne Hathaway, A. P. J. Abdul Kalam, Raj Kapoor, Cristiano Ronaldo, and Deepika Padukone. You can spend the evening at the hotel.

itinerary.title: London to Paris
itinerary.description: After finishing your breakfast, you will be heading to the St. Pancras railway station to board the Eurotunnel and travel to Paris. Once you get done with the check-in formalities, you will be taken to an Indian restaurant for a scrumptious lunch. The first place to visit in Paris is the Eiffel Tower, which is the most visited monument in the world. Travel up to the 3rd floor of the Eiffel Tower, which is the highest floor accessible to visitors and offers a spellbinding view of the entire city. You can go sightseeing in the evening and spend the night at your hotel.

itinerary.title: Paris City Tour
itinerary.description: Enjoy a flavoursome breakfast at the hotel and spend the morning and afternoon at your own pace. In the evening, you will be taken to an acclaimed inhabited area near the Bois de Boulogne, which is the second-largest public park in Paris. After this, experience an hour-long boat ride across the Seine River. Go back to your hotel to spend the night.

itinerary.title: Disneyland
itinerary.description: Make sure to have a filling breakfast because today, you will be heading to the happiest place on earth – Disneyland! Get ready to travel back in time to your childhood days as you meet Disney characters, watch dazzling shows, and come across replicas of places and monuments from your beloved Disney movies. Disneyland, with its thrilling rides and numerous attractions, is the most-visited tourist destination in Europe. Spend the night at your hotel.

itinerary.title: Depart Paris
itinerary.description: Spend the last day of your trip shopping around in Paris. Later, head to the airport to board your flight back to India, taking along innumerable memories of your holiday.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Toronto
itinerary.description: Upon arriving at the Toronto Pearson International Airport, you will be greeted by our tour representative, who will help you get to your hotel. Once the check-in formalities have been dealt with, you can spend the rest of the day relaxing or exploring the city on your own.

itinerary.title: Toronto City Tour
itinerary.description: Begin your day by experiencing Niagara Falls, one of the natural wonders of the world. Get on a boat ride to enjoy the falls in all their glory. Cover some of the most popular sightseeing spots in the city, such as CN Tower, City Hall, the University of Toronto, and Rogers Centre.

itinerary.title: Toronto - Kingston - Ottawa
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel in Toronto and leave for Ottawa while making a stop at Kingston. Take a cruise along the St. Lawrence River and enjoy the view of the Thousand Islands National Park. Later in the day, check in to your hotel in Ottawa.

itinerary.title: Ottawa City Tour
itinerary.description: Get ready for a full day of exploring the capital of Canada. You will be taken to the Royal Canadian Mint, Embassy Row, Parliament Hill, Rideau Falls, and Royal Canadian Mounted Police Musical Ride Centre. Explore the Canadian Museum of History to get a deeper insight into the culture and history of Canada. End the day by strolling around ByWard Market to enjoy some delicious food and a shopping session.

itinerary.title: Ottawa - Quebec City
itinerary.description: Leave Ottawa in the morning and drive along the King’s Highway. Make a stop at the Notre-Dame Basilica of Montreal and Cap-de-la-Madeleine before reaching Quebec City. Check in to your hotel and enjoy a relaxing night in.

itinerary.title: Quebec City Tour
itinerary.description: Early in the day, leave for the Erabliere Chemin du Roy Sugar Shack where you will enjoy a Quebec breakfast and learn about the art of maple extraction. Later on, explore Québec, which is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. View the landmark known as Place Royale and head out to shop and relish some delicious food before returning to your hotel at night.

itinerary.title: Quebec City - Montreal
itinerary.description: On this day, you will be leaving Quebec City and moving towards Montreal. The various sites you will explore in Montreal include Old Montreal, Saint-Sulpice Seminary, and Mount Royal.

itinerary.title: Depart Montreal
itinerary.description: After having your breakfast at the hotel, check out to head to the airport and board your flight back to India.

itinerary.title: Munnar
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at Kochi, our tour manager will help you transfer to Munnar. The journey takes around 5 hours and is famous for its lush scenery. After checking in, spend some time relaxing at the hotel. Later, head out to continue your Munnar sightseeing. You will visit Devikulam, Mattupetty Dam, and Anaimudi Peak. After exploring these places, you will return to your hotel and spend the rest of the evening at leisure.

itinerary.title: Munnar
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head to Rajamalai Hills to visit the Eravikulam National Park, the first national park in Kerala and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Later, head to Nyayamakad, famous for its waterfalls, Echo Point, Kundala, and the Malankara Reservoir. Spend the night in Munnar.

itinerary.title: Thekkady
itinerary.description: After breakfast in the morning, head to Thekkady to visit the Periyar National Park. This famous elephant and tiger reserve also features endemic animals like the nilgai and langur. Check in to your hotel before moving to the national park. Don’t miss Periyar Lake, where you can go on a boat ride to observe water birds from close quarters. Spend the night at a Thekkady lodging.

itinerary.title: Thekkady
itinerary.description: After a sumptuous breakfast, head to the Mangala Devi Temple to seek blessings from Kannagi Devi. The temple is believed to have been built in the 1st century by Cheran Chenguttavan. You will also visit Kumily and Vandiperiyar. Return to your lodging to spend the night in Thekkady.

itinerary.title: Kochi
itinerary.description: After a breakfast bouquet, travel to Kochi to catch your train/flight as your Kerala holiday package comes to a memorable end.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Cochin - Munnar
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival in Cochin, our tour representatives will greet you and take you to Munnar. Visit the Athirappilly Falls on the way. Check-in to your hotel and relax for a while before heading out to explore Munnar. First, you will be taken to the Mattupetty Dam, a concrete gravity dam which was built for the purpose of water conservation. Make your way to Kundala Lake, surrounded by forests and scenic views. Get back to your hotel at night.

itinerary.title: Munnar
itinerary.description: Wrapped in peace and tranquility, Munnar is famous for its tea plantations, hills, and thrilling outdoor activities. Make your way to Echo Point, which serves as the meeting point of three mountain ranges, namely Mudrapuzha, Nallathanni, and Kundala. Some of the activities you can enjoy here are birdwatching, boating, and nature walks. Explore the Eravikulam National Park, which is situated in the Kannan Devan Hills and where you can spot leopards, tigers, giant squirrels, and sloth bears.

itinerary.title: Munnar – Thekkady
itinerary.description: Once you finish having a delicious breakfast, leave for Thekkady from Munnar. After completing the check-in formalities, proceed to explore the Periyar National Park. Also known as the Periyar Tiger Reserve, it is home to tigers, elephants, leopards, lion-tailed macaques, and the Indian bison.

itinerary.title: Thekkady
itinerary.description: After getting done with your breakfast, you have the rest of the day to spend the way you want to.

itinerary.title: Thekkady - Cochin - Depart Cochin
itinerary.description: Check out of your hotel once you get done with your breakfast. You will be transferred to Cochin from where you can board your flight or train back home.

itinerary.title: Welcome to Munnar
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at Cochin, our tour manager will welcome you and help you transfer to Munnar. The scenic journey takes around 4.5 hours. Check into the hotel to freshen up and head to cover tourist attractions like Mattupetti Dam, Anaimudi Peak, Devikulam, and the Kolukkumalai Tea Estate. Spend the night in Munnar.

itinerary.title: Munnar - Thekkady
itinerary.description: Today, you will cover tourist attractions like Echo Point, Eravikulam National Park, Nyayamakad Waterfall, Rajamala, Malankara Reservoir. Later, drive to Thekkady to continue with your tour. Spend the night in Thekkady.

itinerary.title: Thekkady
itinerary.description: Explore the Periyar Natural Park to enjoy the scenic beauty of the neighbouring hills and the wildlife, including elephants, wild gaur, sloth bears, and wild boars. Bid adieu to Thekkady as you return to your home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Delhi
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Delhi Airport or Railway Station, you will be greeted by our tour representatives who will take you to Nainital. Check-in to your hotel and spend the day at leisure.

itinerary.title: Nainital Zoo - Hanuman Garhi
itinerary.description: After enjoying a delicious breakfast, proceed to explore Nainital. You will firstly be taken to the Nainital Zoo. Located at an altitude of 2100 m and sprawled over an area of 4.693 hectares, some of the animals you will get to see at this zoo are leopards, gorals, Tibetan wolves, Japanese macaques, red junglefowls, barking deers, and more. Witness the Hanuman Garhi, which is a religious centre dedicated to Lord Hanuman. Get back to your hotel for a good night’s sleep.

itinerary.title: Bhimtal – Sattal - Naukuchiatal
itinerary.description: On this day, visit the city of Bhimtal and experience the beauty of Sattal Lake and Naukuchiatal Lake. Enjoy boating on Nainital Lake before journeying towards the Naina Devi Himalayan Bird Conservation Reserve. Return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Depart Delhi
itinerary.description: After having your breakfast, leave from Nainital and make your way to Delhi. Board a train or flight back to your hometown.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Delhi
itinerary.description: Upon arriving in Delhi, our tour manager will welcome you and drive you to Nainital. Check into the hotel and spend time relaxing. Later in the evening, shop at Mall Road or enjoy a boat ride on Lake Naini. Spend the night in Nainital.

itinerary.title: Nainital Full Day Tour
itinerary.description: Nainital is a charming Himalayan town and a former British hill station set around Naini Lake. The town gets its name from the Naina Devi temple located on the edge of the Naini Lake. Some places you will visit include Sattal Lake, Bhimtal Lake, Tiffin Top, and the Naina Devi Temple. Don’t miss the ropeway ride on Gun Hill. Move back to the hotel to spend the night in Nainital.

itinerary.title: Nainital - Corbett
itinerary.description: Today, after breakfast, check out of the hotel and head to Corbett. The Jim Corbett National Park was established in 1936 to protect the endangered Bengal tiger. It is famous for its exotic animals, including the Asian elephant, Asian bear, and sambar deer. Check into the hotel and head out on a jeep safari, where you can observe the animals close up. Spend the night in Corbett.

itinerary.title: Corbett – Delhi
itinerary.description: After your breakfast, check out of your hotel from Corbett and head to Delhi to catch your train or flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Delhi
itinerary.description: After you arrive in Delhi, our tour manager will welcome you and drive you to Nainital. The journey takes around 7 hours and is breathtakingly beautiful. At Nainital, check into the hotel and spend some time relaxing. Later, you can enjoy a boat ride on Naini Lake or go shopping on Mall Road. Return to the hotel for dinner, spending the night in Nainital.

itinerary.title: Nainital Full Day Tour
itinerary.description: After a hearty Pahari breakfast buffet, head out for a tour of Nainital. The town gets its name from the Naina Devi Temple on the edge of the Naini Lake. You will visit Mukteshwar Temple, Bhim Tal, Sat Tal, and the Naina Devi Temple. After lunch, go on a ropeway ride on Gun Hill. Enjoy some shopping in the evening. Return to your hotel for dinner. Spend the night in Nainital.

itinerary.title: Nainital – Kausani
itinerary.description: After a hearty breakfast, head to Kausani via Almora. This beautiful village and hill station is famous for its scenic views. Thanks to the uninterrupted view of the Himalayan Mountains, it is often called the Switzerland of India. Some places you will visit in Kausani include Anasakti Ashram, Rudradhani Falls, Bajinath Temple, and the Kausani Tea Estate. Return to your hotel for dinner. Spend the night in Nainital.

itinerary.title: Kausani
itinerary.description: This includes a visit to the Kausani shawl factory and Bageshwar. Return to the hotel for dinner. Spend the night in Kausani.

itinerary.title: Kausani - Corbett National Park
itinerary.description: After morning, head to Corbett, stopping at Ranikhet en route. Here, you will explore the local attractions, including Chaubatia, Haidakhan Babaji Temple, and Bhalu Dam. Upon arriving at Corbett, check into a hotel and spend the rest of the evening at leisure.

itinerary.title: Corbett – Delhi
itinerary.description: The Jim Corbett National Park is the oldest national park in India, established in 1936 to protect the endangered Bengal tiger. It is part of the Corbett Tiger Reserve and home to several animals, including the Asian elephant, Sambar deer, and Asian bear. After a tour of the park, check out of the hotel and head to Delhi. Upon reaching Delhi, you can catch your train or flight home.

itinerary.title: Delhi - Nainital
itinerary.description: Upon arriving in Nainital, our tour manager will welcome you and drive you to Nainital. The journey takes around 7 hours and is breathtakingly beautiful. Check into the hotel and spend some time relaxing. Later in the evening, enjoy a boat ride on Naini Lake. Return to your hotel to spend the night in Nainital.

itinerary.title: Nainital Full Day Tour
itinerary.description: Today, you will explore Nainital. Some of the attractions you will visit include Sattal Lake, Bhimtal Lake, and the Naina Devi Temple, which is located on the edge of Naini Lake. Don’t miss shopping at Mall Road or a ropeway ride on Gun Hill. Spend the night in Nainital.

itinerary.title: Ranikhet Full Day Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head to Ranikhet for a full-day tour of this beautiful hill station. Ranikhet is a trekker’s paradise, famous for its apple and peach orchards. When in Ranikhet, don’t miss the Jhula Devi Temple. Enjoy a Pahari lunch in the afternoon at one of the many local restaurants. Return to your hotel to spend the night in Nainital.

itinerary.title: Nainital – Delhi
itinerary.description: After breakfast in Nainital, check out of the hotel and head to Delhi to catch your train or flight back home.

packages.name: Grand Turkey Package
packages.destination: Istanbul - Istanbul City Tour - Istanbul Bosphorus Cruise And Shopping Tour - Istanbul Princes’ Island Tour

itinerary.title: Arrival in Istanbul
itinerary.description: Arrive at Ataturk International Airport in Istanbul. Transfer to your hotel and check-in. Rest and relax for some time. Later, continue to explore the markets and other attractions around your hotel. Spend the night at a luxury hotel.

itinerary.title: Istanbul City Tour
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast at the hotel. Start your day with a tour of Old Istanbul City. Some places you’ll cover include The Blue Mosque (Sultan Ahmed Mosque), Hagia Sophia, and the Topkapi Palace. You’ll also visit the Grand Bazaar, one of the world’s oldest and largest covered markets. Besides admiring its unique architecture, you’ll also get a unique local perspective by exploring its many tourist-free nooks and crannies. After a lunch break, we’ll cover the remaining attractions, including the Basilica Cistern, the Hippodrome of Constantinople, the Obelisk of Theodosius, the Serpentine Column, the Column of Constantinople, and the Spice Bazaar (Egyptian Bazaar) Return to your hotel in the evening.

itinerary.title: Bosphorus Cruise & Shopping Tour
itinerary.description: Start your day with breakfast at the hotel. Embark on a Bosphorus Cruise, where you'll explore the scenic waterway that separates Europe from Asia. Soak in the magnificent views as your ship/yacht passes through the city’s monumental landmarks. Admire the beautiful views of the Dolmabahce Palace, Rumeli Fortress, Ciragan Palace, Yildiz Palace, and Maiden's Tower. Enjoy lunch at a local restaurant during the cruise. Experience the panoramic view of Istanbul from Camlica Hill. After the cruise, return to your hotel and spend the evening leisurely or go on a shopping spree to the many local markets.

itinerary.title: Princes' Island Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast, take a ferry from Istanbul to the Princes' Islands, a group of nine islands in the Sea of Marmara. Don’t miss the view of the Topkapi Palace, the Leander’s Tower, and Uskudar from the sea. Explore Büyükada, the largest and most popular of the Princes' Islands, known for its beautiful beaches, summer resorts, horse-drawn carriages, and pine forests. Enjoy a leisurely stroll or rent a bicycle to explore the island's charming streets and historic mansions, or sign up for many water sports activities available on the island. Have lunch (not included) at a local restaurant. Take the ferry back to Istanbul in the late afternoon. Return to your hotel and spend the evening at your leisure.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Enjoy your last breakfast in Istanbul. Check out from the hotel. If time permits, you can do some last-minute shopping or visit any remaining sights. Transfer to Istanbul International Airport for your departure flight.

itinerary.title: India to Beijing - International Flight
itinerary.description: Commence your journey with an international flight from India to Beijing, arriving at Beijing Capital International Airport. Upon your arrival, you will be warmly greeted by our tour representatives, who will then assist you in transferring to your hotel, where you can take some time to relax. The day is yours to enjoy at your leisure, and you may also consider attending the captivating Acrobatic show. Please note that meals are not included.

itinerary.title: Beijing Exploration
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a hearty breakfast at the hotel as you prepare for an exciting city tour of Beijing. Your first destination is the Summer Palace, where you can marvel at the Marble Boat, visit a Pearl Shop, and stroll through the beautifully adorned "Long Corridor." Be sure not to miss the iconic Tian'anmen Square, which stands as the world's largest square. Next, venture into the splendid Forbidden City, a place where Emperors of the Ming and Qing dynasties reigned for over 500 years. Here, you have the option to embark on a Hutong tour or a Rickshaw tour for a more immersive experience. Your journey continues to the vibrant Houhai, situated in the heart of Beijing, celebrated for its lively nightlife, bars, cafes, and restaurants. After this visit, you can choose to attend the Kongku show in the evening. Conclude the day with a delectable dinner at an Indian restaurant before returning to your hotel for a comfortable overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Beijing
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a delightful breakfast, and then embark on a visit to the legendary Great Wall at Juyong Pass. This remarkable UNESCO World Heritage Site stands as a colossal defensive structure crafted to ward off intruders. Following this, we'll head to the Longdi Jade shop, where you'll gain insight into Chinese jade culture. In the afternoon, don't miss the opportunity to explore the Bird's Nest (Olympic National Stadium, exterior view) and the Water Cube (exterior view). You can also indulge in some shopping at the Yaxiu market and catch an exciting Acrobatic show. Your overnight stay will be at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Beijing to Shanghai - Morning Domestic Flight
itinerary.description: Catch a morning flight to Shanghai. If your hotel provides a packed breakfast, they will inform and offer it to you. Upon your arrival in Shanghai, our tour representatives will be there to meet you and arrange your transfer. You can enjoy your breakfast at the hotel. Commence your city tour with a visit to the Jade Buddha Temple, an ancient Buddhist temple of great significance. Continue your journey to People Square and Nanjing Road for a spot of shopping. You also have the option to explore the Shanghai Madame Tussauds wax museum and wander along the Riverside Promenade at Taobao City for shopping starting at 8:00 PM. Later in the evening, dine at an Indian Restaurant and return to your hotel for a restful night.

itinerary.title: Shanghai
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a delightful breakfast before embarking on a visit to the Shanghai Museum, the largest repository of ancient Chinese art. Next, explore the Yuyuan Garden, where you can admire the scenic nine zigzag bridge, golden fishpond, charming bridges, and elegant pavilions. Don't miss a visit to the Yu Market and the Taoist Temple in Shanghai. In the afternoon, ascend the Oriental Pearl TV Tower for breathtaking views and an enjoyable day. Optionally, you can consider a visit to the Shanghai Aquarium after 4:00 PM or a Huangpu River Cruise at 8:00 PM. Conclude your day with a transfer to an Indian restaurant for dinner before returning to your hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Shanghai
itinerary.description: Check out of your hotel and make your way to Xitang, a picturesque and well-preserved area graced with meandering rivers and stone bridges. Xitang boasts numerous antique residences, temples, and various attractions. You can also opt for a boat ride to fully appreciate the town's scenic beauty. Return to Shanghai at 8:00 PM and dine at a Chinese Vegetarian restaurant. Head over to Xintiandi for an evening of shopping, dining, and entertainment. Xintiandi comes alive with vibrant nightlife, music, and dance. Conclude your day with a return to the hotel for dinner and an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Shanghai to India - International Flight
itinerary.description: Enjoy a satisfying breakfast at the hotel before making your way to the international airport for your departure. As an optional experience, you can consider taking a ride on the Maglev Train en route to Pudong Airport. This high-speed train journey makes for a unique and enjoyable start to your day.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Port Blair - Corbyn’s Cove Beach - Cellular Jail
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Veer Savarkar International Airport, you will be greeted by our tour representatives, who will help you get to your hotel. Complete the check-in process, freshen up, and then head out for a day of sightseeing. The first place you will be taken to is Corbyn’s Cove Beach, a beach whose shoreline is lined with palm trees and where you can enjoy sunbathing and swimming. Later in the day, visit the iconic landmark known as Cellular Jail. It’s a three-storeyed British colonial prison which is also called Kala Pani. Established in 1906, it was utilised by the colonial government of India to exile criminals and political prisoners. This is where you can witness a light and sound show in the evening. Get back to your hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: Havelock Island - Radhanagar Beach
itinerary.description: On the second day of your trip, board a ship to get to Havelock Island, which is located 41 km northeast of Port Blair. After checking in to your hotel, freshen up and relax for a while. In the evening, get ready to visit a beach that was given the title of the ‘Best Beach in Asia’ by Time magazine in 2004, known as Radhanagar Beach. Famous for its spectacular sunsets, make sure to click a bunch of photographs to preserve the memories.

itinerary.title: Havelock Island
itinerary.description: Spend the third day of your holiday relaxing or indulging in a wide range of water-based adventurous activities. This includes kayaking, scuba diving, snorkelling, and jet skiing. Later on, leave for Port Blair. Check-in to your hotel and have a relaxing evening.

itinerary.title: Depart Port Blair
itinerary.description: In the morning, have your breakfast and leave for the airport to board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Bangalore
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at the airport or railway station in Bangalore, our tour representatives will greet you and help you get to your hotel. Often referred to as the ‘Silicon Valley of India’, Bangalore is known for its pleasant weather, greenery, and modern lifestyle, among several other things. After checking-in at your hotel, you can venture out to explore the city. Take a stroll around the peaceful Cubbon Park which is sprawled over an area of 300 acres. Visit the Lalbagh Botanical Garden, which is 200 years old and covers 240 acres. The next stop for the day will be Tipu Sultan's Summer Palace, a wonderful example of Indo-Islamic architecture. Visit the Vidhana Soudha, Bangalore Palace, St. Patrick's Church, and Bull Temple before heading back to your hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: Bangalore – Mysore
itinerary.description: After having a delicious breakfast, check out of your hotel in Bangalore and leave for the city of Mysore. Check-in to your hotel and enjoy the rest of the day at your own pace.

itinerary.title: Mysore City Tour
itinerary.description: Get done with your breakfast and venture out to witness the numerous scenic spots in Mysore. You will be taken to the Chamundi Hills, Brindavan Gardens, Karanji Lake, Mysore Zoo, and St. Philomena's Cathedral. Get back to your hotel for a good night’s sleep.

itinerary.title: Mysore - Coorg
itinerary.description: On this day, you will be leaving Mysore and making your way towards Coorg, which is among the most stunning hill stations in the country. Check-in to your hotel and you will have the rest of the day to relax.

itinerary.title: Coorg
itinerary.description: Today, you will be exploring Coorg, which is known for its tea and coffee plantations and abundant greenery. Get ready to visit popular tourist spots such as the Omkareshwara Temple, Abbey Falls, Raja's Seat, Iruppu Falls, Madikeri Fort, and the Nagarahole Tiger Reserve.

itinerary.title: Coorg – Bangalore – Depart Bangalore
itinerary.description: Have a filling breakfast and leave for the airport or railway station in Bangalore to get back to your hometown.

packages.name: Wonders of Kerala
packages.destination: Trivandrum - Kovalam - Allepey - Thekkady - Munnar - Kochi

itinerary.title: Trivandrum
itinerary.description: Upon arrival in Thiruvananthapuram, our tour representatives will help you transfer to the hotel. Complete check-in formalities and explore local attractions like the Sree Padmanabhaswamy Temple, Trivandrum Zoo, Sri Chitra Art Gallery, Napier Museum, and the Padmanabhaswamy Palace. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Trivandrum.

itinerary.title: Kovalam
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head to explore the beautiful beaches in the city, including Kovalam, Varkala, and Shangumugham. After a busy day, spend the night at a resort.

itinerary.title: Alleppey
itinerary.description: Enjoy a sumptuous breakfast before leaving the hotel and heading to Alleppey. The journey takes around 4 hours by road and is famous for its scenic views. Here, you will enjoy a luxury houseboat experience in the backwaters of Alleppey. Spend the entire day exploring daily lives of people living along the banks of the Alleppey rivers. You will also enjoy sumptuous food cooked on the boat by experienced chefs. Spend the night on the houseboat in Alleppey.

itinerary.title: Thekkady
itinerary.description: After breakfast, spend some time enjoying the views around the houseboat. Check out of the houseboat to head to Thekkady, which is famous for the Periyar Wildlife Sanctuary. Check in to your hotel and move on to explore local attractions. Some of the local attractions in Thekkady include Periyar Wildlife Sanctuary, Elephant Junction, and the Green Park Spices Plantation.

itinerary.title: Munnar
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head to Thekkady by car. Munnar is a beautiful hill station on the Western Ghats famous for its sprawling tea plantations, waterfalls, and unique flora and fauna. Some of the iconic attractions in the hill town include Eravikulam National Park, Pothamedu View Point, Mattupetty Dam, Kolukkumalai Tea Estate, Top Station, and Echo Point. You will also cover the Nyayamakad Waterfall, Rajamala Hills, Kundala Dam, and the Malankara Reservoir. Return to the hotel to spend the night in Munnar.

itinerary.title: Munnar
itinerary.description: After breakfast, you will head to cover areas you missed yesterday. Enjoy the scenic views of the hill town and return to your hotel. Spend the night at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Kochi
itinerary.description: After a sumptuous breakfast, head to Kochi. The journey takes around 4 hours. Kochi is famously called the Queen of the Arabian Sea because of the centuries of spice trade in its harbours. Check in to a hotel and head to the city for a tour. You will visit the Dutch Palace, the Jewish Synagogue, the Chinese Fishing Nets, the St. Francis Church, and Cherai Beach. Then, return to the luxury hotel to spend the night.

itinerary.title: Kochi
itinerary.description: This is the last day of your trip. After breakfast, you will check out of the hotel and head to the Kochi Airport or Railway Station.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Guruvayur
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at the Kochi Airport (or the Guruvayur Railway Station, depending on your preference), our tour manager will welcome you and help you transfer to the hotel. You can freshen up and spend some time relaxing at the hotel. Join us for a darshan of Guruvayurappan at the Sree Krishna Temple. Spend the night at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Guruvayur – Munnar
itinerary.description: After breakfast, you will head to Munnar. The journey takes around 6 hours. Upon arrival at the hotel, you can freshen up and relax before heading out for a sightseeing tour. You will explore the many tea plantations of Munnar and return to the hotel for a relaxing evening by the fire. Spend the night in Munnar.

itinerary.title: Munnar
itinerary.description: This is your second day in Munnar, where you will explore the beautiful and scenic places in the hill town, including the Eravikulam National Park, Kolukkumalai Tea Estate, Pothamedu View Point, Mattupetty Dam, Kundala Dam, Echo Point, and Top Station. Spend the night in Munnar.

itinerary.title: Munnar – Thekkady
itinerary.description: After breakfast, continue to Thekkady to visit the Periyar National Park, famous for its Asian elephants, monkeys, nilgais, langurs, and wild boars. You will also visit the Cardamom Hills or Yela Mala, renowned for its cardamom, pepper, and coffee plantations. Your tour includes a boat cruise on Periyar Lake to view the wildlife from close quarters. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Thekkady.

itinerary.title: Thekkady to Alleppey
itinerary.description: After a delectable breakfast, head to Alleppey for a houseboat stay. These are traditional rice boats that are now converted into spacious accommodations with comfortable and modern amenities. Enjoy delectable Kerala cuisine cooked fresh in the houseboat. Enjoy the night in the houseboat.

itinerary.title: Alleppey – Kochi
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head to the beautiful port city of Kochi. Some famous attractions in Kochi include the Mattancherry Palace, Marine Drive, Jew Town, and Cherai Beach. In the evening, enjoy a cruise ride on the Sagararani. Spend the night in the hotel.

itinerary.title: Kochi
itinerary.description: On the last day, you will head to the Kochi Airport or the Railway Station, depending on your preference.

itinerary.title: Bucharest – Suceava
itinerary.description: After a sumptuous breakfast of local cold cuts and cheeses, head to the train station to visit Suceava. The journey takes around 7 hours and is absolutely scenic. Upon arrival, check in to a hotel and prepare for a short sightseeing tour of Suceava. You will visit the fortified castles of Suceava, the Saint George Church, the Saint John’s Monastery, and other attractions. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Gura Humorului.

itinerary.title: Bucovina Monasteries
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head to explore some of the world’s famous monasteries and churches. Some of these buildings are hundreds of years old and are part of the UNESCO World Heritage list. For instance, the Sucevita Monastery was founded in 1581 by Gheorghe Movila as a fortress and a princely residence. The intricate paintings on the exterior walls are as impressive as the artefacts in the museum. In fact, Sucevita is the last of the 22 painted churches in Bucovina and has one of the largest numbers of painted images. The next on the list is Voronet Monastery, also called the Sistine Chapel of the East. It is the most famous for all painted churches in Bucovina and was founded by Stephan the Great in 1488. The monastery is listed in the UNESCO World Heritage list. The Moldovita Monastery was founded by Petru Rares, the illegitimate son of the Stephen III of Moldovia. It is one of the 8 painted churches that are part of the UNESCO World Heritage Sites and famous for its frescos depicting stories and themes from the holy scriptures, including the Tree of Jesse, the Siege of Constantinople, and the Last Judgement. On the way to these sites, you’ll stop at Marginea to enjoy local workshops on black ceramicware. Spend the night at Gura Humorului.

itinerary.title: Bucharest
itinerary.description: After breakfast, leave Suceava to reach Bucharest and continue with the next leg of your Europe tour package journey.

packages.name: Delightful Romania
packages.destination: Bucharest - Sibiu - Sighisoara - Bucovina area - Brasov - Bucuresti

itinerary.title: Arrive In Bucharest
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at the Bucharest International Airport, our tour manager will help you transfer and complete the check-in formalities. Spend the rest of the day enjoying the beautiful city and its markets. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Bucharest.

itinerary.title: Bucharest – Sibiu
itinerary.description: After a sumptuous breakfast, head out for a quick tour of Bucharest city. Some of the places you will visit during this tour include Revolution Square, the People’s Salvation Cathedral, the tallest and largest Eastern Orthodox Church in the world, the Romanian Athenaeum, Golescu Mansion, the old Royal Palace, the Arch of Triumph, and the Open Air Village Museum. Later during the day, you will move to Transylvania. On the way, you will stop at Cozia Monastery, one of Romania’s most ancient churches along the Olt Valley. Later, you will proceed to Sibiu, a beautiful medieval town in Transylvania. It was recognised as Europe’s Capital of Culture in 2007. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Sibiu.

itinerary.title: Sibiu – Sighisoara
itinerary.description: Sibiu is a typical European town with medieval buildings, cobblestone roads, roadside cafes, winding lanes, and friendly locals. Some of the places you will visit in Sibiu include the Saint Mary Evangelical Parish Church, which was built in the 14th century, the Museum of the Icons on Glass, the Bridge of Lies, the Large Square, and Turnul Sfatului or the Tower of the Council. Later, after a traditional lunch at a local restaurant, you will head to explore Sighisoara. This city is at the heart of Transylvania and is supposedly the hometown of Vlad the Impaler. This medieval town is famous for its picturesque settings, rich history, and UNESCO World Heritage Structures. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Sighisoara.

itinerary.title: Sighisoara – Bucovina
itinerary.description: After a hearty breakfast, head to explore the many heritage buildings in Sighisoara, viz, the Sighisoara Citadel, the Clock Tower Museum, the Medieval Weapons Museum, and the Covered Stairway. Enjoy walking the city's narrow streets to experience life in a medieval town. Spend the noon enjoying lunch at a local restaurant before heading to Bucovina through the beautiful Borgo Pass.
