Don’t forget to enjoy the many twists, turns, ups, and downs along the Apuseni Mountains of the Carpathian Range. Bucovina is famous for its painted monasteries, orthodox churches, and the many castles mentioned in Bram Stoker’s book Dracula. Stop for a coffee at Dracula’s Castle Hotel. Later, drive to Gura Humorului to end the day at a luxury hotel.

itinerary.title: Explore Bucovina
itinerary.description: After breakfast, you will explore this beautiful city and its heritage monuments. Some of the places you will explore today include the many painted monasteries of Bucovina, Putna Monastery, Suceava Fortress, Bucovina Village Museum, Vatra Dornei, and the Voronet Monastery, also called the Sistine Chapel of the East. This chapel was built by King Stephan the Great in 1487 to celebrate their victory over the Ottoman Empire. Some other attractions here include the Moldovita Monastery, a Romanian Orthodox monastery in the commune of Vatra Moldovitei, and Marginea, where you can enjoy the many workshops selling black ceramicware. Spend the night in Gura Humorului.

itinerary.title: Bucovina Area – Brasov
itinerary.description: Today, after breakfast, head to Brasov via the Bicaz Gorge. Don’t miss the Hasmas National Park along the way, famous for its limestone rocks that tower over 1,000 ft. above the Cheile Bicazuluipass and the Red Lake. The medieval town of Brasov was once the capital of Transylvania and is one of the most beautiful places in Romania. Some places you will visit in Brasov include Council Square, the Black Church, the First Romanian School Museum, Biserica Sfantul Nicolae, and the Orthodox Church, which was built in the 1800s.

itinerary.title: Brasov – Bucharest
itinerary.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast before visiting the Bran Castle, an imposing castle associated with the fictional Count Dracula. The next stop on your tour will be the Peles Castle, the former summer residence of the Royal Family in Romania, built by the first King of Romania. Today, the castle holds different weapons and art objects in its exhibition. Later, you will move to Bucharest and check in to your hotel. Spend the night in Bucharest.

itinerary.title: Depart Bucharest
itinerary.description: Check out of your hotel to head to the Bucharest International Airport to catch your return flight home or continue with the next leg of your Europe tour package journey.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Kochi
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival in Kochi, our representatives will greet you at the airport and help you get to your hotel. Once the check-in formalities are complete, you can relax for a bit before heading out for a day of sightseeing. Start off with the Mattancherry Palace, which is also known as the Dutch Palace. Built in 1557 by the Portuguese, it was constructed as a present to Raja Vera Kerala Varma, who was the then ruler of the Kochi dynasty. The next stop to make is the Hill Palace Museum, which was once the official residence of the rulers of Kochi in the 17th century. Make your way to the Paradesi Synagogue and St. Francis Church before witnessing the Chinese fishing nets. Get back to your hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: Kochi - Alleppey
itinerary.description: After having a delicious breakfast, check out from your hotel to leave for Alleppey. Also known as Alappuzha, it is popular for its beaches, backwaters, lagoons, and canals. Check in to your hotel at Alleppey and head out for lunch. Take a stroll around Alleppey Beach later in the day and return to your hotel for a good night’s sleep.

itinerary.title: Alleppey - Kumarakom
itinerary.description: Once you finish having your breakfast, check out from your hotel, after which you will be driven to the city of Kumarakom. Get ready to board a houseboat upon reaching Kumarakom, the check-in time for which is 12:30 PM. Enjoy the view of Vembanad Lake as the houseboat makes its journey forward. Spend the night in the houseboat.

itinerary.title: Depart Kochi
itinerary.description: Get done with your breakfast and then check out from your houseboat at 9:30 AM. From here, you will be driven to the airport or railway station in Kochi so you can board your flight/train back home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Cochin
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Cochin Railway Station or Airport, our tour representatives will greet you and help you transfer to your hotel. After completing the check-in formalities, freshen up and head out for a tour of Cochin. You will be taken to some of the most historical spots in the city, such as the Mattancherry Palace, Paradesi Synagogue, Santa Cruz Cathedral Basilica, and the Chinese fishing nets. In the evening, get aboard a Sagararani cruise.

itinerary.title: Cochin - Munnar
itinerary.description: In the morning, enjoy a delicious breakfast, after which you will be moving to Munnar. On the way, enjoy the views of Munnar’s tea plantations, rolling hills, and cascading waterfalls. Check-in to your hotel and get a good night’s sleep.

itinerary.title: Munnar Tour
itinerary.description: After having a scrumptious breakfast, you can leave to enjoy the most popular tourist spots in Munnar. Check out the tea plantations, engage in hiking at Echo Point, go for boating at Kundala Lake, and witness the greenery at Mattupetty Dam.

itinerary.title: Munnar - Thekkady
itinerary.description: Today, you will be transferring from Munnar to Thekkady. On the way, visit the Periyar National Park, which is also named the Periyar Tiger Reserve. Some of the animals you will get to see at this wildlife sanctuary are leopards, tigers, elephants, and lion-tailed macaques. Enjoy a round of boating at Periyar Lake before reaching Thekkady. Check-in to your hotel and get some restful sleep.

itinerary.title: Thekkady - Alleppey
itinerary.description: Drive to Alleppey in the morning and check-in to your hotel. Take in the serene view of the backwaters throughout the day.

itinerary.title: Depart Cochin
itinerary.description: Have your breakfast and leave for Cochin. Get to the airport or railway station to board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Delhi - Manali
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Delhi Airport, you will be greeted by our tour representative, who will help you transfer to Manali. Once the check-in formalities are complete, you can spend the rest of the day at leisure.

itinerary.title: Manali – Rohtang Pass - Manali
itinerary.description: Get ready for one of the most thrilling experiences of your life, because today you will be journeying up Rohtang Pass. Famous for being one of the most visited spots in all of Himachal Pradesh, it is located about 51 km from Manali. Once you reach the highest point, you can enjoy the breathtaking view and get plenty of pictures taken.

itinerary.title: Manali
itinerary.description: During the day, you can visit the revered temples in Manali, including the Hadimba Devi Temple and Vashisht Temple. Relax in the evening and spend the night at your hotel.

itinerary.title: Manali – Kullu - Manali
itinerary.description: Make your way to the pristine town of Kullu. On the way, view the Beas River, Sutlej River, and Kullu Valley. Make sure to shop for shawls while you’re in Kullu. Drive back to Manali and get back to your hotel in the evening.

itinerary.title: Manali
itinerary.description: Today can be spent however you want to. You could lounge around your hotel or even step out to indulge in some retail therapy.

itinerary.title: Manali – Delhi – Depart Delhi
itinerary.description: After having breakfast at the hotel, you will be driven to the airport in Delhi, where you can board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Delhi - Jaipur
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Delhi Airport/Railway Station, our tour representatives will greet you and help you transfer to Jaipur, the Pink City. While you’re on your way, make a stop at Amber Fort, situated in Amer, where you can enjoy an elephant ride. After reaching Jaipur, check-in to your hotel and travel around the nearby sightseeing spots.

itinerary.title: Jaipur City Tour
itinerary.description: Enjoy a delicious breakfast and then venture out to witness the beautiful sites of Jaipur. There is the City Palace, which is a royal residence and former administrative headquarters of Jaipur’s rulers. Take in the spellbinding beauty of Hawa Mahal, a structure that is made up of red and pink sandstone. You will also be taken to the UNESCO World Heritage Site known as Jantar Mantar. The other spots you will be exploring in Jaipur today are the Tomb of Salim Chishti and Albert Hall Museum. Later in the day, drive to the town of Pushkar where you can visit Pushkar Lake and the revered Brahma Temple.

itinerary.title: Jaipur - Udaipur
itinerary.description: In the morning, drive from Jaipur to Udaipur. On reaching Udaipur, check-in to your hotel and relax for a while. The first spot you will be taken to is Jagdish Temple, a temple that was built in 1651 during the reign of Maharana Jagat Singh. Explore the gorgeous Saheliyon Ki Bari and enjoy the view of Lake Pichola.

itinerary.title: Udaipur – Mount Abu
itinerary.description: On this day, drive from Udaipur to Mount Abu. Perched on a high rocky plateau and surrounded by greenery, Mount Abu offers just the kind of ambience that honeymooners can relish. After getting done with the check-in process at your hotel, the places you will be visiting in Mount Abu are the Dilwara Temples, Sunset Point, and Nakki Lake.

itinerary.title: Mount Abu – Delhi - Depart Delhi
itinerary.description: In the morning, drive from Mount Abu to Delhi after having your breakfast. Reach the airport or railway station to go back to your hometown.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Bagdogra – Gangtok
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Bagdogra Airport, our tour representatives will greet you and help you get to Gangtok. Once you get to your hotel, complete the check-in process and spend the rest of the day at leisure.

itinerary.title: Gangtok
itinerary.description: After having a scrumptious breakfast, head out to explore Gangtok. Known to be Sikkim’s most populous city, it is also the state’s capital. Make a trip to Tsomgo Lake, which is also known as Tsongmo Lake or Changgu Lake. The surface of this glacial lake reflects different colours depending on the season and is highly respected by the people of Sikkim. Get back to your hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: Gangtok – Darjeeling
itinerary.description: Begin this day by visiting the Ban Jhakri Falls Park and then move to offer your prayers at Do Drul Chorten, a stupa that was built in 1945. The other popular spots you will be visiting are the Directorate of Handicrafts and Handloom, the Namgyal Institute of Tibetology, and the Flower Exhibition Centre. In the evening, leave Gangtok to head towards Darjeeling. Check-in to your hotel and get a good night’s sleep.

itinerary.title: Darjeeling
itinerary.description: Early in the morning, head towards Tiger Hill to view the sunrise wherein you can witness the snow peaks of Kanchenjunga reflect the most magical hues. On the way back to your hotel, stop by the Ghoom Monastery, Japanese Temple, and Batasia Loop. Have a filling breakfast and then continue to explore the city of Darjeeling. Take in the beauty of the Buddhist stupa known as Peace Pagoda and enjoy a fun cable car ride at the Darjeeling Ropeway. Visit the Tenzing & Gombu Rock, Tibetan Refugee Self-Help Center, and Padmaja Naidu Himalayan Zoological Park. Be sure to feast your eyes on the tea plantations of Darjeeling. Get back to your hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: Darjeeling – Depart Bagdogra
itinerary.description: In the morning, check out of your hotel and head for the airport in Bagdogra to board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrive In Gangtok
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at the Bagdogra Airport in Siliguri, our tour manager will welcome you and help you transfer to Gangtok via road. The journey takes over 4 to 5 hours and is beautiful, offering a panoramic view of the majestic Kanchenjunga Mountain range. Check in to your hotel and spend the rest of the evening exploring places around your neighbourhood. Spend the night in Gangtok.

itinerary.title: Gangtok Day Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast, you will head to explore Gangtok, the capital of Sikkim. Established as a Buddhist pilgrimage site in the 1840s, the city is famous for its breathtaking views of the Kanchenjunga. You will cover Tsomgo Lake, the Sikkim Himalayan Zoological Park, Ganesh Tok, Do Drul Chorten, and Enchey Monastery. Don’t miss riding the Gangtok Ropeway. Spend the night in Gangtok.

itinerary.title: Gangtok - Kalimpong
itinerary.description: Today, after breakfast, you will visit the Banjhakri Falls, a popular waterfall that drops from over 100 feet. The water is sourced from freshwater springs higher up in the mountains. Some other attractions include the Research Institute of Tibetology, the Directorate of Handicrafts and Handloom, and the Flower Exhibition Centre. Laer, check out of the hotel and head to Kalimpong. Check into the hotel and spend the night in Kalimpong.

itinerary.title: Kalimpong Day Tour
itinerary.description: Kalimpong is a picturesque town famous for its monasteries, Tibetan handicrafts, churches, and beautiful views of the Teesta River. Some of the places you will cover on your day tour include Delo Park, Mangal Dham Temple, Pine View Nursery, Geden Tharpa Choling Monastery, Lepcha Museum, Durpin Monastery, and Neora Valley. Later in the evening, you will check out of the hotel and head to Darjeeling.

itinerary.title: Kalimpong - Darjeeling
itinerary.description: Today, after breakfast, check out from the hotel and head out shopping. Later in the afternoon, you will head to Darjeeling.

itinerary.title: Darjeeling Day Tour
itinerary.description: Darjeeling is a town in West Bengal and is fondly called the Queen of the Hills in Northeast India. It is popular for its namesake tea – the Darjeeling tea which is loved for its flavour and taste. Some of the places you will visit include Kanchendzonga Peak, Ghoom Monastery, Batasia Loop, and Peace Pagoda. After lunch, you will visit the Padmaja Naidu Himalayan Zoological Park, the Japanese Temple, the Himalayan Mountaineering Institute, the Darjeeling Ropeway Ride, Tenzing, and Gombu Rock. Don’t miss the Tibetan Refugee Self-Help Center and the surrounding tea estate. Spend the night in Darjeeling.

itinerary.title: Depart Darjeeling
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of your hotel and head to the Bagdogra Airport to return home.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Gangtok
itinerary.description: Upon arriving at the Bagdogra Airport, our tour manager will welcome you and help you transfer to Gangtok. The journey takes around 5 hours and is incredibly scenic. Check in to your hotel and spend some time relaxing and exploring places around the neighbourhood. Spend the night in Gangtok.

itinerary.title: Gangtok Day Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head out to explore the city. Some of the places you will explore today include Tsongmo Lake, Hanuman Tok, Ganesh Tok, Do Drul Chorten, Sikkim Himalayan Zoological Park, Enchey Monastery, and the Pal Karma Zurmang Shedup Chokhor Ling Lingdum Monastery. Return to your hotel in the evening to spend the night in Gangtok.

itinerary.title: Gangtok - Kalimpong
itinerary.description: After breakfast, you will head to Banjhakri Falls and Energy Park. Water falls from over 40 feet, cascading down with a lot of force, bringing water from the mountains higher up. Some places you will explore include the Research Institute of Tibetology, the Flower Exhibition Centre, the Directorate of Handicraft and Handloom, and the many flea markets. Later, check out of the hotel and head to Kalimpong. Check in to your hotel and spend the night in Kalimpong.

itinerary.title: Kalimpong - Darjeeling
itinerary.description: Today, spend the day exploring Kalimpong. Some of the attractions you will visit include Delo Park, Kalimpong Science Centre, Mangal Dham Temple, Pine View Nursery, Geden Tharpa Choling Monastery, Lepcha Museum, the Zang Dhok Palri Monastery, and the Durpin Monastery. Later in the evening, head to Darjeeling. Check in to the hotel and spend the night in Darjeeling.

itinerary.title: Darjeeling
itinerary.description: Today, you will explore Darjeeling. Some of the places you will explore include the Kanchendzonga Peak, Ghoom Monastery, Batasia Loop, the Padmaja Naidu Himalayan Zoological Park, the Japanese Temple, the Himalayan Mountaineering Institute, Tenzing, and Gombu Rock. Don’t miss riding the Darjeeling ropeway and the toy train to local places like Siliguri and Pankhabari. Spend the night in Darjeeling.

itinerary.title: Darjeeling Day 2
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head to the Mirik Lake, a beautiful lake with the enormous Kanchenjunga mountains in the backdrop. Spend time shopping in Pashupati Nagar and horse riding along Mirik Lake. Get back to Darjeeling to spend the night at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Depart Darjeeling
itinerary.description: Today, check out of the hotel and head to Bagdogra Airport to catch your flight home.

itinerary.title: Arrive In Gangtok
itinerary.description: Upon arriving at the Bagdogra Airport, our tour manager will welcome you and help you transfer to Gangtok. As you travel to Sikkim's capital, enjoy a panoramic view of the Kanchenjunga Mountain range. Check in to the hotel and spend the night in Gangtok.

itinerary.title: Gangtok Day Tour
itinerary.description: Today, you will explore Gangtok, a beautiful city famous for its natural beauty and amazing view of the Kanchenjunga Mountains. You will visit Baba Mandir, Tsomgo Lake, Hanuman Tok, Sikkim Himalayan Zoological Park, and Ganesh Tok. Spend the night in Gangtok.

itinerary.title: Gangtok - Darjeeling
itinerary.description: Today, you will continue with your Darjeeling tour, starting with a tour of the Ban Jhakri Falls. You will also cover Droul Chorthen, the Directorate of Handicraft and Handloom, the Flower Exhibition Centre, and the Research Institute of Tibetology. Later in the evening, check out of the hotel and head to Darjeeling to continue with the next leg of your trip. Check in to your hotel and spend the night in Darjeeling.

itinerary.title: Darjeeling Day Tour
itinerary.description: Today, you will explore Darjeeling, a beautiful hill station in West Bengal famous for its tea plantations. You will visit the Ghoom Monastery, the Japanese Temple, the Batasia Loop, and the Himalayan Mountaineering Institute. Don’t miss riding the ropeway in Darjeeling. Spend the night in Darjeeling.

itinerary.title: Darjeeling Day 2
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head to Mirik. The town is famous for the Mirik Lake, which is known for its pleasant climate, unparalleled beauty, and neighbouring forests. Return to Darjeeling in the evening.

itinerary.title: Depart Darjeeling
itinerary.description: Today, after breakfast, head to Bagdogra Airport to catch your return flight.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Gangtok
itinerary.description: Upon arriving at Bagdogra Airport, our tour manager will welcome you and help you transfer to Gangtok. The journey is marked by beautiful scenery, including a panoramic view of the Kanchenjunga Mountains. Check in to your hotel and spend the night in Gangtok.

itinerary.title: Gangtok Day Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast, get ready for a full-day tour of Gangtok. Some places you will visit include Baba Mandir, Hanuman Tok, Sikkim Himalayan Zoological Park, and Tshangu Lake. Return to your hotel to spend the night in Gangtok.

itinerary.title: Gangtok - Kalimpong
itinerary.description: Today, you will cover the remaining tourist attractions in Gangtok, including the Banjhakri Waterfalls, Do Drul Chorten, Ganesh Tok, Enchey Monastery, and the Namgyal Institute of Tibetology. Don’t miss riding the Gangtok ropeway. Later, check out of your hotel to proceed to Kalimpong. Check in to your hotel and spend the night in Kalimpong.

itinerary.title: Kalimpong - Darjeeling
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head out to explore Kalimpong. Some of the places you will explore today include the Delo Park, Kalimpong Science Centre, Mangal Dham Temple, Pine View Nursery, Geden Tharpa Choling Monastery, Lepcha Museum, and the Zang Dhok Palri Monastery. Later, check out of the hotel and head to Darjeeling. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Darjeeling.

itinerary.title: Darjeeling
itinerary.description: Today, you will explore Darjeeling. Some of the places you will explore today include Kanchendzonga Peak, Ghoom Monastery, Batasia Loop, Peace Pagoda, the Padmaja Naidu Himalayan Zoological Park, Japanese Temple, Tenzing, Gombu Rock, Tibetan Refugee Self-Help Centre, and a tour of the surrounding tea plantations. Don’t miss the ropeway ride in Darjeeling. Return to the hotel to spend the night in Darjeeling.

itinerary.title: Depart Darjeeling
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel and head to the Bagdogra Airport to catch the flight home.

itinerary.title: Arriving in Gangtok
itinerary.description: Upon arriving at Bagdogra Airport, our tour manager will welcome you and help you transfer to Gangtok. The journey takes around 4 to 5 hours and includes a panoramic view of the adjoining mountains. Check in to your hotel and spend the night in Gangtok.

itinerary.title: Gangtok Day Tour
itinerary.description: After a hearty breakfast, get ready for a tour of the city. You will cover Tshangu Lake, Hanuman Tok, Sikkim Himalayan Zoological Park, Ganesh Tok, and the Enchey Monastery. Return to your hotel in the evening to spend the night in Gangtok.

itinerary.title: Gangtok - Pelling
itinerary.description: Some places you will include Banjhakri Falls and Do Drul Chorten before heading to Pelling, a beautiful town at the height of 6800ft covered with thick forests and abundant wildlife. Check into the hotel and spend the rest of the evening enjoying the beautiful views of the surrounding scenery.

itinerary.title: Pelling
itinerary.description: Some of the places you will drive to Yuksom. On the way, visit Rimbi Waterfalls and the Darap Waterfalls. Some of the attractions in Yuksom include Dubdi Monastery, Kanchenjunga Waterfall, Khecheopalri Lake, Tashiding Monastery, Pemayangtse Monastery, and the Ralang Monastery. Return to Pelling to spend the night.

itinerary.title: Depart Pelling
itinerary.description: Today, you will depart Pelling and head to Siliguri to the Bagdogra Aiport to catch your flight home.

itinerary.title: Arrive In Bagdogra Airport
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at the Bagdogra Airport in Siliguri, our tour manager will welcome you and help you transfer to Gangtok. The journey takes 4 to 5 hours and offers a panoramic view of the Kanchenjunga Mountains. Check in to your hotel and spend the rest of the day exploring places around your hotel.

itinerary.title: Gangtok Full Day Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head out for a full-day tour of Gangtok. You will visit the Baba Mandir, Tshangu Lake, Hanuman Tok, Ganesh Tok, and the Sikkim Himalayan Zoological Park. Spend the evening shopping and enjoying local food before returning to your hotel.

itinerary.title: Gangtok Tour Day 2
itinerary.description: Today, you will cover attractions left out on Day 1. These include Ban Jhakri Falls, Do Drul Chorten, Pal Karma Zurmang Shedup Chokor Ling Lingdum Monastery and Enchey Monastery. Don’t miss riding the Gangtok ropeway for a panoramic view of the Gangtok City.

itinerary.title: Gangtok – Kalimpong
itinerary.description: After breakfast today, you will head to Kalimpong. You will visit Delo Park, Mangal Dham Temple, Kalimpong Science Centre, Pine View Nursery, Geden Tharpa Choling Monastery, Lepcha Museum, and the Zang Dhok Palri Monastery.

itinerary.title: Depart Gangtok
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel and head to Bagdogra Airport to catch your return flight home.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Gangtok
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at the Bagdogra Airport in Siliguri, our tour manager will welcome you and help you transfer to Gangtok. The journey takes 4 to 5 hours and offers a panoramic view of the Kanchenjunga Mountains. Check in to your hotel and spend the rest of the day relaxing or exploring places around your hotel.

itinerary.title: Gangtok Full Day Tour
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delectable breakfast before heading out for a full-day tour of Gangtok City. This picturesque city is famous for its monasteries, scenic beauty, and snow-laden mountains. Some places you will cover include – Hanuman Tok, Ganesh Tok, Rumtek Dharma Chakra Centre, and the Sikkim Himalayan Zoological Park. Return to your hotel in the evening to spend the night in Gangtok.

itinerary.title: Gangtok - Darjeeling
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel to continue touring attractions you missed yesterday. You will cover the Ban Jhakri Falls, Tsongmo Lake, Do Drul Chorten and the Enchey Monastery. Later in the day, head to Darjeeling to continue with the next leg of your journey. Check into the hotel and spend the rest of the day relaxing and exploring places around the hotel.

itinerary.title: Darjeeling
itinerary.description: Today, you will explore Darjeeling, including Tiger Hills, Batasia Loop, Japanese Peace Pagoda, Sandakphu, the Padmaja Naidu Himalayan Zoological Park, Rock Garden, and the Tea Garden Viewpoint. Don’t miss Tenzing Rock and the ropeway ride across tea plantations. Return to your hotel to spend the night in Darjeeling.

itinerary.title: Depart Darjeeling
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel and head to the Bagdogra Airport to catch your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Alleppey
itinerary.description: Upon arriving at Alleppey, check into the hotel and relax for some time. Later, you can enjoy a boat ride as it cruises along the backwaters. You will also experience the daily life of the locals as they go about their work. Enjoy a delectable lunch that includes the best of Kerala cuisine. After lunch, you will visit Alleppey Beach. Spend the night in Alleppey.

itinerary.title: Kochi - Wonderla
itinerary.description: On the second day, you will check out of the hotel and head to Kochi. You will visit Wonderla, India’s biggest water theme park, with over 51 rides. At the end of the day, head to Kochi to spend the night.

itinerary.title: Depart Kochi
itinerary.description: Today, you will check out of the hotel and head out to explore the city. You will cover Cherai Beach, Marine Drive, Jew Town, Mattancherry Palace, Hill Palace Museum, and the Lulu Mall. Later, head to your home with pleasant memories of the vacation.

itinerary.title: Arrival In Hyderabad
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at the Hyderabad airport/railway station, our tour manager will help you transfer to the hotel. Complete your check-in formalities and prepare for your city tour after a quick break. Today, you will cover Hyderabad’s iconic attractions, including Hussain Sagar Lake, Birla Temple, Sanjeevaiah Children’s Park, Lumbini Park, Necklace Road, NTR Garden, and Snow World. Get back to the hotel to spend the rest of the evening at rest.

itinerary.title: Ramoji Film City
itinerary.description: After a delectable breakfast, head out to the famous Ramoji Film City. This is one of the world’s largest film studios, covering around 1,666 acres and offering plenty of attractions, including luxury hotels, adventure rides, wedding venues, and wellness spas. You will enjoy a studio tour and the many rides and attractions within the studio.

itinerary.title: Hyderabad City Tour
itinerary.description: After your morning breakfast, get ready to continue with the final leg of your Hyderabad city tour. You will visit the Charminar monument and the bazaars surrounding the mosque, the Nehru Zoological Park, Makkah Masjid, and the Salarjung Museum. Spend the evening shopping or sampling some of Hyderabad’s delectable street food.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Bid adieu to Hyderabad to continue with the next leg of your journey, or head to the Hyderabad airport/ railway station to return home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Goa
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival in Goa, our tour representatives will greet you and help you get to your hotel. Once the check-in formalities are complete, freshen up and relax for a while. You can spend the rest of the day exploring some of the popular tourist attractions nearby. Get back to your hotel for a good night’s sleep.

itinerary.title: South Goa
itinerary.description: Enjoy a scrumptious breakfast before heading out to experience the beauty of South Goa. You will be taken to Shree Mangueshi Temple and the various churches in Old Goa. The last stop of the day will be Dona Paula, where you can engage in sunbathing, kayaking, scuba diving, and jet skiing.

itinerary.title: North Goa
itinerary.description: Once you get done with your breakfast, get ready to go around North Goa and stroll around its many beaches. Relish dolphin watching and then visit Aguada Fort, which is a 17th century well-preserved Portuguese fort. Get back to your hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: Depart Goa
itinerary.description: Have a filling breakfast and spend the rest of the day at leisure. Check out from your hotel in the afternoon and head to the airport or railway station to get back to your hometown.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Kochi
itinerary.description: Welcome to Kochi, a city that is known as the Queen of Arabian Sea. After you arrive at the Kochi International Airport, our tour manager will greet you and take you to your hotel. Once you complete the check-in formalities, you can relax for a bit before heading out for a day of sightseeing. The first stop of the day will be the Hill Palace Museum, which is the first ever heritage museum to exist in Kerala. The palace complex was built in 1865 and is made up of 49 buildings sprawled over an area of 54 acres. Get a view of the backwaters at Marine Drive before walking around Cherai Beach and experiencing the Chinese fishing nets. Come back to the hotel to spend the night.

itinerary.title: Wonderla
itinerary.description: After consuming a delicious breakfast, head to Wonderla, which is an amusement park spread over an area of 30 acres. Filled with over 50 thrilling rides, get ready for a day full of adrenaline rush. In the evening, you will be shifting to Trivandrum, the capital of Kerala, and staying the night at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Depart Trivandrum
itinerary.description: Before you head back to the airport, you will be taken to see some of the most popular spots in Trivandrum. Start off with the Padmanabhaswamy Temple, where you can pay your respects to Lord Vishnu. Head over to the Thiruvananthapuram Zoo, which is among the country’s oldest zoological gardens, before experiencing the Napier Museum and taking a stroll around Kovalam Beach. Later in the day, board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Wayanad
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival in Wayanad, our tour manager will help you transfer to the hotel and check in. Spend the rest of the day enjoying local attractions, including Edakkal Caves, Banasura Dam, and Muthunga Wildlife Sanctuary. Spend the night in Wayanad.

itinerary.title: Wayanad - Kochi
itinerary.description: Today, you will explore places you should have covered on the first day of your Wayanad tour, including Pookode Lake and Meenmutty Waterfalls. Later in the evening, head to Kochi by bus. The journey takes around 7 hours.

itinerary.title: Kochi
itinerary.description: Today, you will arrive in Kochi and check into the hotel to freshen up. Later, head to explore tourist attractions in Kochi, including the Mattancherry Palace, Marine Drive, and Hill Palace. Leave Kochi in the evening to return to your home.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Istanbul
itinerary.description: Arrive at Istanbul Ataturk Airport and transfer to your hotel. After check-in, take some time to relax and explore the local area. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Istanbul City Tour
itinerary.description: Enjoy a full-day city tour of Istanbul, visiting iconic landmarks such as the Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, Topkapi Palace, and the Grand Bazaar. Optional - Take a Bosporus Cruise to admire the city's stunning skyline and enjoy panoramic views. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Istanbul Free Day
itinerary.description: Spend the day at your leisure in Istanbul. You can visit additional attractions, go shopping, or indulge in the city's renowned culinary scene. Popular attractions in Istanbul include – Spice Market, Rumeli Fortress, Dolmabahce Palace, and Camlica Hill.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Check out from your Istanbul hotel and transfer to Istanbul Airport for your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Goa
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival in Goa, our tour manager will welcome you and guide you to the hotel. Complete check-in formalities and spend the rest of the day exploring places around the hotel. Spend the night in Goa.

itinerary.title: Explore North Goa
itinerary.description: After breakfast, you will head out for a sightseeing tour of North Goa. Some of the towns you will visit include Candolim, Mapusa, Panjim, Mardol, Vagator, and Anjuna. You will visit Fort Aguada in Candolim, Vagator Beach in Vagator, the Basilica of Bom Jesus in Old Goa, and the Mangueshi Temple in Mardol. Don’t miss Dona Paula, Miramar, and Margoa. Spend the night in North Goa.

itinerary.title: Explore South Goa
itinerary.description: After breakfast, explore Mormagoa, Sonauli, and Vasco da Gama. Some of the places you will visit include the Bondla Wildlife Sanctuary in Ponda, the Dudhsagar Falls, the Cotigao Wildlife Sanctuary, Colva Beach, Palolem Beach, and Se Cathedral. Return to the hotel for a relaxing evening.

itinerary.title: Depart Goa
itinerary.description: Check out of the hotel as you bid adieu to Goa and catch your return flight home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Kochi
itinerary.description: Welcome to Port City. Upon arrival to Kochi, our tour manager will welcome you and help you transfer to the hotel. Complete check-in procedures and spend some time relaxing. Later, you will visit local attractions like Mattancherry Palace, Chinese Fishing Nets, Jew Town, Hill Palace Museum, and Cherai Beach. Later, spend the evening exploring the Marine Drive promenade. You can also go for a cruise along the promenade.

itinerary.title: Wonderla
itinerary.description: Today, after breakfast, head to Wonderla, Asia’s largest water theme park. Later in the evening, bid farewell to Kochi and return to your home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Alleppey
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival in Alleppey, our tour representatives will greet you and help you get to your hotel. Get on a houseboat that will take you through a series of canals and lagoons. Sit back, relax, and enjoy some delicious food and the serene views all around you. After having your lunch, walk around Alleppey Beach. Spend the night at your hotel.

itinerary.title: Kochi - Wonderla
itinerary.description: On the second day of your trip, you will be moving from Alleppey to Kochi. After checking in to your hotel, head out to visit Wonderla, which is a part of the largest chain of amusement parks in India. Get on all the thrilling rides and give your family a day of fun and adventures. Return to your hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: Kochi - Cherai Beach - Marine Drive - Munnar
itinerary.description: On this day, visit some of the most popular tourist spots in Kochi. Walk around Cherai Beach, which is one of the most well-known beaches in the city. Explore Marine Drive, which offers numerous shopping options and stunning views. Enjoy a peaceful boat ride at this location. If you have time, visit Lulu Mall and engage in some retail therapy. Later in the evening, leave for Munnar and relish a relaxing night at your hotel.

itinerary.title: Rose Garden - Echo Point - Kundala Dam Lake - Mattupetty Dam - Depart Munnar
itinerary.description: The last day of your trip will be reserved to witness the best sightseeing spots that Munnar has to offer. Start off with Rose Garden, situated 3,500 feet above sea level and home to a wide variety of rises and seasonal tropical fruits. Head over to Echo Point, which is an ideal picnic spot and provides spectacular views of the lush greenery that surrounds the landmark. End the journey by visiting the Kundala Dam Lake and Mattupetty Dam. Later in the day, depart for the airport to board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Coimbatore - Chennai - Arrive in New Jalpaiguri
itinerary.description: Board the train from Coimbatore Junction Railway Station to reach New Jalpaiguri.

itinerary.title: New Jalpaiguri
itinerary.description: The second day of your trip will be reserved for your journey to New Jalpaiguri.

itinerary.title: New Jalpaiguri - Gangtok
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at New Jalpaiguri Railway Station, our tour representatives will greet you and help you get to your hotel. Once you complete the check-in formalities, you can spend the rest of the day at leisure. Spend the night at your hotel.

itinerary.title: Gangtok - Tsongmo Lake - Baba Mandir
itinerary.description: After having your breakfast, make your way to visit Tsongmo Lake, which is also known as Changgu Lake. It’s a glacial lake situated at a height of 3,753 metres which remains frozen throughout the winter season. The lake changes colours as the seasons go by, and is highly respected by the locals. End the day by visiting Baba Mandir, which was built to honour the memory of an Indian army soldier named Baba Harbhajan Singh who sacrificed his life while serving in the army. The temple is located at an altitude of 13,123 ft between Nathu La and Jelep La Pass. Get back to your hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: Gangtok - Darjeeling
itinerary.description: In the morning, proceed for a half-day tour of Gangtok. Start with the Banjhakri Falls and Energy Park, a recreation centre located next to an army camp. The concept of the theme park was created by Pawan Kumar Chamling, who was the Chief Minister of Sikkim. Next up is the Do Drul Chorten, a giant stupa that was constructed in 1945. Explore the Namgyal Institute of Tibetology, which contains a Tibetan library and museum and provides insight into Tibet. You will then be taken to the Directorate of Handicrafts & Handloom and Flower Exhibition Centre. By noon, you will be shifting from Gangtok to Darjeeling, and you can spend the night at your hotel.

itinerary.title: Darjeeling
itinerary.description: On the sixth day of your trip, you will be leaving early in the morning for Tiger Hill, where you can catch the most mesmerising sunrise. At this time, the peaks of Kanchenjunga shine bright, and you get a panoramic view of Mount Everest as well as Mount Kanchenjunga. On your way back, visit the Batasia Loop, which is a spiral railway that offers a gorgeous view of Mount Kanchenjunga and other snow-covered peaks. You will also be stopping by Ghoom Monastery, which is renowned for its statue of the Maitreya Buddha, standing 15 ft tall. Once you get back to your hotel to have breakfast, you can then head out to witness the other magical attractions of Darjeeling. Visit the Japanese Buddhist Temple, which was constructed under the guidance of a Buddhist monk from Japan named Nichidatsu Fujii. You absolutely can’t leave Darjeeling without witnessing its many tea estates. The other spots you will be covering on this day include the Himalayan Mountaineering Institute, Padmaja Naidu Himalayan Zoological Park, Tenzing and Gombu Rock, and the Tibetan Refugee Self-Help Centre. Get on a cable car ride from the Darjeeling Ropeway to get a spellbinding view of Darjeeling’s forests, waterfalls, rivers, tea gardens, and valleys.

itinerary.title: Darjeeling - Kolkata
itinerary.description: In the morning, leave for the New Jalpaiguri Railway Station to board a train to Kolkata.

itinerary.title: Kolkata - Botanical Garden - Kalighat Kali Temple
itinerary.description: After arriving in Kolkata, check-in at your hotel and enjoy a flavourful lunch. Once you’re done with your meal, you can head out for a half-day tour of the City of Joy. The first place you will be visiting is the revered Kalighat Kali Temple, which is among the holiest of the 51 Shakti Peethas. Dedicated to Goddess Kali, the present form of the temple is said to be about 200 years old. You will get to lay your eyes on Vidyasagar Setu, which is also known as the Second Hooghly Bridge. Make your way to the Botanical Garden, an open museum with an impressive collection of plants, herbs, climbers, shrubs, lianas, and so on. Sprawled over an area of 109 hectares, it is home to over 12,000 specimens of rare plants. Get back to your hotel for a relaxing night.

itinerary.title: Kolkata City Tour - Belur Math - Dakshineswar Kali Temple - Victoria Memorial - Indian Museum
itinerary.description: On the ninth day of your trip, you will be visiting some of the most beloved touristy spots in Kolkata. Start off with Belur Math, which is situated on the west bank of the Hooghly River. Founded by Swami Vivekananda, it serves as the headquarters of Ramakrishna Math and the Ramakrishna Mission. Visit Rabindra Bharati University, where you can learn further about the life of Rabindranath Tagore. Next, you will be taken to Dalhousie Square, an area that has remnants of the British colonial era. You can visit Raj Bhavan, Kolkata High Court, Kolkata Town Hall, General Post Office, and Writers' Building. Explore Victoria Memorial, which was built as a dedication to Queen Victoria. Finish off the day by visiting the Indian Museum, which is reputed to be the ninth oldest museum in the world. It is also Asia’s largest and oldest museum.

itinerary.title: Depart Kolkata
itinerary.description: On the final day of your trip, enjoy a delicious breakfast at your hotel and get some shopping done. Later in the day, depart for the railway station to board your train back home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Kochi
itinerary.description: Upon arriving at Kochi, our tour manager will welcome you and help you transfer to the hotel. Freshen up and get ready for a city tour. You will visit Mattancherry Palace, Fort Kochi, Lulu Mall, Jew Town, Hill Palace Museum, and Cherai Beach. In the evening, head to Marine Drive, a famous promenade that looks scenic, thanks to the street lights. You can also go on an evening cruise along the Vembanad Lake on Marine Drive. Spend the night in Kochi.

itinerary.title: Wonderla
itinerary.description: Today, you will check out of the hotel and head to Wonderla, India’s first water theme park with over 50 rides. Later, head to Munnar by road. The distance takes around 3 hours and is absolutely scenic. Check into the hotel and spend the night in Munnar.

itinerary.title: Munnar
itinerary.description: Today, after a delicious breakfast that includes appam, idiyappam, and other Kerala delicacies, head out for a full-day tour of Munnar. You will visit Rose Garden, Echo Point, Kundala Lake, Mattupetty Dam, and the Eravikulam National Park. Head back home in the evening, bidding adieu to Kerala and your vacation.

packages.name: Explore Turks and Caicos Tour Package Itinerary

images.alt_text: Explore Turks and Caicos Tour Package Itinerary
Explore Turks and Caicos Tour Package Itinerary

itinerary.title: Arrival in Providenciales (Turks and Caicos)
itinerary.description: Welcome to the beautiful Turks & Caicos Islands. This British Overseas Territory comprises the larger Caicos Islands and the smaller Turks Islands, located in the Lucayan Archipelago of the Atlantic Ocean and the northern West Indies. Upon your arrival, you will be transferred to your hotel, marking the beginning of your wonderful journey.

itinerary.title: Providenciales – Optional Sunset Tour
itinerary.description: Experience the beauty of Providenciales in the enchanting evening light with this safari-style sunset tour. You won't have to worry about directions or navigation thanks to the convenient hotel pickup. Instead, you can fully appreciate the scenery on your journey to Sapodila Beach, where you can partake in a guided swimming and exploration adventure. Your guide will provide insightful commentary, allowing you to delve deeper into the island's history and culture than you would when exploring independently.

itinerary.title: Providenciales Tour
itinerary.description: Experience the beauty of Providenciales with a sightseeing tour that includes a visit to The Conch Farm. During this excursion, you'll explore various stunning beaches and enjoy a refreshing Rum Punch. Your adventure will also take you to notable attractions like The Hole and the Conch Farm, where your entry is included. Plus, you'll have the pleasure of savouring the delectable cuisine at "Da Conch Shack," featuring a seafood platter. Throughout the tour, keep your camera ready for fantastic photo opportunities on Blue Mountain, and if you're up for it, there are snorkelling spots at Sapodilla.

itinerary.title: Providenciales – Optional: Sunset Cruise Tour
itinerary.description: For adults seeking a more relaxed evening, consider the optional Sunset Cruise Tour. Set sail on a spacious catamaran off Grace Bay, and delight in the serene beauty of a Caribbean sunset. Raise a glass of Champagne and unwind during this 2-hour excursion, which includes convenient hotel pickup and drop-off. As you gently rock on the tranquil waters, indulge in delicious snacks, including fresh conch fritters from a local restaurant. You can toast to the breathtaking surroundings with a choice of wine, Champagne, rum punch, or soft drinks.

itinerary.title: Providenciales – Half-Day Cruise with Snorkeling
itinerary.description: On this day, you will embark on a memorable half-day cruise from Providenciales. This enchanting journey combines a relaxing cruise along the world-renowned Grace Bay beach on the north shore of Providenciales with exhilarating activities. Your first stop takes you to the TCI barrier reef, the third-largest reef system in the world. Here, you'll have the chance to gear up and partake in snorkelling, immersing yourself in one of the most pristine and untouched underwater realms on the planet. The vibrant marine life and crystal-clear waters will captivate your senses. Following the snorkelling adventure, the captain will guide you to the south side of the islands. There, the first mate will embark on a quest to find wild conch, offering a glimpse into the local traditions of the Turks and Caicos Islands. Your journey continues as the captain steers you towards one of the TCI cays. Here, a delicious lunch will be served, and you'll have the opportunity to explore this uninhabited island, taking in its unspoiled beauty and tranquillity.

itinerary.title: Depart Providenciales
itinerary.description: Today, you will bid farewell to Providenciales. After checking out of your hotel, you will arrange your transfer to the airport, where you can catch your flight back home or onwards to your next destination. It's time to carry with you the cherished memories of your wonderful journey.

packages.name: Discover Jamaica: A 6-Day Caribbean Adventure with Our Tour Packages
packages.destination: Montego Bay - Negril - Ys Falls - Appleton Estate

images.alt_text: Discover Jamaica: A 6-Day Caribbean Adventure with Our Tour Packages
Discover Jamaica: A 6-Day Caribbean Adventure with Our Tour Packages

itinerary.title: Arrival in Montego Bay
itinerary.description: As you touch down in Montego Bay, you'll be greeted by the enchanting spirit of the Caribbean. A Jamaican vacation offers the perfect escape to an island paradise, where the melodic tunes of Bob Marley fill the air, and where sandy beaches, sunshine, rich culture, tropical fruits, and coconuts provide a taste of heaven. Upon your arrival, we'll arrange for your transfer to the hotel. You'll spend the night at your Montego Bay accommodation.

itinerary.title: Montego Bay
itinerary.description: Today, a picturesque tour awaits you along the North Coast, with a visit to Columbus Park, an open-air museum that offers the chance to pick up some delightful souvenirs in Ocho Rios. Your journey along Jamaica's stunning north coast will take us past Falmouth, a charming fishing village, before arriving at Discovery Bay, where Christopher Columbus first set foot on Jamaican soil in 1494. You'll also have the opportunity for shopping in the lovely town of Ocho Rios. Make sure to experience the wonder of Dunn's River Falls, where you can ascend this extraordinary creation of Mother Nature. Scale the 600-foot limestone rock formation as water flows around you, plunging into the ocean below—a truly unforgettable experience! Your day will end with an overnight stay at your Montego Bay hotel.

itinerary.title: Montego Bay to Negril
itinerary.description: After enjoying your breakfast, we will arrange for your transfer to Negril, a stunning Caribbean beach destination that attracts visitors from all over. Today is your day to unwind on the pristine white sandy beaches and bask in the warm sunshine. You will spend the night at the Negril hotel.

itinerary.title: Negril to YS Falls
itinerary.description: Today, get ready for an exciting adventure as we take you to the enchanting YS Falls. YS Falls is one of Jamaica's most exquisite natural attractions, offering a chance to immerse yourself in the beauty of a series of untouched and unspoiled waterfalls on the South Coast of Jamaica. These falls consist of seven cascading waterfalls, some of which flow into natural pools, all set amidst lush gardens. Your experience begins with a short open-air jitney ride through the picturesque Jamaican countryside, passing by lush vegetation and rushing rivers along the way. As you complete your brief journey, you'll be greeted by a breathtaking natural setting, complete with well-designed ecological structures, recreational areas, a natural spring pool, and the seven stunning tiers of the majestic YS Falls. You can follow the beautifully crafted wooden walkways to reach the top of the falls, where you can enjoy a refreshing dip in the crystal-clear natural pools. After this exciting adventure, you will return to your Negril hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: Negril - Appleton Estate Tour
itinerary.description: Today, we're off to Appleton Estate for a delightful experience. Upon arrival, you'll be greeted with a refreshing Appleton rum punch. Watch the resident donkey showcase how they extracted juice from sugar cane back in the 18th century. Explore the Distillery and Ageing House, where they'll demonstrate the various methods of distillation. You'll even have the chance to get involved in the traditional sugar cane crushing process and taste freshly squeezed cane juice and molasses. For lunch, indulge in a genuine Jamaican-style meal. The day's adventure concludes with a visit to the Appleton lounge, where you can sample a variety of delicious rums. Tonight, you'll spend the night at your hotel in Negril.

itinerary.title: Depart Negril
itinerary.description: It's time to bid farewell to Negril. Check out from your hotel and proceed to the airport for your flight to your next destination or back home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Pondicherry
itinerary.description: On arrival at Pondicherry, our tour manager will welcome you and help you transfer to the hotel. Later, after some rest, head out to explore Auroville. Later, you will explore Pondicherry’s major tourist attractions, including Manakula Vinayagar Temple, Sacred Heart Basilica, and the Panchavati Anjaneya Temple. Later in the evening, you will explore Pondicherry’s beaches, including Rock Beach, Serenity Beach, and Paradise Beach.

itinerary.title: Pondicherry Day 2
itinerary.description: After breakfast, you will explore some of Pondicherry’s top spots you may have missed yesterday. These include the Pondicherry Museum, Chunnambar Boat House, Nehru Street for shopping, and the Botanical Gardens. Later in the evening, bid adieu to Pondicherry and return to your home town.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Chennai
itinerary.description: Upon arriving in Chennai, our tour representatives will greet you and help you reach your hotel. Once you finish the check-in formalities, you can freshen up and relax for a while before venturing out to explore Chennai. The first stop for the day will be Valluvar Kottam, a historical monument which was built in honour of poet, saint, and philosopher, Thiruvalluvar. Next up is Guindy National Park, a protected area covering 22 acres which was inaugurated by Jawaharlal Nehru in 1959. You will also be visiting Marina Beach and the town of Mahabalipuram which is home to the Group of Monuments at Mahabalipuram that are a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

itinerary.title: Depart Chennai
itinerary.description: After enjoying a scrumptious breakfast, relish the serenity of Edward Elliot's Beach. Our tour representative will take you to explore Arignar Anna Zoological Park or Vandalur Zoo, one of the largest zoos in Southeast Asia. Indulge in some shopping in the evening before making your way back to your hometown.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Kanyakumari
itinerary.description: On arrival at Kanyakumari, check into the hotel and spend some time relaxing. Later, head out for sightseeing. Some places you will cover include Padmanabhapuram Palace, Adi Keshavaperumal Temple, Tiruparappu Waterfalls, Nagaraja Temple, Mathoor Aqueduct, and the Chitharal Rock Temple. Later in the evening, return to Kanyakumari to watch the sunset at Sunset Point.

itinerary.title: Kanyakumari Day 2
itinerary.description: Start Day 2 of your tour with a visit to the Bhagavathi Amman Temple and catch a glimpse of the mesmerising sunrise. Later, you will visit the Vivekananda Rock and the Thiruvalluvar Statue. Later, you will visit the Suchindrum Temple and bid farewell to Kanyakumari as you return home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Kodaikanal
itinerary.description: Arrive in Kodaikanal in the early morning to check into your hotel. Freshen up before assimilating for breakfast. Later, you will explore the beautiful mountains and surrounding villages. You will visit Silver Falls, Chettiar Park, Byrant Park, the Kurinji Andavar Temple, and Coakers Walk. Don’t miss the Guna Caves and the Pine Forests. Later in the evening, visit the Kodaikanal Lake for a boat ride. Don’t miss shopping at the little stalls surrounding the lake to buy chocolates, exotic fruits, avocadoes, and handicrafts at the Tibetan stalls.

itinerary.title: Kodaikanal
itinerary.description: Today, you will explore the local villages in and around Kodaikanal. You will visit Sunset Point, the Pillar Rocks Road, and the Vattakanal Waterfalls. Return to your home with beautiful memories of your Kodaikanal tour.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Ooty
itinerary.description: As you arrive to this quaint hill station, our tour manager will welcome you and help you transfer to the hotel. Some of the places you will visit include the Rose Garden, the Botanical Garden, the St. Stephen’s Church, the Murugan Temple at Elk Hill, Dodabetta Peak, Tea Plantations, and Pykara Falls. Return to your hotel in the evening to enjoy a warm campfire on the resort.

itinerary.title: Ooty Day 2
itinerary.description: Today, you will continue exploring Ooty, covering places you missed yesterday. These include the Mudumalai Wildlife Sanctuary, Emerald Lake, and Avalanche Lake. Don’t forget activities like horse riding, cycling, and shooting. In the evening, bid farewell to Ooty before heading to your home.

itinerary.title: Delhi - Naukuchiatal
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival in Delhi, our tour manager will welcome you and drive you to Naukuchiatal, a small hill station famous for its pristine beauty and adventure activities. The journey takes around 7 hours and is breathtakingly beautiful. Check into the hotel and spend some time relaxing. Later, you can enjoy a boat ride on the Naukuchiatal Lake. Spend the night at a hotel in Naukuchiatal.

itinerary.title: Nainital Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head out for a tour of Nainital. Some of the places you will cover include Bhimtal Lake, Sattal Lake, Lake Naini, and the Naina Devi Temple. Return to your hotel for dinner and spend the night in Nainital.

itinerary.title: Naukuchiatal – Mukteshwar
itinerary.description: Today, you will drive to Mukteshwar via Bhowali. You will also visit Ram Garh on the way. In Mukteshwar, you will visit Chauli ki Jali, Mukteshwar Temple, and the Bhalugaad Waterfall. Spend the night in Mukteshwar.

itinerary.title: Mukteshwar – Binsar
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of your hotel and head to Binsar, a hill station in the Almora District. The hill station is believed for its beauty and landscape and is frequented by birdwatchers and nature lovers. Spend the evening enjoying the sunset from Binsar.

itinerary.title: Binsar Full Day Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head to explore Binsar. You will visit the Binsar Wildlife Sanctuary and the Bineshwar Mahadev Temple, believed to have been built in the 9th or 10th century. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Binsar.

itinerary.title: Binsar - Ranikhet
itinerary.description: Today, you will check out of the hotel in Binsar and head to Ranikhet. The journey takes around 2 hours and is loved for its scenic views. Upon arrival, check into the hotel and relax for some time. Later, you can enjoy a delicious Pahari lunch. You will visit the Ranikhet Golf Ground, Kumaon Regimental Centre, Haidakhan Babaji Temple, Jhula Devi Temple, and Mankameshwar Temple. Spend the evening shopping at Mall Road.

itinerary.title: Ranikhet - Delhi
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of your hotel and head to Delhi. From there, you are free to catch your train or flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Singapore - Indian National Army Monument - Singapore Zoo
itinerary.description: After you land in Singapore, our tour representatives will greet you at the airport and take you to the hotel. Once you have checked in and freshened up, we will meet you at the appointed hour to begin your amazing trip. The first stop of your historic trip is the Indian National Army Monument at the Esplanade Park on Connaught Drive in Downtown Singapore. The war memorial was established on 8th July 1945. After this, take your family to the Singapore Zoo, where you meet with over 4200 animals face-to-face.

itinerary.title: Sentosa Island Tour
itinerary.description: If you want to spend an entire day at one place that will give you the best of both worlds, you must visit Sentosa Islands. Choose from a range of activities available at the spot – from riding a cable car at the Skyline Luge and Skyride to dolphin watching at Dolphin Island.

itinerary.title: Universal Studios – Chinatown
itinerary.description: The third day of your trip includes plenty of excitement, an adrenaline rush, and endless fun. We’ll take you to Universal Studios, where you can enjoy thrilling rides such as the Battlestar Galactica and reminisce about your childhood through the movies you watched. Later in the evening, head to Chinatown to taste some delicious oriental dishes and shop for souvenirs.

itinerary.title: Depart from Singapore
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Colombo
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at the Colombo International Airport, our tour manager will welcome and guide you to the hotel. Complete the check-in formalities and spend some time relaxing in the hotel. Later, head to the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage to spend quality time with the elephants. The Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage was opened in 1975 to provide shelter to baby elephants abandoned by poaching, hunting, or deforestation. Visitors can learn firsthand how the centre cares for these animals and enjoy watching them bathe in the nearby river. You can also feed the elephants if you visit them during their feeding time, which is from 9.15 a.m. to 9.45 a.m. and from 14.15 p.m. to 14.45 p.m. Later, head to Kandy, which is about two hours from Pinnawala. Check into your hotel and spend the rest of the day exploring the area. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Kandy.

itinerary.title: Kandy City Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head out to explore Kandy City. This medieval city has several cultural and historical attractions, including the Temple of the Tooth Relic, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Begin your Kandy city tour with a visit to the Sri Dalada Maligawa, or the Temple of the Tooth Relic, which is believed to hold a tooth of the Buddha. Every year, Buddhists celebrate the Kandy Esala Perahara, an annual procession in which the sacred tooth is paraded on a majestic elephant adorned with a majestic golden casket. Other attractions in Kandy include the Royal Botanical Gardens, the Bahirawakanda Temple, Kandy Lake, and the Ceylon Tea Museum. The Royal Botanical Garden was founded in 1371 and was once only allowed to royalty. The garden has thousands of flora and fauna, including orchids, bamboo, weeping figs, and an extensive spice garden. The Botanical Garden is also home to the exclusive coco de mer, the world’s largest seed, popularly called double coconut. Spend the night in Kandy.

itinerary.title: Kandy – Colombo
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel and head to Colombo. The drive takes around 4 hours and is very scenic. Check into your Colombo hotel to spend the rest of the evening at leisure. Some attractions you will visit in the capital city include the Viharamadevi Temple, Kelaniya Raja Maha Vihariya, and the Cathedral of St Lucia. Don’t miss the Pettah market to shop for unique souvenirs, including handcrafted masks, porcelain tableware, Ceylon tea, and the BMICH to see the replica of the Avukana Budda statue. Spend the night at a Colombo hotel.

itinerary.title: Colombo Day Two
itinerary.description: Today, after breakfast, you will spend the day shopping at the many street markets and malls in Colombo. You can buy gemstones, Ceylon tea, spices, wooden masks, handloom textiles, and even saris in Sri Lanka. Some of the best places for shopping include Pettah Market, Galle Face Green Fair, Liberty Plaza, and the Arcade Independence Square.

itinerary.title: Depart Colombo
itinerary.description: Bid adieu to Sri Lanka as you check out of the hotel and head to the Colombo International Airport to catch your flight home.

itinerary.title: Arrive In Colombo
itinerary.description: Welcome to Ceylon! Upon arriving at the Bandaranaike International Airport, our tour manager will guide you to the hotel and help you with transfer formalities. After a few hours of rest, you can either head to the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage or go directly to Kandy. The Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage was established in 1975 to help abandoned elephants. Visitors can spend time with the elephants in the sanctuary, feeding them, helping them bathe, and watching them as they go about their daily lives. Kandy is Sri Lanka’s last capital, which fell into the British Empire. It is home to the Temple of the Tooth, which is believed to house the tooth of Lord Buddha. Sri Lankans celebrate Esala Perahara, an annual festival where the tooth is paraded through the streets on the back of an elephant. It is also home to beautiful tea estates and the Knuckles Mountain Range, which is listed in the UNESCO Natural World Heritage list. Check into a luxury hotel to spend the night in Kandy.

itinerary.title: Kandy – Nuwara Eliya
itinerary.description: After breakfast, proceed to Nuwara Eliya, a lush and green city surrounded by tea estates, waterfalls, and lakes. It is believed that Nuwara Eliya was Ravana's capital and that Sita was kept captive in Sita Eliya. You will visit the Ramboda Falls, Sri Baktha Hanuman Temple, Hakgala Botanical Garden, Devon Falls, and the Horton Plains National Park. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Nuwara Eliya.

itinerary.title: Nuwara Eliya - Colombo
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel and proceed to Colombo. It is Sri Lanka’s cultural and judicial capital. You will visit Lotus Tower, the National Museum of Colombo, the Sri Lanka Planetarium, Viharamahadevi Park, Gangaramaya Temple, and the Pettah Floating Market. Enjoy shopping at the Arcade Independence Square and the Pettah Market in the evening to buy spices, tea, traditional masks, antiques, gems, and batik items. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Colombo.

itinerary.title: Depart Colombo
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head to the Colombo International Airport to catch your return flight home.

packages.name: Essential United Kingdom
packages.destination: Edinburgh - Inverness - Glasgow - Windermere - Cardiffs - London

itinerary.title: Arrival in Edinburgh
itinerary.description: Arrive in Edinburgh, the capital of Scotland. Check into your hotel and take some time to rest or explore the city at your leisure. Visit popular attractions near your hotel, go shopping, or spend the day relaxing.

itinerary.title: Edinburgh Full-Day Tour
itinerary.description: Spend the day exploring the many local attractions, including Edinburgh Castle, Royal Mile, and Holyrood Palace. You’ll also explore the mesmerizing Highlands, visiting Glencoe, Great Glen, Fort Augustus, Grampian Mountains, and Highland Perthshire. We’ll entertain you throughout the journey with legendary stories about the Jacobites and the mythical Loch Ness monster. Some of the other places we’ll cover in your Edinburgh tour include The National Museum of Scotland, St. Giles' Cathedral, and the beautiful Royal Botanic Garden. You can enjoy a traditional Scottish dinner with a lively ceilidh performance in the evening. Stay overnight at a luxury hotel in Edinburgh.

itinerary.title: Edinburgh to Inverness
itinerary.description: Leave Edinburgh and travel to Inverness, known as the gateway to the Scottish Highlands. En route, you can stop at attractions like Loch Ness, where you can try to spot the legendary Loch Ness Monster. Arrive in Inverness, check into your hotel, and spend the rest of the day exploring Inverness. Stay overnight at a luxury hotel in Inverness.

itinerary.title: Inverness – Full-Day Hop On Hop Off Tour
itinerary.description: Explore Inverness, visiting sites such as Inverness Castle and St. Andrews Cathedral. You’ll start your Hop On Hop Off tour of Inverness with a glimpse of old streets like Castle and Kirk. You’ll also visit Abertarff House, Highland Archive Centre, Tomnahurich Hill, and the Caledonian Canal. Take a boat tour of Loch Ness to admire the stunning scenery and perhaps catch a glimpse of Nessie. You can visit the Culloden Battlefield in the afternoon, where the Jacobite Rising ended. End your tour with a visit to the Southside of Inverness Castle, General Wades Road, Bellfield Park, and Holm Mills shopping village. Spend your night at a luxury hotel in Inverness.

itinerary.title: Inverness to Glasgow
itinerary.description: Depart Inverness and travel to Glasgow, Scotland's largest city. Upon arrival, take a guided city tour to see highlights like the Glasgow Cathedral, George Square, and the Riverside Museum. Spend the evening exploring the vibrant nightlife and entertainment options in the city.

itinerary.title: Glasgow to Windermere
itinerary.description: Leave Scotland and travel south to Windermere, located in England's beautiful Lake District. Enjoy the picturesque scenery as you drive through the countryside. Arrive in Windermere and take a leisurely boat ride on Lake Windermere, the largest lake in England.

itinerary.title: Windermere to Cardiff
itinerary.description: Leave Windermere and journey to Cardiff, the capital city of Wales. Upon arrival, visit Cardiff Castle, an impressive medieval fortification in the city's heart. Explore the Cardiff Bay area, home to the Wales Millennium Centre and various restaurants and shops. Don’t miss Mermaid Quay, Cardiff Barrage, Techniquest, and the beautiful Alexandra Gardens. Cardiff is famous for its shopping centers and popular high-street stores. When in Cardiff, don’t miss the prestigious Victorian and Edwardian arcades, full of designer boutiques, cafes, arts and crafts shops, specialist food shops, and music shops.

itinerary.title: Cardiff Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Spend the day exploring Cardiff further. Visit the National Museum Cardiff, which houses a wide range of art and historical exhibitions. You can also explore the city's Victorian shopping arcades and enjoy a stroll through Bute Park.

itinerary.title: Cardiff to London
itinerary.description: Leave Cardiff and travel to London, the bustling capital of England. Upon arrival, take a panoramic city tour to see iconic landmarks such as Buckingham Palace, Big Ben, and the Tower of London. In the evening, you can explore the vibrant neighborhoods of London, such as Covent Garden or Soho.

itinerary.title: London Full-Day Tour
itinerary.description: Spend the day exploring London's numerous attractions on a Hop On Hop Off tour. Some attractions here include the British Museum, Tower Bridge, the Houses of Parliament, Westminster Abbey, Madame Tussauds, and Leicester Square. Make sure you don’t miss a ride on the London Eye for a panoramic view of the city. Enjoy shopping on Oxford Street or explore vibrant markets like Camden Market or Borough Market. You can also choose a cruise on the Thames for a riverside view of famous landmarks like Big Ben, St Paul’s Cathedral, Shakespeare’s Globe, and Tower Bridge.

itinerary.title: Departure from London
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and depart from London, concluding your Scotland and London tour.

itinerary.title: Arrival & Half-Day Tour Of London
itinerary.description: Arrive in London and check into your hotel. Start your day with a visit to the iconic British Museum. Explore its vast collection of historical artifacts and art from around the world. Afterward, head to Covent Garden, a vibrant area filled with street performers, boutique shops, and charming cafes. Enjoy lunch at one of the many restaurants in the area. Take a stroll along the South Bank of the River Thames. Visit Shakespeare's Globe Theatre and the Tate Modern art gallery. Cross the Millennium Bridge to reach St. Paul's Cathedral. Marvel at its stunning architecture and climb to the top for panoramic city views. Enjoy dinner at a traditional British pub nearby. Explore the vibrant nightlife in the West End. Catch a musical or play in one of the famous theaters like the Royal Opera House or the Theatre Royal Drury Lane.

itinerary.title: Full-Day Tour Of London
itinerary.description: Start your day with a Hop On Hop Off tour of the city. The tour includes a Thames River cruise for a riverside view of the famous historical buildings Some of the places we’ll cover include the Tower of London. We’ll take you on a guided tour to learn about its fascinating history and see the Crown Jewels. Walk across Tower Bridge and explore the nearby attractions like the HMS Belfast, a retired Royal Navy warship turned museum. Enjoy a quick lunch in the Borough Market, known for its diverse food stalls offering delicious international cuisine. Head to Buckingham Palace to watch the Changing of the Guard ceremony. From there, stroll through Green Park and continue to Piccadilly Circus, known for its vibrant billboards and shopping opportunities. Visit the National Gallery in Trafalgar Square and admire its extensive art collection, including masterpieces by renowned artists. Walk through the picturesque neighborhood of Covent Garden again and have dinner at a trendy restaurant. Optionally, you can catch a show in the West End or explore the nightlife in Soho or Camden Town.

itinerary.title: Final Day & Departure
itinerary.description: Visit the iconic British landmarks of Big Ben, the Houses of Parliament, and Westminster Abbey. Take some time to explore the area and capture memorable photos. Take a relaxing boat ride along River Thames to see famous landmarks such as the London Eye, the Shard, and Tower Bridge from a different perspective. Explore the vibrant street of Oxford Street for some shopping or visit the high-end department stores of Harrods or Selfridges. If you're interested in art and history, visit the Victoria and Albert Museum or the Natural History Museum in South Kensington. Enjoy a farewell dinner at a restaurant of your choice or visit a traditional London pub for a pint of beer. Take your flight back home or move on to the next leg of your journey.

packages.name: Abu Dhabi Getaway
packages.destination: Abu Dhabi City Tour - Yas Water World - Warner Bros - Louvre Museum - Ferrari World

itinerary.title: Yas Waterworld - Marina Mall
itinerary.description: After you land in Abu Dhabi, you will be greeted by our tour representatives, who will take you to the hotel. Once you have checked in and freshened up, you can enjoy a relaxing lunch at the hotel’s dining area before heading out for the first day of sightseeing. Head to Yas Waterworld, one of the most exciting spots in UAE, owing to its numerous fun activities and 40 epic rides. In the evening, get set for some retail therapy at Marina Mall, where you can shop your heart out.

itinerary.title: Warner Bros. World - Saadiyat Public Beach
itinerary.description: Your second day in Abu Dhabi is equally fun, thanks to Warner Bros., the world’s largest indoor theme park. You can enjoy the park’s multiple rides and spectacular shows and shop and dine at the park’s numerous retail outlets. Later in the day, visit the Saadiyat Public Beach and relish its peaceful ambience.

itinerary.title: Louvre - Ferrari World
itinerary.description: Lovers of art and culture will have a grand time walking around Louvre in Abu Dhabi, packed with its galleries and exhibitions. End the day by experiencing the excitement of the world’s first Ferrari-themed park at Ferrari World.

itinerary.title: Depart from Abu Dhabi
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

packages.name: Adventure Desert Safari Tour
packages.destination: Dubai - Burj Khalifa - Desert Safari - Wild Wadi Water Park

itinerary.title: Arrive at Dubai – Miracle Garden - Bollywood Park
itinerary.description: Once you land in Dubai, you will be greeted by our tour representatives, who will take you to your hotel. After you check in and freshen up, you can have lunch at the hotel’s dining area before heading out to begin your Middle Eastern holiday. Your first stop will be Miracle Garden, the world's most extensive natural flower garden, which houses more than 150 million flowers. After this, you can head to Bollywood Park, the perfect place for couples who’ve spent their lives romanticizing Bollywood movies. Attractions include exciting rides, movie-based rides, theme-based restaurants, and souvenir shops.

itinerary.title: Burj Khalifa - Jumeirah Beach – Dubai Mall
itinerary.description: The second day of your trip will begin by witnessing the marvellous Burj Khalifa, the tallest building in the world. Besides enjoying a live fountain show from the building’s observation decks, you can also soak in the breathtaking view of the city. You can dine at the world’s highest restaurant or relax at the luxurious Armani Spa. After this, you can take a stroll and breathe in the blue hues of the calm waters of Jumeirah Beach. End your day by shopping at the many luxury brands at the fabulous Dubai Mall.

itinerary.title: Desert Safari
itinerary.description: Your trip to Dubai cannot be complete without having experienced the magic of the desert and everything it offers. GT Holidays arranges desert safari packages that include belly dance performances, camel rides, and dune bashing. You could also enjoy a BBQ meal at night while soaking in the starlit sky from the desert. Relish the delicious local cuisine, sip on Arabic coffee, and spend a night under the twinkling stars blanketed over the dark sky.

itinerary.title: Wild Wadi Waterpark
itinerary.description: We all wish to de-stress and let our hair down during vacations, and that’s exactly what we have prepared for you before you leave Dubai. It’s time to experience the excitement of the Wild Wadi Waterpark, a fun outdoor water park loved by kids and adults alike.

itinerary.title: Depart from Dubai
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

packages.name: Dubai City Tour Package
packages.destination: Dubai - Dubai City Tour - Desert Safari

itinerary.title: Arrive at Dubai – Dubai Mall - Dhow Cruise
itinerary.description: Once you land in Dubai, you will be greeted by our tour representatives, who will take you to your hotel. After you check in and freshen up, you can begin your trip to the Middle East. How about some retail therapy to commence this journey? Browse through the numerous luxury brands and shop your heart out. Head over to Dubai Mall, which proves why Dubai is every shopaholic’s dream come true. In the evening, dress up for the dhow cruise, the ideal mixture of natural beauty and adventures, sailing around the city and mesmerizing you with its many stunning views.

itinerary.title: Miracle Garden - Burj Khalifa - Jumeirah Beach
itinerary.description: The second day of your Middle Eastern holiday will begin with a visit to the Miracle Garden, which houses over 150 million flowers and is the world’s largest natural flower garden. Next comes the architectural beauty of the Burj Khalifa, the world’s tallest building. You can ride up to the observation deck for a spectacular view of the whole city. As the final part of your day, stroll along Jumeirah Beach to soak in the city’s beautiful skyline.

itinerary.title: Desert Safari
itinerary.description: Your trip to Dubai is incomplete without experiencing the city’s desert safari. We arrange desert safaris, helping our guests experience the thrill of dune bashing, camel rides, and delicious local cuisine. You can sip coffee like the Arabs or enjoy a smoking barbecue with the vast desert as the backdrop and spend the night under the glittering stars.

itinerary.title: Depart from Dubai
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

packages.name: Alluring Dubai
packages.destination: Dubai City Tour - Dragon Mart for Shopping - Desert Safari - Dhow Cruise - Bollywood Park

itinerary.title: Arrive at Dubai – Miracle Garden - Jumeirah Beach
itinerary.description: After you land in Dubai, you will be greeted by our tour representatives to take you to the hotel. Once you have checked in and freshened up, you can enjoy a relaxing lunch within the hotel’s dining area before heading out for the initial round of sightseeing. Your first stop is the Miracle Garden. This is the world’s largest natural flower garden and home to over 150 million flowers, covering over 72,000 square meters. Next, it’s time to breathe in the beautiful blues of Jumeirah Beach while you stroll and enjoy a serene evening.

itinerary.title: Bollywood Park – Burj Khalifa
