itinerary.description: Bollywood fans, rejoice because the second day of your trip begins with a visit to Bollywood Park. The park is designed like a Bollywood movie set where you can enjoy rides and shows. You cannot leave Dubai without witnessing Burj Khalifa. This is the world’s tallest building, offering a view of the entire city from the observation decks on the 124th, 125th, and 148th floors.

itinerary.title: Dragon Mart - Dhow Cruise
itinerary.description: Dubai is every shopaholic’s paradise, with several malls and souks selling everything from branded goods to handicrafts and spices. The Desert Mart is the best place to buy everything, including clothes, accessories, electronics, spices, and souvenirs. Set out for an evening Dhow Cruise, the ideal mix of adventures and natural beauty.

itinerary.title: Museum of the Future - Desert Safari
itinerary.description: The Museum of the Future gives visitors a glimpse of the future world. Here, you can experience the many possibilities a technologically-charged future could hold. A trip to Dubai is incomplete without experiencing the spellbinding magic of the desert and the dunes. At GT Holidays, we arrange the best desert safari, helping you spend an evening understanding and appreciating Middle Eastern culture and relishing delicious local cuisine. You can watch belly dancer performances, sleep under the twinkling stars, and ride ATVs/Quads with friends and family.

itinerary.title: Depart from Dubai
itinerary.description: Check out from the hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

packages.name: Amazing Dubai
packages.destination: Dubai - Dhow Cruise - Burj Khalifa - Desert Safari - Ferrari World

itinerary.title: Arrive at Dubai – Dragon Mart - Dhow Cruise
itinerary.description: Once you land in Dubai, you will be greeted by our tour representatives, who will take you to your hotel. After checking in and freshening up, you can begin your vacation with fun retail therapy at Dragon Mart, the best place for clothes, accessories, and electronics. In the evening, enjoy a dhow cruise where you can enjoy a delicious meal on a traditional boat while admiring the city’s amazing skyline.

itinerary.title: Burj Khalifa - Jumeirah Beach - Museum of the Future
itinerary.description: The second day of your trip is all about exploring Dubai's architectural marvels, including the Burj Khalifa, the world’s tallest building. You can climb up the observation deck for a panoramic view of the city. If you’re a beach-loving person, admire the calm atmosphere of Jumeirah Beach before hopping to the Museum of the Future, which gives tourists a glimpse into the possibilities of the future.

itinerary.title: Desert Safari
itinerary.description: You cannot leave Dubai without witnessing the boundless magic of the desert. At GT Holidays, we can arrange a desert safari to help you explore the sun and sand, go dune bashing, ride a camel, and relish some delicious local cuisine before resorting to a blissful sleep under the glittering night sky.

itinerary.title: Bollywood Park - Motiongate Dubai
itinerary.description: Bollywood Park is a theme park dedicated to Bollywood fans. The park is designed to represent the sets of a Hindi movie. You can also get a taste of Hollywood with Motiongate Dubai, a theme park that derives its inspiration from Hollywood movies.

itinerary.title: Dubai – Abu Dhabi – Corniche - Ferrari World
itinerary.description: Take a flight from Dubai to Abu Dhabi. Our tour representatives will transfer you to the hotel, where you can relax and rejuvenate. After lunch at the hotel, visit Corniche beach in Abu Dhabi to enjoy the turquoise hues and the serene environment. Finish this adventurous day by going around Ferrari World, which is the largest indoor theme park to have ever been created and is also the world’s first Ferrari-branded theme park.

itinerary.title: Depart from Abu Dhabi
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

packages.name: Discover Dubai
packages.destination: Dubai - Dhow Cruise - Burj Khalifa - Desert Safari - Aquaventure - Lost Chambers

itinerary.title: Arrive at Dubai – Dubai Mall - Dhow Cruise
itinerary.description: Once you land in Dubai, you will be greeted by our tour representatives, who will take you to your hotel. After checking in and freshening up, prepare for your Middle Eastern holiday with a trip to the fabulous Dubai Mall – the best place to shop for thousands of luxury brands from across the world. In the evening, we’ll meet you at Dubai Creek for an exciting 2-hour dhow cruise with a gourmet dinner, unlimited soft drinks, and a beautiful city skyline view.

itinerary.title: Burj Khalifa - Museum of the Future - Jumeirah Beach
itinerary.description: Make the second day of your trip all about exploring the most stunning touristy spots, starting with the world’s tallest building, the Burj Khalifa, whose observation decks you can ride up to enjoy a view of the whole city. Glimpse into the future of endless possibilities at the Museum of the Future and end the day at Jumeirah Beach in the evening.

itinerary.title: Aquaventure - Lost Chambers - Desert Safari
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a fresh splash of water at the Aquaventure Waterpark. Move on to delve into the underwater world through The Lost Chambers Aquarium. Later in the day, we’ll take you for a memorable Desert Safari. You can experience the desert, enjoy dune bashing, opt for a camel ride, and relish some delicious local cuisine before sleeping blissfully under the glittering night sky.

itinerary.title: Abu Dhabi – Corniche - Ferrari World
itinerary.description: Board your flight from Dubai to Abu Dhabi, where our tour representatives will help you reach your hotel. Once you’re done enjoying a delicious lunch, visit Corniche beach in Abu Dhabi and breathe in its serene ambience. Finish the day with Ferrari World, the world’s first Ferrari-branded theme park and the largest indoor theme park.

itinerary.title: Depart from Abu Dhabi
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

packages.name: Exciting Dubai
packages.destination: Dubai - Dhow Cruise - Burj Khalifa - Desert Safari

itinerary.title: Arrive at Dubai – Miracle Garden - Museum of the Future - Dhow Cruise
itinerary.description: Once you land in Dubai, you will be greeted by our tour representatives, who will take you to the hotel. After checking in and freshening up, get ready for a fabulous Dubai vacation. The first stop is Miracle Garden, the world’s largest natural flower garden, with over 150 million flowers on display. Next is the Museum of the Future, an exhibition that shares a glimpse of what the future might look like for us all. In the evening, ride the dhow cruise to enjoy the beautiful city while enjoying a four-course meal and unlimited soft drinks.

itinerary.title: Burj Khalifa - Jumeirah Beach – Dubai Mall
itinerary.description: The day starts with a visit to the Burj Khalifa, where you can climb up the observation deck to admire a panoramic view of the city. Post this, stroll the serene Jumeirah Beach, and end the day with well-deserved retail therapy at the Dubai Mall.

itinerary.title: Desert Safari
itinerary.description: You cannot leave Dubai without witnessing the magic of the dunes and the desert. You can go dune bashing, opt for a camel ride, and relish some scrumptious local cuisine before retiring for a night’s sleep under the twinkling stars. At GT Holidays, we arrange day-long desert safaris where you can choose from various desert safari packages.

itinerary.title: Bollywood Park – Wild Wadi Waterpark - Lost Chambers
itinerary.description: If you are a fan of Hindi movies, you mustn’t skip Bollywood Park, a theme park designed to resemble a Bollywood movie set. The next stop for the day is the Wild Wadi Waterpark, a water park filled with water-based activities. Later on, you will be taken to deep dive into the endless charm of the underwater world at The Lost Chambers Aquarium.

itinerary.title: Depart from Dubai
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Sharjah
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at the Sharjah International Airport, our tour manager will welcome and guide you to Dubai. Check in to the hotel and spend some time relaxing. Later in the evening, you will visit the Dubai Marina for a dhow cruise. The experience involves food, live entertainment, and sightseeing from the cruise.

itinerary.title: Dubai City Tour
itinerary.description: After a hearty breakfast, our tour manager will take you on a much-awaited city tour. Some of the city’s top attractions include The Dubai Mall, the Dubai Museum of the Future, Dubai Frame, the Dubai Miracle Garden, the Dubai Aquarium, Ski Dubai, the Lost Chambers, and the Jumeirah Mosque. Later in the day, you will visit the Burj Khalifa, the world’s tallest building. Don’t miss the view from the observation deck on the 124th floor. You will also visit the Dubai Fountain, the world’s largest performing fountain, for a light and music show.

itinerary.title: Desert Safari
itinerary.description: Today, after breakfast, you will spend the rest of the morning relaxing and enjoying the amenities of the hotel. Later in the afternoon, head out for a desert safari. Your guide will take you on a thrilling 4x4 drive for dune bashing. You will also enjoy sandboarding, camel riding, and hot air balloon rides. In the evening, enjoy a BBQ dinner at the desert camp with the local Bedouins and spend the night stargazing. Or, you could return to the hotel.

itinerary.title: Depart Dubai
itinerary.description: On the day of departure, you will enjoy a hearty breakfast and check out of the hotel to head to Dubai Mall. You will enjoy some of the activities there, including the largest ice rink in the Middle East. You can also enjoy dining at one of the many restaurants in the mall. Later, you will head to the Sharjah International Airport to catch your return flight home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Sharjah
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at the Sharjah International Airport, our tour manager will welcome and guide you to Dubai. Check into the hotel and spend the rest of the morning relaxing. Spend the evening with a dhow cruise on the Dubai Marina. The experience includes dining, live music, and sightseeing from the cruise.

itinerary.title: Dubai City Tour
itinerary.description: Today, after breakfast, you will head out for a city tour. You will visit most of the city’s top attractions, including the Dubai Frame, the Dubai Miracle Garden, the Dubai Mall, Ski Dubai, the Dubai Museum of the Future, and the Jumeirah Mosque. The highlight of the day is a visit to Burj Khalifa, the tallest manmade structure in the world. Don’t miss the view from the observation deck on the 124th floor of the building.

itinerary.title: Desert Safari
itinerary.description: Today is dedicated to desert safari. An experienced safari driver will take you on a 4x4 for some dune bashing. Enjoy a range of adventurous activities, including sand-skiing, sandboarding, camel riding, and hot-air balloon riding. Spend the night stargazing on a desert camp and enjoy dinner with the local Bedouins. Or, you can return to the hotel in Dubai.

itinerary.title: Depart Dubai
itinerary.description: On the day of departure, you will check out of the hotel after breakfast and head to Dubai Mall. There are plenty of activities and dozens of restaurants to choose from. You can also indulge in some retail therapy at the many flagship stores. Head to the Sharjah International Airport to catch your return flight home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Sharjah
itinerary.description: Your Dubai tour begins with your arrival at the Sharjah International Airport. Our tour manager will welcome you and guide you to Dubai. Check into the hotel and spend the rest of the day relaxing. Later, you will head to the Dubai Marina for a dhow cruise. The experience includes food and drinks, live music, and a mesmerising view of the Dubai skyline.

itinerary.title: Burj Khalifa - Dubai Mall
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a hearty breakfast. Later, head to Burj Khalifa for a 360-degree view of Dubai from the observation deck on the 124th floor. Today, you will also tour the city’s attractions, including the Dubai Museum, the Jumeirah Mosque, and the Dubai Mall. The latter is an ultimate family entertainment destination with attractions like the Dubai Aquarium, the Dubai Ice Rink, Kidzania, and many restaurants.

itinerary.title: Desert Safari
itinerary.description: Today, you will experience a desert safari in the afternoon. A tour guide will drive you to the desert, where an experienced 4x4 driver will take you for some dune bashing. You can also enjoy camel rides, hot air balloon rides, sand skiing, and sandboarding. You can stay in a desert camp, enjoy a BBQ dinner with the local Bedouins while stargazing, or return to the hotel.

itinerary.title: Abu Dhabi - Grand Mosque - Ferrari World
itinerary.description: Today, you will visit Abu Dhabi to explore the UAE’s cultural capital. The first stop of your tour is the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, the largest mosque in the UAE. The mosque is famous for its beautiful architecture and unique furnishings, including humongous carpets, chandeliers, and mosaic tiles. The next stop is Ferrari World, a world-class theme park centred around superfast cars and other automobiles. You can enjoy riding Formula Rossa, the world’s fastest roller coaster.

itinerary.title: Depart Dubai
itinerary.description: On your last day, you will check out of the hotel and head to Dubai Mall to do some last-minute shopping. You can enjoy some of the Mall’s activities or dine at one of the many restaurants. Later, head to Sharjah to return to India.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Dubai
itinerary.description: You will arrive at the Sharjah Airport to begin your Dubai tour. Our manager will welcome you and guide you to Dubai. Check into the hotel and rest until it is time for a dhow cruise in the evening. You will drive to the Dubai Marina for a dhow cruise. The amenities include food and drinks, live entertainment, and a panoramic view of Dubai City.

itinerary.title: Burj Khalifa and Dubai Fountain
itinerary.description: Today, after breakfast, you will explore one of Dubai’s most iconic buildings, the Burj Khalifa. The highlight of the tour is the At the Top 360-degree experience on the observatory deck on the 124th floor. You can enjoy a bird’s eye view of the surrounding desserts and buildings. Later, you will head to the Dubai Fountain, the world’s largest performing fountain. Before returning to the hotel, you can enjoy a light and music show at the Dubai Fountain.

itinerary.title: Desert Safari
itinerary.description: Today, you will go on a desert safari, enjoying some dune bashing in a 4x4 driven by an experienced driver. Other safari experiences include sandboarding, sand-skiing, and hot-air balloon rides. You can stay in the desert for a camp where you can join the local Bedouins for a sumptuous BBQ dinner and enjoy some star gazing. Or, return to your hotel in the evening.

itinerary.title: Dubai Miracle Garden and Dubai Frame
itinerary.description: Start your day with a visit to the Miracle Garden, the world’s most extensive natural flower garden, with over 50 million flowers and 250 million plants. Adjacent to the Miracle Garden is the Butterfly Garden, which has over 50 varieties of butterflies and features 15,000 butterflies. Later, head to Dubai Frame, the world’s largest picture frame. You can also climb to the observation deck of this 50-storey building for a view of the city’s modern skyline.

itinerary.title: Meena Bazaar and Gold Souk
itinerary.description: Today, you will visit Bur Dubai to visit Meena Bazaar. Situated in the historic Al Fahidi District, Meena Bazaar is a local market that gets its name from Delhi’s iconic Meena Bazaar. The market is famous for textiles, spices, jewellery, and electronics. Your next stop is the Gold Souk in Deira, Al Ras. With over 350 gold retailers, the Gold Souk is a great place to buy quality gold for cheap.

itinerary.title: Abu Dhabi - Ferrari World
itinerary.description: After breakfast, you will head to Abu Dhabi. The first stop on the tour is the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, the country’s largest mosque, which is beautiful with white marble, beautiful mosaics, and picturesque domes. Later, head to Ferrari World, the only Ferrari-themed amusement park famous for Formula Rossa, the world’s fastest roller coaster. Head back to the hotel for an overnight stay in Dubai.

itinerary.title: Ski Dubai – Ain Dubai
itinerary.description: After an early morning breakfast, you will head to Ski Dubai for the ultimate indoor ski experience. Temperatures are maintained below zero degrees. Activities include zorbing, snow bullet riding, chair lifting, skiing, and meeting the penguins. Later, head to Ain Dubai, the largest observation wheel in the world, for an unparalleled 360 degree view of Dubai City from a 250-meter height.

itinerary.title: Depart Dubai
itinerary.description: On your last day, you will check out of the hotel and head to Dubai Mall to do some last-minute shopping. You can enjoy some of the Mall’s activities or dine at one of the many restaurants. Later, head to Sharjah to return to India.

itinerary.title: Sharjah - Dubai
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at the Sharjah International Airport, our tour manager will welcome and guide you to Dubai. Check into the hotel and spend the rest of the day at leisure. Later in the evening, head to the Dubai Marina for a dhow cruise. Enjoy live music, great food on the cruise, and a panoramic view of the Dubai skyline. Return to the hotel.

itinerary.title: Burj Khalifa
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head out for a Dubai city tour. You will visit the Burj Khalifa, the world’s tallest building and enjoy an At the Top tour from the observation deck of the 124th floor. Take in a spectacular 360-degree view of the city and the ocean below. Don’t miss the music and light show at the Dubai Fountain, the world’s tallest performing fountain. Return to the hotel in the evening.

itinerary.title: Desert Safari
itinerary.description: Today, after breakfast, you will head out for a desert safari experience, where an experienced safari driver will take you on a thrilling dune ride for some dune bashing. Some other activities you can enjoy include hot air balloon ride, sandboarding, and sand-skiing. You can either return to the hotel or spend the evening at a desert camp for a BBQ dinner with local Bedouins and gaze at the Milky Way.

itinerary.title: Dubai Miracle Garden - Dubai Frame
itinerary.description: Today, you will visit the world’s most extensive natural flower garden. The Dubai Garden is spread over 72,000 sqm and is home to over 50 million flowers and 250 million plants. Don’t miss the Dubai Butterfly Garden, which features 15,000 butterflies and over 50 varieties in different sizes and colours. After lunch, head to Dubai Frame, the world’s largest frame. You can visit the observatory and museum attached to the Frame. Enjoy a sumptuous dinner before returning to the hotel.

itinerary.title: Ski Dubai - Ain Dubai
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head to Ski Dubai, the world’s third largest indoor ski slope. Enjoy live snowfall, snow bumpers, zipline, chairlift ride, and bobsled ride. After lunch, head to Ain Dubai, the world’s largest giant observation wheel for an unparalleled 360-degree view of the city’s skyline.

itinerary.title: Depart Dubai
itinerary.description: Today, you will check out of the hotel to head to Dubai Mall for some retail therapy. Shop at one of the many retail stores, dine at the restaurants or enjoy one of the many entertainment activities. Later, drive to the airport to conclude your Dubai tour and return home.

packages.name: Vibrant Hong Kong and Jeju Island | 6 Days Itinerary

images.alt_text: Vibrant Hong Kong and Jeju Island | 6 Days Itinerary
Vibrant Hong Kong and Jeju Island | 6 Days Itinerary

itinerary.title: Arrival in Hong Kong
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at Hong Kong Airport, our local representative will meet you and escort you to the hotel for check-in. The rest of the day is yours to enjoy at your own pace. Relax and settle in for an overnight stay in Hong Kong.

itinerary.title: Hong Kong City Tour
itinerary.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast. Take a half-day city tour of Hong Kong and explore the Waterfront, visit a Jewellery Workshop, and ascend Victoria Peak by bus. The evening is yours to unwind. Overnight in Hong Kong.

itinerary.title: Farewell to Hong Kong – Hello, Jeju Island
itinerary.description: Today marks your departure from Hong Kong as you catch a flight to your next exciting destination, Jeju Island. This captivating island, the largest volcanic gem in Korea, proudly holds the UNESCO World Natural Heritage designation. Officially known as Jeju Special Self-Governing Province, this top-notch tourist spot offers a delightful blend of mild weather and picturesque landscapes, including beaches, waterfalls, cliffs, and caves. Jeju has also earned the prestigious Global Geopark certificate and the honour of being selected as one of the New 7 Wonders of Nature. Settle in for a relaxing overnight stay at the hotel on Jeju Island.

itinerary.title: Discovering Jeju Island
itinerary.description: Start your morning with a delicious breakfast, and then the day is yours to enjoy at your own pace. For those seeking adventure, consider the optional tour: a day exploring the Western area of Jeju. Available on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays, the tour kicks off at 09:00 with a hotel pick-up. Highlights include Hyupjae Beach, a must-visit destination, Hanlim Park (Jeju's largest theme park featuring diverse botanical gardens), and O’Sulloc Green Tea Field (offering breathtaking views of green tea fields and the surrounding landscape, along with insights into Korean traditional tea culture). The tour concludes at 17:00 with a drop-off at your hotel. Enjoy a comfortable overnight stay in Jeju.

itinerary.title: Explore Jeju Island
itinerary.description: Today is yours to enjoy at your own pace. Consider an optional tour: @Day tour of the Eastern area of Jeju on TUE/THU/SAT@, where you will be picked up at the hotel at 09:00. Highlights include a horse-riding experience and a visit to the Horse Museum (on rainy days), the Seongup Folk Village for a taste of Jeju's unique traditions, and a scenic journey via Gwangchigi Beach—one of Jeju's 10 secret scenic attractions. Witness the incredible Woman Diver show, recognized as a UNESCO Intangible cultural asset, and explore the Haenyeo Museum (alternative course on rainy days). Continue to the iconic SeonsanIlchulbong Peak, known as Sunrise Peak and a symbol of Jeju Island, which is one of three UNESCO Heritage sites on the island. Conclude the day with a visit to Manjang Cave, the longest lava cave in Asia (Daheeyeon serves as an alternative course on rainy days). Enjoy a comfortable overnight stay at the hotel in Jeju. (B)

itinerary.title: Farewell to Jeju Island
itinerary.description: Today, we will transfer you to the airport for your flight back to your hometown or onward to your next destination.

Exploring Dynamic South Korea for 5 Days | Itinerary

itinerary.title: Arrival in Seoul
itinerary.description: Upon reaching Incheon Airport, you will be greeted by a guide and transferred to the hotel for some well-deserved rest. In the evening, enjoy free time at the vibrant streets with Indian restaurants. Explore the bustling Myeongdong street, known for its lively shopping scene, and Itaewon street, renowned for its bars and restaurants. Spend the night at the hotel in Seoul.

itinerary.title: Seoul
itinerary.description: Start the day with a delightful breakfast. Today is a free day for you to enjoy yourself. Alternatively, you have the option to join a Palace tour with lunch (OPTIONAL US$95) from 09:00 to 17:00. The tour includes a guide picking you up at the hotel, passing by Joggye Buddhist Temple and the Blue House (Korean President's House), visiting the main palace (Gyeongbok Palace) with the chance to witness the Royal Guard Changing Ceremony, strolling through the Insadong antique shopping street, having lunch at a local restaurant, exploring the shopping centre for Korean Ginseng or Amethyst, visiting the Traditional Market, Namdaemun, and concluding the day with a visit to Changdeok Palace. Return to the hotel by 17:00 for an overnight stay in Seoul.

itinerary.title: Seoul
itinerary.description: After breakfast today, you have the option to embark on exciting tours. Opt for the DMZ half-day tour (option at $70 per person, without lunch, on SIC 08:00-14:00, closed on Monday and holidays). Passport is required. The itinerary includes a 07:50 pick-up at the hotel, a visit to Imjingak Park, ID check at Unification Bridge, DMZ theatre & exhibition hall, The 3rd Tunnel, Dora Observatory, Dorasan Station, and a stop at either the Amethyst or Ginseng shop. The tour concludes at 14:00 at Itaewon street, from where you'll need to make your own way back to the hotel via taxi or subway after enjoying the street. Alternatively, you can choose the Nami Island & Petit France option (at $140 per person, without lunch, on SIC 09:00-17:00). The tour starts at 09:00 with a pick-up from the hotel, followed by visits to Nami Island, Petit France, and shopping at Ginseng and Amethyst shops. Nami Island is known for its artificial decoration and is a famous shooting site for the drama "Winter Sonata," while Petit France is a charming village with a French-style atmosphere and is also a shooting site for the drama "My Love from the Star." Spend the night at the hotel in Seoul.

itinerary.title: Seoul to Busan
itinerary.description: Begin the day with a delightful breakfast. Today, we will travel to Busan via a high-speed train. Upon arrival, a driver will meet you and transfer you to your hotel. The rest of the day is yours to enjoy at leisure. Spend the night at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Departure from Busan
itinerary.description: Enjoy your breakfast and prepare for departure. This morning, take a high-speed train to Incheon Airport for your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrival at Seoul!

itinerary.title: Seoul to Busan

itinerary.title: Busan to Jeju Island
itinerary.description: Catch a morning flight to Jeju Island and check in at your hotel for a well-deserved rest. The rest of the day is yours to enjoy at your own pace.

itinerary.title: Exploring Jeju Island
itinerary.description: After a delightful breakfast, the day is yours to savour leisurely moments. Alternatively, opt for an optional day tour in the western area of Jeju for £105 per person. Join a Shared Interest Group (SIC) tour starting at 09:00 with a pick-up at your hotel. Explore Hyupjae Beach, one of Jeju's "must-visit" beaches, Hanlim Park (Jeju's largest theme park with diverse botanic gardens), and O’Sulloc Green Tea Field. Immerse yourself in the views of green tea fields, the landscape, and traditional Korean tea culture. The tour concludes at 17:00 with a drop-off at your hotel. Enjoy a comfortable overnight stay at your hotel in Jeju.

itinerary.title: Departure from Jeju Island
itinerary.description: In the morning, after your breakfast, take a flight from Jeju Airport to Seoul and then transfer to Incheon International Airport for your journey back home.

itinerary.title: Exploring Seoul - A Day of City Wonders with a Delightful Lunch
itinerary.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast before embarking on an exciting city tour with a scrumptious lunch on a Seat in Coach. At 09:00, a friendly guide will pick you up at your hotel. Take a leisurely journey passing by Joggye Buddhist Temple and the iconic Blue House, the residence of the Korean President. Explore the grandeur of Gyeongbok Palace, witnessing the captivating Royal Guard Changing Ceremony. Continue your adventure with a stroll through the charming Insadong antique shopping street, followed by a delightful lunch at a local restaurant. After refuelling, visit a shopping centre featuring Korean Ginseng or Amethyst treasures. Immerse yourself in the vibrant atmosphere of Namdaemun Traditional Market and marvel at the historical beauty of Changdeok Palace. itinerary.title: Seoul – DMZ Half Day Tour

Nami Island is an enchanting spot, famous for its appearance in the drama "Winter Sonata," while Petit France offers a cosy village with a French-style atmosphere and is a shooting site for the drama "My Love from the Star." Everland (optional, $140 per person) - Another exciting option from 09:00 to 17:00 is a trip to Everland, a vast outdoor theme park operated by Samsung. The package includes transfer and entrance fees. Conclude your day with an overnight stay at your hotel in Seoul.

itinerary.title: From Seoul to Tranquil Jeju Island
itinerary.description: After a delightful breakfast, you will set off on a morning flight to the picturesque Jeju Island, where serenity awaits. Upon arrival, settle into your chosen hotel and take a well-deserved rest. The rest of the day is yours to unwind and explore at your own pace.

itinerary.title: Discovering the Charm of Eastern Jeju
itinerary.description: Kickstart your day with a delightful breakfast before embarking on a captivating day tour of the Eastern part of Jeju Island (available on Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday). Join a shared tour for an enchanting horse-riding experience, explore the Horse Museum (ideal for rainy days), and immerse yourself in the rich traditions of Seongup Folk Village for an authentic taste of local life. Return to your hotel in Jeju for a peaceful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Farewell to Jeju Island
itinerary.description: Bid adieu to Jeju Island as you catch a morning flight back to Seoul. Enjoy a seamless transfer from Seoul Domestic Airport to Incheon Airport for your journey back home.

Enjoy Mesmerising Japan with Seoul | 9 Days Itinerary

itinerary.title: Arrival in Tokyo
itinerary.description: Upon reaching Tokyo Narita airport, make your way to the hotel. The evening is yours to enjoy at your leisure. Spend the night at the hotel in Tokyo.

itinerary.title: Tokyo – City Exploration
itinerary.description: Start the day with breakfast. Meet at specified locations (hotels in Tokyo) and embark on a bus journey to Hamamatsucho Bus Terminal. Depart from Hamamatsucho Bus Terminal for a captivating sightseeing experience in Tokyo. Explore Tokyo Tower and partake in a traditional Tea Ceremony. Enjoy a Japanese-style lunch and continue the city tour, visiting Imperial Palace Plaza, Nijubashi Bridge, Hinode Pier, and boarding the Sumida River Cruise. Take in the scenic Azumabashi (Bridge over Sumida River), explore Sensoji Temple, and stroll along Nakamise Shopping Street. The tour concludes at Hamamatsucho Bus Terminal; head back to your hotel at your own pace. Spend the night at the hotel in Tokyo.

itinerary.title: Tokyo – Mt. Fuji & Hakone Adventure
itinerary.description: Enjy a heartfelt breakfast meal. Meet up at specified locations (Tokyo hotels) and board the bus bound for Hamamatsucho Bus Terminal. Depart from Hamamatsucho and journey to Mt. Fuji by bus. Explore Mt. Fuji as the bus ascends to the 5th Station, situated at an impressive 2,300 meters (7,546 ft) above sea level. Marvel at the breathtaking views above the clouds. Indulge in a delightful Japanese-style lunch before embarking on a scenic cruise on Lake Ashi. This crater lake, formed by a volcanic eruption nearly 3,000 years ago, offers stunning views of Mt. Fuji standing tall 30 km northwest. Appreciate the majestic sight of Mt. Fuji from the deck of the ship. Take a 7-minute ropeway ride to the summit of Mt. Komagatake, allowing for a total of 50 minutes, including leisurely strolls around the peak. Later, you will leave for Hakone and return to Tokyo by bus. The tour concludes upon arrival at Sukiyabashi Intersection in Ginza. Following the tour, feel free to make your way to your next destination or back to your hotel on your own. Spend the night at the hotel in Tokyo.

itinerary.title: Tokyo to Kyoto
itinerary.description: After a delightful breakfast, check out from the hotel and make your way to Tokyo Station independently. Board Shinkansen Nozomi 27 for your journey to Kyoto. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel, and the remainder of the day is yours to relax.

itinerary.title: Kyoto – Nara – Kyoto
itinerary.description: Start your day with a guided tour of Kyoto. Explore Nijo Castle, Kinkaku-ji Temple, Kyoto Imperial Palace (open on Mondays to Fridays), and Kitano Tenmangu Shrine (open on Saturdays, Sundays, holidays, and specific days). After lunch, venture to Nara, where you'll visit Todai-ji Temple (home to the Big Buddha), Nara Park, Kasuga Taisha Shrine, and Nara Nagomikan. A convenient drop-off service is provided to selected hotels in Kyoto City. Return to the hotel at your own pace and enjoy an overnight stay in Kyoto.

itinerary.title: Departure from Kyoto to Seoul
itinerary.description: Today, head to Kansai airport for your flight to Seoul. Upon arrival at Incheon airport, a guide will welcome you and transfer you to the hotel. Spend the night at the hotel in Seoul.

itinerary.title: Explore Seoul
itinerary.description: After breakfast, enjoy a leisurely day. Optionally, take a guided palace tour with lunch (optional). The tour includes a visit to Joggye Buddhist Temple, the Blue House (Korean President's House), the main palace (Gyeongbok Palace), and the Royal Guard Changing Ceremony. Pass by Insadong antique shopping street, have lunch at a local restaurant, explore the shopping centre of Korean Ginseng or Amethyst, visit the Traditional Market, Namdaemun, and conclude the day with a visit to Changdeok Palace. Return to the hotel by 17:00. Spend the night at the hotel in Seoul.

itinerary.title: Seoul
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a delightful breakfast, followed by an independent exploration of the area. Enjoy the night at your hotel in Seoul.

itinerary.title: Depart from Seoul
itinerary.description: We will transfer you to the airport to catch your flight home or to your next destination. Safe Travel!

itinerary.title: Welcome to Seoul
itinerary.description: As you land at Incheon airport, our friendly guide will be there to greet you. Enjoy a comfortable transfer to your hotel and take a well-deserved rest. The day is yours to explore the vibrant streets filled with Indian restaurants. Wander through the bustling Myeongdong street, renowned for its lively shopping scene. Later, venture into the exciting Itaewon Street, known for its diverse bars and restaurants. Your night will be spent in the comfort of your Seoul hotel.

itinerary.title: Exploring Seoul
itinerary.description: After a delightful breakfast, your day unfolds with the freedom to explore at your own pace. Consider joining our optional Palace Tour with lunch on a shared basis (SIC) for an additional US$94. The tour runs from 09:00 to 17:00 and promises a day filled with captivating experiences. The optional tour includes: 09:00: Pick-up at your hotel by a knowledgeable guide. Enchanting sights: Pass by Joggye Buddhist Temple and catch a glimpse of the Blue House, the official residence of the Korean President. Cultural immersion: Visit the iconic Gyeongbok Palace and witness the awe-inspiring Royal Guard Changing Ceremony. Stroll through history: Wander down the charming Insadong antique shopping street. Lunch break: Enjoy a delicious meal at a local restaurant. Shopping delight: Explore the Korean Ginseng or Amethyst shopping centre. Traditional vibes: Immerse yourself in the vibrant atmosphere of Namdaemun Traditional Market. Architectural beauty: Conclude the day with a visit to Changdeok Palace. At 17:00, return to your hotel for a well-deserved rest. Spend the night at your accommodation in Seoul, reflecting on the day's adventures.

itinerary.title: Seoul - A Day of Exploration
itinerary.description: After a mouthwatering breakfast, take the time to discover Seoul at your own pace. The city has so much to offer, from its vibrant street life to historical landmarks. Enjoy the freedom to roam and immerse yourself in the local culture. Your overnight stay awaits at the hotel in Seoul. Optional Tours: DMZ Half Day Tour (Option: $75 per person) Time: 08:00-14:00 (Closed on Mondays and Holidays) Passport Required 07:50 Pick up at hotel Itinerary: Imjingak Park, ID check at Unification Bridge, DMZ theater & exhibition hall, The 3rd Tunnel, Dora Observatory, Dorasan Station, Amethyst or Ginseng shop 14:00 Drop-off at Itaewon Street Please arrange your return to the hotel via taxi or subway after enjoying the street. Nami Island & Petit France Tour (Option: $145 per person) Time: 09:00-17:00 Itinerary: Hotel pick-up, Nami Island, Petit France, shopping (Ginseng, amethyst) Nami Island: An artistically decorated small island famous for its role in the drama "Winter Sonata." Petit France: A charming village with a French-style atmosphere, also featured in the drama "My Love from the Star." Return to the hotel after a day of exploration. Everland Tour (Option: $145 per person) Time: 09:00-17:00 Explore the vast outdoor theme park operated by Samsung, including transfer and entrance. Enjoy a day filled with thrilling rides and entertainment. Conclude the day with an overnight stay at the hotel in Seoul. (Breakfast included) Seoul offers a diverse range of experiences, and today's itinerary ensures you have the flexibility to choose the adventure that suits you best. Enjoy your exploration!

itinerary.title: Farewell to Seoul
itinerary.description: Today marks the end of your memorable stay in Seoul. Begin your day by transferring to the airport, where you will catch your flight back home or to your next exciting destination.

packages.name: Enchanting Bali Tour
packages.destination: Bali - Barong And Volcano Tour - Bedugul And Tanah Lot Tour

itinerary.title: Arrive at Bali - Tanjung Benoa Beach
itinerary.description: After reaching Bali, our local representative will greet you at the airport and take you to your hotel. Since Bali is famous for its fabulous beaches, begin your trip by visiting Tanjung Benoa Beach, where you can stroll at a leisurely pace, immersing yourself in beachy activities. If you love watersports, choose from parasailing, banana boat riding, and jet skiing. Pamper yourself in the afternoon with two hours of a rejuvenating spa treatment. Spend the night at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Batubulan Village- Kintamani Volcano Safari
itinerary.description: Commence the second day with a visit to Batubulan Village, known for its art exhibits. You can also witness a Barong dance performance in this village. Make sure to experience the Kecak Dance as well while you’re there. Next comes the Kintamani Volcano Safari, where you can enjoy the breathtaking view of the hot black lava of Mount Batur. See the rice terraces, coffee plantations, and ancient temples before returning to your hotel.

itinerary.title: Bedugul - Bali Botanical Garden - Ulun Danu Beratan Temple
itinerary.description: Bedugul is a mountain lake resort area and the first stop on the third day of your Balinese holiday. Visit the Bali Botanical Garden, the most extensive botanical garden in Indonesia, with the biggest collection of wild orchids on the island. For some spiritual experience, visit the Ulun Danu Beratan Temple, dedicated to the Hindu Gods Brahma, Vishnu, and Shiva.

itinerary.title: Depart from Bali
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight home.

packages.name: Discover Bali Package
packages.destination: Bali - Barong And Volcano Tour - Jakarta - Taman Mini

itinerary.title: Arrive at Bali - Uluwatu Temple
itinerary.description: After reaching Bali, you will be received by our tour representatives to be taken to your hotel, where you can have your lunch in peace. Your first stop for the day will be Uluwatu Temple, located on towering cliffs overlooking the sea. Grand celebrations are held at the temple every six months per Balinese customs. Devotees believe the temple is protected by divine powers, thereby saving the shoreline beneath the cliff from erosion. Proceed to Jimbaran Beach, where you can relish a delicious seafood dinner before returning to the hotel and retiring for the night.

itinerary.title: Batubulan – Ubud Traditional Handicraft – Kintamani Village – Tampaksiring
itinerary.description: Begin your second day with a visit to Batubulan village, where you can witness numerous traditional art forms and cultural shows, including the iconic Balinese dance drama of Barong and Keris. After this, head to Ubud to experience the local arts and crafts created by expert craftsmen, where you can purchase souvenirs and gifts. Proceed to the district of Kintamani, where the active volcano of Mount Batur lies, and then to Tampaksiring Palace to marvel at Pura Tirta Empul, a Hindu water temple. Get back to your hotel for dinner and get some restful sleep.

itinerary.title: Shift to Jakarta - Sunda Kelapa Harbour - Fatahillah Square – National Monument
itinerary.description: After breakfast in Bali, head to the airport to board your flight to Jakarta. Our local representatives will transfer you to the hotel. Head over to Sunda Kelapa Harbour, located in the northern part of Jakarta. The next stop is the historic preservation site of Fatahillah Square, situated at the center of Jakarta Old Town. The Puppet Museum is a unique concept, displaying puppets from characters across China, Indonesia, India, Vietnam, Cambodia, and Europe. End the day by visiting the National Monument, also known as Monas, an obelisk in the middle of Merdeka Square in Central Jakarta.

itinerary.title: Taman Mini Indonesia Indah
itinerary.description: In the 4th day, you will visit Taman Mini, a significant point of Indonesia’s rich natural and cultural diversity. Situated in East Jakarta, it contains 26 replicas of traditional houses of chieftains related to Indonesian history. Sprawling over 250 acres, you can find several flora and fauna parks, museums, performing theatres, accommodation facilities, and an Imax theatre.

itinerary.title: Shopping – Depart from Jakarta
itinerary.description: After breakfast, visit a market of your choice, such as the modern and eclectic Pasar Santa or the Tanah Abang Market, the largest textile market in Southeast Asia. Post a round of shopping, you will be transferred to the airport, from where you can board your flight.

packages.name: Bali with Lombok Island
packages.destination: Bali - Kintamani - Lombok Island - Aek Beleg

itinerary.title: Arrive at Bali - Bounty Sunset Cruise
itinerary.description: Once you arrive in Bali, our local representative will greet you at the airport and take you to your hotel. After enjoying a delicious lunch, you can relax and walk around the resort. In the evening, proceed to board the Bounty Sunset Cruise. Coursing through the coastal area of Benoa, it’s where you can relish some delicious food as you watch entertaining dance performances and enjoy the music crafted by talented local artists. Get back to your hotel after a fulfilling dinner on the cruise.

itinerary.title: Celuk Village - Mas Village - Elephant Cave - Kintamani - Ubud Village Tour
itinerary.description: The second day of your trip is all about exploring the rich culture of Bali. We begin with the Balinese village of Celuk, known worldwide for its gold and silver jewelry, after which you will proceed to the quaint Mas Village, where you can find several delicate carvings of wood sculptures. Next is the revered Hindu archaeological site called Elephant Cave or Goa Gajah. Pay your respects at Bali’s Sacred Water Temple, Tirta Empul, and drink in its holy ambiance. Then move along and see the Volcano Village of Kintamani and end the day by going to the central market in Ubud, where you can grab traditional souvenirs for yourself and your loved ones.

itinerary.title: Lombok Island
itinerary.description: On the third day, board a flight from Bali to Lombok. It’s an island located in the province of West Nusa Tenggara and is one of those unexplored gems with many beaches and waterfalls. It also has a volcano! If you wish to escape somewhere quieter, head to Lombok.

itinerary.title: Pusuk Pass - Sendang Gile and Tiu Kelep Waterfall
itinerary.description: Your first stop for the day at Lombok will be Pusuk Pass. Located in Batu Layar, Pusuk Pass is also known as the Monkey Forest. After experiencing the forest area, head to the breathtaking views of the two waterfalls: Sendang Gile Waterfall and Tiu Kelep Waterfall.

itinerary.title: Depart from Bali
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight home.

itinerary.title: Bounty Sunset Cruise
itinerary.description: After you reach Bali, our local representative will greet you at the airport and take you to the hotel. Once you’re done having breakfast at the hotel, proceed to the Benoa Port to board the Bounty Sunset Cruise and enjoy some delicious food with your family or partner. You can also enjoy entertaining dance and music presentations by local artists. Get back to your hotel after a fulfilling dinner on the cruise.

itinerary.title: Lembongan Island Day Cruise
itinerary.description: The second day of your Balinese holiday includes cruising around to breathe in the endless beauty of Lembongan Island. You can partake in activities such as snorkeling and water slides as your vacation.

itinerary.title: Tanjung Benoa Beach
itinerary.description: How can your trip to Bali be complete without witnessing the serene and stunning beaches? Head to Tanjung Benoa Beach on the third day to stroll around at a leisurely pace, immersing yourself in sunbathing and beachy activities. If you have chosen watersports and related activities, choose from parasailing, banana boat riding, jet skiing, and related activities. Pamper yourself in the afternoon with two hours of rejuvenating spa treatment. Spend the night at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Depart from Bali
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

packages.name: Bali with Nusa Penida
packages.destination: Bali - Nusa Penida Island - Tanjung Benoa

itinerary.title: Bounty Sunset Cruise
itinerary.description: Once you land in Bali, our local representative will greet you at the airport and take you to the hotel. After having breakfast at the hotel, proceed to the Benoa Port to board the Bounty Sunset Cruise. You can relish some great food while cruising through Benoa and enjoy some great dance and music performances by local artists. Get back to your hotel after a fulfilling dinner on the cruise.

itinerary.title: Nusa Penida Island Tour
itinerary.description: The Nusa Penida Island is one of the most exotic locations to explore in Bali and is among the largest islands in this tropical paradise. It is known as the Golden Egg of the island and is home to various temples, picturesque lagoons, and cliff formations. Sprawling over an area of 200 sq km, it’s a gem you must explore to take in the natural beauty of Bali.

itinerary.title: Tanjung Benoa Beach
itinerary.description: Your trip to Bali cannot be complete without witnessing the serene and stunning blues of its beaches. Head to Tanjung Benoa Beach, where you can stroll at a leisurely pace, immersing yourself in sunbathing and beachy activities. For those who wish to indulge in water sports, choose from different water sports activities, including parasailing, banana boat riding, and jet skiing. Pamper yourself in the afternoon with two hours of a rejuvenating spa treatment. Spend the night at your hotel.

itinerary.title: Depart from Bali
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrive at Bali - Ayung Bali Rafting
itinerary.description: Once you arrive in Bali, our local representative will greet you at the airport and take you to your hotel. We believe the first day should begin with something thrilling while also allowing you plenty of time to relax later in the day. Visit the Ayung River, the largest river in Bali, for an afternoon of white water rafting, after which you can return to the hotel for a relaxing evening.

itinerary.title: Tanjung Benoa Beach
itinerary.description: Bali is all about the beaches. Spend the second day at Tanjung Benoa Beach, where you can stroll at a leisurely pace, immersing yourself in sunbathing and beachy activities. For lovers of water sports, you can choose from parasailing, banana boat riding, and jet skiing. Pamper yourself in the afternoon with two hours of a rejuvenating spa treatment. Spend the night at your hotel.

itinerary.title: Celuk Village - Mas Village - Elephant Cave - Kintamani - Ubud Village Tour
itinerary.description: Visit the Balinese village of Celuk, well-known for its gold and silver jewelry, and then the Mas Village, where you can witness finely carved wooden sculptures. The famous Elephant Cave, or Goa Gajah, is the next stop, a revered Hindu archaeological site. Experience the holy ambiance of Bali’s sacred water temple, Tirta Empul, before visiting the Volcano Village of Kintamani. Hop to the central market of Ubud, where you can grab traditional souvenirs before returning to your hotel.

itinerary.title: Bounty Sunset Cruise
itinerary.description: After breakfast at the hotel, proceed to Benoa Port to board the Bounty Sunset Cruise. Travel through the coastal areas of Benoa to indulge in delicious food with your family or partner while watching music and dance performed by local artists. Get back to the hotel after a wonderful dinner on the cruise.

itinerary.title: Ubud Monkey Forest - Waterbom Bali
itinerary.description: On the fifth day, you will be taken to the Ubud Monkey Forest, where you can interact with numerous monkeys and experience the calm atmosphere of the temples within the forest. Then, head to the Waterbom Bali water park to enjoy exciting rides in a tropical ambiance.

itinerary.title: Depart from Bali
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight home.

itinerary.title: Arrive at Bali
itinerary.description: As you arrive in Bali, our local representative will greet you at the airport and take you to your hotel. You will have the entire day to relax and spend it as you like.

itinerary.title: Celuk Village - Mas Village - Elephant Cave - Kintamani - Ubud Village Tour
itinerary.description: Begin your day by visiting the Balinese village of Celuk, well-known for its gold and silver jewelry created by expert craftsmen, and then the Mas Village, where you can witness the many finely carved wood sculptures. The next stop is the famous Elephant Cave or Goa Gajah, located near the Elephant River and is a revered Hindu archaeological site. Afterwards, head to the holy ambiance of Bali’s Sacred Water Temple, Tirta Empul. It is believed that these springs were created and blessed by Lord Indra, giving the water purification powers. The next stop is the Volcano Village of Kintamani, where you can experience the majestic Mount Batur, which lies the magical Lake Batur. Before returning to the hotel, visit the central market of Ubud to grab traditional souvenirs for yourself and your loved ones.

itinerary.title: Tanjung Benoa Beach
itinerary.description: Spend the day participating in water sports at Tanjung Benoa Beach, including parasailing, banana boat riding, and jet skiing. Pamper yourself in the afternoon with two hours of a rejuvenating spa treatment. Spend the night at your hotel.

itinerary.title: Depart from Bali
itinerary.description: Our representative will transfer you to the airport for your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Almaty
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival in Almaty, our tour representatives will escort you to the hotel. Check-in, unwind for a while, and later, relish a delightful dinner at an Indian restaurant. Retire for the night at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Almaty City Exploration
itinerary.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast at the hotel before embarking on a city tour of Almaty. Discover the central highlights, including the Palace of the President, Monument of Independence, Republic Square, Panfilov Park, Astana Square, Abai Square, Presidential Park, and the Palace of the Republic. Pause for a delicious lunch at an Indian restaurant and then return to the hotel. In the afternoon, visit the Rakhat Chocolate Factory and the vibrant Zilyoni Local Market, where you can pick up chocolates, dry fruits, and souvenirs. Head back to the hotel to unwind and enjoy the rest of the evening at your own pace.

itinerary.title: Almaty - Meadows & Chimbulak Ski Resort
itinerary.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast before embarking on a full-day tour. This excursion offers breathtaking views of the mountainous landscapes surrounding Almaty city. Our tour guide will guide you to the Medeo Gorge, where you will be captivated by the stunning Trans-Ili Ala-Tau mountains. Continue your journey to the Chimbulak Ski Resort (please note, Cable Car fee not included) situated at an elevation of 2230 metres above sea level. Revel in the experience and spend the night at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Almaty Zoo & Family Park
itinerary.description: Indulge in a delicious breakfast at the hotel before heading to the Almaty Zoo. Immerse yourself in the wonders of the animal kingdom and capture memorable moments with your camera. Later, transfer to one of Kazakhstan's largest family parks for an enjoyable time. Return to the hotel for dinner and spend the night in comfort.

itinerary.title: Departure from Almaty
itinerary.description: After a delightful breakfast, make your way to Almaty airport for your departure.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Tashkent
itinerary.description: When you arrive at Tashkent Airport, our tour representatives will be there to greet you. They'll take you to your hotel. You can have a delicious lunch at an Indian restaurant. After that, get ready to explore Tashkent with our tour representatives. During the Tashkent City Glimpse tour, you will visit Amazing Independence Square, Amir Temur Square, Broadway, Lal Bakhadur Shastri Monument, Victoria Monument, and Broadway again. In the evening, you can enjoy a special Cocktail Gala dinner with a Belly dance performance. You will spend the night at Tashkent.

itinerary.title: Tashkent to Charvak Mountains
itinerary.description: Start your day with a yummy breakfast, and then head to the Chimgan Mountains to see Charvak Lake. During the journey, enjoy the beautiful snowy mountains by taking a Cable Car ride. Once you arrive, have a wonderful time exploring the Charvak Mountains. Take a break for a buffet lunch at Charvak Lake. Afterward, return to the hotel for an overnight stay. (Each person will receive a bottle of mineral water in the bus and hotel room.)

itinerary.title: Tashkent to Samarkand
itinerary.description: Start your day with breakfast. Then, hop on a high-speed train to Samarkand. Once there, explore Medreseh Shir-Dor (built in the 17th century), Medreseh Ulughbek (built in the 15th century), and Medreseh Tilla-Kori (built in the 17th century). Take a break for lunch at a restaurant with a buffet. Afterward, head to Bibi-Khonum Mosque, Shakhi Zinda complex, and do some shopping at Sieb National Market. In the evening, return to Tashkent for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Tashkent
itinerary.description: Start your day with a nice breakfast at the hotel's coffee shop. You will then go on a tour to see Tashkent from above and do some shopping. Do not forget to explore the Tashkent TV Tower with our guide. After lunch, you will go for shopping at Zoom Mall and Charsu Market. Head back to the hotel for dinner and a good night's sleep.

itinerary.title: Tashkent - Departure
itinerary.description: Enjoy your breakfast, and then it will be time to go back to the airport for your flight home.

packages.name: Safari Adventure in Tanzania: A 7-Day Journey from Arusha to Tarangire
packages.destination: Arusha - Lake Manyara - Serengeti - Ngorongoro - Tarangire - Arusha
