itinerary.title: Arrival in Arusha – Lake Manyara
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Kilimanjaro International Airport, our team will be there to assist you with all necessary airport procedures. Our experienced tour guide will then drive you to the captivating Lake Manyara National Park. Upon reaching your hotel, you'll check-in and enjoy a satisfying lunch. Take in the breathtaking views that stretch out across the lake and its surroundings. Later in the afternoon, our guide will lead you on a thrilling game drive within the park. The evening is yours to relax and unwind. You'll enjoy a delicious dinner and spend the night at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Lake Manyara to Serengeti
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a hearty breakfast at the hotel. Today, you'll embark on an exciting journey as you cross the Ngorongoro Massif en route to the renowned Serengeti National Park. Once you arrive, our tour representative will guide you on an exhilarating game drive within the park. After your morning adventure, return to the hotel for a well-deserved lunch. Then, prepare for another thrilling game drive in the Serengeti. As the day draws to a close, head back to the hotel for a delicious dinner and a comfortable overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Serengeti
itinerary.description: On the third day, you'll embark on a full-day safari adventure in the Serengeti, complete with a picnic lunch. Your morning will be dedicated to observing the wildlife along the riverbanks and in the branches of trees. During the afternoon, you'll have the opportunity to spot wildebeests as they roam the area. Take some time to explore the rocky outcrops where cheetahs seek shade and rest. Later in the evening, return to the hotel for a delicious dinner and a comfortable overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Serengeti to Ngorongoro
itinerary.description: After having breakfast at the hotel, we'll make our way to Ngorongoro. Here, we'll have a lovely picnic lunch at Olduvai Gorge, and you can explore the museum located there. This museum holds the remnants of some of humanity's earliest fossils. We recommend spending at least two nights in Ngorongoro. In the evening, we'll return to the lodge to enjoy a delicious dinner.

itinerary.title: Ngorongoro
itinerary.description: After enjoying a hearty breakfast in the morning, our tour guide will accompany you on an exciting 6-hour game-viewing adventure within the Ngorongoro Crater. You'll have the chance to spot an array of wildlife during this expedition, and your picnic lunch will be served right there in the crater. Following your visit, return to the lodge for a well-deserved dinner. Ngorongoro is renowned as one of Africa's premier game-viewing destinations, and it's often referred to as the "8th wonder of the world." Ngorongoro Crater is a natural marvel, boasting the title of the world's largest unbroken caldera, with its impressive 610-meter depth and expansive 260 square kilometers of area. This unique landscape encapsulates the essence of East African beauty and wildlife. The panoramic grandeur and breathtaking views make Ngorongoro Crater a true wonder of the world. Your overnight stay will be in the Ngorongoro region, allowing you to soak in the magic of this remarkable place.

itinerary.title: Ngorongoro to Tarangire
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a hearty breakfast at the hotel. Afterward, we'll make our way to Tarangire National Park, where you'll have the opportunity to explore all the wonderful attractions it has to offer. Return to the hotel for a delicious lunch. In the evening, embark on an exciting game drive. Tarangire National Park is a haven for bird enthusiasts, boasting a wide array of bird species and fascinating wildlife. Enjoy a tranquil overnight stay at Tarangire, surrounded by the beauty of nature.

itinerary.title: Depart from Tarangire to Arusha
itinerary.description: Enjoy a swift breakfast and head to Arusha. Relish a delicious lunch, and then we'll whisk you away to Kilimanjaro International Airport for your departure flight.

itinerary.title: Arrive In Chennai
itinerary.description: Our tour manager will welcome and guide you to the hotel upon arriving in Chennai. Check-in and spend some time relaxing before heading out to Valluvar Kottam, a memorial built to commemorate the Tamil saint and poet Thiruvalluvar. Later, you will head to Guindy to view the reptiles, including vipers, pythons, and cobras. Enjoy shopping at T Nagar and Sowcarpet. End the day with a visit to Marina Beach to enjoy beach vibes. You can enjoy some of the street food stalls on the Marina, including sampling the famous Marina Beach fish fry. Spend the night in Chennai.

itinerary.title: Chennai - Pondicherry
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head to Pondicherry. On the way to Pondicherry, you can visit the famous Beasant Nagar Beach, fondly called Bessy by locals, and the Vandallur Zoo. Check into your hotel in Pondicherry.

itinerary.title: Pondicherry Tour
itinerary.description: Pondicherry is famous for its French influence, which is evident in its buildings, cathedrals, and patisseries. Some places you will cover include the Aurobindo Ashram, Auroville, Manakkula Vinayagar Temple, Panjavadi Anjaneyar Temple, The Sacred Heart Basilica, Rock Beach, and Serenity Beach. End the day by bidding goodbye to Pondicherry and Chennai as you return home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Mysore – Mysore City Tour
itinerary.description: Welcome to Mysore, a city reputed for its rosewood and sandalwood artifacts and heritage structures. Upon your arrival in Mysore, you will be greeted by our tour manager, who will help you get to your hotel. Once you get done with the check-in formalities, you can head out for a day of sightseeing. The first spot you will be visiting is the Sri Chamundeshwari Temple, dedicated to Goddess Durga. After having lunch, experience the beauty of Mysore Zoo and Brindavan Gardens, where you can enjoy a dazzling musical fountain show. Spend the night at your hotel.

itinerary.title: Mysore - Coorg
itinerary.description: Once you relish a scrumptious breakfast at your hotel, you will be leaving to visit the Mysore Palace. Also known as Amba Vilas Palace, it’s a historical palace and the former royal residence of the Wadiyar dynasty. Have your lunch before making your way to Coorg. On the way, you will be stopping at the Golden Temple or the Namdroling Monastery. You can spend your evening at the hotel in Coorg after the check-in formalities are complete.

itinerary.title: Coorg City Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast, get ready for some sightseeing. The first stop will be the Dubare Elephant Camp, a forest camp that is home to elephants and is situated right in the center of a lush green forest. Participate in thrilling activities such as birdwatching, elephant riding, fishing, and a nature walk before heading to the Kaveri Nisargadhama Forest Park. The forest resort offers a beautiful view of the Kaveri River. Have your dinner by a campfire and leave for Mangalore later in the evening.

itinerary.title: Depart Mangalore
itinerary.description: Upon arriving in Mangalore, visit some of the popular spots in the city, like the Gokarnanatheshwara Temple, Mangaladevi Temple, and Kadir Hill Park. After having lunch, you will be taken to the Malpe Beach and Pilikula Biological Park. Later in the evening, leave for your hometown.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Hyderabad
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Hyderabad Railway Station, our tour representatives will greet you and help you get to your hotel. Once you complete the check-in formalities, you can spend the rest of the day at leisure.

itinerary.title: Ramoji Film City
itinerary.description: On this day, you will be visiting Ramoji Film City, which is the largest theme park and amusement park in Hyderabad. It is also the world’s largest film studio complex, as recognised by the Guinness World Records. After experiencing this theme park, you can return to your hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: Snow World - NTR Gardens - Hussain Sagar Lake
itinerary.description: For the third day of your trip, you will be exploring some of the most popular tourist attractions in Hyderabad. Start off with Snow World, an amusement park where you can enjoy ice skating, ice boarding, and snow slides. After this, head to the NTR Gardens, which is an urban park, and wrap up your day by visiting the Hussain Sagar Lake, a heart-shaped lake which is also the largest artificial lake in Asia.

itinerary.title: Hyderabad - Visakhapatnam
itinerary.description: In the morning, have your breakfast and enjoy some shopping. After this, proceed to the railway station in Hyderabad and board a train to Visakhapatnam. Upon checking in to your hotel in Visakhapatnam, you can relax for the rest of the day.

itinerary.title: Ramakrishna Beach - Kali Temple - Visakha Museum - Victory at Sea War Memorial
itinerary.description: Relish a scrumptious breakfast and then head out to explore the numerous sightseeing spots in Visakhapatnam. Walk around Ramakrishna Beach, which is situated on the east coast of the Bay of Bengal. Offer your prayers at the Kali Temple, a temple dedicated to Goddess Kali which was constructed in 1984. Made up of minarets, domes, and tall pillars, the foundation of the temple was originally a skeletal structure that was made using bamboo. Next stop is Visakha Museum, which has various artifacts and historical treasures that are related to the Kalingandhra region. End the day by visiting the Victory at Sea War Memorial. This monument was built to honour the soldiers who fought during the Indo-Pak war in 1971.

itinerary.title: Depart Visakhapatnam
itinerary.description: After having your breakfast at the hotel, leave to witness some of the other touristy spots that Visakhapatnam is home to. Go to the VUDA Park, which is a perfect spot for family outings. It offers you swimming and boating opportunities and the chance to ride on camels and horses. Take your kids to the Kambalakonda Wildlife Sanctuary, which houses several rare species of plants and animals. This includes bush plum trees, golden shower trees, neem trees, the Indian jackal, the Indian leopard, and Indian wild dog. Visit Rushikonda and Kailasagiri and enjoy some shopping before boarding your train to go back to your hometown.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Goa - South Goa
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Goa Airport, our tour representatives will greet you and help you get to your resort. Once you complete the check-in formalities, you can spend the rest of the day at leisure. Spend the night at your hotel.

itinerary.title: South Goa
itinerary.description: After enjoying a delicious breakfast, head out to take in the beautiful sights of South Goa. Start off with the Mangueshi Temple, which is dedicated to Lord Manguesh, an incarnation of Lord Shiva. Head over to the Big Foot Museum, a museum and theme park located in the village of Loutolim. Walk around Dona Paula Beach, where you can enjoy activities such as water skiing, kayaking, parasailing, and windsurfing. Visit the Shri Shantadurga Temple dedicated to Goddess Shantadurga, the Goddess of Peace. Go to the beautiful Mayem Lake where you can enjoy paddle boating and birdwatching. You will also be taken to the Panaji Handicrafts Emporium and Shri Saptakoteshwar Temple, after which you can return to your hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: North Goa
itinerary.description: Today, you will be moving from South Goa to North Goa. After reaching the hotel, you can freshen up and head out to explore the several sightseeing spots in North Goa. This includes the towns of Vagator, Anjuna, and Calangute. You will also be visiting Fort Aguada, which is a Portuguese-era fort from the 17th century. Get back to your hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: Goa - Mangalore
itinerary.description: In the morning, have your breakfast and relax around the hotel. Later in the day, head to the railway station to board a train to Mangalore.

itinerary.title: Depart Mangalore
itinerary.description: After you arrive in Mangalore, check-in to your hotel and relax for a bit before leaving to explore Mangalore. The first stop of the day will be Gokarnanatheshwara Temple, which is also known as Kudroli Sri Gokarnanatha Kshetra, and is dedicated to Gokarnanatha, an incarnation of Lord Shiva. Offer your prayers at the Mangaladevi Temple, before making your way to Kadri Hill Park, which is the largest park in Mangalore. Once you get done with lunch, visit Malpe Beach and Pilikula Biological Park. Later in the evening, board a train to get back to your hometown.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Shoranur - Madgaon
itinerary.description: Once you gather at Shoranur Junction Railway Station, board the train to get to Madgaon.

itinerary.title: Goa - South Goa
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival in Goa, our tour representatives will greet you and help you get to your resort. Once you complete the check-in formalities, you can spend the rest of the day at leisure. Spend the night at your hotel.

itinerary.title: South Goa
itinerary.description: On this day, venture out to see some of the most popular sightseeing spots in South Goa. Start off with the Mangueshi Temple dedicated to Lord Manguesh, an avatar of Lord Shiva. Explore the Big Foot Museum, which is a theme park as well as a museum depicting the rural life of Goa. Take a stroll around Dona Paula Beach, where you can indulge in activities such as kayaking, parasailing, windsurfing, motorboat riding, snorkelling, and water skiing. Offer your prayers at the Shri Shantadurga Temple, which is dedicated to the Goddess of Peace, Goddess Shantadurga. Next up is Mayem Lake, where you can try paddle boating and birdwatching. Wrap up the day by visiting the Panaji Handicrafts Emporium and Shri Saptakoteshwar Temple. Head back to your hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: North Goa
itinerary.description: Today, you will be moving from South Goa to North Goa. Once you reach your hotel, complete the check-in formalities and relax for a while before leaving to explore the touristy spots in North Goa. This will include the towns of Vagator, Anjuna, and Calangute. The last stop of the day will be Fort Aguada, a well-preserved Portuguese fort from the 17th century.

itinerary.title: Depart Goa
itinerary.description: After having a scrumptious breakfast, relax in your hotel before leaving for the railway station to board your train back home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Hyderabad - Birla Mandir - Golconda Fort
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Rajiv Gandhi International Airport, our tour representatives will greet you and help you get to your hotel. After completing the check-in process, relax for a while before heading out to visit some of the most popular tourist spots in Hyderabad. Start off with Birla Mandir, a temple situated towards the southern end of the Hussain Sagar Lake in Hyderabad. Perched on top of the Kala Pahad, the construction of this temple took 10 years to be completed, and it was inaugurated by Swami Ranganathananda of Ramakrishna Mission in 1976. Built with 2000 tons of pure white marble, the temple has an idol of Lord Venkateswara that is close to 11 ft tall. The next place you will be visiting is the Golconda Fort, which is situated in the western part of the city, close to 9 km from the Hussain Sagar Lake. The construction of the fort was completed in the 1600s, and it is famed for being the place where the Koh-i-Noor was once stored. Get back to your hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: Ramoji Film City
itinerary.description: On this day, you will be visiting Ramoji Film City, which is undoubtedly one of the famous tourist attractions in Hyderabad. It’s an integrated film studio and the biggest theme park and amusement park in the city. Sprawled over an area of 1,666 acres, it’s the world’s largest film studio complex and has also been certified by the Guinness World Records. After having a day of fun at this spot, return to your hotel and enjoy a relaxing evening.

itinerary.title: Charminar - Snow World - Lumbini Park
itinerary.description: On the third day of your trip, you will be exploring some of the most iconic sightseeing spots that Hyderabad is home to. The first spot for the day will be the reputed Charminar, a mosque and monument that is integral to the history of the city. The landmark is so vital to Hyderabad that it is also a part of the emblem of Telangana. Built by Muhammad Quli Qutb Shah in 1591, Charminar stands next to Makkah Masjid, which is the main mosque of the city, and hosts several festivities throughout the year, including Eid-ul-Adha and Eid al-Fitr. Next up, head to Snow World, an amusement park which is situated next to Indira Park and is a spot that kids, in particular, will love. End the day by visiting Lumbini Park, which is an urban park standing adjacent to the Hussain Sagar Lake.

itinerary.title: Depart Hyderabad
itinerary.description: For the last day of your trip, explore the Salar Jung Museum after having your breakfast. Reputed to be the third largest museum in India, it has an impressive collection of antiques. In the evening, engage in some retail therapy, and then leave for the airport to board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Pune
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at Pune Railway Station, our tour representatives will greet you and help you get to your hotel. Once you complete the check-in formalities, you can spend the rest of the day at leisure. Relax at your hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: Pune – Lonavala - Lohagad Fort - Karla Caves
itinerary.description: In the morning, have your breakfast and leave for Lonavala. After reaching this gorgeous hill station, visit the Lohagad Fort, which is among the many hill forts located in Maharashtra. It is situated about 52 km northwest of Pune at a height of 1,033 metres above sea level. The fort was once under the Lohtamia empire for majority of the duration, and under the Mughal empire for five years. After this, you will be visiting the Karla Caves. These are also known as Karli Caves, Karle Caves, or Karla Cells. They are a group of ancient Buddhist rock-cut caves that were built between the 2nd century BC and the 5th century AD. You will also be taken to the Lonavala Lake before you return to Pune.

itinerary.title: Pune – Mumbai - Nariman Point
itinerary.description: On the third day of your trip, you will be shifting from Pune to Mumbai. After reaching Mumbai, visit The Taj Mahal Palace, which is a luxury five-star hotel located in the Colaba area of Mumbai. Head to Nariman Point, which is a famous downtown area and posh neighbourhood of Mumbai filled with shopping malls, nightclubs, five-star hotels, and fancy residential apartments. Get back to your hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: Gateway of India - Juhu Beach - Elephanta Caves
itinerary.description: After relishing a delicious breakfast, proceed to explore some of the most famous sightseeing spots in Mumbai. Start off with Gateway of India, which is a vital arch-monument built on the waterfront of Mumbai. The construction of this monument was completed in 1924, and it was built in honour of George V becoming the Emperor of India in December 1911. Take a walk around Juhu Beach, which is Mumbai’s most popular beach. Finish the day by exploring the Elephanta Caves. These are a collection of cave temples dedicated to Lord Shiva and located on Elephanta Island. They were declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1987. Spend the night at your hotel in Mumbai.

itinerary.title: Mumbai – South Goa
itinerary.description: After breakfast, leave for the airport to board a flight to Goa. Upon your arrival at Goa Airport, you will be greeted by our tour representatives, who will help you get to your resort in South Goa. Spend the rest of the day at leisure and get a good night’s sleep.

itinerary.title: South Goa Tour
itinerary.description: After having your breakfast in the morning, proceed to explore the many sightseeing spots in South Goa. The first place you will be visiting is the Mangueshi Temple, which is dedicated to Lord Manguesh, an incarnation of Lord Shiva. After this, you will be going to the Big Foot Museum, which is a museum and theme park located in the village of Loutolim. Enjoy the beauty of Dona Paula Beach, where you can enjoy activities such as water skiing, kayaking, parasailing, and windsurfing. Visit the Shri Shantadurga Temple, which is dedicated to Goddess Shantadurga, the Goddess of Peace. Go to the beautiful Mayem Lake, where you can participate in paddle boating and birdwatching. You will also be taken to the Panaji Handicrafts Emporium and Shri Saptakoteshwar Temple. Walk around the beaches of South Goa, and you can also opt for a boat cruise in the evening to enjoy the cultural dance of Goa. Return to your hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: North Goa Tour
itinerary.description: On the seventh day of your trip, you will be transferring from South Goa to North Goa. Once you check-in to your hotel, our tour guide will take you to some of the most beloved tourist spots in North Goa, including the towns of Vagator, Anjuna, and Calangute. You will also be visiting Fort Aguada, which is a Portuguese-era fort from the 17th century. Spend the night at your hotel.

itinerary.title: Depart Goa
itinerary.description: In the morning, have your breakfast and indulge in some retail therapy. Later in the day, leave for the airport to board your flight back home.

packages.name: Discovering Alaska’s Beauty: McKinley Explorer Adventure with GT Holidays

images.alt_text: Discovering Alaska’s Beauty: McKinley Explorer Adventure with GT Holidays
Discovering Alaska’s Beauty: McKinley Explorer Adventure with GT Holidays

itinerary.title: Arrival in Anchorage
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival, you will be transferred from Anchorage Airport to your hotel. After checking in, you have the rest of the day to relax and unwind. Enjoy your overnight stay at the Anchorage Hotel.

itinerary.title: Anchorage to Talkeetna
itinerary.description: This morning, it's time to check out and head to Anchorage Railway Station for your journey on the Alaska Rail Road to Talkeetna. Relax in your seat and soak in the breathtaking scenery through the large picture windows. Keep an eye out for wildlife and the majestic Mt. Denali. About three hours into the trip, you'll witness one of the most spectacular views of McKinley. Upon arrival in Talkeetna, we'll transfer you to your hotel. In the afternoon, get ready for the Talkeetna Wilderness Jet Boat Safari. This adventure offers the chance to observe nesting bald eagles, beaver activity, and encounters with moose and bears in their natural habitat. You'll spend the night at the hotel in Talkeetna.

itinerary.title: Talkeetna to Denali
itinerary.description: In the morning, check out from your accommodation and make your way to Talkeetna Railway Station to catch the Alaska Rail Road to Denali. Keep a lookout for wildlife and enjoy breathtaking views of Mount McKinley along the way. As you approach Denali Park, you'll traverse Broad Pass, the Alaska Railroad's highest point at 2,363 feet above sea level. Upon reaching Denali, you'll be transferred to your hotel. In the evening, you have the option to embark on a glacier flightseeing or glacier landing tour. Spend the night at your Denali hotel.

itinerary.title: Denali National Park
itinerary.description: Start your day with the Denali Tundra Tour. Denali National Park is known for its immense scale – from the breathtaking scenery to the towering mountains, incredible beauty, and the fascinating wildlife that inhabits it. The Tundra Wilderness Tour offers an ideal opportunity for wildlife enthusiasts to spot animals like moose, bears, wolves, caribou, Dall sheep, and more. This 53-mile journey into Denali National Park is fully narrated by a certified naturalist driver who will share valuable insights into the area's history and geography. After the tour, you'll spend the night at your hotel in Denali.

itinerary.title: Denali to Fairbanks
itinerary.description: This morning, it's time to check out and head to Denali Railway Station for your journey on the Alaska Rail Road to Fairbanks. As you leave Denali, you'll be treated to the picturesque Nenana River Canyon, a well-loved destination for whitewater rafting. Before reaching Fairbanks, the train crosses the Tanana River on one of the world's longest single-span bridges. Upon arrival, we'll transfer you to your hotel. Enjoy an overnight stay at the hotel in Fairbanks.

itinerary.title: Leaving Fairbanks
itinerary.description: This morning, you will embark on a journey through Alaska's rich gold mining history with the Gold Dredge Tour. Hop on the Tanana Valley Railroad for an exciting exploration of the gold fields in the heart of Alaska. Get an up-close look at the Trans-Alaska pipeline and discover informative exhibits about this engineering marvel. A brief train ride with live commentary will take you to the Gold Dredge site, where you can witness how these dredges operated in the gold fields. Following a short gold mining lesson, you'll receive your very own 'poke' filled with pay dirt, allowing you to try your hand at gold panning! In the afternoon, it's time to check out from your accommodation and make your way to Fairbanks Airport to catch your connecting flight to your next destination.

packages.name: Explore Alaska’s Natural Wonders: Anchorage to Denali Adventure

images.alt_text: Explore Alaska’s Natural Wonders: Anchorage to Denali Adventure
Explore Alaska’s Natural Wonders: Anchorage to Denali Adventure

itinerary.title: Anchorage
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival, you will be transferred from Anchorage Airport to your hotel. After completing the check-in process, the rest of the day is yours to enjoy at your leisure. You'll spend the night at the hotel in Anchorage.

itinerary.title: Anchorage to Talkeetna
itinerary.description: In the morning, it's time to check out from your hotel and make your way to Anchorage Railway Station to catch the Alaska Rail Road heading to Talkeetna. Sit back and relish the stunning scenery through the large picture windows. You'll have the chance to spot wildlife and witness the magnificent views of Mt. Denali. About three hours into the journey, you'll encounter one of the most spectacular vistas of McKinley. Upon arrival in Talkeetna, you'll be transferred to your hotel. In the afternoon, get ready for the Talkeetna Wilderness Jet Boat Safari. This safari offers fantastic opportunities to observe nesting bald eagles, beaver activity, and moose and bears in their natural habitats. You'll spend the night at a hotel in Talkeetna.

itinerary.title: Talkeetna to Denali
itinerary.description: Today, it's time to check out from your hotel and make your way to Talkeetna Railway Station, where you'll board the Alaska Rail Road bound for Denali. Be sure to keep a lookout for wildlife and take in the breathtaking views of Mt. McKinley. As you journey towards Denali Park, you'll pass through Broad Pass, which happens to be the highest point on the Alaska Railroad at 2,363 feet. Upon reaching Denali, we'll transfer you to your hotel. In the evening, there's an opportunity for thrilling glacier flightseeing or a glacier landing tour. You'll spend the night at your Denali hotel.

itinerary.title: Denali
itinerary.description: This morning, you will embark on the Denali Tundra Tour. Denali National Park boasts grandeur in every aspect: the landscape, the mountains, the captivating beauty, and the wildlife. The Tundra Wilderness Tour is perfect for those who wish to spot the abundant wildlife, including moose, bears, wolves, caribou, Dall sheep, and more. This fully narrated 53-mile Tundra Wilderness Tour within Denali National Park is guided by a certified naturalist driver. They will not only assist in wildlife spotting but also provide historical and geographical insights into the region. You'll spend the night at your Denali hotel.

itinerary.title: Leaving Denali for Anchorage
itinerary.description: Today, it's time to check out of the hotel and head to Anchorage Airport for your connecting flight to your next destination.

packages.name: Russian Experience
packages.destination: Moscow - Izmailovo - St. Petersburg - Pushkin - Russia

itinerary.title: Arrive In Moscow
itinerary.description: As you arrive at the airport, our tour manager will welcome you and help you transfer to the hotel. Complete the check-in formalities and spend the rest of the day leisurely, enjoying places around the hotel. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Moscow.

itinerary.title: Moscow City Tour
itinerary.description: Russia’s capital and largest city, Moscow, has an incredible history and culture. It combines the best of old and modern architecture with beautiful boulevards, granite embankments of the Moscow River, and historic museums. Today, after breakfast, you will head out for a city tour. Some of the sights you will cover include Poklonnaya Hill, New Maiden Convent, and Vorobievy Hills. You will drive by some of Moscow’s famous streets, including Tverskaya Street, Manezhnaya Square, and Lubianka Square. Don’t miss Savoir Cathedral, the Kremlin, Ohotny Riad, Bolshoy Theatre, and Kropotkinskaya Embankments. End the tour with a visit to Red Square and cover the different cathedrals around the Kremlin. Spend the night in Moscow.

itinerary.title: Moscow City Tour Day 2
itinerary.description: Today, after breakfast, head out for a guided tour of Old Arbat Street, a famous cobblestone street and one of the oldest in Moscow. The tour will cover some famous architectural marvels, street shows, and browse shops selling souvenirs. Learn about the street’s history and enjoy the artisan culture around it. Return to the hotel in the evening to spend the night in Moscow.

itinerary.title: Moscow - Izmailovo
itinerary.description: After breakfast, you will head to Izmailovo, a suburb of Moscow. The Izmailovo Kremlin is famous for its souvenirs, paintings, antiques, and second-hand trifles. The Izmailovo Market is also the largest flea market in Moscow. Spend the day shopping to your heart’s content and return to your hotel in Moscow.

itinerary.title: Moscow - St. Petersburg
itinerary.description: Check out your hotel and head to the train station to catch the Sapsan train to reach St Petersburg. The journey takes around 4 hours and is extremely comfortable. Our guide will meet you at the station and help you check into the hotel. You are free to spend the rest of the day at leisure, enjoying the beautiful neighbourhoods around the hotel. Spend the night in St Petersburg.

itinerary.title: St Petersburg City Tour
itinerary.description: St Petersburg is Russia’s cultural capital, founded in 1703 by order of the Russian Emperor Peter the Great. Some of the city's attractions include mosques, churches, and imperial palaces built during the reign of Peter the Great. The Winter Palace and Peter and Paul Cathedral are highlights of the city. After breakfast, some places you will cover include Spit of the Basil Island, St Isaac Cathedral, Palace Square, Church of the Saviour on Spilled Blood, and the Aurora. You will drive by Nevsky Prospekt, a famous street built during the reign of Catherine II the Great. Some other attractions include the Neva Embankments, Isaac’s Square, Arts Square, and the famous Peter and Paul fortress, which is the burial site of the Russian royal family. Spend the night in St Petersburg.

itinerary.title: St Petersburg City Tour Day 2
itinerary.description: Today, you will explore the famous Winter Palace, a former royal residence of the Russian royal family. The palace is now converted into the Hermitage Museum, which has an impressive collection of over 3 million items, including paintings, sculptures, crockery, costumes, and a huge range of weaponry dating back to the Middle Ages. Spend the day exploring the different buildings within the Palace complex and return to your hotel in the evening.

itinerary.title: St Petersburg - Pushkin
itinerary.description: Today, head to Pushkin, a town in St Petersburg famous for its palaces and parks. The city was earlier named Detskoye Selo, or Children’s Village, and later renamed Pushkin in honour of the legendary Russian poet Alexander Pushkin. You will visit the beautiful Alexander and Catherine Palace. The latter is believed to be so richly decorated that even Catherine, famed for her extravagance, couldn’t keep up with its upkeep costs. The Amber Room within the Palace is truly extravagant, with over 6 tonnes of amber panels. Spend the rest of the day shopping and exploring places around Pushkin. Return to your hotel in St Petersburg.

itinerary.title: Depart Russia
itinerary.description: Today, you will bid goodbye to this beautiful country to catch your flight to return home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Moscow
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at the Moscow airport, our tour manager will welcome you and help you transfer to the hotel. Complete check-in formalities and spend the rest of the day exploring the area around the hotel. Join everyone for a sumptuous dinner and sample local Russian cuisine. Then, spend the night at a luxury hotel in Moscow.

itinerary.title: Moscow City Tour
itinerary.description: Moscow is Russia’s largest city, founded as early as the 12th century. Today, it is one of the country’s most populous cities and a spiritual centre of the Russian Orthodox Church. Some of Moscow’s famous attractions include the Moscow Kremlin, Red Square, St Basil’s Cathedral, the Bolshoi Theatre, Lubianka Square, and the Savoir Cathedral. The Moscow Metro Stations are famous for their ornate decorations and splendid architecture. Enjoy lunch at a local restaurant and spend the rest of the day enjoying circus shows at Moscow’s famous circuses, including Nikulin and Bolshoi. Spend the night in Moscow.

itinerary.title: Moscow City Tour Day 2
itinerary.description: If you’re a fan of street shopping, head to Old Arbat Street, Moscow’s oldest street. Famous for its amazing architecture and souvenir stores, the street was destroyed by the great fire during Napoleon's occupation of Moscow. Enjoy lunch at an Indian restaurant before heading to Bunker 42, a Cold War museum built in 1950. Here, you will learn about the fascinating secrets of the former Soviet Union. The museum has an unassuming façade but comprises a complex tunnel system with rooms stretching out underneath Moscow. Learn about how life existed within the bunker, including how soldiers recycled air and generated fuel and food for over 30,000 people for over 90 days. Later, head out for a cruise on the Volga for a panoramic city view. Spend the night with a sumptuous dinner. Spend the night in Moscow.

itinerary.title: Moscow - St Petersburg
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel and head to the train station to take the Sapsan train to St Petersburg. The journey takes over four hours and includes a complimentary lunch. As you arrive at St Petersburg station, our tour manager will welcome you and help you transfer to the hotel. Later, head to Nikolaevsky Palace to enjoy a folk show. The show includes dances from Stavropol, Don, Volgograd, and Kuban Cossacks. You will also enjoy Cossack songs from different regions and incendiary dances of the Voronezh and Don Cossacks. Later, head out to dinner at a local restaurant before retiring for the day.

itinerary.title: St Petersburg City Tour
itinerary.description: Today, you will head out for a tour of St Petersburg City, exploring its famous sights, including Spit of the Basil Island, St Isaac’s Cathedral, Palace Square, Church of the Saviour on Spilled Blood, the Nevsky Prospect, the Neva Embankments, Isaac’s Square, and the Cruiser Aurora Museum. Enjoy afternoon lunch at a local restaurant before visiting the Peter and Paul Fortress, the burial site of the Russian royal family. Spend the rest of the day continuing with your tour of St Petersburg before retiring for the day.

itinerary.title: Catherine Palace Tour
itinerary.description: Today, you will head to Pushkin to visit the Catherine Palace. It was built in the 18th century and commissioned by Catherine I, the wife of Peter the Great. After the Russian Revolution, the palace was converted into a Museum with over 3 million artefacts, including paintings, crockery, sculptures, and weaponry that date back to the Middle Ages. Enjoy lunch at a local restaurant before heading to the Peterhof to visit the Grand Palace. Built in 1721 by Peter the Great as a Russian Versailles, the Grand Palace is lavish with ornate staircases, gilded statues, and fine silk wall hangings. The palace, along with the city centre, is recognised as a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Spend the rest of the evening shopping and end the day with dinner at a fine dining restaurant.

itinerary.description: Bid adieu to Russia and catch your flight to return home.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Phnom Penh City Tour
itinerary.description: Welcome to the enchanting city of Phnom Penh, where traditional Khmer and colonial styles blend seamlessly with French villas and tree-lined sidewalks. Upon your arrival in Phnom Penh, our representative will greet you at the airport and escort you to your hotel. After a refreshing breakfast, you will embark on a fascinating tour of the city. Your first stop is the remarkable and vibrant Khmer-style Royal Palace complex, built in 1866 during the reign of King Norodom's predecessors. Nearby, you will explore the Silver Pagoda, also known as the Emerald Buddha Temple. Inside, you'll find a wealth of Buddha statues adorned with gold, diamonds, gemstones, and silver. You will then visit the Independence Monument, a symbol of Cambodia's sovereignty, and continue to the National Museum. This beautiful Khmer architectural gem houses an extensive collection of over 5,000 art antiques, crafted from bronze, wood, gold, silver, copper, sandstone, and more. Your journey will take you through the riverside park, where four rivers converge, including the mystical Mekong River. You will walk up to the sacred hill of Phnom Daun Penh, offering panoramic views of the city. As the day concludes, you'll enjoy a restful night at your hotel in Phnom Penh.

itinerary.title: Phnom Penh City Tour to Siem Reap
itinerary.description: In the afternoon, your journey takes you to Tuol Sleng prison, now transformed into the Genocide Museum, which unveils the darkest chapters of the Khmer Rouge regime. Once known as S-21 (an abbreviation for Security Office 21), it served as the Khmer Rouge's primary security camp, designed for the interrogation and elimination of those deemed anti-Angkor. Leaving behind the haunting remnants of Cambodia's tragic history, you will proceed to explore the bustling Russian market for a shopping excursion. Later in the day, you will make your way to the airport or bus station for the flight or express bus journey to Siem Reap. Upon reaching Siem Reap, our representative will be there to greet you at the airport or bus station and provide transportation to your hotel. You'll spend the night at your hotel in Siem Reap.

itinerary.title: Full Day Angkor Tour
itinerary.description: This morning, your journey takes you to the South Gate of Angkor Thom, a significant entrance to the grand royal city that served as the last capital of the Angkor Empire. Within its confines, you will encounter the renowned Bayon Temple, an architectural masterpiece that evolved over a century, resulting in a somewhat intricate design. You will continue your exploration with a visit to the Terrace of the Elephants, a remarkable wall adorned with intricately carved elephants that stretches for 300 metres. This impressive structure graces the heart of Angkor Thom, just in front of the massive temple mountain, Baphuon. Your tour leads you through the Royal Palace Area and Phimeanakas, an imposing sandstone pyramid with strong ritual significance. Adjacent to the Terrace of the Elephants, you will discover the Terrace of the Leper King, marked by a double terrace wall intricately adorned with deeply carved nagas, demons, and mythological beings. Your final stop for the morning is the enchanting Ta Prohm temple, a harmonious blend of human craftsmanship and natural splendour. In the afternoon, you will set your sights on the remarkable Angkor Wat temple. This ancient Cambodian marvel stands as one of the world's oriental wonders, replicating the universe as described in Hindu mythology. Five iconic towers reach towards the sky, surrounded by a symmetrical arrangement of galleries embellished with intricate reliefs and stone depictions of celestial Apsara dancers. The temple is a treasure trove of portals, chambers, and courtyards.

itinerary.title: Full Day Angkor Tour
itinerary.description: After a delightful breakfast, you will set out to explore the wonders of Angkor. Your first stop is the enchanting Ta Prohm temple, where the harmony of human craftsmanship and natural beauty is truly remarkable. In the afternoon, you will travel to Angkor Wat temple, a true marvel of Cambodia's ancient history and one of the most extraordinary sights in the oriental world. It's a representation of the universe according to Hindu mythology. Angkor Wat boasts five majestic towers that reach for the skies, surrounded by an intricate arrangement of galleries adorned with intricate reliefs and stone depictions of celestial Apsara dancers. It's a place of portals, chambers, and courtyards, set in a pyramid with five levels, dedicated to the deity Shiva. As evening descends, you will make your way to visit Preah Khan, often referred to as "The Sacred Sword." This temple, also constructed by Jayawarman VII, is renowned for its incredibly lengthy cruciform corridors and intricate carvings. Your next destination is Neak Pean, a delicate masterpiece of Khmer art. Built by Jayavarman VII, this temple is often described as a heavenly paradise on earth. East Mebon, constructed in the 10th Century by Rajendravarman, is located on a small island, offering a unique and serene setting. Your final stop of the day is Pre Rup, also dating back to the 10th Century and built by Rajendravarman. Here, you will have the opportunity to admire a captivating sunset. After this day of exploration, you will return to your hotel in Seam Reap for a peaceful night's rest.

itinerary.title: Siem Reap City Tour – Floating Village
itinerary.description: Your day begins with a visit to Wat Thmei, also known as the Killing Field. Here, a remarkable glass-walled stupa stands, housing the remains of those who fell victim to the Khmer Rouge. Some of these bones were retrieved from a nearby well, while others belong to soldiers who perished on a nearby battlefield. This solemn place serves as a powerful reminder of Cambodia's history. You will then proceed to "Les Artisans d'Angkor – Chantiers Ecole," an establishment renowned for producing the finest authentic Khmer arts and crafts. After your cultural exploration, you will take a break for lunch at a local restaurant. In the afternoon, you will set out to explore the Floating Villages, situated to the south of Siem Reap. A traditional wooden boat will carry you across the Tonle Sap, Cambodia's "Great Lake" and the largest lake in Asia. As you navigate these waters, you will witness the Khmer way of life reflected in the floating villages. Your next destination is Wat Bo, a pagoda with a rich history dating back to the 18th century. Inside, you'll find distinctive wall paintings depicting the Reamker, Cambodia's interpretation of the epic Ramayana, believed to date from the late 19th century. Your day concludes with a visit to one of the city's bustling markets, Psar Chars, commonly referred to as the "Old Market." Here, you can explore and perhaps find some souvenirs to remember your journey. Tonight, you will rest at your hotel in Siem Reap.

itinerary.title: Depart Siem Reap
itinerary.description: This morning, we'll arrange your transfer to the airport, whether for your journey back home or to your next exciting destination.

itinerary.title: Welcome to Mauritius
itinerary.description: Your journey begins as you land at the Mauritius airport. Upon arrival, our friendly representatives will be there to greet you. They'll take care of your transfer from the airport to the hotel, ensuring a smooth and comfortable start to your trip. Once you've reached the hotel, check-in and enjoy a delicious dinner to refuel after your travels. After your meal, you can unwind and look forward to a restful night's sleep in your cosy accommodation.

itinerary.title: Exploring the Beauty of North Mauritius
itinerary.description: Kickstart your day with a hearty breakfast at the hotel. Get ready for an exciting full-day adventure exploring the wonders of North Mauritius. Our first stop is the enchanting Pamplemousses Gardens, famous for its giant water lilies. You'll be captivated by the beauty of these incredible plants and the serene surroundings of the gardens. Next, we'll head to the capital of Mauritius, "Port Louis," where you can immerse yourself in the rich culture and history of the island. After a day of exploration, we'll return to the hotel for a scrumptious dinner. You can then enjoy a peaceful overnight stay at your hotel.

itinerary.title: A Relaxing Day at Your Leisure
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a quick and satisfying breakfast. It's a perfect opportunity to enjoy some quality time with your loved one. Alternatively, you can choose to enhance your experience by adding an optional tour package to the Blue Safari Submarine. The choice is yours. Later in the day, you will head back to the hotel for a delightful dinner, followed by a restful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Exploring the Beauty of South Island
itinerary.description: Enjoy a hearty breakfast before starting on an exciting full-day adventure exploring the captivating South Island of Mauritius. Your first stop will take you to the Trou aux Cerfs, the crater of an extinct volcano. Next, you will visit the Grand Bassin, a serene natural lake located at the base of a volcanic crater. This place holds significant spiritual importance for Hindus and is a popular pilgrimage site. The tranquillity and beauty of the area are sure to leave a lasting impression. Our journey continues to Chamarel, known for its Colored Earth phenomenon, featuring vibrant and unique hues in the landscape, along with a stunning waterfall that adds to the charm. As the day unfolds, you will also make a stop in the city of Curepipe, where you'll have the opportunity to pick up some souvenirs to remember your time in Mauritius. Finally, you will return to the hotel for a delicious dinner and a peaceful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: A Day to Relax and Unwind
itinerary.description: After enjoying a delightful morning breakfast, your tour representative will give you the freedom to spend the entire day at your leisure. You have the option to unwind in the comfort of your hotel or choose an exciting optional tour package for an Undersea Walk. Later, return to the hotel for a delectable dinner and then settle in for a restful night's sleep.

itinerary.title: A Speedy Escape to Ile Aux Cerfs Island
itinerary.description: Today, as you relish your breakfast, prepare for an exhilarating full-day excursion to the Ile Aux Cerfs Island Resort. This enchanting destination is renowned for its pristine white sandy beaches and an array of thrilling water sports activities. Spend the entire day soaking in the island's beauty and return to your hotel in the evening. Enjoy a delicious dinner and a peaceful overnight stay in the comfort of your hotel.

itinerary.title: Farewell to Mauritius
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a hearty breakfast in the morning. Afterwards, you can opt to engage in some last-minute shopping, explore nearby sights, or simply unwind at your hotel. Our tour representatives will be on hand to transfer you to the airport for your departure when the time comes.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Male
itinerary.description: When you arrive in Male, our tour manager will welcome and guide you to the ferry station to catch your speedboat to Hulhumale. If you prefer taking an ocean plane, make sure to inform our tour planners in advance. Check into the hotel and spend the rest of the day enjoying places around the resort.

itinerary.title: Hulhumale Island Day 1
itinerary.description: Hulhumale is a serene island famous for its vistas of the Indian Ocean and amazing marine life. It is also relatively inhabited and has plenty of restaurants serving delectable seafood. After breakfast, you can enjoy some of the water sports activities offered by the resort. These include snorkelling, scuba diving, swimming, and jet skiing. In the evening, you can enjoy a candlelight dinner at the beach. Spend the night in Hulhumale.

itinerary.title: Hulhumale Island Day 2
itinerary.description: On the second day, you can head out to explore the local markets and restaurants or sign up for one of the many activities offered by the resort. You could enjoy the marine life around the resort, take a private yacht tour, or sign up for a pampering spa session. In the evening, enjoy a pleasant dinner by the beach, as it’s your last night on this island.

itinerary.title: Depart Hulhumale
itinerary.description: Today, after breakfast, you will check out of the hotel and head to the ferry station to catch your speedboat to Male. While you still have time to catch your flight, we suggest you explore the local attractions in Male, including Sultan Park and Victoria Monument. Catch your flight to return home to India.

itinerary.title: Arrive In Paris
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at the Paris International Airport, our tour manager will guide you to the hotel and help you with check-in formalities. After a delicious lunch, head to the Eiffel Tower, where you will visit Level 3, the highest floor accessible to tourists, to appreciate the stunning views of Paris. Spend the night at a comfortable inn in Paris.

itinerary.title: Rhine River Cruise
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head to Bois de Boulogne to catch a cruise on the River Rhine. During this one-hour tour, you will experience Paris from an entirely new angle. Return to your hotel to spend the evening shopping or roaming around Paris’ busy streets and markets.

itinerary.title: Paris - Basel
itinerary.description: After a sumptuous breakfast, check out of the hotel and head to Basel by Euro Rail. On arrival at Basel, check in to a hotel and head out for lunch. Later, continue for a guided tour of the city. Basel is Switzerland’s oldest university city, famous for its art and culture. Some of the city’s top attractions include the Basel Zoo, the Fine Arts Museum, and the Toy World’s Museum. Spend the night at a comfortable inn in Basel.

itinerary.title: Basel - Lucerne
itinerary.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast, then check out of the hotel and head to Lucerne. This medieval town in Switzerland is famous for its medieval architecture, iconic wooden bridge, and beautiful Lake Lucerne. You will explore some of Lucerne’s famous attractions, including the Jesuit Church, the Lucerne Sanctuary, Mill Bridge, Picasso Exhibition Hall, Chapel Bridge, Lion Monument, and the Zyt Tower. End the day with an Indian dinner in Lucerne.

itinerary.title: Lucerne - Interlaken
itinerary.description: After a healthy breakfast, head to Interlaken, one of Switzerland’s oldest and most popular holiday destinations. This stunning alpine beauty is surrounded by the Bernese Oberland Mountains. When in Interlaken, don’t miss the Open-Air Museum, the Yash Chopra Statue, Hohematte Park, and the Alpine Wildlife Park. Later, return to your hotel for a sumptuous dinner.

itinerary.title: Mt Titlis - Zurich
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel and head to Mt Titlis, Central Switzerland’s tallest mountain. You will take the Titlis Rotair, the world’s first revolving cable car, which will take you to the top of Mount Titlis. Enjoy a delicious lunch atop the Titlis before leaving for Zurich. Check into the hotel and spend the night in Zurich.

itinerary.title: Zurich - Rhine Falls
itinerary.description: After breakfast in the morning, head out for a tour of Zurich. You will visit the Fraumunster Church, the Zurich Opera House, the Zurich Zoo, Grossmunster, etc. You will drive along the Hoehenstrasse for a breathtaking view of the Alps. Later, set to a half-day tour of the Rhine Falls, the largest waterfall in Europe. Located in Laufen-Uhwiesen, this breathtaking natural wonder attracts millions of tourists from around the world. Return to Zurich in the evening and spend the night in this beautiful city.

itinerary.title: Depart Zurich
itinerary.description: Spend the last day shopping before heading to the Zurich International Airport to catch your return flight.

itinerary.title: Delhi to Mauritius – Embark on the Magical Mauritius Tour
itinerary.description: Welcome to the enchanting paradise of Mauritius! As you touch down at the Sir Seewoosagur Ramgoolam Airport, our friendly tour representatives will be there to greet you and help you breeze through all the necessary administrative procedures. From the airport, we'll whisk you away to your hotel, ensuring a seamless transition into your new surroundings. After settling in, you can look forward to a delightful dinner and a restful night's sleep at the hotel, preparing for the adventures that await on the Ile Aux Cerfs Island tour package.

itinerary.title: Exploring the Charms of Mauritius - Ile Aux Cerfs Island Tour Package
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delightful breakfast and get ready for an enchanting adventure as you set off for the renowned Ile Aux Cerfs Island, also known as Deer Island. Situated on the picturesque east coast of Mauritius, this island paradise boasts not one, but two charming restaurants, endless stretches of pristine beaches, and a well-equipped boat house for water activities. If you're someone with an adventurous spirit, you'll have the opportunity to partake in the exhilarating experience of parasailing, although this is an optional activity. Feel the rush of excitement as you soar above the crystal-clear waters. It's truly an experience like no other. As the day unfolds, you will return to your hotel for a sumptuous dinner. Afterward, you can unwind and enjoy a restful overnight stay in the cosy confines of your accommodation.

itinerary.title: Discovering the Beauty of Mauritius - Trou Aux Cerfs
itinerary.description: After a delicious breakfast to kickstart your day, it's time to check in with your tour operator for an exciting journey that will take you through the heart of Mauritius, exploring the central and southwestern regions. Your first stop is Trou Aux Cerfs, located in Curepipe, which is the site of an extinct volcano's crater. Here, you'll be immersed in a truly unique and captivating experience as you take in the stunning geological wonders. Continuing your exploration, our tour guides will lead you to the Grand Basin, where you'll encounter two natural lakes that are emblematic of the island's natural beauty. The serene surroundings and tranquil waters make for a perfect opportunity to capture some remarkable moments. Once you have completed your day of exploration, you will return to your hotel to savour a delectable dinner and retire for the night in the comfort of our accommodation.

itinerary.title: Exploring the Natural Beauty of Mauritius - Pamplemousses Gardens
itinerary.description: As the sun graces us with its presence this morning, you will embark on a captivating journey after a delightful breakfast. Our destination: the splendid Pamplemousses Gardens, also known as the Royal Botanical Gardens. These gardens are a true haven for both indigenous and exotic plant species, offering a fascinating exhibition of botanical wonders. In the afternoon, we'll whisk you away to the coastal haven of Grand Baie. This charming tourist village is a hub of activity, where you can indulge in delectable cuisine at restaurants, sip refreshing drinks at bars and pubs, relax on pristine beaches, partake in thrilling water sports, and dance the night away in lively discos. Later in the day, you will return to the comforts of your hotel for a scrumptious dinner. The night will be spent at the hotel, ensuring you're well-rested for the adventures that await.

itinerary.title: Farewell to Mauritius
itinerary.description: On this final day of your unforgettable journey, there's no need to rush. Take your time to pack your bags and relish in the leisurely moments of your stay in beautiful Mauritius. Later in the day, our dedicated tour operators will ensure a seamless departure experience, with your transfer to the airport taken care of.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Zurich
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at the Zurich International Airport, our tour manager will help you move to Lucerne and guide you through check-in formalities. After a few hours of rest, head out to explore the city. You will visit the Art Museums, the Jesuit Church, Lucerne Chapel Bridge, the Picasso Museum, Zyt Tower, and the Mill Bridge. Don’t miss a scenic boat ride on Lake Lucerne. End the night with a sumptuous dinner at an Indian restaurant. Spend the night in Lucerne.

itinerary.title: Geneva - Interlaken
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of your hotel and head to Geneva. The journey takes around 3 hours and is absolutely stunning. Geneva is Switzerland’s most cosmopolitan city and the seat of several international organisations, including the WHO, UNHCR, and the UN. Some places you will explore in the city include the St Pierre Cathedral, Palais des Nations, the Geneva Water Fountain, and the Bains des Paquis. Later, head to Interlaken, a charming city nestled between two lakes and surrounded by the Bernese Oberland Mountains. It’s a great place for adventure lovers, with tourists visiting Interlaken for activities like bungee jumping, hiking, or summertime swimming. You will explore Lakes Thun and Brienz and visit the Matterhorn, Grindelwald, and the Rhone Glacier. Return to the hotel to spend the night in Interlaken.

itinerary.title: Titlis - Zurich
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head to Switzerland’s most popular destination, Mount Titlis. This is a famous skiing destination and the site of the world’s first revolving cable car, Rotair. From Interlaken, you will head to Trusbee, the middle station, by gondola. From Trusbee, you will ride another gondola to reach Stand. And from Stand, you will take the Rotair to reach the summit. At the summit, you’ll see the major attractions, including ice caves, Glacier Caves, Titlis Cliff Walk, and the Ice Flyer Chairlift. Don’t miss the opportunity to lunch at the tallest mountain peak in the central Swiss Alps. Later, head to Zurich and check into your hotel. After some rest, head out to explore some of the city’s tourist attractions, including Old Town, Limmatquai, and the historical Fraumuenster Church, famous for its Chagall windows. You can also drive along the Hoehenstrasse for a spectacular view of the Alps. Spend the night in Zurich.

itinerary.title: Zurich - Rhine Falls - Black Forest
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head out for a tour of the Rhine Falls. This is the largest waterfall in Europe and is located in Laufen-Uhwiesen. The water flows from a height of 23 metres and across a width of 150 metres, providing a magnificent spectacle to tourists. Enjoy a delicious lunch with a view of the cascading falls, then set off on a tour of the Black Forest region, famous for its lush greenery, gorgeous lakes and rivers, and amazing wildlife. The Black Forest is also the source of the Danube River. You’ll enjoy hiking across this amazing forest or taking a relaxing bike ride through the fields and vineyards. Don’t miss a shopping opportunity where you can buy cuckoo clocks and Swiss watches. Return to Zurich for dinner. Spend the night at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Zurich - Limmat River Cruise - Paris
itinerary.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast. Then, head to the prestigious Bois de Boulogne for a one-hour cruise on the Limmat River. Enjoy the panoramic view as the cruiser moves past some of the city’s most beautiful sights of Zurich’s old town. In the evening, return to Paris and spend the night in one of the most romantic cities in the world.

itinerary.title: Paris
itinerary.description: After breakfast, you will head to Disneyland, Europe’s most visited theme park. Return to the hotel to spend the night in Paris.

itinerary.title: Paris
itinerary.description: Today, after breakfast, you are free to explore the different markets, including the Les Puces de Saint-Ouen. Later, catch the flight to return home or continue with the next leg of your Europe tour package.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Singapore - Sentosa Island
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Singapore Changi Airport, our tour representatives will greet you and help you get to your hotel. Once you complete the check-in formalities, you can have lunch and then leave for Sentosa Island. Take a cable car ride and explore the various attractions, such as the Underwater World, Dolphin Lagoon, and Song of the Sea. Return to your hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: Singapore City Tour—Thian Hock Keng Temple—Merlion—Singapore Botanic Gardens
itinerary.description: Have a delicious breakfast in the morning before heading out to witness some of Singapore's most famous sightseeing spots. Start with the Thian Hock Keng Temple, the oldest Chinese temple in the country. Then, head to view the Merlion statue, which is among the most famous landmarks in Singapore. The Merlion is Singapore’s official mascot, with the mythical creature having the head of a lion and the body of a fish. Next, go to the Singapore Botanic Gardens. This 165-year-old tropical garden was Singapore’s first UNESCO World Heritage Site. The garden is home to about 3,000 species of tropical and subtropical plants. Spend the evening indulging in some retail therapy before returning to your hotel to spend the night.

itinerary.title: Universal Studios
itinerary.description: On the third day of your trip, you will be taken to a thrilling destination that will make the child in you come alive: Universal Studios. Situated within Resorts World Sentosa, Universal Studios is a theme park filled with exhilarating rides and enthralling shows. Having themed zones such as New York, Hollywood, Sci-Fi City, Ancient Egypt, The Lost World, Far Far Away, and Madagascar, this is the place where you can get a chance to meet some of your beloved fictional characters.

itinerary.title: Depart Singapore
itinerary.description: Check out of your hotel in the morning and visit a mall to satiate your shopaholic self before heading to the airport to board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Beijing
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at the Beijing Capital International Airport, you will be greeted by our tour representative, who will help you reach your hotel. After completing the check-in formalities and enjoying a welcome drink, you will be stepping out for a day of sightseeing. The first stop for the day is the Beijing National Stadium, which is also known as the Bird's Nest. The stadium was built to host the 2008 Summer Olympics and Paralympics and was also used for the 2022 Winter Olympics and Paralympics. This is where you will also get to witness the National Aquatics Center or Water Cube, which is a swimming center. Spend the night at your hotel.

itinerary.title: Beijing City Tour
itinerary.description: After having a delicious breakfast at your hotel, get dressed to experience some of the most popular attractions in Beijing. The Tiananmen Square is a city square consisting of the Monument to the People's Heroes, the National Museum of China, the Great Hall of the People, and the Mausoleum of Mao Zedong. From there, you will be heading to the Forbidden City, which is among the world’s biggest and most well-preserved wooden structures. The next stop is the Summer Palace, which is a conglomeration of palaces, gardens, and lakes. It’s where you can see the Marble Boat and the Long Corridor, a corridor that’s 728 metres long. Stop at the Hongqiao Market for a bit to shop for pearls and end the evening by attending a Gongfu tea ceremony to learn about the traditional Chinese tea preparation method.

itinerary.title: Beijing – Shanghai
itinerary.description: Start your morning with a filling breakfast, and then head out for an adventurous day. Get a glimpse of the art of jade carving at the Longdi Jade Factory. Next comes the Great Wall of China, a UNESCO World Heritage Site that was built to protect the Eurasian Steppe from several nomadic groups. This is where you can also see the Juyong Pass, a mountain pass that is 18 km long. Later in the evening, board a train to travel to Shanghai. Our tour representatives will meet you at the station and help you transfer to your hotel, where you can relax and spend the night.

itinerary.title: Shanghai City Tour
itinerary.description: Consume your breakfast and then venture out to explore the city of Shanghai. Start off with the Shanghai Museum, which has some of the finest art collections in China. Appease your shopaholic heart at People's Square, and make sure to visit the Silk Market. Take in the spectacular view of Yu Garden with its cloisters, ponds, rockeries, and pavilions. Shop for handicrafts, folk antiques, tea, and clothes at the Yuyuan Market. Explore the Bund, which is a protected historical district and waterfront area. Wrap up your evening by catching a cultural show on the Huangpu River Cruise.

itinerary.title: Depart Shanghai
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of your hotel and indulge in a bit of shopping. Once you are done, you will be driven to the Shanghai Pudong International Airport to board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Singapore – Night Safari
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at Singapore Changi Airport, our tour representatives will greet you and help you get to your hotel. Complete the check-in process and relax for a while. In the evening, you will visit the Night Safari, the world's first nocturnal zoo. Then, you will return to your hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: Sentosa Island - Thian Hock Keng Temple – Merlion - Singapore Botanic Gardens
itinerary.description: Today, you will visit some of the most popular sightseeing spots in Singapore. Start the day by visiting the Thian Hock Keng Temple, Singapore's oldest Chinese temple located in the heart of Chinatown. Then, visit the Merlion statue, based on a mythical creature with the head of a lion and the body of a fish. Walk around the Singapore Botanic Gardens, a 165-year-old tropical garden that was declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2015. Later in the day, head to Sentosa Island, where you can enjoy a cable car ride and explore its many attractions, including the Underwater World, Dolphin Lagoon, and Song of the Sea. Return to your hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: Universal Studios
itinerary.description: How about a day dedicated to exciting rides, entertaining shows, and meeting some of your beloved fictional characters? That’s exactly what you will get to experience at Universal Studios. Witness the theme park's themed zones such as New York, Hollywood, Sci-Fi City, Ancient Egypt, The Lost World, Far Far Away, and Madagascar.

itinerary.title: Singapore - Genting Highlands
itinerary.description: On the fourth day of your trip, transfer from Singapore to Genting Highlands on a luxury coach. Upon reaching Genting Highlands, you will get on a cruise where you can enjoy cocktails and a delicious meal. Spend the night aboard the Superstar Virgo.

itinerary.title: Genting SkyWorlds Theme Park - Kuala Lumpur
itinerary.description: You can reach the Genting SkyWorlds Theme Park in the morning, an amusement park with 9 themed worlds. Later in the day, you will move to Kuala Lumpur. On the way, visit the Batu Caves, a complex of limestone caves. As you reach Kuala Lumpur, check in to your hotel and enjoy a relaxing evening.

itinerary.title: Kuala Lumpur City Tour - King’s Palace - Petronas Twin Towers - National Monument
itinerary.description: On this day, you will explore some of the famous sightseeing spots in Kuala Lumpur. The first stop will be King’s Palace, which is considered the Malaysian version of Buckingham Palace. Next up are the iconic Petronas Twin Towers, which are the tallest twin towers in the world. Visit the National Mosque of Malaysia, the National Monument, and the Old Railway Station. Wrap up the sightseeing at the Royal Selangor Visitor Centre. Spend the evening engaging in some retail therapy, and then return to your hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: Depart Singapore
itinerary.description: Check out of your hotel in the morning and visit a mall to satiate your shopaholic self before heading to the airport to board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Colombo - Bentota
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at Colombo Bandaranaike International Airport, our tour representatives will greet you and help you get to your hotel in Bentota. Bentota is a coastal town on Sri Lanka's southwestern coast. Once you complete the check-in formalities, you can head out to enjoy a variety of water-based activities, such as water skiing, snorkelling, sea diving, banana rides, and windsurfing. You could also book a romantic river safari with our Sri Lanka educational trip package. Then, get back to your hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: Bentota Turtle Hatchery - New Paradise Spice & Herbal Garden - Colombo - Bandaranaike Memorial International Conference Hall
itinerary.description: After breakfast, leave Bentota and head for Colombo. On the way, visit a fish market and the Bentota Turtle Hatchery, which was established to protect and conserve endangered turtle species. You will also stop by the New Paradise Spice & Herbal Garden. Upon reaching your hotel in Colombo, you can finish the check-in process and then leave to visit the Bandaranaike Memorial International Conference Hall. This iconic convention centre hosts an eclectic array of important occasions and events.

itinerary.title: Colombo City Tour - Sri Kaileswaram Temple - Old Parliament Building - Gangaramaya Temple - Sea Street
itinerary.description: On the third day of your trip, you will be taken on a city tour of Colombo. Visit the oldest Hindu temple in Colombo, Sri Kaileswaram Temple, dedicated to Lord Shiva and Ganesha. The following stops will be the Old Parliament Building and the Gangaramaya Temple. The latter is a brilliant example of the perfect mix of cultural significance and modern architecture. You can shop for some gold jewellery at Sea Street in the evening before returning to your hotel.

itinerary.title: Depart Colombo
itinerary.description: Check out of your hotel in the morning and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrive In Bentota
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at the Bandaranaike International Airport in Colombo, our tour manager will welcome you and guide you to Bentota. Check into your hotel and spend the rest of the day enjoying the places in and around it. Spend the night in Bentota.

itinerary.title: Bentota City Tour
itinerary.description: Bentota is a resort town famous for its picturesque landscape and cultural attractions. Some of the attractions you will visit in Bentota include the Kande Viharaya Temple, Ventura Beach, and the Polgampola Waterfalls. Later, you will check out of the hotel and head to Colombo. Spend the night in Colombo.

itinerary.title: Colombo City Tour
itinerary.description: Sri Lanka’s capital city, Colombo, has a rich cultural heritage and is a melting pot of different cultures. Some of the attractions you will cover include the Gangaramaya Temple, Viharamahadevi Park, and the Kelaniya Raja Maha Viharaya. Don’t miss shopping at one of the many flea markets where you can buy spices, tea, handicrafts, Ayurveda products, and Batik wear. Spend the night in Colombo.

itinerary.title: Depart Colombo
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel and head to the airport to catch your flight to India.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Maldives
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at the Velana International Airport in Male, our tour manager will guide you to the ferry terminal to catch your speedboat and take you to Maafushi Island. The journey takes around 45 minutes and offers a panoramic view of the beautiful islands along the route. Check into the hotel and spend the rest of the day exploring places around the resort. You can also enjoy a candlelight dinner on the beach.

itinerary.title: Maafushi Island Tour
itinerary.description: Maafushi is Maldives’s most popular island, with plenty of world-class resorts offering a range of adventure activities, including water sports like snorkelling, scuba diving, swimming, dolphin safaris, and catamaran riding. You can also enjoy the local culture, shop at the local market and dine at a local restaurant. Spend the night in Maafushi.

itinerary.title: Maafushi Island Tour Day 2
itinerary.description: Today, you can continue with your adventure activities. You can either sign up for snorkelling with manta rays or go dolphin watching. Or you can rent a private boat to enjoy the tiny islands around Maafushi.

itinerary.title: Depart Maafushi
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head to the ferry terminal to return to Male. In the capital city of the Maldives, you can explore the many tourist attractions, including Sultan Park, the Artificial Beach, Rasfannu, and the Victory Monument. Later, catch your return flight to India.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Tahiti
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at the Tahiti International Airport, our tour manager will welcome you and help you transfer to the hotel. Complete check-in formalities and spend the day relaxing or enjoying the area around the hotel. Don’t miss the Fa’aruma’I Waterfalls and the Water Gardens Vaipahi. Spend the night in Tahiti.

itinerary.title: Bora Bora
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel and head to Tahiti Airport to catch your flight to Bora Bora. Check into the hotel and spend the rest of the day enjoying the resort's beautiful surroundings. Spend the night in Bora Bora.

itinerary.title: Bora Bora Day Tour
itinerary.description: Bora Bora is famous for its beaches and turquoise lagoons. Today, you will visit some of its iconic attractions, including Matira Beach and Otemanu, as well as the Vaitape neighbourhood. You can also enjoy adventure activities like snorkelling, scuba diving, whale watching, underwater walk, and parasailing. Spend the night at the resort.

itinerary.title: Bora Bora Tour Day 2
itinerary.description: Today, continue with your activities, including a full-day lagoon group tour. Don’t miss the lagoon cruise for a panoramic island view while sipping champagne. You can also opt to snorkel with sharks and stingrays. End the day with a jeep safari to explore the island’s jungles and wildlife. You can also sign up for an aqua safari to enjoy the island’s varied marine life. Spend the night at the resort.

itinerary.title: Depart Bora Bora
itinerary.description: Check out of the hotel and head to Tahiti to catch your return flight home.

packages.name: Mesmerizing New Zealand Tour
packages.destination: Auckland - Waitomo - Rotorua - Christchurch - Mt Cook - Queenstown - Fiji

itinerary.title: Arrive in Auckland
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival in Auckland, our tour representatives will greet you at the airport and help you get to your hotel. Complete the check-in formalities and spend the rest of the day at leisure.

itinerary.title: Auckland
itinerary.description: Get ready to explore the multicultural oasis of Auckland on this day. Start off with the Viaduct Harbour, situated at the heart of Auckland's waterfront, before making your way to the Auckland Harbour Bridge. You will also be taken to the Michael Joseph Savage Memorial Park to enjoy a spectacular panoramic view of the surroundings.

itinerary.title: Auckland - Waitomo – Rotorua
itinerary.description: Make your way through the Waikato area to get to Waitomo. Located on the North Island region of the country, the Waitomo Glowworm Caves are some of the most popular natural attractions in New Zealand. As you get on a boat ride through the glowworm grotto, you will be able to witness thousands of magical glowworms. Later in the day, head towards the city of Rotorua.

itinerary.title: Rotorua
itinerary.description: Known for its hot mud baths and geysers, the first place you will be uncovering in Rotorua is the Te Puia Thermal Reserve, which is a geothermal wonderland. Next stop is the theme park known as Agrodome, which is the largest farm experience in the country and is home to numerous adorable baby animals. Enjoy a Maori Hangi and Concert in the evening.

itinerary.title: Rotorua – Christchurch
itinerary.description: Board a flight to get transferred to the city of Christchurch, which is the largest city in the South Island of New Zealand.

itinerary.title: Christchurch - Mount Cook - Queenstown
itinerary.description: Dedicate this day to exploring Mount Cook, which is the tallest mountain in New Zealand. Make sure to visit Queenstown and relish its vineyards and adventure sports.

itinerary.title: Fiji
itinerary.description: Travel from Christchurch to Fiji after having your breakfast. Explore the Garden of the Sleeping Giant, a botanical garden situated in the middle of the country’s tropical landscape.

itinerary.title: Fiji
itinerary.description: After enjoying a delicious breakfast, you can spend the day as you like. You can choose to explore the charming Viseisei Village, which is Fiji’s oldest settlement.

itinerary.title: Depart Fiji
itinerary.description: Check out of your hotel after breakfast and make your way to the airport to board your flight back home.
