itinerary.title: Arrival in Auckland
itinerary.description: Welcome to the City of Sails! Upon your arrival in Auckland, our tour representatives will be there to greet you and arrange your transfer to the hotel. Take pleasure in your overnight accommodation in Auckland.

itinerary.title: Exploring Auckland's Urban Charms
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a delightful breakfast before immersing yourself in the enchanting wonders of Auckland. Your journey commences with a visit to the iconic Harbour Bridge, followed by a leisurely stroll along the Auckland Viaduct. The panoramic vistas of Auckland city and Waitemata Harbour await you at the tranquil Michael Joseph Savage Memorial Park.

itinerary.title: Waikato Wonders and Rotorua Revelations
itinerary.description: Today's adventure will take you through the picturesque Waikato region as you make your way to Waitomo. Here, you'll have the opportunity to marvel at the renowned Glowworm Caves, a truly mesmerising natural spectacle. Afterward, continue your voyage to the Mamaku Ranges, where you'll ultimately reach the captivating city of Rotorua.

itinerary.title: Rotorua
itinerary.description: Your day commences with a guided tour to the Te Puia Thermal Reserve, where you'll witness bubbling mud pools and erupting geysers. Afterward, proceed to Rainbow Springs to admire New Zealand's splendid trout, captivating wildlife, and a vibrant array of native birds. Conclude your day at the Agrodome for an authentic New Zealand farm experience, featuring cow milking, sheepdog demonstrations, and an introduction to the stars of the nation's sheep industry. The afternoon is yours to enjoy at your own pace. In the evening, an unforgettable Maori Hangi feast and concert await.

itinerary.title: Rotorua to Christchurch
itinerary.description: Today, you will board a domestic flight from Rotorua to Christchurch. Upon your arrival in Christchurch, you will be swiftly transferred to your chosen accommodation.

itinerary.title: Christchurch to Queenstown
itinerary.description: Venture across the picturesque Canterbury Plains, making a stop at Lake Tekapo and its iconic 'Church of the Good Shepherd.' Continue your journey towards New Zealand's loftiest peak, Mount Cook. From there, follow the tranquil shores of Lake Pukaki as you traverse the storied Central Otago region, ultimately arriving in the alpine wonderland of Queenstown.

itinerary.title: Milford Sound
itinerary.description: Begin your day with an early rise as the sun casts its first rays over the horizon. Set forth towards the southern shoreline of Lake Wakatipu, passing through Lumsden en route to Lake Te Anau. Continue your journey into the awe-inspiring Eglinton Valley, and traverse the remarkable Homer Tunnel, a testament to human ingenuity. This brings you to the magnificent Milford Sound, a world-renowned fiord graced by the imposing presence of Mitre Peak and the resplendent Bowen Falls. A delightful buffet lunch awaits you aboard the cruise. After a day of enchantment, return to the charming town of Queenstown.

itinerary.title: Queenstown
itinerary.description: Embrace the excitement of your eighth day with an array of heart-pounding activities at your disposal. From the exhilaration of bungy jumping to the thrill of white-water rafting, or the rush of a jet boat ride, there is no shortage of adventures to embark upon. For a more leisurely experience, ascend the gondola and savour panoramic views of this stunning region.

itinerary.title: Queenstown to Glacier Region
itinerary.description: Bid farewell to Queenstown as our experienced tour representatives guide you through the stunning landscapes. Travelling via Lake Wanaka and the Haast Pass, you'll venture into the heart of the West Coast's native forests, past rugged mountain ranges and shimmering lakes, until you reach the glacier region, where the Franz Josef and Fox Glaciers await your exploration.

itinerary.title: Glacier Region to Christchurch
itinerary.description: On this day, your journey will take you northward to Greymouth, where you'll board the TranzAlpine train (for seat in coach passengers exclusively). Traverse through the verdant beech forests, passing the quaint alpine village of Arthur's Pass, before embarking on a breathtaking journey across the magnificent Southern Alps. Continue your voyage over the picturesque Canterbury Plains until you reach Christchurch.

itinerary.title: Christchurch Exploration
itinerary.description: Today, our expert tour guide will lead you on a captivating exploration of Christchurch, visiting Monavale Gardens, the Arts Centre, the University, the Botanical Gardens, the Museum, and meandering along the serene Avon River.

itinerary.title: Farewell
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a hearty breakfast before making your way to the airport for your departure.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Auckland
itinerary.description: Welcome to the enchanting City of Sails! Upon your arrival in Auckland, our dedicated tour representatives will warmly greet you and escort you to your hotel. Settle in and relish your overnight stay in this vibrant city.

itinerary.title: Auckland Exploration
itinerary.description: Following a delightful breakfast, prepare for a captivating day exploring the city of Auckland. Your itinerary includes a visit to the remarkable Kelly Tarlton's Underwater World and the Antarctic Encounter. The day concludes with a comfortable overnight stay in Auckland.

itinerary.title: Auckland to Waitomo to Rotorua
itinerary.description: As the day unfolds, you will head south through the lush Waikato region to reach the enchanting Waitomo. Immerse yourself in the mesmerising Glowworm Caves, where a captivating underground boat ride awaits. Later, make your way to Rotorua for an indulgent overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Rotorua to Queenstown
itinerary.description: Join our courteous tour representatives for a journey to the Te Puia Thermal Reserve, where you'll witness the spectacle of bubbling mud pools and thunderous geysers. Continue your exploration with a visit to Rainbow Springs, where New Zealand's treasured trout, birds, and wildlife come to life. Afterwards, embrace the rural charm at the Agrodome, where a New Zealand farm show unfolds, featuring cow milking, sheepdog demonstrations, and an introduction to the stars of our sheep industry. In the afternoon, board a domestic flight from Rotorua to Queenstown.

itinerary.title: Milford Sound
itinerary.description: Begin your day with an early rise, as the sun casts its gentle glow over the landscape. Venture southward along the shores of Lake Wakatipu to Lumsden, the journey onward to the serene Lake Te Anau. Traverse the awe-inspiring Eglinton Valley and pass through the remarkable Homer Tunnel, a testament to human engineering, before reaching the spectacular Milford Sound. Here, you'll have the opportunity to partake in a cruise along this world-renowned fiord, where the imposing presence of Mitre Peak and the mesmerising Bowen Falls command your attention. Savour a sumptuous buffet lunch aboard the vessel before making your way back to Queenstown.

itinerary.title: Queenstown
itinerary.description: The sixth day is a grand invitation to experience exhilaration in its purest form. Dive into a world of adventure, where options abound. Whether it's testing your mettle with bungy jumping, navigating the thrilling rapids via white water rafting, skimming over the waters on a jet boat, or ascending gracefully on gondola rides, Queenstown presents a plethora of heart-pounding choices.

itinerary.title: Depart from Queenstown
itinerary.description: Conclude your journey with a delightful breakfast, and then make your way to the airport for your departure. As the remarkable memories of your New Zealand expedition linger in your heart, bid Queenstown a fond farewell.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Sri Lanka – Kandy
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Bandaranaike International Airport, our tour representatives will greet you and help you transfer to Kandy. Once you reach your hotel, complete the check-in formalities and get some rest after you freshen up. Visit the Royal Botanic Gardens, which is famous for its impressive collection of orchids while also housing over 4000 species of plants, such as spices, palm trees, and medicinal plants. You can then offer your prayers at the Sri Dalada Maligawa or Temple of the Tooth, which is known to contain the relic of the tooth of Lord Buddha.

itinerary.title: Kandy – Bentota
itinerary.description: On this day, you will be leaving Kandy and heading to the coastal town of Bentota. Complete the check-in process at your hotel in Bentota, after which you can enjoy a myriad of adventurous activities, such as banana boating, kitesurfing, speed boating, windsurfing, and so on.

itinerary.title: Bentota
itinerary.description: After enjoying a delicious breakfast, you can go to the Turtle Hatchery, which was built to protect the turtles from going extinct. Various kinds of turtle species are found at this hatchery, keeping the eggs safe and caring for them so they aren’t sold off by fishermen. Visit the spice gardens and then spend the rest of the day indulging in watersports.

itinerary.title: Bentota - Colombo
itinerary.description: Relish a scrumptious breakfast at your hotel in Bentota, from where you will be moving towards Colombo, the capital of Sri Lanka. View the temples, colonial buildings, and residential areas in the city before visiting the Bandaranaike Memorial International Conference Hall. Stay the night at your hotel in Colombo.

itinerary.title: Depart Sri Lanka
itinerary.description: Lounge around your hotel for a while after breakfast, post which you can leave for the airport to board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Sri Lanka – Kandy
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Bandaranaike International Airport, you will be greeted by our tour representatives, who will help you transfer to the city of Kandy. After reaching your hotel and completing the check-in formalities, you can freshen up and relax for a while. Once you feel well-rested, head out to explore the beautiful spots in Kandy. Witness the beauty of the Royal Botanic Gardens, which is home to over 4000 species of plants and a wide collection of orchids. Make your way to Sri Dalada Maligawa, also known as Temple of the Tooth, as it houses the relic of the tooth of Lord Buddha. Spend the night at your hotel in Kandy.

itinerary.title: Kandy - Nuwara Eliya
itinerary.description: After enjoying a delicious breakfast, leave Kandy to head towards Nuwara Eliya. Known as the Little England of Sri Lanka, Nuwara Eliya is filled with red bricked buildings and fairy tale cottages, giving the city a magical vibe. Head out for some sightseeing in Nuwara Eliya after the check-in formalities are complete at your hotel. Pay your respects at the Shri Bhakta Hanuman Temple, which as built by the Chinmaya Mission of Sri Lanka. Visit a tea factory before making your way to the Seetha Amman Temple and Horton Plains National Park.

itinerary.title: Nuwara Eliya – Colombo
itinerary.description: On this day, have a filling breakfast and leave for Colombo from Nuwara Eliya. The capital city of Sri Lanka is brimming with temples and colonial buildings, all of which you will see along with its residential areas. Make sure to visit the Bandaranaike Memorial International Conference Hall, a convention centre that hosts a variety of important events.

itinerary.title: Depart Sri Lanka
itinerary.description: Check out of your hotel after having your breakfast. Make your way to the airport to board your flight back home, carrying a bunch of wonderful memories.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Sri Lanka - Kandy
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Bandaranaike International Airport, our tour representatives will greet you and help you get to your hotel in Kandy. Complete the check-in formalities and relax for a while after freshening up. Start your tour of Kandy by visiting the Royal Botanical Gardens, which is spread over an area of 147 acres and houses over 4000 species of plants. Next, go to the Temple of the Tooth Relic, also known as Sri Dalada Maligawa, which has the relic of the tooth of Lord Buddha.

itinerary.title: Kandy - Bentota
itinerary.description: Relish a scrumptious breakfast in the morning, and then head for Bentota. Upon reaching the hotel and completing the check-in formalities, leave to enjoy a bunch of adventurous activities, such as parasailing, windsurfing, jet skiing, banana boating, and kitesurfing. Spend the night at your hotel in Bentota.

itinerary.title: Bentota - Colombo
itinerary.description: During the day, leave for Colombo from Bentota. Colombo is the capital of Sri Lanka and also its largest city. On this day, explore the Bandaranaike Memorial International Conference Hall (BMICH), which is a convention centre built in honour of Solomon West Ridgeway Dias Bandaranaike.

itinerary.title: Depart Sri Lanka
itinerary.description: After having a filling breakfast, check out of your hotel and leave for the airport to board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Bentota - Colombo

itinerary.title: Colombo City Tour

Witness the Old Parliament Building, which is home to the Presidential Secretariat of Sri Lanka. Offer your prayers at the Hindu and Buddhist temples in the city. Post getting done with your lunch, proceed to satiate your shopaholic self at spots like House of Fashion, Majestic City, Odel, Noritake Factory Store, Sea Street, and more.

itinerary.title: Depart Sri Lanka

itinerary.title: Colombo City Tour
itinerary.description: Enjoy a delicious breakfast and spend the day at leisure. Head out later in the day to shop at spots like House of Fashion, Majestic City, Odel, and Noritake Factory Store. You can also visit Sea Street and shop for some jewellery. Get back to the hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: Depart Colombo

packages.name: Cambodia Grand Tour
packages.destination: Phnom Penh - Phnom Penh Exploration - Siem Reap - Siem Reap Exploration

itinerary.title: Arrive in Phnom Penh
itinerary.description: Upon arriving in Phnom Penh, you will be greeted by our tour representative at the airport, who will help you get to your hotel. After the check-in formalities have been completed, you can freshen up and head out. The first sightseeing spot on your trip will be the Royal Palace of Cambodia, a complex of buildings that is the official residence of the King of Cambodia. Visit the Silver Pagoda situated on the southern side of the palace, containing a life-sized gold Buddha adorned with 2,086 diamonds. Next stop is the Independence Monument which was built to celebrate the independence of Cambodia from France. Explore the National Museum of Cambodia, which is reputed to be the largest museum of cultural history in Cambodia. After passing the river-front park, which is a meeting point of four rivers, you can journey up to the Buddhist temple known as Wat Phnom. Stay overnight at your hotel.

itinerary.title: Phnom Penh City Tour
itinerary.description: Begin the second day of your trip by visiting the Tuol Sleng Genocide Museum. It’s a museum that tells the story of the Cambodian genocide. The spot was formerly a secondary school and was utilised by the Khmer Rouge regime as Security Prison 21 from 1975 until 1979. Get excited to shop your heart away at the Russian Market, one of the largest and most beloved markets in Phnom Penh. You can get your hands on paintings, artworks, silk fabrics, purses, Buddha statues, wood carvings, and wooden handicrafts at this market. End the day with a delicious dinner before your overnight stay at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Phnom Penh - Siem Reap
itinerary.description: In the morning, board a flight to get to Siem Reap, Cambodia’s second-largest city. Check in to your hotel and then head out to Angkor, which is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The sites you will be exploring during the day are Prasat Kravan, Srah Srang, and Banteay Srei. Visit the Banteay Samre, a temple that was built in the early 11th century and has been through thorough renovation for the purpose of preservation. Check out one of the oldest and biggest pagodas in Siem Reap, known as Wat Bo Pagoda. Experience a mesmerising dance performance at the Apsara Theatre while having your dinner.

itinerary.title: Siem Reap City Tour
itinerary.description: Today, you will engage in a different way of moving around Siem Reap as our tour guide will present you with bikes that will allow you to explore the streets of the city in a breezier manner. Once you reach Angkor Wat, lay your eyes on the vast array of temples, including Angkor Thom, South Gate, Bayon Temple, and Baphuon Temple. You will also be taken to the Terrace of the Leper King and the Terrace of the Elephants. Spend your evening exploring Siem Reap's nightlife and shopping at the Angkor Night Market. You can also go for a relaxing foot massage before turning in for the night.

itinerary.title: Depart Siem Reap
itinerary.description: Start early in the morning to catch a beautiful sunrise in the Angkor area. Set out on a boat ride to Tonle Sap Lake. Get an insight into traditional Khmer craftsmanship at Artisans Angkor before heading to the airport to board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Rovaniemi
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at the Rovaniemi International Airport, our tour manager will welcome you and help you transfer to the hotel. Complete the check-in formalities and spend the rest of the evening enjoying places around the hotel. We suggest you complete dinner early as the kitchen will likely be closed after you return from the Northern Lights Safari. The next activity on your itinerary is the Reindeer Safari, where a reindeer-led sleigh will pull you to view aurora borealis and not leave until it is over. It’s an indescribable and magical experience to enjoy the sleigh being pulled by the reindeer. Please note that the Northern Lights vary in appearance; we might adjust the tour accordingly. The experience also involves meeting local reindeer herders to understand their daily lives and how they adjust to nature. You can feed reindeers while enjoying warm drinks and buns and stories about reindeer herding and life in Lapland. The entire activity takes around 3 to 4 hours, including transfers. Spend the night in Rovaniemi.

itinerary.title: Santa Claus Village and Snowmobile Safari
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a delicious breakfast and spend the next few hours at leisure, enjoying the scenic view from the hotel. Your next activity begins in the afternoon when you visit Santa Claus Village, an amusement park in Rovaniemi. Activities at the park vary depending on the season you visit. For instance, during summer, you can enjoy the midnight sun or hike along the Koivusaari Nature Trail. During winter, you can enjoy a horse sleigh ride, go forest ice skating, ride a snowmobile, or enjoy a once-in-a-lifetime experience of a polar night. Regardless of when you visit, you will surely be mesmerised by the Taiga forests and their numerous trails. The tour includes enjoying a picnic around a bonfire and waiting for the Northern Lights to appear. You can also enjoy some Finnish makkara sausages served with Lappish berry juice. You’ll end the tour with a snowmobile tour lasting around an hour and 30 minutes. Two adults ride on one snowmobile, with extra charges for a single ride. The tour is suitable for families and children.

itinerary.title: Snowshoe Hike
itinerary.description: Enjoy the day after a heavy breakfast buffet. You will leave for a snowshoe hike to the Wilderness Lodge in the evening. This is a beautiful experience where you’ll enjoy gazing at the clear stars and moon while finding a way in the darkness. Did you know snowshoeing is a great way to enjoy the wilderness in the Lapland? Wilderness Lodge is a traditional lumberjack manor beside the beautiful Raudanjoki River. You’ll cross the bridge over the river to enjoy the frozen rapids. This is a great place to enjoy the Northern Lights. While snowshoes are manageable, you will get assistance using the equipment. We’ll also provide warm clothing for the hiking. During the tour, you’ll break for hot chocolate and sweet bun refreshments beside an open fire.

itinerary.title: Northern Lights Hunting By The Bus
itinerary.description: Enjoy the day lounging around, waiting for the evening tour to take you to Northern Lights Hunting. We’ll cover all the possible areas where you will see the Northern Lights. Don’t forget to carry your camera to capture these beautiful colours. The Northern Lights become clearer as we move away from the city where there’s less light and the sky is clear.

itinerary.title: Depart Rovaniemi
itinerary.description: Bid adieu to the beautiful Lapland and the Arctic Circle as you catch your flight to return home.

Exploring Doha, Desert Safar, Mia Tour and More | Itinerary

itinerary.title: Arrival in Doha with Optional Dhow Cruise
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Hamad International Airport, renowned as one of the finest airports in the world, you will be cordially welcomed by a local representative who will provide assistance with your transfer service. The journey from the airport to your chosen Doha hotel is a brief one, taking no more than 30 minutes under typical conditions, owing to Doha's meticulously planned urban layout. Your accommodation has been thoughtfully selected to provide you with the utmost convenience in the heart of the city. You may check in at 1400 hours and take a moment to unwind. The remainder of the day is yours to savour at your leisure. Your overnight stay will be at your chosen Doha hotel.

itinerary.title: Doha – City Tour and Desert Safari
itinerary.description: Embark on a comprehensive city tour, guided by a professional English-speaking chauffeur, offering a captivating glimpse of this burgeoning metropolis. Begin your excursion with a drive through The Pearl Qatar, an exquisite man-made residential island that draws inspiration from some of the world's most enchanting cities, such as Venice. Here, you will encounter an array of world-class residential apartments, a picturesque marina, premium shopping centres, and charming boulevards. Continue your journey with a visit to the Katara Cultural Village, a complex that celebrates art, culture, and a scenic beach promenade. This destination is another must-see gem of Doha. Your tour will then lead you through the bustling commercial heart of West Bay, onward to the Doha Corniche, and to the iconic Museum of Islamic Art, a breathtaking monument situated along the Corniche. Be sure to capture a photograph of this iconic landmark and take a leisurely stroll through MIA Park, which offers spectacular views of the sea. In the later part of the day, prepare yourself for an exhilarating adventure amidst the attractive sand dunes. Get ready for an adrenaline-pumping experience as our skilled desert driver takes you on a thrilling ride, navigating the undulating dunes. Your overnight stay will be at your selected Doha hotel.

itinerary.title: Doha – A Day of Leisure with Optional Mia Tour, Souq Waqif, and National Museum of Qatar
itinerary.description: Today, the day beckons for leisurely exploration of this captivating city on your own. For those seeking an enriching experience, consider the optional MIA Tour, a journey through the Museum of Islamic Art that promises to consume two hours of your day. This cubistic pyramid structure emerges gracefully from the creamy turquoise waters of the Persian Gulf, an architectural marvel that invites visitors to admire the unwavering Islamic traditions within a kingdom that passionately embraces modernity, transforming into a Middle East Goliath. Alternatively, you may choose the optional Dhow Cruise with a charming corniche walk, a two-hour adventure aboard a traditional wooden sailing boat that was once a staple for merchants but has now evolved to offer modern amenities for the comfort of tourists. As the sun sets over Doha, embark on a serene voyage across the teal waters of the Arabian Gulf, aboard a "dhow," the traditional Qatari sailing vessel once favoured by merchants and fishermen. Should you seek to delve into the rich cultural tapestry of Qatar, the optional Heritage Market Tour awaits you at Souq Waqif, translating to the "standing market." Here, you will discover the Falcon Souq, Spice Souq, Pet Souq, Gold Souq, Handicraft Souq, and Art Gallery, each offering a unique glimpse into the heritage of this land. Bedouins and locals of old would gather along the riverbanks, engaging in the exchange of diverse goods, from fragrant spices to precious wood. Another option for your day's expedition is the National Museum of Qatar, a two-hour sojourn that unravels the singular narrative of Qatar and its people, spanning from ancient times to the present and beyond. The museum artfully organises its exhibits into three "chapters" - Beginnings, Life in Qatar, and The Modern History of Qatar, each theme presented across eleven distinct galleries. This extraordinary edifice also embraces the newly restored Palace of Sheikh Abdullah bin Jassim Al-Thani. Conclude your day of exploration with an overnight stay at your hotel in Doha.Tour Schedule: Afternoon, Sundays, Mondays, Wednesdays, Thursdays, and Saturdays.

itinerary.title: Departure from Doha
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a delightful breakfast at the hotel, and kindly note that the standard check-out time is 12:00. Late check-out is subject to availability and additional charges may apply. You will be warmly greeted by a driver at the hotel and transferred to the airport for your departure.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Zurich
itinerary.description: Arrive at Zurich Airport. Take a train to Interlaken and check in to your hotel. Enjoy the rest of the day at leisure to explore Interlaken or relax. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Interlaken.

itinerary.title: Interlaken – Mount Jungfraujoch
itinerary.description: Take a day trip to Mount Jungfraujoch, known as the "Top of Europe". Travel by train from Interlaken to Grindelwald. Board the Jungfrau Railway, which takes you to the summit of Jungfraujoch. Marvel at the stunning alpine scenery, visit the Ice Palace and enjoy various activities like snowboarding or skiing (depending on the season). Return to Interlaken in the evening.

itinerary.title: Interlaken to Mount Rigi
itinerary.description: Take a day trip to Mount Rigi, also known as the "Queen of the Mountains". Travel from Interlaken to Lucerne by train. From Lucerne, take a boat. Go up Mount Rigi on Europe’s first mountain railway. Enjoy panoramic views from the summit, go for a hike, or take a leisurely stroll around the mountain. Return by cable car to Weggis and a direct boat to Lucerne. From Lucerne, take the train to Interlaken. Stay overnight at a luxury hotel in Interlaken.

itinerary.title: Rhine Falls Excursion
itinerary.description: Check out of your hotel and take a train to Zurich. Check into the hotel. Visit the Rhine Falls, the largest and the most spectacular waterfall in Europe. Travel by train from Interlaken to Schaffhausen. Upon arrival, visit the Rhine Falls and enjoy the impressive views. Take a boat ride to get closer to the falls if you wish. Return to Zurich in the evening.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Arrive at Zurich Airport for your departure. Or Continue your journey to Switzerland & Europe with our customized holiday packages.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Siem Reap
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at the Siem Reap International Airport, you will be greeted by our tour manager who will help you reach your hotel. Complete the check-in formalities and venture out for a day of sightseeing. Your first stop will be Angkor, which is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and is considered to be one of the most vital archaeological sites to exist in Southeast Asia. Visit the sacred temple of Ta Prohm which was designed in the Bayon style during the late 12th century and early 13th century. Head over to see Srah Srang, a lake that is 700 metres long. Next up, the Buddhist temple known as Banteay Kdei awaits your visit before you witness the Thommanon Temple and Chau Say Tevoda. Enjoy the grace of an Apsara Dance while having your dinner before heading back to your hotel.

itinerary.title: Angkor Wat - Terrace of the Leper King - Bakheng Hill
itinerary.description: Travel in a unique and fun way today, as you will be given bikes to explore the lanes of Siem Reap. The first destination will be the iconic Hindu-Buddhist temple complex known as Angkor Wat. This is where you will get to see various temples, such as the Bayon Temple, Angkor Thom South Gate, and Baphuon Temple. Explore the Royal Residence, the Terrace of the Elephants, and the Terrace of the Leper King before being taken to Phnom Bakheng. Head to the downtown region of Siem Reap to have a scrumptious dinner and get a relaxing foot massage. You can choose to shop around at the Angkor Night Market or explore the pubs and clubs in the area.

itinerary.title: Banteay Srei - Wat Bo Pagoda
itinerary.description: Begin your day by visiting Banteay Srei, a temple dedicated to Lord Shiva. Later on, board a Tonle Sap Cruise to lay your eyes on floating villages, stilted houses, and the crocodile farm. Visit Artisans Angkor to learn about the process of making silk. You will then be taken to one of the oldest and biggest pagodas in Siem Reap, Wat Bo Pagoda. End the day with a delicious dinner and a restful night’s sleep.

itinerary.title: Depart Siem Reap
itinerary.description: After finishing your breakfast, check out of your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Zurich - Transfer to Lucerne
itinerary.description: Arrive at Zurich Airport and meet your tour representative. Transfer to Lucerne, a picturesque city located in the heart of Switzerland. Check-in at your hotel and spend the rest of the day at leisure, exploring the city on your own. Stroll along the beautiful Lake Lucerne or visit the famous Chapel Bridge. A cruise on Lake Lucerne is equally popular. Don’t miss the tour to Bern. Overnight stay in Lucerne.

itinerary.title: Lucerne - Mount Titlis Excursion
itinerary.description: After breakfast, embark on a full-day excursion to Mount Titlis, one of Switzerland's most famous mountain destinations. Take a scenic drive through the Swiss countryside to Engelberg, the base of Mount Titlis. Ride the rotating cable car to the summit and enjoy breathtaking views of the surrounding snow-capped peaks. Visit the Glacier Cave and walk on the Cliff Walk, Europe's highest suspension bridge. Don't miss the Ice Flyer, a chair lift ride offering a panoramic view of the surrounding glaciers. In the afternoon, return to Lucerne and spend the rest of the day at leisure. Overnight stay in Lucerne.

itinerary.title: Lucerne - Zurich
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out from your hotel in Lucerne. Transfer to Zurich, Switzerland's largest city and financial hub. Upon arrival, embark on a guided city tour of Zurich, where you will visit the famous Bahnhofstrasse, Lake Zurich, the Old Town, and the iconic churches. Enjoy some free time for shopping or exploring the city further. Overnight stay in Zurich.

itinerary.title: Rhine Falls Excursion
itinerary.description: After breakfast, proceed on a half-day excursion to the Rhine Falls, Europe's largest waterfall. Experience the power of the falls up close as you take a boat ride to the rock in the middle of the falls. Enjoy the stunning natural beauty and capture memorable photos. In the afternoon, return to Zurich and spend the rest of the day leisurely. You can visit some museums and flea markets or enjoy a leisurely stroll along the banks of Lake Zurich. Overnight stay in Zurich.

itinerary.title: Departure from Zurich
itinerary.description: Enjoy a delicious breakfast at the hotel. Check out and transfer to Zurich Airport for your departure flight, marking the end of your Switzerland tour.

packages.destination: Switzerland - Interlaken - Jungfraujoch - Zermatt - Gornergrat - lucerne - Zurich

itinerary.title: Arrival in Zurich - Interlaken
itinerary.description: Arrive at Zurich Airport and take a train to Interlaken. Check in at your hotel and spend the rest of the day exploring the town. Visit the beautiful Hoheweg promenade and enjoy the scenic views of the surrounding mountains. Go shopping for souvenirs, Swiss watches, meteorological instruments, etc. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Interlaken.

itinerary.title: Interlaken - Jungfrau
itinerary.description: Take an excursion to Jungfraujoch, the "Top of Europe." Board a train from Interlaken Ost to Grindelwald From there, transfer to the Jungfrau Railway and ascend to Jungfraujoch on a cogwheel train. Enjoy panoramic views of the Swiss Alps, visit the Ice Palace, and experience the Alpine Sensation exhibition. Return to Interlaken and spend the evening at your leisure.

itinerary.title: Interlaken - Zermatt
itinerary.description: Travel from Interlaken to Zermatt, a picturesque Alpine village. Take a train through the scenic Swiss countryside and enjoy breathtaking views. Arrive in Zermatt and check in at your hotel. Explore the car-free village, visit the Matterhorn Museum, and take in the stunning views of the iconic Matterhorn peak. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Zermatt.

itinerary.title: Zermatt - Gornergrat
itinerary.description: Embark on a journey to Gornergrat, one of the most spectacular viewpoints in the Swiss Alps. Board the Gornergrat Bahn, a cogwheel railway, and ascend to the summit. Enjoy panoramic views of the surrounding peaks, including the Matterhorn. Take a leisurely hike or simply soak in the incredible scenery. Return to Zermatt and spend the evening at your leisure.

itinerary.title: Zermatt - Lucerne
itinerary.description: Travel from Zermatt to Lucerne(via Brig and Bern), a charming city nestled on the shores of Lake Lucerne. Take a train through scenic landscapes and picturesque Swiss towns. Arrive in Lucerne and check in at your hotel. Explore the city's famous landmarks, such as the Chapel Bridge, Lion Monument, and Old Town. Take a boat ride on Lake Lucerne and enjoy the serene beauty of the surroundings. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Lucerne.

itinerary.title: Lucerne - Mt. Titlis
itinerary.description: Take a day trip to Mt. Titlis, a stunning mountain in the Swiss Alps. Travel to Engelberg and ascend to the summit of Mt. Titlis via cable car. Experience the thrilling Titlis Rotair, the world's first revolving cable car. Explore the Ice Palace, enjoy snow activities, and take in the panoramic views from the summit. Return to Lucerne and spend the evening at your leisure.

itinerary.title: Departure from Zurich
itinerary.description: Travel from Lucerne to Zurich by train. If time permits, you can explore Zurich and visit its famous attractions, such as the Old Town, Lake Zurich, and Bahnhofstrasse. Depart from Zurich Airport for your onward journey.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Zurich
itinerary.description: Arrive at Zurich Airport and take a train from Zurich to Lucerne. Check-in at your hotel. Spend the day exploring the city at your leisure. Explore Lucerne's beautiful Old Town, Chapel Bridge, and Lion Monument. Take a boat ride on Lake Lucerne and enjoy the scenic views. Overnight stay in Lucerne.

itinerary.title: Lucerne to Mount Titlis
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out from your hotel and travel to Engelberg by train. Take the Rotair cable car, the world’s first revolving cable car and enjoy a 360-degree view of the mountains, glaciers, and valleys in the Black Forest region. At 10,000 ft. above sea level, Mount Titlis is covered in snow all year round, including during the summer months.

itinerary.title: Lucerne - Interlaken
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out and travel to Interlaken by train. Upon arrival, explore the town and enjoy activities like paragliding or river rafting. In the evening, take a leisurely stroll along Interlaken's main street. Overnight stay in Interlaken.

itinerary.title: Jungfraujoch Excursion
itinerary.description: Embark on a day trip to Jungfraujoch, also known as the "Top of Europe." Travel by train to Kleine Scheidegg, and then board the Jungfrau Railway to the summit. Enjoy panoramic views, visit the Ice Palace, and explore the Sphinx Observatory. Return to Interlaken for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Interlaken – Bern City Tour
itinerary.description: Interlaken is a dream destination for adventure lovers. You can sign up for a helicopter ride for an aerial view of the city. Or go bungee jumping. Take the train to Bern in the afternoon for a city tour with attractions including the Rose Garden, Clock Tower, the Cathedral of Bern, etc. Take a train back to Interlaken. Spend the night in a luxury hotel in Interlaken.

itinerary.title: Interlaken – Zurich
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out and travel to Zurich by train. Check into your hotel. Visit the world’s famous Rhine Falls. Spend the day exploring Zurich’s cobbled streets, flea markets, and museums.

itinerary.title: Zurich Departure
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out from your hotel and travel back to Zurich by train. If time allows, visit the Swiss National Museum or take a leisurely walk around the city. Transfer to Zurich Airport for your departure.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Interlaken
itinerary.description: Arrival in Interlaken. Check into your hotel and freshen up. Explore Interlaken's city center. Visit Hoheweg, the main street, lined with shops, restaurants, and cafes. Enjoy some local cuisine for lunch. Take a leisurely stroll along the beautiful Interlaken promenade, located between Lake Thun and Lake Brienz. Enjoy the stunning views of the surrounding mountains. Indulge in a relaxing dinner at one of the local restaurants. Consider trying traditional Swiss dishes like fondue or raclette.

itinerary.title: Interlaken Full Day City Tour
itinerary.description: Take a day trip to Jungfraujoch, the "Top of Europe." Board the scenic train from Interlaken to Kleine Scheidegg, and then transfer to the Jungfrau Railway, which takes you to the highest railway station in Europe. Explore the attractions at Jungfraujoch, including the Sphinx Observatory, Ice Palace, and various observation decks. Enjoy the panoramic views of the Swiss Alps and surrounding glaciers. Descend back to Interlaken in the afternoon. Relax and enjoy the amenities of your hotel. Consider visiting a local spa or taking a walk by the lakeside.

itinerary.title: Half Day City Tour of Interlaken
itinerary.description: Embark on a day trip to Schynige Platte. Take a scenic cogwheel train from Wilderswil to Schynige Platte, enjoying breathtaking views along the way. Explore the Alpine Garden, which showcases over 600 species of plants native to the region. Take a leisurely walk on the trails and enjoy the fresh mountain air. Descend back to Interlaken and spend the afternoon exploring the town at your own pace. You can visit the Interlaken Casino, go shopping for souvenirs, or try some adventure activities like paragliding or river rafting. Enjoy a farewell dinner at a local restaurant, savoring the delicious Swiss cuisine.

itinerary.title: Cappadocia
itinerary.description: Arrive at Kayseri or Nevsehir Airport. Meet your tour guide and transfer to your hotel in Cappadocia. Check in and freshen up. Start your exploration of Cappadocia with a visit to the Göreme Open-Air Museum, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Explore the rock-cut churches, chapels, and monasteries with stunning frescoes. Enjoy panoramic views of the unique Cappadocian landscape from the museum's viewpoints. Enjoy a delicious dinner at a local restaurant and experience Turkish nightlife, including local folk and belly dancers. Snacks and drinks are included.

itinerary.title: Cappadocia
itinerary.description: Optional hot air balloon ride: Experience the magical sunrise over Cappadocia from a hot air balloon (optional and subject to weather conditions). After breakfast, head to the Devrent Valley, also known as Imagination Valley, and admire the unusual rock formations resembling animals and objects. Continue to Pasabag (Monks Valley) and see the unique mushroom-shaped rock formations. Visit the town of Urgup and explore its charming streets and local market. Explore the Kaymakli Underground City, one of Cappadocia's largest and most impressive underground cities.: Enjoy a traditional Turkish dinner accompanied by live folk music and dance performances.

itinerary.title: Depart Cappadocia
itinerary.description: Take an early morning hike in Rose Valley and enjoy the beautiful scenery. Visit Uchisar Castle, a natural rock fortress offering panoramic views of the region. Afternoon: Visit the picturesque town of Ortahisar and explore its historic castle and charming streets. In the evening, transfer to the airport for your departure or continue your journey to other destinations in Turkey.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Zurich and Transfer to Engelberg
itinerary.description: Arrive at Zurich Airport and proceed to Engelberg. Check into your hotel and take some time to relax. In the afternoon, explore Engelberg. Visit the famous Benedictine monastery and enjoy the scenic beauty of the Swiss Alps. Overnight stay in Engelberg.

itinerary.title: Engelberg Lucerne- Engerlberg
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and travel to Lucerne, located approximately 45 minutes away. Take a cable car ride up to Mount Titlis for breathtaking views and various outdoor activities. Once in Lucerne, explore the iconic Chapel Bridge (Kapellbrücke) and the Water Tower (Wasserturm). Explore the picturesque Old Town with its cobbled streets and historic buildings. Return to Engelberg for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Engelberg to Basel
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and travel to Basel. Upon arrival in Basel, explore the city's rich cultural heritage and vibrant art scene. Visit the Basel Minster (Basler Münster), a stunning Gothic cathedral, and walk through the charming Old Town. Explore the numerous museums, such as the Kunstmuseum Basel or the Fondation Beyeler, which house impressive art collections. Stroll along the Rhine River and enjoy the city's beautiful architecture and lively atmosphere. Overnight stay in Basel.

itinerary.title: Basel – Zurich – Schaffhausen
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and travel to Zurich, which is approximately a 1.5-hour journey. Once in Zurich, embark on a city tour to discover its modern and historical attractions. Visit the Old Town (Altstadt) with its well-preserved medieval buildings, narrow streets, and charming cafés. Explore cultural landmarks such as Grossmünster, Fraumünster, and the Swiss National Museum. Visit Schaffhausen, known for its stunning Rhine Falls, the largest waterfall in Europe, well-preserved old town, and charming architecture. Return to Zurich to enjoy some shopping on Bahnhofstrasse, one of the world's most exclusive shopping streets. In the evening, take a relaxing walk along Lake Zurich and enjoy the beautiful waterfront. Overnight stay in Zurich.

itinerary.title: Depart Zurich
itinerary.description: Depart from Zurich. You can either catch your flight back home or extend your stay in Zurich if you have more time.

packages.name: Wellington Tour Packages
packages.destination: Auckland - Auckland Sightseeing - Waitomo - Rotorua - Wellington - Picton - Kaikoura - Christchurch - Mt Cook - Queenstown - Milford Sound - Queenstown - Glacier Region - Greymouth - Christchurch

itinerary.title: Auckland Arrival
itinerary.description: Welcome to the captivating City of Sails! When you arrive in Auckland, our friendly tour representatives will greet you. After check-in, explore places around the hotel. It's the perfect start to your adventure in this vibrant city, where every corner holds a discovery.

itinerary.title: Auckland- City Tour
itinerary.description: Rise and shine to a hearty breakfast because today is all about exploring the heart of Auckland. Some areas you’ll cover include iconic landmarks like the Harbour Bridge, Auckland Viaduct, and the Michael Joseph Savage Memorial Park. As you stand atop the memorial park, take in the breathtaking panoramic views of Auckland City and the sparkling Waitemata Harbour. It's a day filled with awe-inspiring sights and the promise of exciting discoveries around every corner. Get ready to be captivated by the charm of Auckland!

itinerary.title: Auckland- Waitomo- Rotorua
itinerary.description: Travel from Auckland to Waitomo. You’ll be crossing through the scenic Waikato region. Immerse yourself in the enchanting world of the famous Glowworm Caves, where the mystical glow of thousands of tiny creatures illuminates the underground world. After your time in the caves, your adventure continues through the picturesque Mamaku Ranges, leading you to the captivating city of Rotorua. Brace yourself for a day filled with natural wonders and unforgettable experiences in this unique corner of New Zealand.

itinerary.title: Rotorua
itinerary.description: Today, our tour guides will take you to Te Puia Thermal Reserve, where you'll witness the fascinating spectacle of boiling mud pools and roaring geysers. The next stop on the adventure is Rainbow Springs, where you'll have the chance to admire New Zealand's diverse birdlife and wildlife, a true treat for nature lovers. Then, go to the Agrodome for a captivating New Zealand farm show featuring incredible sheepdog demonstrations and an introduction to the country's sheep industry stars. In the afternoon, explore the place at your own pace or relax. Prepare for a memorable experience in the evening as you savour an authentic Maori Hangi (feast) and enjoy a Maori Concert. It's a day brimming with cultural immersion and natural wonders that will leave you with lasting memories of Rotorua.

itinerary.title: Rotorua- Wellington
itinerary.description: Today, your journey takes you southward to the renowned Taupo Lake resort. Before you continue your expedition along the picturesque Desert Road, explore Taupo's beauty. At this idyllic stopover, soak in the tranquil ambience of this famous lake resort. As you travel onward, witness some of New Zealand's most stunning landscapes along the Desert Road. It's a day of scenic delights and new horizons as you go to the vibrant city of Wellington.

itinerary.title: Wellington
itinerary.description: Prepare for an enriching day as our tour representative accompanies you on a full-day excursion to Wellington, a city brimming with cultural gems. You will visit the renowned Te Papa, New Zealand's National Museum. You'll embark on a captivating journey through the nation's history, culture, and art here. Te Papa offers a deep dive into New Zealand's rich heritage, from captivating exhibitions to interactive displays. After a day filled with exploration and discovery, settle for an overnight stay in the vibrant city of Wellington. Get ready to rest and rejuvenate, as tomorrow has more adventures.

itinerary.title: Wellington- Picton- Kaikoura
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delightful breakfast, for today holds an exciting adventure. You'll embark on a journey to take you across Cook Strait, the watery divide between New Zealand's North and South Islands. As you sail into the captivating Marlborough Sounds, you'll be greeted by crystal-clear waters and lush green forests, painting a picture of tranquillity and natural beauty. Your next destination is Picton, a charming coastal town in the heart of the South Island. From there, your journey continues to the village of Blenheim, surrounded by world-renowned vineyards and stunning landscapes. Finally, you'll go to Kaikoura, a coastal gem known for its marine life. As part of this package, you can enhance your experience with an exciting whale watch cruise and an opportunity to witness these magnificent creatures in their natural habitat. It's a day filled with scenic wonders and thrilling possibilities.

itinerary.title: Kaikoura- Christchurch
itinerary.description: Bid farewell to the coastal charm of Kaikoura. Your journey will take you through the picturesque landscapes of North Canterbury, leading you to the 'Garden City' of Christchurch. Get ready to be enchanted by the natural beauty that unfolds along the way as you make your way to this vibrant city. With its gardens, culture, and history, Christchurch promises a new chapter in your New Zealand adventure.

itinerary.title: Christchurch- Mt.Cook- Queenstown
itinerary.description: Have breakfast and prepare for a journey that promises a day of sheer natural beauty. Our adventure begins with a mesmerising drive across the sweeping Canterbury Plains. Our first stop is Lake Tekapo, where the picturesque 'Church of the Good Shepherd' awaits. Afterwards, we set our sights on New Zealand's tallest peak, the majestic "Mt. Cook." We will pause to absorb its grandeur before continuing our voyage along the tranquil shores of Lake Pukaki, arriving at the Alpine Retreat of Queenstown. Prepare to be enchanted by the breathtaking landscapes that await you today.

itinerary.title: Milford Sound
itinerary.description: Embrace the early morning light as we embark on a captivating day. Our journey begins by tracing the southern shoreline of Lake Wakatipu, leading us to the quaint town of Lumsden and the serene Lake Te Anau. Prepare to be enchanted as we venture deeper into the enchanting Eglinton Valley, a place where nature's splendour knows no bounds. The Homer Tunnel is our passage to the breathtaking Milford Sound, a world-renowned fiord celebrated for its ethereal beauty. Step aboard a cruise and immerse yourself in the mesmerising allure of Milford Sound, where the majestic Bowen Falls cascade before your very eyes. A sumptuous buffet lunch will tantalise your taste buds as you revel in the awe-inspiring surroundings. As the day unfolds, we reluctantly bid adieu to Milford Sound, retracing our steps to Queenstown. Reflect on the day's adventures, cherishing the memories crafted amidst the grandeur of New Zealand's natural wonders.

itinerary.title: Queenstown
itinerary.description: Queenstown is a thrill-seeker's paradise with an array of heart-pounding activities. Queenstown has everything from the exhilarating rush of bungy jumping to adrenaline-pumping twists and turns while white-water rafting to experiencing high-speed excitement while jetboating. For a more leisurely adventure, don't miss the opportunity to ascend heights via a scenic gondola ride, treating yourself to breathtaking vistas of Queenstown and the surrounding landscapes. No matter your choice, today is a day to conquer your fears, embrace new experiences, and make memories that will last for a lifetime. So, gear up for an adrenaline-filled day in the adventure capital of the world!

itinerary.title: Queenstown- Glacier Region
itinerary.description: As Day 12 unfolds, we bid farewell to Queenstown and set for the Glacier Region. We’ll guide you through an enchanting route, starting with the serene beauty of Lake Wanaka and the picturesque Haast Pass. As we continue, you’ll be mesmerised by the West Coast's breathtaking landscapes, including towering mountain ranges, lush native forests, and glistening lakes. The Glacier Region is home to the renowned Franz Josef and Fox Glaciers. These natural wonders, sculpted by time, offer an opportunity to witness the ancient and ever-changing beauty of New Zealand's glaciers. Get ready to be captivated by the sheer magnificence of this glacier wonderland as our journey unfolds.

itinerary.title: Glacier Region
itinerary.description: Today is your day to savour the breathtaking Glacier Region at your own pace. You can explore the pristine beauty of Franz Josef and Fox Glaciers or immerse yourself in the enchanting surroundings. If you're feeling adventurous, there are plenty of optional activities to elevate your experience. Consider taking to the skies on a scenic flight, where you will witness the glaciers' grandeur from above. Alternatively, opt for a guided walk on one of these ancient giants, a journey through ice and time. Please note that these optional activities are not included in the tour price. Whether you embrace the glaciers from the air or walk upon them, today promises unforgettable moments in the heart of this natural wonderland.

itinerary.title: Glacier Region- Greymouth- Christchurch
itinerary.description: Today, our adventure takes us northward from the glacier region towards the charming town of Greymouth. As we board the iconic Tranz Alpine train, a special treat awaits our seat-in-coach passengers. Prepare to be enchanted as you glide through lush beech forests, with the alpine village of Arthur's Pass adding to the picturesque scenery. The highlight of this leg of the journey is the awe-inspiring traverse of the Southern Alps, a visual spectacle that will leave you speechless. As the train continues, you will cross over the expansive Canterbury Plains, with its rolling landscapes and vibrant vistas. Our destination for the day is the vibrant city of Christchurch, where our journey ends. Today's adventure promises a delightful blend of natural beauty and scenic train travel, offering a fitting conclusion to our remarkable New Zealand exploration.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: On this final day of your New Zealand adventure, start your morning with a hearty breakfast, savouring the flavours of this remarkable country one last time. With your bags packed and memories treasured, it's time to bid farewell. Then, it's time to make your way to the airport for your departure. As you journey homeward, take a moment to reflect on the incredible experiences, stunning landscapes, and warm hospitality that have defined your time in New Zealand.

itinerary.title: Arrive In Amsterdam
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at the Schiphol Airport, our tour manager will welcome you and assist with the transfer formalities. Check in to your hotel and spend some time relaxing at the hotel. In the evening, join us for an Amsterdam tour, where you will explore the Van Gogh Museum and the Heineken Experience and spend some time at the Amsterdam Light Festival. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Amsterdam.

itinerary.title: Amsterdam City Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast, start your tour with a visit to the Madame Tussauds Museum and The Amsterdam Dungeon. Later, you will go windmill spotting to see these fascinating structures, some of which are heritage monuments and even have quirky museums or bars attached. The Zandvoort Beach is famous among locals and great for sunbathing, swimming, and watersports. Move back to your hotel to spend the night in Amsterdam.

itinerary.title: Amsterdam Tour
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a sumptuous Dutch breakfast, then move on to the Keukenhof Gardens in Lisse. This is the world’s most extensive flower garden and aptly nicknamed the Garden of Europe, thanks to the millions of tulips, daffodils, and hyacinths that fill this 32-hectare place with colour and fragrance. After lunch, head to the Amsterdam Ice Bar, a unique place and literally the coolest place in the city. Later, go for a canal cruise on the many canals of the city. This is one of the best ways to understand the city's architecture. End your day at the Amsterdam hotel.

itinerary.title: Brussels
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a hearty breakfast buffet before heading out for a full day tour of Belgium's capital city. Brussels is famous for its eclectic architecture, museums, and art galleries. Some of the places you will visit include: The Grand Palace, Atomium, and Mini- Europe. The latter is a miniature park with tiny models of famous monuments in the European Union. Return to your hotel in the evening.

itinerary.title: Depart Amsterdam
itinerary.description: Check out of the hotel to continue with the next leg of your Europe tour package or catch your return flight back home.

packages.name: Morocco Travel Packages: A 12-Days Journey from Casablanca to Marrakech
packages.destination: Casablanca - City Tour - Rabat - Tangier - Chefchaouen - Fes - Midelt - Erfoud - Tinghir - Ouarzazate - Marrakech - Essaouira - Safi - El Jadida - Casablanca

images.alt_text: Morocco Travel Packages: A 12-Days Journey from Casablanca to Marrakech
Morocco Travel Packages: A 12-Days Journey from Casablanca to Marrakech

itinerary.title: Casablanca
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Casablanca's Mohamed V airport, you will be warmly welcomed by your driver and transferred to your hotel. After checking in, you'll spend the night at the hotel in Casablanca. Dinner will be provided.

itinerary.title: Casablanca - City Discovery - Rabat
itinerary.description: Today, we embark on a brief exploration of Casablanca, the thriving business hub of the kingdom. From our comfortable coach, we'll catch glimpses of the Medina, Mohammed V Square, United Nations Place, the charming Habbous quarter, the Royal Palace, and the Anfa residential area. Not to be missed is the grand Hassan II Mosque. After this delightful experience, we set our course for Rabat. Upon arrival, we'll check into our hotel and settle in for the night.

itinerary.title: Rabat - City Exploration - Tangier
itinerary.description: Explore Morocco's administrative capital today. Discover the "Imperial Garden City" with its prominent landmarks, including the Oudayas garden, Hassan Tower, and its Mausoleum. You can choose to have lunch at a local restaurant in Rabat. Afterward, we'll continue our journey to Tangier, passing through Larache and Asilah. Check-in at the hotel in Tangier for a comfortable overnight stay. Breakfast and Dinner will be included.

itinerary.title: Tangier - Chefchaouen - Fes
itinerary.description: Today, we will embark on a captivating journey through the legendary city of Tangier. Our first stop is Cape Spartel, where the sparkling Mediterranean Sea gracefully merges with the vast Atlantic Ocean. Take some free time to relish the breathtaking views from the furthest Northwestern tip of Africa. Next, we head to the enchanting city of Chefchaouen, known for its charming streets adorned in shades of white and blue. There, we'll enjoy a delightful lunch at a local restaurant. In the late afternoon, we make our way to the historic city of Fes, where we'll check in at our hotel. Rest and refresh for the night ahead. You'll spend the night at our comfortable hotel in Fes. Breakfast and Dinner included.

itinerary.title: Fes – Exploring the City
itinerary.description: Today is all about immersing yourself in the rich history of Fez, the oldest of Morocco's Imperial Cities, celebrated for its significant influence on Moroccan culture. Begin with a visit to the ancient Medina. Stroll through the bustling souks, where artisans continue their age-old craft in the traditional oriental way. Later, journey to Meknes, often dubbed the "Moroccan Versailles," and take in the sights, including Bab El Mansour. Return to your hotel and enjoy an overnight stay in Fes with breakfast and dinner included.

itinerary.title: Fes to Erfoud via Midelt
itinerary.description: Begin your day with an early breakfast, and then set off for Merzouga, passing through Erfoud and the charming Berber village of Immouzer du Kandar. Your journey will take you through Ifrane, a picturesque ski resort, and Azrou, a Berber village renowned for its skilled artisans specialising in wood carving and carpet weaving. Take your time for lunch at a serene Kasbah in Midelt. Afterward, continue your adventure through the breathtaking Ziz canyons, offering magnificent views of the Atlas Mountains. You'll finally reach Erfoud and check in at your hotel. Enjoy your overnight stay in Erfoud, with both breakfast and dinner included.

itinerary.title: Erfoud to Ouarzazate via Tinghir
itinerary.description: Today, we'll journey to Ouarzazate through Tinghir, where you'll find the Todra Gorges, renowned for being both the highest and narrowest in the region, just 15 km from Tinghir. The road along the Todra Gorges offers stunning views of palm tree-covered riverbanks. Next, we'll continue our drive to Ouarzazate via Boumalne, Kelaa M'Gouna, and Skoura. Upon arriving in Ouarzazate, you'll have the opportunity to explore its main Kasbahs. Afterward, we'll check in at the hotel, where you'll spend the night. Breakfast and dinner are included.

itinerary.title: Ouarzazate to Marrakech
itinerary.description: Today, we will embark on a journey to the famous Ait Benhadou Kasbah, located just 30 kilometers from Ouarzazate. This stunning fortress is a true gem of southern Morocco and has served as the backdrop for numerous films, including the iconic "Lawrence of Arabia." Aït Benhaddou: This fortified village, now home to only five families, holds UNESCO recognition as a global cultural treasure. Its ancient beauty is a testament to Morocco's rich history. After our exploration, we set out on a scenic route towards Marrakech, taking us through winding mountain roads and the Tizin Tichka Pass, the highest mountain pass in Morocco. Upon arrival, we'll check into our hotel for a comfortable overnight stay. Breakfast and dinner included.

itinerary.title: Marrakech - City Exploration
itinerary.description: Today, embark on a full-day city tour of Marrakech, the second oldest Imperial City and often referred to as the "Pearl of the South." Founded by the Almoravides in the late 11th century, Marrakesh is a vibrant city surrounded by the snow-capped Atlas Mountains and lush oases. Your journey includes visits to renowned attractions such as the Bahia Palace, Menara Gardens, an external view of the Koutoubia Mosque, and an opportunity for a leisurely lunch. Later, immerse yourself in the vibrant atmosphere of the souks and the famous Jemaa El Fna square. Tonight, rest comfortably at your Marrakech hotel. Optional: In the evening, you have the choice to enjoy dinner at the local restaurant "Chez Ali" with captivating folkloric performances and a spectacular Fantasia show or savour the delights of an Arab palace with mesmerising belly dancing.

itinerary.title: Marrakech to Essaouira
itinerary.description: This morning, we'll journey to Essaouira, a city with a rich history that echoes the times when Spain, Portugal, and England vied for control of its coast. This charming coastal town showcases a blend of Moorish and Portuguese architecture, featuring a picturesque Portuguese harbour. Essaouira is renowned for its skilled artisans working with thuja wood, a vibrant silver market, an inspiring art gallery, and its bustling harbour and islands. Fun fact: Orson Welles filmed his masterpiece, Othello, right here in Essaouira. During your visit, explore the impressive Skala ramparts, admire the seaside port, and wander through the captivating Medina. You'll spend the night at a cozy hotel in Essaouira, with both breakfast and dinner provided. Enjoy your stay in this enchanting coastal town.

itinerary.title: Essaouira – Safi - El Jadida - Casablanca
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast before embarking on your journey to Safi, one of Africa's oldest ports beyond Gibraltar. You'll explore the remnants of the Portuguese Sea Castle and can shop for exquisite pottery on Pottery's Hill. Next, you'll head to Oualidia, a charming seaside resort famous for its oyster farming, where you can choose to have a leisurely lunch. In the afternoon, you'll continue your adventure to the picturesque beach resort of El Jadida, formerly known as “Mazagan” during the Portuguese era, for a brief visit. Afterward, you'll make your way to Casablanca, where you'll check in at the hotel for a restful night. Your stay in Casablanca includes breakfast and dinner.

itinerary.title: Leaving Casablanca
itinerary.description: Today, after having a delicious breakfast, it's time to say goodbye to your hotel and head to Mohamed V Airport for your return flight.

packages.destination: Harare - Hwange - Enjoy Game Drives - Victoria Falls - Zambezi River

itinerary.title: Arriving in Harare
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Harare International Airport, you'll be greeted by our tour representatives just outside the baggage hall. After a satisfying lunch, embark on a half-day excursion to Chinoyi Cave, which is situated 120km from here. In the evening, savour a delightful dinner at a local restaurant before heading back to Harare for your overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Harare to Hwange
itinerary.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast at the hotel. After checking out, head to Harare Airport for a flight to Victoria Falls. Upon arrival at Victoria Falls Airport, our tour representatives will greet you and transfer you to Hwange Safari Lodge in a luxurious bus. Check in at the lodge and savour a delicious lunch. In the afternoon, the group will convene for tea before embarking on a three-hour game drive. As the sun sets, return to your lodge for a delightful dinner.

itinerary.title: Delight in Safari Adventures
itinerary.description: Today, our expert guide will lead you on a thrilling safari drive into the National Park. Pause for a delightful American breakfast. The morning is yours to unwind by the pool and relish in some leisurely fun. Lunch will be served around midday, and in the afternoon, the entire group will gather for a tea session before embarking on another exciting safari drive. Return to the lodge for a delectable dinner and enjoy an overnight stay at Hwange.

itinerary.title: Victoria Falls
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a hearty American breakfast, followed by a visit to the stunning Victoria Falls. Return to the hotel for lunch, and then explore the world-renowned "Mighty Victoria Falls," one of the most magnificent waterfalls globally. In the evening, return to the hotel and savour a delicious dinner. You can spend the night at Victoria Falls for a restful stay.

itinerary.title: Zambezi River
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delicious breakfast at the hotel. Next, we'll visit the Crocodile Farm and Crocodile Leather Factory for an interesting tour. Return to the hotel and indulge in a delightful lunch. In the afternoon, the group will embark on a Sunset Cruise along the majestic Zambezi River. Take a break and savour your dinner back at the hotel. You can then relax and enjoy your overnight stay at Victoria Falls.

itinerary.title: Time to Leave
itinerary.description: Once you've had your breakfast, make your way to the airport for your departure.

itinerary.title: Arrival on Mahe Island
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Mahe Airport, our tour representatives will greet you and take you to your hotel. The rest of the day is yours to relax and enjoy. Have a peaceful overnight stay on Mahe Island.

itinerary.title: Mahe Island - Full-Day Mahe Exploration
itinerary.description: Today, you'll enjoy a comprehensive tour of Mahe. Explore court buildings, museums, the post office, and the clock tower. Stroll down Albert Street, where you'll find a vibrant market with stalls brimming with fresh fruits, vegetables, fish, herbs, and spices. Next, take a scenic drive through the Sans Soucis mountain pass and visit the historic Missions Lodge. Afterward, take a break for lunch (not included). Then, continue your journey to the southern tip of the island, where you'll discover the colonial plantation known as "Jardin du Roi."

itinerary.title: Mahe - Reef Safari
itinerary.description: On your third day, you'll embark on a reef safari aboard a catamaran. This adventure will take you to the heart of the harbour, where you can feed the fish and observe intriguing underwater creatures while swimming. Afterward, it's time for a well-deserved break! You'll enjoy a delicious buffet lunch served in the traditional Creole style on board. Later, if you're a fan of marine life, you can choose to go for a swim or relax on the beach of Cerf Island.

itinerary.title: Mahe to Praslin to La Digue
itinerary.description: Start your day with breakfast at the hotel. Afterward, visit Vallee-de-Mai, the natural habitat of the giant Coco-de-Mer nut. Then, we'll take you to the renowned Anse Lazio Beach. Following that, enjoy a 30-minute ferry ride to La Digue. Our guide will assist you in transitioning from an ox-cart to L’Union Estate, where you can explore the copra sheds. Your tour of La Digue will continue an open-sided truck with a canopy, known as a 'camion.' Finally, we'll head to one of the world's most stunning beaches, "Anse Source d'Argent."

itinerary.title: Mahe
itinerary.description: Today is all yours to enjoy as you wish. Take your time exploring this beautiful island on your own and return to the hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Mahe - Homeward Journey
itinerary.description: Have your breakfast and make your way to the airport for your flight back home. Safe Travel!

itinerary.title: Mahe to Praslin
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Mahe International Airport, our representatives will assist you with customs procedures. Your tour guide will then take you to the Mahe ferry terminal, where you'll board a ferry to Praslin. Upon arriving in Praslin, you'll be transferred to your hotel. Relax and enjoy your overnight stay on Praslin.

itinerary.title: Praslin - Vallee-De-Mai
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delicious breakfast at the hotel. Prepare for an exciting full-day tour to explore Vallee-De-Mai, a world-famous Heritage Site. Next, head to Anse Lazio, a stunning beach in this beautiful city. Keep in mind that Vallee-De-Mai is also a habitat for some of the world's rarest birds. Return to the hotel for dinner and an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Praslin to Mahe
itinerary.description: After you've had your breakfast, head to the Praslin ferry terminal to catch a ferry to Mahe. Once you arrive at the Mahe ferry terminal, you'll be taken to the hotel for your overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Mahe Island - Full-Day Exploration
itinerary.description: After enjoying breakfast at your hotel, contact your tour representative for the day's itinerary. They'll guide you on a comprehensive tour of Mahe Island. Explore the island's historical gems, including the court buildings, post office, museum, and the iconic clock tower. Stroll along Albert Street, where you'll encounter a vibrant market offering an array of fresh fish, tropical fruits, vegetables, and a variety of herbs and spices. As you traverse the Sans Soucis mountain pass, take your time to capture some memorable photos at the historic Mission Lodge. Afterward, break for lunch (at your expense) before continuing your journey to the meticulously preserved colonial plantation known as "Jardin du Roi."

itinerary.title: Mahe - Departure
itinerary.description: Enjoy a swift breakfast at the hotel, then head over to Mahe Airport for your departure.

itinerary.title: Colombo - Kandy
itinerary.description: Upon arrival in Colombo, our tour representative will welcome and guide you to Kandy, Sri Lanka’s second-largest city. Check into the hotel and spend some time relaxing. Later, you will explore some of Kandy’s iconic tourist attractions. Kandy has a fascinating history and culture. It is famous for its Buddhist temples, monasteries, spice gardens, and nature reserves. It was also the last capital city of the erstwhile Sinhalese kingdom. Spend the night amidst the wilderness at a luxury hotel in Kandy.

itinerary.title: Kandy - Nuwara Eliya
itinerary.description: After a hearty Sinhalese breakfast buffet of hoppers, string hoppers, and pol roti, head out to explore Kandy. You will visit Kandy Lake, also known as the Sea of Milk, named after a pond called Kiri Muhuda (Sea of Milk) that existed before it was converted into a lake. Later, head to the Temple of the Tooth Relic, a UNESCO World Heritage Site famous for housing the Buddha's canine tooth. Every year, the Sinhalese celebrate the 10-day Esala Prehara, or the Festival of the Tooth, during which the relic is taken out in procession. End your tour of Kandy with some shopping at the Kandy Market Square. Check out of the hotel and head to Nuwara Eliya to spend the night here.

itinerary.title: Nuwara Eliya
itinerary.description: Nuwara Eliya is famously called Little England, thanks to its colonial-style buildings, quaint bungalows, and cool climate. The place is known for its tea plantations, nature reserves, and parks. After breakfast, head out to explore the city’s top attractions: the Ambewala Farms, the UNESCO World Heritage-listed Horton Plains National Park, the Hakgala Botanical Garden, and the Seetha Amman Temple. Enjoy a boat ride on Gregory Lake or a stroll in Victoria Park. Stay overnight in Nuwara Eliya.

itinerary.title: Nuwara Eliya - Bentota
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel and head to Bentota. The journey takes over 5 hours and is absolutely scenic. Check into your hotel and spend the rest of the day exploring places in the neighbourhood.

itinerary.title: Bentota
itinerary.description: Enjoy a sumptuous breakfast before exploring Bentota, a city famous for its toddy production, beaches, marine reserves, and Ayurveda wellness centres. You will visit the Kande Vihara Temple, Turtle Farm, and the Galle Dutch Fort. You can also sign up for watersports and water rides on the Bentota River. Spend the night in Bentota.

itinerary.title: Bentota - Colombo
itinerary.description: After a hearty breakfast, check out of the hotel and head to Colombo, Sri Lanka’s capital city. It was founded in the 16th century by the Portuguese. Some places you will visit in Colombo include Gangaramaya Temple, Galle Face Green, Viharamahadevi Temple, and the Kelaniya Raja Maha Viharaya. Spend the night in Colombo.

itinerary.title: Depart Colombo
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel and head for shopping at the local markets. Later, head to the airport to return home.

itinerary.title: Colombo - Kandy
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at the Colombo International Airport, our tour manager will welcome and guide you to Kandy, Sri Lanka’s second-largest city. The journey takes around 3.5 hours and is absolutely mesmerising. On the way, you’ll visit the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage, where you can catch orphaned elephants enjoying their time bathing and feeding. Check into the hotel and spend the night in Kandy.

itinerary.title: Kandy - Bentota
itinerary.description: Kandy is famous for its monasteries, Buddhist temples, and verdant forests. After breakfast, you’ll head out to explore some of Kandy’s top attractions, including the Temple of the Tooth Relic, the Kandy Lake, and the Royal Botanic Gardens. Later in the day, you will proceed to Bentota, a resort town on the southwest coast of Sri Lanka. The journey takes around 4.5 hours and is absolutely scenic. Check into the hotel and spend the night in Bentota.

itinerary.title: Bentota Tour
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a hearty breakfast buffet amidst the calming ocean waters. Later, explore the city’s top attractions, including the Kande Vihara Temple, Turtle Farm, and the Galle Dutch Fort. You can also sign up for water activities like scuba diving, banana boat riding, and parasailing. Spend the night in Bentota.

itinerary.title: Bentota - Colombo
itinerary.description: Today, after breakfast, check out of the hotel and head to Colombo. You will visit some beautiful places like Waduwwa Beach and the Udawalawe National Park on the way. Check into a hotel and relax before exploring Sri Lanka’s capital city. You will visit the Gangaramaya Temple, Viharamahadevi Temple, Kelaniya Raja Maha Vihara, and the Cathedral of St Lucia. End the day shopping at one of the local markets. Spend the night in Colombo.

itinerary.title: Depart Colombo
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a hearty breakfast buffet before checking out of the hotel to head for souvenir shopping. Later in the day, you will be driven to the airport to return home.

itinerary.title: Arrival In Colombo
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at the Bandaranaike International Airport, our tour manager will welcome you and help you transfer to the hotel. Complete check-in formalities and spend the rest of the day relaxing and enjoying views around the hotel. Spend the night in Colombo.

itinerary.title: Colombo - Bentota
itinerary.description: After a hearty breakfast, head out to explore Colombo, Sri Lanka’s capital city. Colombo is famous for its beaches, colonial buildings, museums, temples, cathedrals, and Buddhist viharas. Some places you will cover include Gangaramaya Temple, Galle Face Green, Viharamahadevi Park, Beira Lake, Dehiwala Zoological Garden, and the Kelaniya Raja Maha Vihara. Later in the evening, visit one of the many local markets in Colombo to buy souvenirs and gifts for friends and family. Then, spend the night at a luxury hotel.

itinerary.title: Bentota Day Tour
itinerary.description: After your morning breakfast, you will begin Day 3 of your tour with a visit to the Bentota Turtle Hatchery Project, a popular attraction and a great place to learn more about endangered sea turtles, including olive ridley and leatherback turtles. Later, head to Madu River to enjoy water sports like jet-ski, windsurfing, parasailing, and romantic river safari. Don’t miss riding the boat to catch the mangrove and experience the fascinating mangroves. After lunch, you’ll leave Bentota and head to Colombo. Spend the night in Colombo’s capital city.

itinerary.title: Depart Colombo
itinerary.description: Today, you will depart Colombo to catch your flight to return home.

itinerary.title: Colombo - Kandy
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at the Colombo International Airport, our tour manager will welcome you and help you transfer to Kandy, Sri Lanka’s second-largest city. Kandy was the last capital city of the Sinhalese royal family and is famous for its colonial architecture and ancient temples. Check into the hotel and spend some time exploring places around the neighbourhood.

itinerary.title: Kandy City Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head to the Temple of the Tooth Relic, a UNESCO World Heritage site famous for hosting the Buddha's canine tooth. The tooth is taken on a procession yearly as part of the Perahara, a 10-day annual festival. Some of the other places you will visit include the Royal Botanical Garden, the Kandy Lake, and the Ceylon Tea Museum. Spend the night in Kandy.

itinerary.title: Kandy - Colombo
itinerary.description: After a leisurely breakfast, check out of the hotel and head to Colombo. You will explore major tourist attractions in Sri Lanka’s capital city, including the Colombo Museum, the Gangaramaya Temple, and the Viharamahadevi Temple. Spend the evening shopping at the local markets before returning to the hotel.

itinerary.title: Depart Colombo
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel and complete your shopping expedition. Later, drive to the airport to continue with your return journey.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Male
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at the Male International Airport, our tour manager will welcome you and help you transfer to Biyadhoo Island Resort on a speedboat.
