Complete check-in formalities and spend the rest of the day exploring the beautiful island and its amenities. End the evening with a candlelight dinner.

itinerary.title: Explore Male
itinerary.description: After breakfast, spend the rest of the day exploring Male. You will check out the markets, shop for memorabilia, and visit some of the Maldives’ famous monuments. Later, you will visit the beach and enjoy watersports like diving, snorkelling, and scuba diving.

itinerary.title: Exploring the Marine Life
itinerary.description: Today, you will have plenty of activities to cover. You could either go on an underwater walk or enjoy a boat ride to view the dolphins. Return to the resort for a sumptuous dinner.

itinerary.title: Island Hopping
itinerary.description: Spend the day island hopping to enjoy activities offered by the resort. Or, you could lie down by the beach to soak in the views or dip in the pool. Get back to the hotel for a delicious dinner.

itinerary.title: Depart Maldives
itinerary.description: Today, you will check out of the resort and proceed to Male Airport to catch your flight to return home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Male
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at the Male International Airport, our tour manager will welcome you and help you transfer to Arena Beach Hotel in Maafushi via speedboat. After a 30-minute ride, you will check in to the hotel. Enjoy the rest of the day exploring the beautiful island, its surroundings, and the amenities. Spend the rest of the evening enjoying a candlelight dinner by the beach.

itinerary.title: Activities
itinerary.description: After a hearty breakfast buffet, head out to explore Arena Beach. Check out the water sports activities – some are complimentary, and some are paid for. Some of the activities you will enjoy include fishing, jet skiing, scuba diving, snorkelling, and banana boat riding. You can also dive into the waters for a spectacular view of the corals and the marine life.

itinerary.title: Island Hopping
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head out for a day of island hopping, where you will visit the small islands on the Kaafu Atoll. Or, you could lie on the beach sipping an aperitif and soaking in the views. Get back to the hotel for some delicious dinner.

itinerary.title: Enjoy Activities in the Resort
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delicious breakfast and head to the pool for a relaxing swim. Later, you can swim on the beach or lie down, soaking the uninterrupted view of the Indian Ocean. Enjoy your stay with a game of billiards or volleyball. We recommend a bicycle ride around the resort.

itinerary.title: Depart Maldives
itinerary.description: On the day of departure, you will enjoy breakfast before checking out and heading to Male Airport to catch your flight to return home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Male
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at the Male International Airport, our tour manager will welcome you and help you transfer to the North Male Atoll by speedboat. Complete check-in formalities and spend the day at leisure. You can dine at one of the many restaurants or enjoy a candlelight dinner by the beach.

itinerary.title: Excursions
itinerary.description: After breakfast, spend a leisurely day enjoying the exclusive amenities offered at the resort. You can swim at their infinity pool, book a spa appointment, visit the gym, take your kids to the recreation club, or go on a boat ride to watch spinning dolphins. End the day dining at one of the many restaurants in the resort.

itinerary.title: Activities
itinerary.description: Today, after breakfast, you will explore some of the resort's activities, some are part of the package, while others are paid. These include jet skiing, windsurfing, banana boat riding, snorkelling, and scuba diving.

itinerary.title: Depart Male
itinerary.description: After a leisurely breakfast, check out of the hotel and head to Male by ferry. You will be taken to the Male International Airport to catch your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Male
itinerary.description: Welcome to Maldives. Upon arrival at the Male International Airport, our tour manager will welcome you and help you transfer to Addu Atoll. Check into the South Palm Resort and spend the rest of the day enjoying the resort, its beautiful surroundings, and the amenities. Spend the night at a water villa.

itinerary.title: Activities
itinerary.description: After breakfast, we’ll help you explore the island and participate in the many activities – some complimentary and some paid. You can go jet skiing, windsurfing, snorkelling, scuba diving, or play beach volley or basketball with friends and family. You can also explore the island on foot, visit its local markets, and buy souvenirs. You can return to the hotel for dinner.

itinerary.title: Explore the Resort
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head out to enjoy the resort's amenities. You can either opt for an underwater walk to see the marine animals up close or enjoy a boat ride to see marine animals in their natural habitat.

itinerary.title: Depart Male
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel and head to the ferry to catch your flight from Male International to return home.

itinerary.title: Arrive at Maldives – Male - Dolphin Watching
itinerary.description: Once you reach Maldives, you will be transferred to your hotel by our tour representative. After you have freshened up, your vacation begins by exploring Male, the capital city of Maldives. You can spend the day exploring popular sites, including Male Fish Market in the heart of the city, and Old Friday Mosque, the oldest mosque in Maldives. And to learn more about the history of Maldives, visit the National Museum. Later in the day, you will be taken to Cinnamon Hakurra, where you can see some adorable dolphins being playful, before returning to your hotel.

itinerary.title: Island Hopping - Sunset Cruise
itinerary.description: The second day of your trip begins with going around the island to experience its beauty. Buy handicrafts and jewelry as gifts or souvenirs. You can also meet locals and interact with them. During the evening, head out for a sunset cruise, where you will experience the island’s serenity and enjoy a delicious dinner before returning to your hotel.

itinerary.title: Snorkelling - Vaadhoo Island
itinerary.description: Begin your 3rd day with snorkelling. What are the Maldives without the thrill of its water sports? Dive deep into the endless magic of the underwater world. During the evening, be prepared to feel mesmerized by the Glowing Beach on Vaadhoo Island.

itinerary.title: Depart from Maldives
itinerary.description: Get ready to check out from the hotel and head to the airport to catch your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrive at Madrid - Aranda de Duero – La Rioja
itinerary.description: A rental car awaits you at the Madrid Airport to transfer you to Aranda de Duero, the capital city of Ribero del Duero region. The city has a strong tradition of winemaking and festivities. Besides sampling some of the area’s wines, you will visit the city’s monasteries, churches, and castles. The itinerary includes a winery, exploring the various underground cellars that have been in use since the 16th century, and enjoying an evening in an authentic Spanish village. The Ribera del Duero is one of the biggest wine-producing regions in Spain, famous for its stunning landscapes and unspoiled villages. Post this, we’ll move on to La Rioja, Spain’s biggest and best wine region. The region is also famous for its castles, churches, and monasteries. Here, you’ll be put up at one of the area’s oldest castle paradors.

itinerary.title: Vivanco Museum of Wine Culture
itinerary.description: The La Rioja region has over 500 wineries and plenty of vineyards, producing over 250 million litres of wine annually. Besides visiting the area's wineries and vineyards, you will explore La Rioja’s ancient castles, the Sierra Cebollera National Park, and the monasteries of Suso and Yuso, which are UNESCO World Heritage Sites. The tour's highlight is the Vivanco Museum of Wine Culture, the biggest winery in the region. You will also be treated to a scrumptious, gourmet lunch and numerous glasses of wine. Spend the night at your hotel in La Rioja.

itinerary.title: Marques de Riscal Winery - Bilbao
itinerary.description: On the third day, you will make your way north to Bilbao. But on the way to the city, we’ll visit the Marques de Riscal. This winery was named the second-best vineyard in 2022 and is credited with transforming Rioja into a modern wine region producing high-quality wines. Renowned architect Frank Gehry designed the building by combining the region’s winemaking tradition with Avante Garde designs. After this, you’ll be departing to Bilbao, where you’ll stay at one of the best hotels in the area.

itinerary.title: San Sebastian - Parte Vieja - San Telmo Museum - Basilica de Santa Maria del Coro
itinerary.description: On the fourth day, you will leave for San Sebastian, famous for its beautiful churches and buildings. Here, you will explore the old town of Parte Vieja. Parte Vieja is renowned for its nightlife and is the best place to sample Basque’s famous pintxos. Some of the attractions here include the San Telmo Museum, Basilica de Santa Maria del Coro, a Roman Catholic parish church, and Plaza de la Constitucion, one of the largest squares in the city.

itinerary.title: Depart from Madrid
itinerary.description: Leave from San Sebastian for Madrid and then head to the airport to board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Madrid - Sabatini Gardens - Royal Palace of Madrid
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Seville Airport, you will be greeted by our tour representatives, who will take you to your hotel. Complete the check-in process and head out for a day of sightseeing in Madrid. Walk around the Sabatini Gardens, which form a part of Madrid’s Royal Palace. The Royal Palace of Madrid serves as the official residence of the Spanish royal family. Return to your hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: Campo del Moro - Museo Nacional del Prado - Temple of Debod
itinerary.description: Today, you will be taken to visit some of the most popular attractions in Madrid. Experience the beauty of Campo del Moro, a park which was designed during the reign of Queen Maria Cristina in the 19th century. The other spots you will be visiting are Museo Nacional del Prado and the Temple of Debod.

itinerary.title: Madrid – Barcelona - Barcelona Museum of Contemporary Art - Magic Fountain
itinerary.description: On the fourth day of your trip, get on a train to move from Madrid to Barcelona. After reaching Barcelona, get done with the check-in process at your hotel, freshen up, and leave for some sightseeing. Admire the beautiful art pieces at the Barcelona Museum of Contemporary Art. Later in the day, enjoy a light and sound show at the Magic Fountain.

itinerary.title: La Sagrada Familia - Casa Mila - Picasso Museum
itinerary.description: Being a land of architectural marvels, you will be exploring some of these marvels on the second to last day of your trip. Visit the Sagrada Familia, which is the world’s largest unfinished Catholic church. Wrap up your day by exploring the Casa Mila and Picasso Museum.

itinerary.title: Depart Barcelona
itinerary.description: In the morning, check out of your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Madrid - Sabatini Gardens - Royal Palace of Madrid
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Adolfo Suárez Madrid–Barajas Airport, you will be greeted by our tour representatives, who will take you to your hotel. After completing the check-in process, venture out for some sightseeing. Visit the Royal Palace of Madrid, which was the official residence of the Spanish royal family. Walk around the Sabatini Gardens which are a part of the palace. Return to your hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: Madrid - Hop On Hop Off Tour
itinerary.description: Today, you will be going on a Hop On Hop Off bus tour where you can witness some of the most popular tourist attractions in Madrid. This will include Campo del Moro, Royal Basilica of Saint Francis the Great, Paseo del Prado, Bridge of Toledo, Museo Nacional del Prado, and Puerta de Alcala. You can also visit some of the tapas bars in the city. Make sure to go to some of the oldest bars in Madrid before heading back to your hotel.

itinerary.title: Madrid – Cordoba - Mosque–Cathedral of Cordoba - Palacio de Viana - Alcazar of the Christian Monarchs
itinerary.description: On the third day of your trip, you will be taking a train from Madrid to Cordoba. Complete the check-in formalities at your hotel and leave to explore the city of Cordoba. The first stop will be the Mosque–Cathedral of Cordoba, which is one of the most significant monuments in the history of Islamic architecture. Witness the beauty of Palacio de Viana, a Renaissance palace with 12 patios that are filled with greenery. Finish the day at the Alcazar of the Christian Monarchs, a medieval alcazar which was built to provide residence to the Christian monarchs and their court. Get back to your hotel in Cordoba for the night.

itinerary.title: Cordoba - Seville – Plaza de Toros de la Maestranza - Torre del Oro
itinerary.description: In the morning, hop on a train to transfer from Cordoba to Seville. On this day, you will be visiting the Plaza de Toros de la Maestranza, which is one of the biggest bullfighting arenas in Spain. Visit the military watchtower known as Torre del Oro before returning to your hotel.

itinerary.title: Seville – Granada - Granada Cathedral - Royal Chapel of Granada
itinerary.description: Get on a train in the morning that will take you from Seville to Granada. Before getting to Granada, you will be enjoying a cruise along the Guadalquivir River. Our tour representatives will take you to some of the most popular touristy spots in Granada. These will include Catedral de Granada, Royal Chapel of Granada, Barrio de Santa Cruz, and the old Jewish quarter. Experience the Sacromonte Caves, the palace known as Alhambra, and the Generalife before going back to your hotel in Granada.

itinerary.title: Granada - Barcelona - La Sagrada Familia - Casa Mila
itinerary.description: On this day, board a flight from Granada to Barcelona. Get settled in your hotel, freshen up, and then head out to explore Barcelona. Visit the famous monument known as Sagrada Família, which is the world’s largest unfinished Catholic church. The last stop for the day will be Casa Mila, which was the final private residence designed by Antoni Gaudi, the renowned Catalan architect.

itinerary.title: Barcelona Museum of Contemporary Art - Magic Fountain
itinerary.description: After having your breakfast, you will be visiting the Barcelona Museum of Contemporary Art. This is a museum that displays the art of local as well as international artists. The museum often hosts exhibitions the showcase the works of painters, sculptors, and filmmakers. In the evening, catch a dazzling light and sound show at the Magic Fountain.

itinerary.title: Depart Barcelona
itinerary.description: Once you’re done with breakfast in the morning, check out of your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Barcelona
itinerary.description: After you land in Barcelona, our tour representatives will greet you at the airport and take you to your hotel. Once you have checked in and freshened up, you can head to the hotel's dining area for a delicious meal. Spend the rest of the day at your leisure.

itinerary.title: Barcelona - Cathedral of Barcelona - La Sagrada Familia - Columbus Monument – Montjuic
itinerary.description: The second day of your trip will take you on a private sightseeing tour to take in the rich cultural heritage of Barcelona. The first stop is the Cathedral of Barcelona, famous for its Gothic design and the seat of the Archbishop of Barcelona. Post this, visit the La Sagrada Familia, the largest unfinished Catholic church in the world. Before you return to your hotel, marvel at the Columbus Monument, which stands 60 meters tall, and visit the Montjuic or the Jewish Mountain. You will also visit the Olympic Village, the Olympic Stadium, and the Sant Jordi Palace.

itinerary.title: Barcelona- Granada – Flamenco Show
itinerary.description: Take a flight from Barcelona to Granada, where our tour representatives will meet and take you to your hotel. Enjoy a flamenco dance show at the Sacromonte caves later in the day and spend the night at your hotel in Granada.

itinerary.title: Granada – Generalife – Alhambra - Seville
itinerary.description: Your time in Granada is dedicated to the best UNESCO World Heritage Sites in Europe. Start with Generalife, the summer palace of the Nasrid rulers, who used it for relief from the busy life of ruling a country. After this, explore the Alhambra with its gorgeous display of Islamic architecture. Board your train to Seville, where you will spend the night at one of the best Seville hotels.

itinerary.title: Seville - Catedral de Sevilla - Santa Cruz Quarter - Torre del Oro – Cordoba
itinerary.description: Visit the UNESCO World Heritage Site and the third-largest Gothic church in the world called the Catedral de Sevilla. Walk through the Santa Cruz Jewish Quarter before heading to the 13th-century watchtower Torre del Oro, the Real Alcazar of Seville, and the General Archive of the Indies. The archive was established in 1785 and is home to thousands of maps, files, and documents related to the Spanish Empire. Get on a boat that will cruise through the Guadalquivir River, and then take a fast train to be transferred to Cordoba and get a good night’s sleep in your hotel.

itinerary.title: Cordoba – Mosque-Cathedral of Cordoba - Jewish Quarter - Madrid
itinerary.description: On your sixth day, you will walk around Cordoba, where we will take you to the Mosque-Cathedral of Cordoba. From there, you will visit the Cordoba Synagogue and then the Alcazar. Stroll around the Jewish Quarter and then board your train to get to Madrid, where you will spend the night in your hotel.

itinerary.title: Madrid - Sabatini Gardens - Royal Palace of Madrid - Campo del Moro
itinerary.description: Witness all the famous landmarks in Madrid during your private sightseeing tour, including the Sabatini Gardens, Royal Palace of Madrid, Campo del Moro, Toledo Bridge, Prado Museum, and Puerta de Alcala. See the fountains of Paseo del Prado and the Royal Basilica of Saint Francis the Great before returning to your hotel.

itinerary.title: Depart from Madrid
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight home.

itinerary.title: Arrive at Madrid
itinerary.description: After you land in Madrid, our tour representatives will greet you at the airport and take you to your hotel. Check in, freshen up and enjoy a delicious lunch at the dining area. You have the rest of the day to spend at your leisure.

itinerary.title: Madrid - Sabatini Gardens - Royal Palace of Madrid - Campo del Moro
itinerary.description: Spend the second day by embarking on a private sightseeing tour to help you explore all the famous spots in Madrid, such as the Sabatini Gardens, Royal Palace of Madrid, Campo del Moro, Toledo Bridge, Prado Museum, and Puerta de Alcala. Visit the Royal Basilica of Saint Francis the Great and see the fountains of Paseo del Prado before returning to your hotel.

itinerary.title: Madrid – Lisbon
itinerary.description: Board your flight from Madrid to Lisbon on your third day. Our tour representatives will take you to your hotel in Lisbon, where you can relax and spend the rest of your evening.

itinerary.title: Lisbon – Wine Tasting - Fado Live Show
itinerary.description: Explore the capital of Portugal, Lisbon, on the fourth day, where you will be taken for a Fado show along with a round of delicious wine tasting. Lisbon is a beautiful city beside the Tagus River, famous for its castles and churches. You'll visit Sao Jorge Castle, Rossio Square, the Church of Sao Roque, and Alfama.

itinerary.title: Lisbon - Seville – Flamenco Show
itinerary.description: Board a flight from Lisbon to Seville, and check in at your hotel in Seville. You can spend the afternoon as you like and then enjoy a flamenco show later in the evening.

itinerary.title: Seville - Catedral de Sevilla - Santa Cruz Quarter - Torre del Oro
itinerary.description: Begin your Seville city tour by visiting the Catedral de Sevilla, the world's third-largest church and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Walk through the Santa Cruz Quarter before heading to the Torre del Oro Watchtower, built during the 13th century by the Almohads. The Real Alcazar de Sevilla is also a UNESCO World Heritage Site and the oldest palace still in use in Europe, believed to be over 1000 years old. Witness the beauty of the Guadalquivir River before turning in for the night.

itinerary.title: Seville – Granada
itinerary.description: Get on a train that will take you from Seville to Granada to learn about the magnificence and wealth of the Spanish people through the Granada Cathedral before returning to your hotel in Granada for the night.

itinerary.title: Granada - Generalife – Alhambra
itinerary.description: Your day in Granada is dedicated to exploring some UNESCO World Heritage Sites. Visit the Generalife, the summer palace for the Nasrid rulers, famous for its beautiful gardens and magnificent structure. After this, explore the Alhambra with its stunning display of Islamic architecture.

itinerary.title: Granada – Barcelona
itinerary.description: Take an afternoon flight from Granada to Barcelona. The tour guide will explain the day ahead and the remaining part of the tour. We'll arrange a private taxi to the hotel where you can spend the rest of your day relaxing.

itinerary.title: Barcelona - Cathedral of Barcelona - La Sagrada Familia - Columbus Monument – Montjuic
itinerary.description: On this day, you will go for a private sightseeing tour to witness the many spots reflecting Barcelona's rich cultural heritage. The first stop will be the Cathedral of Barcelona, which has a Gothic style of architecture and serves as the seat of the Archbishop of Barcelona. After this, you will visit the world's largest unfinished Catholic church, La Sagrada Familia. Witness the 60 meters tall structure called the Columbus Monument and the Montjuic or the Jewish Mountain before returning to your hotel. You will also visit the Olympic Village, the Olympic Stadium, and the Sant Jordi Palace.

itinerary.title: Las Ramblas – Montserrat
itinerary.description: You can spend this day however you like: shopping in the Las Ramblas area or visiting the mountain range called Montserrat.

itinerary.title: Depart from Barcelona
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight home.

packages.name: Wonders of Italy & Swiss
packages.destination: Zurich - Lucerne - Mt. Titlis - Venice - Rome

itinerary.title: Arrival in Zurich
itinerary.description: Arrive at Zurich International Airport. Transfer to your hotel in Zurich. Spend the day exploring the city at your leisure. Visit popular attractions like the Old Town, Bahnhofstrasse, and Lake Zurich.

itinerary.title: Zurich Full-Day City Tour
itinerary.description: Take the Best of Zurich bus tour. Visit the National Museum, Limmatquai, Lindenhof, and the Church of St. Peter to admire the largest church clock-face in Europe. Some other attractions include the Guild Houses, Opera House, University and Swiss Federal Institute of Technology, and Fraumunster Church. Take the Dolderbahn, which travels uphill to Zurichberg & admire old mansions and the Grand Hotel Dolder.

itinerary.title: Lucerne to Mt. Titlis
itinerary.description: Take a scenic train ride to Lucerne (approximately 1 hour). Explore Lucerne's picturesque Old Town, Chapel Bridge, and Lion Monument. Board the bus to Engelberg to board the legendary Titlis Rotair, the world’s first revolving cable car. Enjoy the majestic Alpine views. Visit the Ice Grotto. Enjoy the panoramic view of the mountains with a ride on the Ice Flyer chair and use the Fun Lift for sledging. Return to Lucerne in the evening and then to Zurich to spend the night at a luxury hotel.

itinerary.title: Zurich to Venice
itinerary.description: Take the train to Venice. The journey takes seven to eight hours. Enjoy breathtaking views of the Swiss Alps and surrounding lakes. Upon arrival at Venice train station, take the water taxi to reach your hotel. Explore the city in leisure. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Venice. Spend the rest of the day exploring the charming canals and historic sites of Venice.

itinerary.title: Venice
itinerary.description: Explore the main highlights of Venice, including St. Mark's Square, St. Mark's Basilica, and the Doge's Palace. Take a gondola ride along the canals or visit the beautiful islands of Murano and Burano.

itinerary.title: Venice - Rome
itinerary.description: Travel from Venice to Rome by train (approximately 3.5 hours). Check into your hotel in Rome. Spend the afternoon visiting iconic landmarks and neighboring areas.

itinerary.title: Rome
itinerary.description: Take a bus tour of Rome, exploring various attractions like the Colosseum, Pantheon, the Roman Forum, and the TRevi Fountain. Indulge in some shopping and explore the numerous boutiques. Enjoy the city’s delicious meals in Trastevere. Spend the night in Rome.

itinerary.title: Vatican
itinerary.description: Explore Vatican City, including St. Peter's Basilica and the Vatican Museums. Marvel at the Sistine Chapel and its famous ceiling painted by Michelangelo. Some other attractions here include – Piazza della Repubblica, the Foundation of the Nayads, the ancient Aurelian Walls of Rome, etc. Spend the night in Rome.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Check out of your hotel. Transfer to Rome International Airport for your departure.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Zurich
itinerary.description: After arriving in Zurich, you can start exploring the city. Begin with a visit to the historic Old Town (Altstadt), where you can see landmarks like Grossmünster, Fraumünster, Limmatquai, and the beautiful medieval streets. Stroll along the famous shopping street, Bahnhofstrasse, known for its luxury boutiques and department stores. Visit the Kunsthaus Zurich, one of Switzerland's most important art museums, housing an extensive modern and contemporary art collection. Enjoy a relaxing evening by Lake Zurich, where you can take a boat ride or relax and enjoy the views.

itinerary.title: Zurich Full-Day City Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast, you will continue exploring Zurich, covering attractions like St. Peter’s Church, famous for the church clock, the largest clock face in Europe, the famous Guild Houses, the Opera House, the Swiss Federal Institute of Technology, etc. Take a cogwheel train to Zurichberg to explore the beautiful mansions in the district.

itinerary.title: Zurich City Tour
itinerary.description: Visit the Swiss National Museum, which showcases the cultural history of Switzerland through its extensive collection of artifacts. Explore the trendy Zurich West district, known for its urban vibe, street art, and hip cafes. Don't miss the Freitag Tower, a unique architectural structure made from repurposed shipping containers. If you're interested in history and technology, consider visiting the Zurich Museum of Art and Technology (FIFA Museum), which offers interactive exhibits on football (soccer) and its history. Before leaving Zurich, indulge in some Swiss chocolate shopping. You can visit one of the city's renowned chocolate shops or take a guided tour at the Lindt Chocolate Factory Outlet.

itinerary.title: Arrive at Madrid - Temple of Debod - Museo Nacional Centro de Arte Reina Sofía
itinerary.description: After you land in Madrid, our tour representatives will greet you at the airport and take you to your hotel. Once you’re done checking in and freshening up, you can begin your fabulous Madrid trip. The first stop for the day is the Temple of Debod, an Egyptian temple built in the 2nd century BC. To explain this temple’s significance, motifs, videos, and audiovisual materials are projected on its walls. While the original Temple of Debod was built around the 2nd century BC in Aswan, Egypt, during the 20th century, the Egyptian government gave the temple as a gift to Madrid. It was rebuilt stone by stone in Madrid. After this, go to the Museo Nacional Centro de Arte Reina Sofía, a national museum displaying 20th-century art. The museum was inaugurated in September 1992 and is named after Queen Sofía. Return to your hotel and spend the rest of the day at your pace.

itinerary.title: Madrid - Hop On Hop Off Tour
itinerary.description: On the second day, you will witness the beauty of the many architectural marvels of Madrid through our Hop On Hop Off Tour. You will be given a headphone to learn about the different monuments along the wahyu, a map of the city, and discounts at various restaurants and stores. With over 30 stops getting explored on this tour, you can choose the landmarks you wish to see. Do not forget to breathe in the wonders of the Plaza Mayor, Puerto del Sol, Sabatini Gardens, and Royal Palace. Also, make sure to try out tapas, which is a staple part of Spanish cuisine, during your lunch. If you wish to shop around, check out the Gran Via area. Spend the night at your posh hotel in Madrid.

itinerary.title: Depart from Madrid
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

packages.name: Game of Thrones in Spain
packages.destination: Seville - Italica - Osuna - Barcelona - Girona - Bilbao

itinerary.title: Arrive at Seville
itinerary.description: After you land in Seville, our tour representatives will greet you at the airport and take you to your hotel. Once you check in and freshen up, you can head to the hotel's dining area for a delicious lunch. You will have the rest of the day to spend at your own pace.

itinerary.title: Real Alcazar
itinerary.description: On your second day, the tour guide will be taking you to visit the Real Alcazar, the location for the Water Gardens of Sunspear, the ancestral home of House Martell in Dorne. This palace was shown to be the private retreat of the Martell family. Take your time exploring the gardens, fountains, and many rooms showcased in the show. Four locations within the Alcazar were used – the Ambassador's Hall, the Mercury Pool, the Charles Pavilion, and the Baths of Maria de Padilla. The Moorish palace appears in Seasons 2, 6, 7 and 9 of the series.

itinerary.title: Seville - Italica - Osuna – Seville
itinerary.description: For your third day, you will first visit Italica, an ancient Roman city and the location for filming the final episode of the seventh GOT season. The Italica amphitheatre helps recreate the ruins of Dragonpit, which was once a dragon stable for the House of Targaryen. Other attractions in Italica include the Casa de los Pajaros, the Edificio del Mosaico de Neptuno, and the Casa del Planetario. Head back to Seville for lunch, from where you can leave for the town of Osuna to explore the famous Bullring of Osuna showcased in the show's fifth season, along with the location that formed the fictional city of Meereen. Head back to your hotel in Seville at the end of the day.

itinerary.title: Seville – Barcelona
itinerary.description: On Day 4, you will travel from Seville to Barcelona on a high-speed train. Upon reaching Barcelona, our tour representatives will take you to the hotel, and soon enough, you will board a luxury car for a private sightseeing tour. The driver will take you around to see some of the most popular sites in Barcelona, including the Barcelona Museum of Contemporary Art, the Gothic Quarter, and the Picasso Museum. Spend the day going around the mesmerizing city of Barcelona.

itinerary.title: Barcelona - Girona – Barcelona
itinerary.description: Board a train from Barcelona to Girona. The medieval architecture in Girona was often the perfect backdrop for the show. We'll take you on a detailed visit to the various places in Girona where the show was filmed, including the church near the Pujada de Sant Domenec, the Cathedral of Girona, the Sant Llorenc des Cardassar, and the Jewish quarter where Arya Stark is attacked by the waif while begging. Head over to the Arab Baths, featured in an episode where Arya Stark tried to hide while being attacked by the waif. Explore Besalu on your own before heading back to Barcelona, and before you go back to your hotel, you will also get to see the area that served as Highgarden or the seat of House Tyrell in Game of Thrones. But that's not all - our guide will also explain the fascinating history of Girona.

itinerary.title: Barcelona – Bilbao
itinerary.description: Take a flight from Barcelona to Bilbao. Our tour representatives will take you to your hotel in Bilbao. Enjoy the rest of the day exploring the different attractions around your hotel.

itinerary.title: Bilbao
itinerary.description: Explore the city of Bilbao and the places where bits of the show were shot. Visit La Muriola Beach and the San Juan de Gaztelugatxe island fortress in Bermeo, Basque Country. While Muriola Beach was a part of King's Landing and the place where Davos picks up Gendry in Season 7, the latter became famous as Dragonstone, the ancestral home of Daenerys Targaryen. Your tour guide will also show you around Bilbao, explaining its rich history and heritage. Some places you will explore here include Casco Viejo or Old Quarter of Bilbao, the Gran Via Area, New Bilbao, and the Guggenheim Museum.

itinerary.title: Depart from Bilbao
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrive at Barcelona - Gothic Quarter
itinerary.description: Your trip begins in Barcelona, where our tour guide will meet you at the airport. After you land in Barcelona, you will be met by our tour representative. Barcelona is a vibrant city famous for its food, nightlife, football culture, and attractions like the La Sagrada Familia.

itinerary.title: La Sagrada Familia - Casa Mila - Picasso Museum
itinerary.description: The first stop for the second day of your trip is La Sagrada Familia, an unfinished Roman Catholic minor basilica whose construction was started in 1882 by Francisco de Paula del Villar but later taken over by Antoni Gaudi. Portions of the building designed by Antoni Gaudi have been listed on the UNESCO World Heritage Site. The next destination on the list is Casa Mila, another famous creation of Antoni Gaudi and a UNESCO World Heritage site. Later, head on to the Picasso Museum to explore the artworks of Pablo Picasso, including drawings, sculptures, and engravings. Some other places we’ll cover include – the Olympic Village, the Columbus Monument in La Rambla, and Montjuic hill, from where you can glimpse the Olympic Stadium and the Sant Jordi Palace.

itinerary.title: Barcelona Museum of Contemporary Art - Magic Fountain
itinerary.description: Day 3 is also dedicated to exploring Barcelona, where we will cover the world of intricate art at the Barcelona Museum of Contemporary Art. You will head for a fabulous sound and light show at the Magic Fountain in the evening.

itinerary.title: Barcelona – Granada – Sacromonte
itinerary.description: On the fourth day, take a flight from Barcelona to Granada. This beautiful city is in the foothills of the Sierra Nevada mountains. On your first day in Granada, you’ll enjoy a flamenco dance show at the Sacromonte caves. Spend the night at a hotel in Granada.

itinerary.title: Granada – Generalife – Alhambra
itinerary.description: Some of the highlights of your Granada tour include Alhambra, one of the most famous monuments of the Moorish Empire. The palace was listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List in 1984 and is considered one of the Seven Wonders of the Muslim World. The next place on the list is Generalife, which once served as a summer palace of the Nasrid rulers. The palace is famous for its orchards, gardens and amphitheatres.

itinerary.title: Granada – Seville
itinerary.description: Take a train from Granada to Seville on your sixth day. Spend the rest of the day relaxing at your hotel in Seville. This beautiful city is famous for its cathedrals, churches, and monasteries. Seville is also considered to be the birthplace of the flamenco dance. Spend your day exploring this medieval town’s beautiful art and architecture.

itinerary.title: Plaza de Toros de la Maestranza - Torre del Oro - La Giralda
itinerary.description: Day 7 involves exploring the city of Seville. Some places we will cover include the Catedral de Sevilla, the third-largest church in the world, Santa Cruz, a former Jewish quarter home to the Giralda Tower built around the 12th century and the Alcazar Palace. We’ll also take you to the Plaza de Toros de la Maestranza, the world’s biggest bullfighting festival venue. Other highlights in your Seville trip are Torre del Oro, also called Tower of Gold, built in the 13th century and declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site. We’ll end your day with a cruise on the Guadalquivir River.

itinerary.title: Seville – Lisbon
itinerary.description: Leave for the Seville airport to reach Lisbon, the capital of Portugal. Lisbon is a historic city famous for its cobblestone streets, eclectic arts, medieval architecture, and terrace gardens. We’ll arrange a private cab to take you to the hotel, where you’ll spend the evening and prepare for a busy itinerary the following day.

itinerary.title: Lisbon - Fado Live Show
itinerary.description: Explore the capital of Portugal, Lisbon, on the ninth day. There are plenty of things you can do and places to visit in Lisbon. Don’t miss the Torre de Belem, Alfama District, Sintra Castle, and the National Tile Museum. End the day with a Fado Show, folk music based on ballads, and a wine-tasting session.

itinerary.title: Lisbon – Madrid
itinerary.description: Get on a flight to depart from Lisbon for Madrid, the beautiful capital of Spain, and spend the night at the hotel. Madrid is a historic city famed for its beautiful architecture, food markets, and busy nightlife.

itinerary.title: Sabatini Gardens - Royal Palace of Madrid
itinerary.description: Some places we’ll cover in Madrid include the Sabatini Gardens, a neoclassical-themed garden within the Royal Palace. We will also include the Royal Palace, the official home of the Spanish Royalty, the Plaza Mayor, San Lorenzo de El Escorial, Catedral de Sta Maria la Real de la Almudena, Cybele Palace, and the National Museum of History.

itinerary.title: Depart from Madrid
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Paris
itinerary.description: After you land in Paris, our tour representatives will greet you at the airport and take you to your hotel. Your Paris tour begins with a Hop On Hop Off Tour, where you will visit all the famous landmarks for two days. You can get off wherever you want or sit on the bus listening to the commentary about the places, available in eight languages. Some places you’ll visit on the tour include - the Eiffel Tower, the Louvre, Ecole Militaire, Champs-Elysees, and Galeries Lafayette. You can also see a cabaret show at the Lido in the evening.

itinerary.title: Paris - Hop On Hop Off Tour
itinerary.description: Continue with the Hop On Hop Off Tour on the second day of your sightseeing in Paris. Some of the places you will explore today include Arc de Triomphe, Les Invalides, Place de la Concorde, and Tuileries Gardens. Head over to Latin Quarter later in the day, filled with cafes, bookshops, and bistros.

itinerary.title: Paris – Interlaken
itinerary.description: Take a train from Paris Train Station to travel to Interlaken, Switzerland. Check in to your hotel, freshen up, and enjoy a delicious lunch at the dining area of your hotel. Spend the rest of the day at leisure. Stay overnight at a luxury hotel in Interlaken.

itinerary.title: Interlaken – Jungfraujoch - Sphinx Observation Terrace
itinerary.description: Day 4 of your Alpine tour begins at Interlaken train station. The day includes a full-day tour of Jungfrau. The highlight of this tour is the cogwheel train that offers a scenic view of the mountains as it passes through the Kleine Scheidegg pass. Jungfrau is the world’s highest railway station, offering an incredible view of the surrounding snow. Some attractions include Ice Palace and the Sphinx Observation Terrace, from where you can view the Aletsch Glacier and the snow-capped mountains of nieghbouring countries. Spend the night at your hotel in Interlaken.

itinerary.title: Interlaken – Lucerne
itinerary.description: After breakfast, spend the morning exploring Interlaken. Check out of the hotel and take the train to Lucerne. After completing check-in formalities, you can spend the rest of the day exploring Lucerne at your own pace.

itinerary.title: Lucerne - Mt. Titlis
itinerary.description: Day 6 is about exploring Mount Titlis. Your journey starts with a coach tour to Mount Titlis, the highest vantage point in Central Switzerland. The deluxe motor coach will take you to Engelberg, a mountain resort where you will take a Rotair, the world’s first revolving cable car. The 45-minute journey to the high alpine glacier offers a wonderful view of the Alps. During the 2-hour stay on the mountain, you will visit famous attractions, including the Ice Grotto and the Ice Flyer, and enjoy a chair lift ride over the glacier. After your descent to Engelberg, board the coach to drive back to Lucerne. The day ends with a short tour of Lucerne and some shopping. Stay overnight at a luxury hotel in Lucerne.

itinerary.title: Lucerne – Zurich - Swiss National Museum - Bahnhofstrasse – Limmatquai - St. Peter's Church - Zurich Opera House - Swiss Federal Institute of Technology
itinerary.description: Take a train from Lucerne to Zurich. After freshening up at your hotel, step out to explore the city of Zurich. Start with the Swiss National Museum, where you can learn about Switzerland’s cultural history. Go to the downtown street, among the world’s most exclusive and expensive shopping avenues, known as Bahnhofstrasse. A street that leads through the middle of Zurich's old town called Limmatquai, where you can find numerous restaurants, quaint stores, and churches. Watch a show at the Zurich Opera House, experience moments of peace at St. Peter's Church, and for the last stop of the day, walk around the Swiss Federal Institute of Technology, which is where Albert Einstein studied and taught. End the day by going to Fraumunster Church.

itinerary.title: Depart from Zurich
itinerary.description: Check out of your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Zurich - Lake Zurich - Bahnhofstrasse - Swiss National Museum - Zurich Zoo
itinerary.description: After you land in Zurich, we’ll help you reach your hotel and assist with check-in procedures. You will receive your Swiss Pass, an all-in-one travel pass that allows visitors to explore the country from end to end. You can visit Lake Zurich and enjoy popular activities, including boat rides, swimming, or biking. Other attractions include the Swiss National Museum, which portrays Switzerland’s cultural history, and the Bahnhofstrasse, a downtown street famous for its shopping avenues. The last stop for the day can be Zurich Zoo, inaugurated in 1929 and home to over 380 species.

itinerary.title: Zurich – Mt. Titlis
itinerary.description: Board a train from Zurich to Lucerne to explore Mt. Titlis. Get on a cable car from Engelberg to Mt. Titlis and experience the Lake Lucerne cruise using your Swiss Pass. Take a train back to Zurich later in the day and spend the night at your hotel in Zurich.

itinerary.title: Zurich – Mt. Rigi
itinerary.description: On the third day, you’ll explore Mt. Rigi. Mt. Rigi is at the heart of Central Switzerland and nestled between Lake Lucerne and Lake Zug. Take a train to Lucerne and then board a ferry to Vitznau, after which you will ride up on Europe’s first-ever mountain railway to Mt. Rigi. You can enjoy a 360-degree view of the Alps and the Swiss Midlands here. Don’t forget to explore the earmarked viewing points stretching for several kilometres. You can return by cable car to Weggis and then a direct boat to Lucerne. From Lucerne, you can board a train to Zurich. Stay overnight at a luxury hotel in Zurich.

itinerary.title: Rhine Falls
itinerary.description: Prepare to witness the breathtaking beauty of Rhine Falls, Europe’s biggest waterfall. You can spend the rest of the day walking around the picturesque streets of Zurich.

itinerary.title: Depart from Zurich
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Geneva – Zermatt
itinerary.description: After you land in Geneva, take a train to Zermatt. With its breathtaking scenery and cultural heritage, Zermatt is a must-visit destination for people who love the outdoors. Once you reach the hotel and complete all the necessary formalities, you will have the rest of the day to spend at your own pace.

itinerary.title: Zermatt – Gornergrat – Matterhorn
itinerary.description: The Gornergrat Railway will take you from Zermatt to Gornergrat. At 3082 metres above sea level, Gornergrat is famous for its open-air cog railway. You can see over 29 mountain peaks from this place, including the famous Matterhorn, Switzerland’s most famous peak. Spend the night at your hotel in Zermatt.

itinerary.title: Zermatt – Geneva - St. Pierre Cathedral - Conservatory and Botanical Garden - Museum of Art and History
itinerary.description: Board a train that will take you from Zermatt to the beautiful city of Geneva. Check in to your hotel and head out for a day of sightseeing. We will start with the St. Pierre Cathedral, a former Roman Catholic cathedral that was converted during the Reformation into a Reformed Protestant Church of Geneva. After this, explore the Conservatory and Botanical Garden, spread over 28 hectares. The herbarium here has over six million samples. Head over to the Museum of Art and History, which provides tourists with details regarding the history of Western culture and how the world looked during the ancient era.

itinerary.title: Lake Geneva - Geneva Water Fountain - Mini Train Tour
itinerary.description: On the fourth day, visit Lake Geneva, the largest water body in Switzerland. See the Geneva Water Fountain, one of the most beloved landmarks in the city and one of the world’s tallest fountains. End the day by taking a mini-train tour to Geneva's Old Town.

itinerary.title: Depart from Geneva
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Barcelona - La Sagrada Familia - Casa Mila - Picasso Museum
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Josep Tarradellas Barcelona-El Prat Airport, our tour representatives will greet you at the airport and help you get to your hotel. After completing the check-in process, you can freshen up and venture out to explore the city of Barcelona. Start off with La Sagrada Familia, the world’s largest unfinished Catholic church that was designed by Antoni Gaudí. It was declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2005. Ye another UNESCO World Heritage Site you will be visiting today is Casa Mila, which was the final private residence designed by Gaudi. Wrap up your day by exploring the Picasso Museum.

itinerary.title: Barcelona Museum of Contemporary Art - Gothic Quarter - Magic Fountain
itinerary.description: Consume a scrumptious breakfast at your hotel and get ready for a day of fun sightseeing. Experience the beauty of the pieces at the Barcelona Museum of Contemporary Art. Located in the old city of Barcelona is the Gothic Quarter, which is lined with restaurants, pubs, and bars for you to explore. End the day by visiting the Magic Fountain and catching a light and sound show.

itinerary.title: Depart Barcelona
itinerary.description: Check out of your hotel after having breakfast and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

packages.name: Andalucia White Village Tour
packages.destination: Seville - Jerez De La Frontera - Arcos - Arcos De La Frontera - Grazalema - Ronda - Cordoba - Granada - Malaga

itinerary.title: Arrive in Seville – Jewish Quarter - Barrio Santa Cruz - River Guadalquivir Cruise
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Seville Airport, you will be greeted by our tour representatives, who will take you to your hotel. Complete the check-in process and head out for a day of sightseeing. Explore Barrio de Santa Cruz, the former Jewish neighborhood of Seville that is filled with plazas, colourful edifices, and narrow streets. End the day by getting aboard a cruise along the Guadalquivir River.

itinerary.title: Jerez de la Frontera - Royal Andalusian School of Equestrian Art - Arcos de la Frontera
itinerary.description: Today, you will be driven to Jerez de la Frontera, a city in the southern region of Andalucia. Visit the Royal Andalusian School of Equestrian Art, a school that is renowned for preserving the heritage of the Purebred Spanish Horse. Later on, drive down to the town of Arcos de la Frontera and admire the views of its towers, churches, and quaint stores.

itinerary.title: Grazalema – Sierra de Grazalema Natural Park - Ronda
itinerary.description: On the third day, you will be driven to the village of Grazalema, where you can witness the gorgeousness of the Sierra de Grazalema Natural Park. It’s a national park that houses a complex of mountain ranges that are known as the Sierra de Grazalema. In the afternoon, you will be heading towards Ronda, which is a mountaintop city in the province of Malaga. The famous attractions you can visit here are Puente Nuevo, Alameda del Tajo, and Banos Arabes.

itinerary.title: Bullring of the Royal Cavalry of Ronda – Cordoba
itinerary.description: Get ready to visit one of the oldest bullrings in Spain, the Plaza de Toros de Ronda. Later in the day, head to the city of Cordoba.

itinerary.title: Mosque-Cathedral of Cordoba – Granada
itinerary.description: Begin the day by visiting the Mosque-Cathedral of Cordoba, which is among the most vital monuments in the history of Islamic architecture. You will also be seeing the Roman Bridge of Cordoba and Alcazar de los Reyes Cristianos before leaving for the city of Granada.

itinerary.title: Alhambra - Malaga
itinerary.description: While you’re in Granada, explore the palace and fortress complex known as Alhambra. Famous for being one of the most well-preserved palaces of the historic Islamic world, it is also a shining evidence of Spanish Renaissance architecture. After this, head towards Malaga, a region that is popular for its cultural spots and beaches.

itinerary.title: Depart Malaga
itinerary.description: In the morning, check out of your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

packages.name: Abundant Spain
packages.destination: Bilbao - Santillana Del Mar - Picos Europa - Oviedo - Santiago De Compostela - Burgos - La Rioja

itinerary.title: Arrive at Bilbao - Catedral de Santiago
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Bilbao Airport, you will be greeted by our tour representatives, who will take you to your hotel. After completing the check-in process, venture out for some sightseeing. Go to Casco Viejo, the old quarter of Bilbao, and enjoy a boat ride across the River Nervion later in the day.

itinerary.title: Solomon R. Guggenheim Museum - Euskalduna Conference and Music Centre
itinerary.description: Explore some of the famous tourist attractions in Bilbao on this day. Start off with the Solomon R. Guggenheim Museum, which was founded by Solomon R. Guggenheim and is currently owned and operated by the Solomon R. Guggenheim Foundation. Attend a concert or witness a ballet performance at the Euskalduna Conference and Music Centre.

itinerary.title: Santillana del Mar
itinerary.description: On the third day of your trip, you will be transferred from Bilbao to the town of Santillana del Mar. After completing the check-in formalities at your hotel, you can spend the rest of the day at your own pace.

itinerary.title: Fuente De – Oviedo
itinerary.description: The mountain range of Picos de Europa awaits you on the fourth day of your vacation. Take in the beauty of the Picos de Europa National Park and ride the Fuente De cable car to get a mesmerising view of the mountain range. You will be driven to Oviedo later in the day.

itinerary.title: Metropolitan Cathedral of San Salvador - Archaeological Museum of Asturias
itinerary.description: On this day, we will take you to explore the city of Oviedo. The places you will be going to include the Metropolitan Cathedral of San Salvador and Archaeological Museum of Asturias.

itinerary.title: Oviedo - Santiago De Compostela
itinerary.description: Make your way from Oviedo to Santiago De Compostela. After checking-in at your hotel, you can spend the rest of the day relaxing.

itinerary.title: Santiago De Compostela
itinerary.description: Spend the day exploring Santiago De Compostela. It is said to be the alleged burial site of St. James, who was one of the Twelve Apostles.

itinerary.title: Santiago De Compostela – Burgos - Burgos Cathedral
itinerary.description: Travel to the city of Burgos on the eighth day of your trip. Upon reaching the city, go to the Burgos Cathedral or the Cathedral of Saint Mary of Burgos. The construction of this Catholic church started in 1221 and its designed is influenced by French Gothic architecture.

itinerary.title: Burgos – La Rioja - Vivanco Museum of Wine Culture
itinerary.description: Today, you will be boarding a train to shift from Burgos to La Rioja. Learn about the process of making wine and indulge in delicious wine-tasting sessions at the Vivanco Museum of Wine Culture.

itinerary.title: Sierra Cebollera Nature Reserve
itinerary.description: Spend your day among forests and wildlife at the Sierra Cebollera Nature Reserve. Hailed as one of the most well-preserved regions with regard to flora and fauna, it is the only designated natural park to exist in La Rioja.

itinerary.title: La Rioja – Bilbao
itinerary.description: Board a train from La Rioja to Bilbao on this day. Check-in to your hotel and spend the rest of the day at leisure.

itinerary.title: Depart Bilbao
itinerary.description: Once you’re done with breakfast in the morning, check out of your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Bratislava
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at the M.R. Stefanik Airport, our tour manager will help you transfer to the hotel and complete check-in. Then, you can spend the rest of the day at leisure. Overnight in Bratislava.

itinerary.title: Bratislava Castle Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head out for a Castle Tour. The castle is situated on the hills above the old town and was built in the Renaissance style in the 17th century. Later, visit the Blue Church, famous for its quirky colour and intricate façade. You will also see the Presidential Palace, UFO Bridge and Observation Deck, and Slovak National Theatre. End the tour with a vineyard tour and sampling some tasty local wine flavoured with honey and ginger. Overnight in Bratislava.

itinerary.title: Depart Bratislava
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel to catch your flight home or continue with the next leg of your Europe tour package journey.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Stockholm
itinerary.description: After you land in Stockholm, our tour representatives will greet you at the airport and take you to your hotel. After checking in and freshening up, head to the hotel’s dining area for a delicious lunch. You can spend the rest of the day at your own pace.

itinerary.title: Stockholm - Hop On Hop Off Tour
itinerary.description: Explore Stockholm on a Hop On Hop Off Tour on your second day. You can get off at any spot you like or stay on the bus and listen to the audio commentary. The private coach will cover the Old Town or Gamla Stan, famous for its galleries, studios, cafes, stores, and restaurants. Visit ABBA The Museum, an interactive museum dedicated to the legendary Swedish band. Step down to visit Vasa Museum, a maritime museum that houses the world’s only preserved ship dating back to the 17th century. Explore the Fotografiska Museum to admire contemporary photography. Later, visit the City Hall, famous for its 106 meters tall tower. End the day by shopping at Hamngatan, Stureplan, and Strandvagen. Other places you will visit include – the Royal Palace, the Gothic churches, the souvenir shops, restaurants, pubs, and boutiques in SoFo, and the multiple Swedish design ware shops.

itinerary.title: Depart from Stockholm
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Stockholm - Gamla Stan - Vasa Museum - ABBA The Museum
itinerary.description: After you land in Stockholm, you must reach your hotel on your own. After checking in, you can freshen up and head out for a day of sightseeing in the capital of Sweden. The first stop is the Vasa Museum, famous for a ship that dates back to the 17th century. It is one of the most famous museums in Stockholm and opened in 1990. Later, walk to Gamla Stan or Old Town, filled with cafes, studios, galleries, restaurants, and stores. Are you an ABBA fan? If so, you will love ABBA The Museum.

itinerary.title: Stockholm – Gothenburg – Liseberg - New Alvsborg Fortress - Maritiman
itinerary.description: Board a train from Stockholm to Gothenburg on your second day. Explore the Liseberg, the world’s oldest amusement park, which has existed since 1923. Go on a boat cruise to the New Alvsborg Fortress before heading to the maritime museum of Maritiman, which has a unique collection of 19 vessels, boats, ships, and barges.

itinerary.title: Gothenburg – Malmo - Malmohus Castle
itinerary.description: Get on a train from Gothenburg to Malmo, the first fair trade city in Sweden. Malmo is famous for its flea markets, shopping centers, and cultural experience. Walk around Malmohus Castle, a Renaissance-style building converted into a museum during the 1930s. Spend the night at your hotel in Malmo.

itinerary.title: Malmo - Ystad – Malmo
itinerary.description: Today you will explore Ystad, a coastal town. From historical landmarks to sandy beaches, Ystad is the perfect little getaway for travelers. The town gained popularity due to the Kurt Wallander book series by Swedish author Henning Mankell, who bases these books on a rookie detective named Kurt Wallander. The books are now adapted into a TV series. You will learn more about this on our guided tour in an old converted fire engine. Return to Malmo later in the day and spend the night at your hotel.

itinerary.title: Depart from Malmo
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Stockholm
itinerary.description: After you land in Stockholm, our tour representatives will greet you at the airport and take you to your hotel. We’ll help you check in and leave you to freshen up. You can spend the rest of the day at your own pace, ending it with a gourmet dinner at one of the finest restaurants in Stockholm.

itinerary.title: Stockholm - Hop on Hop Off Tour
itinerary.description: On your second day, you will be exploring the capital of Sweden on a private coach. You can get off at any spot you like or stay on the bus and listen to the audio commentary, available in 10 languages. Visit some of the most famous landmarks in Stockholm. Start with the Old Town or Gamla Stan, full of galleries, studios, cafes, stores, and restaurants. If you’re an ABBA fan, don’t miss ABBA The Museum. Visit the Vasa Museum, inaugurated in 1990 and famous for Vasa, the only preserved 17th-century ship in the world. Some other spots we’ll cover include the Ice Bar, City Hall, Skansen, Royal Palace, Grona Lund, and Fjallgatan.

itinerary.title: Stockholm – Copenhagen – Bakken
itinerary.description: Take a train from Stockholm to Copenhagen on your third day. But don’t forget to admire the Oresund Bridge connecting Sweden and Denmark. Once you reach the capital of Denmark, you can visit Bakken, the world’s oldest amusement park. You can spend the night at your hotel. Copenhagen is famous for its architecture: its buildings, churches, plazas, and canals. The people are among the happiest in the world and friendly as well.

itinerary.title: Copenhagen – Hop on Hop Off Tour - Cruise to Oslo
itinerary.description: Embark on a private coach tour of Copenhagen on your fourth day. Some of the most famous landmarks you will visit today include the National Museum of Denmark to learn more about Denmark’s cultural history and the Tivoli Gardens, the world’s second-oldest amusement park. You will then head to the Christiansborg Palace - the seat of the Danish Parliament, the Supreme Court of Denmark, and the Danish Prime Minister's office. You will also visit the Amalienborg Palace, Gefion Fountain, Langelinie Pavillion, Nyboder, Botanical Gardens, and the Royal Library. Early in the evening, board a cruise to Oslo to spend the night partying and have a gala on the North Sea. Get a night of restful sleep on the cruise.

itinerary.title: Cruise – Oslo – Hop on Hop Off Tour
itinerary.description: Your cruise will reach Oslo in the morning. Once you check in to your hotel and freshen up, you can leave for sightseeing on our private coach, which offers audio commentary for all the landmarks. You will visit the National Theatre, Vigeland Park, Parliament Building, Aker Brygge, and the Akershus Fortress.

itinerary.title: Depart from Oslo
itinerary.description: You are free to explore Oslo until it is time to depart for your return flight.

itinerary.title: Arrive In Bucharest
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Bucharest International Airport, our tour manager will help you transfer to the hotel and complete check-in formalities. Spend the rest of the day exploring the area around your hotel. Bucharest is a reasonably pleasant and very safe city to walk. Overnight at a luxury hotel in Bucharest.

itinerary.title: Explore Bucharest
itinerary.description: After breakfast, you will explore some of Bucharest’s tourist attractions. Start with a guided tour of Old Town, including the Palace of Parliament, Stavropoleous Monastery, the National Bank of Romania, the Romania Athenaeum, etc. Later, you will visit the Village Museum, Arch de Triumph, Revolution Square, Cotroceni Palace, the Botanical Gardens of Bucharest, and the Piata Obor Market. You can stop for lunch at the Piata Obor Market to sample local food, including meatballs, stuffed cabbage, baklava, etc. End the day with a visit to some of Romania’s old bars, including Caru’ cu Bere, the oldest beer house in the city built in Art Nouveau style. Overnight at the Bucharest hotel.

itinerary.title: Bucharest – Timisoara
itinerary.description: After breakfast, you will head out to cover places you missed on the previous day. After a sumptuous lunch of local food, explore the many local markets selling handicrafts, ceramicware, and other items. Later in the evening, head to Bucharest train station for a night train to Timisoara.

itinerary.title: Timisoara – Belgrade
itinerary.description: As you arrive at the Timisoara train station, we’ll help you transfer to Belgrade. Check in at the hotel and spend the rest of the day exploring Serbia’s capital city. Overnight at a luxury hotel in Belgrade.

itinerary.title: Explore Belgrade
itinerary.description: Belgrade is one of Europe's oldest continuously inhabited cities, having existed since 5700 BC. Plenty of fascinating museums, art galleries, statues, sculptures, and roadside cafes offer a value–for–money experience. Some of the places you will visit include the Belgrade Fortress, the Temple of Saint Sava, St. Mark’s Orthodox Church, and the Ruzica Church. Enjoy a delectable lunch in one of the many bistros in Belgrade, offering local fare at affordable rates. Later in the evening, you will cover the remaining tourist spots, including the numerous theatres, museums, and squares. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Belgrade.

itinerary.title: Belgrade
itinerary.description: Today, you are free to explore the city on your own. You can either shop at one of the many local markets to buy local natural cosmetics, books, nut butters, antiques, and other memorabilia. Spend the night in Belgrade.

itinerary.title: Belgrade – Zlatibor
itinerary.description: Today, you will depart to Zlatibor, stopping at Sirogojno to visit the open-air museum displaying the architecture and social and cultural life of people in the Zlatibor region. The museum covers over 5 hectares and is the best place to experience Serbian culture first-hand. Arrive in Zlatibor and check in to a luxury hotel in the town.

itinerary.title: Zlatibor – Podgorica
itinerary.description: After a delectable Serbian breakfast, head to Podgorica, the capital city of Montenegro. Podgorica is a typical Mediterranean city with sunny beaches, churches, cathedrals, and lush vineyards. Enjoy a walking tour of King Nikola’s Palace and the Ribnica Bridge.

itinerary.title: Podgorica – Kotor Bay – Podgorica
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head to the Adriatic Sea for a walking tour of the beautiful Kotor City. This city was fortified in 535 and is famous for its UNESCO World Heritage-recognised old city centre. Return to the hotel in the afternoon to spend the evening at leisure. Overnight at the hotel in Podgorica.

itinerary.title: Depart Podgorica
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel to head to the airport to continue with the next leg of your Europe tour package journey or catch your return flight home.

packages.name: Transylvania Travel Package
packages.destination: Bucharest - Sibiu - Sighisoara - Brasov - Bran - Sinaia

itinerary.title: Arrive in Bucharest
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at the Bucharest International Airport, our tour manager will guide you to the hotel. Spend the rest of the evening enjoying areas in and around your hotel. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Bucharest.

itinerary.title: Bucharest – Sibiu
itinerary.description: Travelling from Bucharest to Sibiu offers a journey through some picturesque landscapes and historical sites in Romania. Explore Bucharest's highlights, such as the Palace of the Parliament, Revolution Square, and the Old Town. Visit the Village Museum (Muzeul Satului) to experience traditional Romanian village life. Enjoy dinner at a local restaurant and experience Bucharest's vibrant nightlife if time permits. On the way, you’ll stop at Curtea de Arges, the first capital of Wallachia. The city is famous for the Royal Church, a 14th-century UNESCO World Heritage Site. The Cortes de Arges monastery is also the centre of a renowned legend wherein one of the construction workers buried his wife alive inside the walls. Later, you will continue to visit Sibiu, passing through Oltului Valley and stopping at Cozia Monastery, erected by Mircea the Elder in 1388. This is a beautiful church situated amidst magnificent natural scenery. In the afternoon, you will visit the medieval city of Sibiu, which was selected as the European Capital of Culture in 2007. Some places you will explore here include the 3 squares of Upper Town: Grand, Lesser, and Huet, the Liar’s Bridge, the Evangelical Church, and the Clock Tower.

itinerary.title: Sibiu – Sighisoara – Brasov
itinerary.description: In the morning, you will depart Sibiu to leave for Sighisoara. This medieval city is famous for the Clock Tower, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Some places you will visit include the School Children’s Ladder, the statue of Petofi Sandor, Hungary’s national poet, and the beautiful Catholic Church. In the afternoon, return to Bucharest with a stop at Brasov. Some places you will see include The Black Church, The Council Square, the First Romanian School Museum, and Biserica Sfantul Nicolae. Spend the night in Brasov.

itinerary.title: Brasov – Bran – Sinaia – Bucharest
itinerary.description: Today, you will explore the Prahova Valley, a grand valley famous for its modern resorts and beautiful mountain scenery. Here, you will visit Bran Castle, a 14th-century fortress that became famous as the abode of the fictional Count Dracula. Next, you will move to Peles Castle, a former summer residence of the Romanian Royal Family. The three Christmas Prince films were filmed in Peles Castle. Move to Bucharest to spend the night in Romania’s capital city.

itinerary.title: Depart Bucharest
itinerary.description: Check out of your hotel to leave for Bucharest to continue with the next leg of your Europe tour package journey or catch your return flight home.

packages.name: Transylvania Holiday Package
packages.destination: Bucharest - Sibiu - Borgo Pass - Sighisoara - Brasov

itinerary.title: Arrive In Bucharest
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at Bucharest International Airport, our tour manager will help you transfer to the hotel and complete check-in formalities. Spend the rest of the day exploring the area around the hotel. Overnight in Bucharest.

itinerary.title: Bucharest – Sibiu
itinerary.description: Today, after a hearty breakfast, head out for a short tour of Bucharest. Today, you will explore the Palace of Parliament, Stavropoleos Monastery, the National Bank of Romania, the Romanian Athenaeum, the Herastrau Park, the Village Museum, and the Arch de Triumph. Later, you will move to Sibiu, exploring many historic villages and castles. The first stop is Poenari. The Poenari Castle is believed to be the original castle of Vlad the Impaler, the ruler of Wallachia, who is supposed to be the inspiration behind Bram Stoker’s fictional character, Count Dracula. Continue the journey towards Sibiu, a beautiful medieval city named the European Cultural Capital, in 2007. The town offers a beautiful view of the snowy peaks of the Fagaras Mountains on the one side and the Cindrel Mountains on the other. Some of the places you will explore here include the three squares, viz., Big, Small, and Huet Squares, the Liar’s Bridge, the Clock Tower, and the Evangelical Church, one of the largest evangelical churches built in Gothic style in Transylvania. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Sibiu.

itinerary.title: Sibiu – Borgo Pass
itinerary.description: Today, you will explore some places mentioned in Bram Stoker’s novel Dracula. The novel covers three regions: Transylvania, Moldavia, and Bucovina. On the way, enjoy lunch at Bran Castle Restaurant, a castle associated with the novel. After sampling some of the region’s local food, head to Borgo Pass and spend the night at Castle Dracula. Overnight in Pasul Bargaului.

itinerary.title: Borgo Pass – Sighisoara
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check the hotel and head to Sighisoara, the hometown of Vlad the Impaler. The Clock Tower in Sighisoara is a historic citadel and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Some attractions you will visit include The Covered Stairway, Biserica din Deal, and the beautiful Catholic Church. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Sighisoara.

itinerary.title: Sighisoara – Brasov
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out and head to Brasov, a medieval town once Transylvania's capital. Some attractions here include the impressive Black Church and the Council Square. You will also visit the hill where Vlad the Impaler supposedly impaled his victims. Spend the night in Brasov.

itinerary.title: Brasov – Bucharest
itinerary.description: Today, you will check out of your hotel to reach Bucharest, Romania’s capital city. Stop at Snagov Island to visit the Snagov Monastery, where Vlad the Impaler is believed to be buried. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Bucharest.

itinerary.title: Depart Bucharest
itinerary.description: Check out of the hotel to head to the Bucharest International Airport to catch your flight back home or continue with the rest of your Europe tour package journey.

itinerary.title: Arrive In Bucharest
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Bucharest International Airport, our tour manager will help you transfer to the hotel and complete check-in formalities. Spend the rest of the day exploring the area around your hotel.

itinerary.title: Bucharest Full Day Tour
itinerary.description: Today, you will explore the many sights of the Old Town, including the Palace of Parliament, the Stavropoleos Monastery, the National Bank of Romania, the Romanian Athenaeum, and Umbrella Street. Later, post lunch, explore Muzeul Satului, an open-air museum, the Arch de Triumph, and the Revolution Square. End the day with a visit to University Square and Charles de Gaulle Square.

itinerary.title: Bucharest Half-Day Tour
itinerary.description: Today, you will explore the Piata Obor market, the Cotroceni Palace, the Botanical Gardens of Bucharest, and the Opera House. Don’t miss to explore the Museum of Contemporary Art and the Cotroceni National Museum. Spend the evening exploring some of Bucharest’s bars, especially at Caru’ cu Bere, the city’s oldest beer house.

itinerary.title: Depart Bucharest
itinerary.description: After checkout, depart for the Bucharest International Airport to catch your return flight home or continue with the next leg of your Europe tour package journey.

packages.name: The Ultimate Guide to Yellowstone Tour Package
packages.destination: Jackson Hole - Grand Teton National Park - Rapid City - Mt. Rushmore Tour

images.alt_text: The Ultimate Guide to Yellowstone Tour Package
The Ultimate Guide to Yellowstone Tour Package

itinerary.title: Arrival in Jackson Hole
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Jackson Hole airport, you will be transferred to your hotel. You will spend the night at the hotel in Jackson Hole.

itinerary.title: Jackson Hole - Yellowstone National Park
itinerary.description: On the second day, please wait in the hotel lobby for your Yellowstone tour pick-up. This full-day journey from Jackson Hole to Yellowstone is an unforgettable experience, allowing you to witness the natural beauty that led to the establishment of America's first national park. During the tour, you'll be treated to breathtaking views of geysers, canyons, waterfalls, rivers, and the diverse wildlife that calls Yellowstone home. You will also have the chance to visit iconic Yellowstone attractions such as Old Faithful and the historic Lake Hotel. Throughout the tour, you'll learn about the region's volcanic geology and its unique ecological features. Keep a keen eye out for Yellowstone's fascinating wildlife, including bison and wolves. Don't miss the impressive eruption of Old Faithful and the stunning colours of the Fountain Paint Pot. You'll also be in awe of the towering waterfall at the Grand Canyon of Yellowstone. Another highlight is a visit to the historic Lake Hotel, which overlooks the largest lake in the country situated at an elevation of over 7,000 feet. The tour will provide opportunities to stop and view wildlife, explore intriguing geothermal features, and capture memorable photographs. After the tour, you will return to your hotel in Jackson Hole, where you will spend the night.

itinerary.title: Jackson Hole - Grand Teton National Park
itinerary.description: Start your day by waiting in the hotel lobby for your West Yellowstone tour (Upper loop). This exciting day trip from Jackson Hole allows you to marvel at one of the most stunning American landscapes, all while comfortably seated in a coach vehicle. As you soak in the breathtaking sights of the rugged Teton Range and take a moment to appreciate the beauty of Jenny Lake, your knowledgeable local guide will share the fascinating geology and history of the Tetons with you. Additionally, you'll have the opportunity to visit Menor's Ferry and the Chapel of the Transfiguration, both of which hold a special place on the US National Register of Historic Places. After the tour, return to your hotel in Jackson Hole for a restful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Jackson Hole - Rapid City
itinerary.description: Start the day with a hearty breakfast. It's time to check out of your hotel in Jackson Hole and wait in the lobby for your transfer to Jackson Hole Airport. There, you'll catch a flight to Rapid City, South Dakota (please note that the flight is not included). Upon arriving in Rapid City, you will be transferred to your hotel, where you can unwind and spend the night.

itinerary.title: Rapid City – Mt. Rushmore Tour
itinerary.description: Today, you will begin your adventure by heading to the nearby Fort Hayes Chuckwagon for the pickup of your Mt. Rushmore tour. While Mt. Rushmore is undoubtedly famous for its iconic faces, the Black Hills have so much more to offer, and this tour provides the perfect opportunity to immerse yourself in the beauty of the region. Your first stop will be Mount Rushmore, where you will spend an hour taking in the grandeur of this remarkable monument. Next, you will set off for a scenic journey along the Peter Norbeck National Scenic Byway, winding your way over Iron Mountain through tunnels and pigtail bridges. For lunch, you will make a stop at the former presidential summer white house for Calvin Coolidge and Dwight D. Eisenhower. Here, you will have the option to order from a menu or take part in a buffet. Continuing your exploration, you will pass through Custer State Park and travel up Needles Highway, passing through more scenic tunnels and enjoying breathtaking views from scenic overlooks. Your final stop is at the world's largest mountain carving. You'll have the chance to visit the memorial, explore the museums, and gain insights into the sculptor Korzak Ziolkowski through his home studio museum. After this captivating tour, you will return to your hotel in Rapid City for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Depart - Rapid City
itinerary.description: As you conclude your visit to Rapid City, it's time to check out of our hotel. We will then arrange for your transfer to the airport for your flight to your next destination or back home.

itinerary.title: Arrive In Oslo
itinerary.description: Welcome to Tiger City! Upon your arrival at Oslo International Airport, our tour manager will help you check into the hotel. Spend the rest of the day at leisure. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Oslo.

itinerary.title: Oslo Full Day Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head to the Hop On Hop Off bus for a full-day city tour. Oslo is one of the oldest Scandinavian cities, founded in the 11th century by Harald Hardrade. The city is surrounded by mountains and its 100-km-long fjord. Some places you will visit today include The Norwegian Museum of Culture, the Viking Ship Museum, the Fram Museum, the Holmenkollen Ski Museum, and the National Museum. In the evening, visit the Karl Johans Gate and the Aker Brygge shopping area. Spend the night in Oslo.

itinerary.title: Depart Oslo
itinerary.description: Check out of your hotel to head to the airport to continue with the next leg of your Europe tour package journey or catch your return flight home.
