packages.name: Norway Holiday Package
packages.destination: Oslo - Norway in a Nutshell - Flåm - Bergen

itinerary.title: Arrive In Oslo
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at the Oslo International Airport, our tour manager will help you check in to the hotel. Check in to your hotel and spend the rest of the day exploring this Viking city. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Oslo.

itinerary.title: Oslo – Flam
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head to Central Station to begin your first day of the Norway tour. You will cover some of Norway’s most scenic places on the West Coast. Some places you will cover include Akershus Fortress, the Norwegian Museum of Culture, the Viking Ship Museum, the Fram Museum, etc. Witness Oslo Fjord, a 100 km-long fjord that extends from Oslo to Fredrikstad. After the tour, head to Flam by train. The 20-km-long train journey is one of the high points of your Norway tour. You will visit Myrdal for a breathtakingly beautiful view of the tall mountains and thundering waterfalls. Spend the night in Flam.

itinerary.title: Flam – Bergen
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head to Aurlandsfjord and into Naeroyfjord, the narrowest fjord in Europe. This is included in the UNESCO World Heritage List and is surrounded by mountains up to 1,800 metres. Don’t miss a chance to admire the small traditional farms on the way to the fjord. The coach journey from Stalheim offers a beautiful view of the Naeroyfjord Valley. This road has 13 steep bends and offers a wonderful view of the Stalheimsfossen and Sivlefossen waterfalls. Continue your journey to Voss and catch a train to Bergen. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Bergen.

itinerary.title: Depart Bergen
itinerary.description: Check out of your hotel in Bergen to continue with the next leg of your Europe tour package or catch your return flight home.

itinerary.title: Arrive In Bergen
itinerary.description: Welcome to Bergen, home to Norway’s famous fjords and mountains. Upon arrival, our tour manager will help you check in to the hotel. Spend the rest of the day exploring attractions around your hotel. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Bergen.

itinerary.title: Bergen Full Day Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast, you will explore the many attractions of this picturesque town on a Hop On Hop Off Tour. Some places you will visit today include Bryggen, the many museums and churches of the city, and the Voringsfossen Waterfalls. Spend the night in Bergen.

itinerary.title: Depart Bergen
itinerary.description: Check out of your hotel to continue with the next leg of your Europe tour package or catch your return flight home.

itinerary.title: Arrive In Porto
itinerary.description: As you arrive at the Porto International Airport, our tour manager will help you complete the transfer formalities. Complete check-in and spend the rest of the day exploring places close to the restaurant. Spend the night in Porto.

itinerary.title: Porto Full Day Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head out to the Hop On Hop Off bus for a full-day tour of Porto. Some sights you will explore today include Luis I Bridge, Porto Cathedral, Clerigos Church, Bolsa Palace, the Church of Saint Francis, and the Foz do Duoro beach. Spend the night in Porto.

itinerary.title: Depart Porto
itinerary.description: You can extend your stay and continue with your Europe tour package or catch your return flight home.

itinerary.title: Arrive In Lisbon
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at the Lisbon International Airport, our tour manager will help you transfer to the hotel. Complete check-in formalities and spend the rest of the day exploring quiet places around your hotel. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Lisbon.

itinerary.title: Lisbon City Tour
itinerary.description: After a hearty breakfast, head out to board your Hop On Hop Off bus. This open-top double-decker bus offers a panoramic view of the city’s top attractions. Some of the places you will visit include the Belem Tower, Jeronimos Monastery, Castelo de Sao Jorge, and the Lisbon Cathedral. In the evening, explore the city’s many restaurants and nightclubs. Spend the night in Lisbon.

itinerary.title: Depart Lisbon
itinerary.description: Today, you will check out of the hotel to continue with the next leg of your Europe tour package or catch your return flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Lucern
itinerary.description: Arrive in Lucerne and check into your hotel. Start your day with a visit to the iconic Chapel Bridge (Kapellbrücke), one of Lucerne's most famous landmarks. Take a leisurely stroll across the bridge and enjoy the scenic views of the Reuss River and the surrounding medieval architecture. Explore the Old Town (Altstadt) area, known for its well-preserved medieval architecture. Wander through the narrow cobblestone streets, visit charming shops, and admire the colorful buildings. Visit the Jesuit Church (Jesuitenkirche), a beautiful Baroque-style church known for its stunning interior decorations. Take a boat ride on Lake Lucerne, which offers breathtaking views of the surrounding mountains and the city. You can choose to take a short round-trip cruise or explore one of the nearby towns along the lake. Visit the Swiss Museum of Transport, located just outside the city center. This interactive museum showcases the history of transportation in Switzerland and offers a variety of exhibits, including trains, planes, automobiles, and even space travel. Enjoy a leisurely dinner at one of the local restaurants in Lucerne, offering a variety of Swiss and international cuisine. Take a relaxing evening walk along the lake promenade or simply relax at your hotel and prepare for the next day.

itinerary.title: Full-Day Lucerne Tour – Mt. Pilatus – Lion Monument
itinerary.description: Take a day trip to Mount Pilatus, one of Lucerne's most famous mountains. You can reach the summit by taking a combination of boat and cogwheel train rides, or by cable car and gondola. Once at the top, you'll be rewarded with breathtaking panoramic views of the Swiss Alps. You can also enjoy hiking trails, visit the summit's restaurants, or take part in various outdoor activities. Return to Lucerne from Mount Pilatus and head to the Lion Monument (Löwendenkmal). This impressive sculpture of a dying lion carved into a rock commemorates the Swiss Guards who were massacred during the French Revolution. Explore the Richard Wagner Museum, located on the shores of Lake Lucerne. This museum is dedicated to the life and work of the renowned composer Richard Wagner and offers insights into his musical genius. Spend the evening exploring Lucerne's vibrant nightlife. Visit one of the lively bars or pubs in the city center, or catch a live music performance or cultural show at one of the local venues.

itinerary.title: Lucerne City Tour – Depart from Lucerne
itinerary.description: Take a short train ride to the nearby town of Engelberg, known for its stunning natural beauty and outdoor activities. Visit Mount Titlis, a popular mountain in the Swiss Alps. Take a cable car ride to the summit and experience the breathtaking views of snow-capped peaks and glaciers. Enjoy activities like walking on the Titlis Cliff Walk, the highest suspension bridge in Europe, or try snowboarding and skiing at the Glacier Park. Return to Lucerne from Mount Titlis and spend the afternoon exploring the Swiss Museum of Art (Kunstmuseum). This museum features a wide range of Swiss artwork, including paintings, sculptures, and installations from various periods. As it's your last evening in Lucerne, indulge in a delightful Swiss fondue dinner at one of the local restaurants. Enjoy the traditional melted cheese dish along with a selection of bread, vegetables, and meats. Take a final evening stroll along the picturesque streets of Lucerne, enjoying the city's charming atmosphere before taking your flight back home. Remember to check the opening hours and availability of attractions and activities in advance, as well as any travel restrictions or guidelines that may be in place.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Zurich – Lucerne
itinerary.description: After you land in Zurich, take a train to Lucerne. After reaching the hotel and completing the check-in, you will have the rest of the day to explore the city. Spend the night at your hotel in Lucerne.

itinerary.title: Lucerne - Mt. Titlis
itinerary.description: On day 2, you will visit Mt. Titlis. Board a train to Engelberg and ride on Rotair, the world’s first revolving cable car to reach Mount Titlis. The cable car ride provides a panoramic view of the snow-covered valleys, glaciers, and valleys. Spend the night at your hotel in Lucerne.

itinerary.title: Lucerne - Mt. Pilatus
itinerary.description: On day 3, you will visit Mt. Pilatus. The tour also includes a 90 min cruise to Alpnachastad from Lucerne. You will also take a cogwheel train to reach the top of Mt. Pilatus. The aesthetic beauty you will experience along the way is beyond spectacular. You can spend the evening at leisure.

itinerary.title: Lucerne – Interlaken
itinerary.description: Reach Lucerne railway station and board the popular Golden Pass train to Interlaken. After the check-in formalities are completed, you can explore the city on your own. Interlaken is a beautiful city with spectacular alpine views and gorgeous lakes.

itinerary.title: Interlaken – Jungfraujoch
itinerary.description: Board a train from Interlaken Ost to Grindelwald and enjoy the breathtaking view on the way. You can enjoy a cogwheel train ride from Grindelwald to Jungfraujoch, Europe’s highest railway station. Don’t miss the beautiful viewpoint in the Bernese Alps. Enjoy the view of the Aletsch Glacier and visit the Ice Palace.

itinerary.title: Interlaken – Zurich – Rhine Falls
itinerary.description: On Day 6, you will check out from your hotel in Interlaken to take the train to Zurich. Check-in at your hotel and head out to explore the gorgeous city of Zurich with all its museums, eateries, and flea markets. Make sure to witness Europe’s biggest waterfall, known as Rhine Falls.

itinerary.title: Depart from Zurich
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Geneva
itinerary.description: After you land in Geneva, you will take a train to Lake Geneva Region. Check in to your hotel, freshen up and have your lunch in the dining area of your hotel, and spend the rest of the day at leisure.

itinerary.title: Lake Geneva - Olympic Museum
itinerary.description: On your second day, you will be exploring the Lake Geneva Region. Lake Geneva separates France and Switzerland – Lausanne falls in the Swiss region and is famous for its breathtaking view of the French Alps. You will also explore the beautiful Swiss Riviera, i.e., the area from Lausanne to Montreux. The Swiss Riviera is famous for its old-world charm and natural beauty. Don’t miss the Olympics Museum, dedicated to the spirit of the Olympics. It also displays the history of the sport, its origin, historical posters, equipment, Olympic torches, and the clothes the Olympians have worn to date. You will also visit the Chateau d’Ouchy, 12th century a neo-Gothic style castle that was rebuilt in the 19th century and converted into a hotel.

itinerary.title: Lake Geneva Region – Zermatt
itinerary.description: Take a train from Lake Geneva Region to Zermatt. Once you’re done checking in to your hotel, you can spend the rest of the day at your own pace. You have the option of travelling to Gornergrat that day.

itinerary.title: Zermatt – Matterhorn
itinerary.description: Day 4 involves visiting Switzerland’s most famous peak, the Matterhorn, also known as the Toblerone Chocolate Mountain. At 3883 above sea level, the Klein Matterhorn is Europe’s highest viewing platform. You can enjoy the panoramic view of the Swiss, French, and Italian Alps from the Matterhorn. Spend the night at your hotel in Zermatt.

itinerary.title: Zermatt – St. Moritz
itinerary.description: Board the Glacier Express train that will take you from Zermatt to St. Moritz. The train passes through 291 bridges and 91 tunnels. You can have the rest of the evening to yourself and relax.

itinerary.title: Depart from St. Moritz
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrive In Amsterdam
itinerary.description: Welcome to the Venice of the North. Upon arrival at the Amsterdam International Airport, our tour manager will welcome you and help you transfer to the hotel. Complete your check-in and spend the rest of the day enjoying the many attractions around your hotel. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Amsterdam.

itinerary.title: Amsterdam City Tour
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a Hop On Hop Off tour of the city. The ticket is valid for 48 hours and allows you to join or leave the tour anytime. The ticket also includes a canal cruise where you will sail through the beautiful old buildings, canal houses, and bridges. Spend the afternoon at leisure exploring the city's many markets and quaint streets. You will explore the Anne Frank Museum, the Van Gogh Museum, the Rijksmuseum, and the Vondelpark. Spend the night in Amsterdam.

itinerary.title: Depart Amsterdam
itinerary.description: Today, you can extend your stay and continue with the Europe tour package or catch your return flight home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Dublin
itinerary.description: Our tour manager will help you transfer to the hotel when you arrive in Dublin. Complete the check-in formalities and prepare for the Hop On Hop Off tour to explore Dublin. The tickets for this tour are valid for 48 hours and allow you to enjoy different tourist attractions at your own pace. Some of the tourist attractions covered on this tour include the Guinness Storehouse, Dublin Castle, St. Patrick’s Cathedral, Kilmainham Gaol, Old Jameson Distillery, and the most famous Trinity College. Spend your afternoon enjoying international cuisine or local Irish fare. The rest of the evening can be enjoyed at leisure. Stay overnight at a luxury hotel in Dublin.

itinerary.title: Dublin Full Day Tour
itinerary.description: You’ll begin your day with a full Irish breakfast. The next stop on our tour is the Wicklow Mountains, the Garden of Ireland. Some attractions include the Powerscourt Waterfall, Powerscourt House and Gardens, and other historic sites. The next stops on this tour are the picturesque towns of Enniskerry and Glendalough. The latter is famous for its monastic monuments from the medieval period. Some of the beautiful villages you’ll cover today include Laragh, Rathdrum, Roundwood, and Avoca. Don’t miss out on Ireland’s oldest mills, the Avoca Handweavers. They have been hand-weaving clothes for over 300 years.

itinerary.title: Dublin to Belfast
itinerary.description: Check out from your Dublin hotel to catch your train to Belfast. The journey takes around 2.5 hours and offers a spectacular view of the beautiful cities. As you arrive in Belfast, check into your hotel before beginning your city tour. Some of the places you will cover here include Titanic Belfast. This six-storey building details the story of Titanic, including its conception, construction, the famous maiden voyage, and its tragic end. If you are a Game of Thrones fan, make sure you don’t miss a customised tour of all the places where the drama series was shot. Spend the night in Belfast.

itinerary.title: Belfast – Giants Causeway – Belfast
itinerary.description: After breakfast today, you will head to Carrickfergus Castle. This Norman castle is one of the best-preserved medieval structures in the country. Later, you will explore Carrick-a-rede Ropebridge and Giants Causeway, the highlight of today’s excursion. The latter is full of stories and mysteries thanks to its rugged coastlines and spectacular waves of the Atlantic Ocean. Spend time climbing the ancient stones before retreating to one of the many cafes and restaurants along the causeway. After lunch, hop on to your bus again to visit the world’s oldest licensed whiskey distillery, Bushmills. There are a few souvenir shops and a bar where you can enjoy this famous tipple. And if you have any energy left, end the day with a visit to the ancient Dunluce Castle before returning to Belfast. Spend the night in Belfast.

itinerary.title: Depart Belfast
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel before moving to Belfast City Airport to continue with the next leg of your Europe tour package or catch your return flight home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Dublin
itinerary.description: As you arrive at Dublin International Airport, our tour manager will help you with the transfer formalities. After you complete check-in, you can spend the rest of the day exploring attractions in and around your hotel. Spend the night at a Dublin hotel.

itinerary.title: Dublin Full Day Tour
itinerary.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast buffet or a full Irish breakfast. Jet off for a full-day tour on the Hop On Hop Off tour. Tickets to this tour is valid for 48 hours, allowing to join or leave at any time. Some of the things you will cover on this tour include Trinity College, the Guinness Storehouse, Dublin Castle, St. Patrick’s Cathedral, Kilmainham Gaol, and the Old Jameson Distillery. You will stop for lunch to enjoy international cuisine or local Irish food. Spend the rest of the day exploring the many nooks and crannies of the city. Stay overnight at a luxury hotel in Dublin.

itinerary.title: Dublin to Galway
itinerary.description: Check out of your hotel in Dublin to catch your train to Galway. The journey takes around 3 hours. Galway is located on the west coast of Ireland and perhaps the only place where you’ll find people speaking Irish commonly. The Old Galway City Tour helps tourists explore the ancient city – just sit back and relax on a double-decker vintage bus to enjoy your day. Some of the places you will visit in Galway include Eyre Square, Galway Cathedral, and the Galway City Museum. The city is famous for its music and culture and a lively café/bar culture. Other attractions in Galway include Connemara National Park, the Aran Islands, Ashford Castle, and Kylemore Abbey. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Galway.

itinerary.title: Galway – Cliff of Moher
itinerary.description: After a heavy breakfast, travel to Burren to experience Ireland’s most famous sight – the Cliffs of Moher. These sea cliffs have been featured in hundreds of movies, including Harry Potter, the Princess Bride, Leap Year, and more. It is also a prime spot to view the country’s abundant flora and fauna, including 20 different species of birds. You will travel through the Burren, a karst landscape paved with glacial-era limestones famous for its cliffs, caves, fossils, and other archaeological sites. The many prehistoric remains on the hills make them eerie and interesting. Drive to the Cliffs of Moher for awe-inspiring views of the Atlantic Ocean and the Aran Islands in the distance. The Cliffs of Moher Visitor Centre offers plenty of information about the area’s geology, history, and wildlife. Spend the night in Galway.

itinerary.title: Galway to Dublin
itinerary.description: Check out of your hotel in Galway to catch your return train to Dublin. Make sure you have enough free time to enjoy shopping at the many local Dublin markets where you can buy rare academic books, art, jewellery, souvenirs, and even jams, juices, and handmade jewellery. Spend the night in Dublin.

itinerary.title: Depart Dublin
itinerary.description: Check out of your Dublin hotel to reach the Dublin International Airport to continue with the next leg of your Europe tour package, or catch your return flight home.

itinerary.title: Arrive In Dublin
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at the Dublin International Airport, our tour manager will help you transfer to Dublin City Centre. Check into your hotel and listen to the tour guide's brief briefing about the upcoming itinerary. You will receive tickets for the Hop On Hop Off tour of Dublin. This is an interesting guided tour with live commentary in several international languages. This tour covers Trinity College, St. Patrick’s Cathedral, Dublin Castle, The Guinness Storehouse, Kilmainham Gaol and the Old Jameson Distillery. The ticket is valid for 48 hours and covers 25 stops. You can leave or join at any time, allowing you to explore the city at your own pace and comfortably.

itinerary.title: Dublin Full Day Tour
itinerary.description: Start your day with a hearty Irish breakfast before continuing your Hop On Hop Off tour. Today, you will visit the world-famous Guinness Storehouse. The place has attracted over twenty million visitors since it opened in 2000. People visit the Guinness Storehouse to understand the history of Irish beer and learn what makes it special. You will also visit Gravity Bar, an iconic rooftop watering hole that offers a panoramic view of the city. The next stop on the tour is the 432-year-old Trinity College. This is Ireland’s oldest university, founded by Queen Elizabeth I of England and Ireland. Don’t miss the Book of Kells, a Celtic gospel book and an illuminated manuscript believed to have been created around 800 AD. Spend the night in Dublin.

itinerary.title: Dublin Full Day Tour
itinerary.description: Today, you can spend the day touring the Wicklow Mountains or, at leisure, exploring the city’s markets and cultural destinations. To the uninitiated, Wicklow is also called the Garden of Ireland, thanks to its beautiful scenery and extensive woodlands. The tour also covers Enniskerry, a picturesque town home to neo-Tudor-style buildings, and Glendalough, a glacial valley famous for its exquisite and historic scenery. You will explore the neighbouring villages of Laragh/Clara, Rathdrum, Roundwood, and Avoca. The latter is home to Ireland’s oldest mill, Avoca Handweavers. Return to Dublin to spend the night at a luxury hotel.

itinerary.title: Depart Dublin
itinerary.description: Check out of your hotel as you reach Dublin International Airport to continue with your Europe tour package or return home.

itinerary.title: Arrive In Dublin
itinerary.description: As you arrive at Dublin International Airport, our tour manager will help you complete the transfer to the hotel. After checking in, we’ll brief you about the next few days of your tour package. Spend the rest of the day at leisure, exploring the many markets and pubs serving traditional Irish fare.

itinerary.title: Dublin City Tour
itinerary.description: After a hearty breakfast buffet, head to catch your Hop On Hop Off tour bus. Today, you will explore Ireland’s capital city from an open double-decker bus. We’ll start with Trinity College, move on to Christ Church Cathedral and St. Patrick’s Cathedral, and cover other attractions like the Guinness Brewery and Storehouse, the Old Library, Kilmainham Gaol, and the Dublin Castle. Don’t miss sampling some of the finest beer at the Guinness Storehouse or the world-famous Irish whiskey at The Old Jameson Distillery.

itinerary.title: Depart Dublin
itinerary.description: Check out from the hotel and move on to the next leg of your Europe tour package or catch your flight to return home.

packages.name: Discover Switzerland
packages.destination: Geneva - Interlaken - Jungfrau - Lucerne - Mount Titlis - Zurich

itinerary.title: Arrive in Geneva
itinerary.description: After you land in Geneva, our tour representatives will greet you at the airport and take you to your hotel. Once the check-in formalities are complete, you will have the rest of the day to spend at your own pace. Stay overnight at a luxury hotel in Geneva.

itinerary.title: Geneva City Tour
itinerary.description: Head to the Geneva Bus Station for a full-day city tour. Your day starts with a visit to the headquarters of all international organisations like the WHO, UNHR, the ILO, and the CERN. You will also cover famous landmarks like the Geneva Water Fountain and the Flower Clock. Get on a mini train to learn about Geneva’s history and then explore Old Town on a walking tour.

itinerary.title: Geneva – Interlaken
itinerary.description: Take the Swiss Rail from Geneva to Interlaken. Enjoy the spectacular view of Lake Geneva and the mountain range from the train. No wonder it makes it to the top 15 most beautiful Swiss train journeys list. Upon reaching your hotel, complete the check-in process, and you will have the rest of the day to spend at leisure.

itinerary.title: Interlaken – Jungfrau
itinerary.description: Board a train from Interlaken Ost to Grindelwald on the fourth day of your trip. Embark on a cogwheel train journey to Jungfraujoch and enjoy the journey as it travels through the Kleine Scheidegg Pass. Jungfrau is the world’s highest railway station at an altitude of 3,454 metres. It is also the perfect viewing point for the Bernese Alps. In Jungfrau, don’t forget to admire the view of the Aletsch Glacier, the biggest glacier in the Alps, and visit the Ice Palace.

itinerary.title: Interlaken – Lucerne
itinerary.description: Spend the morning exploring Interlaken until it is time for your train to Lucerne. At Lucerne, our representatives will help you get to your hotel. After checking in to your accommodation, you can spend the rest of the day at leisure or shop. Lucerne is the best place to explore the Alps and the surrounding historical monuments.

itinerary.title: Lucerne – Mt. Titlis
itinerary.description: Day 6 involves visiting Mount Titlis through a deluxe motor coach from the Lucerne Tourist Station. Mount Titlis is the highest vantage point in Central Switzerland. The tour also includes a visit to Engelberb, a mountain resort in Switzerland. From Engelberg, ride the Rotair, a revolving cable car ride for a 360-degree view of the surrounding Swiss. We will take you on a ride to other attractions in and around Mount LItlis. Spend the night at your hotel in Lucerne. You may also spend the rest of the evening.

itinerary.title: Lucerne – Zurich - National Museum - Lake Zurich
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel in Lucerne to board a train to Zurich. After finishing check-in formalities, you will be heading for an enjoyable city tour. Visit the National Museum, Lake Zurich, University of Zurich, Kunsthaus Zurich, St. Peter's Church, Old Town, Grossmunster Church, and the Opera House.

itinerary.title: Depart from Zurich
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

packages.name: Glacier Dream
packages.destination: Switzerland - Zermatt - Gornergrat - St. Moritz-Zurich - Rhine Fall - Zurich

itinerary.title: Arrive in Zurich – Zermatt
itinerary.description: After you land in Zurich, you will take the Glacier Express from Zurich to Zermatt. This 4-hour journey is probably the best, thanks to its breathtaking mountains and gorges. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Zermatt.

itinerary.title: Zermatt – Gornergrat – Matterhorn
itinerary.description: On the second day, board the Gornergrat Railway to travel 3089m above sea level to Gornegrat. Enjoy the spectacular view of the Matterhorn, Switzerland’s most famous peak. After this adventure, get back to your hotel later in the day.

itinerary.title: Zermatt - St. Moritz
itinerary.description: Get on board the popular Glacier Express for a seven-and-a-half journey from Zermatt to St. Moritz, a resort town in Switzerland’s Engadin Valley. St. Moritz is famous for its mineral springs and has attracted aristocrats and the ultra-rich for centuries. You will spend the night at one of the world's most luxurious and posh St. Moritz ski resorts.

itinerary.title: St. Moritz – Zurich - Rhine Falls
itinerary.description: Travel from St. Moritz to Zurich. While you will be spending most of the day walking around the streets of Zurich, visiting museums, and shopping at flea markets, you absolutely must explore the Rhine Falls, the biggest waterfall in Europe. Spend the night at your hotel in Zurich.

itinerary.title: Bahnhofstrasse - Swiss National Museum
itinerary.description: Getting a Swiss Pass is one of the easiest ways to explore Zurich. Go to the downtown street known as Bahnhofstrasse, among the world's most exclusive and expensive shopping avenues. It is a paradise for all the shopaholics. While this cosmopolitan city is famous for its shopping centres, it also retains its quiet city charm with its historical centres and views of the surrounding countryside. Don’t miss the Swiss National Museum later in the day, which portrays Switzerland’s cultural history.

itinerary.title: Depart from Zurich
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home. You can also use the Swiss Pass to continue your journey.

packages.name: Glacier Paradise
packages.destination: Switzerland - Interlaken - Jungfraujoch - Zermatt - Gornergrat - Zurich

itinerary.title: Arrive in Switzerland – Interlaken
itinerary.description: After you land in Zurich, you will be taking a train to the town of Interlaken. Check in to your hotel, after which you can spend the rest of the day at your own pace.

itinerary.title: Interlaken – Jungfraujoch
itinerary.description: On your second day, board a train from Interlaken Ost to Grindelwald, from where you can take a cogwheel train to the top of Jungfraujoch and the viewing point in the Bernese Alps, situated at an altitude of 3,454 meters. Take in the view of the Aletsch Glacier, the biggest glacier in the Alps, and visit the Ice Palace. Spend the night at your hotel in Interlaken.

itinerary.title: Interlaken - Mt. Rigi – Zermatt
itinerary.description: The third day will be dedicated to an excursion to Mt. Rigi. Board a train to Lucerne and then take a ferry to Vitznau. Ride up Mt. Rigi on Europe’s first-ever mountain railway and get back on a cable car to Weggis. Check out of your hotel and take a train to Zermatt. Spend the evening at leisure.

itinerary.title: Zermatt – Gornergrat – Matterhorn
itinerary.description: The Gornergrat Railway will take you 3089 m above sea level to to Gornergrat. Take in the breathtaking view of the Matterhorn, Switzerland’s most famous peak. Get back to your hotel later in the day.

itinerary.title: Zermatt – Rhine Falls – Zurich
itinerary.description: Take a train from Zermatt to Zurich. Post checking in to your hotel, use your Swiss Pass to proceed to the Rhine Falls, which is the biggest waterfall in Europe.

itinerary.title: Depart from Zurich
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Seville - Plaza de Toros de la Maestranza - Torre del Oro
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Seville Airport, our tour representatives will greet you and take you to your hotel. After checking-in and freshening up, leave to explore the city of Seville. Start off with the Plaza de Toros de la Maestranza, which is the biggest and among the most integral bullfighting arenas in the country. Move on to Torre del Oro, a military watchtower that was built during the first third of the 13th century. End the day by visiting Santa Cruz, a neighbourhood filled with plazas, colourful buildings, and narrow streets and alleys.

itinerary.title: Seville City Tour - La Giralda - Parque de Maria Luisa
itinerary.description: After having breakfast, head out to continue your exploration of Seville. You will be taken to La Giralda, which is the bell tower of Seville Cathedral and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Walk around the Parque de Maria Luisa, a public park which was donated to the city in 1893. The day will end with a cruise along the Guadalquivir River.

itinerary.title: Seville – Ronda - Mirador La Hoya Del Tajo - Puente Nuevo
itinerary.description: On this day, you will be taking a train from Seville to Ronda. Our tour representatives will greet you at the railway station and then take you to your hotel. After freshening up, you will be heading towards Mirador La Hoya Del Tajo, a scenic viewpoint from where you can lay your eyes on El Tajo de Ronda, Puente Nuevo, and the Old City.

itinerary.title: Ronda – Granada
itinerary.description: Travel from Ronda to Granada on the fourth day of your trip. On reaching your hotel and finishing the check-in process, you can spend the rest of the day relaxing or exploring the many tapas bars in the city.

itinerary.title: Granada City Tour - Catedral de Granada - Royal Chapel of Granada
itinerary.description: Have a scrumptious breakfast, and then get ready to go on a city tour of Granada. Take in the beauty of Catedral de Granada, a Roman Catholic church which is also known as the Cathedral of the Incarnation. Serving as the seat of Granada’s Archdiocese, the construction of the church was completed in 1561. Go to the Royal Chapel of Granada, a gothic style chapel that was built between 1505 and 1517. Yet another historical spot you will be heading to today is the Alhambra, a palace and fortress complex which is a prime example of Islamic architecture. Later in the day, enjoy a flamenco show at the Sacromonte Caves before heading back to your hotel.

itinerary.title: Granada – Cordoba - Mosque–Cathedral of Cordoba - Palacio de Viana
itinerary.description: Drive down to the city of Cordoba on the sixth day of your trip. Check-in to your hotel and head out to witness some of the most popular attractions in the city. These sites include the Jewish Quarter, Mosque-Cathedral of Cordoba, and Palacio de Viana.

itinerary.title: Depart Cordoba
itinerary.description: After having your breakfast, check out of your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Geneva – St. Pierre Cathedral - Conservatory and Botanical Garden - Museum of Art and History
itinerary.description: After you land in Geneva, our tour representatives will greet you at the airport and take you to your hotel. We’ll wait until you complete the check-in formalities and freshen up so you can head out to begin your Swiss holiday. The first stop for the day is the St. Pierre Cathedral, a former Roman Catholic cathedral converted into the Reformed Protestant Church of Geneva during the Reformation. Head to the Conservatory and Botanical Garden which covers an area of about 28 hectares. The herbarium here is renowned as one of the largest of its kind in the world, with over six million samples. Visit the Museum of Art and History, which contains more than a million exposition pieces, providing tourists with details regarding the history of Western culture and what civilization looked like during the ancient era.

itinerary.title: The Geneva Water Fountain - Flower Clock – Mini Train Tour
itinerary.description: On your second day, begin by witnessing the beauty of the Geneva Water Fountain as you start your two-hour Geneva city tour. The fountain is one of the city's most beloved landmarks and is one of the world’s tallest fountains. Next, lay your eyes on the Flower Clock. It was created in 1955 using 6,500 flowering plants and shrubs that form the face of the clock. Lastly, go on a mini-train tour to Geneva's Old Town.

itinerary.title: Depart from Geneva
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight home.

itinerary.title: Arrive In Dublin
itinerary.description: Welcome to City of a Thousand Welcomes. Upon your arrival at the Dublin International Airport, our tour manager will welcome and accompany you to the hotel, helping you complete the transfer formalities. After check-in and hearing about your itinerary for the next few days, spend the rest of the day at leisure, exploring places around your hotel. Stay overnight in Dublin.

itinerary.title: Dublin City Tour
itinerary.description: Start your day with a sumptuous English breakfast before embarking on a Hop On Hop Off tour to explore the various attractions in and around Dublin. Today, you will visit Trinity College, the Guinness Storehouse, Dublin Castle, St. Patrick’s Cathedral, Kilmainham Gaol, and the Old James Distillery. This tour consists of a live commentary in a language of your choice. Stop for lunch at a local restaurant to sample local cuisine. Spend the rest of the day to enjoy the lively Dublin markets, or grab a pint at a local pub. Spend the night in Dublin.

itinerary.title: Dublin to Killarney
itinerary.description: After a breakfast buffet, head to the Dublin station to take a train to Killarney, a picturesque town in County Kerry. Killarney is home to Ireland’s tallest mountain, Carrauntoohil, and is famous for its beautiful and extensive forests. The journey takes around 3 hours and offers excellent views of the countryside. After check-in, you’ll take a cart ride from the hotel to Killarney National Park. With more than 26,000 acres of ancient forests, rivers, and lakes, the National Park is undoubtedly the city’s most prized attraction. Some of the activities at Killarney National Park include horse riding, cycling, canoeing and kayaking, fishing, swimming, bird watching, walking—hiking, and boating. You can also sign up for a guided tour of the forests or take a Killarney walking trail.

itinerary.title: Killarney – Ring of Kerry
itinerary.description: Your breakfast options include a medley of continental cuisines and a hearty full Irish breakfast of bacon, sausages, baked beans, eggs, mushrooms, and grilled tomatoes. While you may be tempted to call it a day and retire after such a heavy meal, there’s lots to see and do today. Today, your tour will start with the Ring of Kerry Excursion. You will leave from Killarney to Killorglin via the banks of the river Laune. This is an important town on the Ring of Kerry tourist route, famous for its natural beauty and the Puck Fair. Lough Caragh is between Killorglin and Glenbeigh and is one of the many freshwater lakes in Kerry where you can fish for salmons, sea trout, and freshwater herrings. It’s also an excellent place for kayaking, canoeing, and boat riding. The next stop on the Ring of Kerry route is Cahersiveen, a town at the foot of the Beentee Mountain, overlooking the Valentina Harbour. You can visit the many beautiful churches, The Old Barracks, and the famous Ballycarberry Castle. The next stop is Waterville, a seafront village along the Coomakista Pass and Derrynane. Popular attractions include the Waterville Golf Links, the Charlie Chaplain statue, and the Skellig Gift Store. Sneem, a beautiful village in County Kerry, is the next stop. It is famous for its brightly coloured houses, which attract thousands of visitors from across the world. From there, you will head to Moll’s Gap, a mountain pass and a 57km long circuit between Killarney and Kenmare. The last stop on this route is the scenic Ladies View, Killarney’s most panoramic viewpoint. It is named after Queen Victoria’s Ladies in Waiting, who were part of her entourage when she visited the place in 1861. Spend the night in Killarney.

itinerary.title: Killarney to Dublin
itinerary.description: After breakfast, catch your train to return to Dublin. Spend the night in the city.

itinerary.title: Depart Dublin
itinerary.description: Bid adieu to Emerald Island as you check out of the hotel to catch your flight to the next destination. You can either continue with our Europe tour package or return home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Budapest
itinerary.description: Welcome to Budapest! Upon arrival at the Budapest International Airport, we’ll help you transfer to the hotel. Complete the check-in formalities and spend the rest of the day exploring the area.

itinerary.title: Budapest City Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast, we'll head out on a guided tour of the city. We’ll start from the Chain Bridge, where you can check both sides of the Danube. You’ll pass by the Parliament and the Margaret Bridge to reach Buda. Stop at the Castle District to enjoy views of the Matthias Church and Fishermen’s Bastion. Then, we’ll drive to Gellert Hill to enjoy a panoramic view of the city. Next, travel across the Elisabeth Bridge to Pest and enjoy the famous Central Market Hall and the Dohany Street Synagogue, the largest in Europe. You’ll also visit the Budapest Zoo and Europe’s largest thermal spa, the Amusement Park, and then stop at the Heroes Square. You’ll end the day with a visit to Andrassy Avenue, the Opera House, and St Stephen’s Basilica. Spend the rest of the day exploring the city before returning to your hotel. Spend the night in Budapest.

itinerary.title: Depart Budapest
itinerary.description: Check out of your hotel to catch your flight home or continue with your Europe tour package.

itinerary.title: Arrive In Rome
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at the Leonardo da Vinci – Fiumicino Airport, our tour manager will welcome you and help you transfer to the hotel. Check in to your hotel and spend the rest of the day exploring the many local attractions around your hotel. Rome is a walkable city with most attractions nearby. You can also check the many markets selling antiques, carpets, clothing, and religious art. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Rome.

itinerary.title: Rome Full Day City Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head out for a full-day Hop On Hop Off Bus tour. The open-top double-decker bus allows you a panoramic view of the many attractions. Some of the places you will cover include the Coliseum, the Pantheon, the Roman Forum, the Trevi Fountain, St. Peter’s Basilica, Sistine Chapel, the many Vatican museums, and the Spanish Steps. After lunch, you are free to enjoy some shopping in one of Rome’s many markets and boutiques. Spend the evening sampling delectable Italian cuisine at Trastevere, a quaint part of the city home to numerous small local restaurants. Spend the night in Rome.

itinerary.title: Depart Rome
itinerary.description: Check out of the hotel to continue with the next leg of your journey or catch your return flight home.

itinerary.title: Arrive In Milan
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at the Milan Malpensa Airport, our tour manager will welcome you and help you complete the transfer formalities. After check-in, you are free to spend the rest of the day exploring the many local attractions in and around your hotel. Stay overnight at a luxury hotel in Milan.

itinerary.title: Milan Full Day Tour
itinerary.description: Start your day with a sumptuous breakfast. Later, move to explore the city on a Hop-on hop-off bus. The tour is valid for 48 hours, allowing you to join or leave the bus anytime. This is an open-top double-decker bus offering a 360° view of the many attractions. Some places you will cover on this tour include the Sforza Castle, Basilica di Sant’Ambrogio, Parco delle Basiliche, and Leonardo’s Navigli, a series of artificial canals designed by Leonardo da Vinci. After lunch, you’ll visit other attractions, such as the Duomo, to admire The Madonnina, the Scala Opera House, the Fondazione Prada, and the Leonardo da Vinci Museum of Science and Technology. Spend the night in Milan.

itinerary.title: Depart Milan
itinerary.description: After checking out of the hotel, move to the airport to continue with the next leg of your Europe tour package or catch your flight to return home.

itinerary.title: Arrive In Venice
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at the Venice Marco Polo International Airport, our tour manager will welcome you and assist with travel formalities. After you complete check-in, you can spend the rest of the day exploring the many market stalls and other streets around your hotel. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Venice.

itinerary.title: Venice Full Day Tour
itinerary.description: After a grand breakfast buffet, head to Mark’s Square for a guided walking tour of the city. You will visit Venice’s most popular attractions, including the Ducai Palace, Bridge of Sighs, St. Mark’s Basilica, Santa Maria della Salute, Ponte di Rialto, and Grand Canal. After a quick lunch, cover Venice's many narrow and winding streets, squares, and bridges. You will return to St. Mark’s Square through Mercerie, on the main street, to go shopping. Spend the night in Venice.

itinerary.title: Depart Venice
itinerary.description: Check out of your hotel to reach Venice Airport to continue with the next leg of your Europe tour package or catch your flight to return home.

itinerary.title: Arrive In Florence
itinerary.description: As you arrive at the Florence International Airport, our tour manager will welcome you and help you transfer to the hotel. Check-in and spend the rest of the day exploring the many flea markets selling affordable leather handbags, wallets, bracelets, trinkets and other accessories. It’s also a great place to buy decorative items for your home and inexpensive kitchenware. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Florence.

itinerary.title: Florence Full Day Tour
itinerary.description: After a sumptuous breakfast, head to the Hop On Hop Off bus for a full-day tour of the city. You will travel on an open-top double-decker bus with a panoramic view of the city’s multiple attractions. Some of the places you will cover today include Piazzale Michelangelo, the Accademia Gallery, the Cathedral of Santa Maria del Fiore, Ponte Vecchio, Uffizi Galleries, the Basilica of Santa Croce, and Piazza del Duomo. Don’t miss the statue of David at the Accademia Gallery and the panoramic view from Piazzale Michelangelo. Also, visit the Boboli Gardens and climb the hills of the Church of San Miniato al Monte. Spend the evening visiting the many boutiques of Florence. Stay overnight in Florence.

itinerary.title: Depart Florence
itinerary.description: Check out of your hotel to continue with the next leg of your Europe tour package or catch your return flight home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Bern – Rose Garden - Bern Minster
itinerary.description: After you land in Bern, our tour representatives will greet you at the airport and take you to your hotel. Once you finish checking in and freshening up, it will be time to begin exploring this UNESCO World Heritage Site. The Rose Garden in Bern is perfect for anyone who loves flowers, as this garden contains over 400 rose varieties. Post this, head to the Swiss Reformed Cathedral or Bern Minster, as the locals call the place. Boasting a Gothic design, the construction of this church began in 1421. It is also the tallest cathedral in Switzerland. Spend the rest of the day at your pace and return to your hotel for a good night's sleep.

itinerary.title: Clock Tower - Einstein Museum - Historical Museum - Botanical Garden
itinerary.description: Begin the second day with a tour of the Zytglogge Clock Tower, one of the most popular landmarks in Bern. It was built during the early 13th century and has been around for 800 years. Learn more about the life of Albert Einstein at the Einstein Museum, which contains about 550 original objects and replicas, including letters and 70 films and animations. Head to the Historical Museum, which is Switzerland’s second-biggest museum. It was constructed in 1894 and designed by Andre Lambert to display the history of Bern. The last stop for the day is the Botanical Garden at the University of Bern. Having existed since 1860, it has about 5500 different plant species from all around the world. Spend the night at your hotel in Bern.

itinerary.title: Depart from Bern
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Reykjavik
itinerary.description: Welcome to Iceland! Upon arrival at Reykjavik International Airport, our tour guides will help you transfer to the hotel. Complete check-in formalities and spend the rest of the day at leisure.

itinerary.title: Half Day City Tour – Reykjavik
itinerary.description: Today, you’ll begin your day with a half-day city tour. You’ll start with a visit to the president’s residence at Bessastaoir and the town of Hafnarfjorour, which is believed to have been the home of dwarves, elves, and other hidden people. You will also explore the town’s old fishing harbour before proceeding to Perlan for a panoramic view of the capital. Move on to Hallgrímskirkja church, named after a national poet and clergyman. The unique design is said to resemble a lava flow, a key element of Iceland’s geography. The church took 40 years to build and is one of the city’s most famous landmarks. You’ll end the tour with a visit to Althing, the world’s oldest parliament, founded in 930. Return to Reykjavik to spend the night at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Reykjavik Full Day City Tour
itinerary.description: Today, you’ll start with a full-day tour of Reykjavik. The tour takes you to South Iceland, stopping at some of the country’s most iconic attractions. Some of the places you’ll visit include Thingvellir National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site located in an active volcanic area famous for the Althing, Iceland’s Parliament. Apparently, leaders would meet here to decide on legislation during the Viking Age. The next stop is the majestic Gullfoss, an iconic Icelandic waterfall on the Golden Circle. We’ll have a break for lunch at Gullfoss Café before moving on to the Strokkur Geyser. The next stop is Faxi Waterfall, where you’ll watch salmon climbing upstream during the salmon season. The Skalholt Cathedral and the museum below it are the next attractions on the tour. Return to the hotel to spend the night in the hotel room.

itinerary.title: Whale Watching
itinerary.description: Today, you will embark on a whale-watching journey, sailing from Reykjavik to Faxafloi Bay. This bay is home to a variety of arctic wildlife, including whales, dolphins, puffins, gannets, and some species of gulls. You’ll proceed to the Whale Exhibition Centre and learn more about the ocean's mysteries. The museum is converted from an old Capelin fishing vessel and offers plenty of information about whales and sea birds. Spend the rest of the night leisurely before returning to the hotel room.

itinerary.title: Depart Reykjavik
itinerary.description: Bid adieu to the city as you catch your flight back home, or continue with the next leg of your journey.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Athens
itinerary.description: Welcome to Athens. Upon arrival at the Athens International Airport, we will meet you and help you transfer to the hotel. After completing the checkout formalities, you can spend the rest of the evening exploring the area around the hotel. Stay overnight at a luxury hotel in Athens.

itinerary.title: Athens City Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head to a full-day city tour of Athens. Greece’s capital city is over 3500 years old and one of the oldest capital cities of Europe. Some places you will explore today include the Acropolis, the Parthenon, the Temple of Zeus, Hadrian’s Arch, the Temple of Hephaestus, Erechtheion, and the Roman Forum of Athens. Some of the modern buildings include the Panathenaic Stadium, the National Archaeological Museum, the Parliament, the Maximos Mansion, the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier, and the Prime Minister’s residence. End the day with a visit to the Acropolis Museum, where you can enjoy its famous exhibits, including the Peplos Kore, Karyatid, and the Parthenon west frieze.

itinerary.title: Athens – Argolis – Olympia
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel and leave for Argolis. You’ll drive through the Corinth Canal and visit some remarkable attractions, such as the Theatre of Epidaurus, the towns of Nauplion and Mycenae, and the Tomb of Agamemnon. After Argolis, you’ll drive through the towns of Tripolis and Megalopolis to reach Olympia. You'll check into a luxury hotel in Olympia and spend the rest of the evening exploring the area around the hotel.

itinerary.title: Olympia to Delphi
itinerary.description: Check out from the hotel and head to Delphi. On the way, you will visit the Sanctuary of Olympian Zeus, the Ancient Stadium, and the Archaeological Museum. You’ll drive through the plains of Eliad and Achaia, crossing the Rio-Antirrio Bridge along the Corinthian Bay. You’ll also pass through the towns of Nafpaktos and Itea to arrive in Delphi. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Delphi.

itinerary.title: Delphi to Athens
itinerary.description: Check out from the hotel to explore the city, including the ancient ruins of the Temple of Apollo, the Castalian Spring, the Temple of Athena, and the Oracle of Delphi. You will also explore the Archaeological Museum of Delphi famous for its masterpieces like Iniochos, the Charioteer of Delphi. Drive to Athens and check into a hotel. Spend the night in the city.

itinerary.title: Depart Athens
itinerary.description: Check out of your hotel and bid adieu to the country as you reach the Athens International Airport to board your flight back home or to your next destination for the Greece tour package.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Athens
itinerary.description: Welcome to Athens. Upon arrival in Athens, we will greet you and help you transfer to the hotel. Complete the check-in formalities and spend the rest of the day exploring places around the hotel. Overnight at the hotel in Athens.

itinerary.title: Athens Full Day Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head to a full-day city tour of Athens. Greece’s capital city is over 3500 years old and one of the oldest capital cities of Europe. Some places you will explore today include the Acropolis, the Parthenon, the Temple of Zeus, Hadrian’s Arch, the Temple of Hephaestus, Erechtheion, and the Roman Forum of Athens. Some of the modern buildings include the Panathenaic Stadium, the National Archaeological Museum, the Parliament, the Maximos Mansion, the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier, and the Prime Minister’s residence. End the day with a visit to the Acropolis Museum, where you can enjoy its famous exhibits, including the Peplos Kore, Karyatid, and the Parthenon west frieze.

itinerary.title: Athens - Naxos
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head to catch your ferry to Naxos. The journey takes around 3.5 hours and is scenic as the ferry cruises through the famous Cycladic Islands. Upon arrival, complete the check-in formalities and spend the rest of the evening exploring the areas around the hotel.

itinerary.title: Naxos
itinerary.description: After breakfast, spend the day exploring the beautiful Naxos island. You can also visit Portara or the Great Door. This is the unfinished gate of a vast temple dedicated to Apollo.

itinerary.title: Naxos - Santorini
itinerary.description: After breakfast, catch your ferry to Santorini. The journey takes an hour and is mesmerising as the ferry cruises through the Aegean Sea. Upon arrival, check into a hotel and spend the rest of the evening exploring the island.

itinerary.title: Santorini
itinerary.description: Santorini is a fantastic beach destination with picturesque villages, cobbled streets and beautiful homes. The island is also famous for its unique food and wine – the latter is incredibly unique because of Santorini’s rare grapes. After breakfast, head out for a full-day tour of the island. Some places you will explore include Caldera Sunset and the archaeological sites of Akrotiri. You can also visit the volcano and hot springs.

itinerary.title: Depart Santorini
itinerary.description: After breakfast in the morning, head out to the Santorini International Airport to board your flight back home or to your next destination.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Mykonos
itinerary.description: Welcome to Mykonos. Upon arrival at the Mykonos International Airport, our tour manager will help you transfer to the hotel. After completing the check-in formalities, spend the rest of the day exploring places around the hotel.

itinerary.title: Mykonos Full Day Tour
itinerary.description: After a scrumptious breakfast buffet, head out for a guided tour of Mykonos Island. The glamourous city has been attracting local and international tourists since 1960. It is famous for its beaches, bars, and clubs, as well as its delicious cuisine. The first stop on your Mykonos tour is the idyllic Agios Ioannis Beach, where you can enjoy a great view of Delos Island. You’ll also see fishermen pulling their boats and locals visiting the private chapels built in typical Cycladic architectural style. The next stop is the Ano Mera village, where you explore the Panagia Tourliani, built in the 16th century. Stroll around the town while relaxing at one of the many local restaurants. The next stop is Kalafatis Beach, where you can enjoy refreshments before returning to town. Don’t miss the narrow cobblestone streets of Mykonos to reach the famous windmills and Little Venice. Don’t forget to click pictures with Petros the Pelican, the mascot of Mykonos. After a busy day, return to your hotel to spend the night enjoying a traditional Greek dinner.

itinerary.title: Depart Mykonos
itinerary.description: Today, you can check out from the hotel to catch your return flight or continue with the next leg of your Greece tour package.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Athens
itinerary.description: Welcome to Athens. Our tour manager will greet you upon arrival and help you transfer to the hotel. After completing the check-in formalities, you can explore the area around the hotel. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Athens.

itinerary.title: Athens City Tour
itinerary.description: Today, you will enjoy a full-day city tour of Athens, exploring its historic monuments and other ruins. Some of the places you will explore include the Parthenon, the Ancient Agora of Athens, the Odeon of Herodes Atticus, the Temple of Hephaestus, the Temple of Olympian Zeus, Erechtheion, the Roman Forum of Athens, the Theatre of Dionysus, and the Hadrian’s Arch. Don’t miss some modern monuments like Panathenaic Stadium, where the first Olympic Games was held in 1896, the Presidential Mansion, the Maximos Mansion, the National Archaeological Museum, the National Library, and the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier. The Acropolis Museum is also a must-visit with famous masterpieces like the Propylaea and the Parthenon West Frieze.

itinerary.title: Athens – Lefkada
itinerary.description: After breakfast, you will move to the Athens Airport to catch your domestic flight to Lefkada. After completing the check-in formalities, you will spend the rest of the day exploring places in and around the hotel. Stay overnight in Lefkada.

itinerary.title: Lefkada City Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast, enjoy the beautiful Lefkada Island, famous for its beaches, churches, and monasteries. Lefkada is a fabulous tourist place with lush vegetation, picturesque villages, and secluded beaches with turquoise waters. Some beaches you must visit include Porto Katsiki, Kathisma, and Egremni. Spend the night with a candlelight dinner at one of these beaches.

itinerary.title: Lefkada
itinerary.description: Spend your day at leisure enjoying the beautiful beaches, some of which have impressive cliffs ending to the deep blue sea. You can also take a dolphin cruise at the Amvrakikkos Gulf or visit Melissani Cave at Kefallinia Island.

itinerary.title: Lefkada – Athens
itinerary.description: Bid adieu to Lefkada as you check out of the hotel and head to Lefkada Airport to catch your flight to Athens. Spend the night in Athens.

itinerary.title: Depart Athens
itinerary.description: Move to Athens International Airport to board your flight back home or to the next leg of your Europe tour package.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Athens
itinerary.description: Welcome to Athens! Upon arrival at the Athens International Airport, our tour manager will greet you and help you transfer to the hotel. After you complete the check-in formalities, the manager will explain the tour details. Spend the rest of the day exploring the area around your hotel. Overnight at a luxury hotel in Athens.

itinerary.title: Athens City Tour
itinerary.description: After a hearty breakfast buffet, head out for a half-day city tour. Athens is one of the oldest European cities famous for influencing modern Western Civilisation. It is also great for food lovers, with plenty of street food stalls selling modern and traditional Greek food. You will cover Parliament Square, Maximos Mansion, the National Gallery, the Acropolis, the Temple of Poseidon, the Odeon of Herodes Atticus, the National Garden, and the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier. The tour also includes visiting the Panathenaic Stadium, the site of the first modern Olympics held in 1896. You can relax on the coach as it travels to Panepistimiou Avenue, home to the National Library and the Metropolitan Cathedral of Athens. The Temple of Zeus and the Acropolis Museum are other attractions covered in the tour. After a busy day, retire to your hotel room and enjoy a scrumptious dinner.

itinerary.title: Athens Cruise Tour
itinerary.description: After a breakfast buffet, head to discover the three beautiful Greek Islands in the Saronic Gulf: Paros, Hydra, and Aegina. Paros is comparatively less crowded than Mykonos and Santorini and is famous for its picturesque villages, like the Cyclades. Hydra is renowned for its rich luxury villas and historical monuments. When in Aegina, don’t miss a guided excursion to the Temple of Aphaia.

itinerary.title: Athens Delphi Tour
itinerary.description: After a breakfast buffet at the hotel, head out for a full-day tour of Delphi. This is a UNESCO World Heritage Site famous for its historical monuments, viz., the ancient stadium, the Temple of Apollo, the ancient Theatre of Delphi, and the Delphi Archaeological Museum. As you drive to Delphi, stop at Livadia and Arachova, towns famous for their brightly coloured carpets, rugs, and other woven textiles. Return to Athens to spend the night in your hotel room.

itinerary.title: Athens to Kalabaka
itinerary.description: After a scrumptious breakfast, head to Athens railway station to catch your train to Kalabaka. This town is set on the foothills of Meteora and is famous for the Aspropotamos River, Koziaka Mountains, and the legendary monasteries built on the Meteora rocks. The journey takes around 5 hours and is famous for its beautiful and scenic Greek countryside. Upon arrival, check into the hotel and complete the transfer formalities. Spend the rest of the day at leisure, exploring places around the hotel. Overnight at a hotel in Kalabaka.

itinerary.title: Kalambaka to Athens
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head on a half-day tour of Meteora and the Theopetra Caves. Meteora is located only 5.5 km from central Kalabaka and is famous for its sandstone peaks, where monks established monasteries around the 11th century. You’ll explore and enjoy this beautiful place's natural beauty and cultural heritage while listening to the audio guide, who will share fascinating stories about how the early hermits and monks survived hundreds of years ago. Later, you will proceed south of Meteora to the prehistoric Theopetra Cave, situated at the foot of the Chasia Mountains. This cave was inhabited during the Middle Palaeolithic period, around 130,000 years ago. Return to the hotel in the afternoon to catch your train to Athens. Check into the Athens hotel and spend the night in Greece’s capital.

itinerary.title: Depart Athens
itinerary.description: After breakfast, bid adieu to the country as you catch your flight to return to India or continue with your Greece vacation package.

itinerary.title: Arrival In Athens
itinerary.description: Arrive at Athens International Airport. One of our tour representatives will greet you and help you transfer to the hotel. We’ll also brief you about the different places you’ll cover, general dos and don'ts and other instructions to ensure safe travel. You can spend the evening roaming around the city and enjoying the nightlife in Athens.

itinerary.title: Athens – City Tour And Acropolis
itinerary.description: Athens is famous for its ancient monuments, stunning landscapes, bars and cafes, nightclubs, and local markets. After a breakfast buffet, head on a Hop On Hop Off bus city tour. The first stop is the Panathenaic Stadium – one of the oldest and only stadiums in the world built entirely out of marble. It is also famous for hosting modern world’s first-ever Olympics in 1896. The next stop of the trip is Maximos Mansion, the Prime Minister’s Residence. The mansion also features a rotating display of artwork and design objects by various Greek artists. Some of the other places you’ll cover today include The Temple of Olympian Zeus, the Hadrian’s Arch, the Parliament, the Memory of the Unknown Soldier, the Academy, the University, the National Library of Greece, the Constitution Square, etc. The final stop of the day is the Acropolis Museum, famous for the Parthenon Gallery, which hosts sculptures of the Parthenon. The Archaic Gallery hosts sculptures from 700 BC to 480 BC. Spend your night in Athens.

itinerary.title: Athens To Mykonos
itinerary.description: Post breakfast you’ll move to Mykonos by ferry. The journey takes around 3 to 5 hours and offers a scenic view of the Mediterranean. Check in to a comfortable hotel and roam around the city for some late-evening strolling and shopping. Mykonos is a relatively safe place, even at night. Mykonos is a picturesque Greek island famous for its cobblestoned alleyways, iconic windmills, and legendary nightlife. And, of course, the scrumptious Mediterranean food.

itinerary.title: Mykonos
itinerary.description: Today, after breakfast, you will explore Mykonos’ popular tourist attractions, including the many windmills, Church of Panagia Paraportiani, Paradise Beach, etc. You can also enjoy some adventure sports, including windsurfing, parasailing, and snorkelling. Spend the night in Mykonos soaking in its vibrant nightlife in its many world-famous nightclubs.

itinerary.title: Mykonos To Santorini
itinerary.description: Travel from Mykonos to Santorini by ferry while admiring the beautiful scenery. The journey takes 2-3 hours and is perfect for soaking in the warm Mediterranean sun. Check in to the hotel and spend the rest of the day exploring the island. This idyllic city is famous for its breathtaking views of the Aegean Sea, quaint white houses stacked along the steep slopes, and scrumptious food.

itinerary.title: Santorini
itinerary.description: After a scrumptious breakfast buffet, head on for a full-day tour of Santorini. Some attractions you’ll cover today include the ancient archaeological sites of Akrotiri and Ancient Thera, the many vineyards, and the inland villages lined with whitewashed homes, centuries-old churches, and pottery shops. Some activities you can do in Santorini include kayaking, wine tasting, and hiking. Spend the night in Santorini.

itinerary.title: Depart Santorini
itinerary.description: Today marks the end of your Greek trip package as you head to the Santorini International Airport to catch your flight back home or to continue with the rest of your Europe tour package.

itinerary.title: Arrive In Athens
itinerary.description: Arrive at the Athens International Airport for a grand welcome by our tour manager. We’ll help you check in to your hotel and explain the itinerary for the next few days. Spend the rest of the day exploring places close to the hotel or shopping. Spend the night in Athens.

itinerary.title: Athens City Tour, Acropolis Museum Tour
itinerary.description: After a scrumptious breakfast buffet, head on for the Athens City Tour. Athens has a history of over 3000 years and is the best place to understand Greek civilisation. Some of the places you’ll cover during the city tour include Panathenaic Stadium – This is the only stadium in the world built entirely of marble and the location of the first Modern Olympic Games. Maximos Mansion – This has been the official residence of the Greek Prime Minister since 1982. It is famous for its Greek architecture and artwork. The Temple of Olympian Zeus – This temple was built to honour Zeus, the father of all Olympian Gods. The Hadrian Arch is dedicated to the Roman Emperor Hadrian to honour him for his commitment to his people. Some of the other places you’ll cover include the Parliament, the Memorial of the Unknown Soldier, the Academy, the University, the National Library, and the Constitution Square. Acropolis Museum – This museum is home to statues once found in the Acropolis and deconstructs how the Parthenon sculptures once looked.

itinerary.title: Athens – Argolis –Olympia
itinerary.description: After a continental breakfast buffet, move on to Argolis. Drive on the coastal road, enjoy the beautiful scenery, and make a short stop at the Corinth Canal. This 6km long canal connects the Aegean and Ionian Sea. Move on to explore the Theatre of Epidaurus. This beautiful and well-preserved ancient theatre is famous for its acoustics and aesthetics. Stop at Nafplion, a beautiful town famous for its beautiful castles. Close to Nafplion are the archaeological sites of Mycenae and Epidaurus. The next stop on your tour is Olympia. Drive through Central Peloponnese, exploring the towns of Tripoli and Megalopolis on the way. The latter is famous for its ancient ruins. Spend the night in Olympia, exploring places around the hotel.

itinerary.title: Olympia – Delphi
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel in Olympia to explore the beautiful monuments in the city. This includes the Sanctuary of Olympian Zeus, the Ancient Stadium, and the Archeological Museum. Your next stop is Delphi, a beautiful town 3-4 from Olympia. Drive through the scenic plains of Achaea, passing through the Rion – Antirion Bridge and the picturesque villages of Nafpaktos and Itea. Spend the night in Delphi, exploring places around the hotel.

itinerary.title: Delphi – Kalabaka
itinerary.description: After breakfast, move to Kalambaka. On the way, explore the different archaeological sites along the route. Don’t miss the Delphi Archaeological Museum and the ancient stadium in Delphi. Before checking into a hotel in Kalabaka, make sure you appreciate the beautiful Meteora rock formations and the ancient monasteries perched atop the vertical peaks. Spend the night in Kalabaka.

itinerary.title: Kalabaka – Athens
itinerary.description: You’ll check out from your Kalabaka hotel to visit Meteora to admire the mesmerising scenery. Meteora in Greek means suspended in air and is home to several Eastern Orthodox monasteries. You will return to Athens while stopping by the Statue of Leonidas, a 35-metre-tall statue dedicated to a Spartan warrior. Spend the night in Athens. Don’t forget to explore the different evening markets in the city.

itinerary.title: Depart Athens
itinerary.description: Bid goodbye to this beautiful and ancient country that.’s also the birthplace of democracy. Head to the Athens International Airport to catch your flight back home or to the next leg of your European travel journey.

itinerary.title: Arrive In Athens
itinerary.description: On arrival at the Athens International Airport, our tour manager will help you transfer to your hotel. Check into the hotel and relax. Athens is a beautiful city famous for its ancient ruins, friendly bars and café, and delicious food. With our Greece Holiday Package Itinerary, we’ll unravel the beauty of Athens. Spend the evening relaxing around the hotel and exploring the city at your own pace. Spend your night at the hotel in Athens.

itinerary.title: Athens City Tour And Acropolis Museum
itinerary.description: After a scrumptious breakfast, head on for a busy day of sightseeing. Athens is famous for its historical landmarks, ancient architecture, vibrant neighbourhoods, and excellent street food. Some of the places you will cover include Panathenaic Stadium – This is the world’s only stadium built entirely of marble. It also hosted the world’s first modern Olympic Games in 1896. The Temple of Athena Nike was built around 427 BC to honour Athena Nike, the goddess of victory. The National Library – This beautiful building is home to over one million books, magazines, and handwritten codices. It also houses the world’s finest Greek antiquities. Some other monuments you’ll visit include the Maximos Mansion (Prime Minister’s residence), the Temple of Olympian Zeus, the Hadrian’s Arch, the Memorial of the Unknown Soldier, the Academy of Athens, and the Constitution Square. After lunch, you’ll visit the Acropolis Museum. This museum includes architectural masterpieces from the golden age of Athens. Some of the renowned statues in the museum include the Erechtheion’s Caryatids, the Head of the Statue of Alexander the Great, and the Statue of the Calf-Bearer. Spend the night at the Athens hotel.

itinerary.title: Athens To Santorini
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head to Santorini via ferry. The 4 to 5 hour journey from Athens to Santorini is scenic as you enjoy the Aegean Sea. Check into the hotel and spend the rest of the day exploring the neighbouring places around your hotel. Santorini is famous for its clear waters, the beautiful whitewashed home perched atop rugged cliffs and mesmerising shores. Spend the night at the Santorini hotel.

itinerary.title: Explore Santorini
itinerary.description: Enjoy a scrumptious breakfast buffet spread featuring the best of Greek cuisine. Next, move on to explore the different attractions in and around Santorini. This romantic getaway is a sought-after destination with beautiful scenery and charming architecture. You’ll visit Akrotiri, Ancient Thera, the Santorini Wine Museum, etc. You can also visit the Volcano and hot springs beside the island’s famous Caldera. Spend the night at the Santorini hotel.

itinerary.title: Santorini to Heraklion
itinerary.description: After breakfast, move on to Heraklion via ferry. The journey takes around 1 hour and 45 minutes and will be memorable thanks to the beautiful view of the Aegean Sea. After you arrive in Heraklion, check into your hotel and spend the evening exploring places close to the hotel. Spend the night at the Heraklion hotel.

itinerary.title: Heraklion
itinerary.description: Heraklion is a port city famous for its archaeological sites, historic buildings, impressive fortresses, and fish taverns along the waterfront. You will visit the Knossos Palace, the Minoan Vineyard, and the Heraklion Archeological Museum. The Knossos Palace was built over 9000 years ago and is the oldest known settlement in Crete. Some of the attractions in the palace include the oldest throne in Europe, an ancient theatre, water management systems, frescos, storage jars, and various sacred symbols. Knossos is a Bronze Age archaeological site believed to be Europe’s oldest city. Spend the night at the Heraklion hotel.

itinerary.title: Depart Heraklion
itinerary.description: Bid goodbye to Heraklion and Greece as you proceed to Heraklion International Airport to catch your flight back home or continue with the next leg of your journey.

itinerary.title: Arrive In Athens
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at the Athens International Airport, our tour manager will greet you and help with the transfer procedures. We’ll help you check in to the hotel and explain the details of the Athens tour. Spend the night in Athens exploring places around the hotel. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Athens City Tour and Acropolis Museum
itinerary.description: Athens is renowned for its ancient ruins, stunning landscape, and pristine beaches. After a scrumptious breakfast, begin your day with a city tour. Some of the attractions we’ll cover include the Acropolis and Omonia Square. You’ll see famous sites, including ancient and modern Athens. You’ll explore the city through the Hop On Hop Off Bus Tour while listening to headphones about the different attractions. Some popular attractions include the Panathenaic Stadium, the venue of the first Modern Olympic Games in 1896 and the only stadium in the world built entirely of marble. The Temple of Olympian Zeus is one of the seven wonders of the ancient world and was built in 174 BCE. The Zappeion Megaron is one of the city’s significant landmarks built for meetings and ceremonies. The Temple of Athena Nike was built around 451 - 448 BC. It is dedicated to Athena Nike, the goddess of victory. Other places covered during the city tour include the University of Athens, the Academy of Athens, the National Garden, Hadrian’s Arch, The Parliament, The Tomb of the Unknown Soldier, Schliemann’s House, Catholic Cathedral, Russian Orthodox Church, The Erechtheion, and St Paul’s Church. The Acropolis Museum is another major attraction that houses over 3000 famous artefacts, including the Elgin Marbles and the Caryatids.

itinerary.title: Athens - Argolis/Delphi
itinerary.description: Spend the day leisurely after a scrumptious breakfast exploring places in and around Athens. Depending on the package chosen, you could also opt for a full-day tour of Delphi or Argolis.

itinerary.title: Depart Athens
itinerary.description: Bid goodbye to Athens and head to Athens International Airport to catch your flight back home or continue for the next leg of your journey.

itinerary.title: Arrive In Athens
itinerary.description: On arrival at Athens International Airport, our tour manager will greet you and help you transfer to the hotel. Spend the rest of the day exploring the neighbouring areas around the hotel. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Athens City Tour, Acropolis Museum
itinerary.description: Athens is known for its glorious past and is often called the cradle of Western Civilisation. Its ancient ruins, natural beauty, and vibrant nightlife attract millions of tourists from across the world. After a scrumptious breakfast spread, you’ll head out to explore the city through a full-day city tour covering cultural attractions that haven’t been lost in the sands of time. Some important attractions we’ll cover include: The Temple of Olympian Zeus – Also called the Columns of Olympian Zeus, is dedicated to Zeus, the ruler of Mount Olympus. The Arch of Hadrian – The arch was probably erected to honour Roman Emperor Hadrian, thanking him for his donations to the city of Athens. Acropolis – This 2500-year-old architecture is home to the Parthenon Temple, dedicated to Athena, the god of wisdom and military victory and the patron god of Athens. The Temple of Hephaestus – This Doric peripteral temple is dedicated to Hephaestus, the patron of metal workers. The Temple of Poseidon is dedicated to Poseidon, the Greek God of the Sea. It is one of the earliest buildings built by the Athenians. Museum of Cycladic Art – This grand museum hosts over 3000 ancient Greek, Cycladic, and Cryption culture artefacts. After a scrumptious lunch of souvlaki, Greek salad, moussaka, tzatziki, and other Greek delicacies, you’ll explore the Acropolis Museum. This is one of the finest museums in the world and worth dedicating half a day to explore its contents. The Acropolis Museum is home to thousands of artefacts brought from the several ruins of monuments across Athens, namely, the Acropolis, the Parthenon, and the Erechtheion. Spend the evening shopping and exploring the local markets in Athens. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Athens - Heraklion
itinerary.description: After a breakfast buffet, head on to Heraklion by flight. Check in to the Heraklion hotel and spend the evening exploring places around the hotel. Spend the night in Heraklion.

itinerary.title: Heraklion
itinerary.description: Heraklion is the largest town in Crete and is renowned for its beaches, churches, and vineyards. After a breakfast buffet, you’ll move on to explore the city.
