Some of the places you’ll explore as part of our Athens tour package include: The Palace of Knossos – The ruins of Knossos were first discovered in 1878 and were the palatial residence of the Minoan king, queen, and priests. Popular attractions include the Throne Room, The Megaron of the Queen, and the Bull’s Head fresco. The Archaeological Museum Of Heraklion – The museum is famous for its magnificent collections from the Neolithic to the Roman period and objects from the Minoan civilisation. The Churches of Heraklion – Some churches you’ll explore include the Church of Saint-Pierre-Saint-Paul, the Basilica of Agios Titos, the Agios Minas Cathedral, and the Basilica of Agios Markos. Spend the night in Heraklion.

itinerary.title: Depart Heraklion
itinerary.description: Bid goodbye to beautiful Heraklion and Greece as you move to the Heraklion International Airport to catch your flight back home or move on to the next leg of your Europe tour.

itinerary.title: Arrive In Munich
itinerary.description: As you arrive at Munich International Airport, our tour manager will welcome you and help you transfer and check in to the hotel. We’ll explain the attractions you’ll cover during the next few days. Spend the rest of the evening exploring the neighbouring places around the hotel. Overnight in Munich.

itinerary.title: Munich Full Day City Tour
itinerary.description: Munich has amazing historic sites, parks, castles, food markets, and a vibrant neighbourhood. After breakfast, begin your day with a Hop On Hop Off tour to explore the Bavarian province. Some of the attractions covered in our Munich tour package itinerary include: Marienplatz Square is located in the middle of the city and was founded around 1158 by Henry the Lion. Altes Rathaus is a town hall in the old town of Munich famous for holding celebrations, memorials, and award ceremonies. BMW Museum is a highly recommended museum displaying an impressive collection of cars and motorbikes, along with the history of BMW. The Palace of Nymphenburg is home to the Bavarian royal family and is famous for its extensive sculptures and unusual pavilions. Some of the other attractions you will visit include the Olympic Grounds, English Garden, and Siegestor. The tour lasts around 5 hours and covers all the essential attractions in Munich. You’ll also be taking a break for lunch and refreshments during the tour. Spend the night in Munich.

itinerary.title: Depart Munich
itinerary.description: After breakfast, move on to the Munich Airport or Central Train Station, depending on whether you’d like to catch your flight back home or continue with your Europe tour package.

itinerary.title: Arrive In Munich
itinerary.description: As you arrive at the Munich International Airport, our tour manager will welcome you and help you transfer to the hotel. Check in to the hotel and spend the rest of the day exploring the neighbouring places around the hotel at leisure. Spend the night in Munich.

itinerary.title: Munich - Full Day Tour
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a scrumptious breakfast buffet at the hotel. Move on to a Hop On Hop Off Tour to explore the city at your own pace. Munich is an ideal holiday destination famous for its beautiful buildings, historic sites, parks, castles, and vibrant nightlife. Some places covered in Munich include Marienplatz, Altes Rathaus, the English Garden, Glockenspiel, and the BMW Museum. The entire tour lasts for around 5 hours, including the time to stop for refreshments and lunch. Spend the night in Munich.

itinerary.title: Neuschwanstein and Linderhof
itinerary.description: After breakfast, leave for Neuschwanstein, travelling through the German countryside admiring the beautiful waterfalls, valleys, and quaint villages. Upon reaching Neuschwanstein, you’ll visit the 19th-century fairytale castle that was once the inspiration for the Disney Cinderella castle. You’ll also explore the Linderhof Palace, around 50 minutes from Neuschwanstein. The Linderhof Palace was built in the 19th century by Ludwig II and named after the linder trees surrounding the palatial complex. The entire atmosphere in and around the palace looks magical, with alpine mountains surrounding the building, well-manicured gardens, and ornate sculptures. Return to Munich to spend the night in the city.

itinerary.title: Munich - Salzburg
itinerary.description: After a scrumptious breakfast, check out from the hotel and move to the train station to reach Salzburg. The journey takes around two and a half hours and is the perfect way to enjoy the amazing views as the train passes through the Alpine mountains. Upon arriving at Salzburg, our tour manager will help you check into your hotel, where you’ll spend the rest of the evening at leisure. Spend the night in Salzburg.

itinerary.title: Salzburg City Tour
itinerary.description: Salzburg is a charming and well-preserved town with beautiful gardens, Baroque churches, and the Hohensalzburg fortress. It is the birthplace of Mozart and is famous for its music and architecture. After a breakfast buffet, you’ll tour the city on a Hop-On and Hop-Off bus tour. You can cover the places at your own pace and even get off at any stops. Some places we’ll cover through the package include – Mirabell Palace, Mozart’s residence, Trinity Church, Great Festival Hall, Hellbrunn Palace, and the most famous of all, the Hohensalzburg Palace. You’ll also visit Horse Pond, the Palace of Frohnburg, Nonnberg Abbey, and Mozart Square. In the evening, you can stroll through the Old Town and end the day at one of the many cafes in Salzburg. And don’t forget to sample their Mozartkugeln chocolates. Spend the night in Salzburg.

itinerary.title: Salzburg - Vienna
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out from the Salzburg hotel to board a train to Vienna, Austria’s capital city. The journey takes around 3 hours and promises a scenic view of picturesque Austria. Upon arrival at the Vienna Train Station, our tour manager will welcome you and help you transfer to the hotel. Check-in and spend the rest of the day exploring places around the hotel. Spend the night in Vienna.

itinerary.title: Vienna
itinerary.description: Vienna is famous for its impressive architecture from different eras, including Baroque palaces, cathedrals, modern buildings, and stunning gardens. After breakfast, head to grab your seat on a Hop-On and Hop-Off bus tour to explore the city at your own pace. You can even get off the bus at any time. Some places you will cover during the tour include Schonbrunn Palace, St Stephen’s Cathedral, Hofburg Palace, the Hundertwasser Museum, and the Vienna Zoo. Spend the evening at one of the many Viennese cafes or head to Café Sacher in Hotel Sacher Wien to enjoy its world-famous Sacher cake. You can also sample local food at one of the many bistros or Beisi, as they are locally called. Spend the night in Vienna.

itinerary.title: Vienna Woods
itinerary.description: After a hearty morning breakfast, head to Vienna Woods for a half-day city tour. Vienna Woods is a large belt of mixed woodland with famous towns like Perchtoldsdorf, Modling, and Stammersdorf. Some places you’ll explore here include the Mayerling Memorial Chapel, the Heiligenkreuz Abbey, and the Seegrotte Hinterbruhl, Europe’s biggest underground lake. The bus tour will cover the former Roman spa town of Baden, the Helen’s Valley, and Kahlenberg. The tour ends at Seegrotte Hinterbruhl, where you travel by boat to experience the magic of Europe’s biggest underground lake. Spend the night in Vienna.

itinerary.title: Depart Vienna
itinerary.description: Say goodbye to Vienna as you head to Vienna International Airport, or move on to the next leg of your Europe tour.

packages.name: Germany Travel Package Itinerary
packages.destination: Munich - Stuttgart - Baden Baden - Titisee - Frankfurt - Zurich

itinerary.title: Arrive In Munich
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at the Munich International Airport, our tour manager will greet you and help you transfer to the hotel. Check in to the hotel and spend the evening at leisure, exploring places close to the hotel. Spend the night in Munich.

itinerary.title: Munich City Tour
itinerary.description: After a scrumptious breakfast, head to explore the city on a hop–on hop- –off tour. Learn more about the different places while listening to commentaries in 8 different languages. Some popular attractions include Nyphenburg Palace, Olympiapark, Viktualienmarkt, Altes Rathaus, Marienplatz, Glockenspiel, Neues Rathaus, BMW Museum, and the English Garden. You can get off at any point of the tour. Spend the night in Munich.

itinerary.title: Munich - Neuschwanstein - Linderhof
itinerary.description: After a hearty breakfast buffet, head to Neuschwanstein, travelling through the beautiful German countryside. We promise a mesmerising journey where you can enjoy the German Alps. Reach Neuschwanstein in over 2 hours to experience the magical Neuschwanstein Palace. This magnificent temple was built in the 19th century by King Ludwig II and was the inspiration behind the palace in Disneyland’s Cinderella. It’s not the views from the castle that make this place a must-see but also the gorgeous rooms within the palace that are ornately decorated. Linderhof is another attraction close to Neuschwanstein and is famous for the Linderhof Palace. This, too, was built by King Ludwig in the 19th century. The palace gets its name from the linder trees surrounding the building. Spend the night in Munich.

itinerary.title: Munich - Stuttgart
itinerary.description: Enjoy a breakfast buffet at the hotel and move to Munich Train Station to travel to Stuttgart. The journey takes around 2 -3 hours and is famous for its scenic views. Check into the hotel and spend some time relaxing and unwinding before heading to Stuttgart's Hop On-Hop Off tour. Learn more about important tourist attractions in Stuttgart while listening to the audio guides in 8 different languages. Some of the places covered in the tour include Mercedes–Benz Museum, Porshe Museum, Palace Square, Museum of Illusions, and Stuttgart Wine Museum. Spend the night in Stuttgart.

itinerary.title: Stuttgart - Baden-Baden
itinerary.description: After breakfast, continue with the Hop-On-Hop-Off tour of the city. Today, you’ll cover some places you missed yesterday, including Killesberg Park, Wilhelma, and Castle Solitude. Return to the hotel for lunch before moving on to the next leg of your journey. You’ll take a train to Baden-Baden. The scenic journey takes around 2 hours, with the train passing through the country’s beautiful landscape and cultural sights. Once you reach Baden-Baden, check into a hotel. Spend the evening exploring places around the hotel. Spend the night in Baden-Baden.

itinerary.title: Baden-Baden And Titisee (Black Forest)
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a delectable breakfast spread before exploring the beautiful town of Baden-Baden. You’ll visit Hohenbaden Castle, Merkur Mountain, Museum Frieder Burda, and the Baden–Baden Casino. Move on to the Baden-Baden train station to board the train to Titisee. The journey takes around 3 hours and covers the amazing scenic mountain view of the Black Forest. Check into the hotel in Baden-Baden. Spend the night in Baden-Baden.

itinerary.title: Titisee (Black Forest)
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head to explore the picturesque town of Baden-Baden. Titisee is a beautiful town in the Black Forest region. It literally translates into Lake Titi and gets its name from the highest lake in the forest. The beautiful glacial lake was created in the last ice age. Spend the night in Titisee.

itinerary.title: Depart From Titisee
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head to the Titisee Train station to reach Frankfurt or Zurich to catch your flight back home or move on to the next leg of your journey.

itinerary.title: Arrive In Frankfurt
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at Frankfurt International Airport, our tour manager will be there to welcome you and help you transfer to the hotel. Complete check-in formalities and spend the rest of the day exploring the different places around your hotel. Spend the night in Frankfurt.

itinerary.title: Frankfurt City Tour
itinerary.description: Frankfurt is famous for its beautiful skyline and unique architecture with its historic cathedrals and modern buildings. After a breakfast buffet spread that includes the famous frankfurters, head to the double-decker Hop On Hop Off Tour bus to visit some of the best tourist attractions in the city. Some of the attractions you’ll cover during the tour include the Hauptwatche, Museum Embankment, The Stadel Museum, Römerburg, St Paul’s Church, the Old Opera House, and Zeil, the 14th century street in Frankfurt.

itinerary.title: Depart Frankfurt
itinerary.description: Today, you’ll leave the hotel and move to Frankfurt International Airport to catch your return flight home or proceed to the next leg of your journey.

itinerary.title: Arrive In Dusseldorf
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at Dusseldorf International Airport, our tour manager will welcome you and help you transfer to the hotel. Check-in and spend the rest of the day strolling around the city, exploring places around your hotel.

itinerary.title: Dusseldorf City Tour
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a scrumptious breakfast before heading to the Rhine Metropolis for a Hop On Hop Off Bus Tour. The tour lasts for around 90 minutes and covers the city’s major attractions. Listen to the audio guide in German and English. You can also get off and hop in at any time on the tour. Some of the places you will cover include Central station, Königsallee, Old Town, Rhine Tower, Lütticher Str, Niederkasseler Kirchweg, Rheinterrasse, Aquazoo, and Schloss Jagerhof. You can spend the rest of the day on a cruise across the river Rhine or return to your hotel. Spend the rest of the evening exploring the restaurants and souvenir shops in the city.

itinerary.title: Depart Dusseldorf
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel to Dusseldorf Airport to catch your flight back home or carry on with the next leg of your Europe trip package.

packages.name: Scandinavian Tour Package Itinerary
packages.destination: Helsinki - Stockholm - Panorama - Copenhagen - Oslo - Myrdal - Flam

itinerary.title: Arrive In Helsinki
itinerary.description: As you arrive at the Helsinki- Vantaa International Airport, our tour manager will greet you and help you transfer to the hotel. After completing check-in formalities, the manager will explain the rest of the tour. Spend the rest of the evening at leisure, exploring places in and around the hotel. Spend the night in Helsinki.

itinerary.title: Helsinki City Tour, Stockholm
itinerary.description: After a breakfast buffet, head to the Hop On –Hop Off bus for a sightseeing tour. The tour bus is led by an authorised guide with commentaries in English and Swedish. Some sights included in the tour are – Senate Square, Uspenski Cathedral, the Parliament Building, and the Olympic Stadium. You’ll stop at the Sibelius Monument and Temppeliaukio Church on the way. Some of the other places include the Post Museum, Sinebrychoff Park, the Suomenlinna Fortress, and the National Museum of Finland. After lunch, take some time to rest before leaving for Stockholm, the capital city of Sweden. The ferry ride takes over 17 hours and promises a memorable journey. Spend the night on the cruise.

itinerary.title: Stockholm Panorama Tour
itinerary.description: After a breakfast buffet on the cruise, wait for the ferry to arrive in Stockholm. Upon arrival, you’ll be greeted by our tour manager, who will help you check in to the hotel. After refreshing, dash to Gustaf Adolf’s Torg, where your Stockholm Panorama tour is scheduled to start. You will cover some of the city’s famous buildings throughout the tour. Some places you’ll cover include the Vasa Museum, the Royal Palace, Skansen, the ABBA Museum, the Swedish History Museum, and Lake Malaren. We’ll also cover the old town in depth, which is the heart of Stockholm. Did you know Kansen is the world’s largest outdoor museum? The tour will also include exploring Vasa, the world’s only surviving 17th-century ship of the Vikings. Return to the hotel to spend your evening exploring the local evening markets. Spend the night in Stockholm.

itinerary.title: Stockholm – Copenhagen
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a delectable breakfast buffet spread showcasing the best of Scandinavian cuisine. You have an open schedule in the morning, allowing you to discover the city's various street markets and malls. Head to the Stockholm train station in the afternoon for a 5-hour journey to Copenhagen, the capital of Denmark. Enjoy the scenic view on the way, especially the spectacular Oresund Bridge that connects Sweden and Denmark. During the first 8 km of the journey, you will travel on the bridge before covering the final 4 km through an underwater tunnel. As you arrive at the Copenhagen train station, our tour manager will guide you through check-in, leaving you to explore the city at your own pace. Spend the night in Copenhagen.

itinerary.title: Copenhagen Hop On Hop Off Tour, Oslo
itinerary.description: Copenhagen is a friendly and welcoming city with an interesting history, captivating culture, delicious food, and beautiful architecture. After breakfast, head to the meeting point of your Hop On Hop Off Tour. Copenhagen, being a major centre of culture, business, and science, is sure to keep you entertained. Some of the places you’ll visit during the tour include the Tivoli Gardens, Rosenborg Castle, Amalienborg Castle, Nyhavn, Stroget, Christianborg, Nyboder, Langelinie, and Gefion Fountain. Break for lunch at the end of the tour before heading to Copenhagen Port to head to Oslo for an overnight cruise. Enjoy the scenic views of the North Sea while partying on the cruise. Spend the night on the cruise.

itinerary.title: Oslo Hop On Hop Off Tour
itinerary.description: Enjoy a delicious breakfast on the cruise with a huge spread of Indian, Continental, and Chinese cuisine. We’ll help you check in to the hotel when you arrive in Oslo. Refresh quickly and explore the city on a Hop On Hop Off tour. This tour is the perfect way to discover the Norwegian capital. Learn more about the different places while listening to an audio commentary in English, Norwegian and several other languages. You can also get off and get in at any time for the next 24 hours. Some places you’ll cover include Vigeland Park, Akershus Castle, The Royal Palace, and the Oslo Cathedral. The tour also covers the Fram Museum, Viking Ship Museum, Frognerparken, and Radhuset. Spend the night in Oslo.

itinerary.title: Oslo to Myrdal to Flam to Myrdal And Back To Oslo
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head to the Oslo Train Station to catch the train to Myrdal. The journey takes around 5 hours and is breathtakingly beautiful. Myrdal is a lovely place with a spectacular mountain trail leading to the village of Flam. Take the connecting train to Flam, which is considered one of the most beautiful train journeys in the world. The journey runs from Aurlandsfjord to the high stations of Myrdal station. Enjoy the stunning scenery of Western Norway. Did you know the Flam Railway is one of the steepest standard gauge railway lines? The train covers over 20 tunnels, vertiginous mountainsides, and spectacular scenery along the route. Return to Myrdal and spend time exploring the beauty of the place. Later, take your train to Oslo at the Myrdal train station. Spend the night in Oslo.

itinerary.title: Depart Oslo
itinerary.description: Bid adieu to Oslo as you head to Oslo International Airport to catch your flight back home or move to the next part of your Europe tour.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Helsinki
itinerary.description: Welcome to Helsinki! When you arrive at Helsinki Airport or Port, your ride will be ready to take you to the hotel. Check in, and the rest of the day is yours to relax. Stay overnight in Helsinki.

itinerary.title: Explore Helsinki
itinerary.description: Kickstart your day with breakfast. In the morning, embark on a Hop-on/Hop-off tour of this small city. The tour covers Helsinki's fascinating spots, including the historic centre, City Hall, Parliament buildings, Finlandia Hall, and the Opera House. Don't forget to visit the Sibelius Monument and the Temppeliaukio Church (Rock Church). Helsinki boasts its own panoramic ferris wheel, a must-see! Spend the rest of the day shopping for Finnish designs or savouring the local cuisine, a delightful blend of Nordic and Russian flavours. Stay overnight in Helsinki.

itinerary.title: Departure from Helsinki
itinerary.description: Enjoy your breakfast. Today, you can either extend your stay or check out from the hotel. Take a transfer to Helsinki Airport or Port for your next adventure. Safe travels!

itinerary.title: Arrive In Paris
itinerary.description: Arrive at Charles de Gaulle Airport, where our tour manager will welcome you and help you transfer to the hotel. After check-in, spend the rest of the evening exploring places close to your hotel. Spend the night in Paris.

itinerary.title: Paris Sightseeing
itinerary.description: After a heavy breakfast buffet spread, including baguettes, pastries, croissants and crepes. We have left an open schedule in the morning, allowing you to explore nearby places. Board the Hop On Hop Off Bus tour to enjoy the beautiful sights of Paris. Some sights include Champs Elysees, Arc de Triomphe, Place de la Concorde, Tuileries Garden, and Les Invalides. You’ll also enjoy a cruise along the Seine River and a visit to the Eiffel Tower. End the day with a dinner at one of the many French bistros, enjoying the beauty of Parisian nightlife.

itinerary.title: Depart Paris
itinerary.description: Bid goodbye to Paris as you head to the airport to catch your flight back home or continue with the next leg of your journey.

itinerary.title: Arrive In Nice
itinerary.description: As you arrive at Nice International Airport, our tour manager will greet you and help you transfer to the hotel. Complete the check-in formalities and spend the rest of the day exploring places and markets close to the hotel.

itinerary.title: Nice City Tour
itinerary.description: After a breakfast buffet that includes the best of French cuisine, head out for a guided tour of the city. You will drive along Promenade des Anglais, a seaside promenade that runs along the Bay of Nice and covers some of the city's prominent attractions, including the Cathedral of Saint Nicholas of Nice, Marc Chagall National Museum, and Place Massena. In the evening, explore the beautiful markets to buy souvenirs like ceramic crockery, olive oil, lavender bags, and Herbin jams. Spend the night in Nice

itinerary.title: Depart Nice
itinerary.description: Today, you can either board a flight to return home or continue with your France trip package to explore the South of France, especially Cannes, Menton, St Paul de Vence, and even Monaco.

itinerary.title: Arrive In Cannes
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at the Cannes International Airport, our tour manager will welcome you and help you transfer to the hotel. Complete the check-in formalities and spend the rest of the day exploring places close to your hotel.

itinerary.title: Cannes City Tour, Provence, Nice, Antibes, Grasse
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head out to Nice, a beautiful city that is around 40 minutes from Cannes. On the way, you’ll explore the towns of Antibes, Monte Carlo, Monaco Ville, and Grasse. Some of the most visited places in Antibes include Musee Picasso, Cap d’Antibes, and Port Vauban. From here, you’ll continue to Grasse, an old town in French Riviera, famous for its perfume industry. Your visit will include a tour of a local perfume manufacturing factory. We’ll stop for lunch at Grasse, before moving to Gourdon. This village was listed as one of the most beautiful places in France and is famous for its architectural heritage and beautiful landscapes. The next stop on the tour is Tourettes- sur- Loup, a charming medieval village famous for its sweet violet valleys. Some of the other attractions you will cover during the day include La Croisette in Cannes. Return to your hotel in the evening. Spend the night at your Cannes hotel.

itinerary.title: Depart Cannes
itinerary.description: Bid adieu to Cannes as you check out of your hotel and head to the Cannes International Airport to catch your flight back home or continue with the next leg of your journey.

packages.name: Europe Trip Package Itinerary
packages.destination: Paris - Interlaken - Jungfrau Mountain - Lucerne - Mt. Titlis - Milan - Venice - Florence - Rome

itinerary.title: Arrive In Paris
itinerary.description: Upon arrival in Paris, our tour manager will greet you and help you transfer to the hotel. Complete check-in formalities and spend the rest of the day exploring the neighboring places around the hotel. Spend the night in Paris.

itinerary.title: Paris Hop On Hop Off Tour
itinerary.description: After a delectable Parisian breakfast that includes various cold cuts, breads, and cheese, embark on a city tour through a Hop On Hop Off tour. This tour covers the city’s most famous attractions with an audio commentary in English and French. Some of the places you will visit include Champs Elysees, Arc de Triomphe, Place de la Concorde, Les Invalides, the Tuileries Garden, and the Louvre. In the evening, you will embark on a cruise on the Seine River and end the day exploring the Latin Quarters to enjoy its lively atmosphere and bistros. Spend the night in Paris.

itinerary.title: Disneyland, Paris (Optional)
itinerary.description: You can customise your Europe trip package to include Disneyland, Europe’s largest Disney Park. The journey from Paris to Disneyland takes about an hour, but you can take in the scenery during the drive. Located in Marne-la-Vallée, France, this magical theme park features iconic Disney characters, thrilling rides, enchanting parades, and immersive attractions, captivating visitors of all ages year-round. You could either spend the night at a Disney-themed hotel in Disneyland, or board the Hop On Hop Off coach to return to Paris. Spend the night in Paris.

itinerary.title: Paris To Interlaken
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of your hotel in Paris to reach the train station to catch the Interlaken train. The journey takes around 5 hours and is loved for its scenic views. Note: There are no direct trains to Interlaken; you’ll need at least one change. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel. You can spend the rest of the day at leisure, exploring places in and around your hotel. Spend the night in Interlaken.

itinerary.title: Interlaken To Jungfrau
itinerary.description: Today, you’ll be exploring Jungfrau, a scenic summit in the Bernese Alps. Board the train from Interlaken to Grindelwald, Switzerland’s most famous mountain resort. You’ll deboard here to catch the cogwheel train to Jungfraujoch. Don’t miss the scenic train journey as it passes through Kleine Scheidegg to reach Jungfraujoch, the highest railway station in Europe. Some of the things you will explore here include the adventure-packed Alpine Sensation, a 250-metre-long corridor that connects the Sphinx Hall and Ice Palace, and the Sphinx Observatory for a panoramic view of the Alps from its viewing deck. Don’t miss the Top of Europe building with its many restaurants, shops, and a permanent exhibition. The Ice Palace, a series of ice tunnels with intricately carved ice sculptures, is equally interesting. Jungfraujoch is the best place for adventure activities, including ice skating and skiing. Spend the night in Interlaken.

itinerary.title: Interlaken To Lucerne
itinerary.description: Check out of your hotel in Interlaken to board the train to Lucerne. The journey takes around 2 hours. It is famous for its panoramic views of the Alpine mountains, picturesque lakes, and idyllic countryside. Upon arrival at the train station, our tour manager will help you check in to the hotel. Spend the rest of the day exploring places in and around the hotel. Spend the night in Lucerne.

itinerary.title: Lucerne To Mount Titlis
itinerary.description: After breakfast, proceed to catch the Lucerne Engelberg Express to reach Engelberg. From Engelberg station, there are free shuttle buses that take you to Mount Titlis, Central Switzerland’s tallest mountain. While there are plenty of other activities like skiing, cliff walking, etc., Mount Titlis is most famous for ROTAIR, the world’s first rotating cable car. You can also take an ice flyer, a chair lift that takes you over huge snow fields. Grab some delicious lunch at one of the many restaurants offering a scenic view of the Alps. Return to Lucerne to spend the night at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Lucerne To Milan
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel to take your train to Milan, the economic capital of Italy. The journey takes around 4-5 hours and is breathtakingly beautiful as the train passes through snowcapped mountains and the sparkling Lake Lucerne. Check in to the hotel in Lucerne and spend the rest of the day exploring nearby places.

itinerary.title: Milan, Venice
itinerary.description: After breakfast, move on to explore the city’s beautiful attractions, including the Duomo di Milano. Check out of your hotel to take your train to Venice. Board a Venetian water taxi to reach the hotel. Check into the hotel and wait for your tour guide to take you to St. Mark’s Square, for a relaxing 1.5 hours walking tour. We’ll cover Venice’s most iconic attractions, including the Ducal Palace and the Bell Tower. Return to Merceria for some shopping. Spend the night in Venice.

itinerary.title: Venice to Florence
itinerary.description: Check out of the hotel in Venice to catch your train to Florence. Upon arrival, transfer to the hotel and spend some time relaxing. Later, you’ll be taken for a tour of the Leaning Tower of Pisa. You’ll climb to the top of the tower for an impressive view of the cathedral and the city. Go inside the Baptistery built in ornate Gothic style. At the end of the guided tour, take pictures of the tower and the neighbouring places before returning to Florence. Spend the night in Florence.

itinerary.title: Florence Walking Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast, proceed for a guided walking tour of the city, exploring its ancient and famous buildings. Some of the places you will cover include the Repubblica Square, the Cathedral, the Signoria Square, Palazzo Vecchio, and Loggia de Lanzi. You will also visit the Uffizi Gallery, an art gallery that houses beautiful collections of the Renaissance period. The tour will finish with a view of the beautiful city from the Uffizi Terrace. Spend the night in Florence.

itinerary.title: Florence To Rome
itinerary.description: Check out of the hotel in Florence for a train to Rome. The journey takes around 1-2 hours. Transfer to the hotel and spend the rest of the day at leisure, exploring places in and around the hotel. Spend the night in Rome

itinerary.title: Rome City Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head for a tour where you’ll be visiting the city’s famous monuments by coach and by foot. Some of the attractions you will cover include Piazza della Repubblica, Fountain of the Naiads, Trevi Fountain, La Colonna di Marco Aurelio, the Palazzo di Montecitorio, the Pantheon, Palazzo, Palazzo Madama, Piazza Navona, Via dei Coronari, Castel Sant'Angelo and Via della Conciliazione. Not to mention the Colosseum and St. Peter’s Basilica. Spend the night in Rome

itinerary.title: Depart Rome
itinerary.description: Bid adieu to Rome as you catch your flight to return home or proceed to the next leg of your Europe tour.

packages.name: Whistling West Coast Itinerary: Explore San Francisco, Las Vegas, Los Angeles
packages.destination: San Francisco - Las Vegas - Los Angeles

images.alt_text: Whistling West Coast Itinerary: Explore San Francisco, Las Vegas, Los Angeles
Whistling West Coast Itinerary: Explore San Francisco, Las Vegas, Los Angeles

itinerary.title: Arrival in San Francisco
itinerary.description: Begin your journey by flying to San Francisco, a city that has attained the esteemed status akin to iconic destinations like Paris or London. This city boasts famous hills that provide breathtaking vistas of the Pacific Ocean and San Francisco Bay, along with an extensive array of boutiques, eateries, and a lively cosmopolitan nightlife. In addition to its diversity and allure, San Francisco serves as the gateway to Silicon Valley, the United States' leading high-tech hub. Upon your arrival, check into your hotel for an overnight stay in San Francisco.

itinerary.title: Exploring San Francisco
itinerary.description: Today, embark on a captivating sightseeing tour of San Francisco. Your itinerary includes a visit to the renowned Golden Gate Bridge, distinguished by its towering bridge towers. You will also explore Twin Peaks, Lombard Street, the iconic Cable Car, Pier 39, Nob Hill, Civic Center, Union Square, Fisherman’s Wharf, the Palace of Fine Arts, and other captivating highlights. Conclude the day with an overnight stay at your San Francisco hotel.

itinerary.title: San Francisco to Las Vegas
itinerary.description: Begin your day by departing in the morning for your flight to Las Vegas. Upon arrival, you will be transferred to your hotel. In the evening, you will embark on a captivating city tour of Las Vegas, where you'll witness the mesmerising Colourful Dancing Fountain water fountains of the Bellagio, the Pirate Ships at Treasure Island, the Stratosphere Tower, Downtown Vegas, and, of course, Fremont Street. This lively area features over 12 million lights that come to life in a free show accompanied by pulsating music. You'll spend the night at your hotel in Las Vegas.

itinerary.title: Las Vegas to Grand Canyon (Optional)
itinerary.description: This day offers you the freedom to either relax and enjoy leisure time or opt for the Grand Canyon Tour by bus or air (optional). Don't miss the chance to experience the New Wonder of the West - SKYWALK. In the evening, consider taking the Las Vegas Night Flight (optional) - a thrilling helicopter ride that allows you to marvel at the dazzling lights of nighttime Vegas. Alternatively, you can choose to attend a fabulous show or explore the numerous free shows, such as the Sirens of Treasure Island and much more. You will spend the night at your hotel in Las Vegas.

itinerary.title: Las Vegas to Los Angeles
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a delightful breakfast at the hotel before embarking on your journey to Los Angeles. Later, partake in a captivating city tour of Los Angeles, where we will guide you through the "Entertainment capital of the world." You'll explore iconic destinations such as Hollywood, the Hollywood Walk of Fame, Beverly Hills, the Grauman's Chinese Theatre, the Sunset Strip, Rodeo Drive for the world's most extravagant shopping, and Chinatown for some fabulous bargains. Your night's accommodation will be at a Los Angeles hotel.

itinerary.title: Los Angeles - Universal Studios
itinerary.description: Indulge in a scrumptious breakfast to kickstart your day. Join us for an extraordinary tour of Universal Studios, renowned for its innovative rides and attractions, designed to offer visitors a one-of-a-kind cinematic experience. A visit to Universal Studios is akin to venturing into the heart of Hollywood, where you might just encounter film and TV stars strolling the park's sidewalks. You will once again spend the night at a Los Angeles hotel.

itinerary.title: Departure from Los Angeles
itinerary.description: Savour a delightful breakfast before taking some leisurely moments to relax. Later, prepare for your departure to the airport, where you will board your flight to your next exciting destination.

itinerary.title: Los Angeles - Universal Studios
itinerary.description: Get up for a hearty breakfast. Join us today for an unforgettable tour of Universal Studios, renowned for its groundbreaking rides and attractions. It's designed to immerse visitors in the world of movies like never before, offering a true taste of Hollywood. As you explore, you might even chance upon familiar faces, as films and TV shows are frequently in production here. Spend the night at your Los Angeles hotel.

itinerary.title: Los Angeles - Honolulu
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a delicious breakfast at the hotel before departing for Honolulu. Once you arrive, take the rest of the day at your leisure to soak in the beauty of this vibrant city. Honolulu, the capital and most populous city of Hawaii, is also the southernmost major U.S. city. While "Honolulu" primarily refers to the urban area on the southeastern coast of Oahu, the city and county government together encompass the entire island. Recognized by the U.S. Census Bureau as a census-designated place, Honolulu stands as a vital financial hub in the Pacific Ocean's Island region. Spend the night at your hotel in Honolulu.

itinerary.title: Honolulu - USS Missouri and Pearl Harbor's Arizona Memorial Tour
itinerary.description: Immerse yourself in a historical journey through some of Hawaii's most iconic landmarks, including the USS Missouri and the USS Arizona Memorial at Pearl Harbor. This meticulously guided motor coach tour not only grants you access to these sites but also takes you on a delightful exploration of downtown Honolulu and a serene drive through Punchbowl National Memorial Cemetery. The best part? No tedious waiting in long queues! Your adventure includes roundtrip transportation from your Waikiki hotel and enlightening commentary by a knowledgeable guide. Rest peacefully at your Honolulu hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: Honolulu - Oahu to Big Island Day Tour – Volcano Special (Optional)
itinerary.description: Experience the awe-inspiring volcanoes of Hawaii's Big Island with a captivating day tour from Oahu. You'll board a flight from Honolulu to the Big Island, where you'll embark on a captivating journey through Hawaii Volcanoes National Park, explore the Jaggar Museum, venture into the Thurston Lava Tube, gaze upon the mesmerising Kilauea Iki Crater, and admire the natural beauty of Rainbow Falls. Your adventure includes roundtrip transportation, airfare from your Waikiki hotel to the Big Island, and admission to all these remarkable attractions. Enjoy another peaceful night at your Honolulu hotel. (B)

itinerary.title: Depart from Honolulu
itinerary.description: Bid farewell to Honolulu as you prepare to depart for your homeward flight this morning.

packages.name: Captivating USA Holiday Packages Itinerary
packages.destination: New York - Washington - Buffalo - Niagara - Niagara Falls - Atlanta - Orlando - Chicago - Las Vegas - Grand Canyon - Los Angeles - San Francisco

itinerary.title: Arrival in New York
itinerary.description: Welcome to the vibrant city of New York, often referred to as the "Big Apple" or the "City That Never Sleeps." New York stands as a city of superlatives, boasting titles such as America's largest, most exhilarating, and serving as both the nation's business and cultural hub. For over a century, it has held its position as one of the world's primary centres of commerce and finance. Upon your arrival at the airport, our team will assist you in your transfer to your hotel. You'll spend the night at your hotel in the heart of New York.

itinerary.title: New York City Tour
itinerary.description: Following a satisfying breakfast, your day kicks off with an exploration of the vibrant city of New York. Your itinerary boasts a visit to one of the United States' most renowned symbols, the "Statue of Liberty." You will embark on a delightful ferry ride to Liberty Island, offering a spectacular vantage point to admire the striking New York City skyline. Your next stop promises an unparalleled view of a lifetime from the One World Observatory, located within the World Trade Center. As the day unfolds, you will also have the opportunity to take in the sights of Rockefeller Center, Wall Street, Ground Zero, and Central Park. In addition, you will experience the bustling energy of Times Square, pay a visit to the United Nations, and catch a glimpse of the iconic Trump properties. Concluding this exciting day, you will return to your hotel in New York for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: New York - Washington
itinerary.description: On this day, you will make your way to Washington, DC, the capital of the United States of America and a gateway to its rich historical neighbourhoods and iconic monuments. Besides serving as the centre of the federal government, Washington is a thriving hub for tourism, drawing nearly twenty million visitors annually. After arriving and checking in at your hotel, you'll embark on an exploration of this magnificent US capital. Your journey will take you to some of the nation's most significant landmarks, including the White House, Lincoln Memorial, Supreme Court, the Capitol Building, the Smithsonian Air and Space Museum, Union Station, World War II Memorial Building, Pentagon, and the Washington Monument. After a day filled with history and culture, you'll spend the night at your hotel in Washington.

itinerary.title: Washington - Buffalo – Niagara
itinerary.description: Today, you will journey to Buffalo either by air or road to witness the awe-inspiring Niagara Falls, a natural wonder of the world. Your hotel in Niagara awaits you for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Niagara - USA Side Niagara Falls
itinerary.description: Your day begins with an exciting adventure as you embark on the famous "Maid of the Mist" boat, which brings you up close to the thundering falls and offers magnificent views of both the American and Horseshoe Falls (available seasonally). After this damp but exhilarating ride, you return to the hotel to freshen up. Tonight, you will spend another night at your hotel in Niagara.

itinerary.title: Niagara - Atlanta
itinerary.description: You will take a flight to Atlanta, often referred to as the "New Capital of the South." Atlanta boasts fine dining, museums, theatres, attractions, and world-class shopping, making it an ideal destination for everyone. You can spend some time exploring the numerous shopping malls or head downtown for an evening of entertainment. Your overnight accommodation awaits at a hotel in Atlanta.

itinerary.title: Atlanta City Tour
itinerary.description: On this day, immerse yourself in a city tour that uncovers the landmarks narrating Atlanta's remarkable history and its journey to becoming one of the South's most progressive cities. Your itinerary includes a visit to the World of Coca-Cola, homage to the world-famous beverage, a CNN News Studio Tour, and an exploration of the world's largest aquarium. As the day unfolds, you'll gain insights into the heart of Atlanta's past and present. Tonight, you'll spend the night at your hotel in Atlanta.

itinerary.title: Atlanta to Orlando
itinerary.description: Today, you will depart for Orlando by flight. Orlando, the sixth-largest city in Florida, is renowned as the largest inland city in the state. With the presence of the Disney World theme park, Orlando has become a prominent vacation destination, attracting over 52 million visitors annually. Upon arrival, we'll transfer you to your hotel, where you'll spend the night.

itinerary.title: Orlando – Walt Disney- Magic Kingdom
itinerary.description: Today is dedicated to a visit to the Magic Kingdom, a vast 107-acre realm that first opened its doors on October 1, 1971. Often hailed as "The Most Magical Place on Earth," it boasts seven themed lands and a plethora of attractions suitable for all ages. As you step onto Main Street USA, the cares of the outside world seem to vanish, and you're transported to a realm where storybook fantasies come to life. Disney classics unfold before your eyes, ensuring a day of enchantment and wonder. Your night will be spent at your hotel in Orlando.

itinerary.title: Orlando – Epcot Center
itinerary.description: Commence your day with a visit to the Epcot Center, where you can immerse yourself in a world of futuristic wonders and global exploration. Spanning 260 acres, this remarkable destination showcases both past achievements and the cutting-edge technologies of tomorrow. The World Showcase invites you to embark on a perpetual World Fair experience, featuring pavilions dedicated to eleven diverse countries. Enjoy the diverse array of attractions and live performances. Spend the night at your Orlando hotel.

itinerary.title: Orlando - Sea World
itinerary.description: Today, you'll have the opportunity to explore Sea World, the world's largest marine park. Brace yourself for an extraordinary adventure, including a one-of-a-kind water coaster thrill ride through the enigmatic lost city of Atlantis. Soar into the world of excitement on a jet copter ride to the Wild Arctic. Sea World allows you to get up close and personal with awe-inspiring wild animals, providing you with the chance to touch, feed, and witness their incredible presence. It's an experience that will draw you back time and time again. Spend the night at your Orlando hotel.

itinerary.title: Orlando - Chicago
itinerary.description: Today, you will take a plane to Chicago, renowned as "The Windy City" and "The City of Broad Shoulders." This city attracts 44.2 million visitors annually with its diverse array of attractions. Chicago is the most populous city in Illinois and the entire American Midwest, serving as a dominant hub for finance, industry, and culture in the region. Throughout much of its history, Chicago has been informally known as America's "Second City." Upon your arrival, we'll transfer you to your hotel in Chicago, where you'll spend the night.

itinerary.title: Chicago City Tour
itinerary.description: Following a satisfying breakfast, you will hop on an exciting city tour of Chicago. This comprehensive exploration includes visits to renowned landmarks such as the Sears Tower, Millennium Park, Whacker South, Lake Shore Drive, Navy Pier, Magnificent Mile, Downtown, the Art Institute, River North, and many more. After a day of discovery, you will return to your hotel in Chicago for the night.

itinerary.title: Chicago – Las Vegas
itinerary.description: In the morning, you will depart for your flight to Las Vegas. Upon your arrival, you will transfer to your hotel. In the evening, your Las Vegas city tour awaits you, offering a chance to witness the dazzling Colourful Dancing Fountain water fountains of the Bellagio, the Pirate Ships at Treasure Island, the towering Stratosphere Tower, the vibrant Downtown Vegas, and, of course, the famous Fremont Street. Here, more than 12 million lights illuminate the night with an impressive, free show accompanied by lively music. You will spend the night at your hotel in Las Vegas.

itinerary.title: Las Vegas - Grand Canyon (Optional)
itinerary.description: Today, you have the option to spend the day at leisure or embark on the Grand Canyon Tour by bus or air (optional). Don't miss the opportunity to experience the New Wonder of the West, the Skywalk. In the evening, consider taking the Las Vegas Night Flight (optional), a thrilling helicopter ride over the dazzling nighttime skyline of Vegas. Alternatively, enjoy a fabulous show or attend one of the many free shows, such as the Sirens of Treasure Island, and much more. You will return to your hotel in Las Vegas for the night.

itinerary.title: Las Vegas – Los Angeles
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a delightful breakfast at the hotel before setting off to Los Angeles. You'll travel by plane or bus, embarking on an exciting journey to the City of Angels. Upon arrival, enjoy a city tour of Los Angeles, often referred to as the "Entertainment capital of the world." This tour will take you through famous locations such as Hollywood, the iconic Hollywood Walk of Fame, Beverly Hills, the renowned Grauman's Chinese Theatre, the bustling Sunset Strip, luxurious Rodeo Drive for some of the world's most exclusive shopping experiences, and Chinatown, where you can find great bargains. After a day of exploration, you'll spend the night at your hotel in Los Angeles.

itinerary.title: Los Angeles - Universal Studios
itinerary.description: Today, you're in for a treat as we take you on a tour of Universal Studios. Known for its innovative rides and attractions, Universal Studios is designed to immerse visitors in the world of movies like never before. A visit to Universal is like a journey into the heart of Hollywood, where films and TV shows are continually in production. You might even spot a celebrity strolling along the park's sidewalks. After an exciting day at Universal Studios, you'll return to your hotel in Los Angeles for the night.

itinerary.title: Los Angeles - San Francisco
itinerary.description: Catch a flight to San Francisco, a city that has earned legendary status akin to Paris or London. Your visit will include iconic landmarks such as the famous Golden Gate Bridge with its towering bridge towers. Your tour continues to Twin Peaks, the famous Lombard Street, a ride on the iconic Cable Car, a visit to Pier 39, Nob Hill, the Civic Center, Union Square, Fisherman's Wharf, the beautiful Palace of Fine Arts, and other notable highlights that make San Francisco a truly special place. After a day of exploration, you'll spend the night at your hotel in San Francisco.

itinerary.title: San Francisco City Tour
itinerary.description: On this day, you will embark on a captivating sightseeing tour of San Francisco. Your journey takes you to the iconic Golden Gate Bridge, adorned with the world's tallest bridge towers. From there, you will continue your exploration to Twin Peaks, Lombard Street, the charming Cable Car, Pier 39, the elegance of Nob Hill, the Civic Center, bustling Union Square, the vibrant Fisherman's Wharf, and the exquisite Palace of Fine Arts, among other notable highlights. You will spend the night at your hotel in San Francisco.

itinerary.title: Depart San Francisco
itinerary.description: Start the day with hearty breakfast. Today, you have some leisure time to enjoy at your own pace. Later in the day, you will make your way to the airport to catch your flight to the next destination.

packages.name: Exploring the Best of Honolulu, Pearl Harbour, and Maui

images.alt_text: Exploring the Best of Honolulu, Pearl Harbour, and Maui
Exploring the Best of Honolulu, Pearl Harbour, and Maui

itinerary.title: Arrival in Honolulu
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Honolulu International Airport, you'll be greeted and transferred to your hotel. Enjoy an overnight stay in Honolulu.

itinerary.title: Honolulu – Pearl Harbor, USS Arizona
itinerary.description: Start your day by waiting in the hotel lobby for your pickup, as you embark on a tour of Pearl Harbor. The legacy of Pearl Harbor is a reminder of Hawaii's pivotal role during the events that reshaped world history. During this narrated tour of Pearl Harbor, the USS Arizona Memorial, and other historical landmarks in Honolulu, you'll have the opportunity to immerse yourself in the events of December 7, 1941, and the profound impact it had on the outcome of World War II. The excursion commences at Pearl Harbor, where you'll gain insight into the events that unfolded on that fateful Sunday morning in 1941 when Japan launched a devastating attack on U.S. forces at Pearl Harbor, leading the United States into World War II. You'll then visit the USS Arizona Memorial by boat, providing a poignant setting for reflecting on the intense battle that occurred, resulting in the loss of 1,177 crew members. The journey continues to the National Memorial Cemetery of the Pacific, where many of those who served, their country is laid to rest. Finally, the tour takes you past some of Honolulu's most significant historical landmarks, including Iolani Palace, Kawaiahao Church, the Hawaii State Capitol, and Honolulu City Hall. After the tour, return to your hotel for another comfortable overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Honolulu – A Relaxing Day
itinerary.description: Today, you have the freedom to enjoy a leisurely day, with the option to embark on the Atlantis Submarine tour or visit the Polynesian Cultural Center. Your night will be spent at the hotel in Honolulu.

itinerary.title: Honolulu to Maui
itinerary.description: In the morning, it's time to check out from your hotel in Honolulu. You'll then make your way to Maui and check in to your new hotel. Your overnight stay will be in Maui.

itinerary.title: Maui – Hana Tour
itinerary.description: Today, you will begin your journey by waiting in the lobby for the Hana Tour Pickup. Your destination is Hana, often called the jewel of the Valley Isle, and this day promises a truly breathtaking adventure. Located in East Maui and deeply rooted in Hawaiian traditions, Hana is accessible via a winding, narrow road adorned with charming tiny bridges and surrounded by the wild beauty of lush foliage and waterfalls. On this 68-mile journey, your knowledgeable driver and friendly guide will provide captivating insights into the island's hidden treasures. You'll wind your way through the dense tropical rainforest, encountering more than 600 twists and 59 one-lane bridges along the famous Road to Hana. Throughout this scenic route, you'll be treated to stunning vistas, cascading waterfalls, and picturesque coastal landscapes. Remember, it's not just about the destination; the journey itself on the Road to Hana is a remarkable experience. After this unforgettable day, you will spend the night at your hotel in Maui.

itinerary.title: Depart Maui
itinerary.description: As your time in Maui comes to a close, it's time to check out of the hotel. We'll arrange for your transfer to the airport for your flight to your next destination or back home.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Copenhagen
itinerary.description: Once you land at Copenhagen airport, head to your hotel on your own. Take it easy this day and explore at your own pace. The city's main attractions are conveniently located within walking distance of the city centre. We suggest checking out Tivoli Gardens, Amalienborg Palace, Christiansborg Palace (Danish Parliament), Gefion Fountain, Nyhavn (the old harbour), the iconic Little Mermaid, Round Tower, Carlsberg Museum, or any of the various art, culture, history, and design museums. Do not forget to be available for a leisurely stroll along the pedestrian shopping streets of Strøget and its surroundings. Spend the night at your hotel in Copenhagen.

itinerary.title: Copenhagen to Aarhus
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a nice breakfast. Head to Copenhagen Central Rail Station on your own. Take a train and enjoy the scenic journey through farms and little villages that were built by Vikings over a thousand years ago. Arrive in Aarhus, the second-largest city in Denmark, also known as the City of the Smile. Make your way to the hotel by yourself. Spend the day exploring the charming city. Stay overnight at the hotel in Aarhus.

itinerary.title: Explore Aarhus
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delicious breakfast. We suggest visiting the Old City (Den Gamle By). You can also explore the cathedral, the museum of Danish prehistory, or the Marselisborg Castle, which is the Royal Family's holiday residence. If the Royal Family is away, the palace park is open to the public for free from morning to evening. Spend the night at a hotel in Aarhus.

itinerary.title: Aarhus to Odense
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a wonderful breakfast before heading to Odense, Denmark’s third-largest city and the hometown of Hans Christian Andersen. Arrange your own transfer to the hotel. After checking in, visit Hans Christian Andersen’s home, a humble house turned into a museum dedicated to the famous fairy tale writer. Stay overnight at a hotel in Odense.

itinerary.title: Departure from Odense to Copenhagen
itinerary.description: Wake up and enjoy a tasty breakfast. Take some time to explore Odense before making your own way to the station for the afternoon train back to Copenhagen.

packages.name: Explore Copenhagen at Your Own Pace | 3 Days Itinerary

images.alt_text: Explore Copenhagen at Your Own Pace | 3 Days Itinerary
Explore Copenhagen at Your Own Pace | 3 Days Itinerary

itinerary.title: Welcome to Copenhagen
itinerary.description: Hello there! When you arrive at Copenhagen Airport or Copenhagen Central Train Station, you will be greeted by a car ready to take you to your hotel. Once you have checked in, the rest of the day is yours to enjoy as you please. Have a great night's sleep in Copenhagen.

itinerary.title: Explore Copenhagen
itinerary.description: Good morning! Start your day with a tasty breakfast and then embark on a Hop-on/Hop-off tour of the city. Copenhagen is known for being a hub of culture, business, media, and science. Discover why it is called 'Wonderful Copenhagen' as you visit the Amalienborg Palace, the residence of the Royal Family. Do not forget to say hello to the famous Little Mermaid sculpture by the seaside, inspired by Hans Christian Andersen's character. Copenhagen is also renowned for its stunning sights, lively marina, royal elegance, and impressive art. If you are up for some shopping, head to Stroget, the world's longest pedestrianised street, and explore the main hub for dining, whether you prefer a simple or fancy meal. Rest well in Copenhagen.

itinerary.title: Farewell, Copenhagen
itinerary.description: After a delicious breakfast, you have the option to extend your stay or check out of the hotel. Arrange your own transportation to Copenhagen Airport or Copenhagen Central Train Station for your next adventure. Safe travels!

itinerary.title: Arrival in Istanbul
itinerary.description: Arrive at the Ataturk International Airport in Istanbul and transfer to your hotel. After check-in, spend the rest of the day at your leisure, exploring the vibrant city on your own.

itinerary.title: Istanbul City Tour
itinerary.description: Enjoy a full-day guided tour of Istanbul's iconic landmarks, including the Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, Topkapi Palace, Grand Bazaar, Hippodrome, St. Sophia Museum, and other attractions. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Istanbul Free Day
itinerary.description: Today, you will continue your tour of Istanbul, exploring the many attractions, including Golden Horn, Rumeli Fortress, Dolmabahce Palace, and Camlica Hills. Embark on a Bosporus cruise for a panoramic view of the city’s coastline as the yacht passes through the historic Bosporus Bridge. Later, Explore Istanbul at your own pace. You can visit the Spice Bazaar, stroll along the historic Galata Bridge, or delve into the city's culinary delights.

itinerary.title: Istanbul to Cappadocia
itinerary.description: Transfer to Istanbul Airport for a domestic flight to Cappadocia. Upon arrival, check into your hotel and have the rest of the day free to relax and explore the unique landscapes of Cappadocia.

itinerary.title: Cappadocia Tour
itinerary.description: Optional: Start your day with an unforgettable hot air balloon ride over the Cappadocia region to witness the mesmerizing landscapes from the sky (additional cost). Embark on a full-day tour of Cappadocia's highlights. Visit the Göreme Open-Air Museum, where stunning rock-cut churches and monasteries are found. Explore the fairy-tale-like valleys of Devrent and Pasabag, known for their peculiar rock formations. Witness the ancient art of carpet weaving at a traditional carpet factory.

itinerary.title: Cappadocia Free Afternoon
itinerary.description: Enjoy the day at your leisure. You can explore more of Cappadocia, visit local markets, or relax at your hotel. Transfer to Kayseri Airport for a domestic flight to Izmir. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel in Kusadasi, a coastal town on the Aegean Sea. Spend the rest of the day at your leisure, perhaps taking a stroll along the beautiful Kusadasi Marina.

itinerary.title: Kusadasi
itinerary.description: Full-day tour of Kusadasi. Take a guided tour of the ancient city of Ephesus, one of the best-preserved Roman sites in the world. Explore the Library of Celsus, the Temple of Artemis, and the Great Theater. Other attractions include St. Mary House, Isabey Mosque, and the Temple of Apollo.

itinerary.title: Depart Kusadasi To Istanbul
itinerary.description: Take a domestic flight to Istanbul and spend some time in Istanbul until it is time for your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Welcome to Prague!
itinerary.description: When you arrive at the airport or train station, a car will be there to pick you up and take you to your hotel. After checking in, you have the rest of the day to relax and do whatever you like. Spend the night in Prague.

itinerary.title: Explore Prague
itinerary.description: Start your day with breakfast, and then join the Hop-on-Hop-off tour. This pass is good for 24 hours, so you can explore Prague at your own pace. Discover the Old Town, the heart of Prague, with its well-preserved 13th-century houses and churches. See famous landmarks like the Old Town Hall, the Municipal House, and the Estates Theatre. The Old Town Square is where you'll find the Astronomical Clock, which is must-see. Hop off the bus to see The Metronome monument, offering stunning views of the city. For some upscale shopping, take a stroll along Paris Street. Do not miss the chance to explore the Vltava River, the longest river in the Czech Republic, and admire the beautiful bridges crossing it. The bus tour will take you to Lesser Town, where you can marvel at the magnificent St. Nicholas Church and enjoy the surrounding charming pubs and shops. Spend another night in Prague.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: If you want to stay longer, you can extend your stay. Otherwise, check out of your hotel and head to Prague Airport or Prague Train Station for your next adventure. Safe travels!

itinerary.title: Welcome to Zagreb!
itinerary.description: Get ready for an exciting start to your trip in Zagreb, the capital of Croatia! This vibrant city is perfect for everyone, whether you love shopping, culture, delicious food, or just exploring with friends, family, or your significant other. After arriving, head to your hotel for check-in and some rest. Later, join fellow visitors for the Zagreb Evening Tour! Meet up at the Tourist Information Centre on Ban Josip Jelačić Square 11. The tour, led by an English-speaking guide, lasts 2.5 to 3 hours, allowing you to explore Zagreb's famous historical sights and monuments. Highlights include stops at Ban J. Jelačić Square, Kaptol, Tkalčićeva Street, Stone Gate, St. Mark’s Church, and Lotrščak Tower. Do not miss the chance to visit the unique Museum of Broken Relationships. After the tour, join us for a refreshing drink at one of the many cafes in the city centre. It's a great way to unwind and share your first impressions of this charming city!

itinerary.title: Exploring Split - Guided City Tour
itinerary.description: After having breakfast, you will set off to Split today! Get ready to explore the largest coastal town in Croatia by joining a 75-minute walking tour. Once you check into the hotel, it is time for the guided city tour. The meeting point is the Golden Gate, and you can choose either the 3:00 PM or 5:00 PM departure time. Meet your guide at the Golden Gate of the Diocletian Palace, where you will be amazed by the remains of an ancient palace from the Roman Empire. Marvel at the open colonnades of the Peristyle and continue to the impressive Cathedral of St. Duje (Saint Dominus), known as the oldest Catholic cathedral in the world still in use in its original structure. After the tour, head back to the hotel and enjoy an overnight stay in Split.

itinerary.title: Explore Plitvice Lakes
itinerary.description: Start your day with breakfast and get ready for an amazing tour to Plitvice Lakes. A bus will pick you up from the arranged spot, taking you through the picturesque countryside to reach Plitvice Lakes. Once there, an experienced guide will lead you through ancient woodlands. The journey begins with a walk across the Upper Lakes, a group of 12 lakes separated by natural barriers. Over time, the water changes its path, creating new landscapes and leaving some barriers dry. This constant transformation ensures that Plitvice Lakes always offers a unique and breathtaking view. A highlight of the tour is the Big Waterfall, standing tall at 78 metres. The thunderous sound of the water hitting the ground is an unforgettable experience. The tour concludes with a tram ride. Afterward, you have the chance to enjoy local dishes in a nearby tavern (at your own expense). Following lunch, you will drive back to Split on the highway, still buzzing with excitement from the incredible impressions. Do not forget to charge your camera for more memorable moments! Spend the night at the hotel in Split.

itinerary.title: Split to Dubrovnik - City Tour with Cable Car
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel and head to Dubrovnik. Welcome to Dubrovnik, a beautiful city on the Adriatic coast in Croatia. Once you arrive, check in at the hotel and then get ready for a guided city tour. Dubrovnik Walking Tour Details: Departure Time: 5:00 PM Duration: 1 hour Meeting Point: Onofrio's Fountain Your guide will take you on a city tour, starting with a cable car ride. Board the cable car for a scenic journey up Mt Srđ, offering breathtaking views of the city and the Dalmatian Coast. At the top, enjoy the panoramic terraces, where, on a clear day, you can see sights up to 37 miles away. After exploring the summit, take the cable car back down to the city. Once on the ground, follow your guide through Dubrovnik's Old Town. Navigate the charming cobblestone streets and learn about the rich cultural and historical significance of the area. Highlights include Onofrio's Fountain, Sponza Palace, the main square with the Baroque Cathedral of the Assumption, Rector’s Palace, and the Church of St Blaise. Overnight stay at the hotel in Dubrovnik.

itinerary.title: Dubrovnik
itinerary.description: After breakfast today, you have free time to explore Dubrovnik on your own.

itinerary.title: Leaving Dubrovnik
itinerary.description: After breakfast today, head to the airport to catch your flight back home or to your next destination.

packages.name: Grand Tour of the USA: From New York, Washington, Buffalo
packages.destination: New York - Washington - Buffalo - Niagara Falls - Niagara - Orlando - Miami - Las Vegas - Grand Canyon - Los Angeles - San Francisco

images.alt_text: Grand Tour of the USA: From New York, Washington, Buffalo
Grand Tour of the USA: From New York, Washington, Buffalo

itinerary.title: Arrival in New York
itinerary.description: Welcome to the vibrant "Big Apple" and the city that never sleeps! New York is a place of superlatives, being the largest, most exciting, and a hub for both business and culture in America. It's a city that sets trends and has been a global centre of commerce and finance for over a century. After your flight lands, you will arrange your transfer to the hotel, where you'll spend your first night in New York. Enjoy your stay!

itinerary.title: New York City Tour
itinerary.description: Following a delightful breakfast, our day kicks off with an enriching city tour of New York. Our itinerary boasts a visit to the iconic symbol of the USA, the "Statue of Liberty." You'll embark on a ferry journey to Liberty Island, treating yourself to a spectacular view of the magnificent New York City skyline. Your next stop promises a view of a lifetime as you ascend to the One World Observatory at the World Trade Center. In the afternoon, your journey takes us to renowned landmarks such as Rockefeller Center, Wall Street, Ground Zero, and the serene expanse of Central Park. You will also explore the vibrant ambiance of Times Square, catch a glimpse of the United Nations, and perhaps even spot a glimpse of the Trump legacy. As the day unfolds, you'll have a chance to soak in the essence of this incredible city. You'll return to your hotel in New York for a comfortable overnight stay.

itinerary.title: New York to Washington
itinerary.description: Today, you travel to Washington DC, the capital of the United States of America, known for its rich history and iconic landmarks. Apart from being the seat of the federal government, Washington DC is a major hub for tourism, welcoming nearly twenty million visitors each year. Upon checking in at the hotel, you will have the opportunity to explore this historic city. You can visit the White House, Lincoln Memorial, Supreme Court, the Capitol Building, the Smithsonian Air and Space Museum, Union Station, World War II Memorial Building, the Pentagon, and the Washington Monument. It's a day filled with immersing yourself in the culture and history of the nation's capital. You'll spend the night at your hotel in Washington.

itinerary.title: Washington to Buffalo – USA Side of Niagara Falls
itinerary.description: Start the day with a hearty breakfast. Today, you will journey to Buffalo, either by air or by road, to witness the incredible and world-famous Niagara Falls, a natural wonder that never ceases to amaze. You'll spend the night at a hotel in Niagara.

itinerary.title: Niagara - Exploring the USA Side of Niagara Falls
itinerary.description: Your day begins with a remarkable experience as you will board the renowned "Maid of the Mist" boat. This iconic vessel will take you up close to the thundering falls, allowing you to cruise around both the American and Horseshoe Falls (it is seasonal). After this exhilarating water adventure, return to the hotel to freshen up. You'll spend another night at your hotel in Niagara.

itinerary.title: Niagara to Orlando
itinerary.description: On this day, you will take a flight to Orlando, which is not only the sixth largest city in Florida but also its largest inland city. Orlando has gained fame as a beloved vacation destination, thanks in large part to the presence of the Disney World theme park. This city warmly welcomes over 52 million tourists annually. You will spend the night at a hotel in Orlando.

itinerary.title: Orlando – Walt Disney- Magic Kingdom
itinerary.description: Today's adventure takes you to the enchanting Magic Kingdom. Spanning 107 acres, this magical place first opened its doors on October 1, 1971. Often referred to as "The Most Magical Place on Earth," it boasts seven themed lands and a multitude of attractions to delight visitors of all ages. As you step onto Main Street USA, you'll find yourself transported to a realm where everyday reality blends with storybook fantasies, and Disney classics come to life. It's a place where the worries of the outside world seem to simply melt away. You'll spend the night at a hotel in Orlando.

itinerary.title: Orlando – Epcot Center
itinerary.description: Your day begins at the Epcot Center, where you can immerse yourself in a world of futuristic wonders and global adventures. This vast 260-acre space is dedicated to celebrating past achievements and showcasing the future of technology. In the World Showcase, you'll encounter a unique permanent World Fair, featuring pavilions representing eleven different countries. After a day of exploration, you'll spend the night at your Orlando hotel.

itinerary.title: Orlando - Sea World
itinerary.description: Today, your destination is Sea World, the world's largest Marine Park, offering a wealth of attractions. Brace yourself for the thrill of a one-of-a-kind water coaster ride through the enigmatic lost city of Atlantis. Experience the adrenaline rush of a jet copter ride to the Wild Arctic. At Sea World, you'll have the opportunity to get up close and personal with incredible wild animals, whether through touching, feeding, or simply being in their presence. It's an action-packed experience that will undoubtedly beckon you back time and time again. After an exciting day, you'll return to your Orlando hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Orlando to Miami
itinerary.description: Today, you will travel from Orlando to the vibrant city of Miami, Florida. Miami is renowned as one of the state's most sought-after vacation destinations. It is famous for its beautiful beaches, particularly South Beach, its trendy nightlife, the iconic Art Deco district, the lively Calle Ocho, and the cultural richness of Little Havana. Upon arrival, you will check in to your hotel and have the rest of the afternoon at your leisure to soak in the Miami atmosphere. You'll spend the night at your hotel in Miami.

itinerary.title: Miami City Exploration
itinerary.description: Today, you will embark on a comprehensive city tour of Miami, taking in a variety of fascinating sights. Your tour will include visits to Central Station/Bayfront Park, the iconic Ocean Drive, the vibrant Lincoln Road, the chic Collins Avenue, the trendy Design District, the artsy Midtown Miami, the lush Coconut Grove, and the culturally vibrant Little Havana, among many other attractions. Additionally, you'll have the opportunity to experience the beauty of Biscayne Bay with a relaxing Boat Tour, allowing you to cruise along the tranquil waters of Miami's Biscayne Bay. You'll spend the night at your hotel in Miami.

itinerary.title: Miami – Las Vegas
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a morning flight to Las Vegas. Upon your arrival, you will be transferred to your hotel. In the evening, we invite you to embark on a city tour of Las Vegas, where you will be treated to an array of captivating sights. Experience the mesmerising Colourful Dancing Fountain water display at the Bellagio, witness the Pirate Ships at Treasure Island, take in the breathtaking views from the Stratosphere Tower, explore Downtown Vegas, and, of course, stroll along the iconic Fremont Street. This lively area boasts over 12 million lights that come to life in a vibrant free show set to pulsating music. Your overnight stay will be at a Las Vegas hotel.

itinerary.title: Las Vegas - Grand Canyon (Optional)
itinerary.description: Today, you have the choice to spend your day at leisure or partake in the Grand Canyon Tour, either by bus or air (optional). Don't miss the chance to experience the New Wonder of the West, the Skywalk. In the evening, consider taking the Las Vegas Night Flight (optional) - a mesmerising helicopter ride over the dazzling night-time cityscape of Las Vegas. Alternatively, you can indulge in a fabulous live show or attend one of the many free entertainment performances, such as the Sirens of Treasure Island, and much more. You'll spend the night at your Las Vegas hotel.

itinerary.title: Las Vegas – Los Angeles
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delicious breakfast at the hotel before heading to Los Angeles. You can choose to fly or take a bus for the journey. Upon arriving in Los Angeles, immerse yourself in the city's vibrant atmosphere with a guided city tour. Your tour will take you through the renowned "Entertainment capital of the world," visiting iconic places such as Hollywood, the Hollywood Walk of Fame, Beverly Hills, Grauman's Chinese Theater, the Sunset Strip, Rodeo Drive, famous for its luxury shopping, and China Town, where you can find some great bargains. Your day concludes with an overnight stay at a Los Angeles hotel.

itinerary.title: Los Angeles - Universal Studios
itinerary.description: Today, get ready for an exciting adventure at Universal Studios. Universal Studios is celebrated for its cutting-edge rides and attractions, providing visitors with a unique opportunity to experience the magic of movies like never before. A visit to Universal Studios is like stepping into the heart of Hollywood, where you might even spot film and TV production in action. Following your thrilling day, you'll spend the night at a Los Angeles hotel.

itinerary.title: Los Angeles to San Francisco
itinerary.description: Fly to San Francisco, a city that has achieved legendary status akin to places like Paris or London. Your day will be filled with iconic attractions, including the renowned Golden Gate Bridge with its towering spires. You'll also explore Twin Peaks, Lombard Street, the charming Cable Car, Pier 39, the upscale Nob Hill district, the Civic Center, bustling Union Square, vibrant Fisherman's Wharf, and the elegant Palace of Fine Arts, among other highlights. After an eventful day, you'll spend the night at your San Francisco hotel.

itinerary.title: San Francisco City Tour
itinerary.description: Today, embark on a comprehensive city tour of San Francisco, with the opportunity to revisit some of the iconic sites. Your journey includes a visit to the world-famous Golden Gate Bridge, as well as Twin Peaks, the winding Lombard Street, a ride on the iconic Cable Car, and stops at Pier 39, Nob Hill, Civic Center, Union Square, Fisherman's Wharf, and the majestic Palace of Fine Arts, among other city highlights. Enjoy another night at your San Francisco hotel.

itinerary.title: Depart San Francisco
itinerary.description: Start the day with a hearty breakfast. Take some leisure time today before heading to the airport for your onward flight to your next destination.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Istanbul
itinerary.description: Arrive at Istanbul Ataturk Airport and transfer to your hotel. After check-in, take some time to relax and explore the local area.

itinerary.title: Istanbul City Tour
itinerary.description: Enjoy a full-day city tour of Istanbul, visiting iconic landmarks such as the Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, Topkapi Palace, and the Grand Bazaar. Optional - Take a Bosporus Cruise to admire the city's stunning skyline and enjoy panoramic views. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Istanbul Free Day
itinerary.description: Spend the day at your leisure in Istanbul. You can visit additional attractions, go shopping, or indulge in the city's renowned culinary scene. Popular attractions in Istanbul include – Spice Market, Rumeli Fortress, Dolmabahce Palace, and Camlica Hill.

itinerary.title: Flight to Antalya
itinerary.description: Check out from your Istanbul hotel and transfer to the airport for a domestic flight to Antalya. Arrive in Antalya and transfer to your hotel. Relax and enjoy the beautiful Mediterranean coastline. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Antalya.

itinerary.title: Antalya Old Town and Perge
itinerary.description: Explore Antalya's charming Old Town (Kaleici), known for its narrow streets, historic houses, and picturesque harbor. Visit the ancient city of Perge, which features well-preserved ruins dating back to the Roman period, Aspendos Ancient Theatre, Kursunlu Waterfalls, etc.

itinerary.title: Antalya Free Day
itinerary.description: Spend the day at your leisure in Antalya. You can relax on the beaches, engage in water sports, or take an optional excursion to nearby attractions such as the ancient city of the Side or the stunning Duden Waterfalls. Attractions we’ll cover today include Myra Lycian tombs, the Church of St. Nicholas, Kekova Island, Simena Sunken City, and the Lycian Necropolis.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Check out from your Antalya hotel and transfer to Istanbul Airport for your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Istanbul
