itinerary.description: Arrive in Istanbul and transfer to your hotel. Spend the day at your leisure. Stroll through the bustling Grand Bazaar. Enjoy a traditional Turkish dinner in a local restaurant. Stay at a luxury hotel in Turkey.

itinerary.title: Istanbul
itinerary.description: Start the day with a visit to the stunning Basilica Cistern, an underground marvel. Explore the Sultanahmet area, known as the historic heart of the city. Visit the iconic Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque, and Topkapi Palace. Explore the Spice Bazaar, famous for its aromatic spices, teas, and Turkish delights. Take a relaxing cruise along the Bosphorus Strait, enjoying the views of Istanbul's skyline. Visit the Dolmabahce Palace, a grand Ottoman palace on the shores of the Bosphorus. In the evening, consider watching a traditional Turkish cultural performance, such as a Whirling Dervishes show.

itinerary.title: Istanbul
itinerary.description: Explore the vibrant neighborhoods of Beyoglu and Istiklal Street. Visit the Galata Tower for panoramic views of Istanbul. Discover the Istanbul Modern Art Museum, showcasing contemporary Turkish art. Take a walk across the Galata Bridge to the Karakoy district and try some delicious street food. In the evening, experience the lively nightlife of Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Istanbul to Kusadasi
itinerary.description: Check out from your Istanbul hotel and transfer to the airport for a domestic flight to Izmir. Upon arrival in Izmir, transfer to Kusadasi, a charming coastal town on the Aegean Sea. Relax and unwind at your Kusadasi hotel or take a stroll along the beautiful beaches. Enjoy a delicious seafood dinner at a local restaurant.

itinerary.title: Kusadasi
itinerary.description: Take a full-day excursion to the ancient city of Ephesus, one of the best-preserved Roman ruins in the world. Explore the Library of Celsus, the Great Theater, and the Temple of Artemis. Visit the House of the Virgin Mary, a pilgrimage site believed to be the last residence of the Virgin Mary. Enjoy an authentic Turkish lunch during the excursion. Return to Kusadasi and spend the evening at your leisure.

itinerary.title: Kusadasi
itinerary.description: Explore the city on your own after breakfast. Or, opt for a Pamukkale tour. Drive to the ancient city of Hierapolis and tour the Necropolis, Bath, Basilica, and Frontinius Gate. Swim in Pamukkale’s travertines. Return to Kusadasi and spend the rest of the day exploring the town or relaxing at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Departure From Kusadasi to Istanbul
itinerary.description: Check out from the hotel and travel to Istanbul for your return flight.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Zagreb
itinerary.description: Welcome to Zagreb, the capital of Croatia! Zagreb has a rich history but is also a lively and modern city. During the day, it's bustling with business activities, and as the sun sets, the city comes alive with a vibrant atmosphere. Despite its modernity, the people here greet visitors with warm Croatian hospitality. Check-in to your hotel and later, join the Zagreb Evening City Tour. This tour is like a stroll through the past and present of Zagreb. The city is divided into two parts: the old and romantic Upper Town, and the young and bustling Lower Town, separated by Ilica, the longest street in Zagreb. The Upper and Lower Towns are connected by the Stone Gate (Kamenita vrata), a famous tourist spot with many legends and stories, symbolising faith and peace. Overnight stay at the hotel in Zagreb.

itinerary.title: Zagreb to Zadar (Approx. 3 hrs 30 min) and Zadar Evening City Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast, you will head to Zadar—a city with a remarkable history and a lot of cultural heritage. It is a popular tourist destination. Once you arrive, check into the hotel, and you will have the afternoon to relax. In the evening, you will go on a city tour of Zadar. You will set off to walk through the main part of the city, where you will be guided to the most important places. You will be informed about the cultural sites and highlight things you might want to visit while you are here. You will see interesting spots like the Sea organ, Greetings to the Sun installation, Roman Forum, Temple, St. Mary, and Basilica St. Donat. The tour will also take you to St. Anastasia Cathedral, St. Grisogonus Church, the noble square, St. Simeon Church, and the Square of Five Wells—where you can see remains of the old city walls. The end of the tour will be at the impressive 15th-century City Land Gate. To wrap up the day, you will be taken to try the famous Zadar liqueur called Maraskino. They have been making this liqueur since the 14th century. After that, you will head back to the hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: Zadar - Plitvice Lakes Tour
itinerary.description: After having breakfast, you will head to Plitvice Lakes, which is about a 1.5-hour drive from Zadar. This place is special because it's a UNESCO world heritage site. Imagine 16 lakes arranged like steps, connected by waterfalls, gorges, and rivers. There are an amazing 92 waterfalls in this national park! During your free time there, you can enjoy the natural beauty and see various animals and plants. It's a unique place where the beauty comes from the long interaction between rocks and water. On your way to Plitvice Lakes, you will also pass by the charming Rastoke ethno village on the Korana River. After exploring Plitvice Lakes, you will head back to Zadar, which is only 1.5 hours away. You will stay overnight at a hotel in Zadar.

itinerary.title: Zadar to Hvar (via Split) - Exploring Hvar City
itinerary.description: Today, you will take a ferry from Zadar to Hvar through Split. Hvar is an ancient city with a fascinating history. Every person who visits this old city can find a peaceful and magical experience in its charming surroundings. As you walk around, you'll come across important landmarks like Fortica Fortress, Hvar Cathedral, the theater, Arsenal, and the Franciscan monastery. Each of these places tells a story about the city's long history. If you are looking for a beach vacation with clear blue water, the sweet scent of Mediterranean plants, and lots of sunshine, Hvar is the perfect place. The nearby bays and islands, known as Pakleni otoci (Pakleni islands), add to the charm and make your holiday truly unforgettable. In the evening, choose from the many restaurants in Hvar to enjoy a delicious meal. Explore the city, let its history captivate you, bask in the sunlight, and treat yourself to moments of joy and relaxation. You will spend the night at a hotel in Hvar.

itinerary.title: Hvar to Dubrovnik
itinerary.description: In the morning, after breakfast, you will be heading to Dubrovnik. You will take a ferry from Hvar to Split and then continue your journey to Dubrovnik, which will take about 3 hours and 6 minutes. Once you arrive in Dubrovnik, you will check into the hotel and then go on a city tour. The Discover Dubrovnik tour is perfect for those who want to see all the main attractions and learn about the city's history and architecture. With our knowledgeable guide, you will hear about Dubrovnik's golden age as we explore the Old Town, passing by Onofrio's Fountain and walking up Prijeko Street to the Old Port – the key to Dubrovnik's trading success. You will also visit St. Saviour's, the impressive Franciscan and Dominican church, and see vines that have been producing wine for over 100 years. The Discover Dubrovnik tour lasts about an hour. During this time, you will be entertained, informed, and gain a deep understanding of Dubrovnik's rich history. After the tour, you will spend the night at the hotel in Dubrovnik.

itinerary.title: Dubrovnik
itinerary.description: Good morning! Today, after having breakfast, you have the entire day to do whatever you would like. Explore the area on your own or simply relax. Tonight, you will stay at the hotel in Dubrovnik.

itinerary.title: Departure from Dubrovnik
itinerary.description: After breakfast, it is time to head to the airport. You will catch a flight back to your hometown or your next destination.

itinerary.title: Welcome to Sofia - Explore at Your Own Pace
itinerary.description: Hello and welcome to Sofia! When you arrive at the airport, your car will be ready to take you to the hotel. After checking in, the rest of the day is yours to enjoy as you like. You will spend the night at the hotel in Sofia.

itinerary.title: Sofia City Tour
itinerary.description: After a delicious breakfast, start your day by exploring the unique and sunny city of Sofia. Take an exciting tour of Bulgaria's beautiful capital, Sofia. You will get to see amazing landmarks like the St. Alexander Nevsky Cathedral and other highlights of the city. Spend the night at the hotel in Sofia.

itinerary.title: Departure from Sofia
itinerary.description: Today, you have the option to extend your stay or check out from the hotel. If you are heading to your next destination, we will arrange a transfer to the airport for your onward journey.

packages.name: Brussels Free and Easy 3 Days Itinerary

images.alt_text: Brussels Free and Easy 3 Days Itinerary
Brussels Free and Easy 3 Days Itinerary

itinerary.title: Arrival in Brussels
itinerary.description: Welcome to Brussels! When you arrive at Brussels Airport or Brussels Train Station, you'll be greeted by a car that will take you to your hotel. Check-in and then take it easy for the rest of the day. Spend the night in Brussels.

itinerary.title: Exploring Brussels
itinerary.description: After having breakfast, take a City Sightseeing tour in Brussels. There are 13 stops where you can hop on and off conveniently around the city. You can visit interesting places and attractions at your own pace. Brussels is known for the European Union, the European Parliament, landmarks like Manneken Pis, the Cinquantenaire Arch, Art Nouveau and Victor Horta, the Grand-Place, and the Atomium. The city has a mix of architectural wonders from the Renaissance to modern times, and exploring this heritage is always full of surprises. Spend the night in Brussels.

itinerary.title: Departure from Brussels
itinerary.description: Begin the day with a delicious breakfast. Today, you can either extend your stay or check out from the hotel. Arrange your own transportation to Brussels Airport or Brussels Central Train Station for your next journey.

itinerary.title: Welcome to Vienna!
itinerary.description: When you arrive at Vienna Airport or the Train Station, a car will be there to pick you up and take you to your hotel. Once you have checked in, the rest of the day is yours to relax. You will be spending the night at the hotel in Vienna.

itinerary.title: Explore Vienna
itinerary.description: After breakfast, it's time to explore Austria's capital city, Vienna. A great way to see the city is by taking a relaxing Hop-on-Hop-off bus tour. You can set your own pace, getting on and off at any of the 35 stops as many times as you like. Do not forget to check out the shops along Graben street in the Old Town. And, of course, make sure to visit one of the famous Viennese cafes. You can try the original Sacher cake at Café Sacher and enjoy some tasty food at one of Vienna’s bistros or Beisl, as the locals call them. You will spend the night at the hotel in Vienna.

itinerary.title: Depart from Vienna
itinerary.description: Start the day with a wonderful breakfast. Today, you can either extend your stay or check out from the hotel. If you are moving on to your next adventure, a transfer will be arranged to take you to Vienna Airport or the Train Station.

packages.name: Innsbruck Free and Easy – 3 Days Itinerary

images.alt_text: Innsbruck Free and Easy – 3 Days Itinerary
Innsbruck Free and Easy – 3 Days Itinerary

itinerary.title: Arrival in Innsbruck
itinerary.description: Welcome to Innsbruck! When you arrive at Innsbruck Airport or Innsbruck Train Station, you will meet your car, which will take you to the hotel. After checking in, you have the rest of the day to relax and do whatever you like.

itinerary.title: Exploring Innsbruck
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast and then start exploring the capital of the Tyrol Region. We do not have a guided tour arranged, but you can use the local tourist office's Hop on – Hop off sightseeing service called "The Sightseer." You can book this tour locally at the tourist office. If you prefer not to take a tour, you can wander around the Old Town, visit shops for souvenirs, and have a relaxing time in one of the many cafes. You might also consider a 20-minute car ride to Wattens, where the Swarovski Crystal Worlds are located (reopens May 2015). Do not forget to check out Swarovski's large shop in the Old Town. Overnight stay in Innsbruck.

itinerary.title: Departure from Innsbruck
itinerary.description: After having breakfast, you can either extend your stay or check out of the hotel. We will arrange for a transfer to Innsbruck Airport or Innsbruck Central Train Station for your next journey.

itinerary.title: Arrival In Edinburgh
itinerary.description: You will arrive in Edinburgh by flight or train and check into your hotel. Start your tour with a visit to the iconic Edinburgh Castle. Explore the historic fortress, admire the Crown Jewels of Scotland, and enjoy panoramic views of the city. After the castle, take a leisurely stroll down the Royal Mile, a vibrant street connecting Edinburgh Castle to the Palace of Holyroodhouse. Explore the charming shops, cafes, and historic landmarks along the way. Visit the Palace of Holyroodhouse, the official residence of the British monarch in Scotland. Explore the stunning architecture and learn about its fascinating history. End your day with a visit to Dynamic Earth, an interactive science museum that tells the story of planet Earth through immersive exhibits and displays.

itinerary.title: Full-Day Tour Of Edinburgh
itinerary.description: Start your day by hiking up Arthur's Seat, an ancient volcano and one of Edinburgh's most iconic landmarks. Enjoy panoramic views of the city and surrounding landscape. Visit the Royal Yacht Britannia, the former royal yacht of Queen Elizabeth II. Take a self-guided tour and explore the luxurious rooms, royal apartments, and stunning decks. Head to the National Museum of Scotland, where you can delve into Scotland's rich history, art, and culture. The museum houses diverse exhibits, including artifacts from ancient civilizations and interactive displays. Spend the afternoon exploring the charming streets of the Old Town. Visit the historic St. Giles' Cathedral, wander through the narrow closes, and soak in the medieval atmosphere. Join a ghost tour in the evening to experience Edinburgh's haunted history. Explore the city's eerie alleys, hear spooky tales, and learn about its dark past.

itinerary.title: Final Day & Departure
itinerary.description: Some of the attractions you can cover include Rosslyn Chapel and Calton Hill. Further, you can extend your stay or take your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Vienna
itinerary.description: When you arrive in Vienna, someone will be there to greet you and take you to the hotel. After reaching the hotel, you can check in. The rest of the day is free for you to relax and do what you like. You will spend the night at the hotel in Vienna.

itinerary.title: Vienna to Salzburg
itinerary.description: Start your day with breakfast at the hotel. Then, join a morning city tour and visit Schonbrunn. This tour is a wonderful way to see the important historical places in Vienna. You will pass by impressive buildings like the MAK, the State Opera House, and the Museum of Fine Arts with its famous Habsburg art collection. You will also see the cultural district, home to the Museums Quartier, Hofburg, Parliament, City Hall, and the Burg Theatre. The highlight of the tour is a visit to the beautiful Schonbrunn Palace, the former summer residence of the Habsburg family. On the way back, you will pass by the Belvedere Palace. Later in the afternoon, you'll take a train to Salzburg. Upon arrival in Salzburg, someone will meet you and take you to the hotel. You'll spend the night at the hotel in Salzburg.

itinerary.title: Salzburg to Innsbruck
itinerary.description: Start your day with breakfast at the hotel. In the morning, join the Half Day Salzburg City Tour. You will need to make your way to the starting point at Mirabellplatz, right in front of St. Andrä Church. During the tour, enjoy a wonderful ride with breathtaking views of the landscape where the opening scenes of the film "Sound of Music" were filmed. Relax and listen to the original soundtrack of "Sound of Music." Our guide, who speaks English, will not only highlight the film locations but also share information about the historical and architectural landmarks in the city, along with a part of the picturesque Lake District. The tour will last approximately 4 hours. Afterward, return to the hotel on your own. In the afternoon, you will have a departure transfer to the train station to catch your train to Innsbruck. Upon arrival in Innsbruck, transfer to the hotel, check-in, and spend the night at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Explore Innsbruck
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast at the hotel. Today, you have free time to explore the beautiful town in the Alps. You can visit the Crystal Factory Showroom or simply take it easy. Tonight, you will stay overnight at the hotel in Innsbruck.

itinerary.title: Travel from Innsbruck to Vienna
itinerary.description: Start your day with breakfast at the hotel. Get ready for a transfer to the train station to catch a train to Vienna. Once you arrive in Vienna, you will be taken to the hotel. Check-in is at 2:00 PM. The rest of the day is yours to explore on your own. You will spend the night at the hotel in Vienna.

itinerary.title: Departure from Vienna
itinerary.description: After having breakfast at the hotel this morning, you have the day to yourself until it is time to leave. Later, there will be a transfer to the airport or train station for your onward journey.

packages.name: Best of Eastern Europe 9 Days Itinerary

images.alt_text: Best of Eastern Europe 9 Days Itinerary
Best of Eastern Europe 9 Days Itinerary

itinerary.title: Arrive in Vienna
itinerary.description: When you arrive, someone will meet and greet you. Then, you will be taken to your hotel. After checking in, you have the rest of the day to do whatever you like. You will spend the night at the hotel in Vienna.

itinerary.title: Explore Vienna
itinerary.description: Start your day with breakfast at the hotel. A pick-up will be arranged to take you on a Grand City Tour, including a visit to the Palace of Schonbrunn. This tour will show you the important sights of Vienna, such as the famous Ringstrasse boulevard. You will see landmarks like the State Opera House, Museums of Fine Arts and Natural History, Parliament, National Theatre, City Hall, University, Votive Church, and Urania. Inside the Schonbrunn Palace, you will get a closer look, and the tour will also take you to the Belvedere Palace. The tour ends at the Opera, and then you can find your way back to the hotel on your own. The afternoon is free for you to enjoy at your own pace. You will spend the night at the hotel in Vienna

itinerary.title: Vienna to Salzburg and Back
itinerary.description: Start your day with breakfast at the hotel. Get ready to explore Salzburg on a full-day tour! A comfortable ride will pick you up from the hotel. The tour takes you through the beautiful Salzkammergut Lake District and heads west to Gmunden, a charming town. You will also enjoy the stunning mountain scenery of the Lake District. Upon reaching Salzburg, you will have some free time to grab lunch and do some shopping. Afterward, set off on a guided tour of Salzburg, where you will visit impressive sites such as Fortress Hohensalzburg, the Cathedral, Festival Halls Mozarteum, Getreidegasse, Mozart's Birthplace, and Mirabell Gardens. Once the tour is done, return to Vienna and spend the night at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Vienna to Prague
itinerary.description: After a scrumptious breakfast, check out of the hotel before heading to the train station to catch your train to Prague. The journey takes around 4 hours and is full of amazing views. Our tour manager will meet you at Prague station and help you transfer to the hotel. Check into the hotel and spend the rest of the day exploring places around your hotel.

itinerary.title: Prague City Tour
itinerary.description: Start your day with breakfast at the hotel. Then, make your way to the meeting point for the city tour. In the morning, you will explore Prague's historical landmarks, like the State Opera, National Museum, Wenceslas Square, Charles Square, and Prague Castle. Walk around the Castle courtyards and see St. Vitus Cathedral. The bus will then take you to the Old Town Square, where you can admire the astronomical clock and apostles. The tour ends here, and you can find your way back to the hotel. Enjoy the rest of the afternoon at your leisure. Spend the night at the hotel in Prague.

itinerary.title: Prague to Budapest
itinerary.description: Start your day with breakfast at the hotel. After that, check out and head to the train station. Take a train to Budapest. Upon arrival, transfer to the hotel and check in. The rest of the day is free for you to relax and enjoy. Spend the night at the hotel in Budapest.

itinerary.title: Budapest City Tour
itinerary.description: Have breakfast at the hotel, then join a city tour of Budapest. The tour begins at the Chain Bridge, passing by the Parliament and crossing the Margaret Bridge to reach the Buda side. Explore the Castle District, taking a short walk to see its main attractions. Visit Matthias Church and the Fishermen’s Bastion for a beautiful panorama. Next, travel to Gellért Hill (Citadel) for a spectacular view of Budapest. Cross the Elisabeth Bridge to Pest and see the famous Central Market Hall and the largest Synagogue in Europe. Continue to the City Park, passing by Europe’s largest Thermal Spa, Budapest Zoo, and the Amusement Park. Stop at Heroes Square to see statues of famous Hungarian Kings and Dukes. Take Andrássy Avenue to downtown Pest, passing by the Opera House and St. Stephen’s Basilica. Throughout the tour, get a brief overview of Hungary's last 1000 years of history. The tour concludes in the City Centre, and you can make your own way back to the hotel. The rest of the day is free for you to enjoy at your leisure. Spend the night at the hotel in Budapest.

itinerary.title: Budapest to Vienna
itinerary.description: Start your day with breakfast at the hotel. Afterward, check out and head to the train station to catch a train to Vienna. Once you arrive in Vienna, transfer to your hotel and check in. The rest of the afternoon is free for you to enjoy at your leisure. Spend the night at the hotel in Vienna.

itinerary.title: Departing Vienna
itinerary.description: Have breakfast at the hotel, then check out. A transfer will take you from the hotel to Vienna Airport for your onward journey.

packages.name: Amazing Scotland
packages.destination: Edinburgh - Loch Ness - Glen Coe - Inverness - Glasgow

itinerary.title: Arrival in Edinburgh
itinerary.description: Arrive at Edinburgh Airport and transfer to your hotel. Spend the afternoon exploring the historic city of Edinburgh. Visit the iconic Edinburgh Castle, stroll along the Royal Mile, and explore the city's charming neighborhoods. Some of the tour's highlights include – Fort Augustus, the Grampian Mountains, Caledonian Canal, and Highland Perthshire. Enjoy a traditional Scottish dinner in one of the local restaurants. Overnight stay in Edinburgh.

itinerary.title: Edinburgh
itinerary.description: After breakfast, continue your exploration of Edinburgh. Delve deep into the Highlands by hearing legendary stories of the Jacobites and the mythological Loch Ness Monster. Visit the iconic Loch Ness and go on a boat tour to try and spot the legendary Loch Ness Monster. Don’t miss the Rannoch Moor, one of Britain's few remaining wild areas with vast areas of bogs, lochs, rivers, and wildlife. We’ll also cover Glencoe, a beautiful valley in the Central Scottish Highlands. Spend your time enjoying the scenery and indulging in outdoor activities. Visit the Palace of Holyroodhouse, the official residence of the British monarch in Scotland. Explore the Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh or climb Arthur's Seat for panoramic city views. In the evening, attend a traditional Scottish show featuring bagpipers, dancers, and musicians. Overnight stay in Edinburgh.

itinerary.title: Inverness
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of your hotel and travel to Inverness. Enjoy a scenic drive through the Scottish Highlands, passing by stunning landscapes, lochs, and castles. Upon arrival in Inverness, explore the charming city of Inverness, including Inverness Castle and the Inverness Museum and Art Gallery. Overnight stay in Inverness.

itinerary.title: Inverness and the Highlands
itinerary.description: After breakfast, embark on a full-day tour of the Scottish Highlands from Inverness. The Hop On Hop Off tour will cover how the city developed from the original Castle to Kirk, Abertarff House, Highland Archive Centre, St Andrews Cathedral, Tomnahurich Hill, Kessock Bridge, the Black Isle, Inverness Firth, the Inverness Castle, and the Holm Mills shopping village. Visit the Culloden Battlefield, where the historic Battle of Culloden took place. Explore the picturesque Glen Affric, known for its stunning scenery and beautiful walks. Visit the Urquhart Castle on the shores of Loch Ness. Return to Inverness in the evening and enjoy some free time to relax or explore the city further. Overnight stay in Inverness.

itinerary.title: Glasgow
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of your hotel and travel to Glasgow. Upon arrival, explore the vibrant city of Glasgow, known for its rich architectural heritage and thriving arts scene. Visit the Kelvingrove Art Gallery and Museum, the Glasgow Cathedral, and the Riverside Museum. Enjoy shopping on Buchanan Street, known for its high-end shops and boutiques. Experience Glasgow's lively nightlife in the evening and dine in one of the city's excellent restaurants. Overnight stay in Glasgow.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of your hotel. Depending on your flight time, you may have free time for last-minute shopping or sightseeing. Transfer to the airport for your departure.

packages.name: Traverse Through Trinidad and Tobago with GT Holidays

images.alt_text: Traverse Through Trinidad and Tobago with GT Holidays
Traverse Through Trinidad and Tobago with GT Holidays

itinerary.title: Arrival in Trinidad
itinerary.description: Your journey begins as you arrive at Trinidad's international airport in Port of Spain. Upon your arrival, our friendly team will be there to welcome you and provide a comfortable transfer to your hotel. You'll spend the night at your Trinidad hotel.

itinerary.title: Trinidad – City Exploration
itinerary.description: Today, you will start off on an exciting city tour of Port of Spain, the vibrant and cosmopolitan capital of Trinidad. During this tour, you will traverse through the city's key attractions, including historic buildings, bustling commercial districts, and charming residential areas. Your journey will also take you past Art Galleries, Museums, Parks, Emperor Valley Zoo, and the Botanical Garden. To cap off your day, you'll visit the Lady Young Lookout, offering a breathtaking panoramic view of the city. You'll once again spend the night at your hotel in Trinidad.

itinerary.title: Trinidad - Asa Wright Nature Centre
itinerary.description: Today, you will enjoy a remarkable journey to the renowned Asa Wright Nature Centre, a sprawling 200-acre bird sanctuary and conservation haven nestled deep within the Northern Range hills. After a scenic 1 1/2-hour drive to reach this natural wonder, you'll be warmly greeted by your expert guide. Together, you'll go on an enlightening nature walk through the lush tropical forest, adorned with exotic trees and vibrant, colourful flowers. While we can't guarantee specific wildlife sightings, this unique environment is home to a variety of exotic birds, including toucans, manikins, and hummingbirds. Keep your eyes peeled for these remarkable avian creatures, as well as the graceful butterflies that call this place home. The immersive 1 1/2-hour nature walk promises to be an awe-inspiring experience. Following your nature adventure, you will set out on our return journey to your hotel. Alternatively, you have the option to arrange for a local lunch, served at the Old Plantation House, before heading back to your hotel. Additionally, there's a charming waterfall with a refreshing pool where you can take a relaxing dip. Tonight, you'll enjoy another peaceful night at your hotel in Trinidad.

itinerary.title: Trinidad to Tobago
itinerary.description: You will begin your day by arranging your transfer to Piarco Airport, where you'll catch your flight to Tobago. Upon your arrival at Tobago Airport, your friendly team will be there to welcome you and take you to your hotel. The evening is yours to enjoy at your leisure. You'll spend the night at the hotel in Tobago.

itinerary.title: Tobago Island Tour
itinerary.description: Today offers a full-day tour, a wonderful opportunity to witness the best of this enchanting island. As you traverse the island, you'll be treated to captivating views along both the Atlantic and Caribbean coasts. The journey will take you through lush, vibrant rainforests, past secluded and pristine beaches, alongside exhilarating waterfalls, and to historical landmarks. These diverse experiences provide you with some of the most awe-inspiring vistas of the Caribbean, allowing you to immerse yourself in the island's unique atmosphere while experiencing Tobago in its purest form. You'll have the pleasure of enjoying lunch at Jemma's Treehouse, a renowned restaurant on the island. On certain dates when the restaurant is closed, a similar dining option will be provided. Here, you can savor traditional Tobagan dishes that incorporate the fruits and produce you've encountered during your island exploration. Don't forget to pack your swimwear, as you'll have the chance to take a refreshing dip in the magnificent Argyle Waterfall to cool off. After a day of discovery, you'll spend the night at your hotel in Tobago.

itinerary.title: Tobago Rainforest Tour
itinerary.description: Your day starts early to make the most of the vibrant Tobago Rainforest and its enchanting inhabitants. As you set out, you will follow the scenic Caribbean coast, making your way to various captivating stops along the way. Your journey takes you to Castara Bay, where you have the chance to visit a traditional clay oven bakery (please note that it's open on specific days). You then continue our exploration to the secluded and idyllic Englishman's Bay, offering postcard-worthy views. Along our route, you will be treated to numerous picturesque sights. Throughout the day, you will make stops to sample island fruits and local produce, immersing ourselves in the authentic flavors of the region. The highlight of our adventure is our entry into the oldest protected Rainforest in the Western Hemisphere, known as the Main Ridge. Here, you will embark on a trail that allows us to witness the remarkable workings of this incredible ecosystem. The Rainforest teems with a rich variety of plant life and wildlife, enveloped in the melodious symphony of birdsong. Keep your eyes peeled for the opportunity to spot a wide array of bird species, as well as land crabs, snakes, iguanas, and other fascinating creatures on our journey to the gold and silver falls. Don't miss the chance to spot the White-tailed Sabrewing hummingbird, among other bird species. Keep an eye out for our national bird, the Rufous Vented Chachalacha, also known as the Cocrico. Our lunch stop brings us back to Castara, where you can savour a delightful meal. You will conclude the day with an overnight stay at our hotel in Tobago.

itinerary.title: Departure from Tobago
itinerary.description: This morning, you'll be transferred to Scarborough Airport for your flight back home, with a connection via Trinidad.

packages.name: Explore the Glimpse of Qatar in 4 Days | Itinerary
packages.destination: Doha -Desert Safari - Leisure - Mia Tour - Souq Waqif - National Museum Of Qatar

images.alt_text: Explore the Glimpse of Qatar in 4 Days | Itinerary
Explore the Glimpse of Qatar in 4 Days | Itinerary

itinerary.title: Arrival in Doha with an Optional Dhow Cruise
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at the esteemed Hamad International Airport, renowned as one of the finest aviation hubs globally, you will be warmly greeted by a local representative who will be delighted to assist you with your transfer service. The journey from the airport to your hotel in Doha is expected to take no more than 30 minutes, thanks to the meticulous planning that characterises this city. Your hotel has been thoughtfully chosen for its prime location, ensuring your stay is conveniently situated in the heart of the city. After your arrival, check-in will be available from 1400 hours, allowing you to settle in and unwind at your own pace. The remainder of the day will be entirely at your leisure, affording you the opportunity to explore Doha at your own pace or simply unwind in the comforts of your hotel. You will spend the night at your chosen accommodation in Doha, commencing your journey in this captivating city.

itinerary.title: Doha - City Tour & Desert Safari
itinerary.description: Indulge in a comprehensive city tour of Doha, thoughtfully guided by a proficient English-speaking chauffeur. Explore the enchanting manmade residential island, The Pearl Qatar, whose architectural inspiration hails from the world's most captivating cities such as Venice. You’ll admire the opulent residential apartments, marina, premium shopping malls, and charming boulevards that grace this remarkable destination. Continue your journey with a visit to the Katara Cultural Village, an illustrious complex that is an embodiment of art, culture, and a picturesque beach promenade - an absolute essential when in Doha. Embark on a captivating drive through the bustling commercial hub of WestBay, proceeding towards the iconic Doha Corniche. Here, you will have the privilege of gazing upon the Museum of Islamic Art, an architectural masterpiece that graces the Corniche. Capture a memorable photograph of this iconic monument and consider a leisurely stroll in the adjacent MIA park, offering breathtaking sea views. In the afternoon, brace yourself for an exhilarating desert adventure among the mesmerising sand dunes. Get ready for an adrenaline-pumping experience as our skilled desert driver takes you on a thrilling ride, conquering the undulating dunes. As the day unfolds, you will retreat to the comfort of your hotel in Doha, where you can relish a peaceful night's rest.

itinerary.title: Doha - A Day of Leisure with Optional Mia Tour, Souq Waqif, and National Museum of Qatar
itinerary.description: Today grants you the opportunity to explore the city at your own pace, affording you the freedom to embark on a personal voyage of discovery. For those seeking a deeper cultural immersion, consider the optional Museum of Islamic Art (MIA) Tour, an insightful two-hour experience. The MIA, with its striking cubistic pyramid structure, majestically emerges from the creamy turquoise waters of the Persian Gulf. Here, visitors can marvel at the harmonious coexistence of a puritanical Islamic absolute monarchy, deeply rooted in tradition, while simultaneously embracing the tenets of modernity, evolving into a prominent Middle Eastern entity. Should you yearn for a leisurely maritime encounter, the optional Dhow Cruise with a corniche stroll awaits, also spanning a delightful two-hour duration. The dhow, once a venerable wooden sailing vessel used by merchants, has now been upgraded with contemporary amenities to ensure the utmost comfort for its passengers. As the sun approaches the horizon in Doha, the hour beckons for a traditional Qatari sailing boat, the "dhow," to grace the teal waters of the Arabian Gulf. These vessels, once the vessels of choice for merchants and fishermen, provide an enchanting sunset cruise, an ode to Qatar's maritime history. For those with an inclination towards exploring the rich tapestry of Qatar's heritage, the optional Heritage Market Tour – Souq Waqif Tour is a captivating choice, requiring two hours of your time. Souq Waqif, meaning the "standing market," is a vibrant testament to history. Within its labyrinthine streets, one can discover the Falcon Souq, Spice Souq, Pet Souq, Gold Souq, Handicraft Souq, and Art Gallery, each highlighting a unique facet of traditional commerce. Bedouins and locals, across generations, would gather on either side of the river to barter an array of goods, from fragrant spices to sturdy timber. Alternatively, the optional National Museum of Qatar, also a two-hour excursion, provides a window into the nation's compelling narrative, spanning from its earliest origins to the contemporary era, and projecting towards a promising future. The museum's narrative unfolds across three distinctive "chapters" — Beginnings, Life in Qatar, and The Modern History of Qatar, each conveyed through eleven distinct galleries. This singular edifice harmoniously integrates with the painstakingly restored Palace of Sheikh Abdullah bin Jassim Al-Thani, yielding a truly unique cultural experience. Following a day filled with exploration, your evening shall be spent in repose at your hotel in Doha. Tour Schedule – Afternoon Sun, Mon, Wed, Thu & Sat.

itinerary.title: Departure from Doha
itinerary.description: Relish a sumptuous breakfast at your hotel. Standard check-out is set at 12:00, though the possibility of a late check-out hinges upon availability and incurs additional charges. At the appointed time, your driver shall extend a warm welcome and ensure your smooth transfer to the airport.

packages.name: Stunning Sri Lanka
packages.destination: Duration : 3 Nights / 4 Days Destinations : Sri Lanka - Bentota - Kandy - Colombo

itinerary.title: Arrive In Sri Lanka
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at the Colombo International Airport, our tour manager will welcome you and help you transfer to the hotel. Check into your hotel and spend some time relaxing. Later, head to Bentota to enjoy some adventure activities, including banana boat rides, tube rides, and jet skiing. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Bentota.

itinerary.title: Bentota – Madu River – Kosgoda Turtle Hatchery
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a delectable breakfast of Sri Lankan cuisine, including string hoppers, hoppers, and coconut roti. Later, head out to Madu Ganga, the second-biggest wetland in Sri Lanka. The river covers over 150 acres of land and includes 14 of the 24 mangrove species in Sri Lanka. The mangroves are home to over 300 plant and 250 animal species. Tourists visit the mangrove to enjoy bird watching and boat rides and explore Cinnamon Island. The island is also famous for its ancient Buddhist temple in Koth Duwa. Later, proceed to the Kosgoda Sea Turtle Conservation Centre, which was started in 1981 to conserve sea turtles and protect them from poachers and predators like birds and dogs. You can join the volunteers as they feed and care for baby and injured adult turtles. Return to the hotel to spend the night in Bentota.

itinerary.title: Bentota – Colombo City Tour
itinerary.description: Today, after breakfast, you will check out of the hotel and head to Colombo. You will check into your hotel and spend some time relaxing. Later, you will tour Colombo City, exploring attractions like Gangaramaya Temple, Independence Square, Kelaniya Raja Mahal Viharaya, Dehiwala Zoological Gardens, and Beira Lake. Don’t miss the street markets where you shop for spices, tea, gems, elephant and Buddha figurines, porcelain tableware, and batik wear. Spend the night in Colombo.

itinerary.title: Depart Colombo
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel and bid adieu to Sri Lanka as you wrap up your Sri Lanka package trip.

packages.name: Travel Itinerary | Rio De Janeiro and Iguazu in 6 Days

images.alt_text: Travel Itinerary | Rio De Janeiro and Iguazu in 6 Days
Travel Itinerary | Rio De Janeiro and Iguazu in 6 Days

itinerary.title: Arrival in Rio de Janeiro
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Rio Airport, our local guide will escort you to your hotel. Rio de Janeiro, once the capital of the Portuguese empire and the nation until 1960, is affectionately known as "The Marvelous City." This world-famous destination is celebrated for its awe-inspiring landscapes, nestled amidst verdant, towering mountains and crystal-clear seas. Rio stands as one of Brazil's most culturally and economically significant cities, showcasing iconic landmarks like the Pão de Açúcar, the Corcovado, and the stunning Copacabana and Ipanema beaches. The city pulsates with vibrant energy, and its people, known as Cariocas, exude a carefree spirit and undeniable charm. Whether you're eager to immerse yourself in the Carnival festivities, unwind in natural surroundings, or revel in the luxuries of a cosmopolitan hub, Rio de Janeiro offers an all-encompassing experience. Your first night will be spent at your hotel in Rio De Janeiro.

itinerary.title: Rio de Janeiro
itinerary.description: On this beautiful day in Rio, start with a delightful breakfast at your hotel. Afterward, hop on an exciting Sugar Loaf Excursion. The tour commences with a panoramic view of the city, taking you through downtown Rio. Along the way, you'll pass by remarkable landmarks such as the Maracana Stadium, the Sambodrome, and the awe-inspiring Metropolitan Cathedral, shaped like a pyramid, with a colossal internal diameter of 96 meters and a towering height of 80 meters. Discover the charm of the historic Cinelandia square, adorned with its classical buildings, including the Municipal Theater, the National Library, and the National Museum of Fine Arts. Then, journey to the iconic Pao de Açúcar, a symbol of Rio de Janeiro, accessible via a thrilling two-stage ride on glass cable-cars. In the afternoon, you will explore the picturesque Corcovado Mountain and its breathtaking beaches. As the day comes to a close, return to your hotel in Rio de Janeiro for a restful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Rio de Janeiro
itinerary.description: On this beautiful morning, you set out after a delicious breakfast to explore the captivating Guanabara Bay. Encircled by majestic mountains and pristine beaches, Guanabara Bay boasts a rich tapestry of history. As you embark on your cruise, you will glide past numerous enchanting islands, including Ilha de Villegaignon, Ilha Fiscal, Ilha das Cobras, and Ilha das Enxadas, to name a few. The cruise also affords you spectacular views of the bustling Docks and the iconic Rio-Niteroi Bridge. On the far side of the bay, the Niteroi coastline beckons with a host of alluring attractions. Among these, you'll find the picturesque Gragoata beach and Fort, the Museum of Contemporary Art, and the pristine shores of Flechas, Icarai, Sao Francisco, Charitas, Jurujuba, and Adao e Eva. Marvel at the grandeur of Pedra Itapuca and Pedra do Índio, and don't miss the historic Santa Cruz Fortress. The return journey treats you to captivating sights, including the Laje and São Pedro Fort, as well as the inviting beaches of Flamengo and Botafogo. After a day of exploring, you will return to your comfortable hotel in Rio de Janeiro for a restful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Rio de Janeiro to Iguazu
itinerary.description: This morning, you will head to Rio de Janeiro Airport for your flight to Iguassu. Upon arrival in Iguassu, you'll be transferred to your hotel, where you can settle in and prepare for an exciting day of exploration. Your adventure begins with a visit to the Brazilian Falls, located in the Brazilian Park. This park boasts new and modern facilities that enhance the overall experience. As you arrive at the Visitor's Center, you'll hop onto the panoramic buses, which mark the start of your journey through the park. From there, you'll descend and commence your walk along the winding paths. The first balcony treats you to a breathtaking panoramic view of the magnificent Argentinean Falls. You will then go on a 950-meter walk, which offers stunning vistas of the Iguazu River, leading you to the Brazilian side of the falls. The highlight of your walk will be the pathway that brings you right next to the Floriano Falls. Here, visitors can savour a refreshing sensation and take in a magnificent panoramic view of the lower Iguazu River and the awe-inspiring Devil's Gorge Canyon. After your adventure, an elevator and a set of stairs will guide you to the shopping and restaurant area upstairs. You will spend the night at your hotel in Iguazu, enjoying the comfort and relaxation it offers.

itinerary.title: Iguazu
itinerary.description: On this fifth day, you will start your day with a hearty breakfast. Your adventure today takes you to the Argentinean Side of the Falls. This tour has been enhanced with the introduction of new facilities for the Upper, Lower, and the Devil's Throat Circuits. Your journey begins at the New Visitors Center, where you can explore the Nature's Interpretation Center. From here, you have the option to board a train, which will transport you to Cataratas Station in just about 8 minutes. Alternatively, you can take a short stroll along the "Green Trail" leading to the starting point of the Upper and Lower trails. The UPPER CIRCUIT offers a unique perspective as it spans 800 meters of catwalks, suspended above the jungle's floor to safeguard the wildlife's natural paths. This circuit allows you to witness the falls from above, providing breathtaking panoramic views. The LOWER CIRCUIT, with its 1,600 meters of elevated catwalks, offers a view from below and around the falls. Here, you can immerse yourself in the natural surroundings, experiencing the grandeur of the falls up close. Our journey to the DEVIL'S GORGE commences at Cataratas Station. After an 18-minute train ride, you'll embark on a walk along catwalks that stretch over 1,200 meters above the islands. This leads you to the most awe-inspiring vantage point: the Devil's Throat. After a day of exploration, you'll return to your hotel in Iguazu for the night.

itinerary.title: Depart – Iguazu
itinerary.description: Today, following a satisfying breakfast, we'll arrange for your transfer to Iguazu Airport. From there, you can board a flight to your next destination or back to your hometown, carrying with you cherished memories that will last a lifetime.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Bentota
itinerary.description: Upon arriving at the Colombo International Airport, our tour manager will welcome you and assist you to transfer to Bentota, famous for its calm waters and golden sandy shores. Check into the hotel and spend the rest of the relaxing or exploring places around your neighbourhood. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Bentota.

itinerary.title: Bentota Full Day Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast, you will head out for a city tour. Did you know Bentota is home to Cinnamon Bentota Beach, Sri Lanka’s first resort hotel? The coastal town is famous for its water sport activities like banana boat riding, motor boating, windsurfing, and jet skiing. You will also visit some of the Bentota’s iconic attractions like the turtle farm, boat trip on the Bentota River, Kande Vihara temple, and the Bentota Beach. Spend the rest of the day exploring places around your hotel.

itinerary.title: Bentota – Colombo
itinerary.description: Today, you will explore the markets of Bentota and proceed to Colombo. The journey takes around 2 hours and is beautiful. You will explore Sri Lanka’s capital city, including top attractions like Sea Street in Pettah, the Bazaar Street, the Dutch Church of Wolfendhal, and the Dawatagaha Mosque. Don’t miss the BIMCH centre to see the replica of Avukana Buddha. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Colombo.

itinerary.title: Colombo
itinerary.description: Bid adieu to the city and head to the Colombo airport to catch your return flight home.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Hanoi and City Tour
itinerary.description: When you arrive at the airport, finish your arrival paperwork, and then you'll be taken to the hotel. Check-in at the hotel. In the evening, you will go on a city tour starting from the Temple of Literature, which is the first university in Vietnam. After that, you will head to Ba Dinh Square, the biggest square in Hanoi, where major cultural and political events take place. You can take photos of the Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum from the outside. Later, you will get a good look at the capital by taking a "cyclo" ride, starting from the Old Quarter of Hanoi and stopping at Ngoc Son Temple by Hoan Kiem Lake (also known as the "Sword" Lake). Tonight, you'll stay overnight at the hotel in Hanoi.

itinerary.title: Hanoi to Halong Bay
itinerary.description: Today, after a splendid breakfast, you will leave the hotel and head to Halong Bay, a special place recognized by UNESCO as a Natural World Heritage site in 1994 and 2006. The journey will take you through the Red River delta, where you will see green fields and villages with hardworking farmers busy with their farming tasks or planting seedlings. When you reach Halong, you will get on a large boat to cruise through the bay and discover its breathtaking beauty. The bay is famous for its thousands of unique limestone rocks and small island caves, giving it the nickname "Descending-dragon bay." After lunch, you will visit the Surprising Grotto, and you'll have the option to swim or kayak (at an additional cost). You will pass by floating villages and get close to small islands to appreciate their beauty. In the evening, you can join activities on the boat or simply relax. You will spend the night on board. (Dinner included)

itinerary.title: Halong Bay to Hanoi
itinerary.description: After having breakfast today, you will take a boat trip to Luon Cave, which is like a pool inside an island in Halong Bay. It's a peaceful place with beautiful scenery and green water. On your way back to the Halong Wharf, you will pass through an area with many islands, each with interesting names like Cock-Fighting Rock, Sail Island, Incense Burner Rock, and Sea Dog Rock. Then, you will head to the hotel for check-in. You will have the evening free to relax. Your overnight stay will be at a hotel in Hanoi. (Lunch included)

itinerary.title: Leaving Hanoi
itinerary.description: This morning, after breakfast, we will take you to the airport for your flight back home or to your next destination.

packages.name: Exploring the Beauty and Richness of South America
packages.destination: Buenos Aires - Ushuaia - El Calafate - Bariloche - Puerto Varas - Santiago

images.alt_text: Exploring the Beauty and Richness of South America
Exploring the Beauty and Richness of South America

itinerary.title: Arrival in Buenos Aires
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Buenos Aires Airport, you will be transferred to your hotel. Buenos Aires is a captivating and vibrant port city that extends from south to north along the Rio de la Plata. It has served as Argentina's gateway for centuries. The residents, known as Porteños, take great pride in their intricate and culturally rich identity, cherishing their European heritage. The lifestyle and architecture in Buenos Aires bear a distinct European influence, setting it apart from other South American cities. In the evening, you will enjoy a Tango Show and Dinner at the splendid Tango Porteño. Your overnight stay will be at the hotel in Buenos Aires.

itinerary.title: Buenos Aires
itinerary.description: On this fine morning, embark on a captivating City Tour of Buenos Aires. This delightful excursion invites you to uncover the charm of Buenos Aires, often hailed as the "Queen of the Silver." The journey commences at the heart of the city, where you'll encounter its most captivating landmarks: Av. 9 de Julio, the Colón Theatre, and the iconic Obelisk, widely regarded as the symbol of Buenos Aires. As our exploration unfolds, we'll venture towards Plaza de Mayo and subsequently traverse the southern parts of the city, meandering through the enchanting district of San Telmo, with its enchanting tango venues, La Boca, and the vibrant streets of Caminito. Your path will lead you to Puerto Madero, the rejuvenated port district that has become a hub of gastronomic excellence. We will also pay a visit to the largest green expanse in Buenos Aires, Palermo, with its beautiful parks and distinguished edifices. Finally, your journey will take you to Recoleta, a neighbourhood where culture and sophistication coexist harmoniously. On Sunday, your tour culminates with a visit to the captivating Flea Market of San Telmo. You will spend the night at the hotel in Buenos Aires.

itinerary.title: Buenos Aires to Ushuaia
itinerary.description: Today, you will hop on a flight from El Calafate Airport to the charming city of Ushuaia. Nestled in the southernmost reaches of the Republic of Argentina, on the Isla Grande de Tierra del Fuego, Ushuaia proudly claims its title as the southernmost city in the world. Situated along the stunning Beagle Channel, its name, derived from the yamana language, signifies "bay overlooking the West." Set against the breathtaking backdrop of the sea, lush forests, serene lakes, and majestic mountains, Ushuaia reveals itself as a picturesque city. It boasts a well-established infrastructure for tourists, an elegant commercial hub, and a growing hub of social and cultural activities. Relax and get a good night's sleep at Ushuaia hotel.

itinerary.title: Ushuaia
itinerary.description: This morning, embark on a captivating Half Day Tierra del Fuego National Park Tour, which includes a ride on the Train of the End of the World. Today, this historic train ride offers an engaging glimpse into the rich history of Ushuaia. Known as the "Corner of the Earth," this national park, situated just 12 kilometers from Ushuaia, holds the distinction of being the sole national park in the country with a coastline along the ocean. Encompassing a vast expanse of 63,000 hectares, it safeguards a plethora of native trees, including nires, lengas, cherry trees, calafates, and a variety of vibrant flowers like violets and orchids. In the afternoon, prepare for an enchanting Beagle Channel Navigation excursion, including a visit to Seals Island. At the designated time, you will be transferred to the port to board a comfortable catamaran, setting sail across the waters of the Beagle Channel, where the Atlantic and Pacific Oceans converge. This unique location serves as a sanctuary for an array of sea mammals and birds, providing a remarkable opportunity to observe them in their natural habitat without causing any disruption to their daily routines. Conclude your day with an overnight stay at the hotel in Ushuaia.

itinerary.title: Ushuaia to El Calafate
itinerary.description: On this day, you'll bid farewell to your hotel in Ushuaia and head to the airport for your flight to El Calafate. Upon arrival in El Calafate, you'll be warmly welcomed and transported to your hotel. After checking in, the remainder of the day is yours to enjoy at your leisure. You'll spend the night at your hotel in El Calafate.

itinerary.title: Exploring El Calafate
itinerary.description: Today, you will embark on a full-day excursion to the awe-inspiring Perito Moreno Glacier. As you journey towards this natural wonder, you'll be mesmerised by the splendid beauty of nature. Leaving El Calafate, you'll follow the southern shoreline of the Argentine Lake, traversing 90 kilometers to reach the pathways leading to the glacier. The Perito Moreno Glacier is a remarkable 30,000 years old, covering a vast 192 square kilometers with a towering front wall that stretches over 5 kilometers and some peaks soaring to heights of 80 meters. The deep blue base of the glacier rivals the surrounding waters in its rich hue, and the profound silence is occasionally broken by the thunderous cracking and falling of colossal ice fragments, which drift on the Icebergs Channel. For a closer encounter with the grandeur of the Perito Moreno Glacier, you can partake in the Nautical Safari excursion. This adventure commences at Bajo de las Sombras Port, situated 6 kilometers from the Glacier Vantage Point. Visitors board a vessel to sail across Rico Lake, eventually anchoring at a safe distance from the glacier's immense wall. Here, during the Safari Nautico excursion, you'll have the remarkable opportunity to witness the glacier's towering walls and the icebergs constantly calving from it into Rico Lake. You'll return to your hotel in El Calafate for the night.

itinerary.title: El Calafate to Bariloche
itinerary.description: Begin your day by checking out from your hotel in El Calafate and heading to the airport for your flight to the picturesque city of Bariloche. Upon your arrival in Bariloche, you will be gracefully escorted to your hotel. After checking in, the remainder of the day is yours to enjoy at your leisure. Spend a comfortable night at your chosen hotel in Bariloche.

itinerary.title: Bariloche Exploration
itinerary.description: Embark on an adventure today as you indulge in a delightful breakfast before setting out on a guided tour of the charming city of Bariloche. Your journey commences along the scenic Ezequiel Bustillo Avenue, a meandering paved road hugging the serene shores of Lake Nahuel Huapi. Along the way, you will be treated to stunning vistas of Nahuel Huapi and Moreno Lakes, El Trebol Lagoon, San Pedro and Llao Llao Peninsulas, Victoria Island, Otto, Lopez, Goye, and Catedral Hills, all while passing through the charming town of San Carlos de Bariloche. As you continue your exploration, you will traverse a verdant golf course, cross the bridge connecting Nahuel Huapi Lake with Moreno Lake over the Angostura River, and journey along the shores of López Bay nestled at the base of López Hill. Your adventure culminates at Panoramic Point, a lookout offering a breathtaking panorama of Moreno Lake and the enchanting Llao Llao Peninsula. After a day filled with enchantment, you can relax and unwind at your hotel in Bariloche

itinerary.title: Bariloche to Puerto Varas
itinerary.description: Today, embark on a captivating journey from Bariloche to Chile, traversing the majestic Andes Mountains. Early in the morning, you will depart from the enchanting city of San Carlos de Bariloche, setting your course towards the Cardenal Samore International Pass. Beyond these formidable peaks, the welcoming cities of Osorno, Frutillar, Puerto Varas, and Puerto Montt await your arrival. This pass holds the distinction of being the second most significant international route, facilitating direct connections to Osorno and Puerto Montt via the Southern Road, and forging a link to the wider expanse of Chilean Patagonia. Your voyage will commence by passing through the Argentinean Customs Office and the National Gendarmerie. Gradually, you will encounter signposts guiding you towards the renowned Puyehue hot springs, the imposing Antillanca Volcano with its skiing haven, and the remaining kilometers leading to Osorno, where the bus will make its initial official stop. After a brief respite, the bus will resume its journey to Puerto Varas, which lies just an hour away and marks your final destination for the day. You will spend the night at a hotel in the picturesque Puerto Varas

itinerary.title: Puerto Varas
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delightful Half Day Excursion to Frutillar. This enchanting journey along the shores of Llanquihue Lake, Chile's second-largest lake, will lead you to the picturesque town of Frutillar, all the while treating you to stunning vistas of the majestic Osorno, Calbuco, Puntiagudo, and Tronador volcanoes. As you explore this charming village, which proudly showcases its German architectural heritage from the 19th century, you'll feel transported back in time. Take in the breathtaking sights of the Osorno, Calbuco, Puntiagudo, and Tronador volcanoes and visit the Teatro del Lago. Your overnight stay awaits at the hotel in Puerto Varas.

itinerary.title: Puerto Varas to Santiago
itinerary.description: Today, you will bid farewell to your hotel in Puerto Varas and make your way to Puerto Montt Airport for your flight to Santiago. Upon arriving in Santiago, you will be transferred to your hotel. Santiago serves as the vibrant heart of a region brimming with captivating attractions and activities. Just to the south of the city, you'll discover the lush and picturesque vineyards of the Maipo Valley, a region renowned for producing some of the world's finest wines. This afternoon, you will have the pleasure of embarking on a city tour of Santiago. Your journey commences in the downtown area, commencing from the iconic Bernardo O'Higgins Avenue, the city's principal thoroughfare. You will visit La Moneda presidential palace and then take a leisurely stroll through the pedestrian-friendly streets of Ahumada and Huerfanos. A walk will lead you to the "Plaza de Armas," an enchanting square adorned with the cathedral and several other historic edifices. Next, you will ascend San Cristobal hill to revel in a panoramic view of the city, and then you will proceed to explore other captivating areas of interest, such as Bellavista, a hub of cultural and artistic activity, as well as the modern residential districts of Las Condes and Providencia. You will conclude the day with an overnight stay at your hotel in Santiago.

itinerary.title: Santiago
itinerary.description: Today, embark on a captivating full-day journey to the charming coastal towns of Vina del Mar and Valparaiso from Santiago. Your morning will begin with a departure from Santiago, venturing towards the picturesque coast. Your first stop will be in Pomaire, a quaint village where skilled artisans craft various ceramic dishes, pots, and intriguing sculptures from the local clay, among other handcrafted treasures. As you continue your excursion towards the coast, revel in the beauty of the Renaca beach area and explore the delightful town of Vina del Mar, renowned as the "Garden City" for its exquisite parks and streets adorned with vibrant flowers. In the afternoon, your voyage will lead you to the captivating port of Valparaiso, a city founded in the 16th century, nestled on 43 hills accessible via winding alleys, staircases, and a network of elevators (funiculars). Valparaiso's eclectic architecture and urban development have earned it UNESCO recognition as a part of humanity's cultural heritage. Conclude the day with an overnight stay at your Santiago hotel.

itinerary.title: Depart from Santiago
itinerary.description: After enjoying a hearty breakfast, you will be escorted to the airport for your departure. Whether you are starting on your next exciting destination or heading back to your hometown, you'll carry with you a treasure trove of cherished memories that will last a lifetime.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Sri Lanka
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at the Colombo International Airport, our tour representative will welcome and guide you to the hotel. After a well-deserved rest, proceed to the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage, where you can spend time with abandoned elephants. The orphanage was started in 1975 to care for wounded and abandoned elephants. You can work with local volunteers feeding and bathing the elephants. Check into a luxury hotel in Dambulla to spend the night in the city.

itinerary.title: Dambulla – Sigiriya
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head to explore Sigiriya, one of Sri Lanka’s most iconic monuments, often called the Eight Wonders of the World. Tourists visit the place to explore the Sigiriya Fortress, built by King Kashyapa during the 5th century. The fortress is built on a monolithic rock–visitors must climb 1200 steps to reach the citadel. Besides exploring the fortress and its gardens, tourists also visit the museum to learn more about artefacts and videos related to Sigiriya. The frescoes of life-sized damsels, still preserved at the fort, are equally famous. After exploring Sigiriya, return to Dambulla. Spend the night in Dambulla.

itinerary.title: Dambulla – Kandy
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of your hotel and head to Kandy. On the way, visit the National Spice Gardens in Matale to see the different spices and learn about their culinary and medicinal uses. You can sign up for Ayurvedic treatments, purchase spices, and even join a culinary lesson to learn more about spices and their uses. Some other places you will visit in and around Kandy include Upper Lake Drive, Gem Museum, Market Square, and the most famous of all, the Temple of Tooth Relic. If you’re lucky, you could experience the Kandy Perahara firsthand. This annual 9-day festival culminates in a parade where the tooth relic of Buddha is carried on an elephant in a procession along with cultural dance and song. Spend the night in Kandy.

itinerary.title: Kandy
itinerary.description: Today, you will explore places in and around Kandy. This includes the Royal Botanical Gardens, the Kandy Lake, the Bahirawakanda Temple, and the Ceylon Tea Museum. The Royal Botanical Garden was established in 1821 and includes over 147 acres of plants, including orchids, spices, medicinal plants, and palm trees. The garden was believed to have been established since 1371 when King Wickramaabahu III.

itinerary.title: Kandy – Bentota
itinerary.description: Today, after breakfast, head to Bentota. You can either visit directly or stop at Kithulgala, a small town famous for its water sports activities, including whitewater rafting and abseiling. Some of the other attractions in Kithugala include Belilena Caves and Handun Ella. The Belilena Cave is a famous cave believed to have been inhabited over 32,000 years ago, while Handun Ella is famous for its waterfalls. The place gets its name from the Handun or sandalwood trees that grow abundantly around it.

itinerary.title: Bentota
itinerary.description: Today, you can spend the day leisurely exploring places around the town or opt for a ride on the Madu River in the 915-hectare Madu Ganga Estuary. The wetland covers 64 islands, including Madagaga, the third Ramsar Wetland. Another popular attraction in Madu Ganga is the Kokaduwa Vihariya. The main treasure of Madu Ganga is the mangroves that protect various plant and animal life, including crocodiles, crabs, and various fish. You can also visit the Marine Turtle Conservation in Kosgoda, which houses endangered marine turtle species. There, you can observe the turtles nesting and hatchlings being born. Spend the night in Bentota.

itinerary.title: Depart Bentota
itinerary.description: Bid adieu to Sri Lanka as you check out of the hotel and head to the Colombo International Airport to catch your return flight home.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Saigon
itinerary.description: Welcome to Saigon, which is now called Ho Chi Minh City – a lively and bustling place in Vietnam. When you arrive at the airport, we'll take you to your hotel. Once you're checked in, you will set off on an evening city tour. You will visit the Reunification Palace, where you can learn about the Vietnam War that ended in 1975. Next, you will see the Central Post Office, a beautiful building with a colonial style that's an important part of the city. Then, you will take a walk along Nguyen Hue street to snap some photos of the Opera House and the Ho Chi Minh Committee (from the outside). Finally, you will stroll to Ben Thanh Market, a famous spot in Saigon. It's a wonderful place to see how locals live their daily lives and do some shopping for handmade goods. After the tour, you will spend the night at the hotel in Saigon.

itinerary.title: Saigon - Mekong Delta - Saigon
itinerary.description: Today, you will be heading to the Mekong Delta. When you get there, you will hop on a boat and cruise along the mighty Mekong River. This will give us a chance to see how local people live along the riverbanks. You will make a stop at one of the four islands. Here, you will take small boats rowed by local folks through narrow canals surrounded by water coconut trees. You will visit local factories and then take a peaceful horse-cart ride through the village. In the evening, you will return to Saigon with a stop at Vinh Trang Pagoda. This pagoda is famous for its unique architecture, which combines Chinese, Cambodian, and French influences. You will spend the night at the hotel in Saigon.

itinerary.title: Saigon - Cu Chi Tunnels
itinerary.description: After you have your breakfast today, you will be heading to the Cu Chi Tunnels. You will get a chance to crawl through some of the tunnels underground for a real experience. You will then return to Saigon and drop you off at your hotel. In the evening, you will have free time for shopping in downtown Saigon. There are many great places where you can find lovely stuff at reasonable prices. Some places to check out during your shopping adventure include Ben Thanh Market (the centre and typical market of Saigon), Saigon Square (a few minutes' walk from Ben Thanh Market), An Dong Plaza and its nearby Market, or Diamond Plaza if you're looking for high-quality and brand name goods. Tonight, you'll stay at the hotel in Saigon.

itinerary.title: Depart Saigon
itinerary.description: This morning, after breakfast, we will take you to the airport for your flight back home or to your next destination.

packages.name: Roam Beautiful Reunion Island Free and Easy

images.alt_text: Roam Beautiful Reunion Island Free and Easy
Roam Beautiful Reunion Island Free and Easy

itinerary.title: Arrival at Roland Garros Airport in Sainte Marie
itinerary.description: Welcome to Roland Garros Airport! As you step off the plane, our friendly representative will be there to greet you. They'll provide you with all the essential documents you'll need for your stay, including vouchers, maps, and a handy travel guide. From the airport, you'll be whisked away to your chosen accommodation in a comfortable, air-conditioned vehicle. Once you're settled in, the rest of the day is yours to relax and recover. You'll be spending the night at a lovely hotel in Sainte Marie.

itinerary.title: Sainte Marie – Salazie - Sainte Marie
itinerary.description: On this exciting morning, you will be off to explore the vibrant and unique Indian temples with their captivating architecture. Prepare to have your senses awakened in a truly delightful way. The day's agenda includes a visit to Mr. Rouloff's vanilla plantations, where you'll discover the secrets behind the aromatic pods, the craftsmanship involved in preparing these exquisite pods, and the creation of delightful balms that will enchant your senses. As you venture on, the journey to Salazie presents a series of breathtaking landscapes where lush greenery is all around you. Expect to encounter a myriad of natural wonders, including a profusion of plant species, countless waterfalls, and a kaleidoscope of flowers adorning the paths all the way to the mountaintop. The village, dedicated to the governor of Hell, is a living museum of Creole architecture with its distinctive acute ridgepoles. After a day filled with these mesmerising experiences, you will return to your hotel in Sainte Marie for a well-deserved rest. You'll be spending another peaceful night at your charming accommodation.

itinerary.title: Enjoying Sainte Marie at Your Own Pace
itinerary.description: Today, you have the entire day to leisurely explore the charming island of Sainte Marie on your own. Take your time to discover the local wonders and enjoy the tranquil surroundings. You'll be spending the night at the hotel in Sainte Marie, where dinner is included.

itinerary.title: Departure from Sainte Marie
itinerary.description: Enjoy your breakfast and it will be time to bid farewell to the picturesque Sainte Marie. You'll be transferred to the airport for your journey back home or onward adventures.

packages.name: Splendid Vietnam and Cambodia | 5 Days Itinerary

images.alt_text: Splendid Vietnam and Cambodia | 5 Days Itinerary
Splendid Vietnam and Cambodia | 5 Days Itinerary

itinerary.title: Arrival in Hanoi and City Tour
itinerary.description: When you arrive at the airport, finish your airport paperwork, and then we'll take you to the hotel. Check-in at the hotel. In the evening, you will go on a city tour. You will start at the Temple of Literature, which is the first university in Vietnam. After that, you will go to Ba Dinh Square, the biggest square in Hanoi. This is where important cultural and political events take place. You can take photos of the Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum from the outside. Next, you will get a broad view of the capital city by taking a "cyclo" ride. This fun ride will take you around the Old Quarter of Hanoi, and you will stop at Ngoc Son Temple by the Hoan Kiem Lake, also known as the "Sword" Lake. You will spend the night at the hotel in Hanoi.

itinerary.title: Hanoi to Halong and Back
itinerary.description: After a tasty breakfast, you will head to the charming villages where Vietnamese people grow rice. These villages are part of the Red River Delta, and you will get a glimpse of everyday life there. Your destination is Halong Bay, a place recognized as a Natural World Heritage site by UNESCO since 1994 and 2006. When you reach Halong, you will go to the pier and hop on a lovely traditional wooden boat for a cruise through the bay. During the cruise, you will see interesting rock formations like Stone Dog, Incense Burner (Dinh Huong), and Fighting Cock (Ga Choi). While on the boat, you will have a tasty lunch with seafood. In the heart of one of the small islands, there is a fascinating cave called Thien Cung (Heavenly Residence Grotto). You can explore the cave or just enjoy the boat ride. After about 4 hours of cruising and exploring the bay, you will return to Halong pier and then head back to Hanoi. At night, you will be staying at a hotel in Hanoi.

itinerary.title: Explore Hanoi and Fly to Siem Reap
itinerary.description: After having breakfast, check out from the hotel. Your first stop will be the Ho Chi Minh Complex, which includes Ba Dinh Square, Ho Chi Minh’s Mausoleum, and his private residence from 1954 to 1969. The wooden house, built on stilts in an ethnic minority style, is surrounded by peaceful gardens. In the same area, you will see the One Pillar Pagoda, a significant symbol for the people of Hanoi, founded by King Ly Thai To in 1049. Next, you will visit Tran Quoc Pagoda, the oldest pagoda in Hanoi, with a history of over 1,500 years. After a short walk, you will explore Hanoi Flag Tower and Thang Long Citadel, recognized as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2010, providing insight into Vietnam's history. In the afternoon, you will head to the airport for your flight to Siem Reap. Upon arrival, our representative will pick you up from the airport and take you to the hotel for check-in. The rest of the day is free for you to relax. Overnight at the hotel in Siem Reap.

itinerary.title: Full Day Angkor Tour
itinerary.description: In the morning, after a tasty breakfast, you will check out the South Gate of Angkor Thom, also known as Big Angkor. This place used to be the royal city and was the last capital of the Angkor Empire. You will explore the famous Bayon Temple, which looks a bit mixed up because it was built in various parts over more than a century. Next, you will see the Terrace of the Elephants, a long wall with carved elephants in front of Baphuon, a huge temple mountain in the heart of Angkor Thom. You will also visit the Royal Palace Area, Phimeanakas (an impressive sandstone pyramid), and the Terrace of the Leper King, which has carvings of mythical beings. Your last stop will be Ta Prohm temple, a fantastic mix of human craftsmanship and nature's beauty. In the afternoon, you will visit Angkor Wat temple, a wonder of the oriental world. It's like a replica of the universe according to Hindu mythology, with five towers, galleries, and stone images of celestial Apsara dancers. Tonight, you will stay at the hotel in Siem Reap.

itinerary.title: Depart Siem Reap
itinerary.description: This morning, after a delicious breakfast, you'll be taken to the airport for your flight back home or to your next destination.

packages.name: Exploring Wonderful Oman with Muscat & Nizwa | Itinerary
packages.destination: Muscat - Dolphin Watching - Wahiba - Nizwa - Jabal Akhdar

images.alt_text: Exploring Wonderful Oman with Muscat & Nizwa | Itinerary
Exploring Wonderful Oman with Muscat & Nizwa | Itinerary

itinerary.title: Arrival in Muscat
itinerary.description: Your journey begins as you touch down at Muscat International Airport. Once you've completed the necessary immigration procedures, collected your baggage, and cleared customs, head over to the arrival hall where your friendly chauffeur will be waiting to greet you. From there, you'll be transferred to your hotel in Muscat, where you'll be spending the night in comfort.

itinerary.title: Exploring Muscat's Wonders
itinerary.description: On the second day, your adventure kicks off with a visit to the splendid Grand Mosque, a true gem of Muscat. Please note that the Grand Mosque is not open on Fridays and other public holidays, so plan accordingly. This modern marvel, completed in 2001, seamlessly blends traditional craftsmanship with contemporary design. Prepare to be captivated by the intricate details, including the exquisite handmade carpets, dazzling chandeliers, and the breathtaking dome in the main prayer room. For visitors, both men and women, it's essential to dress respectfully. Ladies should ensure they are fully covered and carry a headscarf, while men are advised to wear trousers. Following this, we'll take a leisurely drive along the picturesque waterfront Corniche. Our next stop is the vibrant Muttrah Souq, where you can immerse yourself in the local colours and culture. Our journey continues with a photo stop at the magnificent Al Alam Palace, the official residence of His Majesty Sultan Qaboos. It is flanked by the historic Portuguese forts, Mirani and Jalali, dating back to the 16th century. This blend of old and new is a true testament to Oman's rich history and traditions. To gain more insight into Oman's history, we'll visit the Bait Al Zubair Museum, where you can explore fascinating exhibits. After a day of discovery, we'll return to your hotel in Muscat, where you can relax and recharge for the night.

itinerary.title: Dolphin Watching Adventure
itinerary.description: On this day, we'll take you away from your Muscat hotel to the Marina for an exciting marine expedition. We'll set sail on a boat in search of dolphins and whales. There's something truly exhilarating about beginning your day by observing wild dolphins in their natural habitat, and if you're particularly fortunate, you might even spot one of the many whale species that grace the waters just a stone's throw away from Muscat's rugged coastline.
