While we can't guarantee a dolphin or whale sighting on every trip, we can assure you that the journey itself is a memorable experience. It's an opportunity to enrich your understanding of these magnificent marine creatures. After our sea adventure, we'll head back to the Marina and return to your hotel. The rest of the day is yours to enjoy at your leisure. As the day turns to night, you'll settle in for another comfortable night at your Muscat hotel.

itinerary.title: Muscat to Wahiba Sands - A Desert Adventure
itinerary.description: On the fourth day of the journey, you will set out on a thrilling expedition to Wahiba Sands, a mesmerising desert landscape. You will enjoy this adventure in 4WD vehicles, offering a scenic and rugged coastal route that promises breathtaking views of the turquoise waters of the Gulf of Oman, complemented by pristine white beaches. Your journey will take you past the charming fishing village of Quriyat, and as you follow the path inland, keep your eyes peeled for the chance to spot flamingos and eagles near an enchanting stream. You will make a stop at the picturesque Wadi Arabayeen, where you'll find inviting pools of water nestled among the date palms, creating a captivating oasis. Next on our itinerary is the remarkable Bimah sinkhole, a natural limestone crater with stunning blue-green waters at the bottom. If we're fortunate enough to have clear, sunny weather, you might even spot sharks gliding through the deep blue ocean or graceful gazelles darting across the landscape as we drive along the coast. As you reach the coastal town of Sur, you will have the opportunity to visit a traditional dhow factory, immersing ourselves in the rich maritime heritage of the region. Continuing your journey, you will wind through mountainous terrain, treating us to breathtaking vistas of the ocean. Your adventure culminates as you arrive at the vast expanse of Wahiba Sands, a sea of red and white sand dunes that can reach impressive heights of up to 200 metres (about half the height of the Empire State Building). This pristine desert is not only a sight to behold but also home to a diverse range of flora and fauna. The ever-changing patterns of the dunes offer a paradise for photographers, and you'll get to experience the exhilarating sensation of riding a roller coaster as you traverse these sandy peaks. To round off the day, you will relish a delightful dinner and spend the night at the Arabian Oryx Camp, surrounded by the enchanting desert landscape.

itinerary.title: From Wahiba Sands to the Heights of Jabal Akhdar
itinerary.description: Start the day with a hearty breakfast at our camp in Wahiba Sands. This vast desert is not just a land of golden dunes; it's also home to the traditional Bedouin tribe, known for their warm hospitality and deep knowledge of the desert. Today, we have the unique opportunity to visit a Bedouin family in their traditional and humble habitat. Leaving behind the stark simplicity of the desert, our journey takes us to Wadi Bani Khalid. Nestled in the mountains, this wadi is dotted with charming, small villages, each offering a picturesque glimpse of Omani life. The wadi's crystal-clear, deep blue waters beckon us for a refreshing swim, so be sure to wear comfortable clothing and walking shoes. The next destination is Al Jebel Al Akhdar, which is renowned for its breathtaking fruit orchards, carefully cultivated in terraces along the mountain slopes. Natural springs and aflaj (irrigation systems) bless the region, making it a lush oasis in the rocky landscape. As we explore, we'll come across charming villages like Saiq, Wadi Bani Habib (the village of old houses), Village Roose, and Al Ain, each offering a unique glimpse into the local way of life. The villages perch on the mountain slopes, providing incredible vistas of dramatic peaks, deep gorges, and winding wadis. If you happen to visit Jabal Al Akhdar in March or April, you'll be treated to the fragrant bloom of the local roses, filling the air with their sweet scent. The villagers distil rose water in their homes, a tradition that has been passed down through generations. For this part of the journey, it's advisable to wear lightweight and comfortable clothing, along with sturdy walking shoes. We'll spend the night at the Sama Jabal Akhdar Hotel, surrounded by the beauty of the mountains. (B for Breakfast)

itinerary.title: Farewell to Jabal Akhdar - Journey to Nizwa and Muscat
itinerary.description: Start the day with a delightful breakfast and bid farewell to Jabal Akhdar and you will make your way to Nizwa, the historical capital of the interior and the birthplace of Islam in the Sultanate of Oman. Nizwa is known for its rich heritage, and the first stop here will be the iconic Round Tower Fort, built back in the 17th century. Although we won't enter, it's a great spot for a photo stop. The Nizwa Souq is another highlight, famous for its bustling Friday cattle auctions and its exquisite hand carved "Khanjars" (traditional daggers) and ornamental silver jewellery. After exploring Nizwa, we'll head to the Muscat International Airport, where our memorable journey comes to an end

packages.name: Highlight of Vietnam | 7 Days Itinerary
packages.destination: Hanoi - Tam Coc - Hoa Lu - Halong - Saigon - Mekong

itinerary.title: Arrival in Hanoi
itinerary.description: When you arrive at Hanoi International Airport, you will be taken to your hotel for check-in. After settling in, you will set off on a city tour. First, you will visit the Temple of Literature, which is the first university in Vietnam. Then, you will head to Ba Dinh Square, the largest square in Hanoi, where important cultural and political events take place. You can take photos of the Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum from the outside. Later, you will get a great view of the capital by taking a "cyclo" ride around the Old Quarter of Hanoi. Your journey will include a stop at Ngoc Son Temple, situated on the Hoan Kiem Lake (also known as the "Sword" Lake). At night, you will stay at the hotel in Hanoi.

itinerary.title: Hanoi - Tam Coc - Hoa Lu - Hanoi
itinerary.description: Start your day with breakfast. Today, you will head south of Hanoi to Ninh Binh, which used to be the capital of ancient Vietnam before Hanoi took over in the 11th century. This area is known for its beautiful landscapes, including Tam Coc Caves and the ancient capital of Hoa Lu, where there are old temples dedicated to King Dinh and King Le who ruled in the 10th century. Your visit to Ninh Binh begins with a boat trip in Tam Coc. Here, you will see impressive limestone karsts rising from the green paddy fields, similar to the landscapes in Guilin (China) and Halong Bay in Vietnam. That is why this place is often called "Halong-bay-on-land." Lunch is included in your day. Afterward, you will return to your hotel in Hanoi for the night.

itinerary.title: Hanoi to Halong
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delicious breakfast. Today, you will head to Halong Bay, a special place that has been considered a Natural World Heritage site by UNESCO since 1994. When you reach Halong, you will hop on a big boat to cruise through the bay and see its amazing beauty. The bay is famous for its unique limestone rocks and small island caves that look like a dragon coming down. During the cruise, you will have lunch on the boat, visit caves, and even have the chance to swim or kayak. You will pass by floating villages and get up close to small islands to appreciate their beauty. After all the activities, you will head back to the boat for dinner. In the evening, there will be some boat activities, or you can just relax on your own. Dinner is included, and you will spend the night on the boat.

itinerary.title: Halong – Hanoi – Saigon
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delicious breakfast. After that, you will head to Hanoi. On the way, you will pass by the Wharf of Halong, where you can see many interesting islands with names like Cock-Fighting Rock, Sail Island, Incense Burner Rock, and Sea Dog Rock. It's a scenic journey. You will return to Hanoi in the evening and then catch a flight to Saigon. When you arrive at the airport in Saigon, we will be there to welcome you. From the airport, we'll take you to the hotel for check-in. You will spend the night at the hotel in Saigon.

itinerary.title: Saigon – Mekong Delta – Saigon
itinerary.description: After you have breakfast, you will be heading to the Mekong Delta today. When you get there, you will hop on a boat and cruise along the big Mekong River. Your first stop is one of the four islands in the area, where you will take in the sights. Then, you will get on small boats rowed by local folks through the little canals. Here, you can try some honey tea, watch how the locals make coconut candy milk, and even give it a taste. You can also take a stroll in the garden where locals take care of honeybees. After that, you will take a peaceful horse-cart ride through the village. Lunch is included, and in the evening, you will head back to Saigon with a stop to visit Vinh Trang Pagoda. This pagoda is famous for its unique architecture, blending Chinese, Cambodian, and French styles. You will stay overnight at a hotel in Saigon.

itinerary.title: Saigon - Cu Chi Tunnels
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delicious breakfast. Today, you will explore the Cu Chi Tunnels, which are one of the few remaining reminders of the Vietnam War. You can even try crawling through the underground tunnels for an authentic experience. In the evening, return to Saigon and go shopping in the downtown area, where you will find many lovely items at reasonable prices. Some recommended places to visit for shopping include Ben Thanh Market (Saigon's main market), Saigon Square (a short walk from Ben Thanh Market), A Dong Plaza, and the nearby market, or Diamond Plaza if you are looking for high-quality and branded goods. Spend the night at the hotel in Saigon.

itinerary.title: Depart Saigon
itinerary.description: After another wonderful breakfast, you will be transferred to the airport for your flight back home or to your next destination.

itinerary.title: Arriving in Muscat - Your First Day
itinerary.description: Your journey begins as you touch down at Muscat International Airport. Once you've smoothly cleared immigration, collected your baggage, and passed through customs, make your way to the arrival hall. There, you'll be greeted by your chauffeur, who will be your guide throughout your trip. From the airport, you'll be transferred to your hotel in Muscat, where you'll be spending the night.

itinerary.title: A Half Day Exploring Muscat's Rich Heritage
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a hotel pickup and get ready to start off a captivating journey through Muscat, the heart of Oman. The first stop is the Grand Mosque, a true gem and a defining feature of Muscat. Please note that visits to the mosque are not possible on Fridays or other public holidays. This architectural marvel, completed in 2001, seamlessly blends modern design with the traditional craftsmanship that Oman is renowned for. The Grand Mosque is a photographer's dream, with its handcrafted carpets, stunning chandeliers, and the awe-inspiring main prayer room under the grand dome. It's an absolute must-see. A quick reminder: For our female visitors, please ensure that you are fully covered and carry a headscarf, and for the gentlemen, kindly don trousers. We'll then go for a scenic drive along the picturesque waterfront Corniche, taking in the vibrant sights of the Muttrah Souq, a bustling and colourful market that is a true sensory delight. Our journey continues with a photo stop at the magnificent Al Alam Palace, the official residence of His Majesty Sultan Qaboos, framed by the historic Portuguese forts Mirani and Jalali, dating back to the 16th century. Next, we'll visit the Bait Al Zubair Museum, offering a fascinating glimpse into Oman's rich history and heritage. The remainder of the day is yours to enjoy at your leisure. When evening falls, return to your hotel in Muscat for a peaceful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Dolphin and Whale Watching Adventure
itinerary.description: On this exciting day, we'll arrange your transfer from your Muscat hotel to the Marina, where a captivating maritime adventure awaits. Our destination: the open seas, as we go on a boat to search for the most delightful marine creatures, dolphins, and the majestic whales. Watching these wild dolphins frolic in their natural habitat is a breathtaking way to kickstart your day. If luck is on your side, you might even be treated to a sighting of one of the various whale species that inhabit the waters just a stone's throw away from Muscat's rugged coastline. While we can't promise you'll see them all, the journey itself is bound to be an enriching experience that will deepen your understanding of these captivating marine mammals. After the sea-bound escapade, you will return to the Marina and then head back to your hotel. The rest of the day is yours to enjoy at your leisure. You'll spend the night at your Muscat hotel, having had a truly memorable day.

itinerary.title: Explore Muscat And Wahiba Sands
itinerary.description: After breakfast, move to the scenic Wahiba Sands by a four-wheel drive vehicle to enjoy the scenic sand dunes and golden sunset. On the way, you’ll enjoy the breathtaking scenery of the Gulf of Oman, including the blue waters that offset the pristine white beaches. As you drive past the fishing village of Quriyat, don't miss the scenic view of the Wadi Dayqah Dam, the largest dam in Oman, and the many flamingoes and migratory birds that visit its inlet streams. Your next stop is Wadi Al Arbaeen, one of Oman’s best wadis. You can swim on one or many of its pools, enjoy a BBQ meal, or go picnicking in one of the many waterfalls in the wadi. You’ll also visit the Bimmah Sinkhole, a spectacular limestone crater with crystal clear turquoise waters. Locals believe that the sinkhole may have been created by a meteorite. You can access the sinkhole through a staircase and take a dip in the clear blue waters. The next stop on the itinerary is the city of Sur. It is famous for its ancient ruins, watch towers and beautiful beaches. Stop for a visit to a traditional dhow factory before winding through the mountain terrains to proceed to the Wahiba Sands, where we have planned an overnight stay at the Arabian Oryx Camp. It's an exhilarating feeling to drive through the undulating and ever-changing red and white sand dunes that could rise to over 200 metres. Don't miss to capture the changing patterns of the sand dunes on your camera. Spend the night at the Arabian Oryx Camp.

itinerary.title: Wahiba To Muscat
itinerary.description: Start your day with a complimentary breakfast before moving to explore the neighbouring Bedouin villages. You’ll also visit a Bedouin home to understand their daily life and experience firsthand how they survive in the dessert. The next stop in the itinerary is Wadi Bani Khalid. This is the only wadis in Oman with a yearly water supply. It is one of the most beautiful wadis in the country, famous for its clear waters, picturesque scenery, and activities like swimming, hiking, and sunbathing. Later you will drive back to the Muscat International Airport to catch your flight back home.

packages.name: Explore Vietnam and Cambodia | 7 Days Itinerary
packages.destination: Hanoi - Halong - Saigon - Mekong - Siem Reap - Angkor

images.alt_text: Explore Vietnam and Cambodia | 7 Days Itinerary
Explore Vietnam and Cambodia | 7 Days Itinerary

itinerary.title: Arrival in Hanoi
itinerary.description: On your arrival at Noi Bai airport, our local guide and driver will be there to pick you up and take you to the centre of Hanoi and you will check into the hotel. In the afternoon, you will visit the Temple of Literature, which is Vietnam's first university. It was built in 1070, and its gardens and well-preserved buildings give us a peaceful look into Vietnam's history. You will also stop by Ba Dinh Square to take photos of Ho Chi Minh's Mausoleum from the outside. After that, you will visit Hoan Kiem Lake and Ngoc Son Temple. To explore more, you will then take a bicycle tour around the Old Quarter of Hanoi. Tonight, you will stay at the hotel in Hanoi.

itinerary.title: Hanoi to Halong Bay and Back
itinerary.description: Start the day with a wonderful breakfast. Today, you will head east through beautiful villages where Vietnamese people live and work in the Red River Delta. Your destination will be Halong Bay, recognized as a special place by UNESCO since 1994 and 2006. When you arrive in Halong, you will go to the pier and hop on a lovely traditional wooden boat to cruise through the bay. During the cruise, you will see interesting rock formations with names like Stone Dog, Incense Burner, and Fighting Cock. While you enjoy the scenery, a tasty seafood lunch will be served on the boat. At the centre of the small islands, there is a cool cave called Thien Cung (Heavenly Residence Grotto) that you can explore, or you can choose to relax on the boat. After about 4 hours of cruising and discovering the bay, you will get off the boat at Halong pier and head back to Hanoi. Stay overnight at the Hanoi hotel.

itinerary.title: Hanoi to Saigon – City Tour
itinerary.description: After having breakfast at the hotel and checking out, you will head to the airport to catch a flight to Saigon, which is now called Ho Chi Minh City. Saigon is a bustling and busy city in Vietnam. When you land, our local guide will pick you up from the airport and take you to the city centre to check into your hotel. In the evening, your city tour will begin at the Reunification Palace. Inside, there are detailed photo exhibitions, and outside, you will see tanks, planes, and weapons. This museum is a powerful experience that is sure to evoke strong emotions. You will also pass by some European-style landmarks like the City Hall and the old Opera House (you can only view them from the outside). You will make a quick stop to see the Notre-Dame Cathedral and the Central Post Office, both built in impressive styles. Tonight, you will stay at a hotel in Saigon.

itinerary.title: Saigon – Mekong Delta – Saigon
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delicious breakfast. Today, you will take a boat ride on the mighty Mekong River to see how local people live along the riverbanks. You will visit one of the four islands in the area for sightseeing. In the heart of a garden, you will enjoy fresh tropical fruits while listening to traditional southern Vietnamese folk music. Afterward, you will hop on small boats rowed by local people through narrow canals surrounded by water coconut trees. You will visit local factories and take a peaceful horse-cart ride through the village's quiet roads. Later, you will board a larger boat to explore a vast area. Lunch will be served at a local restaurant. In the afternoon, you will return to Saigon, making a stop to visit Vinh Trang Pagoda. This pagoda is famous for its unique architecture, blending Chinese, Cambodian, and French influences. Tonight, you will stay at the hotel in Saigon.

itinerary.title: Saigon City Tour - Fly to Siem Reap
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delicious breakfast. Today, you will visit the Reunification Palace, which used to be the Independence Palace of the South Vietnamese president. It is still in its original condition, and the original tanks are on display near the entrance gates. As you explore the city, you will pass by European-style landmarks like the fancy City Hall (Hotel De Ville) and the old Opera House (you can only see them from the outside). You will also make a quick visit to the beautiful Notredame Cathedral and the Central Post Office, both with unique architecture. In the evening, you will head to the airport for your flight to Siem Reap. Once you arrive in Siem Reap, our representative will be there to pick you up and take you to the hotel for check-in. The rest of the day is free for you to relax. Stay overnight at the hotel in Siem Reap.

itinerary.title: Full Day Angkor Tour
itinerary.description: Today, after a tasty breakfast, you will explore the South Gate of Angkor Thom, also known as Big Angkor. The Bayon Temple, famous for its unique architecture, was built in a piecemeal fashion for over a century. Next, you will visit the Terrace of the Leper King, located at the north end of the Terrace of the Elephants. It is a double terrace wall with intricately carved figures of animals, demons, and mythological beings. Your last stop will be the Ta Prohm temple, a beautiful blend of human craftsmanship and natural surroundings. Afterward, you will visit the Angkor Wat temple, Cambodia's ancient wonder and one of the marvels of the eastern world. It's designed as a replica of the universe based on Hindu mythology. Tonight, you will stay at the hotel in Siem Reap.

itinerary.title: Siem Reap – Departure
itinerary.description: Wake up to a delightful breakfast. This morning, you will be taken to the airport for your flight back home or to your next destination.

packages.name: Exploring the Heart of History: A Classic Peru Itinerary

images.alt_text: Exploring the Heart of History: A Classic Peru Itinerary
Exploring the Heart of History: A Classic Peru Itinerary

itinerary.title: Arrive at Lima
itinerary.description: Upon your morning arrival at Lima Airport, you will be warmly greeted and transferred to your hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Exploring Lima
itinerary.description: Start the morning with a heartfelt breakfast. This morning, embark on a delightful half-day city tour of Lima. You'll discover the historical heart of Lima, including the Main Square, The Justice Palace, Plaza San Martin, the Government Palace, the City Hall of Lima, the elegant Torre Tagle palace, the charming station of Desamparados, the tranquil San Francisco convent, and the alluring colonial-style houses with Moorish-style balconies. Afterward, you will venture into the modern areas of the capital, San Isidro and Miraflores, culminating with an astonishing view of the Pacific Ocean. Return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Lima to Cusco
itinerary.description: On the third day of your journey, you will start with a transfer from your hotel to the airport for a flight to the beautiful city of Cusco. Upon arrival, you will be smoothly transported to your accommodation. The morning is yours to enjoy at your leisure. In the afternoon, you’ll embark on a captivating exploration of Cusco, a place where Incan and Spanish cultures harmoniously coexist. Your adventure begins with a visit to the awe-inspiring temples of Koricancha, also known as the Temple of the Sun. We will then proceed to the Cathedral, a magnificent structure surrounded by colonial houses and historic monuments. Our journey continues as we explore the archaeological wonders near Tambomachay, Puca Pucara, Kenko, and finally, the majestic fortress of Sacsayhuaman. After this memorable day of discovery, you will be returned to our hotel in Cusco for a peaceful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Cusco to Machu Picchu and Back to Cusco
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a happy breakfast meal and then transfer to the train station, where you'll board a train destined for the Sanctuary. This train journey will carry you through the enchanting Inca valley to the picturesque town of Aguas Calientes. From there, you will set off on a scenic bus ride to reach the awe-inspiring archaeological wonder that is Machu Picchu, perched on the jungle's edge high amidst the mountains. A guided tour of Machu Picchu awaits you, complete with a delicious, included lunch. After taking in the marvels of this ancient site, return to Cusco. Spend the night at your hotel in Cusco.

itinerary.title: Depart from Cusco to Lima
itinerary.description: After enjoying breakfast, you will be transported to the airport to catch your flight, either to your next exciting destination or back to your hometown, carrying with you a treasure trove of cherished memories that will last a lifetime.

packages.name: Dynamic Vietnam 9 Days Itinerary
packages.destination: Hanoi - Halong - Danang - Hoi An - Hue - Saigon - Mekong

itinerary.title: Arrival in Hanoi and City Tour
itinerary.description: When you arrive at Hanoi International Airport, our local representative will be there to greet you. They will take you to the hotel for check-in. After settling in, we'll start our city tour. First, we'll visit the Temple of Literature, which is the first university in Vietnam. Then, we'll head to Ba Dinh Square, the largest square in Hanoi, where many important cultural events take place. Next, we'll take a "cyclo" ride, a kind of bicycle taxi, to explore the Old Quarter of Hanoi. Along the way, we'll stop at Ngoc Son Temple. Finally, we'll return to the hotel for an overnight stay in Hanoi.

itinerary.title: Hanoi to Halong
itinerary.description: After a delicious breakfast, today, we will head to Halong Bay, a special place recognized by UNESCO as a Natural World Heritage site. On the way, we'll pass through the Red River delta, where you'll see green fields and villages with hardworking farmers busy with their farming tasks like ploughing and planting. Once we reach Halong, we'll hop on a big boat to cruise around the bay and explore its amazing beauty. Halong Bay is famous for its unique limestone rocks and small island caves. After having lunch on the boat, we can visit a cave, go for a swim, or try kayaking (additional cost). We'll also pass by floating villages and get close to small islands to appreciate their beauty. In the evening, there will be activities on the boat, or you can simply relax. Lunch and dinner are included. We'll spend the night on the boat.

itinerary.title: Halong - Hanoi - Danang - Hoi An
itinerary.description: Get up early and have a delightful breakfast and get ready to see the beautiful sunrise over the sea, which the Vietnamese call the "East Sea." It's a magical sight over the small islands in the bay. After breakfast, our boat will keep cruising through amazing areas, each small island with its own unique name, like Sail Island, Fisherman’s Head Rock, Butterfly Rock, or Turtle Island. Then, we'll drive back to Hanoi and head to Noi Bai International Airport for a flight to Danang. Upon arrival, we'll be welcomed at the airport and taken to the coast to reach Hoi An Ancient Town. Check in at the hotel and spend the night in Hoi An.

itinerary.title: Hoi An City Tour
itinerary.description: Wake up for a mouthwatering breakfast. Today you will have a fascinating walk on the Japanese Bridge with its unique tile roof. We'll visit quiet Chinese Assembly Halls and explore the charm of ancient houses. You can also listen to folk music from Central Vietnam at old clubhouses. Later, we can visit shrines or wander into the market by the Thu Bon river. Here, you might feel like the artists who see Hoi An's rooftops as a magical, old-world place with an Oriental touch and a reliable source of inspiration. Hoi An is also an amazing town for shopping. You can buy lanterns, soft silk, raw silk, or even get your clothes tailored in just one day. The rest of the day is free for you to explore the town on your own or take a bike ride along the Thu Bon river to Cua Dai Beach. Tonight, we'll stay at the hotel in Hoi An.

itinerary.title: Hoi An to Hue City Tour
itinerary.description: Start your day with a tasty breakfast. Today, we're heading from Hoi An to Hue through the Hai Van Pass, also known as the "Ocean Cloudy Mountain Pass." Along the way, we'll enjoy the beautiful view of Lang Co Beach before arriving in Hue. Hue has been recognized by UNESCO as Vietnam's 1st Cultural World Heritage site, known for its old royal buildings and traditional Vietnamese way of life. We'll explore the city's charm by visiting the Royal Citadel, Forbidden City, and the Hue Royal Museum. Our tour will continue to the Thien Mu Pagoda, and we'll also check out the Tombs of King Tu Duc, which are well-preserved monuments from the early 19th and early 20th centuries belonging to the Nguyen Emperors. Tonight, we'll stay at a hotel in Hue.

itinerary.title: From Hue to Saigon
itinerary.description: After having breakfast, check out from the hotel. We'll take you to Hue Airport for a midday flight to Saigon. Once you arrive at Tan Son Nhat Airport in Saigon, we'll welcome you and take you to the hotel for check-in. In the evening, our city tour begins at the Reunification Palace, where the Vietnam War ended in 1975. It's now a museum and a place for official receptions. Nearby, you'll see the colonial-style Central Post Office and the Notre Dame Cathedral, built between 1877 and 1883, which is a major landmark in the city. Take a stroll on Nguyen Hue Street to snap some photos of the Opera House and the Ho Chi Minh Committee (from the outside). Then, walk to Ben Thanh Market, a significant symbol of Saigon, where you can experience local daily life and shop for handmade goods. Tonight, you'll stay at the hotel in Saigon.

itinerary.title: Saigon – Cu Chi Tunnels
itinerary.description: After breakfast today, we'll go visit the Cu Chi Tunnels, which is one of the few remaining reminders of the Vietnam War. These tunnels, stretching for 200 kilometres, were dug by hand and used by Vietnamese guerrilla forces during the war. It's a powerful example of how intense the war was. You can even try crawling through some parts of the tunnels to get a real feel for what it was like. After exploring the tunnels, we'll return to Saigon and drop you off at your hotel. In the evening, you have free time for shopping (no services provided). There are a few places you might want to check out, like Ben Thanh Market – the main market in Saigon, Saigon Square (just a few minutes' walk from Ben Thanh Market), An Dong Plaza and its nearby Market, or Diamond Plaza. Tonight, you'll stay at the hotel in Saigon.

itinerary.title: Saigon - Mekong Delta - Saigon
itinerary.description: Today, after having breakfast, you'll head to My Tho. Once there, you'll hop on a boat to cruise along the powerful Mekong River, watching how local people live along the riverbanks. We'll make a stop at one of the four islands in the area for some sightseeing. Next, you'll take small boats rowed by locals through narrow canals with water coconut trees. Here, you'll visit local factories, taste honey tea, and see how coconut candy milk is made. Afterward, enjoy a peaceful horse-cart ride through the village's quiet roads. Your light lunch will be at a nearby local restaurant by the Mekong River (lunch included). In the afternoon, we'll drive back to Saigon, with a stop to visit Vinh Trang Pagoda, a famous pagoda blending Chinese, Cambodian, and French architectural styles. You'll spend the night at the hotel in Saigon.

itinerary.title: Depart Saigon
itinerary.description: Start your day with breakfast, and then you'll be transferred to the airport for your flight back home or to your next destination.

packages.name: Best of Argentina Tour Packages | 9 Day Itinerary
packages.destination: Buenos Aires - El Calafate - Ushuaia - Iguazu

images.alt_text: Best of Argentina Tour Packages | 9 Day Itinerary
Best of Argentina Tour Packages | 9 Day Itinerary

itinerary.title: Arrival in Buenos Aires
itinerary.description: Upon your morning arrival at Ezeiza International Airport, you will be warmly greeted and escorted to your hotel. Buenos Aires, a city of remarkable complexity, pulsates with vitality and allure, extending from the southern reaches to the northern expanse along the Rio de la Plata. This metropolis has served as the venerable gateway to Argentina for countless centuries. The inhabitants, affectionately referred to as Porteños, cherish a culture steeped in refinement, their European heritage being of paramount importance. The city's way of life and architectural landscape distinctly echo the contours of Europe, distinguishing it as the most European-influenced city in all South America. Yet, Buenos Aires has also given birth to unique art forms, most notably the enchanting tango, which has brought global fame to this Argentine gem. The remainder of the day is yours to savour at your own pace. Enjoy an overnight stay at your hotel in Buenos Aires.

itinerary.title: Buenos Aires
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a delightful breakfast. This morning, you'll commence on a captivating Buenos Aires City Tour, an exploration that encompasses a rich tapestry of architectural styles, museums, sculptures, historical landmarks, and the echoes of Colonial, Renaissance, Baroque, Neoclassical, Art Nouveau, Art Deco, Modern, and international influences. Buenos Aires stands as a city replete with distinctive style and flair, offering an array of iconic locations to discover, such as Puerto Madero, Plaza de Mayo, Av. de Mayo, The National Congress Building, Avenida Corrientes, The Obelisk, El Ateneo Bookstore, Floralis Generica, Recoleta Cultural Center, Nuestra Senora del Pilar Basilica, Cemetery of La Recoleta, Caminito Street, and the vibrant neighbourhood of La Boca. As the day unfolds, prepare for a delightful evening filled with the enchanting rhythms of Tango. You'll be whisked away to Tango Porteño, where you will be treated to an Evening Tango Show & Dinner at the opulent and mesmerising Magnificent Tango Porteño. After this memorable experience, you'll return to your comfortable hotel in Buenos Aires for a restful night's sleep, with the option to enjoy dinner if desired.

itinerary.title: Buenos Aires to El Calafate
itinerary.description: Embark on a delightful day by commencing with a hearty breakfast. Your journey today entails heading to the airport to catch a flight bound for El Calafate. Upon your arrival at El Calafate Airport, you'll be warmly received and escorted to your hotel. This charming hamlet is nestled along the southern shores of Lake Argentina. As the seasons unfold, El Calafate adorns itself with the vibrant hues of yellow flowers in spring and lush purple fruits in summer. Local lore tells of a unique promise – those who savor these fruits are destined to return to the enchanting landscapes of Patagonia. The remainder of the day is yours to savour at your own pace, with the option to explore the town independently. As night falls, you will find rest and reprieve at your El Calafate hotel, anticipating the adventures that await.

itinerary.title: El Calafate
itinerary.description: We kickstart the day with a hearty breakfast to fuel our exciting adventure. Our morning is dedicated to a full-day expedition to the awe-inspiring Perito Moreno Glacier. As we embark on this journey, you'll witness the sheer magnificence of Mother Nature in all her glory. We depart from El Calafate, tracing the southern shoreline of the sprawling Argentine Lake, a scenic route spanning 90 kilometres, ultimately leading us to the entrance of Los Glaciares National Park. Here, we follow the pathways that guide us towards the imposing glacier. The Perito Moreno Glacier is an ancient marvel, having stood the test of time for over 30,000 years. Covering an expanse of 192 square kilometres, it boasts an impressive 5-kilometre front wall with peaks reaching heights of up to 80 metres. The glacier's deep blue base is almost as enchanting as the surrounding water. As you stand in its presence, a profound silence envelops you, occasionally broken by the resounding echoes of enormous ice chunks breaking free and plummeting into the lake, where they float gracefully along the Canal de los Tempanos, also known as the Icebergs Channel. For a more immersive experience, we embark on a Nautical Safari excursion, offering an unparalleled perspective of the grandeur of the Perito Moreno Glacier. The journey commences at Bajo de las Sombras Port, located just 6 kilometres from the Glacier Vantage Point. Visitors board a vessel and sail across Rico Lake. Upon reaching the southernmost point of the Canal de los Tempanos, the ship anchors at a safe distance from the glacier's towering wall. It's from here that the Safari Nautico adventure truly begins, affording you the unique opportunity to observe the glacier's colossal walls and the icebergs that continually calve from its icy face into the serene waters of Rico Lake. As the day comes to a close, we return to our comfortable hotel in El Calafate for a well-deserved overnight stay.

itinerary.title: El Calafate to Ushuaia
itinerary.description: Embark on today's journey by boarding a flight at El Calafate Airport, bound for the captivating destination of Ushuaia. Ushuaia graces the southernmost tip of the Republic of Argentina, nestled on the Isla Grande de Tierra del Fuego. This extraordinary locale claims the title of being the world's southernmost city, resting along the Beagle Channel. Its name, derived from the yamana tongue, translates to "bay overlooking the West." Set against the stunning backdrop of the sea, lush forests, serene lakes, and majestic mountains, Ushuaia emerges as a charming city. It boasts a robust tourism infrastructure, an elegant commercial hub, and a thriving social and cultural scene. Your night's lodging awaits at Ushuaia hotel.

itinerary.title: Ushuaia
itinerary.description: This morning, embark on a captivating Half Day Tierra del Fuego National Park Tour, complete with a scenic Train of the End of the World Ride. The historic train ride now stands as a charming means for visitors to delve into Ushuaia's rich past. As you journey through this remote corner of the Earth, you'll be greeted by a truly magnificent landscape. Situated just 12 kilometers from Ushuaia, the Tierra del Fuego National Park is unique as the sole National Park in the country boasting a coastline along the ocean. Within its vast 63,000 hectares, a remarkable variety of flora, including nires, lengas, cherry trees, calafates, as well as delicate flowers like violets and orchids, are meticulously preserved. In the afternoon, prepare for a Beagle Channel Navigation experience, where you'll visit Seals Island. You'll be escorted to the port, where you'll embark on a catamaran adventure, sailing the waters of the Beagle Channel that gracefully connects the Atlantic and Pacific Oceans. This is a haven for a myriad of sea mammals and birds, offering you an exceptional opportunity to observe these fascinating creatures in their natural habitat, without causing any disruption to their daily routines. Conclude your day with an overnight stay at your Ushuaia hotel.

itinerary.title: Ushuaia to Iguazu
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a transfer to the airport in Ushuaia for your flight to Iguazu. Upon your arrival at Iguassu Airport, your knowledgeable guide will warmly welcome you and escort you to your designated hotel. Situated at the border shared by Brazil and Argentina, the spectacular Iguassu Falls await. Nestled within the enchanting Argentine/Brazilian rainforest, these falls hold the distinction of being the widest and most awe-inspiring waterfalls on our planet. Their name, in the native Guarani language, translates to "Big Waters," a name that perfectly encapsulates their grandeur. Your overnight stay will be at a comfortable hotel in Iguazu.

itinerary.title: Iguassu
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a delicious breakfast before embarking on an adventure to explore the magnificent Argentinean side of the Iguassu Falls. The Argentine Falls tour has become even more enchanting with the introduction of new facilities for the Upper, Lower, and Devil's Throat Circuits. Your journey starts at the New Visitors Center, where you can immerse yourself in the wonders of nature at the Nature's Interpretation Center. From the Visitors Center, you have the option to hop on a train, which will whisk you away to Cataratas Station in approximately 8 minutes. Alternatively, you can take a leisurely stroll through the "Green Trail," leading you to the starting point of the Upper and Lower trails. The UPPER CIRCUIT offers an extraordinary experience as you traverse 800 meters of catwalks suspended above the jungle's floor, preserving the natural trails of the local fauna. From this vantage point, you'll be treated to a bird's-eye view of the falls, allowing you to appreciate their grandeur and beauty from a panoramic perspective. The LOWER CIRCUIT, comprising 1,600 meters of catwalks, also elevates you above the jungle floor, offering a unique perspective from below and around the falls. This circuit allows you to become one with the natural environment, allowing you to fully immerse yourself in the awe-inspiring surroundings and witness the falls' sheer magnitude up close. The pinnacle of your journey is the DEVIL'S GORGE. After a scenic train ride from Cataratas Station that takes about 18 minutes, a stroll along the catwalks, suspended some 1,200 meters over the islands, leads you to a breathtaking vista at the most significant observation point: the Devil's Throat. Conclude your day's adventures and retreat to the comfort of your hotel in Iguazu for a restful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Departure from Iguassu to Buenos Aires
itinerary.description: Today, we will go on an exciting excursion to the Brazilian Falls. The Brazilian Park has introduced some impressive new facilities for visitors. Upon reaching the Visitor Center, we board the panoramic buses that initiate our journey through the park, and then we descend to begin our exploration on foot. From the first observation point, we are treated to a breathtaking panoramic vista of the Argentinean Falls. After a 950-meter walk, with awe-inspiring vistas of the Iguazu River, we arrive at the Brazilian side of the falls. The walkway, which takes us right up to Floriano Falls, provides a refreshing welcome and a stunning panoramic perspective of the lower Iguazu River and the Devil's Gorge Canyon. If you desire, you can take an elevator or climb the stairs to reach the shopping and restaurant area on the upper level. After this captivating experience, we return to the entrance on the panoramic buses. Later, we will proceed to the airport for our flight to Buenos Aires. Upon arrival in Buenos Aires, we will be transferred to the international airport for the next leg of our journey or our return home, carrying with us a treasure trove of unforgettable memories.

packages.name: Discover Vietnam and Cambodia | Itinerary
packages.destination: Hanoi - Tam Coc - Hoa Lu - Hanoi - Halong - Saigon - Mekong - Siem Reap - Angkor

itinerary.title: Arrival in Hanoi
itinerary.description: Today, when you arrive at Noi Bai airport, our representative will take you to the hotel. In the evening, you'll have a city tour that includes visiting the Temple of Literature, which is Vietnam's first university. It was built in 1070, and its beautiful gardens and well-kept buildings give you a peaceful look into Vietnam's history. After that, we'll go to Hoan Kiem Lake and Ngoc Son Temple. Finally, we'll take a bike ride around the Old Quarter of Hanoi. You'll spend the night at the hotel in Hanoi.

itinerary.title: Hanoi - Tam Coc - Hoa Lu - Hanoi
itinerary.description: Begin the day with a tasty breakfast. Today, you'll travel to Ninh Binh, which is south of Hanoi. This area is known for its beautiful landscapes, including Tam Coc Caves and the ancient capital of Hoa Lu, where old temples dedicated to King Dinh and King Le can be found. Your visit to Ninh Binh starts with a boat trip in Tam Coc. You'll see amazing limestone islands rising from the green rice fields, creating a scenery similar to Halong Bay in Vietnam. Afterward, you'll head to the site that used to be the kings' palace in the 10th century. Now, it's famous for the wooden reliefs at the Dinh and Le temples. Lunch is included in the plan. In the late afternoon, you'll return to Hanoi and spend the night at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Hanoi to Halong
itinerary.description: After having breakfast, today you'll head to Halong Bay, a place recognized as a World Heritage site by UNESCO in 1994. When you reach Halong, you'll hop on a boat to explore the beautiful bay, often referred to as the "Descending Dragon" bay. It's known for its unique limestone rocks and small island grottoes. Enjoy a delicious lunch featuring fresh seafood while on board. You can also visit the Surprising Grotto, go for a swim or kayak, pass by floating villages, and get close to small islands to appreciate their beauty. Return to the boat for dinner. In the evening, participate in boat activities or simply relax. You'll spend the night on the boat, and dinner will be provided.

itinerary.title: Halong - Bus to Hanoi - Flight to Saigon
itinerary.description: After having breakfast, you'll go on a boat trip to Luon Cave, which is like a peaceful pool inside an island in Halong with clear green water. On the way back to Halong Wharf, you'll pass through an area with many islands, each with interesting names like Cock-Fighting Rock, Sail Island, Incense Burner Rock, or Sea Dog Rock. Once back at Halong Wharf, we'll head to Hanoi airport to catch a flight to Saigon (now known as Ho Chi Minh City). When we arrive, our representative will take us to the city centre to check in at the hotel. We'll spend the night at the hotel in Saigon.

itinerary.title: Saigon - Mekong Delta - Saigon
itinerary.description: Start your day with breakfast. Today, we'll go to the Mekong Delta. When we get there, we'll hop on a boat and cruise along the mighty Mekong River. We'll make a stop at one of the four islands in the area to see the sights. Next, you'll ride in small boats rowed by local people through narrow canals with water coconut trees to visit the local factories. After that, you will enjoy a horse-cart ride along peaceful village roads. In the evening, we'll drive back to Saigon, with a stop to visit Vinh Trang Pagoda. This pagoda is famous in the area for its unique architecture, blending Chinese, Cambodian, and French influences. You will stay overnight at the hotel in Saigon.

itinerary.title: Saigon – Cu Chi Tunnels – City Tour – Saigon
itinerary.description: Today, you'll go to see the Cu Chi Tunnels. These tunnels, stretching over 200km, are now a popular place for both Vietnamese and foreign visitors. During the war, these tunnels played a crucial role and became legendary. They were like secret underground cities with trap doors, living spaces, storage rooms, and even places to make weapons. After the visit to Cu Chi, you'll return to Saigon. In the evening, you'll explore the Reunification Palace and the War Remnants Museum. The museum is quite powerful and might bring out strong emotions. You'll also pass by some European-style landmarks like the City Hall and the old Opera House (you can only see them from the outside). Additionally, you'll quickly visit the Notre-Dame Cathedral and the Central Post Office, both with impressive architecture. You'll spend the night at the hotel in Saigon.

itinerary.title: Saigon to Siem Reap - Explore the City
itinerary.description: In the morning, after having breakfast, you will go to the airport and catch a flight to Siem Reap. Once we arrive, our local tour guide will be there to pick us up and take us to our hotel. Later in the day, we'll visit Wat Thmei, also known as the Killing Field. This place has a special glass-walled stupa that holds the bones of people who were affected by the Khmer Rouge. After that, we'll head to Les Artisans d'Angkor – Chantiers Ecole, a place where you can see and learn about the finest traditional Khmer arts and crafts. Tonight, we'll stay at a hotel in Siem Reap.

itinerary.title: Siem Reap Full Day Angkor Tour
itinerary.description: In the morning, we'll check out the South Gate of Angkor Thom, also known as Big Angkor. There, you'll see the Terrace of the Elephants, a long wall with carved elephants, and it's really tall - about two and a half metres! This wall stretches for 300 metres and is right in the middle of Angkor Thom. Nearby, there's the Baphuon, a huge temple mountain, the Royal Palace Area, and Phimeanakas, which is an impressive sandstone pyramid. At the north end, you'll find the Terrace of the Leper King. Later in the day, we'll visit the Angkor Wat temple, a remarkable ancient temple in Cambodia. It's considered one of the wonders of the eastern world. Angkor Wat is like a model of the universe based on Hindu mythology. You'll see five tall towers and many galleries arranged in a geometric way. Tonight, we'll stay at the hotel in Siem Reap.

itinerary.title: Siem Reap Full Day Angkor Tour
itinerary.description: Today, you'll explore another part of Angkor. First, there's the Ta Prohm temple, a magical mix of human skill and nature's beauty. Huge trees have been growing here for centuries, creating a unique atmosphere. Despite the ancient setting, you'll find some really beautiful decorations on the walls. Next up is Srah Srang, a royal pool where the King used to take a bath with his companions every day. It's like a pyramid with five levels and is dedicated to the god Shiva. Thommanon is a small temple in great condition, built around the same time as Angkor Wat. In the evening, you'll visit Preah Khan, also known as The Sacred Sword. It was built by Jayawarman VII and is famous for its long hallways and intricate carvings. Ta Som is a small, classic Bayon-style monastery with a flat layout. Lastly, you'll visit Pre Rup, built in the 10th century by Rajendravarman, and enjoy the sunset there. Tonight, you'll stay at the hotel in Siem Reap.

itinerary.title: Departing Siem Reap
itinerary.description: Have your breakfast and get ready. This morning, you will be transferred to the airport for your flight back home or to your next destination.

After settling in, we will start our city tour. First, we will visit the Temple of Literature, which is the first university in Vietnam. Then, we will head to Ba Dinh Square, the largest square in Hanoi, where many important cultural events take place. After that, you will get a magnificent view of the capital by taking a "cyclo" ride around the Old Quarter of Hanoi. We will make a stop at Ngoc Son Temple. Tonight, you will stay at the hotel in Hanoi.

itinerary.title: Halong to Hanoi
itinerary.description: After a tasty breakfast, we are heading to Luon Cave by boat. This cave is like a circle-shaped pool on an island in Halong Bay, surrounded by calm and beautiful scenery with greenish water. On our way back to Halong, we will pass through a busy area filled with many islands, each with interesting names like Cock-Fighting Rock, Sail Island, Incense Burner Rock, and Sea Dog Rock. Lunch is part of the plan. In the evening, you have free time to do whatever you like. We will be spending the night at a hotel in Hanoi.

itinerary.title: Leaving Hanoi
itinerary.description: After having breakfast, this morning you will be taken to the airport for your flight back home or to your next destination.

packages.name: Fascinating Reunion Island, Sainte Marie, Salazie and More | Itinerary
packages.destination: Sainte Marie - Salazie - Cilaos Cirque - Excursion to the Volcano

images.alt_text: Fascinating Reunion Island, Sainte Marie, Salazie and More | Itinerary
Fascinating Reunion Island, Sainte Marie, Salazie and More | Itinerary

itinerary.title: Arrival at Roland Garros Airport in Sainte Marie
itinerary.description: Your adventure begins as you touch down at Roland Garros Airport. Upon your arrival, our friendly representative will be there to extend a warm welcome. They will provide you with all the essential documents for your stay, including vouchers, maps, and a handy travel guide. From the airport, you'll be whisked away in an air-conditioned vehicle to your chosen accommodation. The rest of the day is yours to unwind and relax, settling into the serene atmosphere of Sainte Marie. You'll be spending the night at your hotel in Sainte Marie.

itinerary.title: Exploring Sainte Marie and Salazie
itinerary.description: On this beautiful morning, you will be off to explore the vibrant and unique architecture of Indian temples in Sainte Marie. Prepare to be enchanted by the vivid colours and distinctive shapes. Your senses will be treated to a sensory delight as you discover the world of aromatic vanilla pods from Mr. Rouloff's plantation. You'll learn about the fascinating journey from the vanilla plant to the delightful vanilla balms. The aromas will envelop you, creating a sensory experience that's truly enchanting. As we journey to Salazie, you'll be treated to a series of breathtaking landscapes, with lush greenery everywhere you look. The route is adorned with countless plant species, waterfalls, and an array of colourful flowers that adorn the roads, creating a visual feast. Our day continues with a visit to a village dedicated to the governor of Hell, which is a living museum of Creole architecture with its distinctive ridge-pole rooftops. As the day draws to a close, we'll make our way back to the hotel for a well-deserved night of rest. You'll be spending another peaceful night at your hotel in Sainte Marie, where a delightful dinner awaits. (Breakfast and Dinner included)

itinerary.title: Sainte Marie to Cilaos Cirque - A Journey into Time and Nature's Beauty
itinerary.description: Today, you will start on a captivating journey to the southern part of the island, Cilaos Cirque. This remote destination is steeped in history and natural splendour. In 1845, a rugged path was carved out, initially accessible only to pedestrians. It wasn't until 1896 that thermal baths were established, and a proper road for vehicles was constructed. Before that, the trek to Cilaos was made on sedan chairs – quite an adventure! Cilaos village, nestled at an elevation of 1200 metres, is a sight to behold. The ascent along the famous "400 bends road" treats you to awe-inspiring vistas of numerous hamlets dotting the landscape. As you reach the village, you'll feel like you've stepped into a bygone era, with charming old houses surrounded by blooming gardens that resemble an artist's palette. In the hot season, the village bursts with colours, thanks to jacarandas in shades of mauve, dahlias, azaleas, roses, hydrangeas, and mimosas. Cilaos is renowned for several things - its hydrotherapy facilities, exquisite embroidery, unique local wine (the only one produced in Reunion), and the world-famous lentils. The village beckons you to explore its treasures through various walks and hikes. For the most breathtaking view of the cirque, take a forest path to "La Roche Merveilleuse" or opt for a car or bus ride. From this vantage point, you can feast your eyes on the entire cirque, the village below, intricate paths, and lush forests. Don't miss the chance to discover the thermal baths, which include both ancient vestiges dating back to the 19th century, accessible via a picturesque road, and modern facilities for wellness and rejuvenation. After enjoying your lunch at your leisure, you can visit the "Embroidery House" and learn about the intricate "les Jours de Cilaos" (an optional suggestion). On your way back in the late afternoon, we'll make a stop at "the whirlpool" at L’Etang-Salé, a natural wonder. We'll return to your hotel around 5:30 pm, and you'll spend the night in the serene embrace of Cilaos Cirque. (Breakfast and Dinner included)

itinerary.title: Explore Cilaos Cirque at Your Own Pace
itinerary.description: Today is a day for you to unwind and enjoy some leisure time. We've got a range of activities available for you upon request when you arrive, including thrilling options like a helicopter ride, diving adventures, transparent kayaking, and relaxing paddle trips. You'll spend the night at our lovely hotel in Cilaos Cirque, where you can relish delicious meals throughout the day.

itinerary.title: Volcano Adventure
itinerary.description: Prepare for an exciting day as we make our way to the coast, with its serene shores and imposing cliffs leading to St. Peter. From there, we begin our ascent towards the vast Plains of Cafres and the Great Ferme. The highlight of the day is the Commerson crater, a captivating geological formation filled with intriguing rocks, resembling question marks. This natural amphitheatre is a dream come true for geologists, with its intriguing discoveries. As we continue our journey, the landscape will change dramatically, offering stunning vistas. Once the day's exploration is complete, we'll spend the night back at our comfortable hotel in Cilaos Cirque. Enjoy a hearty breakfast and delightful dinner.

itinerary.title: Farewell to Cilaos Cirque
itinerary.description: It's time to bid farewell to the enchanting Cilaos Cirque. Today, you'll be transferred to the airport for your journey back home or onward to your next destination. Enjoy your breakfast before departing.

itinerary.title: Depart Mauritius

itinerary.title: Welcome to Amman
itinerary.description: Welcome to Jordan! As you get off your plane at Amman Airport, our friendly representative will be there to greet you. They'll assist you with the visa formalities, making your arrival a breeze. From there, we'll whisk you away to your hotel. Check-in and settle into your accommodation. The evening is yours to enjoy at your leisure. Rest and relax as you prepare for the adventures that lie ahead. You'll be spending the night at your Amman hotel.

itinerary.title: Exploring Desert Castles and the Dead Sea
itinerary.description: After a hearty breakfast, we will start a fascinating journey to the Eastern Desert. Our first stops are the incredible Al Kharraneh Castle, the Amra Castle (a UNESCO World Heritage site), and the historic Al Azraq Castle, which was once the residence of the legendary Lawrence of Arabia, where he penned parts of his renowned work, "Seven Pillars of Wisdom." We will then continue our adventure to the famous Dead Sea, a natural wonder nestled in the Jordan Valley, about 55 kilometres southeast of Amman. This unique spot is not only the lowest point on Earth but also boasts an incredible richness of natural salts that have accumulated over thousands of years. Immerse yourself in the rejuvenating waters and enjoy the beauty of this unparalleled landscape. After a day filled with exploration, you will return to your Amman hotel where you'll spend the night.

itinerary.title: Exploring Amman, Jerash, and Ajloun
itinerary.description: Kickstart your day with a hearty breakfast. Your adventure begins with the Amman Panoramic tour, offering you a breathtaking view of this vibrant city. Next, we'll take you to the ancient Roman city of Jerash, a treasure trove of history and architecture. Wander through its cobblestone streets, lined with stately columns, and marvel at the grand temples perched on hilltops. You'll discover theatres, expansive public squares, soothing baths, enchanting fountains, and formidable city walls as you explore the secrets of this ancient city. The journey takes you north to Ajloun, a region known for its ecological and historical significance in the Middle East. The highlight of this visit is the Ajloun Castle, also known as Qal’at Ar‐Rabad. This stunning fortress is a prime example of Islamic architecture, dating back to 1184 AD when it was constructed by Saladin's general. The castle's purpose was to oversee the iron mines of Ajloun and thwart the advances of the Crusaders. It stood tall as a guardian, controlling the three main routes leading to the Jordan valley and safeguarding the crucial communication links between Jordan and Syria. As the day draws to a close, you will return to your comfortable hotel in Amman, where a delicious dinner awaits. You can look forward to a restful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Journey from Amman to Petra via Madaba, Mount Nebo, and Little Petra
itinerary.description: Today, following a hearty breakfast, you will start off on an exciting adventure through some of Jordan's most remarkable destinations. Your first stop will be Madaba, a city renowned for its historic treasures. Here, you'll discover the famous 6th-century Mosaic map of Jerusalem and the Holy Land. Madaba is also celebrated for its astonishing Byzantine and Umayyad mosaics, which are sure to leave you in awe. While in Madaba, you will pay a visit to the beautiful St. George's Church, an iconic religious site. Continuing your journey, you will head to Little Petra, also known as Al Beidha due to the pale rock colours that define its unique landscape. Little Petra, or Siq al‐Barid, which translates to "the cold canyon," is a fascinating archaeological site situated to the north of Petra and the town of Wadi Musa. This site is a testament to the Nabataean culture, with intricate buildings carved into the sandstone canyon walls. As its name implies, Little Petra is a smaller-scale wonder, featuring three more open areas connected by a 450-metre canyon. It's worth noting that although it's part of the Petra Archaeological Park, it's accessed separately. The day concludes as you find your way to a comfortable hotel in Petra, where you will enjoy a delightful dinner and spend the night.

itinerary.title: Exploring Petra - A Visit to the Enchanting Red Rose City
itinerary.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast and get ready to embark on a remarkable adventure as you journey to Petra, the Nabatean Red Rose city. Petra is not just a remarkable place, but it's also one of the seven wonders of the world and a UNESCO World Heritage site. To enter this awe-inspiring city, you will traverse a 1-kilometre-long, narrow gorge, nestled between towering cliffs that reach an impressive height of 80 metres. As you make your way through, take a moment to appreciate the dazzling array of colours and intricate rock formations that surround you. Petra is nothing short of massive, and it's teeming with wonders waiting to be discovered. You'll encounter numerous intricately carved rock-cut tombs, a treasury that's sure to leave you in awe, Roman-style theatres where history comes to life, temples steeped in antiquity, sacrificial altars that tell tales of tradition, and colonnaded streets that bear witness to centuries of civilization. After a day filled with exploration and wonder, you will return to your comfortable hotel in Petra for a well-deserved dinner.

itinerary.title: Exploring Petra and Wadi Rum's Desert Wonders
itinerary.description: Good morning! After a hearty breakfast, we're off to explore more of the captivating sites in southern Jordan, including the awe-inspiring Wadi Rum. Get ready for a thrilling adventure as we embark on a jeep ride into the Jordanian desert. Wadi Rum, as described by T.E. Lawrence, is "Vast, echoing, and god-like." The locals affectionately call it the "Valley of the Moon." You'll be spending the night at a hotel in Wadi Rum, where dinner will be served.

itinerary.title: Wadi Rum to Amman - A City Exploration
itinerary.description: Today, after a nourishing breakfast, we'll make our way to Amman. Once we arrive, you have the freedom to explore the city at your own pace. You'll be spending the night at a hotel in Amman, where dinner will be provided.

itinerary.title: Farewell, Amman!
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel and make your way to Amman's airport for your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Welcome to Jordan - Arrival in Amman
itinerary.description: Welcome to the captivating land of Jordan! Your journey begins as you touch down at Amman Airport, where you'll be warmly greeted by our representative. They'll be there to assist you with the visa formalities, ensuring a smooth and hassle-free entry into this beautiful country. Afterward, we'll head to your hotel for check-in. With the formalities sorted, the rest of the evening is yours to enjoy at your leisure. Take this time to relax, soak in the ambiance of Amman, or perhaps explore a bit of the city. Your comfortable overnight stay awaits you at the hotel in Amman.

itinerary.title: Exploring Amman, Madaba, and Mount Nebo en route to Petra
itinerary.description: After a satisfying breakfast, you will start on an exciting journey south towards Petra. Along the way, we'll make some remarkable stops that unveil the rich history and culture of Jordan. The first destination is Mount Nebo, a site held in great reverence in Jordan's history. It is believed to be the place where Moses was laid to rest. Here, you'll find a small Byzantine church, originally constructed by early Christians, which has since grown into a grand complex. Notably, in 2001, the Late Pope John Paul II delivered a sermon to a congregation of around 20,000 Faithfuls at this location. Your next stop will take you to Saint George Church in Madaba. The highlight of this visit is the Madaba Mosaic Map, a remarkable mosaic that adorns the floor of the Greek Orthodox Church of St. George. The church itself was built in 1896 AD, standing upon the ruins of an older 6th-century Byzantine church. With these enriching experiences, you will continue your journey southward towards the enchanting city of Petra. It's here that you will rest for the night at a comfortable hotel.

itinerary.title: Discovering Petra's Marvels
itinerary.description: Today, you will go on a journey to the magnificent Petra Site, also known as the Red Rose City. After indulging in a hearty breakfast, we'll head off to explore this incredible wonder. Petra, with its colossal red mountains and grand mausoleums, stands as a testament to a bygone civilization, vastly different from our modern world. It doesn't demand anything from the present except one thing - to be admired for its true worth. It's an unparalleled marvel created by Mother Nature herself. Here, you'll encounter a remarkable Nabataean-built theatre, reminiscent of Roman design, with the capacity to seat 3,000 spectators. Along your path, you'll come across obelisks, temples, sacrificial altars, and beautifully colonnaded streets. Gazing down on the valley is the awe-inspiring Ad-Deir Monastery, accessible via an 800-step climb carved into the rock. Don't let the name "Monastery" mislead you; it's a somewhat inaccurate nickname, likely attributed to its remote location and some crosses inscribed within. While it might have been used as a church or a hermitage later on, its origins likely point to a temple, possibly dedicated to the deified Nabataen king, Obodas. This city of Petra is a UNESCO World Heritage site, and exploring its rock-cut wonders is a journey back in time. After an enriching tour of Petra, we'll pick you up from the site and return you to your hotel. Enjoy a restful night at the hotel in Petra.

itinerary.title: From Petra to the Mystical Wadi Rum
itinerary.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast, and then prepare for a captivating journey to Wadi Rum, a place of timeless wonder. This extraordinary desert landscape has been left virtually untouched by human interference and remains a testament to the powerful forces of weather and wind. Wadi Rum is a place where nature has sculpted towering skyscrapers that reach heights of up to 1,750 metres. T.E. Lawrence once described this terrain as "vast, echoing, and god-like," and it's easy to see why. The monolithic rock formations form a labyrinth of monumental beauty, challenging even the most intrepid mountaineers. For hikers, this is a sanctuary of serenity, with boundless open spaces waiting to be explored. Traverse canyons and discover ancient water holes, where 4,000-year-old rock drawings and other magnificent treasures are hidden, waiting to be uncovered. As the day draws to a close, you'll spend the night at a Desert Camp, surrounded by the enchanting desert landscape. Enjoy a delectable dinner and rest under the star-studded desert sky, making this an experience to remember.

itinerary.title: From Wadi Rum to the Tranquil Dead Sea
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a hearty breakfast at the hotel as you will embark on a remarkable journey to the captivating Dead Sea. Situated at a remarkable 410 metres below sea level, the Dead Sea holds the title of being the Earth's lowest point. Jordan's Dead Sea coast is a place of both natural wonder and profound spirituality, drawing visitors from around the globe, much like it did in ancient times when it beckoned to kings, emperors, traders, and prophets. The crowning jewel of the Dead Sea is, without a doubt, the incredibly buoyant and soothing water, thanks to its staggering salt content of 31.5%. When you take a dip, you'll find it utterly impossible to sink, providing a unique and unforgettable experience. What's more, this magical water is enriched with 21 different minerals, including abundant magnesium, sodium, potassium, and bromine. Remarkably, 12 of these minerals are exclusive to the Dead Sea, making it truly one-of-a-kind. After your day's adventures, we'll find solace and comfort at the Dead Sea Hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Farewell to the Dead Sea, Hello Amman
itinerary.description: With cherished memories in your heart and a satisfying breakfast to start the day, it's time to check out of the hotel. We'll make our way to Amman airport, where your journey back home begins.

itinerary.description: Get your day off to a great start with a tasty breakfast, and then set out to visit the awe-inspiring Nabatean Red Rose city of Petra. This remarkable city holds a place among the world's seven wonders and is a cherished UNESCO World Heritage site. As you step into the city, prepare to be enchanted by a captivating journey through a narrow gorge that extends for 1 kilometre. This gorge is flanked on both sides by colossal cliffs towering 80 metres high. The rocks here display a mesmerising array of vibrant colours and unique formations, adding to the wonder of the experience. Within the bounds of Petra, you'll discover a vast expanse featuring an array of intricately carved rock tombs, a treasury that tells tales of ancient riches, Roman-style theatres that resonate with history, temples, sacrificial altars, and elegant colonnaded streets. It's a true testament to the artistic and architectural brilliance of the past. After an enriching day of exploration, you'll have the evening to unwind at your own pace. itinerary.title: Exploring Petra and Venturing into Wadi Rum
itinerary.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast as we continue our journey through southern Jordan, visiting some remarkable locations, including the awe-inspiring Wadi Rum.
