Lawrence, is a place that is "vast, echoing, and god-like." The locals affectionately call it the "Valley of the Moon." Prepare to be enchanted by the breathtaking landscapes and the surreal, almost otherworldly ambiance of this unique desert wonderland. At the end of the day's adventures, you will rest at a hotel in Wadi Rum. Enjoy a delicious dinner and unwind.

itinerary.title: Wadi Rum to Aqaba - A Day of Leisure
itinerary.description: After a satisfying breakfast, we'll make our way to the vibrant city of Aqaba, nestled by the stunning Red Sea. This coastal gem isn't just a fantastic beach destination; it's also a fantastic starting point for exploring the treasures of southern Jordan. Aqaba offers a delightful blend of history, outstanding attractions, and plenty of opportunities for relaxation. This city has it all – from captivating historical sites to thrilling activities, excellent shopping spots, and the warm hospitality of its residents. Spend your day at your leisure, exploring the city's many facets, engaging in various activities, or simply relaxing by the sea. As the day winds down, we'll find comfort at our hotel in Aqaba. Enjoy another delectable dinner and prepare for more adventures in Jordan.

itinerary.title: A Day of Leisure in Aqaba
itinerary.description: After a hearty breakfast, today is a day for you to unwind and explore the charming city of Aqaba at your own pace. Aqaba is renowned for offering everything that makes diving in the Red Sea truly exceptional, minus the bustling crowds that you might encounter in Eilat or Egyptian resorts. While its coastline may be relatively short, it packs a punch with a treasure trove of underwater wonders. Within the confines of a protected marine park, you'll discover 25 diving sites that beckon with their shallow coral gardens, dramatic pinnacles, deep canyons, and intriguing shipwrecks. It's a diver's paradise, and you can take your time to revel in this aquatic playground. After a day filled with exploration and underwater adventures, you'll return to your comfortable hotel in Aqaba for a restful night.

itinerary.title: Aqaba's Delights
itinerary.description: Following a delicious breakfast, today unfolds as another day at your leisure. For those seeking extra excitement, there's an optional tour available (additional charges apply). Aqaba has more to offer beyond its captivating waters. You can explore the atmospheric Mamluk fort, a historic gem dating back to the 14th century, and immerse yourself in the fascinating Aqaba Archaeological Museum. Once your sightseeing is complete, take a moment to relax and savour a local brew at the welcoming Al Firdous Cafe, where you can soak in the local atmosphere. As the day comes to a close, return to your hotel in Aqaba for another peaceful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Aqaba to Amman - City Transfer
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a hearty breakfast, and then it's time to bid farewell to your hotel in Aqaba. You'll be journeying from Aqaba to the vibrant city of Amman. You'll spend the night at a comfortable hotel in Amman.

itinerary.title: Amman City Tour - Jerash - Ajloun - Back to Amman
itinerary.description: Following a satisfying breakfast, get ready for a captivating city tour of Amman. This adventure will take you through the heart of Jordan's capital, starting from the city centre and heading to the old Gold Souq. Along the way, you'll have the chance to sample some of Jordan's most popular Arabic sweets. Our journey continues to the bustling Rainbow Street, where you'll find a plethora of charming coffee shops and restaurants. From there, we'll pass through Abdoun, showcasing the newest and most modern part of Amman. Our next stop is the ancient Roman city of Jerash, known for its paved streets, grand temples, theatres, public squares, baths, fountains, and formidable city walls. It's a mesmerising step back in time. As we venture further into northern Jordan, we'll reach one of the most significant ecological and historical sites in the Middle East: Ajloun. The Ajloun Castle, also known as Qal’at Ar‐Rabad, is a remarkable example of Islamic architecture. It was constructed in 1184 AD under the command of Saladin's general. The purpose was to oversee the iron mines of Ajloun and to counter the advancements of the Crusaders by controlling the three main routes to the Jordan Valley and safeguarding the communication routes between Jordan and Syria. You'll spend the night at a hotel in Amman.

itinerary.title: Farewell Amman
itinerary.description: On your last day, enjoy a leisurely breakfast and check out of the hotel. It's time to make your way to Amman Airport for your flight back home, carrying with you a trove of unforgettable memories.

itinerary.title: Arrive at Maldives – Snorkelling - Vaadhoo Island
itinerary.description: Once you reach Maldives, you will be transferred to your hotel by our tour representative. After you have freshened up, begin your trip with water sports and activities. Lose yourself in the beauty of the underwater world through snorkelling. You can also inform our tour guide if you wish to try other things such as surfing. In the evening, you can head to Vaadhoo Island to witness the Glowing Beach's magic before returning to your hotel.

itinerary.title: Male - Dolphin Watching
itinerary.description: The second day of your beachy holiday starts with exploring the capital of Maldives, Male. Travel to famous spots such as the Male Fish Market, the Old Friday Mosque, and the National Museum. You will then be taken to Cinnamon Hakurra later in the day, where you can see some adorable dolphins playing around in their natural habitat.

itinerary.title: Island Hopping - Sunset Cruise
itinerary.description: The island of Maldives is filled with wonderful nature, which is why the third day of your trip is about exploring it in all its beauty. Meet the locals and interact with them to learn about life in the Maldives. Browse the local shops to get jewelry and souvenirs for yourself and your loved ones. In the evening, you will embark on the sunset cruise to enjoy the mesmerizing views and a scrumptious dinner. Get back to your hotel after the cruise and indulge in hours of rest and sleep.

itinerary.title: Depart from Maldives
itinerary.description: Get ready to check out from the hotel and head to the airport to catch your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrive at Maldives - Fishing – Parasailing
itinerary.description: After you land in the Maldives, you will be greeted by our tour representative, who will transfer you to the beautiful Coco Palm Bodu Hithi Resort on a speedboat. Once you’ve freshened up, your Maldivian holiday begins with fishing, a popular water sport in Maldives. Mornings are the perfect time to spot unique fishes such as the yellowfin tuna, wahoo, marlin, and swordfish. After fishing, get ready to experience the thrill of parasailing. After all, your trip to Maldives will not be complete without participating in water-based activities.

itinerary.title: Whale Shark Sighting – Sunset Cruise
itinerary.description: The second day of your tour will begin with a whale shark sighting, an experience you will always remember. You will be taken to the South Ari Atoll Marine Protected Area, the best spot to see whale sharks. During the evening, you can enjoy the sunset cruise and breathe in the gorgeous views while relishing a delicious dinner before returning to the hotel.

itinerary.title: Exploring Male
itinerary.description: On the third day, you will explore Male, the stunning capital of Maldives. Begin with hopping to Male Fish Market in the heart of the city. Learn about the history of Maldives at the National Museum before going to the oldest mosque in Maldives, the Old Friday Mosque. You can walk around the resort at the nearby beaches during the evening and relish a few relaxing moments.

itinerary.title: Depart from Maldives
itinerary.description: Get ready to check out from the hotel and head to the airport to catch your flight back home.

packages.name: Western Discovery Self-Drive Itinerary: Vancouver to Calgary in 13 Days
packages.destination: Vancouver - Victoria - Whistler - Kamloops - Jasper - Lake Louise - Columbia Icefields - Banff - Calgary

images.alt_text: Western Discovery Self-Drive Itinerary: Vancouver to Calgary in 13 Days
Western Discovery Self-Drive Itinerary: Vancouver to Calgary in 13 Days

itinerary.title: Arrival in Vancouver
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Vancouver International Airport, you can collect your vehicle from the car rental agency and then make your way to your hotel. In the evening, we recommend visiting Fly Over Canada (admission is included). This captivating 4D experience takes you on a gentle ride, where chairlift-style seats elevate you before a large spherical screen, creating a remarkable illusion of flying over stunning landscapes. You'll spend the night at your chosen hotel in Vancouver.

itinerary.title: Vancouver
itinerary.description: Today, you will embark on an exciting journey as you make your way to Vancouver's must-visit attractions. Begin your day with the tickets included for a captivating exploration of Grouse Mountain and the enchanting Capilano Suspension Bridge. As you traverse the iconic Lions Gate Bridge, keep an eye out for the exclusive homes nestled in British Properties. Along the way, take a delightful detour to visit the Capilano Salmon Hatchery before continuing to the renowned Capilano Suspension Bridge. At Capilano, prepare for a heart-pounding adventure on the Cliff Walk and immerse yourself in the Treetops Adventure. Afterwards, your journey leads you to Grouse Mountain, where you'll ascend to the mountaintop via the famous Skyride. While at Grouse Mountain, take a leisurely stroll and partake in various activities such as guided bird-watching tours, the captivating "Born to Fly" show at Theatre in the Sky, seasonal logging demonstrations, a ride on the Peak Chairlift, the thrilling Lumberjack Show, a visit to the Eye of the Wind, and so much more. The rest of the day is yours to explore Vancouver City at your own pace. You may want to visit the MacMillan Planetarium, experience the iconic Canada Place, indulge in shopping delights along Robson Street, or unwind at English Bay. Take a leisurely walk through the lush beauty of Stanley Park, explore Granville Island, experience the charm of Chinatown, and discover the historic allure of Gastown. As the day comes to a close, you'll spend the night at your hotel in Vancouver, where you can relax and recharge for more adventures to come.

itinerary.title: Vancouver to Victoria
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a delightful breakfast and today you will be heading to the Tsawwassen Ferry Terminal, where you'll embark on a delightful 90-minute journey aboard BC Ferries. This scenic voyage will take you across the picturesque Strait of Georgia, ultimately arriving at Swartz Bay. After disembarking, set off on a drive to Butchart Gardens, where your admission is already included. Butchart Gardens is renowned as one of Victoria's most treasured attractions and is internationally recognized as one of the world's most exquisite gardens. Following your time in the gardens, proceed to Victoria's Inner Harbour, where you can immerse yourself in the city's maritime heritage and colonial charm. Conclude your day with an overnight stay at your Victoria hotel.

itinerary.title: Victoria to Whistler
itinerary.description: Today, your journey takes you from Victoria to Whistler. Begin your day with the tickets for a Whale Watching Adventure included. As you gaze upon the stunning marine wildlife, keep an eye out for orca whales, seals, porpoises, and more. After this memorable experience, make your way to the Nanaimo ferry terminal for a 100-minute ferry ride aboard BC Ferries, heading towards Horseshoe Bay. Upon disembarking, embark on an awe-inspiring drive along the spectacular Sea-to-Sky Highway to Whistler. Along the way, revel in the breathtaking views, scenic ocean vistas, majestic mountains, and cascading waterfalls. During your journey, take a detour to visit Shannon Falls and explore the dramatic canyons. Your day concludes with an overnight stay at your Whistler hotel.

itinerary.title: Whistler
itinerary.description: Today, you will explore the charming town of Whistler. Begin your day by following the delightful aroma of freshly baked waffle cones to discover Whistler's finest ice cream parlours, bistros, and coffee shops. In the later afternoon, we will embark on an exciting adventure from Whistler village, taking a ride on the Peak-2-Peak Gondola (admission included). This remarkable gondola spans 3 kilometres, connecting the majestic peaks of Whistler and Blackcomb mountains. Don't miss the chance to board the Silver Gondolas, which feature glass bottoms, offering a 360-degree panoramic view. You'll also have the option to partake in various thrilling adventure activities in Whistler. You can choose to ride an All-Terrain Vehicle (ATV), experience the adrenaline rush of Whistler Bungee under the guidance of an experienced naturalist, or embark on a pedalling journey to Alta Lake. After reaching the lake, you'll paddle across its pristine waters and continue your adventure down the picturesque River of Golden Dreams. For the night, you will be staying at a comfortable hotel in Whistler.

itinerary.title: Whistler to Kamloops
itinerary.description: Today, you will embark on a picturesque drive from Whistler to Kamloops. Kamloops' vast and rugged landscape boasts a diverse terrain, ranging from silt bluffs to rolling hills, which has a magnetic pull on visitors from across the globe. Take in the breathtaking panoramic views of mountain ranges, lush agricultural fields, Kamloops Lake, and the confluence of the North and South Thompson Rivers right at the heart of the city. You will spend the night at a hotel in Kamloops.

itinerary.title: Kamloops to Jasper
itinerary.description: This morning, you will continue your journey, heading north along the Thompson River, passing through the Yellowhead Pass on your way to Jasper. As you traverse this stunning route, the mountains' part, revealing the mesmerising aquamarine, glacier-fed lakes perched high above emerald valleys and the graceful elk that graze in Jasper National Park. Your accommodation for the night will be at a hotel in Jasper.

itinerary.title: Jasper
itinerary.description: Today, you have a leisurely day ahead in Jasper. It's a wonderful opportunity to immerse yourself in the stunning landscape of Jasper National Park, which is rich in history and surrounded by some of the most rugged peaks in the Rockies. You can explore the Jasper town-site, visit the Athabasca Viewpoint, wander along the magnificent Maligne Canyon with its 50-metre-high walls, and learn about its unique underground water system. Later in the day, you'll get to enjoy a Maligne Lake Boat Cruise (admission is included), and we highly recommend considering a visit to Miette Hot Springs, White Water Rafting, Jasper Skytram, Sky Gazing, and many other exciting activities. Your overnight stay will be at a hotel in Jasper.

itinerary.title: Jasper to Lake Louise via Columbia Icefields
itinerary.description: After a delicious breakfast, it's time to check out and embark on a journey to Lake Louise via the awe-inspiring Icefields Parkway, known as Canada's most scenic mountain roadway. This route offers breathtaking vistas of glaciers, lakes, and waterfalls. Upon arrival at the Columbia Icefields Discovery Center, you'll have the opportunity to take the Glacier Adventure, which will transport you up to the Athabasca Glacier. Later, you can hop on a coach from the Discovery Center to reach the Glacier Skywalk, an observation platform with a glass floor that extends over the Sunwapta Valley, providing an unobstructed view of the surrounding glaciers. As you continue along the Parkway, you'll pass by the Crowfoot Glacier, Peyto Lake, and Bow Lake on your way to Lake Louise. You'll spend the night at a hotel in Lake Louise.

itinerary.title: Lake Louise to Banff
itinerary.description: Begin your day by savouring the tranquillity of Lake Louise, renowned for its mesmerising turquoise lake, encircled by towering peaks and graced by an elegant château. You have the freedom to choose from a variety of optional activities, including kayaking, exploring hiking trails leading to Lake Agnes, indulging in a spa experience, riding the Lake Louise Gondola, and more. In the afternoon, embark on a scenic drive to Banff. Upon arrival, complete your check-in at the hotel, and the remainder of the day is yours to explore the famous Banff Avenue. You'll be spending the night at the hotel in Banff.

itinerary.title: Banff
itinerary.description: Today, you have a leisurely day ahead to immerse yourself in the enchanting resort town of Banff, nestled amidst the towering peaks of Rundle, Tunnel, Cascade, and Norquay. Take in the beauty of Bow Falls, meander along Tunnel Mountain Drive, marvel at Surprise Corner, visit the Hoodoos, enjoy the views at Two Jack Viewpoint, and embark on a one-hour Lake Minnewanka Boat Cruise (admission included) to discover the local wildlife and vegetation, including the impressive Devil's Gap at the foot of the Rockies. For a breathtaking perspective of the Bow Valley, ascend Sulphur Mountain on a gentle ride aboard the Banff Gondola (admission included), offering a 360-degree panorama. In the afternoon, you can choose to hike along one of the well-maintained trails or a leisurely stroll through Banff's town centre, indulging in boutique shopping. You'll spend the night at the hotel in Banff.

itinerary.title: Banff to Calgary
itinerary.description: Begin your day by embarking on a scenic drive to Calgary. Upon your arrival, you can proceed to check in at your chosen hotel in Calgary. The remainder of the day is yours to enjoy at your leisure. You will spend the night at your hotel in Calgary.

itinerary.title: Depart from Calgary
itinerary.description: The morning grants you the freedom to explore Calgary at your own pace, with opportunities to discover the city's remarkable growth as a thriving hub of the oil industry. You may wish to visit Heritage Park, Fort Calgary, Stampede Park, and Canada Olympic Park. In the afternoon, it will be time to complete the check-out process, followed by returning your vehicle to the designated car rental agency's location at Calgary Airport. From there, you'll proceed to board your flight back home or head to your next exciting destination.

packages.name: Explore Adventure of Jordan for 8 Days | Itinerary
packages.destination: Amman Panoramic - Jerash - Ajloun - Dead Sea - Madaba - Nebo - Little Petra - Wadi Rum

images.alt_text: Explore Adventure of Jordan for 8 Days | Itinerary
Explore Adventure of Jordan for 8 Days | Itinerary

itinerary.title: Welcome to Jordan - Arrival in Amman
itinerary.description: Welcome to the beautiful land of Jordan! Upon your arrival at Amman Airport, you'll be warmly received by our representative who will assist you with the necessary visa formalities. From there, we'll make our way to the hotel for check-in. After a day of travel, the evening is yours to relax and unwind at your leisure. You'll spend the night in the comfort of your Amman hotel.

itinerary.title: Amman Panoramic Tour, Jerash, Ajloun, and the Dead Sea
itinerary.description: After a hearty breakfast, you will go for a panoramic tour of Amman, taking in the city's scenic beauty. Your journey then leads to the ancient Roman city of Jerash, where you will explore the well-preserved relics of a bygone era. Stroll along the ancient paved streets, marvel at the grand temples perched atop the hills, and immerse yourself in the history of this remarkable place. The site boasts theatres, spacious public squares, fountains, baths, and city walls that stand as a testament to the city's grandeur. Then, you will be heading north to Ajloun, a region of great ecological and historical significance in the Middle East. Your destination is the Ajloun Castle, also known as Qal’at Ar‐Rabad. This stunning example of Islamic architecture was constructed in 1184 AD by Saladin's general. Its purpose was to control the iron mines of Ajloun and serve as a strategic fortress to thwart the advances of the Crusaders. The castle stands as a guardian, strategically positioned to control the main routes leading to the Jordan valley and protect the communication links between Jordan and Syria. Your final destination for the day is the Dead Sea, the lowest point on Earth. Here, you'll have the opportunity to float effortlessly in the hypersaline waters, a truly unique and unforgettable experience. You'll spend the night at a hotel by the Dead Sea.

itinerary.title: Exploring the Enchanting Dead Sea
itinerary.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast and get ready for a day of leisure. Today, you have the freedom to explore the remarkable Dead Sea at your own pace. Nestled in the Jordan Rift Valley, the Dead Sea is a unique natural wonder, sitting at an astonishing 1,312 feet (400 metres) below sea level, making it the Earth's lowest point. The highlight of your visit will undoubtedly be the opportunity to float effortlessly in the warm, mineral-rich waters. It's an experience that's not to be missed. Spend the night at your comfortable hotel by the Dead Sea and enjoy your evening with a delicious dinner.

itinerary.title: Journey through History - Madaba, Mt. Nebo, Little Petra, and Petra
itinerary.description: After a satisfying breakfast, you will set off on a journey through history, starting with a visit to Madaba, a city renowned for its famous 6th-century Mosaic map of Jerusalem and the Holy Land. You'll also be captivated by the spectacular Byzantine and Umayyad mosaics that adorn this ancient city. Your next destination is Mount Nebo, a place of biblical significance, mentioned in the Bible as the location where Moses was granted a glimpse of the promised land that he would never enter. Continuing your adventure, you will proceed to Little Petra, also known as Al Beidha or "the White One" due to its pale rock colours. This archaeological gem is located north of Petra and the town of Wadi Musa. It's a Nabataean site with buildings skillfully carved into sandstone canyons. As the name suggests, Little Petra is smaller in scale, consisting of three more open areas connected by a 450-metre (1,480 ft) canyon. It's part of the Petra Archaeological Park but has its own distinct charm. Our final destination for the day is the legendary Petra. Rest for the night in a comfortable Petra hotel and savour a delightful dinner.

itinerary.title: Exploring the Marvels of Petra
itinerary.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast as you will embark on a journey to the ancient city of Petra, known as the Nabatean Red Rose city. This exceptional site has earned its place as one of the world's seven wonders and is designated as a UNESCO World Heritage site. Our adventure begins with a captivating walk through a gorge, flanked by towering cliffs that reach an astonishing height of 80 metres. As you meander through this narrow passage, take in the breathtaking colours and formations of the rocks that surround you. The city of Petra is vast and boasts an array of remarkable features, including intricate rock-cut tombs, a treasury, Roman-style theatres, temples, sacrificial altars, and grand colonnaded streets. After a day of exploration, you'll rest and recharge at your hotel in Petra, where a delicious dinner awaits.

itinerary.title: Discovering the Wonders of Wadi Rum
itinerary.description: Following a satisfying breakfast, you will be off to Wadi Rum, a natural reserve renowned for its awe-inspiring desert landscapes. Our mode of exploration is a thrilling jeep ride into the heart of the Jordanian desert. T.E. Lawrence once described Wadi Rum as "Vast, echoing and god-like," while locals affectionately call it the "Valley of the Moon." The day concludes with a comfortable stay at our hotel in Wadi Rum, where you can enjoy a delightful dinner.

itinerary.title: Journey to Amman
itinerary.description: After a nourishing breakfast, you will make your way to Amman, Jordan's capital city. Here, you have the option to explore the city at your own pace, taking in its vibrant culture and landmarks. You'll spend the night at your hotel, where a delectable dinner will be served.

itinerary.title: Farewell to Amman
itinerary.description: On this final day, begin with a satisfying breakfast at the hotel. It's time to bid Amman goodbye as you check out and head to the Amman airport for your flight back home. Take with you cherished memories that will last a lifetime.

packages.name: Beautiful Thailand Trip for 5 Days | Itinerary

images.alt_text: Beautiful Thailand Trip for 5 Days | Itinerary
Beautiful Thailand Trip for 5 Days | Itinerary

itinerary.title: Welcome to Bangkok - Pattaya
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at the Bangkok International airport, our team will be there to greet you and take you to your hotel in Pattaya. Check in and make yourself comfortable. The remainder of the day is yours to enjoy at your own pace. Spend a relaxing evening at the hotel in Pattaya. Optional Evening Activity: Alcazar Show (Additional Cost) Consider treating yourself to the renowned Alcazar Show, celebrated worldwide as Thailand's best transvestite cabaret show. Over the years, they have continuously enhanced their performance by incorporating innovative stage arts technology. Alcazar seamlessly combines the art of acting, stage design, costumes, and show sequences, leaving an impression on audiences of all ages. If you are up for a captivating and entertaining experience, the Alcazar Show is not to be missed.

itinerary.title: Pattaya – Coral Island
itinerary.description: After a delicious breakfast, embark on an adventure to Coral Island, the largest gem in Pattaya's island collection. Glide through the azure waters in a speedy boat, marveling at the picturesque surroundings. Discover the wonders of the sea as you peer through the transparent floor of a classic glass-bottomed boat, revealing a mesmerizing world of marine treasures and vibrant coral formations. Feel the thrill as you engage in thrilling water activities like Para Sailing and water skiing, creating unforgettable memories on the waves. The evening is yours to unwind and savour the tranquillity of Pattaya. Whether you choose to explore the local scene or relax at the hotel, the night is yours to enjoy. Rest well for another exciting day ahead.

itinerary.title: Pattaya to Bangkok (Approximately 149 Kms / 2 hrs 30 mins)
itinerary.description: Kickstart the day with a delightful breakfast. Today you will set off on a scenic drive from Pattaya to Bangkok. Upon reaching Bangkok, check into your hotel. The remainder of the day is yours to enjoy at your own pace. Spend a relaxing night at the hotel. Optional Tour: Chao Phraya Cruise Without Dinner (Additional Cost) Consider indulging in the Chao Phraya Cruise, sans dinner, at an extra cost. This option still promises the delightful experience of Thai cuisine, entertaining performances, and breathtaking river views. The Chao Phraya Cruise ensures an unforgettable dinner cruise adventure along the river, where you can absorb the picturesque riverside scenery. Historic temples and landmarks gracefully reveal themselves on both sides as you partake in a buffet-style dinner. A live band and talented singers add to the enjoyment with a diverse and captivating performance. Alternatively, you can choose the option with dinner for a more comprehensive experience.

itinerary.title: Explore Bangkok's Beauty
itinerary.description: After a kickstarting breakfast, you will set off on a delightful temple and city tour that promises to unveil the rich cultural treasures of this vibrant city. The highlight of the day is a visit to the Golden Buddha temple, a sanctuary that cradles an ancient golden Buddha. This seated marvel, standing at an impressive 3 metres tall and weighing five and a half tons, dates to the Sukhothai Period, offering a glimpse into Thailand's historical grandeur. Next on the agenda is the Marble Temple, also known as Wat Benchamabophit. This architectural masterpiece represents modern Thai religious artistry, with its main chapel constructed from exquisite white Carrara Italian marble. Inside, you will encounter a replica of Thailand's most beautiful Buddha image, adding to the temple's allure. Prepare to be captivated by the serenity and beauty that encapsulate these sacred sites. Overnight, find comfort at your hotel in Bangkok. Optional: Dive into Oceanic Wonders and Celebrities' World For those seeking an extra dose of excitement, consider exploring Sea Life Bangkok Ocean World (formerly Siam Ocean World), one of Southeast Asia's largest aquariums. Immerse yourself in various themed areas, including the innovative Shark Walk, where, instead of traversing through an acrylic tunnel, you will stroll above a tank inhabited by five species of majestic sharks. Alternatively, indulge in the enchanting world of Madame Tussauds Bangkok, a wax museum that brings celebrities, world leaders, activists, sports icons, legendary artists, and even royalty to life. Revel in the entertainment value and relish the opportunity to rub shoulders with these lifelike wax figures. (Additional cost applies)

itinerary.title: Farewell to Bangkok
itinerary.description: As the sun rises on your final day in Bangkok, bid the city a fond farewell. You will be transferred to Bangkok International Airport, where you will board your flight homeward or towards your next exciting destination.

packages.name: Exciting Bangkok Getaway for 4 Days | Itinerary

images.alt_text: Exciting Bangkok Getaway for 4 Days | Itinerary
Exciting Bangkok Getaway for 4 Days | Itinerary

itinerary.title: Arrival at Bangkok - Chao Phraya River Cruise
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Bangkok International Airport, a warm reception awaits you. You'll be whisked away to your hotel in Bangkok, where you can settle in and make yourself at home. Check-in and get ready for an evening of enchantment. As the night falls, go on a delightful adventure on the Chao Phraya River Cruise. Glide along the river, surrounded by the mesmerising city lights. This cruise promises an unforgettable dining experience with a delectable buffet, offering a feast for your taste buds. As you enjoy your meal, let the soothing tunes of a live band and the captivating performances of professional singers serenade you. The cruise unfolds a panorama of historic temples and landmarks on both sides, creating a magical ambiance. After this exciting experience, return to your hotel and rest for the night.

itinerary.title: Explore the Wonders of Bangkok
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a delightful breakfast before embarking on a fascinating temple and city tour. The highlight of this experience is a visit to the awe-inspiring Golden Buddha temple, home to an ancient golden Buddha. This seated masterpiece, standing at an impressive 3 metres tall and weighing a remarkable five and a half tons, dates back to the Sukhothai Period. Another captivating stop on your journey is the Marble Temple, also known as Wat Benchamabophit. This temple stands out as one of the most modern examples of Thai religious architecture. Its main chapel, constructed with exquisite white Carrara Italian marble, is home to a replica of the most beautiful Buddha image in Thailand. After this enriching tour, the rest of the day is yours to enjoy at your leisure. Settle in for a comfortable overnight stay at your hotel in Bangkok.

itinerary.title: Exploring Bangkok
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delightful breakfast. Today is all about you! Enjoy a full day at your own pace, with the freedom to explore the vibrant city of Bangkok at your leisure. Stay overnight at the hotel in the heart of Bangkok. Optional Excursions: Sea Life Bangkok Ocean World & Madame Tussauds (Additional Cost) For an extra special experience, consider a visit to Sea Life Bangkok Ocean World, formerly known as Siam Ocean World – Southeast Asia's largest aquarium. Dive into various themed areas, including the unique Shark Walk. Unlike a traditional tunnel, here you'll stroll above a tank where five different shark species gracefully swim. Alternatively, immerse yourself in the captivating world of Madame Tussauds Bangkok, a renowned wax museum. Enjoy the entertainment and the opportunity to mingle with lifelike wax figures of global celebrities, political leaders, activists, sports icons, legendary artists, and even royalty.

itinerary.title: Farewell to Bangkok
itinerary.description: After a delightful breakfast, it is time to bid farewell to Bangkok. This morning, a transfer will be arranged to take you to Bangkok International Airport.

packages.name: Vancouver & Whistler Winter Highlights: Explore the Best Vancouver Tour Packages

images.alt_text: Vancouver & Whistler Winter Highlights: Explore the Best Vancouver Tour Packages
Vancouver & Whistler Winter Highlights: Explore the Best Vancouver Tour Packages

itinerary.title: Arrival in Vancouver
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Vancouver International Airport, you will be transferred to your downtown Vancouver hotel. The remainder of the day is yours to explore Vancouver at your own pace. Vancouver, Canada's third-largest metropolis, is a bustling port city with a rich multicultural atmosphere. The city is graced with a breathtaking natural backdrop, featuring the Coast Mountains to the north, overlooking Burrard Inlet, and the waters of the Strait of Georgia to the west. Vancouver is renowned for its restaurants, shopping, vibrant nightlife, mild climate, and cosmopolitan vibe, making it a beloved destination for tourists. Spend the night at your Vancouver hotel.

itinerary.title: Vancouver & Capilano Suspension Bridge Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast, embark on a delightful tour of Vancouver, discovering its highlights. Begin your journey in historic Gastown and Chinatown, followed by a visit to the Canada Place Cruise Ship Terminal and the renowned shopping hub of Robson Street. Explore the sprawling 1000-acre Stanley Park, featuring Native Totem Poles and the lively Granville Island Public Market. Later, cross the Lion's Gate Bridge to explore the Capilano Suspension Bridge Park, home to the iconic Suspension Bridge, Treetops Adventure, and the thrilling Cliffwalk. In the evening, indulge in a delectable tasting menu of your choice at one of Vancouver's finest restaurants, such as Black and Blue, offering an inspired take on Chicago's classic steakhouses; Italian Kitchen, where you can experience a passionate and refined Italian culinary journey; or Coast Restaurant, known for offering the best seafood in British Columbia, embodying the true essence of West Coast dining. Retreat for the night at your Vancouver hotel.

itinerary.title: Vancouver
itinerary.description: Your morning begins with a delightful breakfast. The entire day is yours to enjoy at your leisure, giving you the freedom to explore the city at your own pace. If you're looking for an additional adventure, you have the option to embark on a one-day tour to Victoria. This tour offers the opportunity to visit renowned attractions such as Butchart Gardens, Victoria Harbour, the Royal BC Museum, and more. In the evening, you will return to your comfortable accommodation in Vancouver for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Vancouver – Whistler town:
itinerary.description: You will begin your journey from Vancouver to the charming town of Whistler. Early in the morning, you'll depart Vancouver on a scheduled coach transfer that will take you to this resort town, known for its wide range of winter activities. Upon your arrival and check-in at the hotel, your adventure continues with the remarkable Peak 2 Peak Alpine Experience. This experience offers breathtaking 360-degree views that encompass Whistler Village, majestic mountain peaks, serene lakes, pristine glaciers, and lush forests. The highlight of this experience is the ride on the world's longest unsupported span – the Whistler Peak 2 Peak Gondola, which seamlessly connects the two adjacent mountains of Whistler and Blackcomb. Not only is it the longest of its kind, but it's also the highest continuous lift. Originally designed for the convenience of skiers and snowboarders, it has become a beloved attraction for hikers and sightseers as well, providing them with a captivating journey between two internationally renowned hubs for snow and sun sports. As you traverse between these mountains, you'll be treated to incomparable views of the surrounding peaks, allowing you to breathe in some of the freshest mountain air while taking in the most spectacular vistas in all British Columbia. After a day filled with these awe-inspiring experiences, you will spend the night at your hotel in Whistler.

itinerary.title: Whistler
itinerary.description: On this fifth day of your journey, start your morning with a delicious breakfast. The day is yours to explore the charming Whistler village at your own pace. We highly recommend considering a guided Snowmobile Tour, a fantastic opportunity to experience the beauty of the backcountry with awe-inspiring vistas of Whistler Mountain. In the afternoon, why not give the Winter Zip lining a try? Soar through the forest on an exhilarating high-wire adventure. After a day filled with exciting activities, spend the night at your hotel in Whistler.

itinerary.title: Depart from Whistler to Vancouver
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a hearty breakfast, and then it's time to check out of your hotel. You'll be transferred to Vancouver Airport to catch your flight to your next destination.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Antananarivo
itinerary.description: Arrive at Ivato International Airport in Antananarivo, the capital city of Madagascar. Meet your tour guide and transfer to your hotel. Spend the rest of the day at leisure, exploring the city on your own. Overnight at the hotel in Antananarivo.

itinerary.title: Antananarivo – Morondava
itinerary.description: After breakfast, depart for Morondava, located on the western coast of Madagascar. Check in to your hotel and spend the rest of the day at leisure. In the evening, enjoy a sunset walk along the famous Avenue of the Baobabs, where you can witness the stunning silhouette of baobab trees against the sky. Travel to the craft market and the surrounding areas. Don’t miss visiting the traditional village of Betania on traditional pirogues to admire the fisherfolk and the mangroves. Drive back to Morondova and spend the night at a luxury hotel in Morondava.

itinerary.title: Morondava - Kirindy Reserve - Morondava
itinerary.description: After breakfast, embark on a day trip to the Kirindy Reserve, a protected area known for its unique wildlife. Don’t miss the baobabs, the villages, and the funerary structures of the Sakalava ethnic group. This group has been helping preserve the region’s unique biodiversity and prevent deforestation. Take a guided walk through the reserve, where you may spot different species of lemurs, fossas, bird species, and reptiles, including rare freshwater turtle species, baobab trees, palm trees, and medicinal plants. Enjoy a picnic lunch at a local restaurant in Kirindy Lodge amidst the reserve's natural beauty. Return to Morondava in the evening and spend the rest of the day leisurely. Overnight stay in Morondava.

itinerary.title: Morondava – Antsirabe
itinerary.description: After breakfast, depart from Morondava to Antsirabe while admiring the sunrise at Baobab Avenue. The city is famous for its colonial architecture and historical buildings. You will explore the beautiful city and the villages on the way to the Antsirabe to understand their daily life. Check-in at your hotel.

itinerary.title: Antsirabe – Antananarivo – Andasibe
itinerary.description: After breakfast, continue with your tour to explore Antsirabe. Later leave for Antananarivo and reach the place for midday lunch. Depart for Andasibe, a renowned national park known for its rich biodiversity, including several species of lemurs. Arrive in Andasibe and check into your hotel. Overnight stay in Andasibe.

itinerary.title: Andasibe
itinerary.description: After breakfast, visit the Analamazaotra Special Reserve, home to the Indri lemurs, the largest lemurs in Madagascar. The reserve is famous for its unique flora and fauna endemic to the country, including different varieties of orchids. Enjoy a guided walk through the park, accompanied by the unique calls of the indri lemurs. End your day at the reserve with lunch at the Vakona Private Park. Overnight at a luxury hotel in Andasibe.

itinerary.title: Andasibe – Antananarivo
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel in Andasibe and head to Antananarivo, stopping at the Peryeras Private Reserve to observe the various species of chameleons and other reptiles. Depending on your flight departure time, you may have the opportunity to explore the local markets for some last-minute souvenir shopping. Transfer to Ivato International Airport for your departure flight.

itinerary.title: Welcome to Taipei!
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Taipei International Airport, we'll be there to greet you and take you to your hotel. After checking in, take the rest of the day to relax and explore at your own pace. Enjoy a comfortable overnight stay at the hotel in Taipei.

itinerary.title: Explore Taipei's Beauty (Morning or Afternoon)
itinerary.description: Embark on a delightful half-day tour of Taipei, discovering iconic landmarks such as Chiang Kai-Shek Memorial Hall, Presidential Square (a quick pass-by), Martyrs Shrine, National Palace Museum, a local Taiwanese Temple, and the Handicraft Centre. Revel in the cultural richness and beauty of the city. Later, return to your hotel for a relaxing overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Farewell Taipei
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delicious breakfast before we transfer you to Taoyuan International Airport. It's time to bid farewell to Taipei as you board your flight.

packages.name: Enchanting Taiwan: Taipei, Kaohsiung, Taitung, Taroko | Itinerary

images.alt_text: Enchanting Taiwan: Taipei, Kaohsiung, Taitung, Taroko | Itinerary
Enchanting Taiwan: Taipei, Kaohsiung, Taitung, Taroko | Itinerary

itinerary.title: Welcome to Taipei
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Taoyuan International Airport, you'll be warmly greeted and taken to your hotel. After checking in, take the rest of the day to unwind and explore at your own pace. Spend a comfortable night at the hotel in Taipei.

itinerary.title: Discover Taipei's Charm
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delightful breakfast before embarking on a half-day tour of Taipei. Explore iconic landmarks such as the impressive Chiang Kai-Shek Memorial Hall, home to rich history and culture. Visit the National Palace Museum, showcasing a fascinating collection of Chinese imperial arts and jade spanning 5,000 years. Experience the solemnity of the Martyrs' Shrine with its traditional architecture and witness the captivating Change of Honor Guards ceremony. Immerse yourself in the local culture with a visit to a Taiwanese temple and indulge in the artistry of Taipei at the Taipei Handicraft Centre. The afternoon is yours to enjoy at your own pace. Spend another pleasant night at the hotel in Taipei.

itinerary.title: Exploring Sun Moon Lake from Taipei
itinerary.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast before embarking on a scenic drive to Sun Moon Lake, nestled in the heart of Taiwan at an elevation of 762 metres amidst the majestic mountains of Central Taiwan. Make your first stop at the renowned Wenwu Temple, also known as the Literature-Warrior Temple. This sacred site pays homage to Confucius as the Master of Pen and Kuan Ti as the Master of Sword. Take in the spiritual ambiance as you explore the Holy Monk Shrine and the Ci En Pagoda. Afterwards, head to your hotel, where you'll check in and have the opportunity to unwind in the natural hot springs of the Fleur de Chine Hotel, Sun Moon Lake. The tranquil setting offers a perfect escape for relaxation. Feel free to explore the surroundings at your own pace. Take a leisurely walk along the scenic trails, go for a bike ride, embark on a hike, or enjoy a serene boat ride on the lake. The choice is yours. As the day winds down, settle in for a comfortable overnight stay at the hotel in the enchanting Sun Moon Lake

itinerary.title: Sun Moon Lake, Foguangshan Monastery, and Kaohsiung
itinerary.description: Start your morning with a mouthwatering breakfast. You will go for a scenic drive past the charming Jiji Railway Station, a small and historic gem. Your destination is the renowned Fo Guang Shan Buddhist Monastery, the most celebrated sacred site in southern Taiwan. Immerse yourself in the teachings of Buddhism as you embark on a guided walking tour through the monastery, exploring the impressive "Buddha Memorial Centre." Engage in meaningful conversations with monks and nuns, gaining insights into their way of life. Don't miss the chance to savour a delicious Buddhist vegetarian lunch (available at your own expense). Continuing your journey, head to Kaohsiung City, the second-largest city in Taiwan. The tour unfolds along the picturesque Love River and culminates in the vibrant Liuhe Night Market, offering a plethora of local delights. Retreat to your comfortable hotel in Kaohsiung for a relaxing overnight stay.

itinerary.title: From Kaohsiung to Kenting and Zhiben Hot Springs
itinerary.description: Kickstart the day with a delightful breakfast. Start off on a journey to Kenting National Park, nestled at the southern tip of Taiwan. The park boasts 37 miles of coral-fringed coastline, creating a picturesque setting for our adventure. Along the way, we'll explore key attractions such as the Eluanbi lighthouse, Maobitou coastal scenic area, and Longpan Park. Our scenic drive continues as we head towards Taitung via the Southern Link Highway. The route promises breathtaking views and a memorable travel experience. The day concludes with a delightful stop at Hotel Royal Chihpen, where you can unwind in the soothing embrace of natural hot springs. Spend the night in comfort at the hotel in Taitung.

itinerary.title: Taitung – East Coast National Scenic Area – Taroko
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a delightful breakfast. Today promises an exhilarating East Coast Tour. The East Coast National Scenic Area, often hailed as "Taiwan's last unspoiled haven," unfolds along a mesmerising 170-kilometre stretch down the island's eastern shores. Nature's artistry, shaped by weathering, erosion, and accumulation, showcases a diverse array of captivating landforms. Make captivating stops at Xiaoyeliu, Sanxiantai, Shitiping (Stone Steps), a marble factory, and its accompanying showroom. As the afternoon unfolds, journey onwards to Hualien for a night's rest within the embrace of Taroko National Park. Let the evening unfold in the comfort of your Taroko hotel.

itinerary.title: Exploring Taroko National Park and Returning to Taipei
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a delightful breakfast before setting off on a journey to Taroko National Park. Witness the awe-inspiring Taroko Gorge, a magnificent and narrow ravine formed by the Liwu River, carving its way through solid marble mountains. A scenic road winds through sheer rock walls, surrounded by forested peaks and towering cliffs. As you travel, the river rushes below, alongside colossal marble boulders. Make stops at notable landmarks such as the Tunnel of Nine Turns, Ci Mu Bridge, Swallow Grotto, and Changchun Temple (Eternal Spring Shrine). On your way back to Taipei, take a moment to appreciate the breathtaking Cingshui Cliff and traverse the Syue-Shan Long Tunnel, spanning 12.9 kilometres. Retire for the night at your Taipei hotel.

itinerary.title: Departing from Taipei
itinerary.description: Wake up to a delicious breakfast and prepare for your departure. In the morning, you'll be transferred to the International Airport to catch your flight home.

packages.name: Splendours of South Africa: An Unforgettable GT Holidays Tour Package
packages.destination: Cape Town - Knysna - Oudtshoorn - Cape Peninsula Tour - Johannesburg - Kwantu - Sun City - Day At Leisure

images.alt_text: Splendours of South Africa: An Unforgettable GT Holidays Tour Package
Splendours of South Africa: An Unforgettable GT Holidays Tour Package

itinerary.title: Arrival in Cape Town
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Cape Town International Airport, one of our representatives will be there to greet you and provide a private transfer to your hotel. After checking in, the remainder of the day is yours to relax and enjoy at your own pace. You'll spend the night at your hotel in Cape Town.

itinerary.title: Cape Town Exploration
itinerary.description: Today, we begin our day with a city tour that includes a visit to Table Mountain. Our journey takes us past several noteworthy landmarks, offering a glimpse into the rich history of Cape Town. We'll drive by the Houses of Parliament, District Six, Green Market Square, the South African National Museum, Clifton, and Sea Point. As we head towards the city centre, you'll catch sight of famous sites like the Castle of Good Hope, constructed in 1666 by the Dutch East India Company, and City Hall, an elegant baroque building located at the Grand Parade. Continuing along Adderley Street, we'll come across St. George's Cathedral, which serves as the Anglican Diocese of the Nobel Peace Laureate, Archbishop Desmond Tutu. Our route will also lead us past the Company Gardens and the Malay Quarter, known as the Bo-Kaap. This area earned its name, which means "Above Cape," due to its location against the slopes of Table Mountain. In the early 18th century, Cape Town saw the arrival of thousands of slaves from Java, Ceylon, and other Far Eastern regions. You'll spend the night at your hotel in Cape Town.

itinerary.title: Cape Peninsula Exploration
itinerary.description: After your breakfast, get ready for a full-day tour of the stunning Cape Peninsula. Don't forget your camera, as we're heading to Cape Point, located at the southwest tip of the Cape Peninsula, offering some of the most breathtaking views in the world. On our way back to Cape Town, we'll pass by notable landmarks like the University of Cape Town, Rhodes Memorial, and the Groote Schuur Hospital. You'll also have the option to embark on a half-hour cruise to "Seal Island." We'll make a stop at Chapmans Peak to observe the charming Jackass Penguin Colony at Boulders, and then continue our journey to Cape Point and the Cape of Good Hope. Our day will include a visit to the picturesque Kirstenbosch Botanical Gardens. After a day of exploration, you'll return to your hotel in Cape Town for the night.

itinerary.title: Cape Town to Knysna
itinerary.description: Following breakfast, embark on a private transfer to Knysna. In the evening, enjoy a scenic sunset cruise on the Knysna Lagoon aboard the John Benn. After the cruise, return to the hotel, and the rest of the evening is yours to relax and enjoy at your leisure. Spend the night at the hotel in Knysna.

itinerary.title: Knysna – Full-Day Trip to Oudtshoorn
itinerary.description: Following breakfast, embark on a full-day excursion to Oudtshoorn, where you'll explore the mesmerising Cango Caves, visit an ostrich farm, and experience the Cango Wildlife Ranch. Return to the hotel in the evening and enjoy the rest of your night at your leisure. Spend the night at the Knysna hotel.

itinerary.title: Knysna to Kwantu Game Reserve
itinerary.description: After breakfast, complete the hotel check-out and make your way to Kwantu Game Reserve. You'll have a late lunch at the lodge. In the afternoon, delight in a game drive within the reserve and then return to the lodge for dinner. Your overnight stay will be at the Lodge in Kwantu Game Reserve.

itinerary.title: Kwantu Game Reserve
itinerary.description: Savour a complete day of game drives, beginning early in the morning. This allows you to witness wildlife in their natural surroundings as they go about their daily routines. Spend the night at the Lodge in Kwantu Game Reserve.

itinerary.title: Kwantu Game Reserve to Port Elizabeth
itinerary.description: Start your day with a dawn game drive through the reserve. After the game drive, head back to the lodge for breakfast. Then, it's time to check out from the lodge and continue to Port Elizabeth via a private transfer. Along the way, you have the option to stop at the Bloukrans Bridge for an adrenaline-pumping bungee jumping experience (optional) or proceed to the Tsitsikamma Forest for a thrilling zip line adventure (this is optional). Upon reaching Port Elizabeth, check in at the hotel, and the rest of the day is yours to enjoy at your leisure. Spend the night at the hotel in Port Elizabeth.

itinerary.title: Port Elizabeth to Johannesburg and Sun City
itinerary.description: After breakfast today, you'll be taken to Port Elizabeth airport for your flight to Johannesburg. Please note that the flight cost is not included in the package. Upon landing in Johannesburg, you'll continue with a private transfer to Sun City. Upon reaching Sun City, check in at the hotel. The rest of the day is yours to explore the resort at your leisure. You'll spend the night at the hotel in Sun City.

itinerary.title: Sun City - A Relaxing Day
itinerary.description: Start the day with a delightful breakfast. Today is a day for relaxation and leisure. You can enjoy endless entertainment at the Valley of the Waves, with exciting options like concerts, sporting events, and more. Spend the night at the hotel in Sun City.

itinerary.title: Sun City to Johannesburg
itinerary.description: After enjoying breakfast this morning, it's time to check out of the hotel. You'll embark on a private transfer to the Gold Reef Tour in Johannesburg, where you can explore fascinating historical gold mining attractions (this is optional). Following the tour, you'll be taken to the hotel for check-in. Enjoy your overnight stay in Johannesburg.

itinerary.title: Leaving Johannesburg
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast at your hotel. Make use of the complimentary shuttle service provided by Emperor's Palace to reach JNB Airport for your return flight home.

Vancouver and West Coast Splendour | 5-day Itinerary

itinerary.title: Arrival in Vancouver
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival in Vancouver, you will be transferred to your hotel. Later in the afternoon, you'll have the opportunity to visit FlyOver Canada, an extraordinary 4D show that offers a unique perspective on Canada. FlyOver Canada presents a breathtaking flight simulation ride that is unlike any other. As you take off into a massive dome screen equipped with cutting-edge projection and ride technology, you'll experience the sensation of true flight, complete with the effects of wind, scents, and mist. The immersive experience includes special effects like wind, mist, and scents, combined with the motion of the chairs, creating a sensation of genuine flight. The entire FlyOver Canada experience has a duration of approximately 25 minutes. Your journey begins with "Uplift," an inspiring audio-visual pre-show designed to prepare you for your flight. Following this, you will proceed to the boarding area, where our knowledgeable flight guides will assist you in preparing for the Ultimate Flying Ride. The ride itself lasts around 8 minutes. After this thrilling experience, you will spend the night at your hotel in Vancouver.

itinerary.title: Vancouver
itinerary.description: Today you will join a full-day excursion from Vancouver to Victoria, which includes admission to the stunning Butchart Gardens. After a delicious breakfast, you will set off for an exciting adventure. The Victoria and Butchart Gardens Tour commences with a mesmerising 90-minute cruise on BC Ferries, promising an unforgettable journey. The scenic beauty along the way is so captivating that you won't want to blink; simply sit back and savour the breathtaking vistas as you cross the Georgia Strait and pass through the Gulf Islands. Your exploration continues as you reach the Inner Harbour of Victoria, the capital city of British Columbia, which was named in honour of Queen Victoria. From there, you will visit Butchart Gardens, a sprawling 55-acre oasis of meticulously manicured natural beauty. This tour promises a truly splendid day trip, fit for royalty. After a day filled with such extraordinary experiences, you will return to your hotel in Vancouver for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Vancouver – Tour to Whistler and Shannon Falls
itinerary.description: On Day 3 of your itinerary, you'll set off on a tour from Vancouver to Whistler after enjoying a delicious breakfast. Whistler, renowned for its excellence, was the proud host of the 2010 Olympic Winter Games and is a world-class, year-round resort located amidst the stunning Central Mountain range. Your journey along the Sea to Sky Highway is nothing short of spectacular, treating you to mesmerising views of the ocean and mountains, which include the magnificent Shannon Falls and the culturally rich Squamish Adventure Centre. The awe-inspiring backdrop of Whistler and Blackcomb Mountain will gradually unveil itself before your eyes, setting the stage for the adventure that awaits you in Whistler Village. During your visit to Whistler Village, you have the option to enhance your experience by purchasing admission to the thrilling Peak to Peak Gondola Ride. After an eventful day, you'll return to your hotel in Vancouver for a comfortable overnight stay. Enjoy your evening!

itinerary.title: Vancouver
itinerary.description: Today in Vancouver, your day begins with a delightful breakfast at the hotel. If you dream of a perfect day trip that combines city sights with a tranquil forest escape, look no further - this tour is tailor-made for you. You'll embark on a relaxing journey with our expert guides who provide fascinating commentary as you explore the lively downtown of Vancouver. Marvel at the breathtaking waterfront landmarks, including the iconic sails of Canada Place and the bustling shopping hub of Robson Street. Following this, you'll be treated to a stunning view of the Lions Gate Bridge as you make your way to the heart-pounding adventure of Capilano Suspension Bridge Park. Our adventure continues with a visit to the sandy shores of English Bay on the west side of Stanley Park, a stop at Granville Island, and a picturesque drive through the historic neighborhoods of Chinatown and Gastown. The tour also includes admission to Capilano Suspension Bridge Park, where you can experience the exhilarating Cliffwalk and Treetops Adventure. After a day filled with unforgettable experiences, you'll spend the night at your hotel in Vancouver.

itinerary.description: Wake up to a delicious breakfast. Today, it's time to check out from your hotel and make your way to Vancouver Airport for your departure.
