images.alt_text: South Africa Holiday Packages: A Journey of Wonders with GT Holidays
South Africa Holiday Packages: A Journey of Wonders with GT Holidays

itinerary.title: Arrival in Cape Town
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Cape Town International Airport, you will be warmly greeted by a representative and taken to your hotel. Enjoy a comfortable transfer in a 2-seater sedan with a driver. The remainder of the day is yours to explore at your own pace. Spend the night at your Cape Town hotel.

itinerary.title: Cape Town - Half-Day City Tour
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a delightful breakfast before embarking on a half-day city tour of Cape Town. If the weather allows, you'll have the opportunity to visit Table Mountain, a true natural wonder. On the way, you'll also pass by notable landmarks such as the Castle of Good Hope, Company Gardens, Parliament Buildings, City Hall, the Slave Lodge, and the charming Malay Quarter. The tour will include a visit to Diamond Cutters, where you can witness the art of crafting exquisite gems. After the tour, you'll have the option to return to your hotel or be dropped off at the Victoria & Alfred Waterfront, a vibrant hub of activities and dining. Enjoy a comfortable overnight stay at your Cape Town hotel.

itinerary.title: Cape Town - Cape Peninsula Tour
itinerary.description: Full Day Cape Peninsula Tour with Stops at Hout Bay Harbour, Optional Seal Island Cruise (Weather Permitting), Chapman's Peak Drive (if open), Lunch (on your own), Visit to Cape Point National Park (with Funicular Tour included), Stop at Simon's Town and Boulders Beach Penguin Colony, and a Visit to Kirstenbosch Botanical Gardens. Rest for the night at your Cape Town hotel. It's a full day of adventure and exploration on the Cape Peninsula. We begin our day with a stop at Hout Bay Harbour, where you can choose to go on a Seal Island Cruise (subject to weather conditions). Following that, we may take a scenic drive along Chapman's Peak Drive, provided it's open for travel. Lunch arrangements are at your discretion. Then, we'll visit Cape Point National Park, where a Funicular Tour is included. Our next destination is Simon's Town, home to the charming Boulders Beach Penguin Colony, which is also included in your tour. Finally, our day culminates at the Kirstenbosch Botanical Gardens. You'll spend the night at your hotel in Cape Town.

itinerary.title: Cape Town - George
itinerary.description: Following your morning meal, set out on a private transfer to Knysna, travelling along the N2. During the journey, you'll have the chance to enjoy the George John Benn Cruise within the Featherbed Nature Reserve. Upon your arrival in George, check in at your hotel, and the remainder of the day is yours to spend at your leisure. You'll spend the night at your hotel in George.

itinerary.title: Knysna - Full-Day Oudtshoorn Adventure
itinerary.description: Following breakfast, embark on a day trip to Oudtshoorn, where you'll explore the Cango Caves, visit an ostrich farm, and discover the Cango Wildlife Ranch. Return to your hotel, and the rest of the evening is yours to enjoy at your leisure. Spend the night at your Knysna hotel.

itinerary.title: George to Johannesburg to Sun City (Flight Not Included)
itinerary.description: After enjoying your breakfast this morning, y you will be chauffeured to George Airport for your flight to Johannesburg. Please keep in mind that the flight cost is not included in the package (We recommend a flight around 09:00). Upon your arrival in Johannesburg, a private transfer will be arranged to take you to Sun City. You'll check in at the hotel, and the rest of the day is yours to explore the resort at your own pace. Enjoy your overnight stay at the hotel in Sun City.

itinerary.title: Sun City - A Day of Relaxation
itinerary.description: Today, you have the entire day to unwind and enjoy the delightful offerings of Sun City. You can indulge in endless enjoyment at the Valley of the Waves, where thrilling entertainment, concerts, sports events, and more await. There are no optional activities today. In the evening, you will spend the night at the lodge in Pilanesberg National Park, where you can look forward to memorable game drives. Enjoy your overnight stay at the hotel in Sun City.

itinerary.title: Sun City to Pilanesberg National Park
itinerary.description: Today, we'll travel from Sun City to Pilanesberg National Park. In the afternoon, we'll set out for a thrilling game drive in Pilanesberg National Park. Afterward, enjoy a delicious Western-style dinner at the lodge. You'll spend the night at the hotel in Pilanesberg.

itinerary.title: Pilanesberg National Park
itinerary.description: Savour a leisurely day at the Game Reserve. Start with a morning game drive and enjoy a delicious lunch. In the afternoon, embark on another game drive in the beautiful Pilanesberg National Park. Then, relish a delectable Western-style dinner at the lodge. You'll spend the night at the hotel in Pilanesberg.

itinerary.title: Pilanesberg National Park to Johannesburg
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delicious breakfast and check out of the hotel. You'll then continue your journey with a private transfer to Johannesburg, where you will be dropped off at your hotel. Enjoy an overnight stay in Johannesburg.

itinerary.title: Johannesburg - Gold Reef City Exploration
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a visit to Gold Reef City for a captivating half-day tour. Dive into the rich heritage of this site and discover the art of gold pouring. After the tour, our team will take you back to your hotel for a comfortable drop-off. Enjoy your overnight stay in Johannesburg.

itinerary.title: Leaving Johannesburg
itinerary.description: Today, it's time to check out of your accommodation and make your way to O.R. Tambo International Airport for your journey back home.

itinerary.title: Arrival at Taipei!
itinerary.description: As you touch down at Taipei International Airport, our friendly team will be there to greet you and whisk you away to your hotel. After a smooth check-in, take it easy for the rest of the day. Your night will be spent comfortably at the hotel in Taipei.

itinerary.title: Half day tour to Taipei City, Jiufen Village, and the NorthEast Coast
itinerary.description: Start the day with a delightful breakfast and then set off on a half-day tour of Taipei City and the National Palace Museum. Immerse yourself in the rich history and culture as you visit iconic landmarks like Chiang Kai-Shek Memorial Hall, Presidential Square, and Martyrs’ Shrine. Explore a local Taiwanese Temple and indulge in the artistry at the Handicraft Centre. In the afternoon, set off on a captivating tour to Jiufen Village, where you will be captivated by its unique charm. Marvel at the stunning Nanya Rock Formations and take in the breathtaking scenery of the Bay of Two Colours. Discover the intriguing Jinguashi 13 Ruins before returning to your hotel in Taipei for a restful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Exploring Taroko Gorge in Taiwan
itinerary.description: Today's adventure begins with a hearty breakfast before heading to Taipei Main Station for a scenic train journey to Hualien, the gateway to Taroko Gorge. Get ready to be mesmerised by the wonders of nature as we explore some incredible sights. Our first stop is the Shakadang Trail, where you will stroll along the mesmerising Eternal Spring Shrine (Changchun Temple). Next up, we will visit the impressive Swallow Grotto (Tianxiang) and witness the breathtaking views. Do not miss the chance to discover the artistry of marble at the Marble Factory. We will also make a visit to Qixing Lake and the Hualien Stone Sculptural Park before leaving back to Taipei. Once we arrive, it is time to settle in and unwind at our hotel in Taipei.

itinerary.title: Farewell Taipei
itinerary.description: After a delicious breakfast, it is time to bid Taipei farewell. You will be transferred to Taoyuan International Airport, where you can catch your flight back home or continue your journey to the next exciting destination.

packages.name: Mesmerise South Africa: Unveiling GT Holidays’ Holiday Packages
packages.destination: Cape Town - Peninsular Tour - Knysna - Oudtshoorn - Sun City - Johannesburg

images.alt_text: Mesmerise South Africa: Unveiling GT Holidays’ Holiday Packages
Mesmerise South Africa: Unveiling GT Holidays’ Holiday Packages

itinerary.title: Arrival in Cape Town
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Cape Town International Airport, a friendly representative will greet you and accompany you to your hotel. You'll have the remainder of the day to leisurely explore the city at your own pace. Enjoy your overnight stay at the hotel in Cape Town.

itinerary.title: Cape Town - Exploring the City
itinerary.description: Enjoy a leisurely breakfast before embarking on a half-day tour of Cape Town. If the weather is on our side, we'll ascend Table Mountain. We'll also take you on a scenic drive past iconic landmarks like The Castle of Good Hope, Company Gardens, Parliament Buildings, City Hall, the Slave Lodge, and the charming Malay Quarter. You'll spend the night at your Cape Town hotel.

itinerary.title: Cape Town - Peninsula Excursion
itinerary.description: Enjoy a full day exploring the picturesque Cape Peninsula. We'll make a stop at Hout Bay Harbour, take a cruise to Seal Island, and, weather permitting, drive along the breathtaking Chapmans Peak Drive. Our journey continues to Cape Point National Park, where we'll take a funicular tour. Afterward, we'll visit Simons Town, the charming Boulders Beach Penguin Colony, and the lush Kirstenbosch Botanical Gardens. You'll spend the night at your Cape Town hotel.

itinerary.title: Cape Town to Knysna
itinerary.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast at the hotel, and then complete the check-out process. You'll embark on a journey to Knysna via the N2 road. Once you arrive, you'll check in at your hotel. The remainder of the day is yours to relax and enjoy at your own pace. You'll spend the night at the hotel in Knysna.

itinerary.title: Knysna - Oudtshoorn - Knysna
itinerary.description: Today, we will journey over the picturesque Outeniqua Mountain Pass to reach Oudtshoorn, renowned as the feather capital of the world. Our day includes a visit to the fascinating Cango Caves and the captivating Cango Wildlife Ranch. You'll also get the chance to explore an Ostrich Farm Tour. After our adventures, we will be returning to our hotel in Knysna for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Knysna to Sun City via Johannesburg
itinerary.description: We'll arrange a transfer to George Airport for your flight to Johannesburg, though please note that the flight cost is not included (we recommend a departure around 10:00 AM). Upon landing at O.R. Tambo International Airport, a Thompsons Africa representative will be there to greet you and transfer you to Sun City. Check in at the hotel and enjoy the rest of the day at your leisure. You'll spend the night at the hotel in Sun City.

itinerary.title: Enjoying Sun City
itinerary.description: Today is your day to relax and unwind. There are no scheduled tours, and you won't have a vehicle or guide at your disposal. If you're interested in exploring, there's an option to go on a safari in the Pilanesberg National Park, but you'll need to arrange and pay for it directly with the suppliers. After your day of leisure, you'll spend the night at the hotel in Sun City.

itinerary.title: Sun City to Johannesburg
itinerary.description: You'll be driven to your chosen hotel in Johannesburg, where you can enjoy a leisurely day. Rest for the night at your Johannesburg hotel.

itinerary.title: Leaving Johannesburg
itinerary.description: This morning, it's time to check out and make your way to O.R. Tambo International Airport for your departure.

packages.name: Canadian Rockies Self Drive Adventure: A 7-Day Itinerary
packages.destination: Calgary - Banff - Lake Louise - Jasper - Edmonton

images.alt_text: Canadian Rockies Self Drive Adventure: A 7-Day Itinerary
Canadian Rockies Self Drive Adventure: A 7-Day Itinerary

itinerary.title: Arrival in Calgary
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Calgary International Airport, you will proceed to the car rental location to collect your vehicle. Afterward, you will head to your hotel. The rest of the day is yours to explore and create your own urban adventure, allowing you to form your initial impressions of Western Canada. You will spend the night at your Calgary hotel.

itinerary.title: Calgary to Banff
itinerary.description: Start the day with a delightful breakfast. Today, you will depart for Banff. Upon reaching Banff, you will check in at your hotel. You will spend the night at your Banff hotel

itinerary.title: Banff
itinerary.description: Today, you have a leisurely day to enjoy the picturesque resort town of Banff, nestled amidst the majestic Rundle, Tunnel, Cascade, and Norquay mountains. You can embark on a delightful exploration, starting with visits to Bow Falls, Tunnel Mountain Drive, Surprise Corner, Hoodoos, Two Jack Viewpoint, and a scenic Lake Minnewanka Boat Cruise (admission is included), lasting for one hour. This cruise provides a captivating glimpse of the local wildlife and lush vegetation, including the awe-inspiring Devil’s Gap, nestled at the foothills of the Rockies. For a gentle and panoramic ascent, you can take a ride on the Banff Gondola (admission is included), which transports you to the summit of Sulphur Mountain, offering a stunning 360-degree view of the Bow Valley. In the afternoon, you have the option to embark on a hike along one of the well-maintained trails or take a leisurely stroll through the charming town of Banff, where you can explore the various boutiques and shops. You will spend the night at your hotel in Banff.

itinerary.title: Banff to Lake Louise
itinerary.description: After enjoying your breakfast, begin your day by embarking on a scenic drive through the Bow Valley towards Lake Louise. The enchanting emerald-coloured lake, set against the backdrop of the Victoria Glacier, is certain to etch an unforgettable memory in your heart. Spend the night at a Lake Louise hotel.

itinerary.title: Lake Louise to Jasper
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delightful breakfast. Today, you'll embark on a journey to Jasper via the Icefields Parkway, renowned as Canada's most picturesque mountain route, adorned with glaciers, lakes, and waterfalls. Your adventure continues as you reach the Columbia Icefields Discovery Center, where you'll board the Ice Explorer for an exhilarating ride up the Athabasca Glacier. Subsequently, hop on a coach from the Discovery Center to reach the Glacier Skywalk, an awe-inspiring glass-floored observation platform that offers uninterrupted vistas of the surrounding glaciers and the Sunwapta Valley. As you proceed along the Parkway, don't miss the opportunity to admire the beauty of Crowfoot Glacier, Peyto Lake, and Bow Lake, all on your way to Jasper. Spend the night at Jasper hotel.

itinerary.title: Jasper
itinerary.description: Today, you have a free day to fully immerse yourself in the stunning and distinct natural beauty of Jasper National Park, nestled amidst the rugged peaks of the Rockies. Take the time to explore Jasper's town-site, the breathtaking Athabasca Viewpoint, the captivating Maligne Canyon, and the serene Maligne Lake. As you stroll along the towering 50-metre walls of Maligne Canyon, you'll discover its unique underground water system. Later in the day, enjoy a cruise on Maligne Lake (admission included), and we recommend considering a visit to Miette Hot Springs, a thrilling White Water Rafting experience, a ride on the Jasper Skytram, some mesmerising Sky Gazing, and more. Your overnight stay will be at Jasper hotel.

itinerary.title: Depart from Jasper to Edmonton
itinerary.description: Today, you will make your way to Edmonton Airport. Upon arrival, return your rental vehicle to the car rental agency and then proceed to the airport for your journey back home or to your next exciting destination.

packages.name: Singapore with Thailand
packages.destination: Singapore - Sentosa Island - Bangkok - Pattaya - Coral Island

itinerary.title: Arrive in Singapore – Night Safari
itinerary.description: As soon as you land at Changi Airport, our tour representative will greet you and take you to the hotel. We’ll leave you to check in and rest before proceeding to the first activity – the Night Safari on the Mandai Wildlife Reserve. This open-air zoo is the first of its kind and is home to thousands of animals.

itinerary.title: Singapore City Tour
itinerary.description: The second day begins with exploring the different tourist attractions in the city, namely, Gardens By The Bay, a nature park spread over 101 hectares; the National Gallery, a museum showcasing Southeast Asian art collections; the Merlion Park, famous for the Merlion Statue, a half-lion and half-fish statue. Some other places covered in the tour include the Esplanade Theatre, Suntec City, and Marina Bay. You’ll also visit the Indian National Army Monument in downtown Singapore built in 1995 to honour the brave INA soldiers who died fighting the British in India and Burma, and the Singapore Zoo, which is home to over 2,800 animals.

itinerary.title: Sentosa Island – Universal Studios
itinerary.description: Check out from the city hotel to transfer to Sentosa Island. You’ll begin your adventure with Universal Studios, Southeast Asia's first and only Universal Studios theme park. The park is famous for its amazing rides, games, and interactive shows based on old Hollywood movies like Jurassic Park, Madagascar and Shrek.

itinerary.title: Sentosa Island Tour
itinerary.description: The next day you can enjoy the remaining attractions on Sentosa Island. There are over 25 attractions, ranging from SEA Aquarium and Adventure Cove Waterpark to Madame Tussauds and Palawan Beach. You can also experience the cable car ride from Mount Faber to Sentosa Island or enjoy Skyline Luge and Skyride, an open-air cart drive for a majestic view of the island.

itinerary.title: Singapore – Pattaya - Big Buddha Temple - Dolphin World
itinerary.description: On your fifth day, board your flight from Singapore to Bangkok. Our tour representatives will meet you at the airport and transfer you to your hotel in Pattaya. The first destination in Pattaya is the Big Buddha Temple, where Buddha's idol stands at 300 feet. After witnessing this spiritually rich spot, you can head for a dolphin show at Dolphin World, which kids will surely enjoy.

itinerary.title: Coral Island - Night Bazaar
itinerary.description: On Day 6, take a speedboat to explore the scenic Coral Island, the largest island in Pattaya and one of the most visited tourist attractions. You can stroll with your loved one on the island’s golden beaches or engage in parasailing, snorkelling, banana boat riding and other water-based activities. You can end your day by visiting Pattaya’s popular Night Bazaar, a famous street market selling clothes, accessories, and souvenirs.

itinerary.title: Pattaya – Bangkok
itinerary.description: Begin your day by driving from Pattaya to Bangkok. You can enjoy the rest of the day at leisure or go for a cruise on the Chao Phraya River to enjoy dinner, dance, and live music. The Chao Phraya River Cruise offers a memorable view of the riverside scenery, where you can admire the beautiful temples and landmarks. And to finish the day attend a Cabaret Show to experience glitz and glamour.

itinerary.title: Bangkok City Tour
itinerary.description: Experience the power and magnificence of Thai Royalty early in the day by visiting the Grand Palace, where the King of Thailand resides. The Golden Buddha Temple is another highlight of the day, famous for its seated Buddha that weighs five and a half tons and is from the Sukhothai period. Don’t miss Wat Pho, the reclining Buddha temple famous for its 15 metres tall and 46 metres long Buddha. The soles of this Buddha are crafted with mother-of-pearl shells. Drink in the serenity and peace at Wat Arun, the Temple of the Dawn, one of Thailand’s oldest and most famous temples.

itinerary.title: Depart from Bangkok
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.
