images.alt_text: Wildlife Delight: 3-Day Kruger Tour Adventure with GT Holidays
Wildlife Delight: 3-Day Kruger Tour Adventure with GT Holidays

itinerary.title: Arrival in Johannesburg
itinerary.description: As you land at OR Tambo International Airport, a welcoming representative will greet you. They will then escort you to your awaiting vehicle, which will transport you to your chosen game lodge in Kruger National Park or nearby hotels. Enjoy the remainder of the day at your own pace. You'll spend the night at the lodge.

itinerary.title: Kruger National Park
itinerary.description: Start with a hearty breakfast. A full day of game drives awaits those staying outside the Kruger National Park. For clients inside the park, enjoy early morning and afternoon game drives. Spend the night at the lodge.

itinerary.title: Depart Johannesburg
itinerary.description: After breakfast you will be collected and transferred back to OR Tambo International Airport for your onward flight.

packages.name: Exploring Calgary, Banff and Lake Louise | Itinerary

images.alt_text: Exploring Calgary, Banff and Lake Louise | Itinerary
Exploring Calgary, Banff and Lake Louise | Itinerary

itinerary.title: Arrival at Calgary Airport and Transfer to Banff
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Calgary International Airport, you will be transferred to your hotel in Banff. After checking in, you'll have the rest of the day to leisurely explore the renowned Banff Avenue. You will spend the night at your Banff hotel.

itinerary.title: Banff to Lake Louise - Scenic Exploration
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delightful breakfast and then by checking out of your hotel and leaving your luggage in the lobby. You'll then embark on an Explore Banff Tour that offers stunning vistas of the resort town of Banff, nestled amid the towering mountains of Rundle, Tunnel, Cascade, and Norquay. The tour will include stops at Bow Falls, Tunnel Mountain Drive, Surprise Corner, Hoodoos, Two Jack Viewpoint, and Lake Minnewanka. Here, you have the option to take a one-hour boat cruise to observe the local wildlife and vegetation, including the intriguing Devil’s Gap at the foothills of the Rockies. Later, you'll enjoy a gentle ride on the Banff Gondola, which will take you to the summit of Sulphur Mountain, providing a breathtaking 360-degree panorama of the Bow Valley. In the afternoon, you will be transferred from Banff to Lake Louise, where you'll find the famous turquoise, glacier-fed lake surrounded by towering peaks and graced by a magnificent chateau. You will spend the night at your Lake Louise hotel.

itinerary.title: Lake Louise
itinerary.description: On the third day of your journey, you will venture along the breathtaking Icefields Parkway, known as Canada's most scenic mountain roadway. This remarkable route will lead you to remarkable sights, including glaciers, lakes, and waterfalls. Your first stop will be the Columbia Icefields Discovery Center, where you will embark on the thrilling Ice Explorer Ride, taking you up the Athabasca Glacier. Afterward, you will hop on a coach at the Discovery Center, which will transport you to the Glacier Skywalk. This glass-floored observation platform offers a spectacular, unobstructed view of the surrounding glaciers and the Sunwapta Valley. As you continue along the Parkway, you will pass by the Crowfoot Glacier, Peyto Lake, and Bow Lake. The remainder of the evening is free for you to relish the enchanting beauty of Lake Louise. You can partake in a variety of optional activities, such as kayaking, hiking on trails leading to Lake Agnes, riding the Lake Louise Gondola, and much more. You'll spend the night at the Lake Louise hotel.

itinerary.title: Lake Louise to Calgary
itinerary.description: Wake up to a hearty breakfast. Today, it's time to check out from your Lake Louise accommodations and make your way to Calgary Airport for your onward flight.

packages.name: Discover the Beauty of South Africa: GT Holidays Itinerary
packages.destination: Cape Town - Half Day Cape Town City Tour - Full Day Peninsular Tour - Sun City - Pilanesberg Game Drive - Johannesburg

images.alt_text: Discover the Beauty of South Africa: GT Holidays Itinerary
Discover the Beauty of South Africa: GT Holidays Itinerary

itinerary.title: Arrival in Cape Town
itinerary.description: You'll land at Cape Town International Airport, where a friendly representative will greet you. They'll ensure your smooth transfer to your hotel. Afterward, the day is yours to explore at your own pace. Take a leisurely stroll around the Victoria & Alfred Waterfront, known for its excellent restaurants and vibrant nightlife. It's one of Cape Town's most popular tourist destinations, nestled in a bustling harbor surrounded by pubs, eateries, craft markets, theaters, and more. With Robben Island and Table Mountain as its neighbors, this picturesque spot in the heart of Cape Town's harbor offers stunning views of the sea and mountains. You'll spend the night at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Cape Town City Tour and Table Mountain
itinerary.description: After a delightful breakfast, embark on a half-day Cape Town city tour, including tickets for a visit to Table Mountain (weather permitting). Ascend to the summit of the iconic Table Mountain via a cable car, where you'll be treated to panoramic views of the city and the surrounding landscapes of this southernmost tip of Africa. Explore the country's oldest building, The Castle, and nearby, the well-preserved Company Gardens, both of which are steeped in captivating history. As you continue your drive, you'll pass by significant landmarks such as the Parliament Buildings, City Hall, and the Slave Lodge, each reflecting a rich historical tapestry through their unique architectural styles. Wander up the cobbled streets to the Malay Quarter, where the charming Bo-Kaap homes, adorned with vibrant, ice-cream-like colors, will captivate your senses. Witness the craftsmanship of a skilled diamond cutter as he transforms raw stones into every girl's dream gem. The remainder of the day is yours to enjoy at your leisure. Relax and soak in the beauty of Cape Town. Spend the night at your hotel in this enchanting city.

itinerary.title: Full-Day Peninsula Tour
itinerary.description: Enjoy a leisurely cruise along the stunning stretch of coastline known as Millionaire's Paradise, starting from Clifton and continuing to Camps Bay, all the way to the exclusive beach haven of Llandudno. Our journey takes us to the delightful working harbour of Hout Bay, where you'll embark on a close encounter with the resident seals on Seal Island. Next, we'll wind our way along the renowned Chapman's Peak Drive, hugging the cliffs and relishing the breathtaking ocean views. Our lunch stop is at the Cape of Good Hope Section of the Table Mountain National Park, where you can choose your preferred dining spot (on your own account). We'll then meander back along the coast toward the city, visiting the historically significant naval port of Simon's Town and the endearing penguin colony at Boulder's Beach (expenses on your own account). To conclude our day, we'll head inland to our final destination at Kirstenbosch Botanical Gardens. As the sun sets over the towering peaks of Table Mountain, its last rays illuminate the trees and flowers in a spectacular display of nature's beauty. You'll spend the night at your Cape Town hotel.

itinerary.title: Cape Town to Sun City
itinerary.description: Following a delightful breakfast, it's time to check out and head to Cape Town International Airport for your flight to Johannesburg (please note that the flight is not included). Upon arrival in Johannesburg, you'll be transferred to the enchanting Sun City resort. Arriving at Sun City, you'll check in and have the entire day at your disposal to explore this expansive resort. Sun City stands as South Africa's premier holiday destination, offering an array of entertainment, relaxation options, and a variety of activities. The resort boasts world-class amenities, including golf courses, thrilling game viewing opportunities, a bustling casino, and four distinct top-notch hotels: The Palace of The Lost City, Cascades Hotel, Sun City Hotel, and The Cabanas. Don't miss the chance to experience 'The Valley of the Waves,' one of Sun City's star attractions. It features a vast wave pool, capable of generating impressive 1.8-meter waves every 90 minutes, along with a sandy beach and a selection of exhilarating rides that promise fun for the entire family. Beyond the excitement, Sun City offers a wide range of dining options in a complete food arcade, from casual to fine dining. Additionally, each of the four hotels at the resort boasts its own swimming pool, and Sun City provides an abundance of thrilling water activities. Water World, situated at the man-made Sun City Lake, offers opportunities for parasailing, water-skiing, wakeboarding, and leisurely lake cruises. Your overnight stay will be at the magnificent Sun City resort.

itinerary.title: Sun City – Pilanesberg Wildlife Safari
itinerary.description: After a hearty breakfast, embark on your exhilarating Pilanesberg Game Drive. Discover the wonders of Pilanesberg National Park, a sanctuary for the magnificent 'Big Five' and an array of other fascinating wildlife species. Despite its relatively small size, this park's unique ecological diversity significantly enhances your chances of encountering the Big 5 in their natural habitat. Our expertly guided tour through this renowned reserve takes place in specially adapted open safari vehicles. This ensures an unobstructed view for game viewing, photography, and birdwatching. There's nothing between you and wildlife! Our knowledgeable guides will enrich your experience with their profound knowledge of the bush, animal behaviour, and bird identification, all of which they'll gladly share with you. Not only will you savour this adventure, but you'll also leave with a treasure trove of newfound knowledge. Enjoy your overnight stay at the Sun City resort.

itinerary.title: Leaving Sun City for Johannesburg
itinerary.description: Following a hearty breakfast, you'll be chauffeured back to O.R Tambo International Airport for your onward journey home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Singapore – Night Safari
itinerary.description: Our tour guide will be at Changi Airport to welcome you and help you to transfer to the hotel. We’ll wait until you check in and rest, then proceed with activities for day 1. Your vacation begins with a visit to the Mandai Wildlife Reserve to experience Night Safari. The Night Safari is the world’s first nocturnal wildlife park and a 13-time winner of the Best Attraction category awarded by the Singapore Tourism Board. This is an open-air zoo that houses over 2,500 animals, some of which are rare and endangered.

itinerary.title: Half-day City Tour of Singapore
itinerary.description: The second day involves visiting major tourist attractions like Gardens By The Bay, Little India, Chinatown, the National Gallery, Marina Bay Sands, Botanic Gardens, and the Singapore Zoo.

itinerary.title: Sentosa Island Tour
itinerary.description: On your third day, you will be exploring the gorgeous Sentosa Island and the numerous activities present in its surroundings. Interact with the dolphins at Dolphin Island, visit Palawan Beach to see the famous suspension bridge, and enjoy a thrilling cable car ride at the Skyline Luge and Skyride.

itinerary.title: Resorts World Sentosa – Universal Studios - Trick Eye Museum
itinerary.description: On day 4, you will be transferred from the hotel to the marvellous Resorts World Sentosa, a lifestyle destination resort complete with theme parks, museums, and luxury resorts. After settling into your accommodation, get ready to experience some much-needed adrenaline rush at Universal Studios. Ride Battlestar Galactica, one of the world’s tallest duelling roller coasters, and enjoy games and rides inspired by classic movies such as Transformers, The Mummy, and Jurassic Park. In the evening, head over to the Trick Eye Museum and be mesmerized by its fascinating display of 3D art.

itinerary.title: Adventure Cove - S.E.A. Aquarium – Maritime Experiential Museum - Typhoon Theatre
itinerary.description: Begin Day 5 with Adventure Cove, Southeast Asia’s only aquatic water park with thrilling rides, including high-speed water slides and snorkelling. Immerse yourself in the endless beauty of the underwater world at the S.E.A. Aquarium, home to about 100,000 marine animals. Go in for a unique experience at the Typhoon Theatre, famed for being a 360-degree multimedia adventure of maritime entertainment.

itinerary.title: Depart from Resorts World Sentosa, Singapore
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to Changi Airport to board your flight back home.

packages.name: Durban Getaway: A Gateway to South Africa’s Delights
packages.destination: Durban - City Tour - Day At Leisure

images.alt_text: Durban Getaway: A Gateway to South Africa’s Delights
Durban Getaway: A Gateway to South Africa’s Delights

itinerary.title: Arrival in Durban
itinerary.description: When you land at King Shaka International Airport, a friendly representative will be there to greet you and take you to your hotel. You'll spend the night at the hotel in Durban.

itinerary.title: Durban City Tour
itinerary.description: On the second day of our journey, we're off to explore the beautiful city of Durban. Our city tour departs daily between 08:30 and 09:00, returning around 12:30. Our adventure begins as we stroll along the brand-new Golden Mile, a rejuvenated beachfront promenade that stretches along the inviting beaches of Durban. Along the way, we'll admire the newly upgraded Point Waterfront area. Next, we'll meander through the heart of the city, catching a glimpse of the majestic City Hall and enjoying its rich history. Our journey then takes us to the small craft harbour, where we'll witness the 8th largest harbour in the world. As we drive past the busy sugar terminals and bustling harbour warehouses, we'll head towards the University of Natal - Durban Campus. From there, you'll have a fantastic view of the harbour below. Our next stop is the vibrant African/Indian Markets at Warwick Triangle. This area is home to nine distinct markets, all centered around Durban's largest public transport interchange. Approximately 6,000 street vendors ply their trade here to an average of 460,000 daily commuters. It's a truly authentic experience. We'll also pay a visit to the fascinating Phansi Museum, which boasts the largest publicly accessible collection of Southern African artefacts and traditions. Here, you can see beadworks, headrests, Zulu clay pots, and many other treasures (please note that the museum is closed on weekends, and there may be an entrance fee). From delving into culture, we'll switch to nature as we explore the tranquil Durban Botanic Gardens. Established in 1849, the gardens are home to massive trees from Asia, Africa, and America, as well as a magnificent orchid house. Our day concludes with a visit to an icon of KwaZulu-Natal, the Moses Mabhida Stadium. Here, you'll have the option to take a cable car ride (at your own expense) to the top of the stadium, where you can enjoy a phenomenal view of Durban and its surroundings. After our city tour, we'll return to our hotel in Durban for a comfortable overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Durban - Enjoy a Free Day
itinerary.description: Today, you have the day to yourself to explore the city at your own pace. You'll spend the night at the hotel in Durban.

itinerary.title: Leaving Durban
itinerary.description: After enjoying your morning meal, you'll be taken to King Shaka International Airport for your next flight.

packages.name: Attractive Maple Explorer Tour Packages Itinerary
packages.destination: Toronto - Niagara Falls - Ottawa - Montreal - Quebec City

images.alt_text: Attractive Maple Explorer Tour Packages Itinerary
Attractive Maple Explorer Tour Packages Itinerary

itinerary.title: Arrival in Toronto and Journey to Niagara Falls
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival, you will be transferred from Toronto Airport to Niagara Falls, where you will check in at your hotel. As the evening descends, you will witness the mesmerising sight of the falls, aglow with a vibrant array of coloured lights. Enjoy your overnight stay at the hotel in Niagara Falls.

itinerary.title: Exploring Niagara Falls and Return to Toronto
itinerary.description: Following breakfast, embark on a self-guided tour of the awe-inspiring Niagara Falls. Your tour package includes the Niagara Adventure Pass, which grants you access to the Hornblower Cruise - Voyage to the Falls, Journey behind the Falls, Niagara’s Fury, and White-Water Walk. Later, you will return to Toronto. Upon your arrival, check in at your hotel, and the rest of the day is yours to explore the cultural, entertainment, and financial hub of Canada at your leisure. Spend the night at the hotel in Toronto.

itinerary.title: Toronto - Hop on/Hop off Toronto City Tour
itinerary.description: After a delightful breakfast, it's time to uncover the secrets hidden behind Toronto's iconic skyline with a Hop on/Hop off Toronto city tour. You'll be immersed in the vibrant atmosphere of this cosmopolitan city, visiting remarkable spots like the Eaton Center, City Halls, Casa Loma, Yorkville, and the University of Toronto. As you journey, you'll pass by landmarks such as the Rogers Centre and the CN Tower, all while cruising along the picturesque Harbourfront. You'll spend the night at your Toronto hotel.

itinerary.title: Toronto - Ottawa Via Rail
itinerary.description: Today, following breakfast, you'll check out of your hotel and make your way independently to Union Station to catch the Via Rail train to Ottawa. Along the way, you'll travel through charming lakeside towns alongside Lake Ontario, the historic city of Kingston, and the enchanting Thousand Islands region. Upon your arrival in Ottawa, you'll find your own way to the hotel. The remainder of the day is yours to enjoy at your leisure, exploring the captivating charms of Canada's capital city. You'll stay overnight at your Ottawa hotel.

itinerary.title: Ottawa - City Tour and Travel to Montreal via Via Rail
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delicious breakfast before embarking on a fascinating sightseeing tour of Ottawa. You'll have the opportunity to admire iconic landmarks such as the Parliament buildings, museums, the Canadian Mint, the National Gallery of Canada, the Museum of Civilization, the Prime Minister's residence, and the National Arts Centre. In the afternoon, check out from your hotel and head to the train station to catch your Via Rail train to Montreal. Upon your arrival in Montreal, make your way to the hotel. The rest of the day is yours to enjoy at your leisure. You will spend the night at your Montreal hotel.

itinerary.title: Montreal - City Tour
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a scrumptious breakfast, followed by a captivating sightseeing tour of Montreal. The tour includes exciting highlights such as a photo stop at the stunning Notre Dame Basilica (please note that entrance fees are not included), exploring the residential and financial districts, experiencing the historical charm of Old Montreal, enjoying an outside view of the Olympic Complex, and taking in a breathtaking panoramic view from an observation point atop Mont Royal. Your overnight stay will be at the hotel in Montreal.

itinerary.title: Montreal
itinerary.description: Enjoy a full-day tour to Quebec City after breakfast. Explore the provincial capital's historical treasures and experience its vibrant "joie de vivre" atmosphere. Highlights of the day include visits to the Upper and Lower Towns, the Parliament Buildings, the Plains of Abraham, the Citadel, Chateau Frontenac, Place d’Armes, Quebec National Assembly, and the Notre Dame Basilica. You'll also get to experience the impressive Montmorency Falls, which is 30 metres taller than Niagara Falls, with an included cruise. Spend the night at your hotel in Montreal.

itinerary.title: Depart from Montreal
itinerary.description: Following breakfast, the morning is free for your leisure. In the afternoon, check out from your hotel and proceed to Montreal Airport or VIA Rail Station for your journey back home.

itinerary.title: Arrival at Singapore – Night Safari
itinerary.description: As soon as you arrive in Singapore, our tour guide will be at the airport to welcome you and help you get a transfer to the hotel. The guide will give you details about the entire itinerary, including the activities waiting ahead of you. We’ll then leave you to complete the check-in formalities and rest for some time. The first day includes a Night Safari at the Mandai Wildlife Reserve. The Night Safari is an excellent opportunity to admire hundreds of rare & endangered species like tigers, tapirs, flying squirrels, and rhinoceroses.

itinerary.title: Sentosa Island Tour
itinerary.description: The second day includes a coach tour of Singapore’s best attractions like Gardens By The Bay, Merlion Park, Chinatown, Little India, Chocolate Shop, etc. We’ll leave you to soak in the beauty of the place and admire the wonderful buildings and modern architecture. The next vacation stop is Sentosa, where you can enjoy the numerous attractions on the island. Sentosa is famous for its cable car rides from Mount Faber to Sentosa, the Madame Tussauds Museum shows like Images of Singapore -Live and Wings of Time. You can also take pictures with cute dolphins at Dolphin Island or relax at one of the numerous beaches on the island.

itinerary.title: Universal Studios
itinerary.description: The Universal Studios theme park is the first of its kind in Southeast Asia and is famous for its rides, shows, and games based on old Hollywood blockbusters like Jurassic Park and Shrek. You can ride Battlestar Galactica, the tallest duelling rollercoaster in the world, and have a blast revisiting classic movies such as Transformers, The Mummy, and Jurassic Park.

itinerary.title: Marina Bay Sands
itinerary.description: You will be transferred from the hotel to Marina Bay Sands on the fourth day. Take a bird’s eye view of Singapore’s landscape from Marina Sands SkyPark Observation Deck. Watch the Light and Water Show in the evening and shop at the numerous luxury stores before turning in for the night at your posh accommodation.

itinerary.title: Depart from Singapore
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

packages.name: Exploring the Wonders of South Africa: Amazing Victoria Falls Tour Packages
packages.destination: Livingstone - Afternoon Sunset Cruise On The Zambezi River - Victoria Falls Tour

images.alt_text: Exploring the Wonders of South Africa: Amazing Victoria Falls Tour Packages
Exploring the Wonders of South Africa: Amazing Victoria Falls Tour Packages

itinerary.title: Arrival in Livingstone - Afternoon Zambezi River Sunset Cruise
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at Livingstone Airport, you'll be transferred to your hotel. In the afternoon, enjoy a relaxing sunset cruise on the Zambezi River. Spend the night at your hotel in Livingstone.

itinerary.title: Livingstone – Victoria Falls Tour
itinerary.description: Explore the majestic Victoria Falls on a guided tour. Please note that this tour excludes transfers, as the falls are within walking distance of the hotel. Spend the night at the hotel in Livingstone.

itinerary.title: Leaving Livingstone
itinerary.description: We'll arrange for your transfer from the Avani Victoria Falls Hotel to Livingstone Airport. Enjoy breakfast before you go.

itinerary.title: Sentosa Island Tour
itinerary.description: Our tour guide will be at Changi Airport to welcome you and take you to the hotel to complete check-in formalities. We’ll leave you alone for some time, allowing you to refresh and prepare for the day ahead. On the first day, you will explore Sentosa Island, which has many activities for tourists. Look at the adorable dolphins at Dolphin Island, ride a cable car at the Skyline Luge and Skyride, and visit the island's many beaches.

itinerary.title: Gardens by the Bay - National Gallery Singapore - Singapore Zoo
itinerary.description: Let the second day be about visiting some of the famous touristy spots of Singapore. Begin with Gardens By The Bay, a nature park that is home to 1.5 million plants from every continent. Head to the National Gallery Singapore to peruse the stunning art pieces before moving on to the Singapore Zoo, the world’s best rainforest zoo with over 4,200 animals.

itinerary.title: Universal Studios – Chinatown
itinerary.description: Universal Studios in Singapore is the perfect place to feel like a kid again and enjoy a vibrant theme park filled with rides. In the evening, head to Chinatown to relish some delicious oriental cuisine.

itinerary.title: Kuala Lumpur – Genting Highlands
itinerary.description: Take a flight from Singapore to Kuala Lumpur, where you will be greeted by our tour representatives, who will help you shift to your hotel. Browse through the Genting Strawberry Leisure Farm, hop on to the Genting SkyWorlds Theme Park, and pay your respects at the Chin Swee Caves Temple.

itinerary.title: Malacca - Petronas Twin Towers
itinerary.description: Witness the UNESCO World Heritage Site, Malacca, which has historical significance. Finish the day by visiting the most popular spot in the city, the Petronas Twin Towers.

itinerary.title: Batu Caves - National Mosque of Malaysia
itinerary.description: You will be breathing in the serenity of Batu Caves during the sixth day of your trip. Get mesmerized by the National Mosque of Malaysia before getting back to your hotel.

itinerary.title: Depart from Kuala Lumpur
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrive at Singapore – Night Safari
itinerary.description: After you land in Singapore, our tour representatives will greet you at the airport and take you to the hotel. Once you check in and freshen up, you can begin the first day of your trip with a Night Safari at the Mandai Wildlife Reserve. This is an open-air zoo where guests can observe over 2500 animals from close quarters.

itinerary.title: Singapore Half-Day City Tour – Half-Day Sentosa
itinerary.description: The second day starts with a half-day city tour where a coach will take you to explore different attractions, including Merlion Park, Gardens by the Bay, Marina Sands, Mount Faber, Chinatown, etc. It also includes the National Gallery, a national museum that displays works of Southeast Asian artists. The second half of the day includes Sentosa Island, where you can explore different attractions, including Madame Tussauds, SEA Aquarium, etc. You will be staying at a luxury hotel in Sentosa. You can also enjoy cable car rides at the Skyline Luge and Skyride.

itinerary.title: Universal Studios
itinerary.description: The third day begins with exploring Universal Studios, where you can revisit old classics and explore the different adventure rides, games and attractions based on your favorite blockbuster movies like Jurassic Park, Shrek, Transformers, and Madagascar. Get on Battlestar Galactica and enjoy a memorable day with your kids, who will surely love this tourist attraction.

itinerary.title: Depart from Singapore
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

packages.name: Romantic Retreat: Exploring New Zealand’s Tour Package for Couples

images.alt_text: Romantic Retreat: Exploring New Zealand’s Tour Package for Couples
Romantic Retreat: Exploring New Zealand’s Tour Package for Couples

itinerary.title: Auckland Arrival
itinerary.description: As you land in Auckland, known as 'The City of Sails,' our local representative will warmly greet seat-in-coach passengers and provide a private transfer to your hotel. For those who are self-driving, you can pick up your rental car at the airport and make your way to the hotel.

itinerary.title: Auckland to Rotorua via Waitomo and Matamata
itinerary.description: Travel south through picturesque green hills and fertile farmland to reach the enchanting Waitomo Glowworm Caves. Embark on a guided tour to witness the extraordinary limestone formations and take a captivating boat ride beneath a ceiling adorned with thousands of glimmering glowworms. Afterward, journey to Matamata for a guided tour of the Hobbiton Movie Set, a piece of the magical 'Middle Earth.' Finally, continue your journeys to Rotorua.

itinerary.title: Rotorua
itinerary.description: Begin your day by exploring the Te Puia Thermal Reserve, where you can marvel at bubbling mud pools and powerful geysers. Next, head to the Agrodome for an entertaining New Zealand farm show. Afterward, you pay a visit to Rainbow Springs to observe New Zealand's trout, birds, and wildlife. The afternoon is yours to enjoy Rotorua's additional attractions at your leisure. In the evening, relish an authentic Maori Hangi feast and a captivating concert. Breakfast and dinner options are available.

itinerary.title: Rotorua to Auckland (Approximately 228km, 3 hours)
itinerary.description: On this day, you have the flexibility to decide whether you'd like to enjoy your morning in Rotorua or save it for optional activities in Auckland (please note that these activities are not included in the tour price). After you've made your choice, we'll arrange for your transfer from Rotorua to Auckland.

itinerary.title: Departure Day
itinerary.description: In the morning, it's time to check out of the hotel. Return your rental car, and then catch your flight back to your home country, ending your memorable and relaxing New Zealand trip.

packages.name: Moroccan Odyssey: From Casablanca to Marrakech – An 8-Day Exploration

images.alt_text: Moroccan Odyssey: From Casablanca to Marrakech – An 8-Day Exploration
Moroccan Odyssey: From Casablanca to Marrakech – An 8-Day Exploration

itinerary.title: Arrival in Casablanca
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Casablanca's Mohamed V airport, you will be warmly welcomed and transferred to your hotel. Check in at the hotel and spend the night in Casablanca. Have a splendid dinner at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Casablanca to Rabat - Discovering the Capitals
itinerary.description: Embark on a captivating journey as we delve into the vibrant cities of Morocco. We begin the day with a comprehensive city tour of Casablanca, the nation's economic hub. From the comfort of your coach, you'll witness the enchanting Medina, Mohammed V square, the bustling United Nations square, the lively Central Market, the charming Habbous quarter, the Royal Palace, and the affluent Anfa residential area. Admire the grandeur of the iconic Hassan II Mosque from the outside, and take in the picturesque Ain Diab Cornice, lined with inviting swimming pools and exquisite gastronomic restaurants. In the afternoon, our voyage continues as we set forth to Rabat, Morocco's administrative capital. Here, we'll explore the "Imperial Garden City," known for its significant landmarks. Stroll through the Oudayas garden, stand in awe of the magnificent Hassan Tower and Mausoleum, and witness the formidable ramparts and walls of the Mechouar surrounding the Royal Palace. As the day draws to a close, we'll reach our hotel in Rabat for a seamless check-in. Rest and rejuvenate as you prepare for the adventures that lie ahead. Overnight stay at the hotel in Rabat.

itinerary.title: Rabat to Meknes and Fes
itinerary.description: Today, we journey to Meknes, often referred to as the "Moroccan Versailles," founded by Moulay Ismail in the late 17th century, during the time of Louis XIV. Our exploration includes a visit to the renowned Bab El Mansour, widely regarded as one of Morocco's most exquisite gateways. We also have the option to explore Meknes or the holy city of Moulay Idriss, which gazes upon the ancient ruins of Volubilis. Our journey continues to Fes, where you'll settle into your hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: Fes
itinerary.description: Today, we dedicate the entire day to exploring Fes, the oldest of Morocco's Imperial Cities, renowned for its profound spiritual and educational influence on Moroccan culture. We'll delve into the medieval Medina, where you'll be captivated by its historical charm. Wander through the renowned souks, where skilled artisans continue to craft in the timeless oriental tradition. Enjoy a leisurely lunch. In the afternoon, our sightseeing adventure continues. You'll spend the night at the hotel in Fes.

itinerary.title: Fes to Marrakech
itinerary.description: Start your day with an early breakfast, and then set out for Marrakech. Along the way, you'll pass through some charming places. First, you'll visit Immouzer du Kandar, a picturesque Berber village. Afterward, your journey takes you to Ifrane, a delightful ski resort known for its beauty. Then, you'll continue to Azrou, another Berber village famous for its wood carving and carpet weaving cooperative. As the day progresses, you'll make your way to Marrakech. You'll arrive in the late afternoon and check in to your hotel. Enjoy an overnight stay in the heart of Marrakech.

itinerary.title: Marrakech - City Exploration
itinerary.description: Today is all about discovering the charms of Marrakech, the second-oldest Imperial City and the renowned "Pearl of the South." Established by the Almoravides in the late 11th century, Marrakech is nestled in a verdant oasis at the base of the snow-capped Atlas Mountains. Your day will include visits to iconic landmarks like the Saadian Tombs, Menara Gardens, Koutoubia Mosque, and the magnificent Bahia Palace. After a leisurely lunch, your journey continues with a stroll through the bustling souks and a visit to the famous Jemaa El Fna square. You'll spend the night at your Marrakech hotel.

itinerary.title: Marrakech to Casablanca
itinerary.description: Enjoy a leisurely morning, whether it's exploring the vibrant souks or unwinding by your hotel's poolside. Lunch in Marrakech at your own pace. Later, journey to Casablanca for an overnight stay at your hotel. Breakfast and Dinner included.

itinerary.title: Farewell Casablanca
itinerary.description: As the morning arrives, have your breakfast and get ready to bid adieu to your hotel and make your way to the airport for your return flight.

itinerary.title: Arrive at Singapore - Night Safari
itinerary.description: After you land in Singapore, our tour representatives will welcome you at Changi Airport and drop you at the hotel, leaving you to check in and freshen up. After you enjoy your meal at the hotel, we’ll meet you in the evening to enjoy Night Safari at the Mandai Wildlife Reserve. Later in the evening, get ready to witness the first nocturnal zoo in the world to experience a mesmerizing Night Safari. This unique open zoo has hundreds of animals, including rare and endangered species like Asian elephants, civets, Malayan tigers, and fishing cats.

itinerary.title: Sentosa Island Tour And Singapore Half-Day City Tour
itinerary.description: The next day includes a half-day tour of the city, covering all important destinations like Merlion Park, Mount Faber, Jewellery Factory, Chocolate Shop, and Little India. Sentosa Island is the next destination, with hundreds of attractions to keep you engaged for an entire day. From cable car rides at the Skyline Luge and Skyride to swimming with the dolphins at Dolphin Island or relaxing at one of the many serene beaches on the island, there are dozens of things to do and enjoy on Sentosa Island.

itinerary.title: Universal Studios
itinerary.description: How about going back to your childhood days? Universal Studios is one of the best attractions in Singapore and the first of its kind in Southeast Asia. The studio in Singapore allows adults to relive their childhood, allowing them to ride the Battlestar Galactica and enjoy other rides before heading to Chinatown later in the day to relish oriental cuisine and shop for souvenirs.

itinerary.title: Gardens by the Bay - National Gallery Singapore - Singapore Zoo
itinerary.description: The third day of your trip is to explore the famous touristy spots in Singapore. Explore Gardens by the Bay, a nature park covering 101 hectares. The next stop is the National Gallery in Singapore, home to intricate art pieces from the Southeast Asian community. The last stop for the day is the Singapore Zoo, with more than 4200 animals.

itinerary.title: Explore Little India And Other Attractions
itinerary.description: Little India is popular for its street food, souvenir shops, handicrafts, and other attractions. You can explore the country’s art scene, and enjoy the river view by night on Boat Quay.

itinerary.title: Depart from Singapore
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

packages.name: Romantic Journey Through Morocco: A Honeymoon Adventure
packages.destination: Casablanca - Rabat -Fes - Midelt - Erfoud - Tinghir - Ouarzazate - Marrakech

images.alt_text: Romantic Journey Through Morocco: A Honeymoon Adventure
Romantic Journey Through Morocco: A Honeymoon Adventure

itinerary.title: Casablanca
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Mohamed V Airport, you'll be warmly welcomed and transferred to your hotel in Casablanca. After checking in, you'll spend the night at the hotel in Casablanca. Dinner included.

itinerary.title: Casablanca – Rabat - Fes
itinerary.description: Today, we start with a delightful tour of Casablanca, the bustling business hub of the kingdom. From the comfort of your coach, you'll take in the sights of the Medina, Mohammed V square, United Nations square, the Central Market, the Habbous quarter, the Royal Palace, the residential area of Anfa, and catch a glimpse of the splendid Hassan II Mosque and the picturesque Ain Diab Corniche, adorned with swimming pools and gourmet restaurants. We then continue to Rabat, where you'll have a leisurely lunch. In Rabat, often referred to as the "Imperial Garden City," we explore its key landmarks, such as the Oudayas garden, Hassan Tower, and Mausoleum. You'll also have a chance to admire the ramparts and walls of the Mechouar, which encircle the Royal Palace. Afterward, we make our way to the enchanting city of Fes. You'll check in at the hotel and enjoy a peaceful overnight stay in Fes. Breakfast and Dinner are included.

itinerary.title: Fes - Exploring the Ancient City
itinerary.description: Today is dedicated to exploring the enchanting city of Fes, the oldest of Morocco's Imperial Cities, renowned for its significant contributions to Moroccan culture in the realms of spirituality and education. You'll embark on a journey through the medieval Medina, where you'll visit the Bouanania medersa and the Nejjarine fountain. Take time to wander through the renowned souks, where skilled artisans carry on age-old oriental traditions. Lunch will be at your leisure. In the afternoon, we'll explore the modern part of the city, "Fes Jdid," and the Mellah. You'll spend the night at the hotel in Fes. (Breakfast and Dinner included)

itinerary.title: Fes to Erfoud
itinerary.description: After an early morning start and breakfast, we set off for Erfoud, passing through some remarkable places. Our journey takes us through Immouzer du Kandar, a charming Berber village, then onto Ifrane, a picturesque ski resort, and Azrou, another Berber village famous for its handicraft cooperative, offering wood carving and carpet weaving. You'll have a leisurely lunch break in Midelt. Then, we continue our adventure through the breathtaking Ziz canyons, a route that showcases the stunning Atlas scenery. Finally, we arrive in Erfoud and check in at our hotel. Spend the night in Erfoud. (Breakfast and Dinner included) Optional: Experience a sunrise like no other with a 4X4 jeep excursion to Erg Chebbi, where you can witness the sun rising over the sandy dunes of Merzouga.

itinerary.title: Erfoud to Tineghir, then Ouarzazate
itinerary.description: Today, we'll set off for Tineghir with plenty of opportunities to capture the stunning and one-of-a-kind scenery with your camera. You'll have a leisurely lunch in Tineghir. Afterward, we'll journey on to Ouarzazate via the Todra Canyon and the Dadès Valley, also known as "the Valley of Roses" and famous for its myriad Kasbahs. You'll check in at your Ouarzazate hotel for the night. Enjoy your overnight stay in Ouarzazate.

itinerary.title: Ouarzazate to Marrakech
itinerary.description: Today, we embark on a city tour of Ouarzazate, taking in its main attractions. Our first stop is the mesmerising Kasbah Taourirt, a former Glaoui residence. This splendid kasbah, located on the outskirts of the town, is often regarded as one of Morocco's most beautiful. Its intricate architecture includes luxurious apartments, traditional clay houses, and ornate crenelated towers adorned with exquisite geometric patterns. Some parts of this fortified village are accessible to the public. Continuing our journey, we make our way to the Ait Benhadou Kasbah, located around 30 kilometers from Ouarzazate. This remarkable fortress is renowned for its dramatic appearance and has served as a backdrop for numerous famous films, including "Lawrence of Arabia." Aït Benhaddou is a UNESCO-listed fortified village, boasting crenelated towers and buildings adorned with stunning geometric designs, making it one of the most picturesque villages of its kind in Morocco. Efforts are ongoing to restore and repopulate this historic village, currently home to only five families. After exploring these cultural treasures, we set off for Marrakech, traversing the Tizin Tichka Pass, the highest pass in Morocco's mountains. This scenic route offers breathtaking views of the Atlas Mountains and the charming village of Taddert. You'll have the option to enjoy lunch either in Benhaddou or in Marrakech. Upon arrival in Marrakech, we will check in at our hotel and spend the night in this vibrant city. (Breakfast and Dinner included)

itinerary.title: Marrakech – City Exploration
itinerary.description: Today, we will embark on a city tour of Marrakech, the second oldest Imperial City, often referred to as the "Pearl of the South." Founded by the Almoravides in the late 11th century, Marrakesh is nestled in a picturesque oasis, cradled at the base of the snow-capped Atlas Mountains. In the morning, our journey begins with a visit to the Menara Gardens, a serene retreat. We'll also pass by the majestic Koutoubia Mosque, admiring its exterior beauty. Our next stop takes us to the renowned Bahia Palace and the intriguing Saadian tombs. Lunch is a leisurely affair, allowing you to explore the local cuisine at your own pace. In the afternoon, we delve into the vibrant souks (markets) that Marrakech is famous for. Our journey culminates at the iconic Jemaa El Fna Place. This bustling square is the heart of Medina life, brimming with activity both day and night. By day, it serves as a bustling marketplace, where vendors offer fresh orange juice, nuts, and dried fruits. However, real magic happens at dusk. At 5:00 PM, the square transforms into a hub of entertainment and culinary delights. Food stalls spring to life, dishing up a wide array of vegetables, fish, and meats. As the evening unfolds, the square becomes a stage for performers of all kinds, including snake charmers, singers, musicians, storytellers, and acrobats. Healers and fakirs offer their remedies and cures. The crowd is a mix of locals and tourists, offering a glimpse into the unchanged Medina life, much like medieval times. Don't forget to bring some loose change to Jemaa El Fna, as the performers appreciate a token of your gratitude, in addition to applause. Enjoy a restful night at your Marrakech hotel.

itinerary.title: Leaving Marrakech
itinerary.description: Today, after having your breakfast, it's time to check out of your hotel and make your way to Menara Airport for your return flight.

itinerary.title: Arrive at Singapore - Gardens by The Bay - National Gallery Singapore - Singapore Zoo
itinerary.description: After you land in Singapore, our tour representative will welcome you at the airport and drive you to the hotel. Once you have checked in and freshened up, you can proceed to experience Night Safari at the Mandai Wildlife Reserve. It is the world’s first nocturnal open-air zoo where you can admire over 2500 animals from over 900 species, including civets, leopards, porcupines, etc.

itinerary.title: Singapore Half-Day City Tour – Merlion Park, Chinatown & More
itinerary.description: Day 2 begins with a coach tour of the city where you can explore the different tourist attractions in the city, including Merlion Park, Mount Faber, Jewellery Factory, Chocolate Shop, Little India, etc. Chinatown is the best place for bargain shopping, where you can buy souvenirs and other knickknacks for friends and family. Little India is the best place to explore Indian culture and cuisine and buy handicrafts

itinerary.title: Sentosa Island Tour
itinerary.description: Sentosa Island is famous for its eclectic architecture and amazing adventure activities. The island offers plenty of activities for tourists of all ages to enjoy. This includes visiting the S.E.A Aquarium, Universal Studio, Madame Tussauds, and zipping on the Mega Zip at the Mega Adventure Park. You can also hop on a cable car at the Skyline Luge and Skyride, play with dolphins at Dolphin Island, or walk around the many beaches on the island.

itinerary.title: Depart from Singapore
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home

packages.name: Discovering Stunning New Zealand in Luxury: An Unforgettable Journey
packages.destination: Auckland - Waitomo - Rotorua - Napier - Wellington - Christchurch - Dunedin - Queenstown - Glacier Region - Greymouth

images.alt_text: Discovering Stunning New Zealand in Luxury: An Unforgettable Journey
Discovering Stunning New Zealand in Luxury: An Unforgettable Journey

itinerary.title: Welcome to Auckland
itinerary.description: As you touch down in Auckland, known as 'The City of Sails,' our friendly local representative will be there to greet you if you're arriving by coach. They'll ensure a smooth transfer to your hotel. For those driving, you can pick up your rental car at the airport and make your way to your hotel. Enjoy a comfortable overnight stay in Auckland.

itinerary.title: Auckland to Rotorua via Waitomo
itinerary.description: Journey south through the lush Waikato region to reach Waitomo. Embark on a guided tour of the renowned Waitomo Glowworm Caves, where you'll glide through the caves on a boat beneath a spectacular display of millions of glow worms adorning the cave ceiling. After this enchanting experience, your route takes you over the scenic Mamaku Ranges, leading you to the vibrant city of Rotorua.

itinerary.title: Rotorua
itinerary.description: You will explore Te Puia Thermal Reserve, enjoy the Agrodome Farm Show, and visit Rainbow Springs to observe trout and wildlife. In the afternoon, you will have free time to relax and enjoy yourself.

itinerary.title: Rotorua to Napier
itinerary.description: This is a day for you to relax and unwind. In the afternoon, you'll set off for Napier, journeying south through the stunning Wairakei Geothermal area. You'll then proceed through Taupo and circle around a portion of Lake Taupo, New Zealand's largest lake. The route will take you over picturesque mountain ranges and through well-tended farmlands, finally leading you to the charming 'Art Deco' city of Napier. You'll spend the night at your Napier hotel.

itinerary.title: Napier
itinerary.description: Today it is yours to freely explore charming Napier. In the afternoon, indulge in a delightful wine tour, visiting and savouring tastings at three local wineries. Your evening will be spent at the Napier hotel.

itinerary.title: Napier to Wellington
itinerary.description: On this day, journey through the picturesque Manawatu Gorge and the scenic Takapau Plains. You'll then reach Palmerston North, renowned for its agricultural university. Carry on your southward path, and you'll soon arrive in Wellington, the capital city of New Zealand. Enjoy your overnight stay at the hotel in Wellington.

itinerary.title: Wellington to Christchurch (Make Your Own Arrangements)
itinerary.description: Enjoy your breakfast. Today, start your day with a delightful Wellington city tour in the morning (available for guests traveling by shared coach). Later, make your way to Christchurch via a domestic flight (please note that the airfare is not included).

itinerary.title: Christchurch to Dunedin
itinerary.description: Today, journey south across the picturesque Canterbury Plains to arrive in Dunedin, a city with a strong Scottish influence. Dunedin is famous for its local wildlife and is home to Otago University. Enjoy your overnight stay at a hotel in Dunedin.

itinerary.title: Dunedin to Queenstown
itinerary.description: Today, you have the day to yourself to enjoy optional activities. In the afternoon, we depart from Dunedin and make our way inland, passing through the charming towns of Lawrence and Clyde. We will eventually arrive in Cromwell. The journey continues as we pass through the breathtaking Kawarau Gorge, bringing us to Queenstown in the early evening. You'll spend the night at your Queenstown hotel.

itinerary.title: Queenstown
itinerary.description: Today is a day of leisure, with numerous optional activities to choose from. Queenstown offers an array of thrilling experiences, including bungee jumping, jet boating, white-water rafting, gondola rides, and much more (please note that optional activities are not included in the tour price). Spend the night at your Queenstown hotel.

itinerary.title: Queenstown to the Glacier
itinerary.description: Region Embark on a scenic journey to the Glacier Region, passing through the picturesque Lake Wanaka and the historic Haast Pass, which serves as the entrance to the World Heritage Westland National Park. As you venture up the West Coast, you'll be treated to breathtaking views of majestic mountain ranges, lush native forests, and serene lakes, ultimately arriving at the glacier region encompassing Franz Josef and Fox Glaciers. Enjoy your overnight stay at a hotel in the Glacier Region.

itinerary.title: Glacier Region to Christchurch via Greymouth
itinerary.description: Today, we head north to Greymouth, where we'll embark on a journey aboard the world-renowned Tranz Alpine train (exclusive for seat-in-coach passengers). As you ascend through lush beech forests and pass by the charming alpine village of Arthur's Pass, you'll be treated to breathtaking views of the spectacular Southern Alps. Our adventure continues as we traverse the vast Canterbury Plains, finally arriving in the welcoming city of Christchurch. Rest for the night at your Christchurch hotel.

itinerary.title: Farewell to Christchurch
itinerary.description: Today, make your way to Christchurch Airport as you prepare to board your flight to your next destination or back to your hometown, carrying with you cherished memories that will last a lifetime.

packages.name: Explore Egyptian Wonder for 7 Days | Itinerary
packages.destination: Egypt - Cairo -Aswan - Kom Ombo - Edfu - Luxor

images.alt_text: Explore Egyptian Wonder for 7 Days | Itinerary
Explore Egyptian Wonder for 7 Days | Itinerary

itinerary.title: Arrival in Cairo
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Cairo International Airport, you will be warmly greeted and assisted by our representative to navigate through customs and passport formalities. Subsequently, you will be transferred to your hotel in a private vehicle. Your first night will be spent in the comforts of your Cairo hotel.

itinerary.title: Exploring Cairo
itinerary.description: Following a delicious breakfast, you will embark on an awe-inspiring journey to visit the Great Pyramids of Giza, renowned as one of the Seven Wonders of the World. Your day's itinerary also includes a visit to the Egyptian Museum and the vibrant Khan el Khalil Bazaar, where you will immerse yourself in the bustling local culture. You will then return to your Cairo hotel for another restful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Cairo to Aswan
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a delightful breakfast, after which you will be transported to Cairo Domestic Airport for your flight to Aswan. Upon arrival in Aswan, you will be transferred to the Nile Cruise, marking the commencement of your enchanting voyage. On the cruise, you will visit the magnificent High Dam, the fascinating Unfinished Obelisk, and the charming Philae Temple, reached by a leisurely felucca ride. The day will culminate with your return to the Nile Cruise, where you will spend the night, with delectable meals provided throughout the day

itinerary.title: Kom Ombo - Edfu
itinerary.description: Commence your day with a delightful breakfast. Subsequently, embark on a visit to the Kom Ombo Temple before returning to the comfort of your Nile cruise vessel. As you cruise along, you will arrive at Edfu, where a visit to the Edfu Temple awaits. Following this enriching experience, you shall return to the Nile cruise, where you shall spend the night.

itinerary.title: Luxor
itinerary.description: Once more, begin your day with a satisfying breakfast. You shall then make your way to Luxor, where you will explore the remarkable East Bank sites, including the Karnak Temple and Luxor Temple. Having absorbed the cultural and historical riches, you will return to your Nile cruise for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Luxor – Cairo
itinerary.description: Enjoy your morning breakfast before embarking on an excursion to the West Bank of Luxor, where you will visit the Valley of the Kings, the Temple of Queen Hatshepsut, and the awe-inspiring Two Colossi of Memnon. Following this, you will be transferred to the Luxor Domestic Airport for your flight to Cairo. Upon arrival at Cairo Domestic Airport, you will be escorted to your hotel, where you will spend the night.

itinerary.title: Departure from Cairo
itinerary.description: Savour your morning breakfast as you prepare for the day's proceedings. This morning will see you off to Cairo International Airport, where you will board your flight for your journey back home or to your next destination.

packages.name: Discovering Egypt – Land of Pharaohs | Itinerary
packages.destination: Cairo - Aswan - Nile Cruise - Luxor - Hurghada

images.alt_text: Discovering Egypt – Land of Pharaohs | Itinerary
Discovering Egypt – Land of Pharaohs | Itinerary

itinerary.title: Arrival in Cairo
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival in Cairo, you will be graciously transported to your chosen accommodation. Following your arrival at the hotel, kindly proceed with the check-in process, allowing for a tranquil reprieve for the day. In the evening, prepare to be enraptured by the profound historical narrative of the ancient Egyptians, as it unfurls before your eyes during the enchanting Sound and Light Show held at the iconic Pyramids of Giza. The night shall be spent in the welcoming confines of your Cairo hotel.

itinerary.title: Exploring Cairo
itinerary.description: Commence your day with a delightful breakfast before embarking on a captivating exploration of the Great Pyramids of Giza, widely celebrated as one of the Seven Wonders of the World. Subsequently, your journey will lead you to the Egyptian Museum, home to a treasure trove of invaluable historical artefacts. A visit to the Khan El Khalil Bazaar, formerly recognized as the Turkish bazaar during the Ottoman era, is on the itinerary. In contemporary times, this bustling marketplace is affectionately referred to as the "Khan." The remainder of the day is yours to enjoy at your leisure. Prepare for another restful evening at your Cairo residence.

itinerary.title: Cairo to Aswan - Embarking on a Nile Cruise
itinerary.description: Following a hearty breakfast, you shall be conveyed from your hotel to the airport, ready to embark on a flight to Aswan. Upon your arrival in Aswan, a seamless transfer shall usher you to the cruise terminal, where you will commence your Nile Cruise adventure. Here, you shall explore the remarkable sites of the High Dam, the Unfinished Obelisk, and the resplendent Philae Temple. As the day draws to a close, you shall retire to the comfortable quarters of your cruise ship for a restful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Exploration Along the Nile
itinerary.description: Today's expedition takes you to the extraordinary Kom Ombo Temple, a sanctuary consecrated to not one, but two deities. This temple, a unique architectural gem, was constructed during the Ptolemaic dynasty within the charming Egyptian town of Kom Ombo. Subsequently, your journey will continue to the awe-inspiring city of Edfu, where you will have the privilege to visit the grand Temple of Horus. Of particular note is the colossal statue of Horus in the form of a falcon, which graces the temple's entrance, setting the tone for the magnificence that lies within. As the day unfolds, you shall return to the cruise ship for another tranquil overnight sojourn.

itinerary.title: Nile Cruise
itinerary.description: On this day, we shall embark on a voyage to the East Bank of Luxor, a region replete with historical grandeur. Here, you shall bear witness to two of Upper Egypt's most splendid temples - Karnak and Luxor. The evening will find you ensconced aboard the cruise, where you shall sojourn overnight, partaking of your meals.

itinerary.title: Nile Cruise – Luxor – Hurghada
itinerary.description: Following a nourishing breakfast, we shall disembark from our cruise and commence our journey to Hurghada via coach. Upon arrival, you shall be welcomed in your accommodation. Hurghada, affectionately referred to as Ghardaga by the locals, has gracefully evolved from its humble origins as a fishing village into a globally recognized holiday resort town. It is renowned for its enchanting underwater world, offering remarkable opportunities for diving and snorkelling enthusiasts. You should rest your head at the hotel in Hurghada.

itinerary.title: Hurghada
itinerary.description: Today, the day unfurls leisurely before you, offering the freedom to choose your pursuits. A splendid option is to embark on a snorkelling escapade to the beguiling Giftun Island. Here, you shall be afforded the extraordinary opportunity to swim alongside dolphins, and upon reaching Giftun Island, indulge in various water-based activities. As evening descends, you are free to immerse yourself in the vibrant nightlife that distinguishes Hurghada. Your night's reprieve shall be at the hotel in Hurghada.

itinerary.title: Depart Hurghada/Cairo by Road
itinerary.description: As the sun graces the horizon, you shall be transferred to Cairo by road, embarking on the journey homeward. Your final destination is Cairo Airport, where you shall board your flight to return to your place of residence.

packages.name: Explore Classic Egypt for 8 Days | Itinerary
packages.destination: Cairo - Nile Cruise - Luxor - Sharm el - Sheikh

images.alt_text: Explore Classic Egypt for 8 Days | Itinerary
Explore Classic Egypt for 8 Days | Itinerary

itinerary.title: Arrival in Cairo
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival in the illustrious city of Cairo, you shall be ushered to your selected hotel with all due expedition. It is here where you shall conduct your check-in, affording you the opportunity to unwind and rejuvenate after your journey. As the sun's final rays dissipate into the horizon, you shall be treated to an exquisite performance - the Sound and Light Show at the Pyramids of Giza, a mesmerising narrative of ancient Egyptian history. A peaceful night's rest awaits you at the hotel in Cairo.

itinerary.title: Cairo
itinerary.description: With the break of dawn, a delectable breakfast shall set the stage for your day's explorations. You will embark on a journey to the magnificent Great Pyramids of Giza, a wonder of the ancient world that continues to stand tall and awe-inspiring. The Egyptian Museum shall beckon to you with its unparalleled collection of historical treasures, while the Khan El Khalil Bazaar, formerly referred to as the Turkish bazaar during the Ottoman era but now more colloquially known as the "Khan," shall provide a delightful shopping experience. The remaining hours of the day are yours to relish at your leisure. You shall retreat once again to the comforts of your Cairo abode for a restful night.

itinerary.title: Cairo to Aswan, Embark on a Nile Cruise
itinerary.description: Following a delectable morning repast, you shall be gracefully conveyed from your hotel to the airport for your flight to Aswan. Upon arrival in Aswan, you will be escorted to the cruise terminal, where you shall commence your journey aboard the Nile Cruise. Your day's itinerary shall encompass a visit to the High Dam, the Unfinished Obelisk, and the resplendent Philae Temple. Your night shall be spent in repose on the cruise, savouring the culinary delights of breakfast, lunch, and dinner.

itinerary.title: Exploration Aboard the Nile Cruise
itinerary.description: Enjoy your breakfast. Today's sojourn embarks upon the exceptional Kom Ombo temple, a remarkable edifice dedicated to two deities. This temple, the Temple of Kom Ombo, stands as an architectural marvel from the Ptolemaic dynasty within the Egyptian town of Kom Ombo. Subsequently, your voyage takes you to Edfu, where you shall visit the grandiose Temple of Horus, featuring a colossal statue of Horus depicted as a majestic falcon, commanding attention at the entrance to the primary temple structure. As twilight descends, you shall rest and rejuvenate on the cruise while partaking in the culinary delights of dinner.

itinerary.title: Luxor's Temples and Treasures
itinerary.description: Start the day with an energetic breakfast. In the historic city of Luxor, you shall be captivated by the presence of some of the most awe-inspiring temples in Upper Egypt. Your day's agenda will include a visit to the awe-inspiring Karnak and Luxor temples, as well as an exploration of the Valley of the Kings, the Temple of Queen Hatshepsut, and the Two Colossi of Memnon. Your night shall be spent in a state of serene repose aboard the cruise, punctuated by a nourishing dinner.

itinerary.title: Nile Cruise – Luxor – Sharm el-Sheikh
itinerary.description: At the break of dawn, following a satisfying breakfast, embark on the delightful task of disembarking from the Nile cruise. Your next destination is the enchanting Sharm el-Sheikh, a destination that has garnered international acclaim as a premier holiday resort town, celebrated for its vibrant underwater ecosystems, renowned for diving and snorkelling. Upon your arrival in Sharm El Sheikh, you shall be gracefully transported to your hotel for a seamless check-in experience. The day unfolds in leisurely repose, affording you the opportunity to bask in the surroundings. Slumber finds you at the hotel in Sharm el-Sheikh.

itinerary.title: Sharm el-Sheikh
itinerary.description: Following a nourishing breakfast, the day unfurls leisurely before you, an open canvas on which you may paint your preferred activities. An enticing option presents itself: a full-day excursion to Tiran Island by yacht. This journey commences as you are elegantly conveyed from your residence to the jetty at the Red Sea. Here, you shall board a snorkelling cruise boat, embarking on a captivating voyage through various facets of the sea, guided by an expert. Your senses shall be treated to the mesmerising sight of some of the planet's most vividly hued and uniquely patterned fish, complemented by the living splendour of the coral reefs. Your reprieve is once again spent at the hotel in Sharm el-Sheikh.

itinerary.title: Depart Sharm el-Sheikh – Cairo by Road
itinerary.description: With your stay at the hotel concluded, it is time to bid adieu to Sharm el-Sheikh. The day's course takes you on a terrestrial voyage from Sharm to Cairo by road, leading you to the juncture of your flight to Cairo. Upon reaching Cairo, you shall be transferred to Cairo International Airport, facilitating your embarkation on your departing flight.

packages.name: Awesome Cairo Getaway for 4 Days | Itinerary
