Awesome Cairo Getaway for 4 Days | Itinerary

itinerary.title: Arrival in Cairo
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Cairo International Airport, you will be greeted and assisted by our representative as you navigate through customs and passport formalities. You will then be chauffeured to your hotel in a private vehicle. Your first night will be spent in the comfort of your Cairo hotel.

itinerary.title: Exploring Cairo
itinerary.description: After a delightful breakfast, embark on a captivating journey to witness the magnificence of the Great Pyramids of Giza, renowned as one of the seven wonders of the world. Your itinerary continues with a visit to the Egyptian Museum and an exploration of the vibrant Khan El Khalil Bazar. The day concludes with a return to your Cairo hotel, where you will spend another night.

itinerary.title: Leisure in Cairo
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a sumptuous breakfast, after which you are free to enjoy a leisurely day at your own pace. Your accommodation in Cairo provides a tranquil setting for relaxation and rejuvenation. Another comfortable night awaits you in your hotel.

itinerary.title: Departure from Cairo
itinerary.description: Savour your morning meal and prepare for your departure. Our team will facilitate your transfer to Cairo International Airport, from where you will embark on your journey back home or to your next captivating destination.

packages.name: Splendid Lakes & Glaciers: A Breathtaking Journey from Christchurch to Queenstown
packages.destination: Christchurch - Glacier Region - Wanaka - Queenstown - Mt Cook

images.alt_text: Splendid Lakes & Glaciers: A Breathtaking Journey from Christchurch to Queenstown
Splendid Lakes & Glaciers: A Breathtaking Journey from Christchurch to Queenstown

itinerary.title: Arrival in Christchurch
itinerary.description: As you land in Christchurch, often referred to as 'The Garden City,' our friendly team will warmly welcome you. If you're traveling on a coach, we'll provide a private transfer to your hotel. For those driving themselves, you can pick up your rental car at the airport and make your way to the hotel. Enjoy a relaxing overnight stay in Christchurch.

itinerary.title: Christchurch to the Glacier Region
itinerary.description: Today's journey takes you alongside the picturesque Waimakariri River, across the majestic Southern Alps, and into the charming alpine village of Arthur's Pass. After a stop in Greymouth, continue your journey southward along the wild and rugged West Coast, eventually reaching the enchanting glacier region of Franz Josef and Fox Glaciers. Tonight, you'll find comfort and rest at a hotel in this breathtaking Glacier Region.

itinerary.title: Glacier Region - A Day to Relax and Reconnect with Nature
itinerary.description: Today is a day of leisure, a chance to immerse yourself in the breathtaking beauty of this glacier region. You have the option to enhance your experience with activities such as a scenic flight or a guided walk on one of the majestic glaciers (additional cost applies). For those seeking relaxation, your entry to the rejuvenating Glacier Hot Pools in Franz Josef is already arranged. It's a day to unwind and take in the wonders of nature. Spend the night at a comfortable hotel in the heart of the Glacier Region.

itinerary.title: Glacier Region to Wanaka
itinerary.description: This morning, enjoy a scenic journey as we travel along the West Coast. Marvel at the breathtaking mountain ranges, lush native forests, and serene lakes. We'll pass through the Haast Pass, the entrance to the World Heritage-listed Westland National Park. Our route then takes us along the picturesque shores of Lake Hawea, and we'll reach Wanaka in the early afternoon. The rest of the day is yours to relax and explore at your own pace. You'll spend the night at your comfortable Wanaka hotel.

itinerary.title: Wanaka to Queenstown (Approx. 67km, about 1 hour and 10 minutes)
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a visit to Puzzling World, a captivating attraction known for its eccentric architecture, intricate puzzles, and mind-bending illusion rooms. After this delightful stop, make your way to Queenstown. You'll spend the night at the charming Queenstown hotel.

itinerary.title: Queenstown - A Day of Freedom
itinerary.description: Today is your day to do as you please. You have the choice to explore the myriad of optional attractions Queenstown has to offer. Enjoy activities like bungy jumping, jetboating, white water rafting, gondola rides, and more (additional charges apply). Spend the night at your Queenstown hotel.

itinerary.title: Queenstown to Mount Cook (Approx. 240km, around 3 hours)
itinerary.description: Today, we will head south through the stunning Central Otago region, making our way to the picturesque town of Twizel. From there, we continue our journey, hugging the shores of breathtaking Lake Pukaki, and eventually arrive at the enchanting Mt. Cook National Park. While at Mt. Cook, you'll have the opportunity to take part in various optional activities that promise to make your day even more remarkable. These include taking scenic flights, embarking on a glacier boat ride, or immersing yourself in the intriguing exhibits at the Sir Edmund Hillary Centre. (Please note that optional tours are not included in the tour price.) Your evening will be spent in comfort at our hotel in the heart of Mt. Cook.

itinerary.title: Mount Cook to Christchurch (Approx. 333km, around 4 hours and 30 minutes)
itinerary.description: In the morning, make your way to Christchurch. Along the journey, you'll pause by the serene Lake Tekapo to visit the charming 'Church of the Good Shepherd.' Afterward, you'll continue your drive, crossing the lush Canterbury Plains, until you reach the welcoming city of Christchurch. Enjoy an overnight stay at your hotel in Christchurch.

itinerary.title: Farewell to Christchurch
itinerary.description: Today, make your way to Christchurch airport, where you'll catch your flight on your next adventure or return to your hometown, carrying with you a treasure trove of unforgettable memories.

packages.name: Singapore and Kuala Lumpur with Coach

images.alt_text: Singapore and Kuala Lumpur with Coach
Singapore and Kuala Lumpur with Coach

itinerary.title: Gardens by the Bay - National Gallery Singapore - Singapore Zoo
itinerary.description: After you land in Singapore, our tour representatives will greet you at the airport and take you to your hotel. Check-in and refresh for a busy day ahead as we begin the first day of your Singapore vacation. Visit the Gardens by the Bay, a nature park covering 101 hectares. Head to the National Gallery, a museum with art pieces from the Southeast Asian community. The day ends with a visit to Singapore Zoo, with over 4,200 animals.

itinerary.title: Sentosa Island Tour
itinerary.description: The second day is about exploring the beauty of Sentosa Island. Go on cable car rides, interact with adorable dolphins, or stroll through the island's many beaches.

itinerary.title: Universal Studios – Chinatown
itinerary.description: Universal Studios in Singapore is the first in Southeast Asia. Feel the excitement of the rides and go down memory lane as you see glimpses from the remnants of movies such as Transformers, The Mummy, and Jurassic Park. In the evening, go ahead and enjoy lots of delicious oriental cuisine in Chinatown and get souvenirs for yourself.

itinerary.title: Kuala Lumpur – Genting Highlands
itinerary.description: Take a flight from Singapore to Kuala Lumpur. For your first day in Kuala Lumpur, we will take you to Genting Highlands. Visit the Genting SkyWorlds Theme Park with your family, browse through Genting Strawberry Leisure Farm, and pay your respects at the Chin Swee Caves Temple.

itinerary.title: Malacca - Petronas Twin Towers
itinerary.description: For your second day in Kuala Lumpur, you will witness the UNESCO World Heritage Site, Malacca, filled with historical significance. Finish off the day by visiting the most popular spot in the city, the Petronas Twin Towers.

itinerary.title: Batu Caves - National Mosque of Malaysia
itinerary.description: Experience the serenity of the Batu Caves, brimming with shrines and temples. Breathe in the sanctity of the National Mosque of Malaysia before getting back to your hotel.

itinerary.title: Depart from Kuala Lumpur
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: National Gallery - Merlion Park - St. Andrew's Cathedral
itinerary.description: After you land in Singapore, our tour representatives will greet you at the airport and take you to the hotel. Once you have checked in and freshened up, we’ll meet you at the decided hour to begin your Singapore holiday. National Gallery is the first destination where you can admire the multiple displays of art and culture from the Southeast Asian community. Next is Merlion Park, famous for the iconic Merlion statue, a half-lion and half-fish statue signifying how Singapore started as a fishing village. Finish off your day by breathing in the calm and holy ambience of St. Andrew's Cathedral.

itinerary.title: Sentosa Island Tour
itinerary.description: Sentosa Island in Singapore is brimming with dozens of activities that deserve an entire day. The S.E.A Aquarium is home to over 100,000 marine animals and even take pictures with dolphins at Dolphin Island, hail an exciting cable car ride at the Skyline Luge and Skyride, and go on beachy adventures at the Siloso Beach.

itinerary.title: Universal Studios - Singapore Botanic Gardens
itinerary.description: Visit Southeast Asia’s first Universal Studios to ride the Battlestar Galactica, rock climb, and look for fossils at The Lost World. Later in the day, we will take you to Singapore Botanic Gardens, a UNESCO World Heritage site and the National Orchid Garden, home to over 1,000 species of orchids.

itinerary.title: Gardens by the Bay - Singapore Zoo – Chinatown
itinerary.description: Start the fourth day of your trip with a visit to Gardens By The Bay, a nature park that houses three waterfront gardens. Take your family to the Singapore Zoo, where you can see over 4,200 animals. End your day with a visit to Chinatown to relish some delicious oriental cuisine and buy souvenirs for friends and family.

itinerary.title: Depart from Singapore
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

packages.name: Discover Auckland: A 5-Day Itinerary for Unforgettable Adventures

images.alt_text: Discover Auckland: A 5-Day Itinerary for Unforgettable Adventures
Discover Auckland: A 5-Day Itinerary for Unforgettable Adventures

itinerary.title: Arrival in Auckland
itinerary.description: When you arrive in Auckland, also known as 'The City of Sails', things will be quite straightforward. For those of you traveling by group tour (seat in coach), a friendly local representative will be there to greet you at the airport. They'll take care of you and make sure you get safely to your hotel. If you're one of the independent travelers with a rental car, you'll find your car ready and waiting for you at the airport. You can then hop into your car and drive to your hotel from there. It's as simple as that!

itinerary.title: Auckland to Bay of Islands
itinerary.description: Today, we start our journey by heading north over Auckland's iconic Harbour Bridge. As we drive along the stunning Hibiscus Coast, you'll have the chance to see the majestic Kauri Trees on the way. Our adventure continues, taking us through Whangarei, the main city and port in Northland, before we reach the picturesque Bay of Islands. In the afternoon, we'll dive into New Zealand's rich history with a guided tour of the Waitangi Treaty Grounds. Here, you'll learn about the historic treaty signed between the British Crown and Maori Chieftains. After this enlightening experience, we'll embark on the 'Hole in the Rock and Cape Brett' cruise, a true highlight of the day. For those seeking a little extra romance, you can choose to disembark during the cruise in the charming town of Russell. Take your time to explore this historic gem before returning to Paihia by a local ferry (ferry ticket included). Tonight, we rest in comfort at our hotel in the Bay of Islands.

itinerary.title: Enjoying Bay of Islands
itinerary.description: Today is a day for you to relax and do as you please. You have some optional choices to make your day special. You might consider taking a day tour to Cape Reinga and 90 Mile Beach, a fantastic adventure. Or, if you prefer, you can explore the charming towns of Russell or Kerikeri. Please note that the optional activities are not included in the tour price. After your day of leisure, you'll spend the night at your hotel in the lovely Bay of Islands.

itinerary.title: Bay of Islands to Auckland (Approx. 228km, around 3 hours and 15 minutes)
itinerary.description: Today is a day for you to relax and take it easy. If you'd like, there are optional activities to explore more of this gorgeous region. In the afternoon, you'll make your way back to Auckland. You'll spend the night at your hotel in Auckland.

itinerary.title: Depart Auckland
itinerary.description: Today is the day to head home or continue your journey to the next exciting destination. You'll make your way to the airport, where you'll board your flight. As you leave Auckland, you'll carry with you a treasure trove of memories, ones that will warm your heart for a lifetime.

packages.name: A Trip to Wonderful Philippines | 5 Days Itinerary

images.alt_text: A Trip to Wonderful Philippines | 5 Days Itinerary
A Trip to Wonderful Philippines | 5 Days Itinerary

itinerary.title: Arrival - Manila
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival in Manila, our representative will warmly welcome you and facilitate your transfer to the hotel. Enjoy a comfortable overnight stay at the hotel in Manila.

itinerary.title: Manila
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a delightful breakfast. Embark on a fascinating tour starting from the financial district of Makati, which includes Fort Bonifacio and the American Cemetery. Then, explore the city of Manila, the capital of the country. Visit Rizal Park, dedicated to the national hero, Dr. Jose Rizal, and capture some memorable moments during a brief photo stop. Proceed to the historic Walled City of Intramuros and wander through its cobbled streets. Explore the San Agustin Church, the oldest stone church in the country, showcasing a remarkable collection of ecclesiastical icons, vestments, and other religious artefacts. Nearby, discover Casa Manila, a reproduction of a 19th-century house adorned with Oriental and European decor, as well as Philippine antique furniture. Continue your journey to Fort Santiago, Manila's primary defence against maritime invaders, guarding the city's entrance from Manila Bay. This stone fort holds historical significance with its association to many tragic moments in Philippine history. Afterward, drive to Quiapo, the central district of Manila, often referred to as the heart of the city. Explore its vibrant market, the pilgrimage church of the Black Nazarene, jeepney terminals, and bazaars. Conclude the day with a visit to the Chinese Cemetery, where mausoleums are as grand as houses, showcasing a fusion of Buddhist and Christian influences. Take some time for shopping before returning to the hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Manila to Coron, Palawan
itinerary.description: After enjoying your breakfast, it's time to bid farewell to the hotel and make your way to Manila Airport. Upon arrival in Palawan, you'll be transferred to your hotel. Check-in and take the rest of the day at your leisure. Spend a relaxing night at the hotel in Palawan.

itinerary.title: Coron Island Exploration
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delicious breakfast before embarking on a tour of the stunning islands around Coron in Palawan. Revel in the beauty of Kayangan Lake, a crystal-clear body of water that allows you to see right down to the bottom. Next, venture to the Twin Lagoons, surrounded by rocky cliffs and featuring enchanting blue-green waters straight out of a fairy tale. Enjoy the night at your Palawan hotel.

itinerary.title: Departure from Coron, Palawan to Manila
itinerary.description: As the sun rises, check out from your hotel and head to Manila Airport for your flight back home. Take with you, countless memories to cherish for a lifetime.

images.alt_text: Discover Philippines: Exploring Manila and Cebu
Discover Philippines: Exploring Manila and Cebu

itinerary.title: Arrival in Manila
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival in Manila, our representative will warmly welcome you and assist with your transfer to the hotel. Enjoy an overnight stay at the hotel in Manila.

itinerary.title: Exploring Manila
itinerary.description: Kickstart your day with a delightful breakfast before setting off on a tour of Manila. Begin in the financial district of Makati, covering notable sites such as Fort Bonifacio and the American Cemetery. Continue to the heart of Manila, the country's capital, where you will visit Rizal Park, dedicated to Dr. Jose Rizal, the national hero. After a brief stop for photos, proceed to the historic Walled City of Intramuros. Wander through the charming streets to explore San Agustin Church, the oldest stone church in the country, displaying a remarkable collection of ecclesiastical icons and religious artefacts. Nearby, discover Casa Manila, a reproduction of a 19th-century house adorned with Oriental and European decor, along with Philippine antique furniture. Your journey continues to Fort Santiago, the city's primary defence against sea invaders, rich in historical significance. From the fort, drive to Quiapo, Manila's central district, often called the heart of the city. Explore its vibrant market, visit the pilgrimage church of the Black Nazarene, and experience the lively atmosphere of jeepney terminals and bazaars. Conclude the day with a visit to the Chinese Cemetery, known for its grand mausoleums blending Buddhist and Christian influences. Take some time for shopping before returning to the hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Manila to Cebu
itinerary.description: Commence the day with a delightful breakfast. Enjoy a private transfer from the hotel to the Domestic Airport for your flight to Cebu. Upon reaching Cebu, take a shared transfer to the beach resort. The rest of the day is yours to relax and unwind. Spend the night at the hotel in Cebu.

itinerary.title: Cebu
itinerary.description: Start your day with a satisfying breakfast and embark on a thrilling eco-adventure tour to the hilly landscapes. Explore the Little Europe of Cebu, beginning at the Temple of Lea, an enchanting masterpiece built as a symbol of enduring love. Similar to India's renowned Taj Mahal, it captivates with its artistry. Marvel at the beauty of Celosia Flower Farm, often referred to as the “little Amsterdam” in Cebu, thanks to the lively colours produced by celosia flowers. After a delicious lunch, the tour continues to the Flea Market and Agricultural Products, concluding at Terrazas de Flores, where over a hundred species of flowers adorn the area. Spend the night at the hotel in Cebu.

itinerary.title: Departing Cebu to Manila
itinerary.description: In the morning, after having your breakfast, bid farewell to the hotel and make your way to Manila airport. Board your flight homeward, carrying with you a treasure trove of cherished memories that will last a lifetime.

itinerary.title: Reach Kuala Lumpur – Petronas Twin Towers - KL Bird Park
itinerary.description: Once you land in Kuala Lumpur, our tour representatives will greet you at the airport and take you to your hotel. After checking in and freshening up, get ready for some sightseeing. We’ll cover all the important tourist spots in Kuala Lumpur, including the magnificent Petronas Twin Towers and Batu Caves. Next, head to the Kuala Lumpur Bird Park, which covers an area of 20.9 acres and has over 3,000 local and foreign birds of about 200 different species.

itinerary.title: Johor Bahru - Johor Zoo - Johor Bahru Old Chinese Temple
itinerary.description: You will be transported from Kuala Lumpur to Johor Bahru on your second day. Visit one of the oldest zoos in Malaysia, the Johor Zoo, home to numerous species of birds and mammals. Pay your respects at the Johor Bahru Old Chinese Temple, one of the oldest temples in Johor.

itinerary.title: Legoland Malaysia - Desaru Beach
itinerary.description: Adventure and excitement await you on your third day as you head to Legoland Malaysia, a theme park filled with rides, games, shows, and multiple attractions. In the evening, stroll at Desaru Beach, where you can enjoy water-based activities such as boating, swimming, and fishing.

itinerary.title: Melaka - A'Famosa - Baba Nyonya Heritage Museum
itinerary.description: On your fourth day, you will cover the city of Melaka or Malacca. Visit the old European architectural remains of A'Famosa, which was once a Portuguese Fortress. Next, you will be taken to the Baba Nyonya Heritage Museum, which Chan Kim Lay constructed in 1896.

itinerary.title: Safari Wonderland - Jonker Street
itinerary.description: A shuttle will transfer you to the A'Famosa Resort on your fifth day, where you can enjoy the wonders of the Safari Wonderland, which includes fun shows, rides, and animal presentations. You can head to Jonker Street in the evening to shop for clothes, souvenirs, and antique items.

itinerary.title: Depart from Kuala Lumpur
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Reach Kuala Lumpur - Malacca - Petronas Twin Towers
itinerary.description: Once you land in Kuala Lumpur, our tour representatives will greet you at the airport and take you to your hotel. After you’ve freshened up, we’ll meet you at the appointed hour to begin your first day of sightseeing. Witness Malacca, a UNESCO World Heritage Site brimming with historical importance. Before returning to your hotel, visit the most popular spot in the city, the Petronas Twin Towers.

itinerary.title: KL Bird Park - Batu Caves - National Mosque of Malaysia
itinerary.description: You will be taking in the peace of the Batu Caves on the second day of your trip. The next destination is the National Mosque of Malaysia. You will then head to the Kuala Lumpur Bird Park, spread over 20.9 acres and housing more than 3,000 birds of about 200 species.

itinerary.title: Kota Kinabalu - Lok Kawi Wildlife Park - Tanjung Aru Beach
itinerary.description: Take your flight from Kuala Lumpur to Kota Kinabalu. After you have checked in and freshened up, you will be taken to the Lok Kawi Wildlife Park, a botanical and zoological section park. Enjoy the breathtaking sunset at Tanjung Aru Beach before returning to your hotel.

itinerary.title: Sabah State Museum - Kota Kinabalu City Mosque
itinerary.description: On your fourth day, explore the Sabah State Museum, which is a museum that is home to both modern and historical items, preserving items related to the history and culture of Sabah. Later, head to the Kota Kinabalu City Mosque, the largest mosque and the second most important one in Kota Kinabalu. It is also known as the Floating Mosque, thanks to a manmade lagoon surrounding the structure.

itinerary.title: Mount Kinabalu
itinerary.description: Witness the spectacular view of Mount Kinabalu, the highest mountain in Malaysia, at 4,101 metres and famous for being the world’s most accessible mountain.

itinerary.title: Depart from Kuala Lumpur
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Sabah State Museum - Kota Kinabalu City Mosque
itinerary.description: Once you land in Kota Kinabalu, our tour representatives will greet you at the airport and take you to your hotel. After you have freshened up, we’ll start with the first day of the tour. Kota Kinabalu is the capital of the state of Sabah. You will first visit the Sabah State Museum, which is home to both modern and historical items related to the history and culture of Sabah. Later, head to the Kota Kinabalu City Mosque, the largest and second most important mosque in Kota Kinabalu. It is also known as the Floating Mosque, as a manmade lagoon surrounds it.

itinerary.title: White Water Rafting
itinerary.description: On the second day of your fabulous holiday, you will be experiencing the thrill of white water rafting. Take a train from Kota Kinabalu to the point where you can begin the rafting activity at the Padas River. On the way, breathe in the serene views. After you achieve the much-needed adrenaline rush, you will be treated to a delicious lunch before returning to your hotel in Kota Kinabalu.

itinerary.title: Klias Wildlife Safari River Cruise
itinerary.description: Today, you will journey from Kota Kinabalu to the Klias wetlands, about 112 km from the city. Get on a river cruise as you travel along the Klias River, and be prepared to spot creatures such as the rare silver languor, long-tailed macaques, and probosci's monkeys.

itinerary.title: Depart from Kota Kinabalu
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

Majestic New Zealand Adventure Tour Itinerary

itinerary.title: Auckland - Welcome to 'The City of Sails'
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival in Auckland, known as 'The City of Sails,' our friendly local representative will warmly greet seat-in-coach guests and provide a private transfer to your hotel. Self-drive guests will conveniently pick up their rental car at the airport and drive to their chosen hotel. Get ready to unwind and relax at your Auckland hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: Auckland City Exploration
itinerary.description: After a delicious breakfast, your day kicks off with a morning city sightseeing tour for seat-in-coach guests. You'll have the opportunity to visit two fantastic attractions: Kelly Tarlton’s Sealife Aquarium and the Antarctic Encounter (both for seat-in-coach and self-drive guests). The rest of the day is yours to explore and enjoy as you wish. Rest comfortably for the night at your Auckland hotel.

itinerary.title: Auckland to Rotorua via Waitomo and Matamata
itinerary.description: Enjoy a hearty breakfast and prepare for an exciting day. Your morning journey takes you south through the picturesque Waikato region, leading to Waitomo. There, you'll embark on a guided tour of the seductive glowworm caves. The adventure continues as you proceed to Rotorua via the Hobbiton Movie Set, where you'll have a guided tour of this world-renowned attraction. Rest easy at your Rotorua hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: Rotorua's Natural Wonders and Maori Culture
itinerary.description: Break your fast and set out for a day filled with exploration. Begin your adventure at Te Puia Thermal Reserve, where you can witness boiling mud pools and roaring geysers. Following this, head to the Agrodome for a captivating farm show and visit Rainbow Springs to encounter New Zealand’s trout, birds, and wildlife. The afternoon is yours to enjoy at your leisure. In the evening, enjoy the authentic flavours of a Maori Hangi (feast) and enjoy a memorable concert. Dinner is included, and you'll stay overnight at your Rotorua hotel.

itinerary.title: Rotorua to Christchurch (Your Arrangements)
itinerary.description: After a satisfying breakfast, it's time to make your way to Rotorua airport for your domestic flight to Christchurch (airfare not included). Upon arrival, check in at your Christchurch hotel, and the rest of the day is yours to explore and relax. Get a good night's rest at your Christchurch hotel.

itinerary.title: Journey to Queenstown via Mt Cook
itinerary.description: Enjoy a delightful breakfast to start your day. Your morning adventure takes you across the fertile Canterbury Plains to Lake Tekapo, home to the iconic 'Church of the Good Shepherd.' Continue your journey to New Zealand's highest peak, Mt Cook. Departing from Mt Cook, follow the shores of Lake Pukaki south, traversing the historic Central Otago region, until you reach the 'Alpine Resort' of Queenstown. Settle in at your Queenstown hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: Queenstown to Milford Sound and Back
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a tasty breakfast, and then head to the southern arm of Lake Wakatipu, leading to Lumsden and onward to Lake Te Anau. As you enter the breathtaking Eglinton Valley, you'll travel through the awe-inspiring Homer Tunnel to reach the world-famous Milford Sound. Experience a cruise on this magnificent fjord, dominated by Mitre Peak and the spectacular Bowen Falls. Return to Queenstown after this incredible adventure and rest comfortably at your Queenstown hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: Free Day in Queenstown
itinerary.description: Indulge in a delightful breakfast and take full advantage of a free day in Queenstown. This vibrant town offers a wide range of optional activities, from thrilling bungy jumping and jet boating to white-water rafting and scenic gondola rides. Please note that optional activities are not included in the tour price. You'll spend another night at your Queenstown hotel.

itinerary.title: Queenstown to the Glacier Region
itinerary.description: Savour a scrumptious breakfast and then set off for the glacier region. Your journey will take you via Lake Wanaka and through the historic Haast Pass, serving as the gateway to the World Heritage-listed Westland National Park. As you continue along the West Coast, you'll be treated to spectacular mountain ranges, lush native forests, and serene lakes, all en route to the glacier region of Franz Josef and Fox Glaciers. Find comfort in your hotel for the night in the glacier region.

itinerary.title: Glacier Region to Christchurch
itinerary.description: Enjoy a hearty breakfast to fuel your day. Today, travel north to Greymouth and embark on a scenic ride on the Tranz Alpine train (for seat-in-coach guests). This memorable journey will take you through lush beech forests, past the alpine village of Arthur's Pass, and over the magnificent Southern Alps. The train ride concludes as you traverse the Canterbury Plains, arriving in Christchurch. Settle into your Christchurch hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: Farewell to Christchurch
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delicious breakfast. It's time to head to the airport for your flight to your next destination or your hometown, carrying with you a treasure trove of cherished memories from this incredible journey. Your tour concludes with a fond farewell and a heart full of lasting memories.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Auckland - The City of Sails
itinerary.description: Welcome to the beginning of your incredible New Zealand journey! As you touch down in Auckland, often referred to as 'The City of Sails', you'll be met with warm hospitality and convenience. Our dedicated local representative will be there to greet seat-in-coach passengers upon arrival, ensuring a seamless start to your adventure. You'll then be privately transferred to your comfortable hotel, allowing you to relax and unwind after your journey. For those who have chosen the self-drive option, you'll collect your rental car at the airport. With the freedom of the open road ahead of you, you'll drive to your hotel at your own pace.

itinerary.title: Auckland to Rotorua via Waitomo
itinerary.description: On the second day of your journey, we leave the vibrant city of Auckland and head south through the lush Waikato region. Our destination? The enchanting Waitomo Glowworm Caves. As we arrive in Waitomo, prepare to be captivated by nature's luminescent spectacle. Our guided tour takes us deep into the heart of these renowned caves. A boat ride beneath the cave ceiling reveals a breathtaking sight - millions of glowworms casting a celestial glow, like stars in the night sky. Leaving this subterranean wonderland behind, we continue our adventure through the forested Mamaku Ranges. Our next stop is the remarkable 'Thermal City' of Rotorua, where the earth itself seems to breathe with geothermal activity. Our day culminates with a comfortable night's rest in Rotorua, ready to embrace the wonders of this thermal paradise.

itinerary.title: Rotorua
itinerary.description: Rise for a wonderful breakfast. On this day, we will be exploring the captivating Te Puia Thermal Reserve, where bubbling mud pools and powerful geysers take center stage. Our next stop is Rainbow Springs, a haven for New Zealand's trout, birds, and wildlife. Later, we head to the Agrodome for an authentic New Zealand farm show, featuring sheepdog demonstrations, cow milking, and an introduction to the stars of our sheep industry. The afternoon is yours to enjoy at your own pace. In the evening, savour the rich flavours of an authentic Maori Hangi feast, accompanied by a mesmerising concert. You will be provided with a mouthwatering complimentary dinner. You'll spend the night at our cozy hotel in Rotorua, making this day truly unforgettable.

itinerary.title: Rotorua to Wellington
itinerary.description: Get ready by having a hearty breakfast. Today, we set off on a journey to the charming lake resort of Taupo. Our path leads us along the picturesque shores of Lake Taupo before we reach the welcoming town of Turangi. As we continue our drive, the magnificent Desert Road unfolds before us, with the majestic peaks of Ruapehu, Ngauruhoe, and Tongariro forming a breathtaking backdrop. Our road winds through verdant farmlands as we make our way southward, eventually arriving in the heart of New Zealand's capital city, Wellington. We'll be spending the night in the comfort of our Wellington hotel, ready to explore the city's vibrant offerings.

itinerary.title: Wellington
itinerary.description: Indulge in a delightful breakfast to kickstart your day. Take in the charm of Wellington with a morning sightseeing tour. You'll also have the pleasure of a guided tour at Te Papa, known as the 'Museum of New Zealand.' Afterward, the afternoon is yours to explore the capital city of New Zealand at your leisure. Your cozy hotel in Wellington waits for a relaxing overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Wellington to Kaikoura
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delightful breakfast. Today, we will embark on a journey across the Cook Strait, which gracefully divides New Zealand's North and South Islands. As we sail through, you'll be treated to the mesmerising sights of the Marlborough Sounds, with its crystalline waters and abundant, flourishing forests. Our destination is Picton, a charming town nestled within this natural paradise. We'll then set out on a southward adventure through the scenic town of Blenheim before finally reaching our haven for the night in Kaikoura. Rest easy at your hotel in this picturesque coastal town.

itinerary.title: Kaikoura to Christchurch
itinerary.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast. Then, continue your journey to Christchurch through the picturesque North Canterbury region. Your destination is the enchanting "Garden City" of Christchurch.

itinerary.title: Christchurch to Mount Cook
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delicious breakfast. Today, we will start on a scenic journey across the lush Canterbury Plains, leading us to the breath-taking Lake Tekapo. Take a moment to visit the iconic 'Church of the Good Shepherd', a true gem of the region. Afterward, we will continue our adventure into the enchanting Mount Cook National Park. Your overnight stay awaits at a comfortable hotel in Mount Cook.

itinerary.title: Mount Cook to Queenstown
itinerary.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast. Today, we'll trace the scenic shores of Lake Pukaki as we head south towards the charming town of Twizel. Our journey continues through the historic Central Otago region, which is steeped in tradition and natural beauty. Our destination for the day is the captivating Lake Wakatipu and the picturesque 'Alpine Resort' of Queenstown. Here, we'll be spending the night at a cozy hotel, where you can rest and rejuvenate.

itinerary.title: Queenstown
itinerary.description: Good morning! Enjoy a delicious breakfast to kickstart your day. Today is all about freedom and adventure. Queenstown opens its doors to a plethora of exciting optional activities. Whether you're an adrenaline junkie or simply looking for a leisurely experience, there's something for everyone. The menu of options is vast. You can take the plunge with bungy jumping, feel the thrill of jetboating, conquer the rapids with white water rafting, or ascend to new heights on a gondola ride. And that's just the beginning; Queenstown is a hub of exhilarating experiences. Please note that these optional activities are not included in the tour price, so you can tailor your day to suit your preferences. Embrace Queenstown's charm and let your inner explorer roam free. Enjoy your day!

itinerary.title: Queenstown - Milford Sound - Te Anau
itinerary.description: Today, we are going to venture to the southern edge of Lake Wakatipu, making our way to Lumsden before heading to the serene shores of Lake Te Anau. Along the way, we'll traverse the awe-inspiring Eglinton Valley and pass through the magnificent man-made Homer Tunnel, an engineering marvel. Our destination: the renowned Milford Sound, a place of wonder and tranquility, presided over by the majestic Mitre Peak. We'll embark on an awesome cruise through the world-famous fiord, where nature's beauty knows no bounds. As we sail through the pristine waters of Milford Sound, you'll be captivated by the grandeur of the surrounding cliffs and the serenity of the deep-blue waters. After our cruise, we'll make our way back to Te Anau, where you can look forward to a comfortable night's rest at the hotel, reflecting on the day's incredible experiences.

itinerary.title: Te Anau - Dunedin
itinerary.description: After a delightful breakfast, we will set out on a picturesque journey. We'll traverse the fertile Southland Plains, passing through the charming towns of Gore and Balclutha, before heading north to the southern gem known as the 'Edinburgh of the South,' Dunedin. Your afternoon is free to explore optional activities. Your cozy haven for the night awaits at your Dunedin hotel.

itinerary.title: Dunedin - Christchurch
itinerary.description: Wake up to a scrumptious breakfast and gear up for another day of adventure. Today, we will head north through lush farmland and a string of quaint farming communities on our way to Christchurch. Your comfortable lodging for the night is at a Christchurch hotel.

itinerary.title: Farewell Christchurch
itinerary.description: Savour a delightful breakfast to kickstart your day. As the morning unfolds, make your way to the airport to catch your flight, whether it's towards your next destination or your beloved hometown. Reflect on the cherished memories you've made throughout this journey that will stay with you for a lifetime. This marks the conclusion of your amazing tour!

itinerary.title: Rotorua to Wellington

itinerary.title: Wellington

itinerary.title: Wellington to Christchurch

You'll be enchanted by the breathtaking beauty of Marlborough Sounds, with its pristine waters and verdant woodlands, before your arrival in Picton. As you continue your journey southward through Blenheim and Kaikoura, you'll eventually find yourself in the charming 'Garden City' of Christchurch. itinerary.title: Christchurch to Dunedin
itinerary.description: Today, journey southward across the vast Canterbury Plains to reach charming Dunedin, which bears the influence of Scottish heritage. This city is famous for its rich wildlife and the prestigious Otago University. Rest for the night in a cozy Dunedin hotel.

itinerary.title: Dunedin to Queenstown
itinerary.description: Enjoy your morning at leisure with the option to partake in various activities. Later in the day, you will set off from Dunedin, embarking on a picturesque journey through the charming towns of Central Otago. As the sun begins to set, you'll reach the enchanting Queenstown. Your overnight stay awaits at a splendid hotel in this remarkable destination.

itinerary.title: Queenstown
itinerary.description: Today, you have a day to yourself, with optional attractions to choose from. Queenstown boasts an array of thrilling options, such as bungee jumping, jet boating, white water rafting, and scenic gondola rides. Please note that these optional activities are not included in the tour package. You'll spend the night at your Queenstown hotel. Enjoy your evening.

itinerary.title: Queenstown to the Glacier Region

Today, journey to the enchanting Glacier Region, passing through the picturesque Lake Wanaka and the historic Haast Pass, your gateway to the World Heritage-listed Westland National Park. Drive along the mesmerising West Coast, where you'll be captivated by the stunning mountain ranges, lush native forests, and serene lakes as you make your way to the glacier wonderland of Franz Josef and Fox Glaciers. For those on a Self-Drive adventure, your day's highlights also include complimentary entry to the relaxing Glacier Hot Pools. This evening, unwind and recharge at your cozy hotel in the Glacier Region. Day 11: Glacier Region to Christchurch via Greymouth This morning, we set our course northward towards Greymouth. Here, our adventure takes an exciting turn as we board the renowned Tranz Alpine train (exclusive to seat-in-coach passengers). As we embark on this journey, we ascend through the enchanting beech forests, passing the picturesque alpine haven of Arthur's Pass. Crossing the awe-inspiring Southern Alps, we continue our expedition, traversing the boundless Canterbury Plains. Our day's expedition concludes in the charming city of Christchurch, where we will spend the night in a cozy hotel. Don't forget to enjoy a delightful breakfast to fuel your day!

itinerary.title: Glacier Region – Greymouth – Christchurch
itinerary.description: After breakfast travel to Greymouth on the world-famous TranzAlpine Train, enjoying the scenic view of the lush beech forests as they pass through alpine villages like Arthur’s Pass before reaching the Southern Alps. The trains journeys through the Canterbury Plains as it reaches Christchurch. Upon arrival, our tour manager will welcome you and help you check into the hotel. itinerary.description: Arrive at Tokyo Narita Airport and make your way to the hotel. The evening is yours to relax, and overnight accommodation is provided at the Tokyo hotel.

itinerary.title: Tokyo – City Exploration
itinerary.description: Enjoy a hearty breakfast. Gather at specified locations (hotels in Tokyo) and board the bus heading to Hamamatsucho Bus Terminal. Depart from Hamamatsucho Bus Terminal for a captivating sightseeing tour of Tokyo. Visit iconic landmarks such as Tokyo Tower and partake in a traditional tea ceremony experience. Enjoy a delightful Japanese-style lunch as you continue the city tour, exploring the Imperial Palace Plaza, Nijubashi Bridge, and Hinode Pier. Embark on a Sumida River Cruise from Azumabashi (Bridge over Sumida River) and discover the charm of Sensoji Temple and Nakamise Shopping Street. The tour concludes at Hamamatsucho Bus Terminal, allowing you to return to the hotel at your own pace. Overnight accommodation is provided at the Tokyo hotel.

itinerary.title: Tokyo – Mt. Fuji – Hakone
itinerary.description: Meet at specified locations (your Tokyo hotel) and hop on the bus bound for Hamamatsucho Bus Terminal. Depart from Hamamatsucho and travel to Mt. Fuji by bus, either on the Chuo Expressway or Tomei Expressway. Explore Mt. Fuji, with the bus ascending to the 5th Station along the Subaru Line, situated at an impressive 2,300 metres (7,546 ft) above sea level. Revel in breathtaking views above the clouds at this altitude. Indulge in a delightful Japanese-style lunch before embarking on a scenic cruise on Lake Ashi. This crater lake, formed by a powerful volcanic eruption nearly 3,000 years ago, offers postcard-worthy views of Mt. Fuji, towering 30 km to the northwest. Appreciate the stunning sight of Mt. Fuji from the deck of the ship. Take a 7-minute ropeway ride to the summit of Mt. Komagatake. Afterwards, depart for Hakone and reach Odawara Station by bus. Make your way to the hotel independently. Spend the night at the hotel in Hakone.

itinerary.title: Hakone to Kyoto
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head to Odawara Station using a taxi or bus on your own. Board Shinkansen Nozomi 27 for Kyoto. Upon arrival at Kyoto station, check in to the hotel. The rest of the day is yours to relax. Spend the night at the hotel in Kyoto.

itinerary.title: Kyoto to Nara Tour
itinerary.description: Start the day with breakfast before embarking on the Kyoto and Nara tour. Pickup service is available at designated hotels in Kyoto, and all transportation on this tour is in a seat-in-coach bus. Explore Nijo Castle, a UNESCO World Heritage site, and marvel at the golden beauty of Kinkaku-ji Temple. The Kyoto Imperial Palace (accessible on Mondays to Fridays) offers a glimpse into the historical residence of the Emperor. Later, visit Kitano Tenmangu Shrine on Saturdays, Sundays, holidays, and specific days. Enjoy a Japanese-style lunch (both Veg and Non-Veg options available) and continue to Nara for a tour. Visit Todai-ji Temple and Nara Park, both designated as World Heritage sites. Todai-ji Temple houses a colossal bronze Great Buddha and is a remarkable wooden structure. Explore Kasuga Taisha Shrine, another World Heritage Site, and discover Nara Nagomikan, the largest souvenir shop in Nara. In the evening, return to your hotel in Kyoto. Spend the night in Kyoto.

itinerary.title: Kyoto
itinerary.description: Indulge in a leisurely breakfast and enjoy a free day at your own pace. Overnight at the hotel in Kyoto.

itinerary.title: Departure from Kyoto
itinerary.description: After breakfast, proceed to Kansai airport to catch your flight back to your hometown or next destination.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Nadi - Savusavu - Namale Resort
itinerary.description: Welcome to Nadi International Airport, your gateway to paradise! After smoothly clearing Fiji's Immigration and Customs, make your way through the Customs Hall. Our office is conveniently located as the fourth on the right, immediately after you clear Customs in the Arrivals Concourse. Here, you will meet our friendly local representative at the Information Desk. Our English-speaking representative will warmly greet you with a hearty "Bula," offering you a shell lei, a refreshing mint towel, and a bottle of water. They will then guide you to the domestic departures area. You'll soon board a Fiji Link domestic flight from Nadi Airport to Savusavu (where H class fare is quoted, with a luggage allowance of 15 kilograms). In the rare case that only Y class fare is available, rest assured that the cost will be adjusted accordingly. Upon your arrival in Savusavu, you will be met by a Namale representative who will escort you to the resort in one of their comfortable resort vehicles. Prepare to unwind and enjoy your first night at the enchanting Namale Resort.

itinerary.title: Namale Resort
itinerary.description: Enjoy a luxurious 4-night stay at Namale Resort, where you'll be immersed in pure paradise. Our accommodation options are designed to cater to your preferences, and below you'll find details about the categories and costs. Inclusive Package: Sumptuous Meals: Your days begin with a full-service breakfast, followed by delicious lunches, snacks, and gourmet dinners. Free-flowing Beverages: Savour the finest beers, liquors, red and white wines, and champagne. Your fully stocked mini bar is replenished daily. Hassle-Free Transfers: We provide convenient round-trip transfers to and from Savusavu Airport for your peace of mind. Freshly Laundered Clothes: You won't need to worry about laundry, as we offer daily laundry services. Evening Delights: Experience nightly turndown service that ensures your evenings are as peaceful as your days. Golf Enthusiasts: Enjoy golfing to your heart's content, as it's part of our comprehensive package. Diverse Activities Await: Namale Resort is a haven of activities, ensuring you make the most of your stay. Dive into freshwater swimming pools, explore the vibrant underwater world with snorkeling, or feel the thrill of water-skiing. Take a kayak and paddle along the beautiful coastline, embark on horseback riding adventures, and indulge in friendly competitions of volleyball, tennis, basketball, badminton, and lawn croquet. For the leisurely moments, we offer billiards, table tennis, and ten-pin bowling. If you seek something unique, try your hand at virtual golf or putting on our lush green. The options continue with air hockey, hiking, reef walks, and waterfall hikes. For a cinematic experience, we have a movie theatre ready to entertain. Honeymoon Special: For our honeymooners, we add extra magic to your stay. Find your names etched on native palm wood, hung on your bure or villa door upon check-in. Revel in a chilled bottle of champagne awaiting you on ice upon arrival. Welcome an exquisite gift as you start your romantic journey. Enjoy a private breakfast in bed, and, weather permitting, relish a delightful lunch at the waterfalls. For a truly romantic touch, experience a private dinner dine-out under the starry Fiji sky (weather dependent). To complete your blissful getaway, we offer a 10% discount on all spa treatments. As the sun sets, rest easy knowing you're staying at the enchanting Namale Resort, where all your meals are included.

For those who love horseback riding, there are opportunities to explore the surroundings on horseback. Sports enthusiasts can engage in friendly games of volleyball, tennis, basketball, badminton, lawn croquet, and even billiards. If you prefer indoor activities, challenge your companions to table tennis or ten-pin bowling. For a touch of virtual golf, try your swing on the putting green, or opt for a more thrilling experience with a game of air hockey. Nature lovers can explore the nearby hiking trails, venture on reef walks, and discover the serenity of waterfall hikes. As the day comes to a close, you can even enjoy a movie in the on-site theatre. With a multitude of choices, your day at Namale Resort promises both adventure and relaxation. You'll spend the night at this idyllic resort. (B for Breakfast included)

itinerary.description: Your journey begins as you land at Nadi International Airport. Once you've gone through Fiji's Immigration & Customs, head towards the Customs Hall exit. You'll easily spot our Tour Shop at number 21 or booth 6. If you need assistance, don't hesitate to ask for help at the Information Desk. Look out for our friendly representative, dressed in our company uniform, who will warmly greet you with a "Bula," offer you shell leis, refreshing minted towels, and bottled water. They will then guide you to our office, where you can exchange your vouchers and receive important information. Once you've sorted out your vouchers, our Portage service will take care of your luggage. You'll also meet your driver, who will transport you in our comfortable, air-conditioned vehicle to your Coral Coast Resort.
