itinerary.title: Exploring the Coral Coast
itinerary.description: On this day, you have a choice of activities to make the most of your time on the beautiful Coral Coast. You can either enjoy the resort's facilities or spend your day relaxing on the stunning white sandy beaches. If you're up for an adventure, consider the SIGTOKA RIVER SAFARI TOUR, a half-day excursion aboard a specially designed safari jet boat. This thrilling journey takes you 10 miles up the Sigatoka River, where you'll have the opportunity to visit authentic Fijian villages and immerse yourself in the daily life of the local 'Kaiviti' (Fijian people). During the tour, you'll learn about the rich local history and interesting facts about the area. Be sure to have your camera ready to capture the breathtaking scenery along the way. You'll also get to experience village life firsthand and take part in a traditional Fijian sevusevu, which involves a Kava ceremony. And of course, don't miss the chance to sample delicious Fijian cuisine. After a day of exploration and cultural experiences, you'll spend the night at your chosen hotel or resort on the Coral Coast.

itinerary.title: Exploring Coral Coast
itinerary.description: Today, you have the freedom to enjoy your day at your own pace or opt for some exciting Optional Excursions, available at an additional cost. We highly recommend taking a tour to Suva, the capital city of Fiji. This tour ensures that you get to explore and discover fascinating places in the capital. During the tour, you'll have the chance to visit several interesting sites in Suva, such as the Fiji Museum, city landmarks, colonial buildings like the 1902 Catholic Cathedral, Government Building, the historic Grand Pacific Hotel, an old cemetery, and the library, among many others. Please note that lunch is not included in the tour costs, but you'll have plenty of dining options in the city. The tour typically drops guests off at the MHCC Complex, which boasts a Food Court with a wide range of authentic cuisines to choose from. As part of this excursion, you'll also have the opportunity to visit the world-renowned Pure Fiji Factory. They welcome visitors daily for tours, except on Saturdays. After your day of exploration, you'll return to your hotel or resort on the Coral Coast for a comfortable overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Relaxation and Cultural Exploration in Coral Coast
itinerary.description: Today is all about taking it easy and enjoying some well-deserved pampering at the resort spa. You'll find a range of fabulous treatments available to help you unwind and rejuvenate. Alternatively, you can choose to explore the rich history and natural beauty of the Coral Coast. Visit the Sigatoka Sand Dunes National Park, a part of the National Trust of Fiji, where you can discover the fascinating history of this area. Explore the Kula Eco Park and immerse yourself in Fiji's unique wildlife and conservation efforts. You'll also have the opportunity to visit Lawai Village and gain insight into the local way of life. In the afternoon, you'll be treated to a delightful Indian-style High Tea at the private home of one of the Indian settlers from India. This is a unique chance to experience the lifestyle of Fiji's Indian community, see their homes, farms, and learn about their general way of life. After a day of relaxation and cultural exploration, you'll spend the night at your hotel or resort on the Coral Coast, ensuring a comfortable and restful stay.

itinerary.title: Leaving the Coral Coast
itinerary.description: On this day, you'll need to check out early for your departing flight.

packages.name: Explore Splendid Adelaide for 4 Days | Itinerary

images.alt_text: Explore Splendid Adelaide for 4 Days | Itinerary
Explore Splendid Adelaide for 4 Days | Itinerary

itinerary.title: Arrival in Adelaide
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Adelaide Airport, take a shuttle transfer to your hotel. Please note that early check-in is not guaranteed. After settling in, you may embark on a 90-minute Stadium Tour at Adelaide Oval, featuring the Bradman Collections. This tour commences at 2:00 PM on non-event dates and does not include transfers. Following the tour, return to your hotel for check-in. Spend the night at the hotel in Adelaide.

itinerary.title: Adelaide – Choose a Full Day Tour
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a delightful breakfast. You have the option to select one Full Day SIC Tour, which offers limited hotel pickup. Your choices include either the Full Day Grand Barossa Valley Wine Tasting & Hahndorf Tour with Lunch or the Full Day SIC Victor Harbour, Port of Goolwa, and McLaren Vale Wine Region Tour with Lunch. Your overnight stay will be at the hotel in Adelaide. (Lunch is included.)

itinerary.title: Adelaide – Full Day Kangaroo Island Highlight Tour
itinerary.description: Indulge in a complimentary breakfast before embarking on an early morning Full Day Cruise Kangaroo Island Highlights Tour, complete with a two-course lunch. After the tour, return to your hotel and enjoy another comfortable night in Adelaide.

itinerary.title: Departure Day
itinerary.description: Relish a delicious breakfast to start your day. Today marks the day of departure from Adelaide. As a bonus, you can partake in a Half Day SIC Morning Adelaide City Tour with limited hotel pickup (please note that there is no hotel drop-off). This tour concludes at 12:00 PM at the Central Bus Station, and you will need to make your own way back to the hotel. Later in the day, depart for Adelaide Airport via a shuttle transfer for your onward flight. Please ensure that your flight is scheduled for after 3:00 PM.

packages.name: Witness the Spirit of Australia for 14 Days | Itinerary
packages.destination: Melbourne - Brisbane - Gold Coast - Currumbin - Hamilton Island - Great Barrier Reef - Sydney

images.alt_text: Witness the Spirit of Australia for 14 Days | Itinerary
Witness the Spirit of Australia for 14 Days | Itinerary

itinerary.title: Arrival in Melbourne
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Melbourne Tullamarine Airport, you will be swiftly transferred to your hotel for check-in. The remainder of the day is graciously yours to enjoy at your leisure. You shall spend the night in the comforts of your Melbourne hotel.

itinerary.title: Melbourne - A Half-Day City Tour
itinerary.description: In the morning, enjoy your breakfast and you will set off on a delightful half-day City Tour of Melbourne. Later in the day, you have the option to partake in a guided one-hour tour of the illustrious Melbourne Cricket Ground (MCG), which is available between 10:00 and 15:00 on non-event dates, or you may choose to embark on a serene one-hour Melbourne Yarra River Cruise, with the last departure scheduled between 15:00 and 15:30. At the conclusion of your chosen activity, you will return to your hotel at your own leisure. You shall spend the night in the comforts of your Melbourne hotel.

itinerary.title: Melbourne - Full Day Tour
itinerary.description: On the third day of your itinerary, you have the option of embarking on a full day Shared in Coach (SIC) tour. You can select either the Morning Full Day Great Ocean Road Tour, commencing at 0800 hours and concluding after 2000 hours, or the Afternoon Full Day Phillip Island Penguins, Kangaroos & Koalas Tour, which departs at 1300 hours and returns after 2130 hours. You will spend the night at your Melbourne hotel.

itinerary.title: Melbourne - Brisbane/Gold Coast
itinerary.description: In the morning, please check out and proceed to Melbourne Tullamarine Airport via Shared in Coach (SIC) transfer. It is essential to arrive at Brisbane or Gold Coast Domestic Airport by 10000 hours, where another SIC transfer will take you to your hotel. Later in the afternoon, you are free to independently partake in a 55-minute Jet Boating Adventure (no transfers included, though limited Courtesy SIC Transfers are available upon request from Surfers Paradise Hotels only). Early in the evening, you are encouraged to independently join a 1-hour Fire Truck Tour of the Gold Coast, commencing from 36 Caville Avenue, Surfers Paradise (no transfers included; infants below 1 year are exempted). You will be accommodated for the night at your Gold Coast hotel.

itinerary.title: Gold Coast - Dream World
itinerary.description: Commence the day with a sumptuous breakfast, setting the tone for an entire day of enchantment at the renowned Dream World. As the day draws to a close, make your way back to the hotel, where you shall be accommodated for the night in the heart of Gold Coast's hospitality.

itinerary.title: Gold Coast - Currumbin Wildlife Sanctuary
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a delightful breakfast, an ideal prelude to a morning filled with an immersive experience at the Currumbin Wildlife Sanctuary for half a day. In the afternoon, embark on a transfer for another half-day adventure, this time at the captivating Seaworld. Located on the Gold Coast, Seaworld offers a unique blend of a marine mammal park, an oceanarium, and a theme park. Here, one can relish exhilarating rides, observe captivating animal exhibits, and partake in various other attractions. What sets Seaworld apart is its steadfast commitment to the cause of conservation, achieved through education and the admirable rescue and rehabilitation of wildlife that is sick, injured, or orphaned. As the day comes to an end, return to your hotel for a peaceful evening of relaxation, where you will once again spend the night in the heart of Gold Coast's welcoming accommodations.

itinerary.title: Gold Coast - Movie World
itinerary.description: Embark on an entire day of enchantment at Movie World, where you can immerse yourself in the captivating world of cinema. The park boasts an array of movie-themed rides and attractions, ranging from exhilarating motion simulators to heart-pounding roller coasters, as well as leisurely river rides. (Please note: The Combo Ticket is non-refundable in case of utilisation of only one park or loss of ticket.) Return to the hotel in the evening and spend the night in the luxurious comfort of your Gold Coast accommodation.

itinerary.title: Gold Coast - Brisbane - Hamilton Island
itinerary.description: Bid farewell to your Gold Coast haven today as you check out from the hotel, preparing to embark on your journey to Brisbane Airport. From there, you'll take a flight to the picturesque Hamilton Island. Upon arrival at Hamilton Island Airport, a warm welcome and transfer to the resort awaits you. During your stay, take advantage of complimentary access to catamarans, paddle skis, windsurfers, and snorkelling equipment. Additionally, enjoy unlimited use of the convenient 'Island Shuttle' service, available daily from 7:00 am to 11:00 pm. As the day turns into night, find repose in the elegant surroundings of your Hamilton Island hotel.

itinerary.title: Hamilton Island to the Great Barrier Reef
itinerary.description: Commence your day with a delightful breakfast. Embark on a full-day adventure as you set sail on the Cruise Whitsunday's Great Barrier Reef Tour, departing from the Marina and featuring a sumptuous buffet lunch. In the afternoon, you'll have the opportunity to experience the Half Day Cruise Whitsunday's Whitehaven Beach Tour, commencing at approximately 12:45 pm, with no transfer services included. Retire for the night at your accommodations on Hamilton Island.

itinerary.title: Hamilton Island to Whitsunday's Whitehaven Beach
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a delectable breakfast, and thereafter, savour a half-day excursion aboard the Cruise Whitsunday's Whitehaven Beach Tour, either in the morning at approximately 8:15 am or in the afternoon around 12:45 pm, departing from the Marina. Your restful evening awaits at your chosen Hamilton Island hotel.

itinerary.title: Hamilton Island to Sydney
itinerary.description: Enjoy a leisurely breakfast to start your day. As the morning unfolds, it is time to bid farewell to your Hamilton Island lodging. You will be transferred to Hamilton Airport to catch your flight to Sydney. Upon arriving at Sydney Airport, you will be seamlessly transported to your designated hotel for check-in. Your night's accommodation is in Sydney.

itinerary.title: Sydney – Half Day City Tour
itinerary.description: Commence your day with a complimentary breakfast and set out for a morning half-day tour of the splendid city of Sydney. This tour will treat you to breathtaking views of the iconic Opera House and the majestic Harbour Bridge, along with a visit to the serene shores of Manly Beach, among other delights. Following this, venture to the Sea Life Aquarium at Darling Harbour, where you can redeem your Combo 2 Pass voucher for admission to both the Sea Life Aquarium and the Sydney Tower Eye, complete with a captivating 4D experience (please note that transfers to the Aquarium and the Tower are not included). In the evening, make your own way to King Street Wharf #5, Darling Harbour, where you will embark on the Sydney ShowBoat Indian Dinner Cruise, enjoying standard seating. Conclude your day with an overnight stay at your hotel in Sydney, accompanied by a delectable dinner.

itinerary.title: Sydney
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a delightful breakfast and select one of the two captivating full day SIC tours on offer. Please be aware that there is limited hotel pickup available, with a total of only nine pickup points for all tours scheduled between 7-7:50 AM, depending on your hotel's location. Your first choice is the Full Day SIC Blue Mountains Tour, which includes a visit to a Wildlife Park and the opportunity to experience the scenic wonders of Scenic World. This tour departs at 8:00 AM daily and returns by 6:00 PM. Alternatively, opt for the Full Day SIC Blue Mountains Tour, which incorporates a visit to a Wildlife Park, a delectable lunch, and the chance to take part in the Scenic Rides. This tour follows the same schedule as the previous option. Enjoy another overnight stay at your Sydney hotel.

itinerary.title: Depart from Sydney
itinerary.description: Savour a satisfying breakfast to commence your day. Subsequently, check out from your hotel in the morning and proceed to Sydney Airport for your onward flight to your next destination or your hometown. As you depart, carry with you a treasure trove of memories that will linger in your heart for a lifetime. Please note that the transfer service is available for departure flights after 7:00 AM for domestic flights or 8:00 AM for international flights. Should your departure fall before these times, an additional private surcharge will be applicable.

packages.name: Perth with Margaret River Region – Itinerary

images.alt_text: Perth with Margaret River Region – Itinerary
Perth with Margaret River Region – Itinerary

itinerary.title: Arrival in Perth
itinerary.description: On your first day, you'll land at Perth Airport. A private transfer will be waiting for you, but please note that this service is available for flights arriving before 10:00 PM. If your flight arrives later, there may be an extra charge. The transfer will take you to your city hotel, where you can check in and spend the night.

itinerary.title: Explore Perth and Fremantle
itinerary.description: In the morning, you'll have your breakfast and embark on a half-day tour of Perth and Fremantle. This tour doesn't include a hotel drop-off, and it wraps up at Barrack Street Jetty. After the tour, you can take a leisurely stroll over to the Perth Mint on Hay Street, where you can join a tour at 3:30 PM without the need for additional transportation. Later, make your way back to your hotel in Perth for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Perth - Rottnest Island Adventure
itinerary.description: After having your breakfast, get ready for a full day of exploring Rottnest Island! You'll embark on an exciting tour that includes a 90-minute adventure boat ride and a delicious Thomson Rest Lunch. Please note that this tour isn't suitable for children under 4 years old. After your thrilling day on the island, return to your Perth hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Perth – Full Day Adventure
itinerary.description: Prepare for an action-packed day of exploration! Today, you'll embark on a full-day tour that includes a visit to the remarkable Pinnacles, a stop at Caversham Wildlife Park to meet adorable koalas, and an exciting sandboarding and 4-wheel drive adventure. You'll cap off this thrilling day with a delicious serving of fish and chips. After all the excitement, return to your Perth hotel for a comfortable overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Perth – Spend the Night in Margaret River Region
itinerary.description: On this day, it's time to check out of your Perth hotel. Before you leave, you can leave your large or heavy bags at the hotel's Bell desk and carry just a small bag with you. You're in for an exciting adventure as you head to the Margaret River Region. Here's what's in store for you: a visit to a fascinating cave, some delightful wine tasting, a stop at Busselton Jetty, and a chance to admire the stunning Cape Leeuwin Lighthouse. To keep you fueled and satisfied, lunch and dinner are included in the day's plan. When the day's adventures are done, you'll find comfort and rest at Abbey Beach Resort in Busselton.

itinerary.title: Margaret River Region - Perth
itinerary.description: On this day, it's time to check out from your place in the Margaret River Region. You'll be joining a lovely Margaret Region Wine Tasting Tour, complete with a delicious lunch. Later in the day, you'll head back to Perth, arriving in the late evening. Once you're back in Perth, you'll check into your hotel and spend the night there.

itinerary.title: Leaving Perth
itinerary.description: On the last day of your trip, it's time to check out from your Perth hotel. After that, you'll be taken to Perth Airport on a private transfer for your next flight. Please keep in mind that there may be additional charges for flights departing before 6:00 AM. Safe travels!

itinerary.title: Arrive Hobart
itinerary.description: Your Hobart adventure begins as you touch down at Hobart Airport. Upon arrival, you'll be greeted by our tour guide, who’ll take you to the hotel via private transfer. Keep in mind that early check-in is not guaranteed, but you can drop off your luggage and freshen up. Once settled, explore the heart of Hobart's city centre. Wander along the nearby areas and treat yourself to local cuisine for lunch. Take a stroll to explore the vibrant city and its beautiful surroundings. For dinner, indulge in the region's flavours at a local restaurant, where you can savour traditional Swiss dishes such as fondue or raclette. Enjoy an overnight stay at your hotel in Hobart.

itinerary.title: Hobart - Grand Port Arthur Tour
itinerary.description: Awake to the aroma of a freshly prepared breakfast and embrace the day that awaits. Today's journey promises an enchanting blend of history and nature as you set out on the Full Day Grand Port Arthur Tour. This immersive experience is your gateway to Tasmania's captivating past and breathtaking landscapes. Step back in time with a visit to the Isle of the Dead, where echoes of centuries gone by whisper through the air. As you sail through the picturesque harbour, a captivating cruise unveils the secrets hidden within its azure waters. Prepare to be mesmerised as you explore the rugged terrain of the Tasman National Park. Return to your Hobart hotel for a peaceful overnight stay as the sun begins to set.

itinerary.title: Hobart - Bruny Island Wilderness Coast Tour With Cruise
itinerary.description: Get ready for a day filled with awe-inspiring natural wonders on the Full Day Bruny Island Wilderness Coast Tour. This adventure-packed day begins early, so rise and shine to make the most of it. This fantastic tour includes an exciting cruise where you can spot playful seals, encounter incredible wildlife, and enjoy a delicious local lunch courtesy of Pennicott Wilderness Journeys. Please remember that there's no hotel pickup or drop-off for this adventure. You'll need to reach the Pennicott Wilderness Journeys office by 07:45 AM, conveniently located at Franklin Wharf. It's next to the Elizabeth St. Pier and the Constitution Dock Lifting Bridge, so finding it won't be a hassle. After an incredible day filled with unforgettable experiences, return to your cosy Hobart hotel for a well-deserved overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Hobart – Wineglass Bay
itinerary.description: Today brings a special treat – the Early Morning Full Day Wineglass Bay & Freycinet National Park Tour. This is your chance to discover the sheer beauty of Wineglass Bay and the wonders of Freycinet National Park. As the sun rises, you'll be setting off on an adventure that will leave you in awe. With a full day ahead to explore this natural wonderland, expect stunning vistas and maybe even spot some local wildlife up close. After a day of exploration, return to your cosy Hobart hotel for a well-deserved overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Depart Hobart
itinerary.description: Your adventure concludes with a morning Half Day Hobart City Tour. To join this delightful tour, be at Brooke St. Pier Point by 9:00 AM. Remember there's no hotel pickup or drop-off for this part of the journey, so plan your morning accordingly. The tour will conclude by 12:45 PM at Brook St Pier Point, and you'll have the afternoon to yourself. Take some time to explore Hobart at your leisure, perhaps visiting any last-minute attractions or savouring a delicious meal in the city, and you'll return to the hotel independently. Later in the day, it's time to bid farewell to this charming city. A private transfer will whisk you away to Hobart Airport for your onward flight, which should be scheduled after 4:00 PM. As you depart, cherish the memories of an incredible journey through Hobart, leaving you with a heart full of adventure and a soul touched by its natural beauty.

itinerary.title: Arrive Hobart
itinerary.description: Arrive at Hobart Airport and enjoy a private airport transfer to an exclusive 5-star hotel. While we cannot guarantee early check-in, you can drop your luggage and explore the city. You can visit the Museum of Old and New Art, Battery Point, Salamanca Place, Tasmanian Museum and Art Gallery. Stay overnight in Hobart.

itinerary.title: Hobart - Grand Port Arthur Tour
itinerary.description: Prepare for a day of history and natural beauty at the Grand Port Arthur. This immersive experience includes a guided Isle of the Dead tour, a captivating harbour cruise, Convict Cemetery, Point Puer Boys Prison, and the Tasman National Park. Return to your Hobart hotel for a relaxing overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Hobart - Bruny Island Wilderness Coast Tour with Cruise
itinerary.description: Spend the day at Bruny Island, which also includes a wilderness cruise experience featuring seals and wildlife encounters with white wallabies, dolphins and sea birds. You’ll also explore Bruny Island by foot, visiting the pristine beaches, rainforest areas, and even hikes. The tour includes an elaborate lunch spread using local Tasmanian produce and seafood. After an unforgettable day, return to your Hobart hotel for an overnight stay. Please Note: There are no hotel pickups or drop-offs for this tour. Guests must join the tour by 7:45 a.m. from the Pennicot Journeys Office at Franklin Wharf.

itinerary.title: Hobart – Full Day Tour
itinerary.description: Rise early for a full-day tour of Mt. Field, Russell Falls, and the iconic Mt. Wellington. If you're visiting on a Tuesday, Wednesday, Friday, or Sunday, you'll also have the opportunity to experience the Tassie Devils Tour. Enjoy another peaceful night at your Hobart hotel.

itinerary.title: Hobart - Wineglass Bay & Freycinet National Park Tour - Launceston
itinerary.description: Bid farewell to Hobart as you check out from the hotel. Join the Full Day Wineglass Bay & Freycinet National Park Tour. Includes a guided tour of Wineglass Bay, hiking at Freycinet National Park, and exploring the wildlife and scenery of the park. You’ll need moderate fitness for the hiking. Please note that this tour operates exclusively on Thursdays. Later in the day, you'll be transferred to your Launceston hotel. You'll use the Hobart Transit Centre to connect with the scheduled transfer from Hobart to Launceston. Spend the evening exploring the places around your hotel after checking in. Overnight at a luxury Launceston hotel.

itinerary.title: Launceston Tour
itinerary.description: Today, you can either opt for the Full Day SIC Cradle Mountains National Park Tour departing from Launceston or the Full Day SIC Bays of Fire Tour to explore the natural wonders of Tasmania. Afterwards, retire to your Launceston hotel for a restful night.

itinerary.title: Depart Launceston
itinerary.description: It's time to bid farewell to Tasmania. Check out from your Launceston hotel and depart by a private transfer to Launceston Airport (LST) for your onward flight.

packages.name: Visit Hamilton Island with Reef Cruise in 4 Days | Itinerary

images.alt_text: Visit Hamilton Island with Reef Cruise in 4 Days | Itinerary
Visit Hamilton Island with Reef Cruise in 4 Days | Itinerary

itinerary.title: Welcome to Hamilton Island
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Hamilton Island Airport, you'll be smoothly transferred to your resort. The remainder of the day is yours to relish at your own pace. Your package offers complimentary access to an array of watercraft, including catamarans, paddle skis, windsurfers, and snorkelling gear. Additionally, you'll have unrestricted use of the convenient 'Island Shuttle' service, operating from 7:00 am to 11:00 pm daily. Spend the night in the luxurious accommodations of the Hamilton Island hotel.

itinerary.title: Hamilton Island - Great Barrier Reef Adventure
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a delightful breakfast. Set off on a memorable full-day adventure with Cruise Whitsunday's Great Barrier Reef Tour to Reefworld. This exhilarating journey includes a delectable lunch served at the marina. After a day filled with wonder, return to your Hamilton Island hotel for the night, with breakfast and lunch included in your package.

itinerary.title: Hamilton Island - A Relaxing Day
itinerary.description: Savour your morning breakfast and relish the day ahead as it unfolds leisurely. Hamilton Island offers an array of delightful activities for you to explore at your own pace. Spend your night at the hotel on this charming island.

itinerary.title: Farewell to Hamilton Island
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delightful breakfast and proceed to complete the check-out formalities at the hotel. Then, make your way to Hamilton Airport for your flight to your next destination or back to your hometown, carrying a treasure trove of cherished memories that will last a lifetime.

packages.name: Exploring Beautiful Perth in 6 Days | Itinerary

images.alt_text: Exploring Beautiful Perth in 6 Days | Itinerary
Exploring Beautiful Perth in 6 Days | Itinerary

itinerary.title: Arrival in Perth
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Perth Airport, a private transfer awaits you, provided your flight touches down before 10:00 PM. Please note that additional charges may apply for late-night arrivals. Your destination: a city hotel. Check-in is available, but early check-in cannot be guaranteed. You'll spend the night at the hotel in Perth.

itinerary.title: Explore Perth and Fremantle
itinerary.description: Kickstart your day with a morning half-day shared-in-coach (SIC) tour of Perth and Fremantle (Tour # PF - Daily Departures). The tour concludes at Barrack Street Jetty and doesn't include hotel drop-off. Afterward, take a leisurely stroll to the Perth Mint on Hay Street, where you can join the 3:30 PM tour. No transfers are provided for this portion. Following your visit to the Perth Mint, return to your hotel on foot. Your second night will be spent at the hotel in Perth.

itinerary.title: Perth - A Full Day of Exploring Rottnest Island
itinerary.description: Today, indulge in a comprehensive Rottnest Island Discovery Tour, where you'll experience a thrilling 90-minute Adventure Eco Express Boat Tour and enjoy a delicious lunch at Thomson Rest. Please note that this tour is not suitable for infants up to 4 years of age (Tour # EC7 - Daily Departures). Spend the night in Perth, and for those seeking added adventure, consider the option to hire a bike, complete with a helmet, for self-guided exploration at a supplementary cost of AUD50 for adults and AUD15 for children. Please be aware that this option is also not suitable for infants up to 4 years of age.

itinerary.title: Perth – A Day Packed with Adventure
itinerary.description: On this day, immerse yourself in a full day of excitement with the SIC Pinnacles, Caversham Wildlife Park Koalas, Sand Boarding & 4 Wheel Drive Adventure, which includes a delectable Fish & Chips meal. Once again, you'll spend the night at your Perth hotel.

itinerary.title: Perth - Choose a Memorable Full Day Excursion
itinerary.description: Select from a delightful array of full-day tours for a truly enriching experience. Your options include: A Full Day SIC Tour to Margaret River, where you'll explore fascinating caves, savour exquisite wines, stroll along the iconic Busselton Jetty, and visit the majestic Cape Leeuwin Lighthouse. A delectable lunch is included to satisfy your culinary desires. (Tour # MR) Alternatively, opt for a Full Day SIC Tour to Wave Rock, York, and delve into the vibrant world of wildflowers and Aboriginal culture. Enjoy a picturesque picnic lunch as you embark on this journey, available on TUE, WED, FRI, and SUN only. (Tour # WR) For a unique adventure, you can also choose a Full Day SIC Tour to the Valley of the Giants Tree Top Walk. Marvel at the colossal trees and savour a gourmet picnic lunch. Please note that this tour is available on TUE only. (Tour # TT). Your day concludes with an overnight stay at your Perth hotel.

itinerary.title: Farewell to Perth
itinerary.description: After a restful night, it's time to check out and prepare for your departure. A private transfer will take you to Perth Airport, ensuring a hassle-free journey to catch your onward flight. Please note that additional surcharges apply for flights before 6 am.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Siem Reap
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at the Siem Reap International Airport, our tour manager will help you with transfer formalities. Check into the hotel and spend the rest of the day relaxing or visiting places in your neighbourhood. Later, you will explore some of Siem Reap’s ancient ruins and historical sights. You will visit the Baray Big Pond and Les Artisans—Chantiers Ecoles to learn about the finest Khmer arts and crafts. Other places you will visit include Bayon Temple, Ta Prohm Temple, and the Prasat Preah Khan. End the day by visiting the historic Pre Rup Temple, dedicated to Lord Shiva. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Siem Reap.

itinerary.title: Full Day – Angkor Wat
itinerary.description: Today, you will explore the south gate of the 402-acre Angkor Wat temple. King Suryavarman II built Angkor Wat in the first half of the 12th century. Thanks to the intricate carvings and idols of Lord Vishnu, the construction of the temple is believed to have spanned over 30 years. The temple is believed to be inspired by Mount Meru, the abode of the Gods. Some of Angkor Wat’s famous towers rise into the sky, giving tourists a magical moment. Return to your hotel to spend the night in Siem Reap.

itinerary.title: Siem Reap City Tour
itinerary.description: Today, you will visit the Floating Villages of Cambodia. These unique communities are built on the Tonle Sap Lake. Some popular villages along the river include Chong Khneas, Kampong Phluk, and Prek Toal. These villages are home to a bustling market selling fresh produce. You will visit some of Siem Reap’s popular attractions, including Wat Bo, a respected pagoda founded in the 18th century with unique paintings depicting the Ramayana. Don’t miss Wat Thmei, a unique glass-wall stupa that contains the bones of victims of the Khmer Rouge regime or the Psar Chars (Old Market). Spend the rest of the day shopping and enjoy food from the street stalls.

itinerary.title: Depart Siem Reap
itinerary.description: Bid adieu to Siem Reap to catch your flight to return home or continue with your Cambodia travel.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Phnom Penh
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at the Phnom Pen International Airport, our tour manager will welcome you and help you transfer to the hotel. On your way to the airport, don’t miss the beautiful buildings that beautifully blend French colonial and traditional Khmer architecture and the scenic tree-lined streets. Check into your hotel and spend some time relaxing. Later, you will visit some of Phnom Penh’s iconic attractions like the Royal Palace, Wat Phnom Daun Penh, the Tuol Sleng Genocide Museum, and the Silver Pagoda, famous for the Temple of the Emerald Buddha. The temple contains several Buddha statues decorated with precious stones and made using gold and diamonds. The National Museum is another popular attraction. It houses several artefacts from the Khmer tradition, including 5,000 art antiques made in bronze, wood, gold, silver, copper, and sandstone. Spend the night at a hotel in Phnom Penh.

itinerary.title: Phnom Penh City Tour – Silk Island
itinerary.description: Today, you will visit the Tuol Sleng prison, which has been converted into a Genocide Museum. Your next stop is the Russian Market, where you can shop for traditional Cambodian artefacts and trendy apparel. This afternoon, you will head to Silk Island for a boat ride to enjoy the scenic views of the Mekong River. During the 1.5-hour drive, you will view houses built on stilts. The homes also have workshops below, which are used to weave silk into stunning pieces. Return to the Mekong River cruise to enjoy the spectacular sunset amidst the backdrop of the Royal Palaces. Spend the night at the hotel in Phnom Penh.

itinerary.title: Depart Phnom Penh
itinerary.description: Bid adieu to Phnom Penh and Cambodia as you catch your flight to return home or continue with your Asia tour package.

packages.name: Guide to an Australian Journey | 15 Days Itinerary
packages.destination: Melbourne - Brisbane - Tangalooma - Gold Coast - Cairns - Kuranda - Sydney

images.alt_text: Guide to an Australian Journey | 15 Days Itinerary
Guide to an Australian Journey | 15 Days Itinerary

itinerary.title: Arrival in Melbourne
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Melbourne Tullamarine Airport, you will be transferred to your hotel for check-in. The remainder of the day is yours to enjoy at your leisure. Spend the night at your Melbourne hotel.

itinerary.title: Melbourne - Half-Day City Exploration
itinerary.description: This morning, we will set off on a captivating half-day city tour of Melbourne. Please note that hotel pickups are limited and take place between 7:00 and 7:50 AM. Following the tour, you have two enticing options: you can delve into the history of the Melbourne Cricket Ground (MCG) with a guided 1-hour tour, available between 10:00 and 15:00 on non-event dates, or you can opt for a leisurely stroll to the Southgate Art & Leisure Precinct to join a delightful 1-hour Melbourne Yarra River cruise, with the last departure at 15:00-15:30. Return to the hotel at your own pace and rest comfortably in Melbourne for the night.

itinerary.title: Melbourne - Full Day Great Ocean Road Adventure
itinerary.description: Today, you have a choice between two full day SIC tours. The morning full-day Great Ocean Road tour departs at 08:00 and returns after 20:00, offering an unforgettable experience. Alternatively, you can opt for the afternoon full day SIC tour to Phillip Island, where you'll have the chance to see penguins, kangaroos, and koalas. This tour departs at 13:00 and returns after 21:30. Enjoy your selected tour and return to your Melbourne hotel for a relaxing overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Melbourne to Brisbane, and onto Tangalooma
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a sumptuous breakfast. In the early morning, it's time to bid farewell to your Melbourne hotel. Head to Melbourne Tullamarine Airport to catch an early flight to Brisbane. Ensure that you arrive at Brisbane International Airport by 0730 hours or at the Domestic Airport by 0840 hours. From there, proceed to Brisbane Holt Street Wharf. Check-in at 0930 hours and embark on the 1000 hours Tangalooma Launch to Moreton Island. Upon arrival at Tangalooma Island Resort (subject to weather and tides), the rest of your day is free to relish a host of optional island activities. In the evening, don't miss the captivating Wild Dolphin Feeding program (weather and tides permitting). You'll spend the night at your comfortable Tangalooma hotel.

itinerary.title: Tangalooma to Gold Coast
itinerary.description: As the new day unfolds, it's time to check out of your Tangalooma accommodation and prepare for an exciting adventure: the Desert Safari & Sand Tobogganing Tour. In the evening, catch the 1600 hours launch back to Brisbane Holt Street Wharf. From there, you'll make your way to the Gold Coast. Hotel Conxions SIC will transfer you and assist with the check-in process. Enjoy a peaceful night's rest at your Gold Coast hotel.

itinerary.title: Gold Coast - Dream World
itinerary.description: Indulge in a full day of adventure at Dream World, a haven of excitement and thrills. As the evening descends, retreat to the comfort of your hotel for an overnight stay in the heart of Gold Coast.

itinerary.title: Gold Coast - Half Day City Tour
itinerary.description: This morning, partake in a Half Day Currumbin Wildlife Sanctuary experience, a glimpse into the wondrous world of Australian wildlife. In the afternoon, set forth for a Half Day at SeaWorld, a marine oasis on the Gold Coast, brimming with enchanting rides, captivating animal exhibits, and a commitment to wildlife conservation. As dusk approaches, return to your hotel for another night's rest on the charming Gold Coast.

itinerary.title: Gold Coast - Movie World
itinerary.description: A full day awaits you at Movie World, where cinematic dreams come to life. With a plethora of movie-themed rides and attractions, from heart-pounding motion simulators to exhilarating roller coasters and leisurely river rides, your day will be filled with endless entertainment. When the sun dips below the horizon, return to your hotel for a peaceful night's stay in the vibrant city of Gold Coast.

itinerary.title: Gold Coast to Cairns
itinerary.description: Commence your day by checking out from your accommodation in the morning. You will then be transported to Brisbane/Gold Coast Airport to board your flight bound for Cairns. Upon your arrival at Cairns Airport, you will be smoothly transferred to your hotel for a seamless check-in process. The remainder of the day is yours to relish at your leisure. Spend the night at your Cairns hotel. (Breakfast included)

itinerary.title: Cairns - Big Cat Cruise to Green Island
itinerary.description: Today, indulge in a full day of adventure with the Big Cat Cruise to the splendid Green Island Reef. The experience encompasses a delightful buffet lunch and the option to partake in activities such as a semi-submarine excursion or exploring the mesmerising underwater world with a glass-bottom boat. Alternatively, you can equip yourself with snorkelling gear for an enchanting underwater encounter. (Additional costs apply for an upgrade to the SunLover Outer Barrier Reef Cruise or the Reef Magic Outer Barrier Reef Cruise, each offering additional perks at a supplement cost.) Following this exhilarating day, retreat to your Cairns hotel for the night. (Breakfast and Lunch provided)

itinerary.title: Cairns - Kuranda Exploration
itinerary.description: Embark on a captivating full day SIC Kuranda excursion that includes one-way Sky Rail admission (please note it's not valid for the Diamond Gondola). Enjoy leisurely moments in the charming Kuranda Village and partake in the one-way Scenic Rail adventure. Alternatively, opt for the enriching Full Day SIC Cape Tribulation & Daintree Wilderness Tour with a delectable lunch available at an additional supplement cost. Your day concludes with an overnight stay at your Cairns hotel.

itinerary.title: Cairns - Sydney
itinerary.description: In the morning, bid adieu to your Cairns hotel and transfer to Cairns Airport to board your flight to Sydney. Upon arrival at Sydney Airport, make your way to the hotel for check-in. Enjoy a restful night at your Sydney hotel.

itinerary.title: Sydney - City Expedition
itinerary.description: Embark on a morning Sydney City Tour that unveils the iconic views of the Opera House and Harbour Bridge. Your journey includes a visit to the sun-kissed Manly Beach and other notable attractions. Please note that this tour is complementary and non-refundable, with limited hotel pickup and no hotel drop-off. It concludes by 11:45 AM near Darling Harbour or Circular Quay. Disembark nearest to King Street Wharf, Darling Harbour. Later in the day, venture to the Sea Life Aquarium at Darling Harbour to redeem your Combo 2 Pass voucher for admissions to the Sea Life Aquarium and Sydney Tower Eye with a mesmerising 4D Experience (please note that transfers to the Aquarium and Tower are not included). Prepare for another night of relaxation at your Sydney hotel.

itinerary.title: Sydney - Choose Your Full Day Tour
itinerary.description: Select from one of the two captivating full day SIC tours available to you, but please note that hotel pickup options are limited, with just nine select points of departure between 7:00 and 7:50 AM, contingent upon your hotel's location. First, immerse yourself in the breathtaking beauty of the Blue Mountains on a full day SIC tour that includes a visit to a Wildlife Park and exhilarating scenic rides at Scenic World. Your adventure commences at 8:00 AM and concludes at 6:00 PM. Do bear in mind that hotel pickup is mandatory and non-refundable. Alternatively, you can opt for the full-day SIC Blue Mountains Tour, which not only includes a visit to a Wildlife Park but also a delectable lunch and captivating scenic rides. The tour departs at 8:00 AM and returns by 6:00 PM. Please note that, like the first option, hotel pickup is both compulsory and non-refundable. After your day's excursion, you will spend the night at your hotel in Sydney.

itinerary.title: Depart - Sydney
itinerary.description: This morning, you will check out from your hotel and be transferred to Sydney Airport. From there, you will board your flight to your next destination or return to your hometown, carrying with you a trove of cherished memories that will last a lifetime. Please be aware that this transfer service is valid for departure flights scheduled after 7:00 AM for Domestic flights or 8:00 AM for international flights. An additional private surcharge will be applicable for early morning transfers.

packages.name: Attractive Australian Getaway with GT Holidays | Itinerary

images.alt_text: Attractive Australian Getaway with GT Holidays | Itinerary
Attractive Australian Getaway with GT Holidays | Itinerary

itinerary.title: Welcome to Brisbane - The Gold Coast
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Brisbane International Airport, you will receive a warm reception and be swiftly transported to your Gold Coast accommodation. The evening is yours to savour at your leisure, ensuring a tranquil beginning to your stay. Spend the night luxuriating in the comforts of your Gold Coast hotel.

itinerary.title: Gold Coast - A Day at Movie World
itinerary.description: Delight in an entire day of enchantment at Movie World. This enchanting park boasts an array of thrilling movie-themed rides and captivating attractions, spanning from dynamic motion simulators to exhilarating roller coasters and leisurely river voyages. As the day draws to a close, return to your hotel, taking with you cherished memories of your adventures. (Your Combo ticket includes a complimentary souvenir bag and a delightful photo-frame at Movie World - please note that no refunds will be granted for a single park utilisation or a lost ticket.) Once again, spend the night in comfort at your Gold Coast haven.

itinerary.title: Gold Coast – Sea World
itinerary.description: Savour a splendid day at SeaWorld, an exceptional marine sanctuary, oceanarium, and amusement park nestled along the Gold Coast. This remarkable destination offers a medley of exhilarating rides, captivating animal exhibits, and an array of other attractions, all dedicated to the noble cause of wildlife conservation through education and the compassionate care of ailing, wounded, or orphaned creatures. (Please note that the combo ticket is non-refundable in the event of the utilisation of a one-park ticket or loss of the ticket.) Consider replacing or substituting this option with a full-day Dream World admission on one of the days, as opposed to Movie World or Sea World, for an additional fee of AUD 20 for adults and AUD 10 for children. As the day draws to a close, return to your hotel in the evening to enjoy a restful overnight stay on the Gold Coast. (B)

itinerary.title: Gold Coast/Brisbane – Sydney
itinerary.description: Commence your day by checking out and proceeding to Brisbane or Gold Coast airport. Arrive at Sydney airport no later than 21:30 and make your transfer. (Please note that infants below 1 year of age are not permitted for this transfer.) Upon arrival at Sydney airport, transition smoothly to your hotel for check-in. Settle in and prepare for an indulgent overnight stay in the heart of Sydney.

itinerary.title: Sydney - Morning City Tour and Evening Cruise
itinerary.description: Commence your day with a delightful morning exploration of Sydney, capturing breathtaking vistas of the Opera House and Harbour Bridge. This engaging tour also includes a visit to the picturesque Manly Beach. Remember, this experience is a complimentary indulgence, and it's non-refundable. Your enchanting tour concludes at approximately 11:45, conveniently located near Darling Harbour or Circular Quay. Afterwards, make your way to King Street Wharf, Darling Harbour, where you can head to the Sea Life Aquarium to redeem your combo 2 pass voucher. This pass grants you access to the Sea Life Aquarium and the Sydney Tower Eye with a 4D experience. Please note that transfers to the aquarium and tower are not included. In the evening, it's time to set out on your own to King Street Wharf #5, Darling Harbour. Here, you'll embark on the Sydney Show Boat Cruise, an enchanting journey complete with a delectable Indian vegetarian dinner and standard seating. Keep in mind that this cruise does not operate on Tuesdays, Sundays, or during select dates (01 October, 25, 26, 31 December, 01 January, and 14 February). If you desire an upgrade to priority seating, it's available at a supplemental cost of AUD 25 per person extra, and please note that Jain menu options are not provided. Spend the night at your hotel in Sydney, embracing the memories of a splendid day.

itinerary.title: Sydney – A Full Day Exploring the City
itinerary.description: Today, you have the delightful opportunity to take part in a full-day excursion of your choice. Select from the following options, with limited hotel pickups available at nine designated points, commencing between 7 and 7:50 in the morning, contingent on your hotel's location. Full Day Scenic Blue Mountains Tour with a Visit to a Wildlife Park: Begin your day's adventure at 8 o'clock and anticipate your return by 6 in the evening. Please note that hotel pickup is mandatory and non-refundable. Full Day Scenic Blue Mountains Tour, including Wildlife Park, Lunch, and Scenic Rides: Depart at 8 am for a day filled with exploration, and expect to be back by 6 pm. Hotel pickup is compulsory and non-refundable. Full Day Scenic Blue Mountains Tour with Wildlife Park, a Delectable 2-course Lunch, and a River Cruise: Your day begins at 8 am, and the tour concludes at Darling Harbour or Circular Quay. Hotel pickup is mandatory and non-refundable. After your day of exploration, you will return to your overnight accommodation in Sydney.

itinerary.title: Farewell to Sydney
itinerary.description: This morning, it's time to bid adieu to your hotel in Sydney. You will be transferred to Sydney Airport for your departure flight to your next destination or your hometown. The transfer service is available for flights departing after 7 am for domestic flights or 8 am for international flights. Please note that an additional private surcharge will apply for early morning transfers. As you depart, carry with you a treasure trove of memories to cherish for a lifetime.

packages.name: Explore Australian Delight for 13 Days | Itinerary
packages.destination: Melbourne - Brisbane - Gold Coast - Big Cat Cruise - Green Island - Cairns - Sydney

images.alt_text: Explore Australian Delight for 13 Days | Itinerary
Explore Australian Delight for 13 Days | Itinerary

itinerary.title: Arrival in Melbourne
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Melbourne Tullamarine Airport, proceed to your hotel for check-in. The remainder of the day is yours to enjoy at your leisure. You'll be spending the night at your comfortable accommodation in Melbourne.

itinerary.title: Exploring Melbourne
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a splendid Half Day SIC Melbourne City Tour, which starts with limited pickups between 7:00 am and 7:50 am (Complimentary & NON-Refundable). This delightful tour concludes at 11:45 am at Federation Square. Afterward, you can stroll over to MCG Gate #3 (located between light towers 1 & 2) to join a guided 1-hour tour of the Melbourne Cricket Ground (MCG). These tours operate between 10 am and 3 pm on non-event dates. Alternatively, you can take a leisurely walk to the Southgate Art & Leisure Precinct and embark on a 1-hour Melbourne Yarra River Cruise. The last departure for the cruise is between 3 pm and 3:30 pm. Your night will be spent comfortably at your Melbourne hotel.

itinerary.title: Melbourne - Choose Your Full Day Tour
itinerary.description: For your third day in Melbourne, you have the delightful option of selecting one full day SIC tour from the following: Morning Great Ocean Road Adventure: Departure is at 8 am in the morning, and you'll return after 8 pm in the evening. This picturesque journey will take you along the iconic Great Ocean Road, showcasing stunning coastal vistas. Afternoon Phillip Island Wildlife Experience: Your adventure begins at 1 pm in the afternoon and concludes after 9:30 pm. This tour includes encounters with penguins, kangaroos, and koalas on picturesque Phillip Island. Morning Sovereign Hill Gold Rush Excursion: Available exclusively on Mondays, Tuesdays, Thursdays, and Saturdays, this tour commences at 8 am and concludes at 5:30 pm. It's a step back in time to experience the Gold Rush era at Sovereign Hill. Morning Puffing Billy Steam Train & Yarra Valley Wineries: Operating on Mondays, Wednesdays, Fridays, and Sundays, this tour departs at 8:00 in the morning. Enjoy a scenic train ride on the Puffing Billy Steam Train and visit esteemed wineries like Dominique Portet and Rochford. Morning Puffing Billy Steam Train & Healesville Wildlife Experience: On Mondays, Wednesdays, Fridays, and Sundays, this tour sets off at 8:00 in the morning. Immerse yourself in the charm of the Puffing Billy Steam Train and explore the wildlife at Healesville Sanctuary. After your chosen adventure, you will return to your hotel in Melbourne for the night.

itinerary.title: Melbourne – Brisbane – Gold Coast
itinerary.description: This morning, bid farewell to your Melbourne abode and head to Melbourne Tullamarine Airport. You'll catch a flight to Brisbane or the Gold Coast. Upon arrival at Brisbane/Gold Coast Airport, a warm welcome awaits, and you'll be whisked away to your hotel on the Gold Coast. Spend the night luxuriating in your Gold Coast accommodation.

itinerary.title: Gold Coast - Movie World
itinerary.description: Savour a full day of enchantment at Movie World. This cinematic realm boasts a plethora of movie-themed rides and attractions, from exhilarating motion simulators to heart-pounding roller coasters and leisurely river cruises. As twilight descends, retire to your lodgings. Spend the night at your Gold Coast hotel.

itinerary.title: Gold Coast - Sea World
itinerary.description: Delight in an entire day at SeaWorld. This coastal haven serves as a marine mammal sanctuary, an oceanarium, and an enthralling theme park nestled on the shores of the Gold Coast. It features exhilarating rides, captivating animal exhibits, and an ardent commitment to wildlife preservation through education and the recovery of ailing, injured, or orphaned creatures. As the day's end approaches, return to your abode. (Combo Ticket - No Refund if 1 Park Ticket Utilised or Ticket lost). (Consider the option of a Return SIC for a full day of Dreamworld admission on one of the days, in place of Movie World or Sea World, for a supplementary cost of AUD20 per adult and AUD10 per child). Rest peacefully at your Gold Coast hotel.

itinerary.title: Gold Coast/Brisbane to Cairns
itinerary.description: In the morning, bid adieu to your hotel and head to Gold Coast/Brisbane Airport to catch your flight to Cairns. Upon arrival at Cairns Airport, you'll be whisked away to your hotel for check-in. The rest of the day is yours to enjoy at your leisure. Spend the night at your comfortable Cairns hotel.

itinerary.title: Cairns - Full Day Big Cat Cruise to Green Island
itinerary.description: Today promises a full day of adventure with the Big Cat Cruise to Green Island Reef. Your day will include a sumptuous buffet lunch and the choice of a semi-submarine and glass-bottom boat experience, or the use of snorkelling gear (Package 4). For those seeking more, there's an opportunity to upgrade to the Sun-lover Outer Barrier Reef Cruise with a semi-submarine, glass-bottom boat, snorkelling gear, and buffet lunch, at a supplemental cost of AUD70 for adults and AUD50 for children. Alternatively, you can opt for the Reef Magic Outer Barrier Reef Cruise with similar inclusions at a supplemental cost of AUD75 for adults and AUD40 for children. Your night will be spent in the comfort of your Cairns hotel.

itinerary.title: Cairns - Choice Of 1 Full Day Tour
itinerary.description: Today, Cairns offers a splendid choice for your full-day adventure. Opt for the captivating SIC Kuranda Tour, which encompasses a one-way Sky Rail journey, though please note that it does not include the Diamond Gondola. You'll have the opportunity to enjoy leisure time in the charming Kuranda Village and conclude your day with a one-way Scenic Rail experience, excluding the Gold Class seating. If you desire a more opulent experience, you can choose to upgrade to the Diamond Gondola on the Sky Rail at an additional cost of AUD 18 for adults and AUD 9 for children. Similarly, a Gold Class Seating upgrade on the Scenic Rail is available at an extra cost of AUD 44 for adults and AUD 44 for children. It's worth noting that Sky Rail will be closed on 15th and 26th of October, as well as on 25th December, while the Scenic Rail will not operate on 15th, 16th of October, 8th, 9th of November, 6th, 7th, and 25th of December. You also have the option to include either a visit to Tjapukai Cultural Park or the Rain-forestation, which features the Pamagirri Dance and an Army Duck tour during your Kuranda Tour. This add-on is available at an extra cost of AUD 50 for adults and AUD 35 for children. Alternatively, if you're seeking a different experience, you can choose the Full Day SIC Cape Tribulation & Daintree Wilderness Tour, which includes lunch at an additional cost of AUD 35 for adults and AUD 20 for children. Please be aware that this tour does not operate on 25th December, 1st January, and throughout the month of February. After your day of exploration, you'll return to your hotel in Cairns for a peaceful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Cairns to Sydney
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a check-out from your hotel in Cairns and make your way to Cairns Airport. There, you will board a flight bound for Sydney. Upon your arrival at Sydney Airport, you will be transferred to your hotel for check-in. Enjoy an overnight stay in Sydney.

itinerary.title: Sydney - Half Day City Tour
itinerary.description: Embark on a delightful half-day tour of Sydney in the morning. Witness the iconic Opera House and Harbour Bridge and take a trip to Manly Beach. Please note that this tour is complementary and non-refundable, with limited hotel pickup and no hotel drop-off. It concludes around 11:45 near Darling Harbour or Circular Quay. Disembark at the closest point to King Street Wharf, Darling Harbour. Later in the day, make your way to Sea Life Aquarium at Darling Harbour to redeem your Combo 2 Pass voucher for admission to Sea Life Aquarium and Sydney Tower Eye with a 4D experience. Please note that transfers to the aquarium and tower are not included. In the evening, you are free to make your way to King Street Wharf #5, Darling Harbour, between 6.50 pm and 7pm to join the Sydney ShowBoat Indian Dinner Cruise with standard seating. Please be aware that this cruise does not operate on Tuesdays, Sundays, October 1st, December 25th, December 26th, December 31st, January 1st, and February 14th. Should you wish to upgrade to priority seating, it is available at an additional cost of AUD25 per person. Please note that a Jain menu is not catered for. Enjoy your overnight stay at the hotel in Sydney.

itinerary.title: Sydney - Choose a Full Day Adventure
itinerary.description: Today, immerse yourself in a captivating full-day tour of your preference from the following options. Opt for one of the three enticing Full Day SIC Tours, each with limited hotel pickup locations, commencing between 7:00 and 7:50 in the morning, contingent on your hotel's location. Option 1: Experience the Full Day SIC Blue Mountains Tour with Wildlife Park and revel in scenic rides at Scenic World. The tour begins at 8 am and concludes at 6 pm. Please note that hotel pickup is mandatory and non-refundable. Option 2: Explore the Full Day SIC Blue Mountains Tour with Wildlife Park, savour a delectable lunch, and delight in the scenic rides. The tour sets off at 08:00 and wraps up at 6 pm. Hotel pickup is compulsory and non-refundable. Option 3: Delight in the Full Day SIC Blue Mountains Tour with Wildlife Park, indulge in a 2-course lunch, and embark on a relaxing river cruise. The tour commences at 08:00 and ends either at Darling Harbour or Circular Quay. Hotel pickup is mandatory and non-refundable. Retreat to your Sydney hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: Farewell to Sydney
itinerary.description: This morning, it's time to bid adieu to your Sydney abode. Check out from your hotel and make your way to Sydney Airport for your onward journey, be it to your next destination or the comforting embrace of your hometown. Please be advised that this transfer service is available for departure flights after 7 am for domestic flights or 8 am for international flights. For those with early morning departures, a private surcharge will apply.

packages.name: Glimpses of Vietnam and Cambodia Itinerary
packages.destination: Saigon - Mekong Delta - Cu Chi - Phnom Penh

images.alt_text: Glimpses of Vietnam and Cambodia Itinerary
Glimpses of Vietnam and Cambodia Itinerary

itinerary.title: Arrival in Saigon – Explore the City
itinerary.description: Today, you will arrive at Saigon, now called Ho Chi Minh City, which is a lively place in Vietnam. After landing at the airport, we will take you to the city centre and help you check in at the hotel. In the evening, our city tour begins at the Reunification Palace, where the Vietnam War came to an end in 1975. This big building is now a museum. Nearby, you will find the Central Post Office, a beautiful old building that's a big deal in the city. You will take a stroll on Nguyen Hue street to see the Opera House and the Ho Chi Minh Committee. After that, you will have a walk to Ben Thanh Market, a famous spot in Saigon where you can see how the locals live and buy handmade goods. You'll spend the night at the hotel in Saigon.

itinerary.title: Saigon – Mekong Delta – Saigon
itinerary.description: After a delicious breakfast, you will head to My Tho. Once you arrive there, you will hop on a boat and cruise along the mighty Mekong River. This will give you a chance to see how the local people live along the riverbanks. You will make a stop at one of the four islands in the area for some sightseeing. Next, you will take small boats rowed by local people through narrow canals with water coconut trees. You will visit local factories where they make honey tea and coconut candy milk. You can even try these tasty treats! If you're interested, you can also take a stroll in the garden where locals take care of honeybees. After this, you will enjoy a horse-cart ride through the peaceful village roads and have a light lunch at a local restaurant near the Mekong River, featuring Elephant Ear fish. In the evening, we will drive back to Saigon with a stop to visit Vinh Trang Pagoda, a famous pagoda with a unique mix of Chinese, Cambodian, and French cultural influences. You will be spending the night at the hotel in Saigon.

itinerary.title: Saigon – Cu Chi Tunnels Tour – Phnom Penh
itinerary.description: After breakfast, you will go and see the Cu Chi Tunnels, an important site from the Vietnam War. These tunnels, stretching for 200 kilometres, were dug by hand and used by Vietnamese guerrilla forces during the war. Before the Tet Offensive in 1968, almost 10,000 soldiers were based in this tunnel complex. Today, it stands as a powerful reminder of the intensity of the war. You can even try crawling through some parts of the tunnels to get a real feel for what it was like. In the afternoon, you will head to the airport for a flight to Phnom Penh. When you arrive in Phnom Penh, our representative will be there to pick you up and take you to the hotel. The rest of the day is free for you to relax. You will stay overnight at the hotel in Phnom Penh.

itinerary.title: Phnom Penh City Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast today, you will check out some amazing places in the city. First, you will visit the royal palace complex built in 1866 with vibrant Khmer-style architecture by King Norodom's predecessors. Nearby is the Silver Pagoda, also known as the Emerald Buddha temple, filled with Buddha statues adorned with gold, diamonds, gemstones, and silver. You will make a stop at the Independence Monument and explore the National Museum, a beautiful building with Khmer architecture. It houses over 5000 art antiques made from materials like bronze, wood, gold, silver, copper, and sandstone. As you stroll through the river-front park where four rivers meet, including the mystical Mekong, you will walk up to the sacred hill Phnom Daun Penh. In the afternoon, you will visit Tuol Sleng prison, now known as the Genocide Museum, a hidden part of the Khmer Rouge regime. It was called S-21, a security camp designed for questioning and eliminating those opposed to the Khmer Rouge, leaving a dark part of Cambodia's history. To end the day on a brighter note, you will go shopping around the Russian market. You will spend the night at the hotel in Phnom Penh.

itinerary.title: Depart Phnom Penh
itinerary.description: After breakfast this morning, you will be transferred to the airport for your flight back home or to your next destination.

packages.name: Romantic Australia Dreaming for 11 Days | Itinerary
packages.destination: Brisbane - Gold Coast - Hamilton Island - Sydney

images.alt_text: Romantic Australia Dreaming for 11 Days | Itinerary
Romantic Australia Dreaming for 11 Days | Itinerary

itinerary.title: Arrival in Brisbane - Gold Coast
itinerary.description: You must arrive at either Brisbane or Gold Coast Airport by 10:00 a.m. From there, a shared transfer will take you to your hotel. As an option, in the afternoon, you can independently make your way to a thrilling 55-minute Jet Boating Adventure. No transportation will be provided for this activity. Later in the early evening, you have the opportunity to independently join a 1-hour Fire Truck Tour of Gold Coast, starting from 36 Caville Avenue, Surfers Paradise. No transfers are included. You will spend the night at your Gold Coast hotel.

itinerary.title: Gold Coast – Dream World
itinerary.description: Today, you'll have the entire day to enjoy the wonders of Dream World. Return to your hotel in the evening. You'll spend the night at your hotel in Gold Coast.

itinerary.title: Gold Coast - Currumbin Wildlife Sanctuary
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a morning transfer to the captivating Currumbin Wildlife Sanctuary for a half-day experience. Later in the afternoon, you will set off for a half-day adventure at Seaworld, a splendid marine mammal park, oceanarium, and theme park nestled on the stunning Gold Coast. Here, you'll discover a wealth of exhilarating rides, captivating animal exhibits, and a myriad of other attractions, all while supporting the noble cause of wildlife conservation through education and the rescue and rehabilitation of sick, injured, or orphaned wildlife. In the evening, return to the comfort of your hotel, where you will spend the night.

itinerary.title: Gold Coast – Movie World
itinerary.description: Indulge in a full day of entertainment at the renowned Movie World. Your journey includes a return SIC transfer to the Movie World admission, complete with a complimentary Souvenir Bag and a delightful Photo Frame at MW (Combo Ticket - No Refund available if one Park is Utilised or Ticket is lost). As the day unfolds, relish the magic and excitement of this theme park. In the evening, make your way back to your hotel, where you will spend the night.

itinerary.title: Gold Coast to Hamilton Island
itinerary.description: Begin your day by checking out of your hotel in the morning. Then, make your way to Brisbane Airport for your flight to Hamilton Island. Upon arrival at Hamilton Island Airport, you will be transferred to the resort. Your package includes complimentary access to catamarans, paddle skis, windsurfers, and snorkelling equipment. You also have unlimited access to the 'Island Shuttle' service, available from 7:00 am to 11:00 pm daily. Spend the night at the hotel on Hamilton Island.

itinerary.title: Hamilton Island - Whitehaven Beach
itinerary.description: Start your day with a visit to Wildlife Hamilton Island. In the afternoon, embark on the Ex Hamilton-Marina half-day Afternoon Cruise to Whitsunday's Whitehaven Beach (Departure at approximately 12:45 pm, no transfers included). You'll spend the night at the hotel on Hamilton Island.

itinerary.title: Hamilton Island to the Great Barrier Reef
itinerary.description: Indulge in a splendid full-day cruise to the Great Barrier Reef with a delectable lunch on board. Depart from Hamilton Island Marina Jetty and immerse yourself in the beauty of the reef. As the day comes to a close, return to your Hamilton Island hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Farewell to Hamilton Island, Greetings to Sydney
itinerary.description: Bid farewell to your Hamilton Island abode in the morning and make your way to Hamilton Airport for your flight to Sydney. Upon arrival at Sydney Airport (scheduled arrival for 21:30 hours), you will be whisked away to your hotel for check-in. Settle in for the night and embrace the charms of Sydney.

itinerary.title: Sydney - Hop-On Hop-Off Adventure
itinerary.description: Begin your day leisurely as you sip in the morning calmly. Make your way independently to the nearest BigBus Bus Stop, where you'll join the Sydney & Bondi Hop-On Hop-Off Sightseeing Bus. This enchanting experience offers comprehensive commentary in English and numerous stops at vantage points, inviting you to explore at your own pace. You can effortlessly hop on and off at your leisure throughout the day. Your Classic Ticket is valid for 24 hours, commencing from the moment you present your voucher to the Coach Driver, granting you the freedom to relish a day of Sydney exploration. In the evening, take charge of your own adventure as you head to King Street Wharf #5, Darling Harbour between 18:50 and 19:00 hours. There, you will embark on the Sydney ShowBoat Cruise, where you'll indulge in an Indian Vegetarian Dinner and enjoy standard seating. No transfers are provided. Your night's rest awaits at the hotel in Sydney.

itinerary.title: Sydney - A Day of Unhurried Delights
itinerary.description: This morning, savour the essence of Sydney's must-see attractions at your own unhurried pace. Proceed independently to Bennelong Point, where you will embark on the Sydney Opera House 1-hour Inside Guided Tour, available between 9 am and 5 pm. Later in the day, take your own path (transfers not included) to Sea Life Aquarium at Darling Harbour to exchange your Combo 4 Pass voucher. This pass grants you access to Sydney Wildlife, Madame Tussauds, Sea Life Sydney Aquarium, and the Sydney Tower Eye with a 4D Experience. Transfers to the Aquarium and Tower are not provided. The night holds comfort at your hotel in Sydney.

itinerary.title: Farewell to Sydney
itinerary.description: As the new day dawns, it's time to bid adieu to your comfortable abode. Check out from the hotel and make your way to Sydney Airport for your onward flight, taking with you a treasure trove of cherished memories. Please note that transfers are valid for departure flights after 7 am for Domestic or 8 am for international flights. An additional private surcharge will apply for early morning transfers.

packages.name: Discover Alice Springs with Ayers Rock | Itinerary

images.alt_text: Discover Alice Springs with Ayers Rock | Itinerary
Discover Alice Springs with Ayers Rock | Itinerary

itinerary.title: Arrival in Alice Springs
itinerary.description: Ensure your arrival at Alice Springs Airport no later than 11:45 AM, as a Scheduled International Carrier (SIC) will facilitate your transfer to the city hotel, where you will promptly check-in. This afternoon, embark on a captivating Half-Day SIC A Town Like Alice Tour, scheduled to depart at 1:30 PM (AATK A3). During this excursion, you will explore the notable landmarks of 'The Alice', with a special focus on The School of the Air. Here, you will gain insight into the unique educational methods employed to instruct children who are geographically isolated, relying on radio communication. With some luck, you may even have the chance to listen to and observe live lessons in progress through the airwaves. The tour continues with a visit to the historic Telegraph Station, which commemorates the original site of the first European settlement in Alice Springs. Subsequently, you will journey to the Royal Flying Doctors Service, where you will gain a deeper understanding of how medical assistance is extended to those residing in the remote 'outback'. Another highlight of the day will be a visit to the Alice Springs Reptile Centre, offering you the opportunity to get up close and personal with some of Central Australia's semi-arid desert reptiles, including the impressive Perentie Lizard and the enigmatic Thorny Devil. The tour's grand finale takes place atop Anzac Hill, affording you a sweeping panoramic view of Alice Springs township and the majestic MacDonnell Ranges. Following this delightful day of exploration, you will retreat to your comfortable accommodation at the hotel in Alice Springs for a restful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Alice Springs
itinerary.description: Commence your morning by embarking on the Full Day Shared in-conveyance (SIC) West MacDonald Ranges Tour (AATK A8 - please be prepared for some moderate walking across uneven terrain during this excursion). Our first destination is Angkerle, more commonly recognized as Standley Chasm. A leisurely stroll beckons along the stony watercourse, where a spring-fed pool teems with a splendid assortment of indigenous wildlife and avian species. Upon completing your walk, relish a respite for morning tea. You will then proceed to Ellery Creek Big Hole, an awe-inspiring waterway that has carved its path through the rugged expanse of the ranges. Continuing your expedition, you will visit the Ochre Pits, an intriguing geological formation displaying natural ochres embedded within the cliff faces. These ochres have served as a vital source of materials for indigenous peoples for countless millennia. Your journey takes you to Ormiston Gorge, where the imposing topography is accompanied by a virtually perpetual waterhole, drawing an assorted variety of aquatic birds and fish. At Glen Helen Gorge, you will take part in a delightful Ploughman's Lunch, savouring a repast set amidst the captivating natural surroundings. The culminating stop on your itinerary is Simpson Gap, one of the most renowned destinations within the ranges. Traverse through the gap to uncover the hidden waterhole, while maintaining a vigilant watch for the elusive black-footed rock wallabies concealed amid the rocky crevices. Following your day of exploration, you will retire to your accommodation in Alice Springs for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Alice Springs to Ayers Rock
itinerary.description: On the third day of your journey, it is time to bid adieu to Alice Springs. Begin your day with an early morning check-out and be ready to embark on the Half Day SIC Transfer to Ayers Rock Resort, all the while enjoying the scenic enroute Touring through the MacDonald and James Ranges. Your amiable Driver Guide will regale you with informative commentary about the landscape. You'll also make a delightful stop at a camel farm, where the opportunity to enjoy a brief camel ride awaits (at your own expense). Subsequently, there will be a chance to purchase a light lunch at Mount Ebenezer. The breathtaking Atila, also known as Mount Conner, will captivate your senses before you reach Ayers Rock Resort. Upon arrival at Ayers Rock Resort, it will be time for check-in. In the later afternoon, you can partake in the Half Day SIC Uluru Sunset Tour (AATK # Y11 - Note that the 3-Day National Park Fee is already included in your package). Later in the evening, there will be SIC Transfers for the Field of Light Self-Guided Tour, so please ensure you have your National Park Ticket handy. Please note that infants above one year will be charged as children for this tour. You'll be spending the night at the Resort in Ayers Rock.

itinerary.title: Departure from Ayers Rock
itinerary.description: As the fourth day dawns, it is time to check-out from your accommodation. Early in the morning, you'll be part of the Half Day SIC Uluru Sunrise Tour. It's worth mentioning that breakfast is not included today, given the early morning departure for the tour. In the afternoon, you'll be transferred to Ayers Rock Airport courtesy of SIC Transfers to catch your onward flight.

packages.destination: Adelaide - Kangaroo Island - Full Day Seal Bay Discovery Tour

Explore Adelaide with Kangaroo Island | Itinerary

itinerary.title: Arrival in Adelaide
itinerary.description: Commence your journey by arriving at Adelaide Airport no later than 6.30am. Upon your arrival, a shuttle transfer to your designated hotel will be provided. While an early check-in cannot be guaranteed, we will do our best to accommodate your needs. Later in the day, take a leisurely stroll to the iconic Adelaide Oval, where you can take part in a 90-minute stadium tour, featuring the Bradman Collections. Your evening will be spent in comfort at the hotel in Adelaide.

itinerary.title: Adelaide – Choose One Full-Day Excursion
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a complimentary breakfast, setting the tone for a day filled with exploration. itinerary.title: Adelaide to Kangaroo Island - Full-Day Seal Bay Discovery Tour
itinerary.description: Commence your day with check-out from the hotel, where you may kindly leave your substantial or oversized luggage at the Hotel Bell desk. itinerary.title: Kangaroo Island to Adelaide

Delight in a sumptuous 2-Course Lunch at Hanson Bay. Subsequently, transfer back to Adelaide, where you shall check in at your chosen hotel. Enjoy your overnight stay at the hotel in Adelaide.

itinerary.title: Departure from Adelaide
