The tour culminates at the Central Bus Station, from where you may return to the hotel independently. Later in the day, proceed to Adelaide Airport via a Shuttle Transfer for your onward flight.

packages.name: Amazing Vietnam and Cambodia | 5 Days Itinerary
packages.destination: Saigon - Mekong Delta - Cu Chi - Siem Reap - Angkor

images.alt_text: Amazing Vietnam and Cambodia | 5 Days Itinerary
Amazing Vietnam and Cambodia | 5 Days Itinerary

itinerary.title: Arrival in Saigon – Saigon City Tour
itinerary.description: Today, you will arrive in Saigon, which is now called Ho Chi Minh City – a lively and exciting place in Vietnam. When you land at the airport, we will take you to the city centre and help you check in at the hotel. In the evening, our city tour begins at the Reunification Palace, a big building that played a role in the Vietnam War, which ended in 1975. Now it's a museum and a place for official meetings. Right nearby is the Central Post Office, a cool-looking building from the colonial era that's a big deal in the city. You will be strolling along Nguyen Hue street, where you can take pictures of the Opera House (from outside) and the Ho Chi Minh Committee (from outside). After that, you will walk to Ben Thanh Market, an important symbol of Saigon. There, you can see how the locals live and even do some shopping for handmade goods. Tonight, you will stay at the hotel in Saigon.

itinerary.title: Saigon - Mekong Delta - Saigon
itinerary.description: After having breakfast today, you will go to My Tho. When you arrive, you will get on a boat and cruise along the mighty Mekong River, watching how the local people live along the riverbanks. We will stop at one of the four islands in the area to see the sights. Then, you will hop on small boats rowed by local people, and they will take you through small canals with water coconut trees. You will visit local factories where you can taste honey tea and see how the locals make coconut candy milk. You can even try it yourself or take a walk in the garden where locals take care of honeybees. After that, you will enjoy a horse-cart ride along the peaceful village roads. For lunch, you will stop at a local restaurant near the Mekong River and try Elephant Ear fish. In the evening, we will drive back to Saigon with a stop to visit Vinh Trang Pagoda, a famous pagoda in the area with a mix of Chinese, Cambodian, and French architectural influences. Tonight, you will stay at a hotel in Saigon.

itinerary.title: Saigon – Cu Chi Tunnels Tour – Siem Reap
itinerary.description: After breakfast today, you will visit the Cu Chi Tunnels, which are special tunnels from the time of the Vietnam War. These tunnels, about 200 kilometres long, were dug by hand and used by Vietnamese guerilla forces during the war. Before the Tet Offensive in 1968, almost 10,000 soldiers lived in these tunnels. Even today, they show us how tough the war was. You can even try crawling through some parts of the tunnel to experience it for yourself. In the afternoon, you will be heading to the airport for a flight to Siem Reap. When you arrive in Siem Reap, our representative will pick you up from the airport and take you to the hotel. The rest of the day is free for you to relax. You will spend the night at the hotel in Siem Reap.

itinerary.title: Full Day Angkor Tour
itinerary.description: Today is all about exploring the amazing Angkor temples. After breakfast, you will start at the South Gate of Angkor Thom, also known as Big Angkor. This was the royal city and the last capital of the Angkor Empire. You will visit the famous Bayon Temple, which is a bit of an architectural puzzle because it was built over a century in a kind of patchwork way. Next, you will check out the Terrace of the Elephants, a long wall with carved elephants, and Terrace of the Leper King, which has carvings of nagas, demons, and mythological beings. You will also explore Baphuon, a huge temple mountain, and the Royal Palace Area with Phimeanakas, an impressive sandstone pyramid. Your last stop in the morning is the enchanting Ta Prohm temple, where nature and human skill have combined to create something wonderful. In the afternoon, you will visit the famous Angkor Wat temple, a replica of the Hindu universe. It has five towers, numerous galleries with carvings, and stone images of celestial Apsara dancers. It's like stepping into a mystical world. Tonight, you will stay at the hotel in Siem Reap.

itinerary.title: Leaving Siem Reap
itinerary.description: After your breakfast this morning, we will take you to the airport for your flight back home or to your next destination.

packages.name: Classic Kenya Safari: A 7-Day Adventure Through Nairobi
packages.destination: Nairobi - Tree Hotel - Fairmont Mount Kenya Safari Club - Mount Kenya- Nakuru/Naivasha - Masai Mara

images.alt_text: Classic Kenya Safari: A 7-Day Adventure Through Nairobi
Classic Kenya Safari: A 7-Day Adventure Through Nairobi

itinerary.title: Nairobi
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport in Nairobi, you'll disembark from your flight and go through immigration and customs procedures. Your welcoming team will be there to greet you and provide a smooth transfer to your hotel. You'll spend the night at the hotel in Nairobi.

itinerary.title: Nairobi to Tree Hotel
itinerary.description: After a hearty breakfast, we'll depart from Nairobi in the morning and head towards Nyeri, a charming town nestled in Kenya's coffee-growing and dairy farming region, known as the former White Highlands. Upon reaching the base hotel, you'll be treated to a delicious lunch. Then, our adventure continues as we make our way to a unique tree hotel. Here, you'll experience an enchanting evening watching a procession of animals emerging from the forest. They gather at the floodlit water hole and salt lick, where they playfully jostle for the best spots. As the night falls, you have the option to stay awake and witness a captivating display of strength, with elephants engaging in friendly contests. However, even these gentle giants usually avoid challenging the mighty rhinoceros, keeping a respectful distance. In the case of Mountain Lodge, you'll arrive directly at the lodge for a delightful lunch. You'll enjoy your meals and spend the night at the Tree Hotel, surrounded by the natural beauty of the Kenyan wilderness. (Includes Breakfast, Lunch, and Dinner) Remember to pack an overnight bag as you'll be transferring to the Ark for a unique experience in the heart of the forest.

itinerary.title: Tree Hotel to Fairmont Mount Kenya Safari Club
itinerary.description: Embark on a short morning drive to the Fairmont Mount Kenya Safari Club, located at the base of the awe-inspiring Mount Kenya, standing tall at 17,058 feet. En route, you'll have the exciting opportunity to pause and visit the Equator, adding a unique geographical experience to your journey. With its panoramic vistas of the majestic Mount Kenya, the Fairmont Mount Kenya Safari Club Resort offers a true blend of comfort, relaxation, and adventure. The resort boasts 120 luxuriously appointed hotel rooms set amidst sprawling 100-acre landscaped gardens. Originally established as the private retreat of renowned movie star and club founder, William Holden, this esteemed establishment has hosted legendary figures like Winston Churchill and Bing Crosby. The Fairmont Mount Kenya Safari Club offers a wealth of recreational activities to make your stay truly unforgettable. You can enjoy activities such as horseback riding, golf, croquet, a bowling green, table tennis, swimming, and even a relaxing visit to the on-site beauty salon. For nature enthusiasts, the hotel features an animal orphanage, providing a unique opportunity to get up close with local wildlife. After a delightful lunch, the remainder of the day is yours to explore and partake in the various activities offered at the hotel. Whether you're seeking adventure or relaxation, this magnificent resort has something for everyone. Relish your meals at the Fairmont Mount Kenya Safari Club as you enjoy the exquisite blend of British cuisine with the captivating backdrop of Mount Kenya. Enjoy a comfortable and lavish overnight stay at the resort. (Includes Breakfast, Lunch, and Dinner)

itinerary.title: Mount Kenya to Nakuru/Naivasha
itinerary.description: Today's journey takes us over the stunning Aberdare Mountain range. We pause briefly to admire the breathtaking Thompson's Falls, a majestic 73-meter waterfall named after the Scottish explorer Joseph Thompson, who first laid eyes on it in 1884. We continue our adventure to Nakuru, where we'll enjoy a delicious lunch. In the afternoon, get ready for an exciting game drive. Nakuru National Park is teeming with wildlife, and the birdwatching opportunities are truly remarkable. The park is famous for hosting magnificent flocks of both lesser and Greater Flamingos, turning the lakeshores into a striking stretch of pink. Nakuru is a bird lover's paradise, boasting over 400 bird species, including White Pelicans, Plovers, Egrets, and Marabou Storks. It's also one of the few places in Africa where you can spot the White Rhino and the rare Rothschild Giraffe. Tonight, we'll settle in for a comfortable stay at a lodge in Nakuru or Naivasha, where you can relish breakfast, lunch, and dinner.

itinerary.title: Nakuru/Naivasha to Masai Mara
itinerary.description: After a satisfying breakfast, embark on a scenic drive through the breathtaking Great Rift Valley to reach the renowned Masai Mara National Reserve. This expansive reserve is a part of the vast Serengeti plains, famous for the incredible annual wildebeest migration and is the habitat of the Big Five: Lions, Elephants, Leopards, Buffaloes, and Rhinos. Enjoy a delicious lunch at your lodge or camp and take some time to relax before setting out on an afternoon game drive. The Masai Mara Game Reserve is one of the world's most extraordinary wilderness areas, where you'll encounter a diverse array of large mammals. Some of the resident wildlife species in the park include Maasai Giraffes, Buffaloes, Elands, and thousands of plains game such as Impalas, Zebras, Topis, as well as both Thomson's and Grant's Gazelles. Conclude your day with a hearty meal and spend the night at a comfortable lodge or camp in the heart of the Mara. This includes Breakfast, Lunch, and Dinner.

itinerary.title: Masai Mara
itinerary.description: After a hearty breakfast, we set out for a morning game-viewing drive-in search of the diverse wildlife that calls this reserve home. With a bit of luck, you might witness a thrilling live hunt unfolding right before your amazed eyes! Following a delicious lunch at your lodge, embark on another exhilarating game drive, with a chance to encounter the renowned 'Big 5.' Enjoy your meals and spend the night at a lodge or camp in Mara. Complimentary Breakfast, Lunch, and Dinner are provided.

itinerary.title: Masai Mara to Nairobi
itinerary.description: Enjoy your breakfast and then check out of your accommodation. It's time to make the journey back to Nairobi, arriving in time for lunch. You can choose your lunch venue. Afterward, we'll arrange your transfer to Jomo Kenyatta International Airport for your onward flight.

Enjoy an overnight stay in Nairobi.

itinerary.title: Nairobi to Nakuru or Naivasha
itinerary.description: Today, we set off for the enchanting Lake Nakuru National Park, nestled within the Great Rift Valley. After a satisfying lunch, an exhilarating afternoon game drive awaits. The park boasts abundant wildlife, and the spectacular bird-watching opportunities are sure to captivate even the most hesitant birdwatcher. The park is home to vast flocks of both lesser and greater flamingos, turning the lakeshore into a mesmerising pink spectacle. Its birdlife is renowned worldwide, with over 400 bird species, including white pelicans, plovers, egrets, and marabou storks. This park is also one of the rare places in Africa where you can spot the white rhino and the elusive Rothschild giraffe. You'll enjoy your meals and spend the night at a lodge or camp in Nakuru or Naivasha.

itinerary.title: Nakuru / Naivasha to Masai Mara
itinerary.description: Today, you'll spend the night in Naivasha, where you'll have the opportunity to observe the diverse birdlife around the lake. After breakfast, we'll embark on a journey through the stunning Great Rift Valley to reach the Masai Mara National Reserve. This vast reserve is part of the renowned Serengeti plains, famous for the breathtaking migration of wildebeests and home to the Big Five: Lions, Elephants, Leopards, Buffalos, and Rhinos. You'll enjoy lunch at your lodge or camp and have some leisure time before setting out for an afternoon game drive. The Mara Game Reserve is considered one of the most incredible wilderness areas in the world. The diversity of large mammals is astounding and easily observable. Among the park's residents are Maasai Giraffes, Buffalos, Elands, and thousands of plains game species, including Impalas, Zebras, Topis, and both Thomson's and Grant's Gazelles. You'll dine and stay overnight at a lodge or camp in the Mara.

itinerary.title: Masai Mara
itinerary.description: Embark on a morning game-viewing excursion in search of the diverse wildlife that calls this reserve home. If luck is on your side, you may have the astonishing opportunity to witness a live hunt unfold before your very eyes, capturing each moment in awe! Following a delicious lunch at your lodge, set out for another thrilling game drive, with the expectation of encountering the renowned 'Big 5.' Enjoy your meals and spend the night at a lodge or camp in Mara.

itinerary.title: Masai Mara to Nairobi
itinerary.description: Today, you will check out and make the journey back to Nairobi, arriving in time for lunch. You can enjoy lunch at your own leisure. Afterward, we'll transfer you to Jomo Kenyatta International Airport for your departure flight back home, carrying with your delightful memories of your stay in Kenya.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Nairobi - Samburu
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at the airport, you'll be greeted by our representatives who will help you with customs and immigration procedures. You'll meet your tour guide and begin your journey to Samburu National Park. After arriving, you can check in at the hotel and enjoy your lunch. In the afternoon, we'll take you on a thrilling game drive in the park until sunset. Later, take a break from the tour and savour a delicious dinner at the lodge.

itinerary.title: Samburu Safari
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delicious breakfast at the hotel. Embark on an exciting adventure in the reserve, spending the entire day on thrilling game drives to witness the incredible wildlife. Return to the hotel in the evening for a sumptuous dinner, and then rest peacefully for the night.

itinerary.title: Samburu to Aberdares
itinerary.description: After a delicious breakfast in the morning, we will head to Aberdares to explore its wonderful attractions. Upon arriving in the city, we'll check in and enjoy a scrumptious lunch at the Aberdares Country Club. It will be around noon, and you can return to the lodge for a bit of rest. Later in the day, you can relish the joy of observing animals and playing near the floodlit waterhole. Finally, we will proceed to the unique tree lodge known as "The Ark," nestled in the heart of Aberdare National Park. This tree lodge is home to a rich variety of wildlife, including elephants, rhinos, bushbucks, and leopards. Don't forget to capture some incredible moments from the ground-level bunker at the tree lodge.

itinerary.title: Aberdares to Lake Nakuru
itinerary.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast at the hotel. We'll continue our journey towards the breathtaking Great Rift Valley and the mesmerising Lake Nakuru National Park. Upon arrival at the lodge, indulge in a delicious lunch. The remainder of the day is yours to enjoy with your loved ones. In the evening, relish a delightful dinner at the lodge before a tranquil night's rest.

itinerary.title: Lake Nakuru to Masai Mara
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delightful breakfast at the hotel. Next, meet your tour representative as you prepare to journey to the renowned Masai Mara National Reserve. Upon reaching the camp, check into the lodge and enjoy a relaxing lunch. In the afternoon, embark on an exciting game drive in this world-famous reserve. Return to the lodge for a delicious dinner and spend the night there.

itinerary.title: Masai Mara
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast at the hotel. Today, you have the entire day to explore the reserve and embark on exciting game drives. In the evening, make your way to the lodge for a delicious dinner.

itinerary.title: Exploring the Wonders of Masai Mara
itinerary.description: Today is dedicated to exploring the remarkable beauty of Masai Mara with your knowledgeable tour guide. Masai Mara is a captivating destination teeming with diverse wildlife. Its rolling hills are blessed with a constant water supply throughout the year, making it an ideal habitat for a wide variety of animals. During your visit, you'll have the opportunity to encounter numerous predators, including jackals, leopards, hyenas, lions, and zebras. The animals are typically well-fed during the day, ensuring you witness their natural behaviours and activities. After an exciting day of wildlife sightings, return to your hotel for a delicious dinner and a comfortable night's rest.

itinerary.title: Leaving Masai Mara
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delicious breakfast at the hotel. After breakfast, complete the check-out process, and we'll arrange for your transfer to Nairobi. You'll enjoy a delightful lunch at a city restaurant. Later, our tour representative will assist you in getting to the airport for your departure.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Cairo
itinerary.description: Greetings and safe travels! Today marks the commencement of your thrilling African tour with GT Holidays. Upon your arrival at Cairo International Airport, our courteous representatives will be on hand to provide valuable assistance with immigration, visa procedures, and customs clearance. You will then be transported in a private coach to your hotel.

itinerary.title: Exploring Cairo
itinerary.description: Following a delightful breakfast, embark on a visit to the captivating Egyptian Museum of Antiquities, home to the most extensive collection of artefacts dating from the time of the pharaohs. After a leisurely lunch, continue your journey to the awe-inspiring Great Pyramids of Giza, which include the renowned structures of Cheops, Chephren, and Mykerinos, as well as the enigmatic Sphinx.

itinerary.title: Luxor - Nile Cruise
itinerary.description: On this day, you shall make your way to Luxor Airport and embark on a flight bound for Luxor City. Our courteous representatives shall be at your service, facilitating your transfer to the luxurious Nile Cruise Ship, where you will embark on a captivating four-night voyage. In the afternoon, you may explore the renowned Karnak and Luxor Temples, enveloped in an aura of tranquillity. Following your exploration, return to Luxor City and take up residence aboard the cruise ship for an enchanting overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Nile Cruise Expedition
itinerary.description: Our journey continues as we set our course towards the West Bank of the majestic Nile River. Here, you shall have the opportunity to visit a plethora of remarkable sites, including the Valley of the Kings, the Hatshepsut Temple, and the imposing Colossi of Memnon. Following a brief sojourn at these historic locations, the cruise shall gracefully navigate the Esna Lock, ultimately leading us to the charming city of Edfu.

itinerary.title: Cruise - Aswan City
itinerary.description: Following a delightful breakfast, our tour representatives shall escort you on a Horse Carriage Ride to explore the magnificent Horus Temple in Edfu. Subsequently, your voyage shall progress towards Kom Ombo, where you shall have the privilege of visiting the esteemed Sobek Temple. As the day unfolds, our cruise shall gracefully sail its way to the enchanting Aswan City, where you shall spend the entire night in splendour.

itinerary.title: Aswan City
itinerary.description: In the morning, you will embark on a journey to visit the monumental High Dam and the awe-inspiring Unfinished Obelisk within Aswan City. Following this, you will embark on a delightful Felucca Sail Boat ride, during which you will have the opportunity to behold the magnificent Agha Khan Mausoleum and the storied Nilometer.

itinerary.title: Aswan City - Cairo
itinerary.description: Commence your day with a sumptuous breakfast at the hotel and relish the charm of Aswan City in the company of your beloved companions. Alternatively, for those seeking an enhanced experience, an additional package (available at an extra cost) grants access to the remarkable Abi-Simbel Temples. As the afternoon approaches, it will be time for you to take a flight back to Cairo.

itinerary.title: Cairo - Final Departure
itinerary.description: After savouring a delectable breakfast, kindly check out from the hotel and proceed to Cairo Airport for your final departure, marking the culmination of this remarkable journey.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Cairo
itinerary.description: Welcome to the Land of Pharaohs! Upon your arrival at Cairo International Airport, our dedicated representative will be there to meet and assist you in smoothly navigating through customs and passport formalities. You will then be transported in a private coach to your hotel, where you can relax and unwind at your leisure. In the evening, you are invited to join the captivating Sound & Light Show, a mesmerising experience that will set the stage for your overnight stay in Cairo.

itinerary.title: Cairo - City Exploration
itinerary.description: Following a delightful breakfast at the hotel, our representative will guide you on an extensive tour of Cairo City. In the morning, you will embark on a journey to witness the grandeur of the pyramids of Cheops, Chephren, and Mycerinus, a marvel listed among the Seven Wonders of the World. A pause for a sumptuous lunch will be followed by an expedition to Sakkara, home to the very first pyramid constructed in ancient Egypt. Additionally, you will explore the historical city of Memphis, the capital of Upper and Lower Egypt. Don't miss the opportunity to partake in an adventurous camel or horse ride. Later, you will have the chance to visit the remarkable artistic creations at the Papyrus Institute and explore the Old Bazaars. Your overnight accommodation awaits you at the hotel in Cairo.

itinerary.title: Cairo - A Historic Exploration
itinerary.description: Commencing the day with a hearty breakfast, you shall embark on a journey to the Egyptian Museum, housing a remarkable repository of Egyptian antiquities. This distinguished institution boasts the world's most extensive collection of Pharaonic artefacts, along with the treasures from the tomb of Tutankhamen. Following this enlightening visit, your itinerary leads you to the Citadel, majestically perched upon the Muqattam Hills. Here, the Cairo Bazaar awaits, renowned among travellers from centuries past. A well-deserved break for lunch shall be provided. Post the respite, the next destinations on your schedule include the Church of the Virgin and St. Mark's Cathedral. The day concludes with your overnight stay at the Cairo hotel.

itinerary.title: Cairo - Alexandria, the "Pearl of the Mediterranean"
itinerary.description: Daybreak heralds a buffet breakfast, a prelude to a full-day excursion to Alexandria. Your journey begins with a visit to "Pompey's Pillar," an imposing monument erected in memory of a Roman Emperor in 297 A.D. Subsequently, you shall proceed to explore the formidable Quaitbay Citadel, perched on the northern apex of the eastern harbour. This site is believed to have been the location of the Pharos of Alexandria during the 15th century. Of special note, you will have the opportunity to visit the expansive "Alexandria Library," the largest such institution on the African continent, in the company of your loved ones. Thereafter, return to your Cairo hotel for a peaceful night's rest.

itinerary.title: Farewell, Cairo
itinerary.description: As you savour your breakfast, the time has come to bid adieu to your Cairo abode. Following your morning repast, you will be transferred to Cairo International Airport for your final departure.

packages.name: Ultimate Guide to Explore Canadian Rockies, Canada, Toronto and Calgary
packages.destination: Toronto -City Tour - Ottawa City Tour - Montreal - The Paris Of North America - Quebec - Calgary - Icefield Parkway - Kelowna - Vancouver - Vancouver City Tour

itinerary.title: Arrival in Toronto and City Tour
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Toronto Airport, you will be greeted by our tour representatives who will accompany you to your hotel. Prepare for an exciting city tour of Toronto, where you'll explore some of its iconic landmarks. Your itinerary includes a visit to the esteemed Stanley Cup and the Hockey Hall of Fame. Don't forget to explore the renowned Rogers Centre, known for its dynamic and versatile entertainment offerings. Next, make your way to the famous CN Tower, where you'll take a thrilling ride in the glass elevator to reach the 1,122-foot glass-floored outdoor observation deck. Take in the breathtaking views and relish your time in this incredible city.

itinerary.title: Ottawa City Tour
itinerary.description: Following a quick breakfast, prepare for a day of exploration in Kingston. Upon your arrival, indulge in a captivating cruise through the enchanting 1000 Islands, providing a fascinating glimpse of this destination's allure. Afterwards, proceed to Ottawa, where you'll have the opportunity to visit Parliament Hill, a revered symbol of Canada's national government. Don't miss the chance to explore The Rideau Canal, Ontario's inaugural UNESCO World Heritage Site, among other captivating attractions.

itinerary.title: Montreal - The Paris of North America
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a delightful breakfast and board a luxurious coach for your journey to Montreal. Discover the splendid beauty of Notre Dame, renowned for its exquisite paintings, statues, ornate interior, gilded polychrome carvings, and a magnificent altarpiece. Make sure to capture some memorable photographs from the summit of Mont Royal, as you enjoy a breathtaking panoramic view of Montreal from this vantage point.

itinerary.title: Quebec
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a delicious breakfast before embarking on a captivating city tour of Quebec. Our knowledgeable tour guide will share the rich history and lead you through the remarkable walled city, the largest in North America. Make sure to explore the iconic landmarks, including the Parliament Buildings, Upper and Lower Towns, the Plains of Abraham, Chateau Frontenac, Place d'Armes, the Citadel, and the Quebec National Assembly.

itinerary.title: Quebec to Calgary
itinerary.description: Start your day with a hearty American breakfast, and then proceed to the airport for your flight to Calgary. Our tour representatives will be there to assist you upon arrival. Calgary is renowned for its breathtaking beauty, and you'll have the opportunity to explore the magnificent Heritage Park, the Olympic Park, and much more. Following your exploration of Calgary, you'll be transferred to the charming city of Banff, known for its picturesque streets and stunning natural landscapes.

itinerary.title: Icefield Parkway
itinerary.description: Start your day with a quick breakfast at the hotel, and then take some time to relax. Your journey will commence as you head towards the Icefield Parkway, where you'll be surrounded by steep gorges, snow-capped peaks, and stunning blue lakes. Make sure to pause at the ice field and step onto the ice itself. Here, you'll come face to face with the glaciers and even embark on a thrilling Glacier adventure. Later, you'll have the opportunity to stop at Johnston Canyon and revel in the true essence of fun.

itinerary.title: Kelowna
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a morning breakfast. Get ready to savour the breathtaking vistas of the Canadian Rockies as you are transported to the charming city of Kelowna. You'll also have the chance to enjoy a brief orientation tour of this beautiful locale.

itinerary.title: Kelowna to Vancouver
itinerary.description: Following a delightful breakfast, you'll step aboard a luxurious coach, accompanied by our knowledgeable tour guide, who will lead you to the pristine environs of Whistler. Upon arrival, you'll relish a breathtaking journey aboard the extraordinary Peak 2 Peak Gondola, spanning the Blackcomb and Whistler Mountains. This experience affords you the chance to behold the panoramic vistas of mountain ranges and the stunning Whistler valley.

itinerary.title: Vancouver City Tour
itinerary.description: Today promises an enchanting exploration of Vancouver's finest attractions. Commence your day with a hearty breakfast and rendezvous with your guide for a captivating tour. Your adventure will commence with a visit to the renowned Stanley Park, followed by the exhilarating traverse of the Capilano Suspension Bridge. The day's itinerary proceeds to Stanley Park's highlights, including Prospect Point and English Bay. You'll also delve into the rich heritage of West Coast Native Totem Poles. Your journey continues with a visit to Gastown, a historic district, where you'll amble through its charming streets and admire its Victorian-style architecture. The tour takes you through picturesque houses and serene, tree-lined avenues, concluding with the exhilarating experience of the Capilano Suspension Bridge.

itinerary.title: Vancouver Airport
itinerary.description: Bid adieu to your Vancouver adventure with a swift breakfast, and then make your way to the airport for your departing flight.

packages.name: Spain Holiday Package
packages.destination: Lisbon - City Tour - Lisbon - Seville - City Tour - Seville - Cordoba - City Tour - Toledo-Madrid - Madrid - City Tour - Zaragoza - Barcelona

itinerary.title: Arrive in Lisbon - Oceanario de Lisboa
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Humberto Delgado Airport, our tour representatives will greet you and help you get to your hotel. Complete the check-in formalities and then head out to explore Lisbon, which is Portugal’s capital and also its largest city. The first spot you will be going to is Oceanario de Lisboa, which is one of Europe’s largest indoor aquariums. Walk around Baixa, the commercial centre of Lisboa, and then go to Alfama, which is among the oldest neighbourhoods in Lisbon. End the day by visiting the two UNESCO World Heritage Sites, Belem Tower and Jeronimos Monastery.

itinerary.title: Lisbon – Seville – Plaza de Toros de la Maestranza - Torre del Oro - La Giralda
itinerary.description: On the second day of your trip, shift from Lisbon to Seville, which is the fourth-largest city in Spain. Visit the Plaza de Toros de la Maestranza, which is the largest bullfighting arena in the country. You will also be visiting Torre del Oro and La Giralda. The Torre del Oro, or the Tower of Gold, was built in the 12th century to serve as a military watchtower. La Giralda, a bell tower that harmoniously blends Moorish and Renaissance architecture, is another must-see attraction.

itinerary.title: Cordoba – Mosque–Cathedral of Cordoba - Palacio de Viana - Puerta del Puente
itinerary.description: After having your breakfast, depart from Seville and move towards Cordoba, which is the capital of the province of Cordoba. Explore the Mosque–Cathedral of Cordoba, a monument that is an integral part of Islamic architecture. Get mesmerised by the beauty of Palacio de Viana, a Renaissance palace surrounded by a garden and 12 patios. Visit the Palacio de Viana, Puerta del Puente, and Alcazar de los Reyes Cristianos, and end the day by witnessing a flamenco show.

itinerary.title: Toledo - Toledo Cathedral – Madrid
itinerary.description: Drive down to the city of Toledo which stands out because of its historical landmarks. Visit the gothic style castle, Santa Iglesia Catedral Primada de Toledo, whose architecture has French influences. You will be taken to the Mariano Zamorano Swords Factory before you leave for Madrid, the capital of Spain.

itinerary.title: Madrid City Tour: Campo del Moro - Sabatini Gardens - Royal Palace of Madrid
itinerary.description: Today, you will be exploring the popular tourist attractions in Madrid. Start off with Campo del Moro, a 19th century park which was built during the reign of Queen Maria Cristina. After this, walk around the Sabatini Gardens, which are a part of the Royal Palace of Madrid.

itinerary.title: Zaragoza - Barcelona - Gothic Quarter
itinerary.description: Drive from Madrid to the city of Zaragoza, from where you will be taken to Barcelona. After you reach Barcelona, freshen up at your hotel and head out for a day of sightseeing. Go to the Gothic Quarter, the charming neighbourhood lined with clubs, restaurants, and bars. Head to the Palau Sant Jordi, Basílica de la Sagrada Família, and Olympic Village before going back to your hotel.

itinerary.title: Depart Barcelona
itinerary.description: In the morning, check out of your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

packages.name: Rome & Venice Tour Package
packages.destination: Rome - Venice - Venice Island Tour - Pisa-Florence - Vatican-Sistine Chapel

itinerary.title: Arrive In Rome
itinerary.description: Welcome to a city that was once the capital of the greatest empires of the ancient world! Upon your arrival at Rome International Airport, our tour manager will guide you to a private car to catch your train to Venice. The journey takes around 3.5 hours on a high-speed train. Check in to your hotel and spend the rest of the day exploring the many places in and around your hotel. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Rome.

itinerary.title: Venice Island Tour
itinerary.description: Venice is a beautiful city and one of the most visited in the world. After breakfast, you’ll catch the Alilaguna boat at St. Mark’s Square. You’ll see Murano Island, famous for its glassmaking. Historians believe the industry began around the 1200s and has flourished ever since. Your next stop is Burano Island. This place was once described as a mini-Venice and is famous for its colourful houses, Venetian masks, and lacemaking. Your boat trip ends with a trip to Torcello Island, known for Santa Maria Assunta Cathedral, Venice’s first cathedral and the Museum of Torcello. Return to your hotel to spend the night in Venice.

itinerary.title: Venice – Florence – Pisa
itinerary.description: After a quick breakfast, you will take a train to Florence. The journey takes around 3 hours and offers a breathtakingly beautiful view of the vast Italian countryside. Florence is considered the birthplace of the Renaissance and a major centre for art, architecture, and culture. After arriving in Florence, check into your hotel and relax before visiting the historic University of Pisa. Some places you will visit in Pisa include the Leaning Tower, Piazza dei Miracoli, Duomo, Piazza dei Cavalieri, and the historic Scuola Normale. The Pisa Battistero is over 600 years old and is the largest baptistery in Italy. It is considered a masterpiece of Romanesque art. Move to Florence in the evening to spend the night in the city.

itinerary.title: Florence – Rome
itinerary.description: Enjoy your Italian breakfast spread and head out for a city tour. Some of the famous places you will enjoy today include the Cathedral of Santa Maria del Fiore, Uffizi Galleries, the Ponte Vecchio, Piazzale Michelangelo, Piazza della Signoria, the Duomo, and Palazzo Pitti. After lunch, you will move to Rome to enjoy the last leg of your Rome and Venice (Italy) tour package. In the evening, you will explore the Exhibition Palace, the Fountain of the Naiads, the Capitoline Museum, and the Piazza Venezia. If time permits, you will also cover the Roman Forum, The Coliseum, St. Peter’s Basilica, Porta Flaminia, The Arch of Constantine, The Circus Maximus, Piazza Navona, and the Trevi Fountain. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Rome.

itinerary.title: Vatican City
itinerary.description: After breakfast, you are free to enjoy the rest of the day at leisure or continue visiting sites you left out yesterday. There are plenty of flea markets in Rome that you can see today or take an optional tour of the city’s multiple attractions like Piazza Venezia and the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier. After lunch, you will visit the Vatican City. Some attractions include the Sistine Chapel, the Vatican Museum, St. Peter’s Basilica, and the Gardens of Vatican City. Return to your hotel to relax and prepare for departure tomorrow.

itinerary.title: Departure:
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of your hotel and move to Rome International Airport to continue to your next destination on your Europe tour package or catch your return flight home.

packages.name: Athens Greece Tour Package
packages.destination: Athens - Mykonos - Mykonos Full Day Cruise - Santorini

itinerary.title: Arrive in Athens
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at the Athens International Airport, our tour manager will greet you and help you transfer to the hotel. After completing check-in formalities, get ready to explore Athens. This beautiful city is over 3,500 years old and is believed to be the cradle of Western Civilisation. Our tour guide will pick you up for a night city tour, including dinner and a folk show. You will visit the Port of Piraeus, Europe’s biggest passenger and the City Hall. Some other attractions include Mikrolimano Harbour, the Temple of Olympian Zeus, the Tomb of the Unknown Solider, the National Garden, the Parliament Building, and the National Library. Enter the tour with a visit to Plaka, an old historical neighbourhood in Athens. You can walk across this neighbourhood and enjoy dinner at one of the many popular taverns accompanied by Greek folk dance. Return to your hotel room and spend the night in Athens.

itinerary.title: Athens to Mykonos
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head to catch a ferry to Mykonos. The journey takes around two and a half hours and is loved for its scenic views. Upon arrival at Mykonos, our tour guide will help you transfer to the hotel. Mykonos is a beautiful island with glamorous nightclubs, whitewashed windmills, and stunning beaches. Spend the rest of the day exploring places in and around the hotel.

itinerary.title: Mykonos Full Day Cruise
itinerary.description: Today, after breakfast, you’ll set out for a full-day cruise to the southern coast of Mykonos. This gem on the Aegean Sea offers the perfect opportunity to watch, relax, and enjoy the serene waters. Unlike any average cruise on a yacht, you will get into kaiki, a traditional fishing boat built using pine wood. You’ll visit Dragonissi, a beautiful uninhabited island in the Aegean Sea. Return to Mykonos and stop at Frangias beach for snorkelling and swimming. Your next stop is Kalafati Beach, where you’ll be served lunch at one of the seaside restaurants. After lunch, spend some time at the beach before moving to Paradise Beach for water sports. The final destination on the cruise is Ornos Beach. Return to your hotel room and spend the night in Athens.

itinerary.title: Mykonos to Santorini
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel to catch your ferry to Santorini. The journey takes 2 to 3 hours and is a pleasure because of the scenic views. Upon arrival, our tour manager will help you transfer to the hotel. Santorini is a wonderful island with multi-coloured cliffs, dazzling white houses, volcanoes, and a rich history. After check-in, spend the rest of the evening at leisure, exploring places in and around the hotel. Spend the night in Santorini.

itinerary.title: Santorini Full Day Tour
itinerary.description: After a breakfast buffet, head out to explore this beautiful island, including the Skaros Rock, the ancient ruins of Thera, and Akrotiri. Your journey includes a Caldera tour for some great views of the volcanoes. Spend the night in Santorini.

itinerary.title: Santorini to Athens
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a Greek breakfast, check out of the hotel and head to Athens. Our tour representatives will help you transfer to the hotel. Enjoy the rest of the evening in Athens.

itinerary.title: Depart Athens
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel and head to the airport to catch your flight back home or to continue with your Greece tour package.

packages.name: Oppex Tour Package
packages.destination: Sri Lanka - Kandy - Nuwara Eliya - Bentota - Colombo

itinerary.title: Arrive in Sri Lanka – Kandy
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Bandaranaike International Airport, our tour representatives will greet you and help you get to your hotel in Kandy. Complete the check-in formalities and relax for a bit. Venture out to explore the city of Kandy. Start off with the Royal Botanic Gardens, located near the longest river in Sri Lanka and home to a humongous collection of orchids. Proceed to the Temple of the Tooth, which also goes by the name of Sri Dalada Maligawa. The temple is known to have the relic of the tooth of Lord Buddha.

itinerary.title: Kandy - Nuwara Eliya
itinerary.description: In the morning, have your breakfast and then leave for Nuwara Eliya from Kandy. As you make your way to your hotel, feast your eyes on the mountains, strawberry fields, and cultural attractions of the city. Take a tour of one of the tea factories in Nuwara Eliya before offering your prayers at the Shri Bhakta Hanuman Temple and Seetha Amman Temple. Make a stop at the gorgeous Horton Plains National Park before getting back to your hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: Nuwara Eliya
itinerary.description: In the morning, take your time as you relish a scrumptious breakfast. You have the rest of the day to spend at leisure.

itinerary.title: Nuwara Eliya- Bentota
itinerary.description: On this day, you will be leaving Nuwara Eliya and heading towards the coastal town of Bentota. Once the check-in formalities are complete, you can get ready for a day of fun-filled activities, such as windsurfing, kitesurfing, parasailing, and banana boating.

itinerary.title: Bentota
itinerary.description: In the morning, have your breakfast and then head out to explore Bentota. You can tour the herbal gardens before going to the Turtle Hatchery, which was built to prevent turtles from going extinct. The rest of the day can be dedicated to enjoying more water-based adventures.

itinerary.title: Bentota - Colombo
itinerary.description: On the sixth day, you will be transferred to the capital city of Sri Lanka, Colombo. Check out the Bandaranaike Memorial International Conference Hall (BMICH), which was built between 1970 and 1973. Get back to your hotel in Colombo for the night.

itinerary.title: Colombo
itinerary.description: Dedicate this day to exploring Colombo. Go to the Old Parliament Building and visit the many temples in the city. Later in the day, indulge in some shopping at spots like House of Fashion, Majestic City, Odel, and the local souvenir stores.

itinerary.title: Depart Sri Lanka
itinerary.description: After having a delicious breakfast, check out of your hotel and leave for the airport to board your flight back home, carrying a bundle of sweet memories with you.

packages.name: Lion City Tour
packages.destination: Singapore - Night Safari - Star Virgo Cruise - Onboard Star Virgo - Penang - Phuket - Singapore - Sentosa Sunset Tour - Universal Studios

itinerary.title: Night Safari
itinerary.description: Once you land in Singapore, our tour representatives will greet you at the airport and take you to your hotel. After you check in and freshen up, you can have lunch at the hotel's dining area and get some restful sleep. Later in the evening, we’ll begin the trip with Night Safari, the world’s first nocturnal zoo and come face-to-face with animals such as Asian Elephants, the Malayan tiger, and fishing cats.

itinerary.title: Gardens By The Bay - National Gallery Singapore – Chinatown
itinerary.description: Begin the second day of your trip with Gardens By The Bay, a nature park sprawling over 101 hectares with three waterfront gardens. The next destination is the National Gallery, where you can witness a display of Southeast Asian art and culture. The last stop of the day is Chinatown, where travellers can devour delicious oriental cuisine and shop for souvenirs. Board the Star Virgo Cruise at night.

itinerary.title: Penang
itinerary.description: The cruise reaches Penang early in the day, where you can explore this Malaysian state. Visit the Tropical Spice Garden to witness the beautiful flora and fauna, the Kek Lok Si Temple, and the Pinang Peranakan Mansion. Spend the night at the Star Virgo Cruise.

itinerary.title: Phuket
itinerary.description: The cruise will reach Phuket on the fourth day of your trip, where you can visit Patong Beach, try snorkelling, and pay your respects at the Wat Chalong temple before getting on the Star Virgo Cruise to be taken back to Singapore.

itinerary.title: Back to Singapore - Sentosa Island Tour
itinerary.description: The fifth day of your Singapore holiday is about experiencing Sentosa Island's exotic aura. Of the many activities it offers, you can opt to interact with dolphins, take a cable car ride, and visit Palawan Beach.

itinerary.title: Universal Studios
itinerary.description: Universal Studios in Singapore is the first of its kind in Southeast Asia. If you’re in the mood to get on some thrilling rides and be reminded of the magic of classics like Transformers, The Mummy, and Jurassic Park, this is the right place.

itinerary.title: Depart from Singapore
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

packages.name: Sizzling Singapore Holiday Package
packages.destination: Singapore - Night Safari - Star Virgo Cruise - Onboard Star Virgo - Malacca - Singapore - Sentosa Sunset Tour - Universal Studios

itinerary.title: Night Safari
itinerary.description: After you land in Singapore, our tour representatives will meet you at the airport and help you check in at your hotel. We’ll leave you to freshen up and offer details about where and when to meet to begin the first day of your vacation. In the evening, experience Night Safari at the world’s first nocturnal zoo. It’s a part of the Mandai Wildlife Reserve and home to animals like Asian Elephants, the Malayan tiger, the Malayan tapir, the Nile hippo, and fishing cats.

itinerary.title: Gardens by the Bay - Singapore Zoo – Chinatown - Star Virgo Cruise
itinerary.description: Head to Gardens By The Bay, Singapore’s most extravagant nature park with over 1.5 million plants spread over 101 hectares. The next stop is Singapore Zoo which provides shelter to more than 4200 animals. Hop on to Chinatown to relish some delicious oriental food and shop for souvenirs. You will board the Star Virgo Cruise at night, transferring you to Kuala Lumpur.

itinerary.title: Kuala Lumpur – Malacca - Petronas Twin Towers
itinerary.description: As the cruise stops at Kuala Lumpur, you will have a few hours to explore this alluring city. The next stop is Malacca, a UNESCO World Heritage Site with historical significance. From here, we will take you on a full-day city tour covering all popular tourist spots like Petronas Towers, Kuala Lumpur Bird Park, KLCC Park, etc. Board the cruise at night to head back to Singapore.

itinerary.title: Back to Singapore - Sentosa Island Tour
itinerary.description: After returning to Singapore, the next stop is Sentosa Island, where you can come face-to-face with adorable dolphins, ride cable cars, and stroll across serene beaches.

itinerary.title: Universal Studios
itinerary.description: Universal Studios could be the best gift if you want to take a trip down memory lane and feel like a kid again. Ride Battlestar Galactica or re-experience the magic of movies like Transformers, The Mummy, and Jurassic Park.

itinerary.title: Depart from Singapore
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

packages.name: Amazing Singapore Tour
packages.destination: Singapore - Sentosa Sunset Tour - Singapore City Tour - Universal Studios

itinerary.title: Sentosa Island Tour
itinerary.description: After you land in Singapore, our tour representatives will greet you at the airport and take you to your hotel. Once you have checked in and freshened up, it is time to begin your fabulous Singapore vacation. On your first day, you will be exploring the gorgeous Sentosa Island and the numerous activities present in its surroundings. Interact with the dolphins at Dolphin Island, visit Palawan Beach to see the famous suspension bridge, and enjoy a thrilling cable car ride at the Skyline Luge and Skyride.

itinerary.title: Gardens by the Bay - National Gallery Singapore - Merlion Park - Singapore Zoo
itinerary.description: The first stop on your second day is Gardens By The Bay, a nature park that covers an area of 101 hectares and has three waterfront gardens. After this, head to the National Gallery Museum, which displays mesmerizing pieces of art from the Southeast Asian community. Next is Merlion Park, which contains the iconic Merlion statue, a half-lion and half-fish statue signifying how Singapore started as a fishing village. The last stop for the day is the Singapore Zoo, home to more than 4200 animals.

itinerary.title: Universal Studios - Chinatown
itinerary.description: You must visit Universal Studios theme park in Singapore, the first of its kind in Southeast Asia. Don’t forget to ride Battlestar Galactica, the world’s tallest duelling rollercoaster. Kids and adults will surely enjoy revisiting classic movies such as Transformers, The Mummy, and Jurassic Park. Gift your family a memorable day through a tour of the enchanting Universal Studios. In the evening, head to Chinatown to buy souvenirs for yourself and your loved ones and to relish some delicious oriental cuisine.

itinerary.title: Depart from Singapore
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Tokyo
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Narita, our tour representatives will greet you, and you will be transferred to the hotel by bus. Enjoy your overnight stay in Tokyo.

itinerary.title: Tokyo City Tour
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delicious breakfast. Embark on a guided sightseeing tour of Tokyo, exploring iconic landmarks such as Tokyo Tower, Akasaka Guest House, Meiji Shrine, and the National Diet Building. Continue your journey to the Imperial Palace East Garden, Imperial Palace Plaza, Tasaki Pearl Gallery, Ginza Shopping District, Asakusa Kannon Temple, Sumida River Cruise, and Nakamise Shopping Street. Don't forget to explore the Kappabashi, Ueno, and Akihabara areas. Return to the hotel from Harajuku Station for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Tokyo
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delicious breakfast and then spend the day as you please. Consider taking optional tours if you wish. Relax and unwind for the night in Tokyo.

itinerary.title: Tokyo - Hakone - Mt. Fuji - Hiroshima
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a hearty breakfast. Travel directly from Tokyo to Kyoto, with a thrilling bullet train ride from Tokyo to Odawara. Embark on a sightseeing adventure to Hakone by coach, where you can marvel at the breathtaking views of Mt. itinerary.title: Arrival in Beijing
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Beijing International Airport, you will be greeted by our tour representatives who will assist you in transferring to your hotel. You will spend the night at your hotel.

itinerary.title: Exploring Beijing
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a delightful breakfast at the hotel. Your first stop is at Tian'anmen Square, the largest square in the world. From there, proceed to the Forbidden City, a historic palace complex that served as the seat of power for Ming and Qing dynasty emperors. Afterward, you'll have the opportunity to visit a renowned pearl shop and explore the Summer Palace, including the Marble Boat and the enchanting Long Corridor. In the evening, immerse yourself in the captivating world of Kung Fu with a thrilling show before returning to your hotel for a comfortable overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Beijing to Shanghai by Train
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a hearty breakfast, preparing for a day filled with exploration. Embark on a fascinating journey to the Longdi Jade shop, where you'll have the opportunity to delve into the captivating world of Chinese Jade Culture. From there, your adventure continues as you make your way to the awe-inspiring Great Wall at Juyong Pass, an esteemed UNESCO World Heritage Site, and a remarkable defensive marvel. Following this incredible experience, it's time to make your way to the railway station for your train journey to Shanghai. Upon your arrival in this vibrant city, the tour operator will be there to ensure a smooth transfer to your hotel. Settle in and unwind as you prepare for an enjoyable overnight stay in Shanghai.

itinerary.title: Shanghai
itinerary.description: Kickstart your day with a scrumptious breakfast and embark on a cultural journey to the Shanghai Museum. This venerable institution houses a treasure trove of ancient artefacts that offer insight into ancient wisdom and philosophy. The museum is thoughtfully divided into three exhibition halls and eleven galleries, making it a delight to explore. Next, head over to People Square and Nanjing Road, both excellent spots for a bit of shopping. Visit the silk shop, and then venture into the enchanting Yuyuan Garden, replete with its charming golden fishpond, picturesque bridges, and tranquil pavilions. Your exploration continues with a visit to Yu Market and a photo stop outside the bustling TV Market. As the sun begins to set, you're in for a treat – enjoy a leisurely Huangpu River Cruise, taking in the shimmering lights of this dynamic city. After this delightful experience, return to your hotel for a comfortable overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Departure from Shanghai
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a delightful breakfast. Spend your morning exploring the city and indulging in some retail therapy. As the afternoon approaches, make your way to the airport, where you'll board your departing flight.

itinerary.title: Exploring Beijing
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delightful breakfast at the hotel. Your first destination is the Summer Palace, where you'll have the opportunity to explore the Marble Boat, Long Corridor, and visit the Pearl Shop. Following this, you will visit the renowned Tian’anmen Square, known as the world's largest square. Don't miss the chance to explore the Forbidden City, which served as the imperial palace for Emperors of the Ming and Qing dynasties for over 500 years. Next, you'll experience a Hutong tour, also known as a Rickshaw tour, offering you a unique perspective of Beijing's traditional neighbourhoods. Your journey continues as you explore Houhai Lake and its surrounding district in Central Beijing, which is well-known for its vibrant nightlife scene. This area boasts numerous popular restaurants, cafes, pubs, and bars, attracting visitors from all corners of the world. In the evening, you will be treated to a mesmerising Kung Fu show. After the day's adventures, return to your hotel for a comfortable overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Beijing
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a hearty breakfast, and then embark on a city tour that promises to unveil the rich culture of Chinese Jade. Your first stop is the Longdi Jade Shop, where you'll discover the intricacies of Chinese Jade craftsmanship. Next, you'll journey to the awe-inspiring Great Wall-Juyong Pass, a UNESCO World Heritage Site renowned for its immense defensive prowess. In the afternoon, explore the modern marvels of the Bird’s Nest and Water Cube. As the day winds down, return to the Railway Station for an overnight train journey to Xian.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Xian
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Shanghai Hongqiao railway station, you will be warmly greeted by our tour representatives and transferred to your hotel. Take some time to rest and then embark on an extraordinary adventure to witness the 2,000-year-old Terra Cotta Warriors, each of which forms part of the subterranean mausoleum of Emperor Qin. Your day continues with a visit to a ceramic shop and the Shaanxi Historical Museum, where you can marvel at splendid bronzes and porcelain artefacts. In the evening, you have the option to attend a Tang Dynasty performance, a captivating showcase of ancient Chinese dance and music. Conclude your day with a delightful dinner at an Indian restaurant before returning to your hotel for a restful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Xi’an
itinerary.description: Today, you will explore Xi’an before proceeding to Hangzhou, a city famous for its silk and tea. Begin your tour of Xi’an with a visit to the Big Wild Goose Pagoda Square. It is famous for its Buddhist architecture, especially symmetrical pagodas that form a square-like pyramid. Some of the other attractions here include a huge musical fountain and various museums. The next place on the itinerary is the Muslim Bazaar, which lies 100 metres towards the west of the Bell Tower. Its market is famous for its souvenir shops, mosques, and small roadside eateries selling hand-pulled noodles, dumplings, and other tasty desserts. Spend the night at Xi’an.

itinerary.title: Xi’an To Hangzhou
itinerary.description: Check out from the hotel after breakfast to proceed to Hangzhou. The journey takes around 7 to 8 hours, after which you will check in at your hotel. You can spend the rest of the day exploring the city. Some of the things you can do today include viewing fish at Flower Harbour or enjoying a boat ride on West Lake. And if there’s time enjoy shopping at the Hangzhou Silk Shop.

itinerary.title: Hangzhou to Shanghai
itinerary.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast and prepare for an exciting city tour. Begin by visiting Lingyin Temple to seek blessings from the divine. Later, embark on a car journey to Shanghai. Upon arrival, explore People Square and Nanjing Road for some shopping indulgence. You also have the option to explore the fascinating Madame Tussauds wax museum in Shanghai. Continue your journey to the enchanting Yuyuan Garden, where you can admire the picturesque nine zigzag bridge, golden fishpond, charming bridges, and pavilions. Don't forget to take a stroll through the vibrant Yu Market and Taoist temple in Shanghai. Finally, head to your hotel for a comfortable overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Exploring Shanghai
itinerary.description: Rise and shine early in the morning, and make your way to the renowned Jade Buddha Temple, a prominent Buddhist sanctuary in Shanghai. Take a moment to savor a cup of robust tea at a local tea shop. Afterward, you will venture to Taobao City for some enjoyable shopping. If you're interested, you can also visit the Shanghai Aquarium and explore the scenic Bund area. For a breathtaking view of the city, ascend to the second level of the Oriental Pearl TV Tower. In the evening, don't miss the opportunity to experience the Huangpu River Cruise. Return to your hotel for a restful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Departure from Shanghai
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a delightful breakfast and dedicate some time to shopping or exploring the city at your leisure. In the afternoon, make your way to the airport and board your flight for your departure.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Beijing
itinerary.description: On the first day of your journey, you will board a flight to China, landing at the Beijing Capital International Airport. Upon your arrival, you will be warmly greeted by our tour representatives and efficiently transferred to your designated hotel. After the journey, take some time to relax and explore the city at your own pace. In the evening, you have the choice to attend an Acrobatic show; please note that this option does not include meals.

itinerary.title: Exploring Beijing
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a satisfying breakfast at your hotel. Get ready to embark on a comprehensive city tour that will include visits to the Summer Palace, the Marble Boat, a Pearl Shop, and the exquisitely painted "Long Corridor." Don't miss the opportunity to witness the grandeur of Tian'anmen Square, the world's largest square. Proceed to the Forbidden City, where the Emperors of the Ming and Qing dynasties ruled for more than 500 years. You also have the option to partake in a Hutong tour or a Rickshaw tour, allowing you to delve deeper into the local culture. Your next destination is Houhai, situated in the heart of Beijing and renowned for its vibrant nightlife, offering an array of bars, cafes, and restaurants. In the evening, you can choose to attend the Kongku show. Conclude the day with a delightful dinner at an Indian restaurant before returning to your hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Beijing
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a hearty breakfast and embark on a city tour of Beijing. Your first stop is the Longdi Jade Shop, where you'll have the opportunity to learn about the rich Chinese Jade culture. Next, proceed to the legendary Great Wall at Juyong Pass, a UNESCO World Heritage Site renowned for its monumental defensive fortifications. In the afternoon, explore the iconic Bird’s Nest and Water Cube. You'll be provided with a packed Indian dinner box for your evening meal. Later, return to the Railway Station for an overnight train journey to Xian.

itinerary.title: Xian - Arrival at 08:09 by Z19
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Shanghai Hongqiao railway station, you'll be greeted by our tour representatives and transferred to your hotel. After a brief respite, you will delve into history by visiting the awe-inspiring Terra Cotta Warriors, a remarkable collection that dates back over 2000 years and forms part of Emperor Qin's subterranean tomb. Later in the day, explore a ceramic shop and the Shaanxi Historical Museum, where you can admire magnificent bronzes and porcelain artefacts. You also have the option to attend a mesmerising Tang Dynasty performance showcasing ancient Chinese dance and music. Conclude the day with a delicious meal at an Indian restaurant before returning to your hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Xi'an to Hangzhou
itinerary.description: Travel via the Z88/Z85 train with a soft berth, departing at 1948 and arriving at 1213 the following day. Begin your day by checking out of your hotel and heading to the Big Wild Goose Pagoda square, a renowned location known for its classical buildings adorned with intricately carved beams and beautifully painted rafters. Afterward, make your way to the Muslim Bazaar, situated just 100 metres west of the Bell Tower. Here, you'll discover a variety of souvenir shops, unique market stalls, and bars managed by the local Muslim community. You'll be provided with a packed Indian dinner box before proceeding to the train station for an overnight journey to Shanghai.

itinerary.title: Explore Hangzhou
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Hangzhou Railway Station, our tour representatives will be there to welcome you and assist with your transfer to the Flower and Fishpond. Enjoy a delightful boat ride on West Lake and visit a Hangzhou silk shop. In the evening, relish an Indian dinner at the same location.

itinerary.title: Hangzhou to Shanghai by Car
itinerary.description: Begin the day by checking out from the hotel at 10:00 AM. Your first stop is the Lingyin Temple, where you can seek blessings. Afterward, you will embark on a car journey to Shanghai. Upon your arrival, explore People Square and Nanjing Road for some shopping. You also have the choice to visit the Madame Tussauds wax museum in Shanghai. Continue your day with a visit to the picturesque Yuyuan Garden, where you can admire the Nine Zig Zag Bridge, the Golden Fishpond, and various bridges and pavilions. Don't forget to explore the vibrant Yu Market and Taoist temple in Shanghai. An optional program is available from 7:00 PM to 9:00 PM. In the evening, immerse yourself in the nightlife of Xintiandi, known for its lively music and dancing. Conclude the day with dinner at an Indian restaurant before returning to your hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Shanghai
itinerary.description: Start your day early by visiting the renowned Jade Buddha Temple, the most famous Buddhist temple in Shanghai. Take a break at a tea shop and savor a cup of robust tea. Next, head to Taobao City for some shopping. In the afternoon, you have the option to visit the Shanghai Aquarium after 4:00 PM. In the evening, explore the Bund and make a visit to the 2nd level of the Oriental Pearl TV tower. Additionally, consider the optional program of a Huangpu River Cruise.

itinerary.title: Shanghai to India - by International Flight
itinerary.description: Enjoy a leisurely morning and have breakfast at your convenience. Then, you will be transferred to the International Airport for your flight back home. As an alternative, you can choose to experience the Maglev Train on your way to Pudong Airport.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Beijing
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Beijing International Airport, you will be warmly greeted by our tour representatives, who will assist you in transferring to your hotel. After a smooth check-in, you can take the rest of the day to relax and explore the city at your own pace. Your overnight accommodation will be at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Exploring Beijing
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a hearty breakfast at the hotel. Your first destination will be the magnificent Summer Palace, where you can marvel at the enchanting Marble Boat, stroll along the stunning Long Corridor, and shop for pearls. Following that, you will visit the renowned Tian’anmen Square, the largest square in the world. Don't forget to explore the historic Forbidden City, which served as the imperial palace for the Ming and Qing dynasties for over 500 years. In the afternoon, enjoy a delightful Rickshaw tour, also known as a Hutong tour. Continuing your journey, you will explore the charming Houhai Lake and its vibrant surroundings in the heart of Beijing. This area is celebrated for its lively nightlife, with numerous popular restaurants, cafes, pubs, and bars. It attracts tourists from around the world each year. In the evening, you'll be treated to a mesmerising Kung Fu show. Return to the hotel for a restful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Beijing
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a hearty breakfast, then venture to the legendary Great Wall at Juyong Pass, an esteemed UNESCO World Heritage Site. This colossal fortification was ingeniously constructed to safeguard against unwelcome intrusions. Following this, pay a visit to the Longdi Jade shop to immerse yourself in the fascinating world of Chinese jade culture. As noon approaches, explore the remarkable Bird’s Nest, the Olympic National Stadium, and the iconic Water Cube from the outside. If you fancy some retail therapy, don't miss the Yaxiu market, and in the evening, treat yourself to an enthralling Acrobatic show. You'll spend the night at your comfortable hotel.

itinerary.title: Beijing Departure
itinerary.description: Kickstart your morning with a delicious breakfast, and if you're in the mood for some last-minute shopping, seize the opportunity. Afterwards, head back to the airport to catch your departing flight.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Siem Reap
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival in Cambodia, you will be greeted by our tour representatives who will help you get to Siem Reap. Once you reach the hotel and complete the check-in formalities, freshen up and venture out to explore the city of Siem Reap. Start off by visiting East Mebon, a 10th century temple which was built during the rule of King Rajendravarman. Explore the temples of Neak Poan and Prasat Preah Khan later in the day. Witness an enchanting Apsara Dance while having your dinner. Stay the night at your hotel.

itinerary.title: Siem Reap Exploration
itinerary.description: Enjoy a beautiful sunrise in the morning and then proceed to the land of Angkor, which is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Visit the temple known as Banteay Srei, a 10th century temple dedicated to Lord Shiva and Goddess Parvati. Yet another temple to visit in Angkor is Banteay Samre, which was built in the early 11th century. The other places you will be taken to today are Ta Prohm Temple, Banteay Kdei, Prasat Kravan, Prasat Chau Say Tevoda, and Thommanon. Go back to Siem Reap for the night.

itinerary.title: Siem Reap Exploration
itinerary.description: After enjoying a delicious breakfast, get ready to visit some more temples situated in Angkor. The ones you will be going to are Bayon Temple and Baphuon Temple, as well as Angkor Thom, which was the capital city of the Khmer Empire. Later, you will be taken to visit the Terrace of the Elephants, which is a ruined temple complex, and the Terrace of the Leper King, situated on the north of the Terrace of the Elephants. Make a stop at the west gate of Angkor Thom before making your way to Phnom Bakheng. Head back to Siem Reap for dinner, after which you can either head out to a pub or opt for a relaxing foot massage. Spend the night at your hotel.

itinerary.title: Siem Reap - Phnom Penh - Sihanoukville
itinerary.description: In the morning, board a flight to Phnom Penh and drive down to Sihanoukville. Upon reaching your hotel, you can go out after freshening up and relaxing for a bit. Visit one of the many islands that Sihanoukville is home to and partake in fun activities such as snorkelling, scuba diving, and kayaking. Get back to your hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: Sihanoukville - Bamboo Island
itinerary.description: In the morning, get on a boat to witness the islands of Sihanoukville. You will also be taken to Bamboo Island, after which you can engage in thrilling activities like swimming, sunbathing, and scuba diving. Get back to Sihanoukville and spend the night at your hotel.

itinerary.title: Sihanoukville - Phnom Penh
itinerary.description: Today, you will be leaving for Phnom Penh to explore some of its most beloved tourist attractions. Check out the Royal Palace, which was built to serve as the official residence of the King of Cambodia. Witness the beauty of the Silver Pagoda, a Buddhist temple located within the Royal Palace. Visit the Independence Monument and National Museum of Cambodia before returning to your hotel.

itinerary.title: Depart Phnom Penh
itinerary.description: Before leaving for the airport, check out the Tuol Sleng Genocide Museum, a museum that chronicles the Cambodian genocide. Proceed to board your flight back home.
